## Wave 5: binaries

**Spec:** §3 (all), §4.3 Wave 5 (5.1-5.6), §4.5 (dependency guards, exec guard),
§10.3.1-§10.3.5 (test relocation), §11.1 step 8. Spec file:
`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-06-manager-agent-split-design.md`.

**Goal.** Five binaries replace `cmd/clustarr`, `cmd/segmentarr-worker` and
`cmd/squasharr-worker`: `cmd/manager`, `cmd/agent`, `cmd/ui` (cobra, command
trees in `internal/cli/<bin>`), and the renamed `cmd/markers` and
`cmd/transcode` (pflag). Engine and pool pods get an explicit `command`
(`pkg/binpath`), every `cmd/clustarr` test lands in its new home, and
`cmd/clustarr` plus the six `app/<svc>` root packages are deleted.

### Wave-specific rules

- **Runs after W1-W4** (§11.1 step 8 depends on steps 3-7). W5.1 checks every
  symbol this wave consumes before anything is written.
- **`cmd/clustarr` keeps compiling and passing until W5.17**, which deletes it.
  Until then every helper a new home needs is an adapted **copy** (W5.4, W5.16):
  `git mv` of a `cmd/clustarr` test file would strand the helpers its siblings
  still call (`rbacRoles`, `identityKubeconfigs`, `decodeRendered`, ...).
- **No installer, chart, kustomize or image content changes in W5.** They are the
  installers wave's (§11.1 step 9). The only exceptions are mechanical: the two
  Dockerfile build paths the `git mv` renames break (W5.12) and the deleted root
  package in `RBAC_PATHS_grabarr` (W5.17). So the installers still run
  `clustarr <svc> --role ...` after W5, a binary that no longer exists. That
  window is accepted (nothing deploys, R14), and guards that read installers
  keep guarding them in transitional form (W5.16) until the installers wave
  rewrites them. The two guards that cannot survive the window are handed off
  explicitly (table below).
- **RBAC role names are not recut in W5** (§4.6's `manager`/`agent-*` roles are
  installer-bound). Start envtests run each new identity under the roles that
  hold its grants today, through `starttest.RolesFor` (W5.4); the installers
  wave replaces that bridge with one role per identity.
- **Every new `.go` file starts with `hack/boilerplate.go.txt` verbatim**; the
  snippets below omit it.
- **Envtest packages in this wave:** `internal/cli/manager`, `internal/cli/agent`,

```go
package cli_test

import (
 "bytes"
 "os/exec"
 "runtime"

 "testing"

 "github.com/spf13/cobra"

)

func execute(t *testing.T, cmd *cobra.Command, args ...string) (string, error) {
 t.Helper()
 var out bytes.Buffer
 cmd.SetOut(&out)
 cmd.SetErr(&out)
 cmd.SetArgs(args)
 err := cmd.Execute()
 return out.String(), err
}

// -v is klog's verbosity; a manifest writing it must not get a version print.
func TestVersionFlagHasNoShorthand(t *testing.T) {
 root, _, _ := cli.NewRoot("manager", "short", "long")
 f := root.Flags().Lookup("version")
 require.NotNil(t, f)
 assert.Empty(t, f.Shorthand)
 out, err := execute(t, root, "--version")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, "manager "+version.String()+"\n", out)
}

func TestVersionCommandPrintsTheBinaryAndToolchain(t *testing.T) {
 root, _, _ := cli.NewRoot("agent", "short", "long")
 out, err := execute(t, root, "version")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Contains(t, out, "agent "+version.String()+"\n")
 assert.Contains(t, out, "go "+runtime.Version()+" "+runtime.GOOS+"/"+runtime.GOARCH)
}

func TestVersionCommandTakesNoArguments(t *testing.T) {
 root, _, _ := cli.NewRoot("ui", "short", "long")
 _, err := execute(t, root, "version", "extra")
 require.Error(t, err)
}

 root, lo, to := cli.NewRoot("manager", "short", "long")
 require.NotNil(t, lo)
 require.NotNil(t, to)
 for _, name := range []string{"log-level", "log-format", "log-add-source",
  "tracing-enabled", "tracing-endpoint", "tracing-insecure", "tracing-sample-ratio"} {
  assert.NotNil(t, root.PersistentFlags().Lookup(name), name)
 }
}

func TestEnvOr(t *testing.T) {
 t.Setenv("CLUSTARR_TEST_ENV_OR", "")
 assert.Equal(t, "fallback", cli.EnvOr("CLUSTARR_TEST_ENV_OR", "fallback"))

  want     bool

  assert.Equal(t, tc.want, cli.EnvBoolOr("CLUSTARR_TEST_ENV_BOOL", tc.fallback), tc.value)
```

```go
func names(fs *pflag.FlagSet) map[string]bool {

 fs.VisitAll(func(f *pflag.Flag) { out[f.Name] = true })
 return out
}

func TestBindManagerBindsElevenFlagsAndElectsByDefault(t *testing.T) {
 fs := pflag.NewFlagSet("manager", pflag.ContinueOnError)
 o := ctrlflags.BindManager(fs)
 require.NoError(t, fs.Parse(nil))
 assert.Len(t, names(fs), 11)
 assert.True(t, o.LeaderElect, "every controller manifest passed --leader-elect; the manager defaults it on")
 require.NoError(t, fs.Parse([]string{"--leader-elect=false", "--nats-single-node"}))
 assert.False(t, o.LeaderElect)
 assert.True(t, o.BusSingleNode)
}

 o := ctrlflags.BindAgent(fs)
 got := names(fs)
 assert.Len(t, got, 8)
 for _, retired := range []string{"leader-elect", "leader-election-namespace", "nats-single-node"} {

 }{
```

```go
// Package cli is the plumbing the cobra binaries (manager, agent, ui) share
// (spec §3.2). It imports only cobra, pflag, pkg/version, pkg/obs/obsflags,
// pkg/fsops and controller-runtime's signals package, so cmd/ui links no
// manager and no pkg/k8s (TestCLIStaysLight).
package cli

const (
 EnvNamespace               = "POD_NAMESPACE"
 EnvNATSURL                 = "NATS_URL"
 EnvIndexPath               = "CLUSTARR_INDEX_PATH"
 EnvIndexDSN                = "CLUSTARR_INDEX_DSN"
 EnvFacadeBindAddress       = "CLUSTARR_FACADE_BIND_ADDRESS"
 EnvFacadeAPIKeySecret      = "CLUSTARR_FACADE_API_KEY_SECRET"
 EnvNativeImage             = "CLUSTARR_NATIVE_IMAGE" // was CLUSTARR_ENGINE_IMAGE and CLUSTARR_WORKER_IMAGE (§3.11)
 EnvGPUNodeLabelNVIDIA      = "CLUSTARR_GPU_NODE_LABEL_NVIDIA"
 EnvGPUNodeLabelIntel       = "CLUSTARR_GPU_NODE_LABEL_INTEL"
 EnvDataClaim               = "CLUSTARR_DATA_CLAIM"
 EnvEngineServiceAccount    = "CLUSTARR_ENGINE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT"
 EnvTraktBaseURL            = "CLUSTARR_TRAKT_BASE_URL"
 EnvPlexBaseURL             = "CLUSTARR_PLEX_BASE_URL"
 EnvIntelRenderGroups       = "CLUSTARR_INTEL_RENDER_GROUPS"
 EnvCardigannDefinitionsDir = "CLUSTARR_CARDIGANN_DEFINITIONS_DIR"
 EnvCardigannBundled        = "CLUSTARR_CARDIGANN_BUNDLED"
 EnvExternalURL             = "CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_URL"
 EnvArtSigningKey           = "CLUSTARR_ART_SIGNING_KEY"
 EnvExternalMetricsService  = "CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_METRICS_SERVICE"
 EnvExternalMetricsSecret   = "CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_METRICS_SECRET"
)

// EnvOr returns $name when it is set and non-empty, else fallback.
func EnvOr(name, fallback string) string {
 if v := os.Getenv(name); v != "" {
  return v
 }
 return fallback
}

// EnvBoolOr returns $name parsed as a bool when it parses, else fallback.
func EnvBoolOr(name string, fallback bool) bool {
 if v, err := strconv.ParseBool(os.Getenv(name)); err == nil {
  return v
 }
 return fallback
}
```

`internal/cli/root.go`:

```go
// NewRoot is a binary's root command: --version without a shorthand (klog's
// -v), the --log-* and --tracing-* flags bound once on PersistentFlags, and
// the version subcommand. Errors are printed once, by Main.
func NewRoot(binary, short, long string) (*cobra.Command, *logging.Options, *tracing.Options) {
 root := &cobra.Command{
  Use: binary, Short: short, Long: long,
  Version: version.String(), SilenceUsage: true, SilenceErrors: true,
 }
 root.SetVersionTemplate(binary + " {{.Version}}\n")
 lo, to := obsflags.Bind(root.PersistentFlags())
 root.InitDefaultVersionFlag()
 if f := root.Flags().Lookup("version"); f != nil {
  f.Shorthand = ""
 }
 root.AddCommand(NewVersionCommand(binary))
 return root, lo, to
}

// NewVersionCommand prints "<binary> <version>" and the Go toolchain.
func NewVersionCommand(binary string) *cobra.Command {
 return &cobra.Command{
  Use: "version", Short: "Print the " + binary + " version", Args: cobra.NoArgs, SilenceUsage: true,
  RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
   out := cmd.OutOrStdout()
   if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s %s\n", binary, version.String()); err != nil {
    return err
   }
   _, err := fmt.Fprintf(out, "go %s %s/%s\n", runtime.Version(), runtime.GOOS, runtime.GOARCH)
   return err
  },
 }
}

// ApplyUmask is a PersistentPreRunE: the process umask from $UMASK (design
// §11), set once before any subcommand runs.
func ApplyUmask(*cobra.Command, []string) error { return fsops.ApplyUmaskFromEnv() }
```

`internal/cli/main.go`:

```go
// Main runs newCmd() under a signal context. controller-runtime's
// pkg/manager/signals is stdlib-only; its root re-export would link the
// manager into cmd/ui. A second signal exits 1 (the signals package), as does
// any error from RunE.
func Main(newCmd func() *cobra.Command) {
 ctx := signals.SetupSignalHandler()
 if err := newCmd().ExecuteContext(ctx); err != nil {
  fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "error:", err)
  os.Exit(1)
 }
}
```

```go
// AgentManagerOptions renders ctrl.Options for one agent domain (§3.5.2
// step 5): no lease, controllers declared non-leader, Secret and ConfigMap
// uncached, the pinned default field owner.
func (o Options) AgentManagerOptions() ctrl.Options {
 opts := o.ManagerOptions("", false)
 opts.Controller.NeedLeaderElection = new(false)
 opts.Client.FieldOwner = string(DefaultFieldOwner)
 opts.Client.Cache = &client.CacheOptions{DisableFor: []client.Object{&corev1.Secret{}, &corev1.ConfigMap{}}}
 return opts
}
```

```go
// RolesFor is the bridge between §10.2.4's identities and the roles RBAC_ROLES
// generates before the installers wave recuts them (§4.6). It reads RBAC_ROLES,
// so a role W4 added for app/autoscale is in the manager's set without a list
// here. The installers wave replaces the body with `return []string{identity}`.
func RolesFor(t testing.TB, identity string) []string {
 t.Helper()
 switch identity {
 case "manager":
  var out []string
  for _, r := range installtest.RBACRoles(t, installtest.RepoRoot(t)) {
   if r.Name != "grabarr-engine" {
    out = append(out, r.Name)
   }
  }
  return out
 case "agent-catalog", "agent-events", "agent-metadata":
  return []string{"catalogarr"}
 case "agent-import":
  return []string{"importarr"}
 case "agent-index":
  return []string{"indexarr"}
 case "agent-caption":
  return []string{"captionarr"}
 case "grabarr-engine", "ui":
  return []string{identity}
 }
 t.Fatalf("no RBAC identity %q", identity)
 return nil
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement.**

```go
// EngineCommand is the argv an engine container runs (spec §3.5.5): the agent
// binary with one --domain, no shell. A torrent pod names its DownloadClient
// and derives its "<client>-<ordinal>" from $POD_NAME in Go
// (torrent.EngineIdentity); a usenet engine is always ordinal 0 (CEL).
// cmd/agent's engine_argv_test parses exactly this output.
func EngineCommand(dc *downloadv1alpha1.DownloadClient, dataDir, scratchDir string) (command, args []string) {
 command = []string{binpath.Agent}
 if dc.Spec.Torrent != nil {
  args = []string{"--domain=torrent-engine", "--download-client=" + dc.Name, "--data-dir=" + dataDir}
  if sc := scratchSpec(dc); sc != nil {
   dir := scratchDir
   if sc.Path != "" {
    dir = sc.Path
   }
   args = append(args, "--scratch-dir="+dir)
  }
  return command, args
 }
 scratch, publish := engineDirs(dc, scratchDir)
 args = []string{"--domain=usenet-engine", "--engine=" + dc.Name + "-0", "--data-dir=" + dataDir, "--scratch-dir=" + scratch}
 if publish != "" {
  args = append(args, "--publish-dir="+publish)
 }
 return command, args
}
```

  `torrentContainer` drops `script`/`WithCommand("/bin/sh", "-c")`/`WithArgs(script)` for
  `cmd, args := EngineCommand(dc, dataDir, scratchDir)` then `.WithCommand(cmd...).WithArgs(args...)`

```go
// EngineIdentity is the torrent engine's "<client>-<ordinal>" (spec §3.5.5),
// the engine label its Downloads carry. podName must be the StatefulSet
// replica "<client>-engine-<N>" with N decimal: anything else fails at start
// rather than claiming ordinal "abc12".
func EngineIdentity(client, podName string) (string, error) {
 n, ok := strings.CutPrefix(podName, client+"-engine-")
 if client == "" || !ok || n == "" || strings.Trim(n, "0123456789") != "" {
  return "", fmt.Errorf("torrent engine: pod %q is not a replica of DownloadClient %q's StatefulSet (%s-engine-<N>)",
   podName, client, client)
 }
 return client + "-" + n, nil
}

// PodName is $POD_NAME, else the hostname (which a StatefulSet pod's is).
func PodName(getenv func(string) string, hostname func() (string, error)) (string, error) {
 if p := getenv("POD_NAME"); p != "" {
  return p, nil
 }
 return hostname()
}
```

```go
package manager

// recordingManager forwards everything to a real manager but records the
// field indexes registration asks for, without touching the cache, and the
// type of every runnable registration adds.
type recordingManager struct {
 ctrl.Manager
 indexes map[string]bool // "<Kind> <name>"
 added   []string        // fmt.Sprintf("%T", runnable), in order
}

func (m *recordingManager) GetFieldIndexer() client.FieldIndexer { return recordingIndexer{m} }

func (m *recordingManager) Add(r manager.Runnable) error {
 m.added = append(m.added, fmt.Sprintf("%T", r))
 return m.Manager.Add(r)
}

type recordingIndexer struct{ m *recordingManager }

func (r recordingIndexer) IndexField(_ context.Context, obj client.Object, field string, _ client.IndexerFunc) error {
 gvk, err := apiutil.GVKForObject(obj, r.m.GetScheme())
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 r.m.indexes[gvk.Kind+" "+field] = true
 return nil
}
```

  In the same file, the autoscale step's wiring (§9.4, W4.74): `register` calls
  `autoscale.Register` whether `--autoscale` is on or off, and passes the flag as
  `Options.Enabled`. `manager.Runnable` above is `sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/manager`'s;
  importing it unaliased inside package `manager` is legal, since a package's own
  name is not in its scope.

```go
// TestRegisterWiresAutoscaleByTheFlag holds §9.4: QueueGauge runs with or
// without --autoscale; only with it do the HPA reconciler, the External
// Metrics server, CertManager and NamespaceGuard run; without it a
// leader-only pass (k8s.LeaderOnly) deletes the HPAs the manager labelled.
func TestRegisterWiresAutoscaleByTheFlag(t *testing.T) {
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 run := func(enabled bool) *recordingManager {
  o := DefaultOptions()
  o.Namespace, o.NativeImage, o.SkipNameValidation = "default", "native:test", true
  o.Autoscale = enabled
  o.ExternalMetricsBindAddress = "127.0.0.1:0" // Server.Runnable listens at construction (W4.70)
  mgr, err := ctrl.NewManager(env.Config, managerOptions(o))
  require.NoError(t, err)
  rec := &recordingManager{Manager: mgr, indexes: map[string]bool{}}
  names, err := register(rec, membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock()), o)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  assert.Contains(t, names, "autoscale", "the autoscale step runs with --autoscale=%v", enabled)
  return rec
 }
 count := func(added []string, prefix string) int {
  n := 0
  for _, a := range added {
   if strings.HasPrefix(a, prefix) {
    n++
   }
  }
  return n
 }
 const ctrlType = "*controller.Controller[" // controller-runtime's internal controller, which the builder Adds
 on, off := run(true), run(false)

 for _, rec := range []*recordingManager{on, off} {
  assert.Contains(t, rec.added, "*extmetrics.QueueGauge", "QueueGauge runs whatever --autoscale says")
 }
 for _, typ := range []string{"*manager.Server", "*extmetrics.CertManager", "*extmetrics.NamespaceGuard"} {
  assert.Contains(t, on.added, typ, "--autoscale adds %s", typ)
  assert.NotContains(t, off.added, typ, "--autoscale=false adds no %s", typ)
 }
 // Other registrations add LeaderOnly runnables too (history replay, the
 // bundle loader), so the HPA cleanup shows as exactly one more of them.
 assert.Equal(t, count(on.added, "k8s.LeaderOnly")+1, count(off.added, "k8s.LeaderOnly"),
  "--autoscale=false deletes the labelled HPAs once, as the leader")
 assert.Equal(t, count(off.added, ctrlType)+1, count(on.added, ctrlType),
  "exactly one more controller, the HPA reconciler \"autoscale\", with --autoscale")
}
```

```go
// Package manager is cmd/manager's command tree (spec §3.4): every reconciler
// in one leader-elected process under the lease manager.clustarr.io.
package manager

const LeaderElectionID = "manager.clustarr.io"

type Options struct {
 k8s.Options
 Logging logging.Options
 Tracing tracing.Options

 DataDir              string // grabarr, squasharr, captionarr --data-dir and importarr --data-path, merged
 EngineScratchDir     string // grabarr's controller --scratch-dir, renamed
 NativeImage          string // grabarr --engine-image and squasharr --worker-image, merged (§13 OD3)
 DataClaim            string
 EngineServiceAccount string

 Slots             map[string]int32
 IntelRenderGroups []int64
 NodeLabelNVIDIA   string
 NodeLabelIntel    string
 JobWindow         int
 JobRetention      time.Duration
 GraftConcurrency  int

 CardigannDefinitionsDir string
 CardigannBundled        bool
 TraktBaseURL            string

 Autoscale                  bool
 ExternalMetricsBindAddress string
 ExternalMetricsService     string
 ExternalMetricsSecret      string
 LegacyLeaseCheck           bool

 // Test seams; production leaves them zero. RESTConfig nil reads the
 // kubeconfig; SkipNameValidation lets one test binary start the manager
 // twice (controller names are process-global).
 RESTConfig         *rest.Config
 SkipNameValidation bool
}

func DefaultOptions() Options {
 o := Options{Options: k8s.DefaultOptions()}
 o.LeaderElect = true
 o.DataDir, o.EngineScratchDir = "/data", "/scratch"
 o.DataClaim, o.EngineServiceAccount = downloadclient.DefaultDataClaimName, downloadclient.DefaultEngineServiceAccount
 o.Slots = squashmanager.DefaultSlots()
 o.NodeLabelNVIDIA, o.NodeLabelIntel = pool.DefaultNodeLabelNVIDIA, pool.DefaultNodeLabelIntel
 o.JobWindow, o.JobRetention = squashmanager.DefaultJobWindow, squashmanager.DefaultJobRetention
 o.GraftConcurrency = audiograft.DefaultConcurrency
 o.CardigannBundled = true
 o.Autoscale = true
 o.ExternalMetricsBindAddress, o.ExternalMetricsService, o.ExternalMetricsSecret = ":6443", "external-metrics", "external-metrics-tls"
 o.LegacyLeaseCheck = true
 return o
}

// Validate is §3.4.1's check, run before anything touches the cluster.
func (o Options) Validate() error {
 var errs []error
 for _, req := range []struct{ flag, value string }{
  {"--nats-url", o.NATSURL}, {"--native-image", o.NativeImage}, {"--data-claim", o.DataClaim},
  {"--engine-service-account", o.EngineServiceAccount}, {"--data-dir", o.DataDir},
 } {
  if strings.TrimSpace(req.value) == "" {
   errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("%s is required", req.flag))
  }
 }
 for _, l := range []struct{ flag, key string }{
  {"--gpu-node-label-nvidia", o.NodeLabelNVIDIA}, {"--gpu-node-label-intel", o.NodeLabelIntel},
 } {
  if msgs := validation.IsQualifiedName(l.key); len(msgs) > 0 {
   errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("%s %q: %s", l.flag, l.key, strings.Join(msgs, "; ")))
  }
 }
 if o.Autoscale && (o.ExternalMetricsBindAddress == "" || o.ExternalMetricsBindAddress == k8s.DisabledBindAddress) {
  errs = append(errs, errors.New("--autoscale needs --external-metrics-bind-address; pass --autoscale=false to run without the External Metrics API"))
 }
 if err := o.Options.Validate(); err != nil {
  errs = append(errs, err)
 }
 return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// managerOptions is §5.6's one merged cache.
func managerOptions(o Options) ctrl.Options {
 opts := o.Options.ManagerOptions(LeaderElectionID, o.LeaderElect)
 opts.Client.FieldOwner = string(k8s.DefaultFieldOwner)
 opts.Client.Cache = &client.CacheOptions{DisableFor: []client.Object{&corev1.Secret{}, &corev1.ConfigMap{}}}
 opts.Cache.ByObject = map[client.Object]cache.ByObject{&batchv1.Job{}: transcodejob.PoolJobCache(o.Namespace)}
 if o.SkipNameValidation {
  opts.Controller.SkipNameValidation = new(true)
 }
 return opts
}
```

```go
type RunFunc func(context.Context, Options) error

func NewCommand() *cobra.Command { return NewCommandWith(Run) }

 root.RunE = func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
  o := d
  o.Options = *common
  o.Logging, o.Tracing = *lo, *to
  var err error
  if o.Slots, err = squashmanager.ParseSlots(slots); err != nil {
   return fmt.Errorf("--slots: %w", err)
  }
  if o.IntelRenderGroups, err = ctrlflags.ParseGIDs(renderGroups); err != nil {
   return fmt.Errorf("--intel-render-groups: %w", err)
  }
  if err := o.Validate(); err != nil {
   return err
  }
  return run(cmd.Context(), o)
 }
```

`internal/cli/manager/run.go` (§3.4.2 in order):

```go
func Run(ctx context.Context, o Options) error {
 if err := o.Validate(); err != nil { // 1
  return err
 }
 to := o.Tracing
 to.ServiceName = "manager"
 ctx, shutdown, err := obs.Bootstrap(ctx, o.Logging, to) // 2
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 defer shutdown()
 log := logging.FromContext(ctx)
 k8s.RegisterRESTClientMetrics() // 3

 cfg := o.RESTConfig // 4
 if cfg == nil {
  if cfg, err = ctrl.GetConfig(); err != nil {
   return fmt.Errorf("manager: kubeconfig: %w", err)
  }
 }
 opts := managerOptions(o)
 if o.LeaderElect && o.LegacyLeaseCheck {
  lock, err := k8s.NewGatedLeaseLock(cfg, opts.LeaderElectionNamespace, LeaderElectionID)
  if err != nil {
   return fmt.Errorf("manager: legacy lease gate: %w", err)
  }
  opts.LeaderElectionResourceLockInterface = lock
 }
 mgr, err := ctrl.NewManager(cfg, k8s.WithBaseContext(opts, ctx))
 if err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("manager: %w", err)
 }

 bus, nc, err := busconn.Connect(o.NATSURL, "manager", busconn.WithHooks(obs.BusHooks())) // 5
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 defer nc.Close()
 defer func() { _ = bus.Close() }()
 top := o.BusTopology()
 if err := busconn.EnsureTopology(ctx, bus, top); err != nil { // 6
  return err
 }
 if err := mgr.Add(k8s.LeaderOnly(func(ctx context.Context) error { return busconn.KeepTopology(ctx, nc, bus, top) })); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := mgr.Add(k8s.LeaderOnly(func(ctx context.Context) error { return busconn.WatchDeadLetters(ctx, bus, top) })); err != nil {
  return err
 }

 var ready, live k8s.Checks // 7
 if err := ready.Add("jetstream", busconn.ReadyChecker(nc, bus)); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 cacheReady, err := k8s.CacheSyncChecker(mgr)
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := ready.Add("cache", cacheReady); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 components, err := register(mgr, bus, o) // 8
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := k8s.AddProbes(mgr, &ready, &live); err != nil { // 9
  return err
 }
 log.Info("starting", "components", components, "lease", LeaderElectionID, "leaderElection", o.LeaderElect) // 10
 if err := mgr.Start(ctx); err != nil { // 11
  return fmt.Errorf("manager: %w", err)
 }
 return nil
}

// Imports (aliased: every registration package is named manager):
//   catalogmanager "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/manager"
//   importmanager  "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/import/manager"
//   indexermanager "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/indexer/manager"
//   grabmanager    "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/grab/manager"
//   squashmanager  "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/squash/manager"
//   captionmanager "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/caption/manager"
//   "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/autoscale"

// register adds every manager-side component in §3.4.2's fixed order.
func register(mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) ([]string, error) {
 steps := []struct {
  name string
  add  func() error
 }{
  {"catalog", func() error { return catalogmanager.Register(mgr, bus, catalogmanager.Options{Options: o.Options}) }},
  {"import", func() error {
   return importmanager.Register(mgr, bus, importmanager.Options{Options: o.Options, TraktBaseURL: o.TraktBaseURL})
  }},
  {"index", func() error {
   return indexermanager.Register(mgr, bus, indexermanager.Options{Options: o.Options,
    CardigannDefinitionsDir: o.CardigannDefinitionsDir, CardigannBundled: o.CardigannBundled})
  }},
  {"grab", func() error {
   return grabmanager.Register(mgr, bus, grabmanager.Options{Options: o.Options, DataDir: o.DataDir,
    ScratchDir: o.EngineScratchDir, EngineImage: o.NativeImage, DataClaimName: o.DataClaim,
    EngineServiceAccount: o.EngineServiceAccount})
  }},
  {"squash", func() error {
   return squashmanager.Register(mgr, bus, squashmanager.Options{Options: o.Options, Slots: o.Slots,
    DataDir: o.DataDir, WorkerImage: o.NativeImage, DataClaimName: o.DataClaim,
    IntelRenderGroups: o.IntelRenderGroups, NodeLabelNVIDIA: o.NodeLabelNVIDIA, NodeLabelIntel: o.NodeLabelIntel,
    JobWindow: o.JobWindow, JobRetention: o.JobRetention, GraftConcurrency: o.GraftConcurrency,
    Logging: o.Logging, Tracing: o.Tracing})
  }},
  {"caption", func() error { return captionmanager.Register(mgr, bus, captionmanager.Options{Options: o.Options, DataDir: o.DataDir}) }},
 }
 // The autoscale step runs whatever --autoscale says (§9.4): QueueGauge is
 // always added, and with --autoscale=false Register's leader-only pass
 // deletes every HPA a previous release's manager labelled. Enabled, not
 // the presence of the step, is what turns the reconciler, the External
 // Metrics server, CertManager and NamespaceGuard on (W4.74).
 steps = append(steps, struct {
  name string
  add  func() error
 }{"autoscale", func() error {
  admin, ok := bus.(events.StreamAdmin)
  if !ok {
   return fmt.Errorf("manager: autoscaling needs a bus that reports consumer state; %T does not", bus)
  }
  return autoscale.Register(mgr, admin, autoscale.Options{
   Enabled:     o.Autoscale,
   Namespace:   o.Namespace,
   BindAddress: o.ExternalMetricsBindAddress,
   ServiceName: o.ExternalMetricsService,
   SecretName:  o.ExternalMetricsSecret,
  })
 }})
 var names []string
 for _, s := range steps {
  if err := s.add(); err != nil {
   return nil, fmt.Errorf("manager: register %s: %w", s.name, err)
  }
  names = append(names, s.name)
 }
 return names, nil
}
```

```go
package main

func managerCase(t *testing.T, cfg *rest.Config, natsURL string) (manager.Options, string, string) {
 t.Helper()
 o := manager.DefaultOptions()
 o.Namespace = "default"
 o.NATSURL, o.BusSingleNode = natsURL, true
 o.MetricsBindAddress = k8s.DisabledBindAddress
 o.HealthProbeBindAddress = starttest.FreeAddress(t)
 o.ExternalMetricsBindAddress = starttest.FreeAddress(t)
 o.NativeImage = "ghcr.io/mediactl/clustarr/native:dev"
 o.EngineServiceAccount = "media-clustarr-grabarr-engine"
 o.DataDir = t.TempDir()
 o.GracefulShutdownTimeout = 10 * time.Second
 o.RESTConfig, o.SkipNameValidation = cfg, true
 return o, o.HealthProbeBindAddress, o.ExternalMetricsBindAddress
}

func start(t *testing.T, o manager.Options) (cancel func()) {
 t.Helper()
 ctx, stop := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 done := make(chan error, 1)
 go func() { done <- manager.Run(ctx, o) }()
 t.Cleanup(func() {
  stop()
  select {
  case err := <-done:
   assert.NoError(t, err, "Run on a clean shutdown")
  case <-time.After(30 * time.Second):
   t.Error("Run did not return within 30s of its context ending")
  }
 })
 select {
 case err := <-done:
  t.Fatalf("Run returned before serving probes: %v", err)
 case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
 }
 return stop
}

func TestManagerStartsServesProbesAndStopsOnSignal(t *testing.T) {
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 natsURL := starttest.EmbeddedNATS(t)
 kcs := starttest.IdentityKubeconfigs(t, env, []string{"manager"})
 cfg := starttest.RESTConfig(t, kcs["manager"])
 admin, err := client.New(env.Config, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 createInstallerAPIService(t, env.Config) // apiregistration.k8s.io/v1 v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io -> default/external-metrics:443, no caBundle

 // Readiness never waits on leader-only work (§3.3, §9.4): the C12a proof
 // app/import/all (non-leader) carried.
 t.Run("non-leader", func(t *testing.T) {
  starttest.HoldLease(t, env.Config, "default", manager.LeaderElectionID)
  o, probe, extmetrics := managerCase(t, cfg, natsURL)
  start(t, o)
  starttest.WaitForProbe(t, "http://"+probe+"/healthz")
  starttest.WaitForProbe(t, "http://"+probe+"/readyz")
  _, err := tls.Dial("tcp", extmetrics, &tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true}) //nolint:gosec // only the handshake is observed
  require.Error(t, err, "no serving Secret yet: the External Metrics server must refuse the handshake")
  assertNoAutoscaleWrites(t, admin) // no HPA, no external-metrics-tls Secret, APIService caBundle empty
 })

 t.Run("leader", func(t *testing.T) {
  starttest.ReleaseLease(t, env.Config, "default", manager.LeaderElectionID)
  o, probe, extmetrics := managerCase(t, cfg, natsURL)
  starttest.AssertWroteOnlyAs(t, admin, "manager", func() {
   start(t, o)
   starttest.WaitForProbe(t, "http://"+probe+"/readyz")
   verifyBundle(t, env.Config)
   verifyRetrigger(t, env.Config)
   verifyCaptionarrController(t, env.Config, o.DataDir)
   verifyGrabController(t, env.Config)
   verifySquashController(t, env.Config)
   verifyExternalMetrics(t, env, admin, extmetrics) // §10.3.3 leader bullet, below
  })
 })
}
```

  `verifyExternalMetrics`: waits for Secret `default/external-metrics-tls`; waits for the

```go
package main

// parse runs the real command tree with a recording RunFunc. POD_NAMESPACE
// is what the downward API sets; the index domain's facade needs it.
func parse(t *testing.T, args ...string) (agent.Options, error) {
 t.Helper()
 t.Setenv("POD_NAMESPACE", "default")

 cmd := agent.NewCommandWith(func(_ context.Context, o agent.Options) error { got = o; return nil })
 cmd.SetOut(io.Discard)
 cmd.SetErr(io.Discard)
 cmd.SetArgs(args)
 return got, cmd.Execute()
}

  {[]string{"--domain=import", "--index-path=/x"}, "--index-path is only meaningful with --domain index"},

  {[]string{"--domain=torrent-engine", "--engine=sab-0", "--publish-dir=/data/x"}, "--publish-dir is only meaningful with --domain usenet-engine"},
 } {
  _, err := parse(t, tc.args...)
  assert.EqualError(t, err, tc.want, "%v", tc.args)
 }
 // An environment default is not "set": NATS_URL and CLUSTARR_INDEX_PATH are fine on any domain.
 t.Setenv("CLUSTARR_INDEX_PATH", "/var/lib/clustarr/index/releases.db")
 _, err := parse(t, "--domain=catalog")

}
```

`internal/cli/agent/options.go`:

```go
// Package agent is cmd/agent's command tree (spec §3.5): one domain per
// process, never elected, never ensuring topology.
package agent

const (
 DefaultIndexPath          = "/var/lib/clustarr/index/releases.db"
 DefaultFacadeBindAddress  = ":8080"
 DefaultFacadeAPIKeySecret = "indexarr-facade"
 defaultTopologyWait       = 45 * time.Second
)

type Options struct {
 k8s.Options
 Domain  string
 Logging logging.Options
 Tracing tracing.Options

 DrainTimeout time.Duration
 TopologyWait time.Duration

 DataDir                   string // import, caption, engines
 SampleMaxBytes            int64  // import
 TraktBaseURL, PlexBaseURL string // import
 IndexPath, IndexDSN       string // index
 FacadeBindAddress         string // index
 FacadeAPIKeySecret        string // index
 DownloadClient            string // torrent-engine
 Engine                    string // engines
 ScratchDir, PublishDir    string // engines

 // Test seams; production leaves them zero.
 RESTConfig         *rest.Config
 WrapBus            func(events.Bus) events.Bus
 SkipNameValidation bool
}

func DefaultOptions() Options {
 return Options{
  Options: k8s.DefaultOptions(), TopologyWait: defaultTopologyWait,
  DataDir: "/data", SampleMaxBytes: fsops.DefaultSampleMaxBytes, ScratchDir: "/scratch",
  IndexPath: DefaultIndexPath, FacadeBindAddress: DefaultFacadeBindAddress, FacadeAPIKeySecret: DefaultFacadeAPIKeySecret,
 }
}

var errDomain = fmt.Errorf("--domain takes exactly one of %s", strings.Join(domainNames, ", "))

func (o Options) Validate() error {
 if _, ok := domains[o.Domain]; !ok {
  return errDomain
 }
 var errs []error
 if strings.TrimSpace(o.NATSURL) == "" {
  errs = append(errs, errors.New("--nats-url is required"))
 }
 switch o.Domain {
 case "import", "caption", "torrent-engine", "usenet-engine":
  if o.DataDir == "" {
   errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("--domain %s needs --data-dir", o.Domain))
  }
 }
 switch o.Domain {
 case "torrent-engine":
  if o.Engine == "" {
   errs = append(errs, errors.New("--domain torrent-engine needs exactly one of --engine or --download-client"))
  }
 case "usenet-engine":
  if o.Engine == "" {
   errs = append(errs, errors.New("--domain usenet-engine needs --engine"))
  }
  if o.ScratchDir == "" {
   errs = append(errs, errors.New("--domain usenet-engine needs --scratch-dir"))
  }
 case "index":
  if o.FacadeBindAddress != k8s.DisabledBindAddress && (o.FacadeAPIKeySecret == "" || o.Namespace == "") {
   errs = append(errs, errors.New("the Torznab facade fails closed: it needs --facade-api-key-secret and --namespace, or --facade-bind-address=0"))
  }
  if o.IndexPath == "" && o.IndexDSN == "" {
   errs = append(errs, errors.New("--index-path is required unless --index-dsn is set"))
  }
 }
 if err := o.Options.Validate(); err != nil {
  errs = append(errs, err)
 }
 return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// managerOptions is AgentManagerOptions plus the test seam.
func managerOptions(o Options) ctrl.Options {
 opts := o.Options.AgentManagerOptions()
 if o.SkipNameValidation {
  opts.Controller.SkipNameValidation = new(true)
 }
 return opts
}

// drainFor is §3.5.6: the longest declared AckWait among the domain's durables.
func drainFor(domain string) time.Duration {
 var longest time.Duration
 top := events.Default()
 for _, d := range agentdomain.Domains() {
  if d.Name != domain {
   continue
  }
  for _, name := range d.Consumers {
   if c, ok := top.Consumer(name); ok && c.AckWait > longest {
    longest = c.AckWait
   }
  }
 }
 return longest
}
```

`internal/cli/agent/domains.go` (§4.2.1; aliases avoid the many packages named `agent`,
and `eventsdomain` keeps `app/catalog/agent/events` from shadowing `pkg/events`):

```go
import (
 catalogagent "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/agent"
 catalogdomain "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/agent/catalog"
 eventsdomain "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/agent/events"
 metadatadomain "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/agent/metadata"
 captionagent "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/caption/agent"
 torrentagent "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/grab/agent/torrent"
 usenetagent "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/grab/agent/usenet"
 importagent "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/import/agent"
 indexeragent "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/indexer/agent"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
)

type registerFunc func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error)

var domainNames = []string{"catalog", "events", "metadata", "import", "index", "caption", "torrent-engine", "usenet-engine"}

// Domains is every --domain value, in §3.5.1's order.
func Domains() []string { return slices.Clone(domainNames) }

var domains = map[string]registerFunc{
 "catalog": func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error) {
  return catalogdomain.Register(ctx, mgr, bus, catalogdomain.Options{Options: o.Options})
 },
 "events": func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error) {
  return eventsdomain.Register(ctx, mgr, bus, eventsdomain.Options{Options: o.Options})
 },
 "metadata": func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error) {
  return metadatadomain.Register(ctx, mgr, bus, metadatadomain.Options{Options: o.Options})
 },
 "import": func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error) {
  return importagent.Register(ctx, mgr, bus, importagent.Options{Options: o.Options, DataDir: o.DataDir,
   SampleMaxBytes: o.SampleMaxBytes, TraktBaseURL: o.TraktBaseURL, PlexBaseURL: o.PlexBaseURL})
 },
 "index": func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error) {
  return indexeragent.Register(ctx, mgr, bus, indexeragent.Options{Options: o.Options, IndexPath: o.IndexPath,
   IndexDSN: o.IndexDSN, FacadeBindAddress: o.FacadeBindAddress, FacadeAPIKeySecret: o.FacadeAPIKeySecret})
 },
 "caption": func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error) {
  return captionagent.Register(ctx, mgr, bus, captionagent.Options{Options: o.Options, DataDir: o.DataDir})
 },
 "torrent-engine": func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error) {
  client, err := engineClient(o.Engine)
  if err != nil {
   return catalogagent.Registration{}, err
  }
  return torrentagent.Register(ctx, mgr, bus, torrentagent.Options{Options: o.Options, Client: client, Engine: o.Engine,
   DataDir: o.DataDir, ScratchDir: o.ScratchDir})
 },
 "usenet-engine": func(ctx context.Context, mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) (catalogagent.Registration, error) {
  client, err := engineClient(o.Engine)
  if err != nil {
   return catalogagent.Registration{}, err
  }
  return usenetagent.Register(ctx, mgr, bus, usenetagent.Options{Options: o.Options, Client: client, Engine: o.Engine,
   DataDir: o.DataDir, ScratchDir: o.ScratchDir, PublishDir: o.PublishDir})
 },
}

// domainFlags names the domains each domain flag belongs to (§3.5.1).
var domainFlags = map[string][]string{
 "data-dir": {"import", "caption", "torrent-engine", "usenet-engine"}, "sample-max-bytes": {"import"},
 "trakt-base-url": {"import"}, "plex-base-url": {"import"},
 "index-path": {"index"}, "index-dsn": {"index"}, "facade-bind-address": {"index"}, "facade-api-key-secret": {"index"},
 "download-client": {"torrent-engine"}, "engine": {"torrent-engine", "usenet-engine"},
 "scratch-dir": {"torrent-engine", "usenet-engine"}, "publish-dir": {"usenet-engine"},
}

// engineClient is the DownloadClient an engine identity "<client>-<ordinal>"
// names: everything before the last hyphen, since a client's own name may
// hold hyphens. Both engines' Register need it (W3.11's Options.Client). It
// is app/grab's splitEngineIdentity, moved here because W5.17 deletes the
// shim. A torrent identity built from --download-client by
// torrentagent.EngineIdentity always splits back to that client.
func engineClient(engine string) (string, error) {
 i := strings.LastIndex(engine, "-")
 if i <= 0 || i == len(engine)-1 {
  return "", fmt.Errorf("--engine %q is not \"<client>-<ordinal>\"", engine)
 }
 return engine[:i], nil
}

// orList renders "a", "a or b", "a, b, c or d".
func orList(xs []string) string {
 if len(xs) == 1 {
  return xs[0]
 }
 return strings.Join(xs[:len(xs)-1], ", ") + " or " + xs[len(xs)-1]
}
```

`internal/cli/agent/command.go`: `NewCommandWith(run RunFunc)` builds

`--domain`, `--drain-timeout`, `--topology-wait` (default 45s), `--self-check` and the domain
flags of §3.5.1 into `d := DefaultOptions()` (env defaults: `--index-path` `cli.EnvIndexPath`,

```go
 root.RunE = func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
  if selfCheck {
   return runSelfCheck(cmd.OutOrStdout())
  }
  o := d
  o.Options = *common
  o.Logging, o.Tracing = *lo, *to
  if _, ok := domains[o.Domain]; !ok {
   return errDomain
  }
  flags := slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(domainFlags))
  for _, f := range flags {
   if cmd.Flags().Changed(f) && !slices.Contains(domainFlags[f], o.Domain) {
    return fmt.Errorf("--%s is only meaningful with --domain %s", f, orList(domainFlags[f]))
   }
  }
  if o.Domain == "torrent-engine" {
   if (o.Engine == "") == (o.DownloadClient == "") {
    return errors.New("--domain torrent-engine needs exactly one of --engine or --download-client")
   }
   if o.DownloadClient != "" {
    pod, err := torrentagent.PodName(os.Getenv, os.Hostname)
    if err != nil {
     return err
    }
    if o.Engine, err = torrentagent.EngineIdentity(o.DownloadClient, pod); err != nil {
     return err
    }
   }
  }
  if !cmd.Flags().Changed("drain-timeout") {
   o.DrainTimeout = drainFor(o.Domain)
  }
  if !cmd.Flags().Changed("graceful-shutdown-timeout") && o.DrainTimeout > 0 {
   o.GracefulShutdownTimeout = o.DrainTimeout + 15*time.Second
  }
  if err := o.Validate(); err != nil {
   return err
  }
  return run(cmd.Context(), o)
 }
```

`internal/cli/agent/bus.go`:

```go
// domainBus gives every subscription of the domain its drain (§3.5.6) and
// applies CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS (§9.2), so the registration packages keep
// subscribing exactly as they did. Agent-side code type-asserts no optional
// bus interface (grep '\.(events\.' app/*/agent app/*/worker), so embedding hides none.
type domainBus struct {
 events.Bus
 drain time.Duration
 slots map[string]int
}

func (b domainBus) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, s events.Subscription, h events.Handler) (func(), error) {
 if s.Drain == 0 {
  s.Drain = b.drain
 }
 if n, ok := b.slots[s.Durable]; ok {
  s.MaxInFlight = n
 }
 return b.Bus.Subscribe(ctx, s, h)
}
```

`internal/cli/agent/run.go` (§3.5.2):

```go
func Run(ctx context.Context, o Options) error {
 register, ok := domains[o.Domain] // 1
 if !ok {
  return errDomain
 }
 if err := o.Validate(); err != nil { // 2
  return err
 }
 to := o.Tracing
 to.ServiceName = "agent-" + o.Domain
 ctx, shutdown, err := obs.Bootstrap(ctx, o.Logging, to) // 3
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 defer shutdown()
 k8s.RegisterRESTClientMetrics() // 4
 cfg := o.RESTConfig
 if cfg == nil {
  if cfg, err = ctrl.GetConfig(); err != nil {
   return fmt.Errorf("agent: kubeconfig: %w", err)
  }
 }
 mgr, err := ctrl.NewManager(cfg, k8s.WithBaseContext(managerOptions(o), ctx)) // 5
 if err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("agent: %w", err)
 }
 raw, nc, err := busconn.Connect(o.NATSURL, "agent-"+o.Domain, busconn.WithHooks(obs.BusHooks())) // 6
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 defer nc.Close()
 defer func() { _ = raw.Close() }()
 if err := busconn.AwaitTopology(ctx, raw, events.Default(), o.TopologyWait); err != nil { // 7
  return err
 }
 slots, err := events.ParseSlotOverrides(os.Getenv(events.SlotsEnv))
 if err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("$%s: %w", events.SlotsEnv, err)
 }
 var bus events.Bus = domainBus{Bus: raw, drain: o.DrainTimeout, slots: slots}
 if o.WrapBus != nil {
  bus = o.WrapBus(bus)
 }
 var ready, live k8s.Checks // 8
 if err := ready.Add("jetstream", busconn.ReadyChecker(nc, raw)); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 cacheReady, err := k8s.CacheSyncChecker(mgr)
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := ready.Add("cache", cacheReady); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 reg, err := register(ctx, mgr, bus, o) // 9
 if err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("agent: register %s: %w", o.Domain, err)
 }
 if reg.Close != nil {
  defer func() { _ = reg.Close() }()
 }
 for _, ix := range reg.Indexes {
  if err := mgr.GetFieldIndexer().IndexField(ctx, ix.Object, ix.Name, ix.Extract); err != nil {
   return fmt.Errorf("agent: field index %q: %w", ix.Name, err)
  }
 }
 if len(reg.Indexes) > 0 {
  if err := catalogagent.AssertIndexes(mgr, reg.Indexes); err != nil {
   return err
  }
 }
 if err := ready.Merge(reg.Ready); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := live.Merge(reg.Live); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := k8s.AddProbes(mgr, &ready, &live); err != nil { // 10
  return err
 }
 logging.FromContext(ctx).Info("starting", "domain", o.Domain, "drain", o.DrainTimeout)
 if err := mgr.Start(ctx); err != nil { // 11
  return fmt.Errorf("agent %s: %w", o.Domain, err)
 }
 return nil
}
```

```go
// selfcheck.go
type selfCheckReport struct {
 PieceCompletion string `json:"pieceCompletion"`
 OK              bool   `json:"ok"`
}

// runSelfCheck is `agent --self-check` (§10.1.1): no domain, no cluster, no
// NATS. A bolt piece completion means a cgo-free build, under which every
// seeding torrent would rehash (R13).
func runSelfCheck(w io.Writer) error {
 r := selfCheckReport{PieceCompletion: pieceCompletion, OK: pieceCompletion == "sqlite"}
 enc := json.NewEncoder(w)
 enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
 if err := enc.Encode(r); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if !r.OK {
  return fmt.Errorf("self-check: the torrent piece completion is %q, not sqlite: this agent was built without cgo (R13)", r.PieceCompletion)
 }
 return nil
}
```

```go
package main

// subscriptions records what a domain subscribes and whether it serves RPC.
type subscriptions struct {
 events.Bus
 mu      sync.Mutex
 durable map[string]bool
 served  bool
}

func (s *subscriptions) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, sub events.Subscription, h events.Handler) (func(), error) {
 s.mu.Lock()
 s.durable[sub.Durable] = true
 s.mu.Unlock()
 return s.Bus.Subscribe(ctx, sub, h)
}

// Serve is events.Requester's responder method (pkg/events/bus.go), recorded.
func (s *subscriptions) Serve(subject, queue string, h func(ctx context.Context, data []byte) ([]byte, error)) error {
 s.mu.Lock()
 s.served = true
 s.mu.Unlock()
 return s.Bus.Serve(subject, queue, h)
}

func controllerNames(t *testing.T) map[string]bool {
 t.Helper()
 families, err := ctrlmetrics.Registry.Gather()
 require.NoError(t, err)
 out := map[string]bool{}
 for _, f := range families {
  if f.GetName() != "controller_runtime_max_concurrent_reconciles" {
   continue
  }
  for _, m := range f.GetMetric() {
   for _, l := range m.GetLabel() {
    if l.GetName() == "controller" {
     out[l.GetValue()] = true
    }
   }
  }
 }
 return out
}

func TestEveryDomainStartsServesProbesAndStopsOnSignal(t *testing.T) {
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 natsURL := starttest.EmbeddedNATS(t)
 starttest.EnsureTopology(t, natsURL) // the manager's job; agents only wait for it
 admin, err := client.New(env.Config, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 identity := map[string]string{
  "catalog": "agent-catalog", "events": "agent-events", "metadata": "agent-metadata",
  "import": "agent-import", "index": "agent-index", "caption": "agent-caption",
  "torrent-engine": "grabarr-engine", "usenet-engine": "grabarr-engine",
 }
 kcs := starttest.IdentityKubeconfigs(t, env, slices.Collect(maps.Values(identity)))
 homes := map[string]agentdomain.Domain{}
 for _, d := range agentdomain.Domains() {
  homes[d.Name] = d
 }
 var facadeAddr string
 captionData := t.TempDir()

 cases := []struct {
  domain      string
  prepare     func(t *testing.T, o *agent.Options)
  verify      func(t *testing.T)
  controllers []string
 }{
  {domain: "catalog", verify: func(t *testing.T) { starttest.VerifyRenderer(t, env.Config, natsURL, "catalog", false) }},
  {domain: "events", verify: func(t *testing.T) { verifyRedownload(t, natsURL) }},
  {domain: "metadata"},
  {domain: "import", prepare: func(t *testing.T, o *agent.Options) { o.DataDir = t.TempDir() }},
  {domain: "index", prepare: func(t *testing.T, o *agent.Options) {
   t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", t.TempDir())
   o.IndexPath = filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "releases.db")
   facadeAddr = starttest.FreeAddress(t)
   o.FacadeBindAddress = facadeAddr
  }, verify: func(t *testing.T) { verifyFacade(t, env.Config, facadeAddr) }},
  {domain: "caption", prepare: func(t *testing.T, o *agent.Options) { o.DataDir = captionData },
   verify: func(t *testing.T) { verifyCaptionarrWorker(t, env.Config) }},
  {domain: "torrent-engine", prepare: func(t *testing.T, o *agent.Options) {
   prepareTorrentClient(t, env.Config)
   o.Engine, o.DataDir = "torrents-0", t.TempDir()
  }, controllers: []string{"torrent-engine"}},
  {domain: "usenet-engine", prepare: func(t *testing.T, o *agent.Options) {
   prepareUsenetClient(t, env.Config)
   o.Engine, o.DataDir, o.ScratchDir = "sabnzbd-0", t.TempDir(), t.TempDir()
  }, controllers: []string{"usenet-engine"}},
 }
 require.Len(t, cases, len(agent.Domains()), "every domain has a case")

 for _, tc := range cases {
  t.Run(tc.domain, func(t *testing.T) {
   o := agent.DefaultOptions()
   o.Domain, o.Namespace, o.NATSURL = tc.domain, "default", natsURL
   o.MetricsBindAddress = k8s.DisabledBindAddress
   o.HealthProbeBindAddress = starttest.FreeAddress(t)
   o.GracefulShutdownTimeout, o.TopologyWait = 10*time.Second, 10*time.Second
   o.RESTConfig = starttest.RESTConfig(t, kcs[identity[tc.domain]])
   rec := &subscriptions{durable: map[string]bool{}}
   o.WrapBus = func(b events.Bus) events.Bus { rec.Bus = b; return rec }
   if tc.prepare != nil {
    tc.prepare(t, &o)
   }
   before := controllerNames(t)
   starttest.AssertWroteOnlyAs(t, admin, identity[tc.domain], func() {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
    done := make(chan error, 1)
    go func() { done <- agent.Run(ctx, o) }()
    t.Cleanup(cancel)
    starttest.WaitForProbe(t, "http://"+o.HealthProbeBindAddress+"/healthz")
    starttest.WaitForProbe(t, "http://"+o.HealthProbeBindAddress+"/readyz")
    if tc.verify != nil {
     tc.verify(t)
    }
    if d, ok := homes[tc.domain]; ok && d.Autoscaled && d.MinReplicas == 0 { // §9.9
     want := map[string]bool{}
     for _, c := range d.Consumers {
      want[c] = true
     }
     rec.mu.Lock()
     assert.Equal(t, want, rec.durable, "a min-0 domain subscribes exactly its table consumers")
     assert.False(t, rec.served, "a min-0 domain serves no RPC: zero replicas would be an outage")
     rec.mu.Unlock()
    }
    cancel()
    select {
    case err := <-done:
     require.NoError(t, err, "Run on a clean shutdown")
    case <-time.After(30 * time.Second):
     t.Fatal("Run did not return within 30s of its context ending")
    }
   })
   added := map[string]bool{}
   for n := range controllerNames(t) {
    if !before[n] {
     added[n] = true
    }
   }
   want := map[string]bool{}
   for _, n := range tc.controllers {
    want[n] = true
   }
   assert.Equal(t, want, added, "only the engines register controllers in an agent (§10.3.2)")
  })
 }
}
```

```go
type flags struct {
 fs                                           *pflag.FlagSet
 dataDir, selfCheck, scratchDir, graftTask, termLog *string
 trial, version                               *bool
 lo                                           *logging.Options
 to                                           *tracing.Options
}

func newFlags() flags {
 fs := pflag.NewFlagSet("transcode", pflag.ContinueOnError)
 f := flags{fs: fs}
 f.dataDir = fs.String("data-dir", jobspec.LogicalDataRoot, "Where the RWX /data volume is mounted.")
 // --self-check, --trial, --scratch-dir, --graft-task, --termination-log: main.go:58-62 verbatim (at `0d3ae234`; the `var _ worker.GraftEngine = inprocess.Engine{}` assertion above `main` stays)
 f.version = fs.Bool("version", false, "Print the version and exit.")
 f.lo, f.to = obsflags.Bind(fs)
 return f
}

// printVersion is not run: run never returns 0 (TestRunNeverReturnsZero),
// and --version is not a pool run.
func printVersion(w io.Writer) int {
 fmt.Fprintf(w, "transcode %s\n", version.String())
 return 0
}
```

```go
type flags struct {
 fs                  *pflag.FlagSet
 ffmpeg, metricsAddr *string
 threads             *int
 version             *bool
 lo                  *logging.Options
 to                  *tracing.Options
}

func newFlags() flags {
 fs := pflag.NewFlagSet("markers", pflag.ContinueOnError)
 f := flags{fs: fs}
 // --concurrency is gone; --ffmpeg, --ffmpeg-threads and --metrics-bind-address
 // stay (segmentarr-worker main.go:56-58 at 0d3ae234, verbatim)
 f.ffmpeg = fs.String("ffmpeg", "ffmpeg", "The ffmpeg binary.")
 f.threads = fs.Int("ffmpeg-threads", 0, "Threads per ffmpeg run; 0 lets ffmpeg choose.")
 f.metricsAddr = fs.String("metrics-bind-address", ":8080", "Where /metrics is served; empty serves none.")
 f.version = fs.Bool("version", false, "Print the version and exit.")
 f.lo, f.to = obsflags.Bind(fs)
 return f
}
```

  and in `run` (every later `*ffmpeg`, `*threads`, `*metricsAddr`, `*lo` and `to` becomes
  `*f.ffmpeg`, `*f.threads`, `*f.metricsAddr`, `*f.lo` and `f.to`):

```go
 f := newFlags()
 if err := f.fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
  fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "markers:", err)
  return worker.ExitMisconfigured
 }
 if *f.version {
  return printVersion(os.Stdout)
 }
 // env check as before, then (§3.7 step 3):
 if err := fsops.ApplyUmaskFromEnv(); err != nil {
  fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "markers:", err)
  return worker.ExitMisconfigured
 }
 spec, ok := events.Default().Consumer(events.ConsumerSegmentarrAnalyze)
 if !ok { /* as before, ExitMisconfigured */ }
 overrides, err := events.ParseSlotOverrides(getenv(events.SlotsEnv))
 if err != nil {
  fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "markers: $"+events.SlotsEnv+":", err)
  return worker.ExitMisconfigured
 }
 // ... logging, tracing (f.to.ServiceName = "markers"), textdet as before ...
 var subscribed atomic.Bool
 if *f.metricsAddr != "" {
  mux := http.NewServeMux()
  mux.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.Handler())
  mux.HandleFunc("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK) })
  // readiness gates nc; the closure reads it once it is set below
  mux.HandleFunc("/readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
   if subscribed.Load() && ncRef.Load() != nil && ncRef.Load().IsConnected() {
    w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
    return
   }
   w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
  })
  srv := &http.Server{Addr: *f.metricsAddr, Handler: mux, ReadHeaderTimeout: 10 * time.Second}
  // ListenAndServe goroutine and deferred Close as before
 }
 nc, err := nats.Connect(need["NATS_URL"], nats.Name("markers/"+need["POD_NAME"]))
 // ...
 ncRef.Store(nc)
 sub := spec.Subscription()
 sub.MaxInFlight = events.SlotsFor(spec, overrides)
 sub.Drain = spec.AckWait // §3.7 step 11: unsub waits for in-flight handlers up to the drain
 unsub, err := bus.Subscribe(ctx, sub, h.Handle)
 if err != nil { /* ExitRetriable as before */ }
 defer unsub()
 subscribed.Store(true)
 log.InfoContext(ctx, "markers serving", "slots", sub.MaxInFlight, "dnn", det != nil)
 <-ctx.Done()
 return worker.ExitDrained
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the tests.** `system_envtest_test.go` holds the harness:

```go
package system

// pair starts the manager and one agent domain in this process, each under its
// own identity kubeconfig, and stops both at cleanup. Controller names are
// process-global, so each test function runs the manager once (SkipNameValidation
// covers only the tests' own repeats).
func pair(t *testing.T, env *envtest.Environment, natsURL, domain string, tune func(*manager.Options, *agent.Options)) {
 t.Helper()
 kcs := starttest.IdentityKubeconfigs(t, env, []string{"manager", "agent-" + domain})
 mo := manager.DefaultOptions()
 mo.Namespace, mo.NATSURL, mo.BusSingleNode = "default", natsURL, true
 mo.NativeImage, mo.Autoscale, mo.ExternalMetricsBindAddress = "native:test", false, k8s.DisabledBindAddress
 mo.MetricsBindAddress, mo.HealthProbeBindAddress = k8s.DisabledBindAddress, starttest.FreeAddress(t)
 mo.LeaderElect, mo.DataDir = false, t.TempDir()
 mo.RESTConfig, mo.SkipNameValidation = starttest.RESTConfig(t, kcs["manager"]), true
 ao := agent.DefaultOptions()
 ao.Domain, ao.Namespace, ao.NATSURL = domain, "default", natsURL
 ao.MetricsBindAddress, ao.HealthProbeBindAddress = k8s.DisabledBindAddress, starttest.FreeAddress(t)
 ao.FacadeBindAddress, ao.DataDir = k8s.DisabledBindAddress, mo.DataDir
 ao.RESTConfig, ao.SkipNameValidation = starttest.RESTConfig(t, kcs["agent-"+domain]), true
 if tune != nil {
  tune(&mo, &ao)
 }
 runUntilCleanup(t, "manager", func(ctx context.Context) error { return manager.Run(ctx, mo) }, mo.HealthProbeBindAddress)
 runUntilCleanup(t, "agent-"+domain, func(ctx context.Context) error { return agent.Run(ctx, ao) }, ao.HealthProbeBindAddress)
}
```

  `runUntilCleanup` starts `run` in a goroutine, waits for `/readyz`, and at cleanup cancels
  and requires a nil error within 30 s. One top-level test per flow (each its own envtest and
  NATS, so the manager's controllers are registered once per test binary run through
  `SkipNameValidation`):

| `TestHistoryAcrossManagerAndEvents` | manager + `events` | `start_envtest_test.go:886` `verifyHistory` (replay in the manager, sink and DLQ projector in the agent) |
| `TestImportListAcrossManagerAndImport` | manager + `import` | `start_envtest_test.go:1064` `verifyImportList` (the controller's device flow in the manager, syncs in the agent; `tune` sets both `TraktBaseURL`s) |
| `TestRendererThroughTheOverlayProfileController` | manager + `catalog` | `starttest.VerifyRenderer(t, env.Config, natsURL, "system", true)` |
| `TestMediaFileProbeRoundTrip` | manager + `import` | new, below |

```go
func TestMediaFileProbeRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
 installtest.FindTool(t, "ffprobe") // the import domain probes through ffprobeexec until §11.1 step 11
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 natsURL := starttest.EmbeddedNATS(t)
 var dataDir string
 pair(t, env, natsURL, "import", func(m *manager.Options, a *agent.Options) { dataDir = m.DataDir })
 admin, err := client.New(env.Config, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 src, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(installtest.RepoRoot(t), "test/data/mediainfo/sample_h264_8bit.mp4"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 movieDir := filepath.Join(dataDir, "media/movies/Sample (2024)")
 require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(movieDir, 0o755))
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(movieDir, "Sample (2024).mp4"), src, 0o644))
 createRootFolderAndMovieFile(t, admin, "/data/media/movies", "/data/media/movies/Sample (2024)/Sample (2024).mp4")

 starttest.WaitForLong(t, "the MediaFile is probed", func() bool {
  var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  if admin.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKey{Namespace: "default", Name: "sample-2024"}, &mf) != nil {
   return false
  }
  return mf.Status.MediaInfo != nil && mf.Status.ProbeHash != ""
 })
 var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.NoError(t, admin.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKey{Namespace: "default", Name: "sample-2024"}, &mf))
 assert.Equal(t, "h264", mf.Status.MediaInfo.VideoCodec)
 // Only catalogarr (the manager's reconciler) wrote status; the agent wrote the probe record to KV.
 for _, e := range mf.ManagedFields {
  if e.Subresource == "status" {
   assert.Equal(t, "catalogarr", e.Manager)
  }
 }
}
```

```go
package depguard_test

// The guards are only as good as the helper; prove it finds a known chain.
func TestTheHelperFindsAKnownChain(t *testing.T) {
 g := depguard.Load(t, "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/cmd/transcode", "CGO_ENABLED=0")
 require.True(t, g.Has("github.com/obinnaokechukwu/ffgo"))

 require.NotEmpty(t, chain)

 g.Deny(rec, []depguard.Rule{{Path: "github.com/obinnaokechukwu/ffgo", Why: "probe"}})
 assert.True(t, rec.failed, "Deny must fail on a linked package")
 rec = &recorder{TB: t}
 g.Require(rec, "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/no/such/package", "probe")
 assert.True(t, rec.failed, "Require must fail on a missing anchor")
}

// recorder captures failures instead of failing the test.
type recorder struct {
 testing.TB
 failed bool
}

func (r *recorder) Errorf(string, ...any) { r.failed = true }
func (r *recorder) Helper()               {}

func TestRuleMatching(t *testing.T) {
 assert.True(t, depguard.Rule{Path: "a/b"}.Matches("a/b/c"))
 assert.False(t, depguard.Rule{Path: "a/b"}.Matches("a/bc"))
 assert.False(t, depguard.Rule{Path: "a/b", Exact: true}.Matches("a/b/c"))
 assert.False(t, depguard.Rule{Path: "a/b", Except: []string{"a/b/ok"}}.Matches("a/b/ok"))
 assert.True(t, depguard.Rule{Regexp: regexp.MustCompile(`^x/app/[a-z]+/agent(/|$)`)}.Matches("x/app/catalog/agent/events"))
}
```

```go
func TestNoProductionCodeStartsAProcess(t *testing.T) {
 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 var checked int
 // internal/ is in scope too: §4.5.6 predates the tree this wave creates.
 for _, dir := range []string{"app", "pkg", "cmd", "ui", "api", "internal"} {
  require.NoError(t, filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, dir), func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
   if err != nil || d.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(p, ".go") || strings.HasSuffix(p, "_test.go") {
    return err
   }
   rel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, p)
   rel = filepath.ToSlash(rel)
   for _, allowed := range execAllowed {
    if strings.HasPrefix(rel, allowed) {
     return nil
    }
   }
   f, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), p, nil, parser.SkipObjectResolution)
   if err != nil {
    return err
   }
   checked++
   aliases := map[string]string{} // local name -> import path
   for _, imp := range f.Imports {
    ip, _ := strconv.Unquote(imp.Path.Value)
    if ip == "os/exec" {
     t.Errorf("%s imports os/exec: no production code runs an external program (R2)", rel)
    }
    name := path.Base(ip)
    if ip == "gopkg.in/vansante/go-ffprobe.v2" {
     name = "ffprobe"
    }
    if imp.Name != nil {
     name = imp.Name.Name
    }
    aliases[name] = ip
   }
   ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
    sel, ok := n.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
    if !ok {
     return true
    }
    x, ok := sel.X.(*ast.Ident)
    if !ok {
     return true
    }
    switch ip, fn := aliases[x.Name], sel.Sel.Name; {
    case ip == "syscall" && (fn == "Exec" || fn == "ForkExec"),
     ip == "os" && fn == "StartProcess",
     // go-ffprobe's three functions, by name: pkg/mediainfo keeps the type
     // ffprobe.ProbeData in BuildRaw's and AudioProbeFrom's signatures until W8.7.
     ip == "gopkg.in/vansante/go-ffprobe.v2" && (fn == "ProbeURL" || fn == "ProbeReader" || fn == "SetFFProbeBinPath"):
     t.Errorf("%s calls %s.%s: no production code starts a process (R2)", rel, x.Name, fn)
    }
    return true
   })
   return nil
  }))
 }
 require.Greater(t, checked, 500, "the walk found too few files; it is not looking where it thinks it is")
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** `test/guards/depguard/depguard.go`:

```go
// Package depguard loads one package's import graph through `go list -deps`
// and checks it against rules (spec §4.5). It is imported only by tests.
package depguard

type Rule struct {
 Path   string
 Exact  bool           // false: Path or Path/...
 Except []string       // exact import paths the rule allows
 Regexp *regexp.Regexp // when set, matches instead of Path
 Why    string
}

func (r Rule) Matches(pkg string) bool {
 if slices.Contains(r.Except, pkg) {
  return false
 }
 if r.Regexp != nil {
  return r.Regexp.MatchString(pkg)
 }
 return pkg == r.Path || (!r.Exact && strings.HasPrefix(pkg, r.Path+"/"))
}

type Graph struct {
 root    string
 imports map[string][]string
 std     map[string]bool
}

type listed struct {
 ImportPath string
 Imports    []string
 Standard   bool
}

// Load runs `go list -deps -json=ImportPath,Imports,Standard pkg` under env
// (appended to the process environment) from the repository root.
func Load(t testing.TB, pkg string, env ...string) Graph {
 t.Helper()
 cmd := exec.Command("go", "list", "-deps", "-json=ImportPath,Imports,Standard", pkg)
 cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), env...)
 out, err := cmd.Output()
 require.NoError(t, err, "go list -deps %s", pkg)
 g := Graph{root: pkg, imports: map[string][]string{}, std: map[string]bool{}}
 dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(out))
 for {
  var p listed
  if err := dec.Decode(&p); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
   break
  } else {
   require.NoError(t, err)
  }
  g.imports[p.ImportPath] = p.Imports
  g.std[p.ImportPath] = p.Standard
 }
 require.Contains(t, g.imports, pkg, "go list did not list %s", pkg)
 return g
}

func (g Graph) Has(pkg string) bool { _, ok := g.imports[pkg]; return ok }

// Packages is every package in the closure, sorted.
func (g Graph) Packages() []string { return slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(g.imports)) }

// Chain is the shortest import path from the root to pkg (BFS over Imports).
func (g Graph) Chain(pkg string) []string {
 prev := map[string]string{g.root: ""}
 queue := []string{g.root}
 for len(queue) > 0 {
  cur := queue[0]
  queue = queue[1:]
  if cur == pkg {
   var chain []string
   for p := pkg; p != ""; p = prev[p] {
    chain = append([]string{p}, chain...)
   }
   return chain
  }
  for _, next := range g.imports[cur] {
   if _, seen := prev[next]; !seen {
    prev[next] = cur
    queue = append(queue, next)
   }
  }
 }
 return nil
}

// Deny fails once per linked package a rule matches, naming why and the chain.
func (g Graph) Deny(t testing.TB, rules []Rule) {
 t.Helper()
 for _, pkg := range g.Packages() {
  for _, r := range rules {
   if r.Matches(pkg) {
    t.Errorf("%s links %s (%s):\n  %s", g.root, pkg, r.Why, strings.Join(g.Chain(pkg), "\n  <- "))
    break
   }
  }
 }
}

func (g Graph) Require(t testing.TB, pkg, why string) {
 t.Helper()
 if !g.Has(pkg) {
  t.Errorf("%s no longer links %s (%s): a guard anchored on it would pass vacuously", g.root, pkg, why)
 }
}

const mod = "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/"

// AllowApp fails for every module app/ package in the closure that matches
// none of allowed (patterns over the module-relative path).
func (g Graph) AllowApp(t testing.TB, allowed []*regexp.Regexp) {
 t.Helper()
 for _, pkg := range g.Packages() {
  rel, ok := strings.CutPrefix(pkg, mod)
  if !ok || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, "app/") {
   continue
  }
  if !slices.ContainsFunc(allowed, func(re *regexp.Regexp) bool { return re.MatchString(rel) }) {
   t.Errorf("%s links %s, which is not classified for this binary; add it to the allow-list or cut the edge:\n  %s",
    g.root, rel, strings.Join(g.Chain(pkg), "\n  <- "))
  }
 }
}

// OnlyImportedBy fails for every edge q -> p in the closure where target(p)
// and !importers(q).
func (g Graph) OnlyImportedBy(t testing.TB, target, importers func(string) bool, why string) {
 t.Helper()
 for _, q := range g.Packages() {
  for _, p := range g.imports[q] {
   if target(p) && !importers(q) {
    t.Errorf("%s imports %s (%s)", q, p, why)
   }
  }
 }
}
```

```go
// productionFiles parses every non-test .go file under the module's code
// trees, keyed by module-relative path.
func productionFiles(t *testing.T, dirs ...string) map[string]*ast.File {
 t.Helper()
 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 if len(dirs) == 0 {
  dirs = []string{"app", "pkg", "internal", "cmd", "ui"}
 }
 out := map[string]*ast.File{}
 for _, dir := range dirs {
  require.NoError(t, filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, dir), func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
   if err != nil || d.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(p, ".go") || strings.HasSuffix(p, "_test.go") {
    return err
   }
   f, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), p, nil, parser.SkipObjectResolution)
   if err != nil {
    return err
   }
   rel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, p)
   out[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = f
   return nil
  }))
 }
 return out
}

// moduleDirs is the module-relative directory of every module package in g.
func moduleDirs(g depguard.Graph) map[string]bool {
 out := map[string]bool{}
 for _, p := range g.Packages() {
  if rel, ok := strings.CutPrefix(p, mod); ok {
   out[rel] = true
  }
 }
 return out
}

// controllerBuilders are the calls that start a controller-runtime builder
// chain: ctrl's NewControllerManagedBy alias, builder.ControllerManagedBy,
// and the generic builder.TypedControllerManagedBy[request] (the remediation
// loop's, F3.1). controller-runtime v0.25.1 has no other.
var controllerBuilders = map[string]bool{"NewControllerManagedBy": true, "ControllerManagedBy": true, "TypedControllerManagedBy": true}

// unindex strips a generic instantiation from a callee: F[T](...) and
// pkg.F[T1, T2](...) call F.
func unindex(e ast.Expr) ast.Expr {
 switch v := e.(type) {
 case *ast.IndexExpr:
  return v.X
 case *ast.IndexListExpr:
  return v.X
 }
 return e
}

// isBuilderStart reports whether call starts a controller builder chain.
func isBuilderStart(call *ast.CallExpr) bool {
 switch f := unindex(call.Fun).(type) {
 case *ast.SelectorExpr:
  return controllerBuilders[f.Sel.Name] && isPackageIdent(f.X)
 case *ast.Ident:
  return controllerBuilders[f.Name]
 }
 return false
}

// builderChain reports whether the method chain e begins with a controller
// builder call (ctrl.NewControllerManagedBy(mgr).For(...)...,
// builder.TypedControllerManagedBy[Key](mgr).Named(...)...).
func builderChain(e ast.Expr) bool {
 for {
  switch v := e.(type) {
  case *ast.CallExpr:
   if isBuilderStart(v) {
    return true
   }
   e = v.Fun
  case *ast.SelectorExpr:
   e = v.X
  default:
   return false
  }
 }
}
```

`test/guards/registration_test.go` (the §10.3.3 rewrite):

```go
// home is one app service and where it is registered: its registration
// packages (app/<svc>/manager, app/<svc>/agent[/...], app/autoscale,
// app/segments/worker, app/squash/worker) and the binary directories that
// import them. The services are discovered, never listed.
type home struct {
 service string   // "app/catalog"
 regs    []string // "app/catalog/manager", "app/catalog/agent/catalog", ...
 bins    []string // "internal/cli/manager", "internal/cli/agent", "cmd/markers", "cmd/transcode"
}

var regPkg = regexp.MustCompile(`^app/([a-z]+)/(manager|agent(/[a-z]+)?)$|^app/autoscale$|^app/segments/worker$|^app/squash/worker$`)

func homes(t *testing.T) []home {
 t.Helper()
 by := map[string]*home{}
 var managers, agents int
 for _, bin := range []string{"internal/cli/manager", "internal/cli/agent", "cmd/markers", "cmd/transcode"} {
  for path, f := range productionFiles(t, bin) {
   _ = path
   for _, imp := range f.Imports {
    ip, _ := strconv.Unquote(imp.Path.Value)
    rel, ok := strings.CutPrefix(ip, mod)
    if !ok || !regPkg.MatchString(rel) {
     continue
    }
    service := strings.Join(strings.Split(rel, "/")[:2], "/")
    h := by[service]
    if h == nil {
     h = &home{service: service}
     by[service] = h
    }
    if !slices.Contains(h.regs, rel) {
     h.regs = append(h.regs, rel)
     if strings.HasSuffix(rel, "/manager") {
      managers++
     }
     if strings.Contains(rel, "/agent") {
      agents++
     }
    }
    if !slices.Contains(h.bins, bin) {
     h.bins = append(h.bins, bin)
    }
   }
  }
 }
 require.GreaterOrEqual(t, managers, 6, "found %d manager registrations; internal/cli/manager moved or changed shape", managers)
 require.GreaterOrEqual(t, agents, 6, "found %d agent domain registrations; internal/cli/agent moved or changed shape", agents)
 require.Contains(t, by, "app/segments", "markers' worker is a home too (never covered before)")
 out := make([]home, 0, len(by))
 for _, h := range by {
  out = append(out, *h)
 }
 slices.SortFunc(out, func(a, b home) int { return strings.Compare(a.service, b.service) })
 return out
}
```

  `wiringFiles(h)` returns the non-test files of every `h.regs` directory plus every `h.bins`
  directory (replacing the old `serviceDir` + `"."`). `serviceComponents(t, root, h)` is the old
  walker (`runnable_registration_test.go:269-364`) over `h.service`, skipping every directory in
  `h.regs` (the old "skip the service's own top-level package"). `runnableTypes(t, h)` likewise.
  With those three swapped, these bodies are copied verbatim, looping over `homes(t)` instead of
  `runnableServices(t)`: `TestEveryManagerRunnableIsRegistered`, `TestEveryServiceComponentIsRegistered`
  (with `pendingWiring`, empty), `TestNoBareRunnableFunc`, `TestEveryEveryReplicaIsAdded`, the
  last also asserting every `k8s.LeaderOnly(...)` is a direct `Add` argument. Then:

```go
// Controller names are process-global; only the manager registers them
// in bulk, so uniqueness is held across what cmd/manager links.
func TestControllerNamesAreUniqueAcrossTheBinary(t *testing.T) {
 linked := moduleDirs(depguard.Load(t, mod+"cmd/manager", linuxStatic...))
 files := map[string]*ast.File{}
 for path, f := range productionFiles(t) {
  if linked[filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(path))] {
   files[path] = f
  }
 }
 // body of runnable_registration_test.go:702-774 over files, the replay
 // controllers' "replay-" prefix included; floor: >= 30 chains. Two
 // changes from the original: a chain counts when builderChain(sel.X)
 // holds, not chainStartsWith(sel.X, "NewControllerManagedBy"), and the
 // unnamed check matches isBuilderStart(call), not isCallTo(call,
 // "NewControllerManagedBy"), so a generic TypedControllerManagedBy[K]
 // chain (the remediation loop's, F3.1) is held to a unique literal name
 // like every other.
}

// Among module packages cmd/agent links, only the two engines build a
// controller; markers, transcode and ui link none (§10.3.2).
func TestOnlyTheManagerRegistersControllers(t *testing.T) {
 builds := func(f *ast.File) bool {
  found := false
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
   if !ok {
    return true
   }
   if isBuilderStart(call) {
    found = true
    return true
   }
   if sel, ok := unindex(call.Fun).(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok {
    switch sel.Sel.Name {
    case "New", "NewTyped", "NewUnmanaged", "NewTypedUnmanaged":
     if x, ok := sel.X.(*ast.Ident); ok && importAlias(f, "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/controller", "controller") == x.Name {
      found = true
     }
    }
   }
   return true
  })
  return found
 }
 files := productionFiles(t)
 for bin, allowed := range map[string][]string{
  "cmd/agent":     {"app/grab/engine/torrent", "app/grab/engine/usenet"},
  "cmd/markers":   nil,
  "cmd/transcode": nil,
  "cmd/ui":        nil,
 } {
  env := linuxStatic
  if bin == "cmd/agent" {
   env = linuxCgo
  }
  linked := moduleDirs(depguard.Load(t, mod+bin, env...))
  builders := map[string]bool{}
  for path, f := range files {
   if dir := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(path)); linked[dir] && builds(f) {
    builders[dir] = true
   }
  }
  assert.ElementsMatch(t, allowed, slices.Collect(maps.Keys(builders)), "%s links controller builders", bin)
 }
}

// R9: a leader-only runnable (a type whose NeedLeaderElection returns true,
// or a k8s.LeaderOnly wrapper) is wired only where cmd/manager links and no
// other binary does.
func TestLeaderOnlyRunnablesLiveInTheManager(t *testing.T) {
 managerOnly := moduleDirs(depguard.Load(t, mod+"cmd/manager", linuxStatic...))
 for _, bin := range []struct{ pkg string; env []string }{
  {"cmd/agent", linuxCgo}, {"cmd/markers", []string{"CGO_ENABLED=0"}}, {"cmd/transcode", []string{"CGO_ENABLED=0"}}, {"cmd/ui", linuxStatic},
 } {
  for dir := range moduleDirs(depguard.Load(t, mod+bin.pkg, bin.env...)) {
   delete(managerOnly, dir)
  }
 }
 files := productionFiles(t)
 leaderTypes := map[string]bool{} // "<import path>.<Type>"
 for path, f := range files {
  for _, d := range f.Decls {
   fn, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl)
   if !ok || fn.Recv == nil || fn.Name.Name != "NeedLeaderElection" || fn.Body == nil || len(fn.Body.List) != 1 {
    continue
   }
   if ret, ok := fn.Body.List[0].(*ast.ReturnStmt); ok && len(ret.Results) == 1 && isIdent(ret.Results[0], "true") {
    leaderTypes[mod+filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(path))+"."+receiverTypeName(fn.Recv.List[0].Type)] = true
   }
  }
 }
 var sites int
 for path, f := range files {
  dir := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(path))
  if dir == "pkg/k8s" {
   continue // declares LeaderOnly
  }
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   sel, ok := n.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
   if !ok {
    return true
   }
   x, ok := sel.X.(*ast.Ident)
   if !ok {
    return true
   }
   ip := importPathOf(f, x.Name)
   if (ip == mod+"pkg/k8s" && sel.Sel.Name == "LeaderOnly") || leaderTypes[ip+"."+sel.Sel.Name] {
    sites++
    assert.True(t, managerOnly[dir], "%s wires the leader-only %s.%s, but %s is linked by a binary that never elects (R9)",
     path, x.Name, sel.Sel.Name, dir)
   }
   return true
  })
 }
 require.GreaterOrEqual(t, sites, 4, "found %d leader-only wiring sites; this guard is not looking where it thinks it is", sites)
}
```

  (`importPathOf(f, name)` resolves a file's import by its local name; it lives in `astutil_test.go`.)
  `leaderTypes` also gets, for each leader type, the exported functions of its declaring package
  whose first result is the type or a pointer to it (the `ctors` computation of
  `serviceComponents`), so a runnable wired through `artwork.NewReaper(...)` is a site too.

```go
// Every ctrl.NewManager / manager.New in production code wraps its options in
// k8s.WithBaseContext, discovered rather than listed (§10.3.3).
func TestEveryManagerGetsTheBaseContext(t *testing.T) {
 var calls int
 for path, f := range productionFiles(t) {
  ctrlAlias := importAlias(f, "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime", "controllerruntime")
  mgrAlias := importAlias(f, "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/manager", "manager")
  k8sAlias := importAlias(f, mod+"pkg/k8s", "k8s")
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
   if !ok || !(isSelector(call.Fun, ctrlAlias, "NewManager") || isSelector(call.Fun, mgrAlias, "New")) {
    return true
   }
   calls++
   wrapped := slices.ContainsFunc(call.Args, func(a ast.Expr) bool {
    inner, ok := a.(*ast.CallExpr)
    return ok && isSelector(inner.Fun, k8sAlias, "WithBaseContext")
   })
   assert.True(t, wrapped, "%s: a manager built without k8s.WithBaseContext runs every runnable under the discard logger", path)
   return true
  })
 }
 require.GreaterOrEqual(t, calls, 2, "the manager and the agent each build one")
}
```

`test/guards/bus_hooks_test.go`:

```go
// Every bus connection carries the trace hooks: busconn.Connect with
// busconn.WithHooks(obs.BusHooks()), and natsbus.New (markers, transcode,
// which must not link pkg/obs) with the inline tracing hooks. pkg/busconn's own
// natsbus.New is the implementation of Connect and is exempt.
func TestEveryBusConnectionCarriesTraceHooks(t *testing.T) {
 var connects, news int
 for path, f := range productionFiles(t) {
  busconnAlias := importAlias(f, mod+"pkg/busconn", "busconn")
  obsAlias := importAlias(f, mod+"pkg/obs", "obs")
  natsbusAlias := importAlias(f, mod+"pkg/events/natsbus", "natsbus")
  tracingAlias := importAlias(f, mod+"pkg/obs/tracing", "tracing")
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
   if !ok {
    return true
   }
   switch {
   case isSelector(call.Fun, busconnAlias, "Connect"):
    connects++
    assert.True(t, hasCall(call.Args, busconnAlias, "WithHooks", func(c *ast.CallExpr) bool {
     return hasCall(c.Args, obsAlias, "BusHooks", nil)
    }), "%s: busconn.Connect without busconn.WithHooks(obs.BusHooks())", path)
   case isSelector(call.Fun, natsbusAlias, "New") && !strings.HasPrefix(path, "pkg/busconn/"):
    news++
    assert.True(t, hasCall(call.Args, natsbusAlias, "WithHooks", func(c *ast.CallExpr) bool {
     return inlineHooks(c, tracingAlias)
    }), "%s: natsbus.New without the tracing hooks", path)
   }
   return true
  })
 }
 require.GreaterOrEqual(t, connects, 3, "manager, agent and ui connect through busconn")
 require.GreaterOrEqual(t, news, 2, "markers and transcode build their bus by hand")
}
```

  `hasCall(args, pkg, name, inner)` reports whether an argument is a call `pkg.name(...)` for which
  `inner` (nil: always) holds; `inlineHooks` holds when the call's argument is an
  `events.Hooks{...}` composite literal with `BeforePublish: tracing.Inject` and
  `AfterReceive: tracing.Extract`. Both live in `astutil_test.go`.
