`app/remediation/manager/ownership_envtest_test.go` (package `manager_test`):

```go
// TestMediaFileStatusIsOwnedByCatalogarrAlone replaces W4.13's
// TestMediaFileFieldManagersStayDisjoint (§2.12): after a loop pass over an
// object already in its steady state -- probed, named, markers answered --
// every status leaf is catalogarr's, no catalogarr-markers entry exists on
// a file the loop created, and the main resource carries only importarr's
// spec and catalogarr's labels.
func TestMediaFileStatusIsOwnedByCatalogarrAlone(t *testing.T) {
 e := remediationtest.StartManager(t, func(mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus) error {
  return rmanager.Register(mgr, bus, rmanager.Options{Options: k8s.DefaultOptions(), Concurrency: 2, IOWorkers: 2})
 })
 probetest.Start(t, e.Bus, remediationtest.FakeProber)                            // agent-import's probe worker
 remediationtest.MarkersAnswerer(t, e.Bus, schema.MarkersAnswer{Result: "NotFound"}) // agent-metadata's, answering every task
 nn := e.MovieFile(t, "ownership", "inception", "Inception (2010).mkv")
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  mf := e.Get(t, nn)
  return mf.ProbeCurrent() && mf.Status.Naming != nil && mf.Status.Markers != nil
 }, 30*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond, "never reached its steady state")
 e.Touch(t, nn) // an observed-fingerprint change: one more pass over the steady object
 time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
 got := e.Get(t, nn)
 for _, entry := range got.ManagedFields {
  switch {
  case entry.Manager == "remediationtest": // the test's own Touch
  case entry.Subresource == "status":
   assert.Equal(t, "catalogarr", entry.Manager, "a second manager owns status leaves")
  case entry.Manager == "catalogarr":
   paths := remediationtest.ManagedFieldPaths(got.ManagedFields, "catalogarr", "")
   meta, _ := paths["f:metadata"].(map[string]any)
   assert.Contains(t, meta, "f:labels")
  default:
   assert.Equal(t, mediafilespec.FieldManager.String(), entry.Manager)
  }
 }
 status, _ := remediationtest.ManagedFieldPaths(got.ManagedFields, "catalogarr", "status")["f:status"].(map[string]any)
 assert.Contains(t, status, "f:markers", "catalogarr owns status.markers now (§2.12)")
}

// A loop pass writes no item status: the owning Movie's managedFields are
// what its own reconciler left (ownerstatus_envtest_test.go's intent, moved).
func TestALoopPassDoesNotReleaseOwnerStatus(t *testing.T)
```

`test/guards/mediafilestatus_test.go` (package `guards`):

```go
// TestOnlyTheLoopWritesMediaFileStatus (loop spec §3.20): no PatchStatus,
// PatchStatusCAS or k8s.Apply with a catalogac.MediaFile configuration
// outside app/remediation, except mediafilespec's spec applies, the import
// agent's, and test support (remediationtest, starttest).
func TestOnlyTheLoopWritesMediaFileStatus(t *testing.T) {
 allowed := []string{"app/remediation", "app/import/mediafilespec", "app/import/worker/", "app/import/agent", "test/starttest"}
 for path, f := range productionFiles(t) {
  if slices.ContainsFunc(allowed, func(p string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(path, p) }) {
   continue
  }
  alias := importAlias(f, mod+"api/applyconfiguration/catalog/catalog/v1alpha1", "v1alpha1")
  if alias == "" {
   continue
  }
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
   if !ok {
    return true
   }
   name, _ := calleeName(call.Fun)
   if name != "PatchStatus" && name != "PatchStatusCAS" && name != "Apply" {
    return true
   }
   for _, arg := range call.Args {
    if chainRootedAt(arg, alias, "MediaFile") {
     t.Errorf("%s: %s writes a MediaFile apply configuration outside the loop", path, name)
    }
   }
   return true
  })
 }
}
```

(`productionFiles`, `importAlias(f, path, def)` and `calleeName` are W5.15's and W5.19's helpers in
`test/guards`; `test/guards` is one package, so a call with another arity breaks every guard in it.
W5.15's `chainStartsWith(e, fn)` takes no alias and keeps its meaning for the registration guards;
this guard's root check is a new helper, appended to `test/guards/astutil_test.go`:)

```go
// chainRootedAt reports whether e is a call chain whose first call is
// alias.sel(...), as in catalogac.MediaFile(name, ns).WithStatus(...).
func chainRootedAt(e ast.Expr, alias, sel string) bool {
 for {
  switch v := e.(type) {
  case *ast.CallExpr:
   if isSelector(v.Fun, alias, sel) {
    return true
   }
   e = v.Fun
  case *ast.SelectorExpr:
   e = v.X
  case *ast.ParenExpr:
   e = v.X
  default:
   return false
  }
 }
}
```

```go
// A retired manager is no longer one any writer may use, but Validate still
// accepts it: release N's one release apply runs under it (§7.3.8).
func TestRetiredFieldManagersStayValid(t *testing.T) {

 }
```

```go
// MarkersTask asks the metadata domain's marker worker for one MediaFile's
// TheIntroDB segments (loop spec §4.12). The loop builds Query from its
// cache, so the worker reads no Kubernetes object. Subject:
// clustarr.work.segmentarr.markers.normal.<mediaKey>; Msg-Id
// events.MsgIDForMarkers(File.UID, Seq).
type MarkersTask struct {
 File      Ref           `json:"file"`
 Seq       int64         `json:"seq"`
 Inputs    MarkersInputs `json:"inputs"`
 SeriesKey string        `json:"seriesKey,omitempty"`
}

// Schema implements Payload.
func (MarkersTask) Schema() string { return "catalog.MarkersTask.v2" }

// MarkersInputs fence a markers record: the probe its answer is for.
type MarkersInputs struct {
 ProbeHash  string       `json:"probeHash"`
 DurationMs int64        `json:"durationMs"`
 Query      MarkersQuery `json:"query"`
}

// MarkersQuery names the file to TheIntroDB: a movie by its TMDB id, an
// episode by its series' TVDB id, season and episode.
type MarkersQuery struct {
 IDs     map[string]string `json:"ids"`
 Season  int32             `json:"season,omitempty"`
 Episode int32             `json:"episode,omitempty"`
}

// MarkersAnswer is the worker's answer: Result Found, NotFound or Error.
type MarkersAnswer struct {
 Result    string        `json:"result"`
 Segments  []SegmentJSON `json:"segments,omitempty"` // at most 20
 Message   string        `json:"message,omitempty"`  // at most 512 bytes
 FetchedAt time.Time     `json:"fetchedAt"`
}

// MarkersRecordSchema is RecordHeader.Schema on a clustarr-markers record.
const MarkersRecordSchema = "records.markers.v1"

// MarkersRecord is one file's record in clustarr-markers, keyed
// events.RecordKey(file UID).
type MarkersRecord struct {
 RecordHeader
 Inputs    MarkersInputs  `json:"inputs"`
 SeriesKey string         `json:"seriesKey,omitempty"`
 Answer    *MarkersAnswer `json:"answer,omitempty"`
}
```

```go
// MsgIDForMarkers is a markers task's Msg-Id, "markers/<file UID>/<seq>".
func MsgIDForMarkers(fileUID string, seq int64) string {
 return "markers/" + fileUID + "/" + strconv.FormatInt(seq, 10)
}

// MsgIDForMarkersAt is a deferred markers task's, republished for at:
// MsgIDForMarkers plus "/at-<unix>", so the dedup window keeps it.
func MsgIDForMarkersAt(fileUID string, seq int64, at time.Time) string {
 return MsgIDForMarkers(fileUID, seq) + "/at-" + strconv.FormatInt(at.Unix(), 10)
}
```

`publish.go` is replaced by `records.go`:

```go
// markersRequestTimeout is how long a request (or a deferral past its
// reset) stands before the loop asks again (§4.12).
const markersRequestTimeout = 24 * time.Hour

// maxValue is clustarr-markers' MaxValueSize (§4.3).
const maxValue = 16 << 10

// spec is the clustarr-markers instantiation of pkg/records. No markers
// answer is a fact: nothing on disk changes.
func spec() records.Spec[*schema.MarkersRecord] {
 return records.Spec[*schema.MarkersRecord]{
  Remediation: "markers", Bucket: events.BucketMarkers, Schema: schema.MarkersRecordSchema, MaxValue: maxValue,
  New:      func() *schema.MarkersRecord { return &schema.MarkersRecord{} },
  Answered: records.TerminalAnswered,
  Fact:     func(*schema.MarkersRecord) bool { return false },
 }
}

// Records is the loop's read half; the loop writes its requests as
// remediation.RecordWrite effects.
type Records struct{ q *records.Requester[*schema.MarkersRecord] }

func NewRecords(bus events.Bus) *Records {
 return &Records{q: records.NewRequester(bus.KV(events.BucketMarkers), spec())}
}

// Get reads uid's record, its revision, and whether there is one.
func (r *Records) Get(ctx context.Context, uid string) (*schema.MarkersRecord, uint64, bool, error) {
 return r.q.Get(ctx, events.RecordKey(uid))
}

// Answers is the worker's half.
type Answers struct{ a *records.Answerer[*schema.MarkersRecord] }

// NewAnswers is the worker's half, writing as writer (the pod).
func NewAnswers(bus events.Bus, writer string) *Answers {
 return &Answers{a: records.NewAnswerer(bus.KV(events.BucketMarkers), spec(), writer, version.String())}
}

func (a *Answers) Superseded(ctx context.Context, t schema.MarkersTask) (bool, error) {
 return a.a.Superseded(ctx, events.RecordKey(t.File.UID), t.Seq)
}

func (a *Answers) Defer(ctx context.Context, t schema.MarkersTask, until time.Time) (records.Verdict, error) {
 return a.a.Defer(ctx, events.RecordKey(t.File.UID), t.Seq, until)
}

// Answer writes ans for t (state answered; state failed, transient, with
// ans.Message as the failure when failed), clamping Message to 512 bytes and
// Segments to 20.
func (a *Answers) Answer(ctx context.Context, t schema.MarkersTask, ans schema.MarkersAnswer, failed bool) (records.Verdict, error) {
 ans.Message = clamp(ans.Message)
 if len(ans.Segments) > 20 {
  ans.Segments = ans.Segments[:20]
 }
 rec := &schema.MarkersRecord{Inputs: t.Inputs, SeriesKey: t.SeriesKey, Answer: &ans}
 rec.Schema, rec.MediaFile, rec.Seq, rec.State = schema.MarkersRecordSchema, t.File, t.Seq, records.StateAnswered
 if failed {
  rec.State, rec.Failure, rec.Transient = records.StateFailed, ans.Message, true
 }
 return a.a.Answer(ctx, events.RecordKey(t.File.UID), rec)
}

// TaskMessage is the subject, Msg-Id and envelope of rec's task.
func TaskMessage(rec schema.MarkersRecord, now time.Time) (subject, msgID string, env *events.Envelope, err error) {
 return taskMessage(schema.MarkersTask{File: rec.MediaFile, Seq: rec.Seq, Inputs: rec.Inputs, SeriesKey: rec.SeriesKey},
  events.MsgIDForMarkers(rec.MediaFile.UID, rec.Seq), now)
}

// DeferredTask is t republished for at, a spent key's reset.
func DeferredTask(t schema.MarkersTask, now, at time.Time) (subject, msgID string, env *events.Envelope, err error) {
 return taskMessage(t, events.MsgIDForMarkersAt(t.File.UID, t.Seq, at), now)
}

func taskMessage(t schema.MarkersTask, id string, now time.Time) (string, string, *events.Envelope, error) {
 name, data, err := schema.Encode(t)
 if err != nil {
  return "", "", nil, err
 }
 env := &events.Envelope{ID: id, Type: "catalog.MarkersTask", Schema: name, Source: "catalogarr@" + version.String(),
  Key: t.File.Namespace + "/" + t.File.Name, Time: now.UTC(), Data: data}
 return events.WorkMarkersSubject(events.MediaKey("mediafile", t.File.Namespace, t.File.Name)), id, env, nil
}

// NotAskedMultiEpisode and NotAskedOrder are the NotFound messages of the
// queries the loop decides without asking, byte for byte the handler's
// (TestTheLoopsNotAskedMessagesMatchTheWorkers).
func NotAskedMultiEpisode(others int) string {
 return fmt.Sprintf("the file holds %d more episodes, whose segments TheIntroDB times per episode%s", others, notAskedSuffix)
}

func NotAskedOrder(order catalogv1alpha1.EpisodeOrder) string {
 return fmt.Sprintf("episode order %s is not the aired order TheIntroDB numbers episodes in%s", order, notAskedSuffix)
}

const notAskedSuffix = ": not asked: metadata: not found"
```

(`clamp` moves here from the handler. `MsgID`, `Publish` and `PublishAt` are deleted; §4.13 retires
`markers.MsgID`.)

`plan.go`:

```go
// Input is what Plan decides from: the draft's probe, the stored markers,
// the query the loop built, and the two records.
type Input struct {
 Kind         commonv1.MediaKind
 File         schema.Ref
 ProbeHash    string
 Probed       bool
 DurationMs   int64
 Prev         *catalogv1alpha1.FileMarkers
 Query        Query
 Record       *schema.MarkersRecord // clustarr-markers, when RecordOK
 RecordRev    uint64
 RecordOK     bool
 RecordRead   bool
 Segments     segments.Record
 SegmentsOK   bool
 PacedUntil   time.Time
 Now          time.Time
}

// Query is the TheIntroDB query, or why the loop answers it NotFound itself.
type Query struct {
 Ask       *schema.MarkersQuery
 NotAsked  string
 SeriesKey string
}

// Note is one record outcome the loop counts after its apply.
type Note struct {
 State    string
 TimedOut bool
}

// Decision is what Plan decided.
type Decision struct {
 Markers   *catalogv1alpha1.FileMarkers // the block to apply; Prev when nothing changed
 Request   *schema.MarkersRecord        // write at Record.Revision, then publish
 Republish *schema.MarkersRecord
 Due       time.Time
 Again     bool
 Unpaced   bool
 Notes     []Note
}

// Plan is the markers planner (loop spec §4.12): it incorporates TheIntroDB's
// answer and the segment analysis into status.markers, asks TheIntroDB when
// the markers are due, and otherwise carries the stored block verbatim --
// re-merging only when an input changed, so a stored map that is not the
// canonical merge (untagged legacy segments) is never rewritten and
// cluster-plex's SeedKey never moves for nothing.
func Plan(in Input) Decision {
 d := Decision{Markers: in.Prev}
 if (in.Kind != commonv1.MediaKindMovie && in.Kind != commonv1.MediaKindEpisode) || !in.Probed || in.ProbeHash == "" {
  return d
 }
 m := in.Prev.DeepCopy()
 if m == nil {
  m = &catalogv1alpha1.FileMarkers{}
 }
 changed := false
 analysed := analysedSegments(in)
 if in.SegmentsOK && in.Segments.ProbeHash == in.ProbeHash && analysisChanged(in.Prev, in.Segments) {
  m.Analysis = analysisOf(in.Segments, in.Now)
  changed = true
 }
 theintrodb := theIntroDBSegments(m)
 due, left := DueAt(in.Kind, in.ProbeHash, in.Probed, in.Prev, in.Now)
 var rec schema.MarkersRecord
 if in.RecordOK && in.Record != nil {
  rec = *in.Record
 }
 switch {
 case !due:
  if left > 0 {
   d.Due = in.Now.Add(left)
  }
 case in.Query.NotAsked != "":
  withTheIntroDB(m, catalogv1alpha1.MarkersNotFound, in.Now, in.ProbeHash, in.DurationMs, in.Query.NotAsked, notFoundSince(in.Prev, in.ProbeHash, in.Now))
  theintrodb, changed = nil, true
 case !in.RecordRead:
  d.Again = true // the probe moved this pass; the record is read next pass
 case in.RecordOK && answeredFor(rec, in.ProbeHash, in.Prev):
  at := *rec.AnsweredAt
  res, msg := catalogv1alpha1.MarkersResult(rec.Answer.Result), rec.Answer.Message
  if rec.State == records.StateFailed {
   res, msg = catalogv1alpha1.MarkersError, rec.Failure
  }
  if res != catalogv1alpha1.MarkersError || in.Prev == nil || in.Prev.ForProbeHash != in.ProbeHash {
   theintrodb = toSegments(rec.Answer)
  }
  var since *metav1.Time
  if res == catalogv1alpha1.MarkersNotFound {
   since = notFoundSince(in.Prev, in.ProbeHash, at)
  }
  withTheIntroDB(m, res, at, rec.Inputs.ProbeHash, rec.Inputs.DurationMs, msg, since)
  changed, d.Unpaced = true, true
  d.Notes = append(d.Notes, Note{State: rec.State})
 case in.RecordOK && rec.Inputs.ProbeHash == in.ProbeHash && rec.State == records.StateRequested &&
  in.Now.Before(rec.RequestedAt.Add(markersRequestTimeout)):
  d.Due = rec.RequestedAt.Add(markersRequestTimeout)
  if rec.ClaimedAt == nil && in.Now.Sub(rec.RequestedAt) < records.RepublishWindow {
   r := rec
   d.Republish = &r
  }
 case in.RecordOK && rec.Inputs.ProbeHash == in.ProbeHash && rec.State == records.StateDeferred && rec.DeferredUntil != nil &&
  in.Now.Before(rec.DeferredUntil.Add(markersRequestTimeout)):
  d.Due = rec.DeferredUntil.Add(markersRequestTimeout)
 case in.PacedUntil.After(in.Now):
  d.Due = in.PacedUntil
 default:
  req := schema.MarkersRecord{Inputs: schema.MarkersInputs{ProbeHash: in.ProbeHash, DurationMs: in.DurationMs, Query: *in.Query.Ask},
   SeriesKey: in.Query.SeriesKey}
  req.Schema, req.MediaFile, req.State, req.RequestedAt = schema.MarkersRecordSchema, in.File, records.StateRequested, in.Now
  req.Seq = records.NextSeq(rec.Seq, 0, in.Now)
  d.Request, d.Due = &req, in.Now.Add(markersRequestTimeout)
  if in.RecordOK && rec.Inputs.ProbeHash == in.ProbeHash && (rec.State == records.StateRequested || rec.State == records.StateDeferred) {
   d.Notes = append(d.Notes, Note{TimedOut: true})
  }
 }
 if !changed {
  return d
 }
 m.Segments = markerSegments(segments.Merge(theintrodb, analysed))
 d.Markers = m
 return d
}
```

with these helpers in the same file (each a few lines, named for what they compute):
`answeredFor(rec, probeHash, prev)` (state answered or failed, `Inputs.ProbeHash == probeHash`,
`AnsweredAt` set and after `prev.FetchedAt` when `prev` is for the same probe hash);
`analysisChanged(prev, rec)` (§4.12's rule: `(ProbeHash, Version, AnalyzedAt)` against
`prev.Analysis.{ForProbeHash, Version, AnalyzedAt}`; a v1 record, `rec.Schema == ""`, compares
`ProbeHash` and `Version` only); `analysisOf(rec, now)` (`SegmentAnalysis{Result, AnalyzedAt:
rec.AnalyzedAt (now for a v1 record), ForProbeHash, Version, Message: rec.LastError.Message when set}`);
`analysedSegments(in)` (the record's segments when it is for `in.ProbeHash`); `theIntroDBSegments`,
`withTheIntroDB`, `toSegments` (moved from `segmenting/apply.go` and the handler, unchanged);
`notFoundSince(prev, probeHash, at)` (the handler's rule: the previous NotFound's
`NotFoundSince`, else its `FetchedAt`, else `at`); `markerSegments` (the
`[]segments.Segment → []catalogv1alpha1.MarkerSegment` copy).

3d. **The worker.** `app/catalog/worker/markers/handler.go`:

```go
// Handler is the catalogarr-markers durable's handler: it asks TheIntroDB
// for one file and writes the answer into clustarr-markers by CAS. It reads
// no Kubernetes object: the task carries the query (loop spec §4.12).
type Handler struct {
 Providers  []metadata.MarkersProvider
 Clock      func() time.Time
 Answers    *catalogmarkers.Answers // writes as this pod (NewAnswers' writer)
 Bus        events.Publisher        // a deferral's republish at the reset
 MaxDeliver uint64                  // the consumer's; the last delivery answers failed

 mu     sync.Mutex
 absent map[string]time.Time
}

// ErrNotAsked is a NotFound decided without asking a provider.
var ErrNotAsked = errors.New("not asked")

func (h *Handler) Handle(ctx context.Context, m events.Message) error {
 env := m.Envelope()
 if env.Schema == "catalog.MarkersTask.v1" {
  return nil // published before the switch: the file's next due pass asks with a v2 task
 }
 var task schema.MarkersTask
 if err := schema.Decode(env.Schema, env.Data, &task); err != nil {
  return events.Discard("undecodable markers task", err)
 }
 if task.File.UID == "" || task.Seq == 0 {
  return events.Discard("a markers task with no file or sequence", fmt.Errorf("file=%v seq=%d", task.File, task.Seq))
 }
 if sup, err := h.Answers.Superseded(ctx, task); err != nil {
  return err
 } else if sup {
  return nil
 }
 now := h.now()
 q := metadata.MarkersQuery{IDs: metadata.ExternalIDs(task.Inputs.Query.IDs), Season: task.Inputs.Query.Season,
  Episode: task.Inputs.Query.Episode, DurationMs: task.Inputs.DurationMs}
 var segs metadata.Segments
 var err error
 if h.seriesAbsent(task.SeriesKey, now) {
  err = fmt.Errorf("the series is not on TheIntroDB: %w: %w", ErrNotAsked, metadata.ErrNotFound)
 } else if segs, err = h.ask(ctx, q); errors.Is(err, metadata.ErrNoTitle) {
  h.rememberAbsent(task.SeriesKey, now)
 }
 var rl *metadata.RateLimitedError
 switch {
 case errors.As(err, &rl) && rl.RetryAfter > deferAfter && h.Bus != nil:
  until := now.Add(rl.RetryAfter)
  v, derr := h.Answers.Defer(ctx, task, until)
  if derr != nil {
   return events.Retry(rl.RetryAfter, errors.Join(err, derr))
  }
  if v != records.Wrote {
   return nil // superseded or answered meanwhile: nothing to defer
  }
  subject, id, denv, perr := catalogmarkers.DeferredTask(task, now, until)
  if perr == nil {
   _, perr = h.Bus.Publish(ctx, subject, denv, events.WithMsgID(id), events.WithScheduleAt(until))
  }
  if perr != nil {
   return events.Retry(rl.RetryAfter, errors.Join(err, perr))
  }
  return nil
 case errors.As(err, &rl):
  if m.Attempt() >= h.MaxDeliver {
   _, aerr := h.Answers.Answer(ctx, task, schema.MarkersAnswer{FetchedAt: now, Message: err.Error()}, true)
   return aerr
  }
  return events.Retry(rl.RetryAfter, err)
 case errors.Is(err, errNoProvider):
  return nil // the registry, not the file: the record stays requested and the loop asks again after 24 h
 }
 ans := schema.MarkersAnswer{FetchedAt: now}
 switch {
 case err == nil:
  ans.Result, ans.Segments = string(catalogv1alpha1.MarkersFound), toJSON(segs)
 case errors.Is(err, metadata.ErrNotFound):
  ans.Result = string(catalogv1alpha1.MarkersNotFound)
  if errors.Is(err, ErrNotAsked) {
   ans.Message = err.Error()
  }
 default:
  logging.FromContext(ctx).WarnContext(ctx, "markers: fetch failed", "mediafile", task.File.Name, "error", err)
  ans.Result, ans.Message = string(catalogv1alpha1.MarkersError), err.Error()
 }
 _, err = h.Answers.Answer(ctx, task, ans, false)
 return err
}
```

`seriesAbsent`, `rememberAbsent`, `ask`, `deferAfter`, `SeriesAbsentTTL`, `errNoProvider` stay;

and both `+kubebuilder:rbac` markers are deleted (the loop builds the query; §4.14: agent-metadata

```go
type Options struct {
 Bus    events.Bus
 Writer string // POD_NAME
}

func Setup(ctx context.Context, o Options, providers []metadata.MarkersProvider) (stop func(), err error) {
 spec, ok := events.Default().Consumer(events.ConsumerCatalogMarkers)
 if !ok {
  return nil, fmt.Errorf("markers: consumer %q missing from the default topology", events.ConsumerCatalogMarkers)
 }
 h := &Handler{Providers: providers, Bus: o.Bus, Answers: catalogmarkers.NewAnswers(o.Bus, o.Writer), MaxDeliver: uint64(spec.MaxDeliver)}
 stop, err = o.Bus.Subscribe(ctx, spec.Subscription(), h.Handle)
 if err != nil {
  return nil, fmt.Errorf("markers: subscribe %s: %w", events.ConsumerCatalogMarkers, err)
 }
 return stop, nil
}
```

```go
// RecordSchema is a v2 record's Schema; a v1 record has none.
const RecordSchema = "segments.Record.v2"

// Attempt is an analysis that failed.
type Attempt struct {
 ProbeHash string    `json:"probeHash"`
 Version   int32     `json:"version"`
 Message   string    `json:"message"`
 At        time.Time `json:"at"`
}

// Record is a file's analysis in clustarr-segments, keyed
// events.RecordKey(MediaFile UID), written by cmd/markers by CAS.
type Record struct {
 Schema     string     `json:"schema,omitempty"`
 File       schema.Ref `json:"file,omitzero"`
 ProbeHash  string     `json:"probeHash"`
 Version    int32      `json:"version"`
 Result     string     `json:"result"`
 Segments   []Segment  `json:"segments"`
 AnalyzedAt time.Time  `json:"analyzedAt,omitzero"`
 Amend      int32      `json:"amend,omitempty"`
 LastError  *Attempt   `json:"lastError,omitempty"`
}
```

`pkg/segments/store.go`:

```go
// Store reads and writes clustarr-segments by compare-and-swap.
type Store struct{ kv events.KV }

func NewStore(kv events.KV) *Store { return &Store{kv: kv} }

// Get reads uid's record; a v1 record reads as v2 with File.UID from its
// key; a record of another schema reads as absent.
func (s *Store) Get(ctx context.Context, uid string) (Record, uint64, bool, error) {
 e, err := s.kv.Get(ctx, events.RecordKey(uid))
 if errors.Is(err, events.ErrKeyNotFound) {
  return Record{}, 0, false, nil
 }
 if err != nil {
  return Record{}, 0, false, err
 }
 var r Record
 if json.Unmarshal(e.Value, &r) != nil || (r.Schema != "" && r.Schema != RecordSchema) {
  return Record{}, e.Revision, false, nil
 }
 if r.Schema == "" {
  r.File.UID = uid
 }
 return r, e.Revision, true, nil
}

// Update applies fn to uid's current record (nil when absent) and writes the
// result by CAS, re-reading and re-applying on a lost race, at most
// records.CASAttempts times; fn's false writes nothing.
func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, uid string, fn func(cur *Record) (Record, bool)) (bool, error) {
 for range records.CASAttempts {
  cur, rev, ok, err := s.Get(ctx, uid)
  if err != nil {
   return false, err
  }
  var curp *Record
  if ok {
   curp = &cur
  }
  next, write := fn(curp)
  if !write {
   return false, nil
  }
  b, err := json.Marshal(next)
  if err != nil {
   return false, err
  }
  if rev == 0 {
   _, err = s.kv.Create(ctx, events.RecordKey(uid), b)
  } else {
   _, err = s.kv.Update(ctx, events.RecordKey(uid), b, rev)
  }
  if errors.Is(err, events.ErrKeyExists) || errors.Is(err, events.ErrRevisionMismatch) {
   continue
  }
  return err == nil, err
 }
 return false, records.ErrRaced
}

// WakeRef is S21's recordsource.Decoder: a v2 record's file ref and no
// state (every put wakes); a v1 record is skipped (none is written after
// F3.4).
func WakeRef(value []byte) (schema.Ref, string, bool) {
 var r struct {
  Schema string     `json:"schema"`
  File   schema.Ref `json:"file"`
 }
 if json.Unmarshal(value, &r) != nil || r.Schema != RecordSchema || r.File.Name == "" {
  return schema.Ref{}, "", false
 }
 return r.File, "", true
}
```

`app/segments/worker/worker.go`: `Handler.KV` and `Handler.Bus` go for `Records *segments.Store`;
`record(ctx, f)` reads `h.Records.Get(ctx, f.UID)` (and keeps its "current analyzer, not an
Error" rule); `publish` is replaced by

```go
// store writes res as f's record by CAS (loop spec §4.12): an analysis
// replaces the record; an amendment (withIntro) adds the intro and counts
// one more Amend; an Error keeps the segments of the same probe and
// version and records the attempt.
func (h *Handler) store(ctx context.Context, ns string, f *file, res analysisResult, amend bool) error {
 now := time.Now().UTC()
 _, err := h.Records.Update(ctx, f.UID, func(cur *segments.Record) (segments.Record, bool) {
  next := segments.Record{Schema: segments.RecordSchema, File: schema.Ref{Namespace: ns, Name: f.MediaFile, UID: f.UID},
   ProbeHash: f.ProbeHash, Version: segments.AnalyzerVersion, Result: res.Result, Segments: res.Segments, AnalyzedAt: now}
  same := cur != nil && cur.ProbeHash == f.ProbeHash && cur.Version == segments.AnalyzerVersion
  switch {
  case amend && same:
   next.Amend = cur.Amend + 1
  case res.Result == string(catalogv1alpha1.MarkersError) && same:
   next = *cur
   next.Schema, next.File = segments.RecordSchema, schema.Ref{Namespace: ns, Name: f.MediaFile, UID: f.UID}
   next.LastError = &segments.Attempt{ProbeHash: f.ProbeHash, Version: segments.AnalyzerVersion, Message: res.Message, At: now}
  case res.Result == string(catalogv1alpha1.MarkersError):
   next.LastError = &segments.Attempt{ProbeHash: f.ProbeHash, Version: segments.AnalyzerVersion, Message: res.Message, At: now}
  }
  return next, true
 })
 return err
}
```

`analyze` and `withIntro` return an `analysisResult{Result, Message string; Segments []segments.Segment}`
instead of a `schema.SegmentsResult`; `Handle` calls `h.store(ctx, task.Namespace, f, res, isAmend)`
where `Handle` called `h.publish`. The `events.MsgIDForObject(...)` result Msg-Id at worker.go:358 goes
with `publish` (§4.12: the same-Msg-Id hazard goes). The site that builds the handler sets
`Records: segments.NewStore(bus.KV(events.BucketSegments))`. `worker_test.go`: every assertion on a
published `SegmentsResult` reads the record through `segments.NewStore(...).Get` instead; add
`TestASeasonAmendmentIncrementsAmend` (a recorded analysis, a season that reveals an intro twice
inside an hour: `Amend` reads 2 and both intros' `AnalyzedAt` differ).

is `PublishPlan`'s body up to the publish (its `opts` become `at`, zero for a movie); `PublishPlan`

`app/catalog/segmentplan/sweeper.go`:

```go
// Sweeper deletes clustarr-segments records whose MediaFile is gone, once a
// day (loop spec §4.11): the bucket's TTL is 0, so nothing else does.
type Sweeper struct {
 KV     events.KV
 Reader client.Reader // the manager's cache, with mfindex.UID
 Every  time.Duration // 0 is a day
}

// Run sweeps every Every until ctx ends; it is added k8s.LeaderOnly.
func (s *Sweeper) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
 every := s.Every
 if every == 0 {
  every = 24 * time.Hour
 }
 t := time.NewTicker(every)
 defer t.Stop()
 for {
  if _, err := s.Sweep(ctx); err != nil {
   logging.FromContext(ctx).Warn("segmentplan: sweep failed", "error", err)
  }
  select {
  case <-ctx.Done():
   return nil
  case <-t.C:
  }
 }
}

// Sweep deletes, at the revision it read, each record whose UID (v2: its
// File.UID; v1: its key, ParseKVKeyToken) no MediaFile in the cache has.
func (s *Sweeper) Sweep(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
 keys, err := s.KV.Keys(ctx)
 if err != nil {
  return 0, err
 }
 n := 0
 for _, k := range keys {
  e, err := s.KV.Get(ctx, k)
  if errors.Is(err, events.ErrKeyNotFound) {
   continue
  }
  if err != nil {
   return n, err
  }
  uid, err := events.ParseKVKeyToken(k)
  var r struct {
   File schema.Ref `json:"file"`
  }
  if json.Unmarshal(e.Value, &r) == nil && r.File.UID != "" {
   uid, err = r.File.UID, nil
  }
  if err != nil {
   continue // not a record key: never guess
  }
  var files catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
  if err := s.Reader.List(ctx, &files, client.MatchingFields{mfindex.UID: uid}, client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy); err != nil {
   return n, err
  }
  if len(files.Items) > 0 {
   continue
  }
  if err := s.KV.DeleteRevision(ctx, k, e.Revision); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, events.ErrRevisionMismatch) {
   return n, err
  }
  n++
 }
 return n, nil
}
```

3f. **The markers planner,** `app/remediation/markers` (package `markers`, imported as
`markersplanner` by the manager):

```go
// Package markers is the loop's markers planner (loop spec §3.5, §4.12):
// status.markers from TheIntroDB's clustarr-markers records and the segment
// analysis's clustarr-segments records; TheIntroDB asked through a record and
// a task; the segment plan published when analysis is due.
package markers

type Options struct{ Bus events.Bus }

type Adapter struct {
 bus      events.Bus
 records  *catalogmarkers.Records
 segments *segments.Store
}

func New(o Options) *Adapter {
 return &Adapter{bus: o.Bus, records: catalogmarkers.NewRecords(o.Bus), segments: segments.NewStore(o.Bus.KV(events.BucketSegments))}
}

// Input is what Gather read.
type Input struct {
 catalogmarkers.Input
 Episode *catalogv1alpha1.Episode
 Read    bool
}

func (*Adapter) Name() remediation.PlannerName { return remediation.PlannerMarkers }

func (*Adapter) Applies(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
 k := mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind
 return k == commonv1.MediaKindMovie || k == commonv1.MediaKindEpisode
}

func (a *Adapter) Gather(ctx context.Context, env *remediation.Env, v *remediation.View) (Input, error) {
 in := Input{Read: true}
 uid := string(v.File.UID)
 q, ep, err := query(ctx, env.Reader, v.File)
 if err != nil {
  return in, remediation.Transient(err)
 }
 in.Query, in.Episode = q, ep
 rec, _, ok, err := a.segments.Get(ctx, uid)
 if err != nil {
  return in, remediation.Transient(err)
 }
 in.Segments, in.SegmentsOK = rec, ok
 if due, _ := catalogmarkers.Due(v.File, v.Now.Time); !due || q.NotAsked != "" {
  return in, nil
 }
 if in.Record, in.RecordRev, in.RecordOK, err = a.records.Get(ctx, uid); err != nil {
  return in, remediation.Transient(err)
 }
 in.RecordRead = true
 outstanding := in.RecordOK && in.Record.Inputs.ProbeHash == v.Prev.ProbeHash &&
  (in.Record.State == records.StateRequested || in.Record.State == records.StateDeferred)
 if env.Pacer != nil && !outstanding {
  if at := env.Pacer.Reserve(records.PaceMarkers, uid); at.After(v.Now.Time) {
   in.PacedUntil = at.Add(mediafile.PacerJitter(uid))
  }
 }
 return in, nil
}

func (a *Adapter) Plan(v *remediation.View, in Input, out *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) (remediation.Result, error) {
 var res remediation.Result
 if !in.Read {
  return res, nil
 }
 pin := in.Input
 pin.Kind, pin.Now, pin.Prev = v.File.Spec.MediaRef.Kind, v.Now.Time, v.Prev.Markers
 pin.File = schema.Ref{Namespace: v.File.Namespace, Name: v.File.Name, UID: string(v.File.UID)}
 pin.ProbeHash, pin.Probed = v.Draft.ProbeHash, v.Draft.MediaInfo != nil
 if v.Draft.MediaInfo != nil {
  pin.DurationMs = v.Draft.MediaInfo.RuntimeMillis
 }
 d := catalogmarkers.Plan(pin)
 out.Markers = d.Markers
 res.Due, res.Again, res.Unpaced = d.Due, d.Again, d.Unpaced
 for _, n := range d.Notes {
  res.Records = append(res.Records, remediation.RecordNote{State: n.State, TimedOut: n.TimedOut})
 }
 if d.Request != nil {
  value, err := json.Marshal(d.Request)
  if err != nil {
   return res, err
  }
  res.Effects = append(res.Effects, remediation.RecordWrite{Bucket: events.BucketMarkers, Key: events.RecordKey(pin.File.UID),
   Revision: in.RecordRev, Value: value, Remediation: "markers", Lane: "none", Pace: records.PaceMarkers})
 }
 for _, rec := range []*schema.MarkersRecord{d.Request, d.Republish} {
  if rec == nil {
   continue
  }
  subject, id, env, err := catalogmarkers.TaskMessage(*rec, v.Now.Time)
  if err != nil {
   return res, err
  }
  res.Effects = append(res.Effects, remediation.Publish{Subject: subject, MsgID: id, ExpectStream: events.StreamWorkSegmentarr, Envelope: env})
 }
 planned := v.File.DeepCopy()
 planned.Status = *out
 if segments.Due(planned, v.Now.Time) && (v.File.Spec.MediaRef.Kind == commonv1.MediaKindMovie || in.Episode != nil) {
  subject, id, env, at, err := segmentplan.PlanMessage(planned, in.Episode, v.Now.Time)
  if err != nil {
   return res, err
  }
  res.Effects = append(res.Effects, remediation.Publish{Subject: subject, MsgID: id, Envelope: env, At: at})
 }
 return res, nil
}

// Copy is markers' row of §3.5's table.
func (*Adapter) Copy(from, into *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) { into.Markers = from.Markers.DeepCopy() }

// Sources: S20 and S21 (§3.3, §4.9).
func (a *Adapter) Sources(ctrl.Manager) ([]remediation.Source, error) {
 return []remediation.Source{
  {Name: "S20/clustarr-markers", Raw: recordsource.New(a.bus, events.BucketMarkers, remediation.FileKey)},
  {Name: "S21/clustarr-segments", Raw: recordsource.New(a.bus, events.BucketSegments, remediation.FileKey,
   recordsource.WithDecoder[remediation.Key](segments.WakeRef))},
 }, nil
}
```

`query.go` is the handler's `query` moved to the loop (cache reads; D-F3-9's names):

```go
// query names mf to TheIntroDB from the cache: a movie by its TMDB id; an
// episode by its series' TVDB id, season and episode, only in the aired
// order; a file holding several episodes, or an episode in another order, is
// a NotFound the loop writes itself (§4.12). It also returns the episode,
// for the segment plan. An item the cache does not hold yet is an error the
// caller makes Transient.
func query(ctx context.Context, c client.Reader, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) (catalogmarkers.Query, *catalogv1alpha1.Episode, error) {
 key := client.ObjectKey{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: mf.Spec.MediaRef.Name}
 switch mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind {
 case commonv1.MediaKindMovie:
  var mv catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  if err := c.Get(ctx, key, &mv); err != nil {
   return catalogmarkers.Query{}, nil, err
  }
  return catalogmarkers.Query{Ask: &schema.MarkersQuery{IDs: map[string]string{"tmdb": strconv.FormatInt(mv.Spec.TmdbID, 10)}}}, nil, nil
 default:
  var ep catalogv1alpha1.Episode
  if err := c.Get(ctx, key, &ep); err != nil {
   return catalogmarkers.Query{}, nil, err
  }
  if others := otherEpisodes(mf.Spec.MediaRef); others > 0 {
   return catalogmarkers.Query{NotAsked: catalogmarkers.NotAskedMultiEpisode(others)}, &ep, nil
  }
  var sr catalogv1alpha1.Series
  if err := c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: ep.Spec.SeriesRef}, &sr); err != nil {
   return catalogmarkers.Query{}, nil, err
  }
  if order := episodeorder.EffectiveEpisodeOrder(sr.Spec.SeriesType, sr.Spec.EpisodeOrder); order != catalogv1alpha1.EpisodeOrderOfficial {
   return catalogmarkers.Query{NotAsked: catalogmarkers.NotAskedOrder(order)}, &ep, nil
  }
  tvdb := strconv.FormatInt(sr.Spec.TvdbID, 10)
  return catalogmarkers.Query{
   Ask:       &schema.MarkersQuery{IDs: map[string]string{"tvdb": tvdb}, Season: ep.Spec.SeasonNumber, Episode: ep.Spec.EpisodeNumber},
   SeriesKey: "tvdb:" + tvdb,
  }, &ep, nil
 }
}
```

(`"tmdb"`, `"tvdb"` are `metadata.KeyTMDB` and `metadata.KeyTVDB`'s values; the planner spells them
so the manager links no `pkg/metadata`, and `TestTheLoopsNotAskedMessagesMatchTheWorkers` gains
`assert.Equal(t, metadata.KeyTMDB, "tmdb")` and the TVDB twin; `otherEpisodes` moves with `query`.)

```go
// A replay annotation on a MediaFile is acted on by the loop's actuator, not
// a replay-<kind> controller: the dead letter is republished to its subject
// and the annotation (and, when it named the projector's sequence, the
// dead-lettered marker) is consumed.
func TestAReplayAnnotationOnAMediaFileIsActedOnByTheLoop(t *testing.T) {
 e := remediationtest.Start(t)
 nn := e.File(t, "replay", "heat-abc", "/data/movies/heat.mkv")
 mf := e.Get(t, nn)
 task := schema.MarkersTask{File: schema.Ref{Namespace: nn.Namespace, Name: nn.Name, UID: string(mf.UID)}, Seq: 3,
  Inputs: schema.MarkersInputs{ProbeHash: "h"}}
 name, data, err := schema.Encode(task)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 const subject = "clustarr.work.segmentarr.markers.normal.mediafile.replay.heat-abc"
 dead := &events.Envelope{ID: "markers/x/3", Schema: name, Type: "catalog.MarkersTask", Key: nn.Namespace + "/" + nn.Name, Data: data,
  Headers: map[string]string{events.HeaderDLQSubject: subject}}
 dlq := &fakeDLQ{seq: 42, subject: "clustarr.dlq.catalogarr.markers.x", env: dead}
 got := remediationtest.CaptureSubject(t, e.Bus, subject)
 act := replayactuator.New(replay.NewReplayer(replay.ReplayDeps{Client: e.Admin, Bus: e.Bus, DLQ: dlq, Recorder: e.Recorder}))
 r := e.ReconcilerWithActuators(nil, act)
 e.Annotate(t, nn, k8s.AnnotationDeadLettered, subject+"@2026-10-06T12:00:00Z")
 e.Annotate(t, nn, history.AnnotationDeadLetterSeq, "42")
 e.Annotate(t, nn, history.AnnotationReplay, "42")
 e.Pass(t, r, nn)
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return len(got()) == 1 }, 5*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond, "the dead letter was not republished")
 assert.Equal(t, "replay:42:"+string(mf.UID), got()[0].ID)
 after := e.Get(t, nn)
 assert.NotContains(t, after.Annotations, history.AnnotationReplay)
 assert.NotContains(t, after.Annotations, k8s.AnnotationDeadLettered, "the replayed sequence was the projector's: the marker goes")
 assert.False(t, slices.Contains(replay.ReplayKinds, catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.WithKind("MediaFile")),
  "MediaFile must not get a replay-<kind> controller: it would be a second MediaFile watcher (§3.9)")
}
```

```go
// Package replay is the loop's replay actuator (loop spec §3.9): a
// clustarr.io/replay request on a MediaFile, handled by the one Replayer
// every replay-<kind> controller uses, without a MediaFile controller of its
// own.
package replay

type Actuator struct{ r *replay.Replayer }

// New is the replay actuator over r.
func New(r *replay.Replayer) *Actuator { return &Actuator{r: r} }

func (*Actuator) Name() string { return "replay" }

// Act hands applied's metadata to the Replayer when it carries the replay
// annotation: it republishes the dead letter and consumes the annotation
// with its own guarded JSON patch (history/replay).
func (a *Actuator) Act(ctx context.Context, _ *remediation.Env, _ client.Client, applied *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) (time.Duration, error) {
 if _, ok := applied.Annotations[history.AnnotationReplay]; !ok {
  return 0, nil
 }
 obj := &metav1.PartialObjectMetadata{
  TypeMeta:   metav1.TypeMeta{APIVersion: catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.String(), Kind: "MediaFile"},
  ObjectMeta: *applied.ObjectMeta.DeepCopy(),
 }
 res, err := a.r.Replay(ctx, obj)
 return res.RequeueAfter, err
}
```

```go
func Actuators(mgr ctrl.Manager, d Deps) []remediation.Actuator {
 acts := []remediation.Actuator{rename.New(rename.Options{Recorder: mgr.GetEventRecorder("rename")})}
 if reader, ok := history.DLQReaderFor(d.Env.Bus); ok {
  acts = append(acts, replayactuator.New(replay.NewReplayer(replay.ReplayDeps{
   Client: mgr.GetClient(), Bus: d.Env.Bus, DLQ: reader, Recorder: mgr.GetEventRecorder("clustarr-replay"),
  })))
 }
 return acts
}
```

`helm dependency build charts/clustarr` once per worktree before `make test` or any `test/guards`
test. No task in this wave changes an API type or an RBAC marker; each still proves the roles did
not move with `make manifests && git diff --exit-code -- config/rbac charts/clustarr/templates/rbac.yaml`.

## What the wave does

- **F4.1** builds the one MediaFile index by item, `remediation.mediafile.item`, and moves every
  reader of the nine it replaces onto it: the six item reconcilers, the loop's naming wakes (F3.1's
  port of `mediafile.clustarr.io/owner`), captionarr's `captionarr.spec.mediaRef`, librarydelete's
  `librarydelete.spec.mediaRef.target`, and the segment planner. It folds the three identical
  Episode-by-series indexes into the Series controller's `.spec.seriesRef`. The item controllers
  still exist after F4.1; only their indexes change.
- **F4.2** makes Movie and Episode the loop's item keys: their controllers go, `ReconcileItem` and
  `Watches()` replace `Reconcile` and `SetupWithManager`, the loop adapts their watches to `Key`,
  the item arm of the MediaFile source (S1, S1') replaces their MediaFile watches, and every status
  write goes through `itemstatus.Apply`.
- **F4.3** does the same for Album, Book, Audiobook and Issue, and moves Album's track-listing RPC
  behind `album.ReleaseCache`.
- **F4.4** is the gate.

## Deviations from loop spec §8.6 and §3.12, each with its reason

1. **`episode.MediaFileByEpisodeIndex` is deleted, not pointed at the new index.** §8.6 F4.1 says it
   "points at it, so the segment planner keeps working", but the new index's values are
   `<kind>/<name>` and the planner passes a bare episode name: an alias would compile and find
   nothing, silently. The segment planner reads `mfindex.Item` with `mfindex.ItemKey` instead, and
   the deleted name makes every other reader fail to compile.
2. **The item status write lives in `app/catalog/controller/itemstatus`, not in `rollup` or
   `app/remediation`.** The catalog agent links `rollup` (`app/catalog/worker/{search,grab}`), so a
   `catalogarr` apply there makes W5.19's `TestEveryFieldManagerHasItsHome` see `catalogarr` in the
   `catalog` home; `app/remediation` imports the item packages, so they cannot import it back.
   `itemstatus.Apply` is `k8s.PatchStatusCAS`'s single attempt over the planned view (§3.12) without
   the read: the view is the object in hand, so it applies with that object's resourceVersion.
3. **Items keep their AudioGraft watch and read until F7.3.** §3.12 says "the MediaFile and
   AudioGraft watches go", but `status.graft` is written only from F7.2 and the donor only from
   F7.1, so dropping the AudioGraft watch in F4 would freeze `status.audio.graft`. §3.3's S23 keeps
   today's AudioGraft watches until each kind's fold; the AudioGraft watch is one of the items'
   `Watches()` until F7.3 removes it.
4. **The item arm of S1/S1' is its own handler on the loop's MediaFile informer**
   (`ItemReconciler`'s file wakes), registered on the same controller as F3.1's `mediaFileEvents`.
   One informer event reaches both; the behaviour is §3.3's. The item packages' envtests run the
   same handler through `app/remediation/itemtest` without the file planners. It enqueues item keys
   on a create, a delete, a generation change and a `FileSignature` change only: §2.14 lists only
   rollup inputs, and `spec.mediaRef` is immutable (`self == oldSelf`), so S1's "old and new
   mediaRef" is one ref and an annotation or label change wakes no item.
5. **The loop does not register `.spec.seriesRef`.** §3.16 says all indexes are registered by
   `remediation.RegisterIndexes`, but the Series controller (not folded) registers
   `.spec.seriesRef`; a second registration is an indexer conflict. The loop reads it; F4.1
   exports `series.RegisterIndexes` for the controller and for test harnesses.
6. **Item map functions read without deep copies** (F4.3). Six item controllers' sources now gate
   one controller's `HasSynced`, so a slow map function delays every file pass, not one kind
   (CLAUDE.md, "A watch's map function runs for every object at startup"). `albumsOf`, `booksOf`,
   `issuesOf` and the Artist/Author/Comic Lists in the three `mapQualityProfile`s only read, so they
   list with `client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy`.

```go
import (

func file(ns, name string, ref commonv1.MediaRef) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 return &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: ns, Name: name},
  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{MediaRef: ref, Path: "/data/media/" + name + ".mkv"},
 }
}

// builderIndexer registers Register's index on a fake client builder.
type builderIndexer struct{ b *fake.ClientBuilder }

func (i builderIndexer) IndexField(_ context.Context, obj client.Object, field string, fn client.IndexerFunc) error {
 i.b.WithIndex(obj, field, fn)
 return nil
}

// One index serves every item kind and every item a pack covers: the second
// episode of a multi-episode file finds it, which captionarr's index never
// did (loop spec §3.16).
func TestExtractNamesTheItemAndEveryKey(t *testing.T) {
 for _, tc := range []struct {
  name string
  ref  commonv1.MediaRef
  want []string
 }{
  {"movie", commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"}, []string{"movie/heat"}},
  {"multi-episode file", commonv1.MediaRef{
   Kind: commonv1.MediaKindEpisode, Name: "show-s01e01", Keys: []string{"show-s01e01", "show-s01e02"},
  }, []string{"episode/show-s01e01", "episode/show-s01e02"}},
  {"a track narrows the album and adds no value", commonv1.MediaRef{
   Kind: commonv1.MediaKindAlbum, Name: "ok-computer", Track: "rec-2",
  }, []string{"album/ok-computer"}},
  {"book", commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindBook, Name: "earthsea"}, []string{"book/earthsea"}},
  {"audiobook", commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindAudiobook, Name: "guards-guards"}, []string{"audiobook/guards-guards"}},
  {"issue pack, an empty key skipped", commonv1.MediaRef{
   Kind: commonv1.MediaKindIssue, Name: "saga-1", Keys: []string{"saga-1", "saga-2", ""},
  }, []string{"issue/saga-1", "issue/saga-2"}},
  {"attributed to nothing", commonv1.MediaRef{}, nil},
 } {
  t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   assert.Equal(t, tc.want, mfindex.Extract(file("media", "f", tc.ref)))
  })
 }
 assert.Nil(t, mfindex.Extract(&catalogv1alpha1.Movie{}), "another kind indexes nothing")
}

// The value is the one librarydelete and the item packages build:
// "<kind>/<name>" in the MediaRef vocabulary.
func TestItemKey(t *testing.T) {
 assert.Equal(t, "episode/show-s01e02", mfindex.ItemKey(commonv1.MediaKindEpisode, "show-s01e02"))
}

func TestIndexDeclaresTheOneName(t *testing.T) {
 assert.Equal(t, "remediation.mediafile.item", mfindex.Item)
 assert.Equal(t, mfindex.Item, mfindex.Index.Name)
 assert.IsType(t, &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{}, mfindex.Index.Object)
 require.NotNil(t, mfindex.Index.Extract)
}

// FilesOf lists through the index, never the namespace, and narrows by kind
// and namespace both.
func TestFilesOfListsThroughTheIndex(t *testing.T) {
 b := fake.NewClientBuilder().WithScheme(k8s.MustNewScheme()).WithObjects(
  file("media", "heat-1080p", commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"}),
  file("media", "s01e01e02", commonv1.MediaRef{
   Kind: commonv1.MediaKindEpisode, Name: "show-s01e01", Keys: []string{"show-s01e01", "show-s01e02"},
  }),
  file("other", "heat-elsewhere", commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"}),
  file("media", "an-episode-named-heat", commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindEpisode, Name: "heat"}),
 ).WithInterceptorFuncs(interceptor.Funcs{List: func(ctx context.Context, c client.WithWatch, list client.ObjectList, opts ...client.ListOption) error {
  lo := (&client.ListOptions{}).ApplyOptions(opts)
  require.False(t, lo.FieldSelector == nil || lo.FieldSelector.Empty(), "FilesOf listed the whole namespace")
  return c.List(ctx, list, opts...)
 }})
 require.NoError(t, mfindex.Register(context.Background(), builderIndexer{b}))
 c := b.Build()

 names := func(kind commonv1.MediaKind, name string) []string {
  files, err := mfindex.FilesOf(context.Background(), c, "media", kind, name)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  out := []string{}
  for _, f := range files {
   out = append(out, f.Name)
  }
  return out
 }
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"heat-1080p"}, names(commonv1.MediaKindMovie, "heat"))
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"s01e01e02"}, names(commonv1.MediaKindEpisode, "show-s01e02"), "the second episode finds the pack")
 assert.Equal(t, []string{}, names(commonv1.MediaKindBook, "heat"))
}
```

```go
func fileFor(ref commonv1.MediaRef) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {

  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{MediaRef: ref, Path: "/data/media/f.mkv"},
 }

// A file is one file key and one item key per item it covers (loop spec §3.2).
func TestItemKeysAreTheItemsAFileCovers(t *testing.T) {
 key := func(kind remediation.KeyKind, name string) remediation.Key {
  return remediation.Key{Kind: kind, Namespace: "media", Name: name}
 }
 assert.Equal(t, []remediation.Key{key(remediation.KindMovie, "heat")},
  remediation.ItemKeys(fileFor(commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"})))
 assert.Equal(t, []remediation.Key{key(remediation.KindEpisode, "show-s01e01"), key(remediation.KindEpisode, "show-s01e02")},
  remediation.ItemKeys(fileFor(commonv1.MediaRef{
   Kind: commonv1.MediaKindEpisode, Name: "show-s01e01", Keys: []string{"show-s01e01", "show-s01e02"},
  })), "a multi-episode file is N Episode keys, its first episode once")
 assert.Equal(t, []remediation.Key{key(remediation.KindAlbum, "ok-computer")},
  remediation.ItemKeys(fileFor(commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindAlbum, Name: "ok-computer", Track: "rec-2"})),
  "mediaRef.track narrows an Album reference and makes no key")
 assert.Equal(t, []remediation.Key{key(remediation.KindBook, "earthsea")},
  remediation.ItemKeys(fileFor(commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindBook, Name: "earthsea"})))
 assert.Equal(t, []remediation.Key{key(remediation.KindAudiobook, "guards-guards")},
  remediation.ItemKeys(fileFor(commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindAudiobook, Name: "guards-guards"})))
 assert.Equal(t, []remediation.Key{key(remediation.KindIssue, "saga-1")},
  remediation.ItemKeys(fileFor(commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindIssue, Name: "saga-1"})))
 for _, k := range []commonv1.MediaKind{commonv1.MediaKindSeries, commonv1.MediaKindArtist, commonv1.MediaKindAuthor, commonv1.MediaKindComic} {
  assert.Nil(t, remediation.ItemKeys(fileFor(commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: k, Name: "x"})), "%s holds no files of its own", k)
 }
 assert.Nil(t, remediation.ItemKeys(nil))
}

func TestItemKindCoversTheSixItemKinds(t *testing.T) {
 for mk, want := range map[commonv1.MediaKind]remediation.KeyKind{
  commonv1.MediaKindMovie: remediation.KindMovie, commonv1.MediaKindEpisode: remediation.KindEpisode,
  commonv1.MediaKindAlbum: remediation.KindAlbum, commonv1.MediaKindBook: remediation.KindBook,
  commonv1.MediaKindAudiobook: remediation.KindAudiobook, commonv1.MediaKindIssue: remediation.KindIssue,
 } {
  got, ok := remediation.ItemKind(mk)
  require.True(t, ok, mk)
  assert.Equal(t, want, got)
 }
 _, ok := remediation.ItemKind(commonv1.MediaKindSeries)
 assert.False(t, ok)
 assert.Equal(t, remediation.KeyKind("Movie"), remediation.KindMovie, "§3.2's spelling")
}
```

```go
package guards

import (
 "go/ast"
 "go/token"
 "strconv"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// The nine MediaFile item indexes and the two duplicate Episode-by-series
// indexes are gone (loop spec §3.16): remediation.mediafile.item serves every
// reader of a file by its item, and Episodes are found by series through the
// Series controller's ".spec.seriesRef". A literal naming a retired index in
// production code is a reader that would find nothing and say nothing: the
// cache answers an unregistered index with an error the map functions swallow.
func TestTheRetiredMediaFileIndexesAreGone(t *testing.T) {
 retired := map[string]bool{
  ".spec.mediaRef.movie": true, ".spec.mediaRef.episode": true, ".spec.mediaRef.album": true,
  ".spec.mediaRef.book": true, ".spec.mediaRef.audiobook": true, ".spec.mediaRef.issue": true,
  "mediafile.clustarr.io/owner": true, "captionarr.spec.mediaRef": true,
  "librarydelete.spec.mediaRef.target": true,
  "episode.spec.seriesRef": true, "mediafile.clustarr.io/episode-series": true,
 }
 files := productionFiles(t)
 require.Greater(t, len(files), 100, "productionFiles found too few files; this guard is not looking where it thinks it is")
 for path, f := range files {
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   lit, ok := n.(*ast.BasicLit)
   if !ok || lit.Kind != token.STRING {
    return true
   }
   if s, err := strconv.Unquote(lit.Value); err == nil && retired[s] {
    t.Errorf("%s names the retired index %q: read remediation.mediafile.item (app/remediation/mfindex) "+
     "or series.EpisodeBySeriesRefIndex", path, s)
   }
   return true
  })
 }
}
```

```go
package mfindex

import (

 "fmt"
 "slices"

 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// Item is the one index of MediaFiles by the catalog item they back (loop
// spec §3.16). It replaces nine: the six item controllers'
// ".spec.mediaRef.<kind>", the MediaFile reconciler's
// "mediafile.clustarr.io/owner", captionarr's "captionarr.spec.mediaRef" and
// librarydelete's "librarydelete.spec.mediaRef.target". Readers: the item
// keys, the loop's naming wakes, librarydelete, the segment planner, and
// until F5.3 the two caption controllers.
const Item = "remediation.mediafile.item"

// Index declares Item (split spec §3.5.2). The remediation loop registers it
// once per process, through Register from remediation.RegisterIndexes; every
// other reader only lists through it, and a test that runs a reader without
// the loop registers it itself.
var Index = k8s.FieldIndex{Object: &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{}, Name: Item, Extract: Extract}

// ItemKey is Item's value for one item: "<kind>/<name>", kind in the
// MediaRef vocabulary ("movie", "episode", ...).
func ItemKey(kind commonv1.MediaKind, name string) string { return string(kind) + "/" + name }

// Extract is Item's extractor: the ItemKey of spec.mediaRef's item and of
// every spec.mediaRef.keys entry, each once, so every episode of a
// multi-episode file (and every issue of a pack) finds it. mediaRef.track
// narrows an Album reference and adds no value. A file attributed to
// nothing has none.
func Extract(o client.Object) []string {
 mf, ok := o.(*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile)
 if !ok || mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind == "" || mf.Spec.MediaRef.Name == "" {
  return nil
 }
 ref := mf.Spec.MediaRef
 out := []string{ItemKey(ref.Kind, ref.Name)}
 for _, name := range ref.Keys {
  if key := ItemKey(ref.Kind, name); name != "" && !slices.Contains(out, key) {
   out = append(out, key)
  }
 }
 return out
}

// Register registers Item on idx. A second registration on one cache is an
// "indexer conflict", so only remediation.RegisterIndexes calls it in a
// process, and tests that run a reader without the loop.
func Register(ctx context.Context, idx client.FieldIndexer) error {
 if err := idx.IndexField(ctx, Index.Object, Index.Name, Index.Extract); err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("mfindex: register %s: %w", Item, err)
 }
 return nil
}

// FilesOf lists the MediaFiles of the item kind/name in namespace through
// Item, never the whole namespace (CLAUDE.md, "A watch's map function runs
// for every object at startup"). opts are added to the List, so a map
// function that only reads names passes client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy.
func FilesOf(ctx context.Context, r client.Reader, namespace string, kind commonv1.MediaKind, name string,
 opts ...client.ListOption,
) ([]catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, error) {
 var files catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
 all := append([]client.ListOption{client.InNamespace(namespace), client.MatchingFields{Item: ItemKey(kind, name)}}, opts...)
 if err := r.List(ctx, &files, all...); err != nil {
  return nil, fmt.Errorf("mfindex: MediaFiles of %s %s/%s: %w", kind, namespace, name, err)
 }
 return files.Items, nil
}
```

1. `app/remediation/itemkeys.go`:

```go
package remediation

import (
 "slices"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
)

// The item kinds (loop spec §3.2): the loop's second key type, beside
// KindMediaFile. An item key reconciles one catalog item's file rollups
// (§3.12); it writes that item's status and finalizer and nothing else.
const (
 KindMovie     KeyKind = "Movie"
 KindEpisode   KeyKind = "Episode"
 KindAlbum     KeyKind = "Album"
 KindBook      KeyKind = "Book"
 KindAudiobook KeyKind = "Audiobook"
 KindIssue     KeyKind = "Issue"
)

var itemKinds = map[commonv1.MediaKind]KeyKind{
 commonv1.MediaKindMovie:     KindMovie,
 commonv1.MediaKindEpisode:   KindEpisode,
 commonv1.MediaKindAlbum:     KindAlbum,
 commonv1.MediaKindBook:      KindBook,
 commonv1.MediaKindAudiobook: KindAudiobook,
 commonv1.MediaKindIssue:     KindIssue,
}

// ItemKind is the item key kind of a MediaRef kind; false for a kind that
// holds no files of its own (series, artist, author, comic).
func ItemKind(kind commonv1.MediaKind) (KeyKind, bool) {
 k, ok := itemKinds[kind]
 return k, ok
}

// ItemKeys are the items whose rollups mf feeds (loop spec §3.2):
// spec.mediaRef's item and every spec.mediaRef.keys entry, each once, in
// that order. keys exists only for Episode and Issue packs, so a
// multi-episode file is one file key and N Episode keys; mediaRef.track
// narrows an Album reference and makes no key.
func ItemKeys(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) []Key {
 if mf == nil {
  return nil
 }
 kind, ok := ItemKind(mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind)
 if !ok || mf.Spec.MediaRef.Name == "" {
  return nil
 }
 var keys []Key
 for _, name := range append([]string{mf.Spec.MediaRef.Name}, mf.Spec.MediaRef.Keys...) {
  k := Key{Kind: kind, Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: name}
  if name != "" && !slices.Contains(keys, k) {
   keys = append(keys, k)
  }
 }
 return keys
}
```

```go
// RegisterIndexes registers EpisodeBySeriesRefIndex. The Series controller
// registers it (SetupWithManager); every other reader in the manager -- the
// Episode item path, the remediation loop's naming wakes, the segment
// planner -- reads this one index (loop spec §3.16, "Consolidated"), and a
// test that runs one of them without the Series controller calls this.
func RegisterIndexes(ctx context.Context, idx client.FieldIndexer) error {
 return idx.IndexField(ctx, &catalogv1alpha1.Episode{}, episodeBySeriesRefIndexKey, indexEpisodeBySeriesRef)
}

func indexEpisodeBySeriesRef(o client.Object) []string {
 ep, ok := o.(*catalogv1alpha1.Episode)
 if !ok {
  return nil
 }
 return []string{ep.Spec.SeriesRef}
}
```

```go
package itemstatus_test

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/reconcile"

 catalogac "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/applyconfiguration/catalog/catalog/v1alpha1"
 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/itemstatus"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/test/starttest"
)

// statusFields is each manager's owned top-level status fields.
func statusFields(t *testing.T, m *catalogv1alpha1.Movie) map[string]map[string]any {
 t.Helper()
 out := map[string]map[string]any{}
 for _, e := range m.ManagedFields {
  if e.Subresource != "status" || e.FieldsV1 == nil {
   continue
  }
  var f map[string]any
  require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(e.FieldsV1.Raw, &f))
  out[e.Manager], _ = f["f:status"].(map[string]any)
 }
 return out
}

// An item apply seeded from a view another manager has since overtaken is a
// Conflict, never a rollback; seeded from the fresh object it lands under
// catalogarr and leaves the other manager's leaves alone (loop spec §3.12,
// "Why CAS"; CLAUDE.md, "A lost update is not an SSA release").
func TestApplyRefusesAStaleViewAndLandsAFreshOne(t *testing.T) {
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 ctx := t.Context()
 c, err := client.New(env.Config, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)

 m := &catalogv1alpha1.Movie{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "default", Name: "heat"},
  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.MovieSpec{TmdbID: 949, QualityProfileRef: "hd", RootFolderRef: "movies"},
 }
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, m))
 view := m.DeepCopy() // what a reconcile planned from

 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMetadata, catalogac.Movie("heat", "default").WithStatus(
  catalogac.MovieStatus().WithMetadata(catalogac.MovieMetadata().WithTitle("Heat").WithYear(1995).
   WithStatus(catalogv1alpha1.MovieReleaseStatusReleased).WithRefreshedAt(metav1.Now()))))
 require.NoError(t, err)

 wanted := func() *catalogac.MovieApplyConfiguration {
  return catalogac.Movie("heat", "default").WithStatus(catalogac.MovieStatus().WithPhase(catalogv1alpha1.MoviePhaseWanted))
 }
 conflicted, err := itemstatus.Apply(ctx, c, view, wanted())
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, conflicted, "an apply seeded from a stale view must not land")
 assert.Equal(t, reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: itemstatus.ConflictRequeue}, itemstatus.Requeue(conflicted))
 var got catalogv1alpha1.Movie
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(m), &got))
 assert.Empty(t, got.Status.Phase)

 conflicted, err = itemstatus.Apply(ctx, c, &got, wanted())
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.False(t, conflicted)
 assert.Equal(t, reconcile.Result{}, itemstatus.Requeue(conflicted))
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(m), &got))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.MoviePhaseWanted, got.Status.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, "Heat", got.Status.Metadata.Title, "the other manager's write survives")
 owned := statusFields(t, &got)
 assert.Contains(t, owned["catalogarr"], "f:phase")
 assert.NotContains(t, owned["catalogarr"], "f:metadata", "catalogarr claims nothing the gateway owns")
 assert.Contains(t, owned["catalogarr-metadata"], "f:metadata")
}
```

```go
package remediation

import (
 "context"
 "errors"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"

 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/reconcile"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/rollup"
)

func heatFile(gen int64, labels map[string]string, st catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 return &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "heat-1080p", Generation: gen, Labels: labels},
  Spec: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{
   MediaRef: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"},
   Path:     "/data/media/movies/Heat (1995)/Heat.mkv",
  },
  Status: st,
 }
}

func readyIs(s metav1.ConditionStatus) []metav1.Condition {
 return []metav1.Condition{{Type: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionReady, Status: s, Reason: "Probed"}}
}

// A status-only update wakes the file's items only when an input to their
// rollups moved (loop spec §3.3 S1', §2.14); a spec change always does.
func TestItemWakeKeys(t *testing.T) {
 heat := []Key{{Kind: KindMovie, Namespace: "media", Name: "heat"}}
 none := catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{}
 for _, tc := range []struct {
  name     string
  old, cur *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  want     []Key
 }{
  {"a spec change", heatFile(1, nil, none), heatFile(2, nil, none), heat},
  {"the Transcoded verdict", heatFile(1, nil, none),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{TranscodeProfile: "hevc@abc"}}), heat},
  {"the probed audio languages", heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{
   Audio: []commonv1.AudioStream{{Language: "eng"}}}}),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{
    Audio: []commonv1.AudioStream{{Language: "eng"}, {Language: "jpn"}}}}), heat},
  {"probed at all", heatFile(1, nil, none), heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeHash: "p1"}), heat},
  {"a new probe hash alone", heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeHash: "p1"}),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeHash: "p2"}), nil},
  {"Ready", heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{Conditions: readyIs(metav1.ConditionTrue)}),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{Conditions: readyIs(metav1.ConditionFalse)}), heat},
  {"the transcode phase", heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{
   Transcode: &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase("Queued")}}),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{
    Transcode: &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase("Running")}}), heat},
  {"the graft phase", heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{
   Graft: &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase("Waiting")}}),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{
    Graft: &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase("Running")}}), heat},
  {"the graft tag", heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{
   Graft: &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase("Succeeded")}}),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{
    Graft: &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase("Succeeded"), Tag: "graft@1"}}), heat},
  {"probe metadata outside the rollups", heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeVersion: 1}),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeVersion: 2}), nil},
  {"the loop's own sequence", heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{LastSeq: 1}),
   heatFile(1, nil, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{LastSeq: 2}), nil},
  {"a label", heatFile(1, nil, none), heatFile(1, map[string]string{"tier": "hd"}, none), nil},
 } {
  t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   assert.Equal(t, tc.want, itemWakeKeys(tc.old, tc.cur))
  })
 }
 assert.Equal(t, heat, itemWakeKeys(nil, heatFile(1, nil, none)), "a missing old object reads as a create")
}

type recordingItem struct {
 res  reconcile.Result
 seen []types.NamespacedName
}

func (r *recordingItem) ReconcileItem(_ context.Context, nn types.NamespacedName) (reconcile.Result, error) {
 r.seen = append(r.seen, nn)
 return r.res, nil
}

func (r *recordingItem) Watches() []rollup.Watch { return nil }

// An item key reaches its kind's path, and the timer it asks for is a Due
// requeue (loop spec §3.11).
func TestItemReconcilerDispatchesByKind(t *testing.T) {
 movies := &recordingItem{res: reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: time.Hour}}
 ir := &ItemReconciler{Items: map[KeyKind]rollup.Item{KindMovie: movies}}
 res, err := ir.Reconcile(context.Background(), Key{Kind: KindMovie, Namespace: "media", Name: "heat"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, []types.NamespacedName{{Namespace: "media", Name: "heat"}}, movies.seen)
 require.NotNil(t, res.Priority)
 assert.Equal(t, PriorityTimed, *res.Priority)

 _, err = ir.Reconcile(context.Background(), Key{Kind: KindAlbum, Namespace: "media", Name: "x"})
 require.Error(t, err)
 assert.True(t, errors.Is(err, reconcile.TerminalError(nil)), "a kind with no path is not retried")
}
```

`app/catalog/controller/rollup/downloadpredicate_test.go`:

```go
package rollup_test

import (
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/event"

 downloadv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/download/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/rollup"
)

// TestDownloadPredicateSeesAnImportHeldForAPerson is S9's edge (loop spec
// §3.3, §3.12): importarr holding an import for a person leaves the Download
// Completed, but DownloadNonTerminal no longer counts it, so the item must
// wake although the phase did not move -- else a transcoded movie keeps
// activeDownloadRef and reads Downloading until an unrelated wake.
func TestDownloadPredicateSeesAnImportHeldForAPerson(t *testing.T) {
 p := rollup.DownloadPredicate()
 old := &downloadv1alpha1.Download{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "heat-dl", Namespace: "media", Generation: 1}}
 old.Status.Phase = downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPhaseCompleted
 old.Status.Import = &downloadv1alpha1.ImportState{State: downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhasePending}
 held := old.DeepCopy()
 now := metav1.Now()
 held.Status.Import = &downloadv1alpha1.ImportState{State: downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseBlocked,
  Message: downloadv1alpha1.ImportMessageExistingFileFinal, HeldSince: &now}
 require.True(t, rollup.DownloadNonTerminal(old))
 require.False(t, rollup.DownloadNonTerminal(held), "the fixture must be an import held for a person")
 assert.True(t, p.Update(event.UpdateEvent{ObjectOld: old, ObjectNew: held}), "a held import wakes the item")

 msg := old.DeepCopy()
 msg.Status.Import.Message = "importing 1 of 2"
 assert.False(t, p.Update(event.UpdateEvent{ObjectOld: old, ObjectNew: msg}), "an import message alone wakes nothing")
}
```

(The held import sets both `message` and `heldSince`, so the test holds whichever form of
`DownloadNonTerminal`'s import rule the branch carries: `991b7ced`'s `ImportMessageExistingFileFinal`
or `1b62902b`'s `heldSince`, which F0.2's rebase brings.)

```go
package remediation_test

import (
 "context"
 "sync"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 ctrl "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 metricsserver "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/metrics/server"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/reconcile"

 catalogac "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/applyconfiguration/catalog/catalog/v1alpha1"
 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/rollup"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation/itemtest"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation/mfindex"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/test/starttest"
)

// countingItem counts the item keys the loop reconciles for one kind.
type countingItem struct {
 mu   sync.Mutex
 seen map[types.NamespacedName]int
}

func (c *countingItem) ReconcileItem(_ context.Context, nn types.NamespacedName) (reconcile.Result, error) {
 c.mu.Lock()
 defer c.mu.Unlock()
 c.seen[nn]++
 return reconcile.Result{}, nil
}

func (c *countingItem) Watches() []rollup.Watch { return nil }

func (c *countingItem) count(name string) int {
 c.mu.Lock()
 defer c.mu.Unlock()
 return c.seen[types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: name}]
}

func mediaFile(name string, ref commonv1.MediaRef) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 return &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "default", Name: name},
  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{MediaRef: ref, Path: "/data/media/" + name + ".mkv"},
 }
}

// The item arm of the MediaFile source (loop spec §3.3 S1, S1'; §2.14
// "Wake-ups") wakes every item a file covers when the file appears or goes,
// when its spec changes, and when an input to the items' rollups moves in a
// status-only write -- and for nothing else, so the loop's own status
// applies do not churn 16,500 items.
func TestTheItemArmWakesTheItemsAFileCovers(t *testing.T) {
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 ctx := t.Context()
 mgr, err := ctrl.NewManager(env.Config, ctrl.Options{
  Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme(), Metrics: metricsserver.Options{BindAddress: "0"}, HealthProbeBindAddress: "0",
 })
 require.NoError(t, err)
 movies := &countingItem{seen: map[types.NamespacedName]int{}}
 episodes := &countingItem{seen: map[types.NamespacedName]int{}}
 require.NoError(t, mfindex.Register(ctx, mgr.GetFieldIndexer()))
 require.NoError(t, itemtest.Start(mgr, map[remediation.KeyKind]rollup.Item{
  remediation.KindMovie: movies, remediation.KindEpisode: episodes,
 }))
 go func() { _ = mgr.Start(ctx) }()
 require.True(t, mgr.GetCache().WaitForCacheSync(ctx))
 c := mgr.GetClient()

 heat := mediaFile("heat-1080p", commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"})
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, heat))
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return movies.count("heat") > 0 }, 10*time.Second, 20*time.Millisecond, "a new file wakes its movie")

 pack := mediaFile("show-s01e01e02", commonv1.MediaRef{
  Kind: commonv1.MediaKindEpisode, Name: "show-s01e01", Keys: []string{"show-s01e01", "show-s01e02"},
 })
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, pack))
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return episodes.count("show-s01e01") > 0 && episodes.count("show-s01e02") > 0 },
  10*time.Second, 20*time.Millisecond, "a multi-episode file wakes every episode it covers")

 // A status write outside every rollup's inputs wakes no item.
 before := movies.count("heat")
 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr,
  catalogac.MediaFile(heat.Name, heat.Namespace).WithStatus(catalogac.MediaFileStatus().WithProbeVersion(7)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  var got catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  return c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(heat), &got) == nil && got.Status.ProbeVersion == 7
 }, 10*time.Second, 20*time.Millisecond)
 require.Never(t, func() bool { return movies.count("heat") > before }, 2*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond,
  "a probeVersion write woke the movie")

 // The Transcoded verdict moving in a status-only write does.
 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr,
  catalogac.MediaFile(heat.Name, heat.Namespace).WithStatus(catalogac.MediaFileStatus().WithProbeVersion(7).
   WithMediaInfo(commonv1.MediaInfo{Container: "mkv", VideoCodec: "hevc", TranscodeProfile: "hevc-main10@abc"})))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return movies.count("heat") > before }, 10*time.Second, 20*time.Millisecond,
  "the Transcoded verdict must reach the movie")

 // A file going wakes every item it covered.
 e1, e2 := episodes.count("show-s01e01"), episodes.count("show-s01e02")
 require.NoError(t, c.Delete(ctx, pack))
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return episodes.count("show-s01e01") > e1 && episodes.count("show-s01e02") > e2 },
  10*time.Second, 20*time.Millisecond, "a deleted pack wakes both episodes")
}

// downloadItem counts its keys and watches Downloads through S9's shared
// predicate, mapping each to its target, as the six item kinds do.
type downloadItem struct{ countingItem }

func (d *downloadItem) Watches() []rollup.Watch {
 return []rollup.Watch{{Object: &downloadv1alpha1.Download{}, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{rollup.DownloadPredicate()},
  Map: func(_ context.Context, o client.Object) []reconcile.Request {
   dl := o.(*downloadv1alpha1.Download)
   return []reconcile.Request{{NamespacedName: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: dl.Namespace, Name: dl.Spec.Target.Name}}}
  }}}
}

// TestAnImportHeldForAPersonWakesTheItem is S9's edge against a real
// apiserver and cache (loop spec §3.3, §3.12): a Completed Download whose
// import importarr holds for a person wakes its item though the phase stays
// Completed; an import message alone does not.
func TestAnImportHeldForAPersonWakesTheItem(t *testing.T) {
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 ctx := t.Context()
 mgr, err := ctrl.NewManager(env.Config, ctrl.Options{
  Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme(), Metrics: metricsserver.Options{BindAddress: "0"}, HealthProbeBindAddress: "0",
 })
 require.NoError(t, err)
 movies := &downloadItem{countingItem{seen: map[types.NamespacedName]int{}}}
 require.NoError(t, mfindex.Register(ctx, mgr.GetFieldIndexer()))
 require.NoError(t, itemtest.Start(mgr, map[remediation.KeyKind]rollup.Item{remediation.KindMovie: movies}))
 go func() { _ = mgr.Start(ctx) }()
 require.True(t, mgr.GetCache().WaitForCacheSync(ctx))
 c := mgr.GetClient()

 magnet := "magnet:?xt=urn:btih:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"
 dl := &downloadv1alpha1.Download{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "heat-dl", Namespace: "default"},
  Spec: downloadv1alpha1.DownloadSpec{Protocol: commonv1.ProtocolTorrent,
   Source: downloadv1alpha1.DownloadSource{MagnetURL: &magnet},
   Target: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"}},
 }
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, dl))
 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerGrabarr, downloadac.Download(dl.Name, dl.Namespace).WithStatus(
  downloadac.DownloadStatus().WithPhase(downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPhaseCompleted)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerImportarr, downloadac.Download(dl.Name, dl.Namespace).WithStatus(
  downloadac.DownloadStatus().WithImport(downloadac.ImportState().WithState(downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhasePending))))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return movies.count("heat") > 0 }, 10*time.Second, 20*time.Millisecond)
 time.Sleep(time.Second) // the create and the two status writes settle
 before := movies.count("heat")

 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerImportarr, downloadac.Download(dl.Name, dl.Namespace).WithStatus(
  downloadac.DownloadStatus().WithImport(downloadac.ImportState().WithState(downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhasePending).
   WithMessage("importing 1 of 2"))))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Never(t, func() bool { return movies.count("heat") > before }, 2*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond,
  "an import message alone woke the item")

 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerImportarr, downloadac.Download(dl.Name, dl.Namespace).WithStatus(
  downloadac.DownloadStatus().WithImport(downloadac.ImportState().WithState(downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseBlocked).
   WithMessage(downloadv1alpha1.ImportMessageExistingFileFinal).WithHeldSince(metav1.Now()))))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return movies.count("heat") > before }, 10*time.Second, 20*time.Millisecond,
  "an import held for a person must wake the item though the phase stayed Completed")
}
```

```go
  &catalogv1alpha1.Episode{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "default", Name: "itemkey-show-s01e01"},
   Spec: catalogv1alpha1.EpisodeSpec{SeriesRef: "itemkey-show", SeasonNumber: 1, EpisodeNumber: 1}},
  &catalogv1alpha1.Episode{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "default", Name: "itemkey-show-s01e02"},

  &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "default", Name: "itemkey-show-s01e01e02"},

    Path: "/data/media/tv/Show/Season 01/Show - S01E01E02.mkv", Quality: q}},
 }
 for _, o := range objs {
  require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, o))
 }

  var m catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  return c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: "default", Name: "itemkey-heat"}, &m) == nil &&

 // it creates selects these files. The Movie and the Episodes carry the item
 // finalizer, so their going also proves the item path's reconcileDelete.
 for _, o := range objs {
  require.NoError(t, client.IgnoreNotFound(c.Delete(ctx, o)))

 for _, o := range objs {

  })
```
