```go
package rollup

import (
 "context"

 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/handler"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/predicate"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/reconcile"
)

// Item is one item kind on the remediation loop's queue (loop spec §3.12):
// how to reconcile one item, and every watch that wakes it except its
// MediaFiles', which the loop's file signature (S1') wakes it for. The six
// item packages implement it and never import app/remediation, which adapts
// each Watch to its Key.
type Item interface {
 ReconcileItem(ctx context.Context, nn types.NamespacedName) (reconcile.Result, error)
 Watches() []Watch
}

// Watch is one watch of an item kind on a kind other than MediaFile: the
// watched object, the map from an event's object to the items it wakes, and
// the predicates that pass the event.
type Watch struct {
 Object     client.Object
 Map        handler.MapFunc
 Predicates []predicate.Predicate
}

// Self is the Map of an item's watch on its own kind: the object is the item.
func Self(_ context.Context, o client.Object) []reconcile.Request {
 return []reconcile.Request{{NamespacedName: client.ObjectKeyFromObject(o)}}
}
```

1b. `app/catalog/controller/rollup/downloadpredicate.go` (S9; the six packages' identical
    `downloadPredicate` moves here, gaining the `DownloadNonTerminal` arm):

```go
package rollup

import (
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/predicate"

 downloadv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/download/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// DownloadPredicate is S9 (loop spec §3.3, §3.12), the Download predicate
// the six item kinds share: generation, status.phase and deleting, as each
// package's downloadPredicate had them, plus a change of DownloadNonTerminal,
// which reads status.import too -- an import importarr holds for a person
// leaves the phase Completed, but the Download is no longer the item's
// active download, and the old predicate missed that edge.
func DownloadPredicate() predicate.Predicate {
 return k8s.Or(
  k8s.GenerationChanged(),
  k8s.StatusFieldChanged(func(o client.Object) downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPhase {
   dl, ok := o.(*downloadv1alpha1.Download)
   if !ok {
    return ""
   }
   return dl.Status.Phase
  }),
  k8s.StatusFieldChanged(k8s.IsDeleting),
  k8s.StatusFieldChanged(func(o client.Object) bool {
   dl, ok := o.(*downloadv1alpha1.Download)
   return ok && DownloadNonTerminal(dl)
  }),
 )
}
```

1. `app/catalog/controller/itemstatus/apply.go`:

```go
// Package itemstatus is the remediation loop's one item status write (loop
// spec §3.12, applyItemStatus): a Movie's, Episode's, Album's, Book's,
// Audiobook's or Issue's status under catalogarr, preconditioned on the
// object the reconcile planned from. It lives apart from rollup, which the
// catalog agent links, so a catalogarr write is reachable from the manager
// alone (split spec §5.15, TestEveryFieldManagerHasItsHome).
package itemstatus

import (
 "context"
 "time"

 apierrors "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/errors"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/reconcile"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// ConflictRequeue is how soon an item whose apply met a newer object is
// reconciled again (loop spec §3.12).
const ConflictRequeue = time.Second

// Apply applies ac -- the item's complete status, from its one renderer --
// under k8s.ManagerCatalogarr with item's resourceVersion as a precondition:
// k8s.PatchStatusCAS's single attempt over the planned view, without the
// read, since the view is item itself. conflicted reports that the
// apiserver holds a newer object (catalogarr-grab, catalogarr-metadata or
// catalogarr-series wrote since the cache read), so the caller requeues in
// ConflictRequeue and plans again from the newer cache instead of rolling
// that write back with an apply seeded from a stale read. An item apply is
// never skipped: the loop does not own the whole item status, and the cache
// strips managedFields.
func Apply[A k8s.CASApplyConfiguration[A]](ctx context.Context, c client.Client, item client.Object, ac A) (conflicted bool, err error) {
 if _, err := k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr, ac.WithResourceVersion(item.GetResourceVersion())); err != nil {
  if apierrors.IsConflict(err) {
   return true, nil
  }
  return false, err
 }
 return false, nil
}

// Requeue is what a reconcile returns after an Apply that did not fail:
// ConflictRequeue after a conflict, nothing otherwise.
func Requeue(conflicted bool) reconcile.Result {
 if conflicted {
  return reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: ConflictRequeue}
 }
 return reconcile.Result{}
}
```

1. `app/remediation/items.go`:

```go
package remediation

import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "maps"
 "slices"

 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/meta"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "k8s.io/client-go/util/workqueue"
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/builder"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/event"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/handler"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/reconcile"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/rollup"
)

// ItemReconciler is the loop's item path (loop spec §3.12): one rollup.Item
// per item kind, reconciled by its own ReconcileItem, woken by its own
// non-file watches adapted to Key and by the item arm of the MediaFile
// source (S1, S1'), which replaced every item kind's MediaFile watch.
type ItemReconciler struct {
 Items map[KeyKind]rollup.Item
}

// Reconcile runs k's item path. A timer the item asks for (an air date, an
// availability date, a conflict requeue) is a Due requeue, at PriorityTimed
// (§3.11).
func (ir *ItemReconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, k Key) (reconcile.Result, error) {
 it, ok := ir.Items[k.Kind]
 if !ok {
  return reconcile.Result{}, reconcile.TerminalError(fmt.Errorf("remediation: no item path for %s %s/%s", k.Kind, k.Namespace, k.Name))
 }
 res, err := it.ReconcileItem(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: k.Namespace, Name: k.Name})
 if res.RequeueAfter > 0 && res.Priority == nil {
  res.Priority = new(PriorityTimed)
 }
 return res, err
}

// Watch adds the item path's sources to b: the item arm of the MediaFile
// source, then each item kind's Watches, in kind order.
func (ir *ItemReconciler) Watch(b *builder.TypedBuilder[Key]) *builder.TypedBuilder[Key] {
 if len(ir.Items) == 0 {
  return b
 }
 b = b.Watches(&catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{}, ir.fileWakes())
 for _, kind := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(ir.Items)) {
  for _, w := range ir.Items[kind].Watches() {
   b = b.Watches(w.Object, itemHandler(kind, w.Map), builder.WithPredicates(w.Predicates...))
  }
 }
 return b
}

// itemHandler adapts an item package's map function to kind's keys.
func itemHandler(kind KeyKind, m handler.MapFunc) handler.TypedEventHandler[client.Object, Key] {
 return handler.TypedEnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(func(ctx context.Context, o client.Object) []Key {
  reqs := m(ctx, o)
  keys := make([]Key, 0, len(reqs))
  for _, r := range reqs {
   keys = append(keys, Key{Kind: kind, Namespace: r.Namespace, Name: r.Name})
  }
  return keys
 })
}

// fileWakes is the item arm of S1 and S1' (§3.3, §2.14): a file appearing or
// going, a spec change, or a FileSignature change enqueues the keys of every
// item the file covers that has a path here. It never enqueues the file key.
// TypedFuncs enqueues the initial list's creates at handler.LowPriority.
func (ir *ItemReconciler) fileWakes() handler.TypedEventHandler[client.Object, Key] {
 add := func(q workqueue.TypedRateLimitingInterface[Key], keys []Key) {
  for _, k := range keys {
   if _, ok := ir.Items[k.Kind]; ok {
    q.Add(k)
   }
  }
 }
 return handler.TypedFuncs[client.Object, Key]{
  CreateFunc: func(_ context.Context, e event.TypedCreateEvent[client.Object], q workqueue.TypedRateLimitingInterface[Key]) {
   add(q, ItemKeys(asMediaFile(e.Object)))
  },
  UpdateFunc: func(_ context.Context, e event.TypedUpdateEvent[client.Object], q workqueue.TypedRateLimitingInterface[Key]) {
   add(q, itemWakeKeys(asMediaFile(e.ObjectOld), asMediaFile(e.ObjectNew)))
  },
  DeleteFunc: func(_ context.Context, e event.TypedDeleteEvent[client.Object], q workqueue.TypedRateLimitingInterface[Key]) {
   add(q, ItemKeys(asMediaFile(e.Object)))
  },
 }
}

// itemWakeKeys is the item arm for an update: a spec change wakes the items
// of the old and the new object; a status-only change wakes the file's items
// only when an input to their rollups moved. Labels, annotations and every
// other status field wake no item.
func itemWakeKeys(old, cur *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) []Key {
 switch {
 case old == nil || cur == nil:
  return ItemKeys(cur)
 case old.Generation != cur.Generation:
  keys := ItemKeys(old)
  for _, k := range ItemKeys(cur) {
   if !slices.Contains(keys, k) {
    keys = append(keys, k)
   }
  }
  return keys
 case SignatureOf(old) != SignatureOf(cur):
  return ItemKeys(cur)
 default:
  return nil
 }
}

// FileSignature is what of a MediaFile's status the item rollups read
// (§3.3 S1'): the Transcoded verdict, the probed audio languages, whether it
// is probed at all, its Ready status, and the transcode and graft phases with
// the graft's tag. A status write that moves none of them wakes no item.
type FileSignature struct {
 Transcoded     bool
 AudioLanguages string
 Probed         bool
 Ready          metav1.ConditionStatus
 TranscodePhase catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase
 GraftPhase     catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase
 GraftTag       string
}

// SignatureOf is mf's FileSignature.
func SignatureOf(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) FileSignature {
 s := FileSignature{
  Transcoded:     rollup.Transcoded(mf),
  AudioLanguages: rollup.AudioLanguagesObject(mf),
  Probed:         mf.Status.ProbeHash != "",
 }
 if c := meta.FindStatusCondition(mf.Status.Conditions, catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionReady); c != nil {
  s.Ready = c.Status
 }
 if t := mf.Status.Transcode; t != nil {
  s.TranscodePhase = t.Phase
 }
 if g := mf.Status.Graft; g != nil {
  s.GraftPhase, s.GraftTag = g.Phase, g.Tag
 }
 return s
}

func asMediaFile(o client.Object) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 mf, _ := o.(*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile)
 return mf
}
```

```go
// Package itemtest runs the remediation loop's item path without its file
// planners, for the item packages' envtests (loop spec §3.12). It is test
// support: only _test.go files import it, so no binary links it.
package itemtest

import (
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/builder"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/controller"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/manager"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/rollup"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation"
)

// Start registers on mgr one controller, "itemtest", that runs items exactly
// as the loop runs them -- remediation.ItemReconciler's sources (each item's
// Watches and the item arm of the MediaFile source) and its dispatch -- and
// none of the loop's file planners, so a test may write a MediaFile's status
// itself and watch the item follow. The name check is skipped, so every
// test in a binary may start one. The caller registers the indexes the
// items read (mfindex.Register and the item packages' RegisterIndexes) and
// starts mgr.
func Start(mgr manager.Manager, items map[remediation.KeyKind]rollup.Item) error {
 ir := &remediation.ItemReconciler{Items: items}
 return ir.Watch(builder.TypedControllerManagedBy[remediation.Key](mgr).Named("itemtest")).
  WithOptions(controller.TypedOptions[remediation.Key]{SkipNameValidation: new(true), RecoverPanic: ptr.To(true)}).
  Complete(ir)
}
```

```go
// items is the loop's item path (loop spec §3.12): one reconciler per item
// kind, each recording Events under its kind's name as its controller did.
// recorder is mgr.GetEventRecorder.
func items(c client.Client, s *runtime.Scheme, recorder func(name string) k8sevents.EventRecorder, bus events.Bus) map[remediation.KeyKind]rollup.Item {
 return map[remediation.KeyKind]rollup.Item{
  remediation.KindMovie:   &movie.Reconciler{Client: c, Scheme: s, Recorder: recorder("movie"), Bus: bus},
  remediation.KindEpisode: &episode.Reconciler{Client: c, Scheme: s, Recorder: recorder("episode"), Bus: bus},
 }
}
```

```go
// itemReconciler adapts an item path's ReconcileItem (loop spec §3.12) to
// reconcile.Reconciler, so the table drives every kind the same way.
func itemReconciler(it interface {
 ReconcileItem(context.Context, types.NamespacedName) (reconcile.Result, error)
}) reconcile.Reconciler {
```

```go
package album_test

import (
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/album"
 pkgmetadata "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/metadata"
)

func cachedAlbum(uid types.UID, group string, refreshed time.Time) *catalogv1alpha1.Album {
 return &catalogv1alpha1.Album{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{UID: uid},
  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.AlbumSpec{ReleaseGroupID: group},
  Status:     catalogv1alpha1.AlbumStatus{Metadata: &catalogv1alpha1.AlbumMetadata{RefreshedAt: metav1.NewTime(refreshed)}},
 }
}

// The releases are fetched again only when the Album, its release group or
// its metadata changed (loop spec §3.12); a spec edit the selection reads
// (a pinned release) re-selects from the cached releases.
func TestReleaseCacheKeysOnTheAlbumItsGroupAndItsRefresh(t *testing.T) {
 at := time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 c := album.NewReleaseCache(album.DefaultReleaseCacheSize)
 alb := cachedAlbum("u1", "rg-1", at)
 _, ok := c.Get(alb)
 assert.False(t, ok)
 releases := []pkgmetadata.AlbumRelease{{Title: "OK Computer"}}
 c.Put(alb, releases)
 got, ok := c.Get(alb)
 require.True(t, ok)
 assert.Equal(t, releases, got)

 for name, miss := range map[string]*catalogv1alpha1.Album{
  "a metadata refresh":       cachedAlbum("u1", "rg-1", at.Add(time.Hour)),
  "another release group":    cachedAlbum("u1", "rg-2", at),
  "a recreated namesake":     cachedAlbum("u2", "rg-1", at),
  "no metadata at all":       {ObjectMeta: alb.ObjectMeta, Spec: alb.Spec},
 } {
  _, ok := c.Get(miss)
  assert.False(t, ok, name)
 }
 pinned := alb.DeepCopy()
 pinned.Spec.ReleaseID = new("official")
 _, ok = c.Get(pinned)
 assert.True(t, ok, "a pinned release re-selects from the cached releases")
}

func TestReleaseCacheIsBounded(t *testing.T) {
 assert.Equal(t, 4096, album.DefaultReleaseCacheSize)
 at := time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 c := album.NewReleaseCache(2)
 for _, uid := range []types.UID{"u1", "u2", "u3"} {
  c.Put(cachedAlbum(uid, "rg", at), nil)
 }
 assert.Equal(t, 2, c.Len())
 _, ok := c.Get(cachedAlbum("u1", "rg", at))
 assert.False(t, ok, "the least recently used entry goes first")
}
```

package's existing `newTestConfig`, `startCacheOnly`, `testNamespace`, `testRootFolder`,
`createSteadyArtist`, `combinedBus`, `fakePublisher` and `fakeAlbumLookupRPC`):

```go
package album_test

import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "sync/atomic"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 k8sevents "k8s.io/client-go/tools/events"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogac "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/applyconfiguration/catalog/catalog/v1alpha1"
 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/album"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
 pkgmetadata "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/metadata"
)

// countingLookup is fakeAlbumLookupRPC that counts its calls and records
// the budget each one was given.
type countingLookup struct {
 calls  atomic.Int32
 budget atomic.Int64 // nanoseconds left on the last call's deadline
 album  *pkgmetadata.Album
 err    error
}

func (c *countingLookup) Request(ctx context.Context, subject string, in, out any) error {
 c.calls.Add(1)
 if dl, ok := ctx.Deadline(); ok {
  c.budget.Store(int64(time.Until(dl)))
 }
 return fakeAlbumLookupRPC{album: c.album, err: c.err}.Request(ctx, subject, in, out)
}

// The track-listing RPC runs only when the Album's metadata changed (loop
// spec §3.12): a reconcile that changes nothing the release selection's
// input depends on makes no RPC, a miss gets 10 s, and a failure is not
// cached -- it keeps the tracks and requeues in 30 s.
func TestAnAlbumReconcileWithoutAMetadataChangeMakesNoRPC(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 defer cancel()
 cfg := newTestConfig(t)
 c := startCacheOnly(t, ctx, cfg)
 direct, err := client.New(cfg, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 const ns = "album-releasecache-ns"
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, testNamespace(ns)))
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, testRootFolder(ns, "music-root", "/data/media/music")))
 createSteadyArtist(t, ctx, c, ns, "radiohead", "a74b1b7f-71a5-4011-9441-d0b5e4122711", "music-root")
 alb := &catalogv1alpha1.Album{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "ok-computer", Namespace: ns},
  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.AlbumSpec{ArtistRef: "radiohead", ReleaseGroupID: "b1392450-e5a3-37d1-83d3-b8b08ca6c4d9"},
 }
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, alb))
 key := types.NamespacedName{Namespace: ns, Name: alb.Name}

 // gateway writes status.metadata as the metadata gateway does, refreshed at at.
 gateway := func(at time.Time) {
  t.Helper()
  _, err := k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMetadata, catalogac.Album(alb.Name, ns).WithStatus(
   catalogac.AlbumStatus().WithMetadata(catalogac.AlbumMetadata().WithTitle("OK Computer").WithRefreshedAt(metav1.NewTime(at)))))
  require.NoError(t, err)
 }
 // caughtUp waits for the cache to hold what the apiserver holds, so a
 // reconcile's apply never conflicts on a stale view.
 caughtUp := func() {
  t.Helper()
  require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
   var cached, live catalogv1alpha1.Album
   return c.Get(ctx, key, &cached) == nil && direct.Get(ctx, key, &live) == nil &&
    cached.ResourceVersion == live.ResourceVersion
  }, 5*time.Second, 10*time.Millisecond)
 }
 fetched := &pkgmetadata.Album{Releases: []pkgmetadata.AlbumRelease{{
  IDs: pkgmetadata.ExternalIDs{pkgmetadata.KeyMBRelease: "official"}, Status: "Official", TrackCount: 1,
  Media: []pkgmetadata.Medium{{Position: 1, Tracks: []pkgmetadata.Track{{
   IDs: pkgmetadata.ExternalIDs{pkgmetadata.KeyMBRecording: "rec-1"}, Title: "Airbag", Position: 1,
  }}}},
 }}}
 rpc := &countingLookup{album: fetched}
 r := &album.Reconciler{
  Client: c, Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme(), Recorder: k8sevents.NewFakeRecorder(10),
  Bus: combinedBus{Publisher: fakePublisher{}, requester: rpc},
 }
 reconcileOnce := func() (time.Duration, catalogv1alpha1.Album) {
  t.Helper()
  caughtUp()
  res, err := r.ReconcileItem(ctx, key)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  caughtUp()
  var got catalogv1alpha1.Album
  require.NoError(t, direct.Get(ctx, key, &got))
  return res.RequeueAfter, got
 }

 at := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
 gateway(at)
 _, got := reconcileOnce()
 require.EqualValues(t, 1, rpc.calls.Load())
 assert.LessOrEqual(t, time.Duration(rpc.budget.Load()), 10*time.Second, "a miss gets 10 s, not the 30 s requeue")
 assert.Greater(t, time.Duration(rpc.budget.Load()), 9*time.Second)
 require.Len(t, got.Status.Tracks, 1)

 _, _ = reconcileOnce()
 assert.EqualValues(t, 1, rpc.calls.Load(), "a reconcile without a metadata change made an RPC")

 gateway(at.Add(time.Minute))
 _, _ = reconcileOnce()
 assert.EqualValues(t, 2, rpc.calls.Load(), "a metadata refresh fetches the releases again")

 rpc.err = errors.New("nats: timeout")
 gateway(at.Add(2 * time.Minute))
 requeue, got := reconcileOnce()
 assert.EqualValues(t, 3, rpc.calls.Load())
 assert.Equal(t, 30*time.Second, requeue, "a failed fetch requeues in 30 s")
 assert.Len(t, got.Status.Tracks, 1, "a failed fetch keeps the tracks")
 cond := k8s.FindCondition(got.Status.Conditions, "TracksSynced")
 require.NotNil(t, cond)
 assert.Equal(t, "RPCError", cond.Reason)
 _, _ = reconcileOnce()
 assert.EqualValues(t, 4, rpc.calls.Load(), "a failure is not cached")
}
```

```go
package album

import (
 lru "github.com/hashicorp/golang-lru/v2"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 pkgmetadata "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/metadata"
)

// DefaultReleaseCacheSize bounds a ReleaseCache (loop spec §3.12).
const DefaultReleaseCacheSize = 4096

// ReleaseCache holds each Album's fetched releases, keyed by the Album's
// UID, spec.releaseGroupID and status.metadata.refreshedAt, so the
// track-listing RPC runs only when one of them changed: an Album reconcile
// no longer waits on the metadata gateway on the loop's shared queue (§3.12,
// §3.17). Everything else the selection reads -- a pinned release, the
// Artist's metadata profile, the files -- is applied to the cached releases
// on every reconcile. A failed fetch is never cached. The releases it hands
// back are shared: SelectRelease and BuildTracks only read them.
type ReleaseCache struct {
 lru *lru.Cache[releaseKey, []pkgmetadata.AlbumRelease]
}

type releaseKey struct {
 uid          types.UID
 releaseGroup string
 refreshedAt  int64 // status.metadata.refreshedAt in Unix nanoseconds; 0 without metadata
}

// NewReleaseCache is a ReleaseCache of at most size Albums, least recently
// used out first; a size below 1 is DefaultReleaseCacheSize.
func NewReleaseCache(size int) *ReleaseCache {
 if size < 1 {
  size = DefaultReleaseCacheSize
 }
 c, err := lru.New[releaseKey, []pkgmetadata.AlbumRelease](size)
 if err != nil { // lru.New fails only for a size below 1, ruled out above
  panic(err)
 }
 return &ReleaseCache{lru: c}
}

func keyOf(alb *catalogv1alpha1.Album) releaseKey {
 k := releaseKey{uid: alb.UID, releaseGroup: alb.Spec.ReleaseGroupID}
 if alb.Status.Metadata != nil {
  k.refreshedAt = alb.Status.Metadata.RefreshedAt.UnixNano()
 }
 return k
}

// Get is alb's cached releases.
func (c *ReleaseCache) Get(alb *catalogv1alpha1.Album) ([]pkgmetadata.AlbumRelease, bool) {
 return c.lru.Get(keyOf(alb))
}

// Put caches a successful fetch of alb's releases.
func (c *ReleaseCache) Put(alb *catalogv1alpha1.Album, releases []pkgmetadata.AlbumRelease) {
 c.lru.Add(keyOf(alb), releases)
}

// Len is how many Albums the cache holds.
func (c *ReleaseCache) Len() int { return c.lru.Len() }
```

1. **Album's RPC behind the cache** (`album/reconciler.go`):
   - `Reconciler` gains

```go

 // builds a private cache of DefaultReleaseCacheSize on first use.
 Releases     *ReleaseCache

```

     and

```go
func (r *Reconciler) releaseCache() *ReleaseCache {
 r.releasesOnce.Do(func() {
  if r.Releases == nil {
   r.Releases = NewReleaseCache(DefaultReleaseCacheSize)
  }
 })
 return r.Releases
}
```

- Beside `metadataSyncRPCBackoff` (30 s, still the requeue after a failure):

```go
// metadataSyncRPCTimeout bounds one track-listing RPC on a cache miss (loop
// spec §3.12): the loop's workers are shared by every file and item, so a
// slow gateway costs one worker 10 s, not 30.
const metadataSyncRPCTimeout = 10 * time.Second
```

- In `syncTracks`, the fetch becomes a cache lookup first; the code from `req := schema.MetadataRequest{`
     through the `json.Unmarshal` block is replaced by:

```go
 cache := r.releaseCache()
 releases, cached := cache.Get(alb)
 if !cached {
  req := schema.MetadataRequest{
   Kind: commonv1.MediaKindAlbum,
   IDs:  map[string]string{pkgmetadata.KeyMBReleaseGroup: alb.Spec.ReleaseGroupID},
  }
  rpcCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, metadataSyncRPCTimeout)
  defer cancel()
  var resp schema.MetadataResponse
  if rpcErr := r.Bus.Request(rpcCtx, events.RPCMetadataLookup, req, &resp); rpcErr != nil {
   return kept(rpcErr)
  }
  if resp.Error != "" {
   return kept(fmt.Errorf("metadata gateway: %s", resp.Error))
  }
  var fetched pkgmetadata.Album
  if len(resp.Result) > 0 {
   if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Result, &fetched); err != nil {
    return kept(fmt.Errorf("decode album: %w", err))
   }
  }
  releases = fetched.Releases
  cache.Put(alb, releases)
 }

 release, selection := SelectRelease(alb.Spec, profile, previous, releases, files)
```

     `syncTracks`' doc gains: "The RPC runs only on a ReleaseCache miss."

```go
// album/reconciler.go
// Watches is the Album's item path on the remediation loop (loop spec §3.12;
// S5, S9, S10): every watch that wakes an Album except its files'.
func (r *Reconciler) Watches() []rollup.Watch {
 return []rollup.Watch{
  {Object: &catalogv1alpha1.Album{}, Map: rollup.Self, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{albumPredicate()}},
  {Object: &downloadv1alpha1.Download{}, Map: r.mapDownload, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{rollup.DownloadPredicate()}},
  {Object: &catalogv1alpha1.QualityProfile{}, Map: r.mapQualityProfile, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{k8s.GenerationChanged()}},
  {Object: &catalogv1alpha1.Artist{}, Map: r.mapArtist, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{k8s.GenerationChanged()}},
 }
}

// book/reconciler.go
// Watches is the Book's item path on the remediation loop (loop spec §3.12;
// S6, S9, S10): every watch that wakes a Book except its files'.

 return []rollup.Watch{
  {Object: &catalogv1alpha1.Book{}, Map: rollup.Self, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{bookPredicate()}},
  {Object: &downloadv1alpha1.Download{}, Map: r.mapDownload, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{rollup.DownloadPredicate()}},
  {Object: &catalogv1alpha1.Author{}, Map: r.mapAuthor, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{authorPredicate()}},
  {Object: &catalogv1alpha1.QualityProfile{}, Map: r.mapQualityProfile, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{k8s.GenerationChanged()}},
 }
}

  {Object: &downloadv1alpha1.Download{}, Map: r.mapDownload, Predicates: []predicate.Predicate{rollup.DownloadPredicate()}},

 }
```

## How the old and the new subtitle paths coexist inside this wave

Nothing between W4.13 and F8.12 is deployed (loop spec §8.2 rule 3, D1), but every commit builds,
vets and passes the tests of the packages it touches.

- **F5.1** puts the subtitles planner into the loop. From then on the loop owns `status.subtitles`,
  `status.sidecars` and `status.handledNonces.subtitleSearch`, lists the media directory through its
  gates, writes requested records into `clustarr-subtitles` and publishes v2 FetchTasks. The
  SubtitleProfile and SubtitleRequest controllers keep running beside it on v1 tasks, renamed
  `schema.FetchTaskV1` (loop spec §8.2 rule 1: mechanical edits doomed code needs to keep compiling),
  and the v1 fetch worker keeps answering them.
- **F5.2** moves the fetch worker to v2 tasks and records. It acks every v1 task as stale, so the
  doomed SubtitleRequest controller's tasks are no longer worked; its envtests use a recording bus
  and never needed a worker.
- **F5.3** deletes the SubtitleRequest machinery and retires `captionarr-worker`.
- **F5.4** adds the forced-search nonce and makes the v1 dead-letter resolvers namespace-only.

## Deviations from loop spec §8.6, each with its reason

1. **The history resolvers move with the payload structs.** `schema.FetchTask` becomes v2 in F5.1
   and `schema.SubtitleEvent` v2 in F5.2. `app/catalog/history/target.go` decodes both, and
   `TestEveryPayloadHasAResolver` demands a resolver for each payload's current schema, so the v2
   resolvers land in F5.1 and F5.2 or those commits do not build. F5.4 keeps what §8.6 gives it that
   is not forced earlier: the v1 resolvers made namespace-only, and a test pinning the DLQ projector's
   `mediafiles` grant (§6.10; F3.5 adds the grant itself).
2. **`captionarr-worker` loses its home in F5.2.** F5.2 removes the fetch worker's last
   `PatchStatusCAS`, so W5.19's `TestEveryFieldManagerHasItsHome` would fail at F5.2 on
   `wantHomes[ManagerCaptionarrWorker] = {"caption"}`. F5.2 sets that row to `nil` and drops the
   `fetch.FieldManager` alias; F5.3 moves the name into `RetiredFieldManagers()` as §8.6 says, once
   `app/caption/status`'s tests, the last users of `PatchRequest(…, ManagerCaptionarrWorker, …)`, go.
3. **The two new MediaFile indexes are split.** `remediation.mediafile.subtitles` serves S14 and
   lands in F5.1; `remediation.mediafile.subtitleProfile` serves the slim reconciler and lands in
   F5.3. Each amends W5.7's `TestManagerFieldIndexes` (§8.3 names only F5.3).
4. **The listing gates gain a sixth.** §6.4.3's five gates never list a file whose last block was
   `Blocked` on `MediaDirUnreadable` or `MediaFileNotOnDisk`, so §6.4.1's 5-minute wake would replan
   without reading the directory and the block could never lift. F5.1 adds that gate.
5. **`Input` gains `Labels`, `ProbeCurrent`, `LastListed`, `PacerSlot` and `Queued`** beside §6.4's
   fields: `Labels` because §3.3 makes every profile selection read `View.Labels()`; `ProbeCurrent`
   because the hold row reads the draft (§3.5); `LastListed` because gates 3 and 4 need the path
   and probe hash this process last listed; `PacerSlot` because gate 1 checks the reservation before
   the listing (§4.7); `Queued` because §6.4.6's `Admin.Subjects` check is a read, which Gather does
   and Plan cannot.
6. **A withdrawal is skipped when a new dispatch of the same language follows in the same pass.**
   The record write and the withdrawal would both CAS at the revision Gather read, so the second
   would always miss; the new `requested` record supersedes the old task by its higher Seq instead
   (§4.8: the old task's worker finds `Seq > S` and acks).

```go
  LastListed:  &Listed{Path: videoPath, ProbeHash: "hash-1"},
  Records:     map[string]subtitlestore.Entry{},
  BacklogOpen: true,
  PacerSlot:   now,
  DataDir:     "/data",
  Now:         now,
 }
}

// issuer is View.Issue's rule: records.NextSeq over a floor each issue raises.
func issuer(floor int64) func(int64) int64 {
 return func(rec int64) int64 {
  floor = records.NextSeq(rec, floor, now)
  return floor
 }
}

// entry is German's record at revision rev, as the store reads it.
func entry(rev uint64, mutate func(*schema.SubtitleRecord)) subtitlestore.Entry {
 var r schema.SubtitleRecord
 r.Schema = schema.SubtitleRecordSchema
 r.MediaFile = schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "film", UID: "uid-film"}
 r.Sub = "de"
 r.RequestedAt = now.Add(-time.Minute)
 r.ProbeHash, r.ProfileGeneration = "hash-1", 4
 mutate(&r)
 return subtitlestore.Entry{Record: r, OK: true, Revision: rev}
}

// searching is German in flight at seq since at.
func searching(seq int64, at time.Time) catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus {
 t := metav1.NewTime(at)
 return catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus{
  LangKey: "de", State: catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateSearching,
  Attempts: commonv1.Attempts{Initial: &t, Latest: &t, Count: 1},
  Dispatch: &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: seq, DispatchedAt: t},
 }
}

func withBlock(in Input, b *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus) Input {
 in.File.Status.Subtitles = b
 return in
}

func TestANewProbeHashResetsAttemptsAndWithdraws(t *testing.T) {
 base := func() Input {
  in := fixture()
  in.File.Status.ProbeHash = "hash-2"
  in.File.Status.LastSeq = 500
  in = withBlock(in, &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{
   Phase: catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSearching, Profile: "default", ProbeHash: "hash-1",
   Wanted: []string{"de"}, Items: []catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus{searching(500, now.Add(-time.Hour))},
  })
  in.Records["de"] = entry(7, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) { r.Seq, r.State = 500, records.StateRequested })
  return in
 }

 t.Run("the gate is closed: the old request is withdrawn", func(t *testing.T) {
  in := base()
  in.BacklogOpen = false
  d := Plan(in, issuer(500))
  assert.Equal(t, []Withdraw{{LangKey: "de", Seq: 500}}, d.Withdraws)
  assert.Empty(t, d.Dispatches)
  it := d.Block.Items[0]
  assert.Equal(t, "hash-2", d.Block.ProbeHash)
  assert.Zero(t, it.Attempts.Count, "the old file's search history is gone")
  assert.Equal(t, int64(500), it.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
  assert.True(t, it.Dispatch.Withdrawn)
  assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending, it.State)
  assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted, d.Block.Phase)
 })
 t.Run("the gate is open: a new dispatch supersedes it", func(t *testing.T) {
  d := Plan(base(), issuer(500))
  assert.Empty(t, d.Withdraws, "a record write and a withdrawal at one revision cannot both land")
  require.Len(t, d.Dispatches, 1)
  x := d.Dispatches[0]
  assert.Greater(t, x.Seq, int64(500))
  assert.Equal(t, uint64(7), x.Revision)
  assert.Equal(t, int64(500), x.IncorporatedThrough)
  assert.Equal(t, "hash-2", x.Task.ProbeHash)
  assert.Equal(t, int32(1), d.Block.Items[0].Attempts.Count, "reset, then the new file's first search")
 })
}

func TestAnAnsweredRecordIsIncorporated(t *testing.T) {
 answeredAt := now.Add(-10 * time.Second)
 for _, tc := range []struct {
  name  string
  names []string // the directory after the worker's answer
  rec   func(*schema.SubtitleRecord)
  check func(t *testing.T, it catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, d Decision)
 }{
  {"downloaded", []string{videoName, deName}, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) {
   r.Verdict, r.Score, r.ScoreOutOf, r.Provider, r.SubtitleID, r.Name = schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, 150, 180, "os", "42", deName
  }, func(t *testing.T, it catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, d Decision) {
   assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateDownloaded, it.State)
   assert.Equal(t, deName, it.Name)
   assert.True(t, it.DownloadedAt.Time.Equal(answeredAt), "the record's time, never the loop's now")
   assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSatisfied, d.Block.Phase)
  }},
  {"unavailable", []string{videoName}, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) {
   r.Verdict, r.ScoreOutOf, r.LastError = schema.SubtitleVerdictUnavailable, 180, "no matching subtitle found"
  }, func(t *testing.T, it catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, d Decision) {
   assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateUnavailable, it.State)
   assert.Equal(t, "no matching subtitle found", it.LastError)
   assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted, d.Block.Phase)
  }},
  {"throttled", []string{videoName}, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) {
   until := now.Add(3 * time.Hour)
   r.Verdict, r.LastError, r.ThrottledUntil = schema.SubtitleVerdictThrottled, "every eligible provider is throttled", &until
  }, func(t *testing.T, it catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, d Decision) {
   assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending, it.State, "throttled is not Searching any more")
   assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted, d.Block.Phase)
  }},
  {"dropped", []string{videoName}, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) {
   r.Verdict, r.LastError = schema.SubtitleVerdictDropped, "file changed since planned"
  }, func(t *testing.T, it catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, d Decision) {
   assert.Equal(t, "fetch dropped: file changed since planned", it.LastError)
  }},
  {"another probe", []string{videoName}, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) {
   r.Verdict, r.Name, r.ProbeHash = schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, deName, "hash-0"
  }, func(t *testing.T, it catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, d Decision) {
   assert.Empty(t, it.Name, "an answer for other bytes is discarded")
   assert.Equal(t, int64(300), it.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
  }},
 } {
  t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   in := fixture()
   in = withBlock(in, &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{
    Phase: catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSearching, Profile: "default", ProbeHash: "hash-1",
    Wanted: []string{"de"}, Items: []catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus{searching(300, now.Add(-time.Minute))},
   })
   in.Listing = &Listing{Names: tc.names}
   in.Records["de"] = entry(9, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) {
    r.Seq, r.State, r.AnsweredAt = 300, records.StateAnswered, &answeredAt
    tc.rec(r)
   })
   d := Plan(in, issuer(300))
   it := d.Block.Items[0]
   assert.Equal(t, int64(300), it.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
   tc.check(t, it, d)
  })
 }
}

 }{

  {ReasonProfileInvalid, func(in *Input) {

  }, time.Time{}},
```

```go
  }, Need{Reserve: true}},
  {"gate 1: a slot in the future lists nothing", func(in *Input) {
   in.File.Status.Subtitles.Items[0].Name, in.File.Status.Subtitles.Items[0].DownloadedAt = "", nil
   in.File.Status.Sidecars = nil
   in.File.Status.Subtitles.Items[0].Attempts.Latest = &metav1.Time{Time: now.Add(-7 * time.Hour)}
   in.PacerSlot = now.Add(30 * time.Second)
  }, Need{}},
  {"gate 1: a due slot lists and reads the record", func(in *Input) {
   in.File.Status.Subtitles.Items[0].Name, in.File.Status.Subtitles.Items[0].DownloadedAt = "", nil
   in.File.Status.Sidecars = nil
   in.File.Status.Subtitles.Items[0].Attempts.Latest = &metav1.Time{Time: now.Add(-7 * time.Hour)}
   in.PacerSlot = now
  }, Need{List: true, Records: []string{"de"}}},
  {"in flight: the record is read", func(in *Input) {
   in.File.Status.Subtitles.Items[0] = searching(20, now.Add(-time.Minute))
   in.File.Status.Sidecars = nil
  }, Need{Records: []string{"de"}}},
 } {
  t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   in := steady()
   tc.mutate(&in)
   assert.Equal(t, tc.want, Needs(in))
  })
 }

 t.Run("gate 2: an answered record is incorporated", func(t *testing.T) {
  in := steady()
  in.File.Status.Subtitles.Items[0] = searching(20, now.Add(-time.Minute))
  in.File.Status.Sidecars = nil
  in.Records = map[string]subtitlestore.Entry{"de": entry(4, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) {
   r.Seq, r.State, r.Verdict, r.Name = 20, records.StateAnswered, schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, deName
  })}
  assert.Equal(t, Need{List: true, Records: []string{"de"}}, Needs(in))
 })
}
```

`app/caption/subtitleplan/imports_test.go`:

```go
package subtitleplan

// TestThePlannerImportsNoIO holds loop spec §6.4's purity rule: the adapter's
// Gather does the I/O; Plan and Needs read only their Input.
func TestThePlannerImportsNoIO(t *testing.T) {
 banned := map[string]string{
  "os": "Gather reads /data", "net": "no network", "net/http": "no network",
  "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client":         "Gather reads the cache",
  "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events":           "the bus is the adapter's",
  "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/natsbus":   "the bus is the adapter's",
  "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/membus":    "the bus is the adapter's",
  "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation":      "the loop calls the planner, never the reverse",
 }
 entries, err := os.ReadDir(".")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 fset := token.NewFileSet()
 files := 0
 for _, e := range entries {
  if !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".go") || strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), "_test.go") {
   continue
  }
  f, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, e.Name(), nil, parser.ImportsOnly)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  files++
  for _, imp := range f.Imports {
   p := strings.Trim(imp.Path.Value, `"`)
   if why, ok := banned[p]; ok {
    t.Errorf("%s imports %s: %s (loop spec §6.4)", e.Name(), p, why)
   }
  }
 }
 require.GreaterOrEqual(t, files, 9, "the guard reads the wrong directory")
}
```

`pkg/subtitlestore/store_test.go` (package `subtitlestore_test`), with `buses(t)` returning a
membus and an embedded nats-server bus, each `Ensure`d with `events.Default().ForSingleNode()` (the
embedded server is started as `app/caption/worker/fetch/helpers_envtest_test.go`'s `natsBus` starts it):

```go
const uid = "uid-film"

func task(seq int64) schema.FetchTask {
 return schema.FetchTask{
  MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "film", UID: uid},
  LangKey: "de", Seq: seq, ProbeHash: "hash-1", ProfileGeneration: 4, Profile: "default",
 }
}

func TestAnswerRefusesASupersededSeq(t *testing.T) {
 for name, bus := range buses(t) {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   ctx := t.Context()
   loop, worker := subtitlestore.New(bus, ""), subtitlestore.New(bus, "fetch-0")
   require.NoError(t, loop.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(task(5), now), 0, 0))
   e, err := loop.Get(ctx, uid, "de")
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.NoError(t, loop.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(task(6), now), e.Revision, 0))

   sup, err := worker.Superseded(ctx, task(5))
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.True(t, sup)
   landed, err := worker.Answer(ctx, task(5), schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictUnavailable})
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.False(t, landed)

   e, err = loop.Get(ctx, uid, "de")
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.Equal(t, records.StateRequested, e.Record.State)
   assert.Equal(t, int64(6), e.Record.Seq)
  })
 }
}

func TestWithdrawBeatsALateAnswer(t *testing.T) {
 for name, bus := range buses(t) {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   ctx := t.Context()
   loop, worker := subtitlestore.New(bus, ""), subtitlestore.New(bus, "fetch-0")
   require.NoError(t, loop.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(task(5), now), 0, 0))
   e, err := loop.Get(ctx, uid, "de")
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.NoError(t, loop.Withdraw(ctx, uid, "de", 5, e.Revision, 0))

   sup, err := worker.Superseded(ctx, task(5))
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.True(t, sup, "a worker that has not started never starts")
   landed, err := worker.Answer(ctx, task(5), schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictUnavailable})
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.False(t, landed, "a late non-download answer is dropped")
   e, err = loop.Get(ctx, uid, "de")
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.Equal(t, records.StateWithdrawn, e.Record.State)

   landed, err = worker.Answer(ctx, task(5), schema.SubtitleRecord{
    Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, Score: 150, ScoreOutOf: 180, Name: "Film (2010).de.srt",
   })
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.True(t, landed, "a written sidecar is a fact: recorded over the withdrawal (§4.8)")
  })
 }
}

func TestRequestNeverOverwritesAnUnincorporatedDownload(t *testing.T) {
 for name, bus := range buses(t) {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   ctx := t.Context()
   loop, worker := subtitlestore.New(bus, ""), subtitlestore.New(bus, "fetch-0")
   require.NoError(t, loop.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(task(5), now), 0, 0))
   landed, err := worker.Answer(ctx, task(5), schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, Name: "x.srt"})
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.True(t, landed)
   e, err := loop.Get(ctx, uid, "de")
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.ErrorIs(t, loop.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(task(6), now), e.Revision, 4), records.ErrUnincorporatedFact)
   require.NoError(t, loop.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(task(6), now), e.Revision, 5))
  })
 }
}

func TestEachLanguageHasItsOwnKey(t *testing.T) {
 for name, bus := range buses(t) {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   ctx := t.Context()
   s := subtitlestore.New(bus, "")
   forced := task(7)
   forced.LangKey = "en:forced"
   require.NoError(t, s.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(task(7), now), 0, 0))
   require.NoError(t, s.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(forced, now), 0, 0), "no contention between languages")
   assert.Equal(t, events.RecordSubKey(uid, "en:forced"), subtitlestore.Key(uid, "en:forced"))
   e, err := s.Get(ctx, uid, "en:forced")
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.Equal(t, "en:forced", e.Record.Sub)
  })
 }
}

func TestAForeignOrUndecodableRecordReadsAbsent(t *testing.T) {
 for name, bus := range buses(t) {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   ctx := t.Context()
   kv := bus.KV(events.BucketSubtitles)
   _, err := kv.Put(ctx, subtitlestore.Key(uid, "de"), []byte("{not json"))
   require.NoError(t, err)
   e, err := subtitlestore.New(bus, "").Get(ctx, uid, "de")
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.False(t, e.OK)
   assert.NotZero(t, e.Revision, "a write replaces it at that revision")

   other := subtitlestore.Requested(task(1), now)
   other.MediaFile.UID = "uid-other"
   b, err := json.Marshal(other)
   require.NoError(t, err)
   _, err = kv.Put(ctx, subtitlestore.Key(uid, "en"), b)
   require.NoError(t, err)
   e, err = subtitlestore.New(bus, "").Get(ctx, uid, "en")
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.False(t, e.OK, "a record naming another file is not this file's")
  })
 }
}
```

`app/remediation/backlog_test.go` (package `remediation`):

```go
type fakeAdmin struct {
 events.StreamAdmin
 state events.ConsumerState
 err   error
}

func (a *fakeAdmin) ConsumerState(_ context.Context, stream, durable string) (events.ConsumerState, error) {
 if stream != events.StreamWorkCaptionarr || durable != events.ConsumerCaptionFetchNormal {
  return events.ConsumerState{}, fmt.Errorf("read %s/%s", stream, durable)
 }
 return a.state, a.err
}

func TestTheCaptionBacklogGate(t *testing.T) {
 at := time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 clock := at
 admin := &fakeAdmin{state: events.ConsumerState{Pending: 300, AckPending: 199}}
 b := NewCaptionBacklog(admin, func() time.Time { return clock })
 assert.True(t, b.NeedLeaderElection())
 assert.False(t, b.Open(at), "no reading yet")

 b.read(t.Context())
 assert.True(t, b.Open(at), "499 is under the ceiling")
 admin.state.AckPending = 200
 b.read(t.Context())
 assert.False(t, b.Open(at), "500 is the ceiling (§6.4.6)")

 admin.state.AckPending = 0
 b.read(t.Context())
 assert.True(t, b.Open(at.Add(119*time.Second)))
 assert.False(t, b.Open(at.Add(2*time.Minute)), "a reading two minutes old closes the gate")

 clock = at.Add(time.Minute)
 admin.err = errors.New("nats: timeout")
 b.read(t.Context())
 assert.True(t, b.Open(at.Add(time.Minute)), "a failed read keeps the last good reading until it is stale")
}
```

```go
// TestCopyTakesOnlyTheSubtitlesFields: subtitles, sidecars and the
// subtitleSearch nonce, and nothing of the transcode nonces beside it.
func TestCopyTakesOnlyTheSubtitlesFields(t *testing.T) {
 from := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{
  Subtitles:     &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted},
  Sidecars:      []catalogv1alpha1.Sidecar{{Path: "/data/a/b.de.srt", Name: "b.de.srt"}},
  HandledNonces: &catalogv1alpha1.HandledNonces{SubtitleSearch: "1759752000", TranscodeRetry: "r"},
  ProbeHash:     "p",
 }
 into := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{HandledNonces: &catalogv1alpha1.HandledNonces{TranscodeCancel: "c"}}
 New(Options{}).Copy(from, into)
 assert.Equal(t, from.Subtitles, into.Subtitles)
 assert.Equal(t, from.Sidecars, into.Sidecars)
 assert.Equal(t, &catalogv1alpha1.HandledNonces{SubtitleSearch: "1759752000", TranscodeCancel: "c"}, into.HandledNonces)

 New(Options{}).Copy(&catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{}, into)

}
```

`app/remediation/subtitles/loop_envtest_test.go` (package `subtitles_test`), the loop under the
manager's remediation registration alone, over an in-memory bus and a temporary `/data`:

```go
var testCfg *rest.Config

func TestMain(m *testing.M) { os.Exit(starttest.Main(m, &testCfg)) }

var nsSeq atomic.Int32

type loop struct {
 c       client.Client
 bus     events.Bus
 dataDir string
 ns      string
}

func startLoop(t *testing.T) *loop {
 t.Helper()
 cfg := starttest.RequireEnvtest(t, testCfg)
 mgr := starttest.NewManager(t, cfg)
 l := &loop{c: starttest.Client(t, cfg), bus: starttest.MemBus(t), dataDir: t.TempDir(),
  ns: "subs-" + strconv.Itoa(int(nsSeq.Add(1)))}
 require.NoError(t, l.c.Create(t.Context(), &corev1.Namespace{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: l.ns}}))
 require.NoError(t, remediationmanager.Register(mgr, l.bus, remediationmanager.Options{
  Options: k8s.Options{Namespace: l.ns}, DataDir: l.dataDir,
 }))
 starttest.Start(t, mgr)
 return l
}

// profile is a selector profile wanting langs for files labelled with this
// test's namespace. No test uses spec.default: SubtitleProfile is
// cluster-scoped, and a second default is Invalid.
func (l *loop) profile(t *testing.T, langs ...string) *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile {
 t.Helper()
 p := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: l.ns}, Spec: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfileSpec{
  Selector: &metav1.LabelSelector{MatchLabels: map[string]string{"subs-test": l.ns}},
 }}
 for _, lang := range langs {
  p.Spec.Languages = append(p.Spec.Languages, subtitlev1alpha1.LanguageItem{Key: lang, Language: lang})
 }
 require.NoError(t, l.c.Create(t.Context(), p))
 t.Cleanup(func() { _ = l.c.Delete(context.Background(), p) })
 return p
}

// film plants the video under /data at a whole-second mtime (spec.modTime
// round-trips at second precision), its Movie and its MediaFile, and seeds
// the probe as an importer would (probestore.Seed): the loop's probe planner
// incorporates it and the subtitles planner plans in the same pass.
func (l *loop) film(t *testing.T) (*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, string) {
 t.Helper()
 ctx := t.Context()
 logical := "/data/movies/" + l.ns + "/Film (2010)/Film (2010).mkv"
 local := filepath.Join(l.dataDir, strings.TrimPrefix(logical, "/data"))
 require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(local), 0o755))
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(local, []byte("not really a video"), 0o644))
 mtime := time.Now().Truncate(time.Second)
 require.NoError(t, os.Chtimes(local, mtime, mtime))
 require.NoError(t, l.c.Create(ctx, &catalogv1alpha1.Movie{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "film", Namespace: l.ns},
  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.MovieSpec{TmdbID: 603, QualityProfileRef: "hd", RootFolderRef: "movies"},
 }))
 mf := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "film", Namespace: l.ns, Labels: map[string]string{"subs-test": l.ns}},
  Spec: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{
   MediaRef: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "film"},
   Path:     logical, SizeBytes: int64(len("not really a video")), ModTime: metav1.NewTime(mtime),
  },
 }
 require.NoError(t, l.c.Create(ctx, mf))
 require.NoError(t, probestore.New(l.bus).Seed(ctx, probestore.Seed{
  MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: l.ns, Name: "film", UID: string(mf.UID)}, Path: logical,
  ProbeHash: mediainfo.ProbeHash(logical, mf.Spec.SizeBytes, mtime), ProbeVersion: mediainfo.ProbeVersion,
  MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{Container: "matroska", Audio: []commonv1.AudioStream{{Index: 1, Codec: "aac", Language: "eng"}}},
  Prober:    "test",
 }))
 return mf, filepath.Dir(local)
}

func (l *loop) waitFor(t *testing.T, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, what string, ok func(*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 t.Helper()
 var got catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 starttest.WaitFor(t, what, func() bool {
  return l.c.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &got) == nil && got.Status.Subtitles != nil && ok(&got)
 })
 return &got
}

func searchingGerman(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
 s := m.Status.Subtitles
 return s.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSearching && len(s.Items) == 1 && s.Items[0].Dispatch != nil
}

// TestTheLoopIncorporatesAnAnsweredRecord: a real second writer, the worker's
// Answer, lands after the loop's request; the loop incorporates it, lists the
// directory, and is still the only status writer.
func TestTheLoopIncorporatesAnAnsweredRecord(t *testing.T) {
 l := startLoop(t)
 p := l.profile(t, "de")
 mf, dir := l.film(t)
 mf = l.waitFor(t, mf, "the loop to dispatch German", searchingGerman)
 seq := mf.Status.Subtitles.Items[0].Dispatch.Seq

 store := subtitlestore.New(l.bus, "")
 e, err := store.Get(t.Context(), string(mf.UID), "de")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.True(t, e.OK)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateRequested, e.Record.State)
 assert.Equal(t, seq, e.Record.Seq, "status first, then the record (§3.8)")

 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "Film (2010).de.srt"), []byte("1\n00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:02,000\nHallo.\n"), 0o644))
 landed, err := subtitlestore.New(l.bus, "fetch-0").Answer(t.Context(), schema.FetchTask{
  MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: l.ns, Name: "film", UID: string(mf.UID)}, LangKey: "de", Seq: seq,
  ProbeHash: mf.Status.ProbeHash, ProfileGeneration: p.Generation, Profile: p.Name,
 }, schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, Score: 150, ScoreOutOf: 180,
  Provider: "os", SubtitleID: "42", Name: "Film (2010).de.srt"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.True(t, landed)

 mf = l.waitFor(t, mf, "the answer to be incorporated", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Subtitles.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSatisfied
 })
 it := mf.Status.Subtitles.Items[0]
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateDownloaded, it.State)
 assert.Equal(t, int32(150), it.Score)
 assert.Equal(t, "Film (2010).de.srt", it.Name)
 assert.Equal(t, seq, it.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
 require.Len(t, mf.Status.Sidecars, 1, "the answer opened the listing gate")
 assert.Equal(t, "Film (2010).de.srt", mf.Status.Sidecars[0].Name)
 assert.Equal(t, filepath.Dir(mf.Spec.Path)+"/Film (2010).de.srt", mf.Status.Sidecars[0].Path)
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]bool{string(k8s.ManagerCatalogarr): true}, starttest.StatusManagers(mf.ManagedFields))
}

// TestSubtitlesSurviveABlockedPass: a file in its steady state whose
// directory disappears is Blocked with its items intact.
func TestSubtitlesSurviveABlockedPass(t *testing.T) {
 l := startLoop(t)
 p := l.profile(t, "de")
 mf, dir := l.film(t)
 mf = l.waitFor(t, mf, "the loop to dispatch German", searchingGerman)
 steady := mf.Status.Subtitles.Items

 require.NoError(t, os.Rename(dir, dir+".moved"))
 // The worker's answer opens gate 2, so the next pass lists the directory.
 _, err := subtitlestore.New(l.bus, "fetch-0").Answer(t.Context(), schema.FetchTask{
  MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: l.ns, Name: "film", UID: string(mf.UID)}, LangKey: "de",
  Seq: steady[0].Dispatch.Seq, ProbeHash: mf.Status.ProbeHash, ProfileGeneration: p.Generation, Profile: p.Name,
 }, schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictUnavailable, ScoreOutOf: 180})
 require.NoError(t, err)

 mf = l.waitFor(t, mf, "the block to read Blocked", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Subtitles.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseBlocked
 })
 assert.Equal(t, subtitleplan.ReasonMediaDirUnreadable, mf.Status.Subtitles.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, steady, mf.Status.Subtitles.Items, "items, attempts and the dispatch are kept verbatim")
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]bool{string(k8s.ManagerCatalogarr): true}, starttest.StatusManagers(mf.ManagedFields))
}

// TestAProfileEditThatWantsNothingNewWritesNoMediaFile: S13 re-plans every
// file and writes none whose block does not change (§6.4.7).
func TestAProfileEditThatWantsNothingNewWritesNoMediaFile(t *testing.T) {
 l := startLoop(t)
 p := l.profile(t, "de")
 mf, _ := l.film(t)
 mf = l.waitFor(t, mf, "the loop to dispatch German", searchingGerman)
 rv := mf.ResourceVersion

 unchanged := metrics.RemediationPassesTotal.WithLabelValues(string(remediation.KindMediaFile), "unchanged")
 before := testutil.ToFloat64(unchanged)
 require.NoError(t, l.c.Patch(t.Context(), p, client.RawPatch(types.MergePatchType,
  fmt.Appendf(nil, `{"spec":{"mods":[%q]}}`, subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleModRemoveHI))))
 starttest.WaitFor(t, "the fan-out pass", func() bool { return testutil.ToFloat64(unchanged) > before })

 var got catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
```

1. **`pkg/events`.** In `subjects.go`, beside `WorkFetchSubject` (whose parameter becomes `fileUID`
   and whose doc reads "clustarr.work.captionarr.fetch.<priority>.<mediafile-uid>.<langKey>"):

   ```go
   // WorkFetchSubjectAnyPriority is fileUID's langKey fetch subject with a
   // wildcard for the lane, for PurgeSubject when the loop withdraws a request
   // (loop spec §3.8): a forced search and a scheduled one go to different lanes.
   func WorkFetchSubjectAnyPriority(fileUID, langKey string) string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("clustarr.work.captionarr.fetch.*.%s.%s", tok(fileUID), tok(langKey))
   }

   // MsgIDForSubtitleFetch is a subtitle fetch task's deduplication ID,
   // "subtitle/<fileUID>/<langKey>/<seq>" (loop spec §6.5): every dispatch
   // carries the sequence the loop issued, so it is unique for the life of the
   // file and the one-hour window absorbs only a republish of that dispatch.
   func MsgIDForSubtitleFetch(fileUID, langKey string, seq int64) string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("subtitle/%s/%s/%d", fileUID, langKey, seq)
   }
   ```

   `MsgIDForSubtitle` and `MsgIDForForcedSubtitle` stay until F5.3 deletes their last caller.

2. **`pkg/events/schema/subtitle.go`.** `FetchTask` is replaced by loop spec §6.7.1's struct
   verbatim (`MediaFile`, `Path`, `ProbeHash`, `LangKey`, `Seq`, `Profile`, `ProfileGeneration`,
   `MinScore`, `UpgradeMarginPoints`, `Upgrade`, `Forced`, `OnDisk *OnDiskSubtitle`, `SidecarMode
   uint32`, `Query SubtitleQuery`, `Extract []commonv1.SubtitleStream`), with
   `func (FetchTask) Schema() string { return "subtitle.FetchTask.v2" }`; `SubtitleQuery` and
   `OnDiskSubtitle{Name string json:"name"; Score int32 json:"score"}` as §6.7.1 has them. Add:

   ```go
   // FetchTaskType is the Clustarr-Type header of every fetch task.
   const FetchTaskType = "subtitle.FetchTask"

   // FetchTaskV1Schema names the SubtitleRequest-keyed task release N retires;
   // the fetch worker acks one as stale (loop spec §6.7.2).
   const FetchTaskV1Schema = "subtitle.FetchTask.v1"

   // FetchTaskV1 is the v1 payload, kept only while the SubtitleRequest
   // controller still publishes it; F5.3 deletes it with that controller.
   type FetchTaskV1 struct {
    RequestRef Ref    `json:"requestRef"`
    LangKey    string `json:"langKey"`
    MinScore   int32  `json:"minScore,omitempty"`
    Upgrade    bool   `json:"upgrade,omitempty"`
    ProbeHash  string `json:"probeHash,omitempty"`
   }

   func (FetchTaskV1) Schema() string { return FetchTaskV1Schema }

   // SubtitleVerdict is what a fetch found (loop spec §6.6).
   type SubtitleVerdict string

   const (
    SubtitleVerdictDownloaded  SubtitleVerdict = "downloaded"
    SubtitleVerdictKept        SubtitleVerdict = "kept"
    SubtitleVerdictUnavailable SubtitleVerdict = "unavailable"
    SubtitleVerdictFailed      SubtitleVerdict = "failed"
    SubtitleVerdictThrottled   SubtitleVerdict = "throttled"
    SubtitleVerdictDropped     SubtitleVerdict = "dropped"
   )

   // SubtitleRecordSchema is RecordHeader.Schema on every subtitle record:
   // "records.<remediation>.v1" (loop spec §4.5).
   const SubtitleRecordSchema = "records.subtitle.v1"

   // MaxSubtitleLastError is SubtitleItemStatus.lastError's MaxLength.
   const MaxSubtitleLastError = 512

   // SubtitleRecord is one language's record in clustarr-subtitles, key
   // events.RecordSubKey(fileUID, langKey) (loop spec §6.6). The loop writes
   // requested and withdrawn; the caption domain writes answered and failed.
   type SubtitleRecord struct {
    RecordHeader
    ProbeHash         string          `json:"probeHash"`
    ProfileGeneration int64           `json:"profileGeneration"`
    Verdict           SubtitleVerdict `json:"verdict,omitempty"`
    Score             int32           `json:"score,omitempty"`
    ScoreOutOf        int32           `json:"scoreOutOf,omitempty"`
    Provider          string          `json:"provider,omitempty"`     // at most 253 bytes
    SubtitleID        string          `json:"subtitleID,omitempty"`   // at most 256 bytes
    Name              string          `json:"name,omitempty"`         // a base name, at most 255 bytes
    ReplacedName      string          `json:"replacedName,omitempty"` // the sidecar an upgrade removed
    LastError         string          `json:"lastError,omitempty"`    // at most MaxSubtitleLastError
    ThrottledUntil    *time.Time      `json:"throttledUntil,omitempty"`
   }
   ```

   `schematest.Payloads()` gains `schema.FetchTaskV1{}` (F5.3 removes it); `schema.FetchTask{}`
   is now v2 there. A record is a KV value, not a bus payload: it is not listed.

3. **Doomed v1 callers (mechanical).** In `app/caption/controller/subtitlerequest/reconciler.go`'s
   `publish`, `schema.Encode(schema.FetchTask{…})` becomes `schema.Encode(schema.FetchTaskV1{…})`,
   and `FetchTaskType` becomes an alias of `schema.FetchTaskType`; in `fixture_envtest_test.go`
   (`task schema.FetchTask`, `var ft schema.FetchTask`) and in
   `app/caption/worker/fetch/{worker.go,helpers_envtest_test.go}` (`task`'s embedded
   `schema.FetchTask`, `decodeTask`, `fixture.message`) the type becomes `schema.FetchTaskV1`.
   Nothing else in those packages changes.

4. **`app/catalog/history/target.go`.** `resolveFetchTask` decodes v2 and returns
   `mediaFileTarget(p.MediaFile.Namespace, p.MediaFile.Name)` (namespace from the key when the
   ref has none). A new resolver keeps today's behaviour for v1 dead letters until F5.4, without
   naming the schema package's transitional struct:

   ```go
   // fetchTaskV1Ref is the one field of a v1 FetchTask a dead letter needs.
   type fetchTaskV1Ref struct {
    RequestRef schema.Ref `json:"requestRef"`
   }

   func (fetchTaskV1Ref) Schema() string { return schema.FetchTaskV1Schema }

   func resolveFetchTaskV1(key string, data []byte) Target {
    var p fetchTaskV1Ref
    if err := schema.Decode(p.Schema(), data, &p); err != nil || p.RequestRef.Name == "" {
     return Target{Namespace: namespaceOf(key)}
    }
    return refTarget(p.RequestRef, subtitlev1alpha1.GroupVersion.String(), "SubtitleRequest")
   }
   ```

   and `resolvers[schema.FetchTaskV1Schema] = resolveFetchTaskV1`.

5. **`pkg/subtitlestore`** (`doc.go`: "Package subtitlestore is the clustarr-subtitles instantiation
   of pkg/records (loop spec §6.6): the loop requests and withdraws through it, the caption domain
   answers through it, and nothing else opens the bucket."):

   ```go
   package subtitlestore

   const (
    Remediation = "subtitle"
    MaxValue    = 8 << 10
   )

   // Bus is what the store needs of the bus.
   type Bus interface{ KV(bucket string) events.KV }

   // Entry is one read of a language's record. Revision is the key's
   // revision, 0 when absent and non-zero with OK false for an undecodable or
   // foreign value, which a write replaces at that revision.
   type Entry struct {
    Record   schema.SubtitleRecord
    OK       bool
    Revision uint64
   }

   var spec = records.Spec[schema.SubtitleRecord]{
    Remediation: Remediation, Bucket: events.BucketSubtitles, MaxValue: MaxValue,
    Answered: func(state string) bool { return state == records.StateAnswered || state == records.StateFailed },
    // Only a download changed the disk; it is the one answer a withdrawal
    // must not swallow and a new request must not overwrite (§4.7, §4.8).
    Fact: func(r schema.SubtitleRecord) bool { return r.Verdict == schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded },
   }

   type Store struct {
    req *records.Requester[schema.SubtitleRecord]
    ans *records.Answerer[schema.SubtitleRecord]
    Now func() time.Time
   }

   // New is the store over bus's clustarr-subtitles bucket; writer names the
   // answering pod in the records it writes ("" for the loop, which answers nothing).
   func New(bus Bus, writer string) *Store {
    kv := bus.KV(events.BucketSubtitles)
    return &Store{req: records.NewRequester(kv, spec), ans: records.NewAnswerer(kv, spec, writer, version.String())}
   }

   func Key(fileUID, langKey string) string { return events.RecordSubKey(fileUID, langKey) }

   // Requested is the record the loop writes for t: its inputs, so an answer
   // is matched by them as well as by Seq.
   func Requested(t schema.FetchTask, at time.Time) schema.SubtitleRecord {
    var r schema.SubtitleRecord
    r.Schema, r.MediaFile, r.Sub, r.Seq = schema.SubtitleRecordSchema, t.MediaFile, t.LangKey, t.Seq
    r.State, r.RequestedAt = records.StateRequested, at.UTC()
    r.ProbeHash, r.ProfileGeneration = t.ProbeHash, t.ProfileGeneration
    return r
   }

   func (s *Store) Get(ctx context.Context, fileUID, langKey string) (Entry, error) {
    rec, rev, ok, err := s.req.Get(ctx, Key(fileUID, langKey))
    if err != nil {
     return Entry{}, fmt.Errorf("subtitlestore: get %s %s: %w", fileUID, langKey, err)
    }
    return Entry{Record: rec, OK: ok, Revision: rev}, nil
   }

   // Request writes rec at rev (0 creates), refusing to overwrite an answer above
   // incorporatedThrough (records.ErrUnincorporatedFact); a CAS miss is records.ErrRaced.
   func (s *Store) Request(ctx context.Context, rec schema.SubtitleRecord, rev uint64, incorporatedThrough int64) error {
    _, err := s.req.Request(ctx, Key(rec.MediaFile.UID, rec.Sub), rev, rec, records.IncorporatedThrough(incorporatedThrough))
    return err
   }

   // Withdraw is records.Withdraw (§4.7's table) on one language.
   func (s *Store) Withdraw(ctx context.Context, fileUID, langKey string, seq int64, rev uint64, incorporatedThrough int64) error {
    _, err := s.req.Withdraw(ctx, Key(fileUID, langKey), rev, seq, records.IncorporatedThrough(incorporatedThrough))
    return err
   }

   // Superseded is checked before any provider request (§6.6).
   func (s *Store) Superseded(ctx context.Context, t schema.FetchTask) (bool, error) {
    return s.ans.Superseded(ctx, Key(t.MediaFile.UID, t.LangKey), t.Seq)
   }

   // Answer records ans for t, re-reading immediately before its CAS; it
   // reports false when §4.8's rules dropped it.
   func (s *Store) Answer(ctx context.Context, t schema.FetchTask, ans schema.SubtitleRecord) (bool, error) {
    ans.Schema, ans.MediaFile, ans.Sub, ans.Seq = schema.SubtitleRecordSchema, t.MediaFile, t.LangKey, t.Seq
    if ans.State == "" {
     ans.State = records.StateAnswered
    }
    ans.ProbeHash, ans.ProfileGeneration = t.ProbeHash, t.ProfileGeneration
    at := s.now()
    ans.AnsweredAt = &at
    ans.LastError = clip(ans.LastError, schema.MaxSubtitleLastError)
    switch err := s.ans.Answer(ctx, Key(t.MediaFile.UID, t.LangKey), ans); {
    case errors.Is(err, records.ErrDropped):
     return false, nil
    case err != nil:
     return false, fmt.Errorf("subtitlestore: answer %s %s: %w", t.MediaFile.UID, t.LangKey, err)
    }
    return true, nil
   }
   ```

   `clip` cuts on a rune boundary (as `pkg/download.clampMessage` does); `now` is `Now` or
   `time.Now`, in UTC.

6. **`app/caption/subtitleplan`.** `doc.go`: "Package subtitleplan is the subtitles remediation's
   pure planner (loop spec §6.4). The loop's `subtitles` adapter gathers its Input and turns its
   Decision into effects; nothing here does I/O." Then:

   - `input.go`: the types of the Interfaces list above, with `Input` as loop spec §6.4 plus
     `Labels map[string]string` (`View.Labels()`), `ProbeCurrent bool` (`View.ProbeCurrent()`),
     `LastListed *Listed` (this process's last listing of the file, nil when never), `PacerSlot
     time.Time` (zero: no reservation asked) and `Queued map[string]bool` (langKeys whose fetch
     subject still holds a stored task); `Listed{Path, ProbeHash string}`; `Need{Records []string;
     Reserve, List bool}`; `Decision{Block *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus; Sidecars
     []catalogv1alpha1.Sidecar; SidecarsListed bool; HandledNonce string; Dispatches []Dispatch;
     Withdraws []Withdraw; Wake time.Time; Held bool; Events []Event; FileUID string}`;
     `Dispatch{LangKey string; Seq int64; Record bool; Revision uint64; IncorporatedThrough int64;
     New, Republish, Evicted bool; Priority Priority; Task schema.FetchTask}` (`Republish`: the
     record is `requested` at `Seq` already, publish only; `Evicted`: Gather's stored-task reading
     says the task is gone, so the republish takes a fresh Msg-Id, §6.4.6); `Withdraw{LangKey string; Seq int64}` (the
     adapter's `Withdrawer` reads the record afresh, so no revision travels); `Event{Type, Reason, Message string}`; `Priority` with
     `PriorityHigh = "high"`, `PriorityNormal = "normal"`, `PriorityLow = "low"` (the values of
     `events.Priority`, which the adapter converts); the six reasons; `RequestTimeout = 26 *

     `maxItems = 20`.
   - `profile.go`: moved from `app/caption/controller/subtitleprofile/profile.go` —

     `DefaultWinner`, `selectorMatches(p, mf)` → `SelectorMatches(p, labels map[string]string)`,

   - `sidecars.go`: `carriedSidecars(videoPath string, stored []catalogv1alpha1.Sidecar)` (fills
