     `Path = filepath.Dir(videoPath) + "/" + name`, sorted by name, at most 32); `sidecarNames`;
     and `rebind`:

     ```go
     // rebind keeps a downloaded item's name true to the directory (§6.4.3): a
     // sidecar the rename actuator moved is found under its canonical name or
     // the .ass twin; one that is gone clears the candidate, so the language is
     // wanted and searched again.
     func rebind(it *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, videoPath, hiExt string, names []string) {
      if it.Name == "" || slices.Contains(names, it.Name) {
       return
      }
      canon := filepath.Base(subtitles.SidecarName(videoPath, subtitles.LangKey(it.LangKey), hiExt))
      for _, n := range []string{canon, strings.TrimSuffix(canon, ".srt") + ".ass"} {
       if slices.Contains(names, n) {
        it.Name = n
        return
       }
      }
      gone := it.Name
      it.State = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending
      it.Score, it.Provider, it.SubtitleID, it.Name, it.DownloadedAt = 0, "", "", "", nil
      it.LastError = "sidecar " + gone + " is gone"
     }
     ```

   - `plan.go`, the planner. `Plan` and `Needs` run one pass, so the two never disagree about what is
     due; a `Needs` run records the records it would read and the gates it would open instead of
     deciding:

     ```go
     func Plan(in Input, issue func(recordSeq int64) int64) Decision {
      p := &pass{in: in, issue: issue}
      p.run()
      return p.d
     }

     func Needs(in Input) Need {
      p := &pass{in: in, issue: func(int64) int64 { return 0 }, need: &Need{}}
      p.run()
      slices.Sort(p.need.Records)
      p.need.Records = slices.Compact(p.need.Records)
      return *p.need
     }

     type pass struct {
      in        Input
      issue     func(int64) int64
      need      *Need // set in a Needs run
      d         Decision
      winner    *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile
      cad       cadence
      threshold int32
      want      map[string]bool
      extract   map[int32]bool
      throttled map[string]time.Time
      wake      time.Time
     }

     // record is langKey's record when Gather read it; a Needs run asks for it.
     func (p *pass) record(langKey string) (subtitlestore.Entry, bool) {
      if p.need != nil {
       p.need.Records = append(p.need.Records, langKey)
      }
      e, ok := p.in.Records[langKey]
      return e, ok
     }

     func (p *pass) askList()    { if p.need != nil { p.need.List = true } }
     func (p *pass) askReserve() { if p.need != nil { p.need.Reserve = true } }
     func (p *pass) at(t time.Time) {
      if !t.IsZero() && (p.wake.IsZero() || t.Before(p.wake)) {
       p.wake = t
      }
     }

     func (p *pass) run() {
      in, mf := p.in, p.in.File
      st := &mf.Status
      if !EligibleKind(mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind) {
       return // the adapter's Applies keeps this unreachable
      }
      p.d.FileUID = string(mf.UID)
      p.d.Block = st.Subtitles.DeepCopy()
      p.d.Sidecars = carriedSidecars(mf.Spec.Path, st.Sidecars)
      if st.HandledNonces != nil {
       p.d.HandledNonce = st.HandledNonces.SubtitleSearch
      }
      switch {
      case !in.Item.Exists:
       p.block(ReasonItemNotFound, fmt.Sprintf("the %s %q this file belongs to no longer exists; "+
        "subtitles are not fetched for a file Clustarr no longer manages", mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind, mf.Spec.MediaRef.Name), time.Time{})
       return
      case !in.ProbeCurrent:
       p.d.Held = true // §6.4.1: the previous block stays verbatim
       return
      }
      if p.winner = WinningProfile(in.Labels, in.Profiles); p.winner == nil {
       p.block(ReasonNoProfile, "no SubtitleProfile selects this MediaFile and there is no default profile", time.Time{})
       return
      }
      if Invalid(p.winner) {
       p.block(ReasonProfileInvalid, fmt.Sprintf("SubtitleProfile %q is marked Invalid", p.winner.Name), time.Time{})
       return
      }
      local, err := datapath.Local(in.DataDir, mf.Spec.Path)
      if err != nil {
       p.block(ReasonNotOnDataVolume, fmt.Sprintf("MediaFile %q: %v", mf.Name, err), time.Time{})
       return
      }
      if p.listGateOpen() {
       p.askList()
      }
      if l := in.Listing; l != nil {
       dir, base := filepath.Dir(local), filepath.Base(mf.Spec.Path)
       switch {
       case l.Err != nil:
        p.block(ReasonMediaDirUnreadable, fmt.Sprintf("cannot list %s: %v", dir, l.Err), in.Now.Add(diskRetry))
        return
       case !slices.Contains(l.Names, base):
        // A listing without the video is what a missing mount looks
        // like too: it is not trusted about sidecars (reconciler.go:268-275).
        p.block(ReasonNotOnDisk, fmt.Sprintf("%s is not in %s", base, dir), in.Now.Add(diskRetry))
        return
       }
       p.d.Sidecars, p.d.SidecarsListed = listedSidecars(mf.Spec.Path, l.Names), true
      }
      p.plan()
     }

     // listGateOpen is §6.4.3's gates 3 to 5, and the disk block's retry.
     func (p *pass) listGateOpen() bool {
      in, st := p.in, &p.in.File.Status
      last, b := in.LastListed, st.Subtitles
      switch {
      case last == nil, last.Path != in.File.Spec.Path, last.ProbeHash != st.ProbeHash:
       return true
      case b == nil:
       return true
      case b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseBlocked && (b.Reason == ReasonMediaDirUnreadable || b.Reason == ReasonNotOnDisk):
       return true
      }
      return false
     }

     // block keeps items, attempts, nextSearchAt and dispatches verbatim
     // (today's block(), without the liveness rules).
     func (p *pass) block(reason, message string, wake time.Time) {
      b := p.d.Block
      if b == nil {
       b = &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{}
      }
      b.Phase, b.Reason, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseBlocked, reason, message
      p.d.Block, p.d.Wake = b, wake
     }

     func (p *pass) plan() {
      in, mf := p.in, p.in.File
      st, now, spec := &mf.Status, in.Now, p.winner.Spec
      pp, profileLangs := plannerProfile(spec)
      p.extract = extractableStreams(st.MediaInfo, spec.Embedded, providerset.Order(slices.Clone(in.Extractors), spec.Providers))
      existing := buildExisting(st.MediaInfo, spec.Embedded, filepath.Base(mf.Spec.Path), sidecarNames(p.d.Sidecars), profileLangs, p.extract)
      audio := audioLanguages(st.MediaInfo, in.Item.OriginalLanguage)
      wantedKeys, cutoffMet := subtitles.Plan(pp, audio, existingKeys(existing))
      anyWant, _ := subtitles.Plan(pp, audio, nil)
      p.cad, p.threshold = cadenceFor(spec), minScoreFor(mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind, spec)
      p.want = map[string]bool{}
      for _, k := range wantedKeys {
       p.want[string(k)] = true
      }

      b := p.d.Block
      if b == nil {
       b = &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{}
      }
      items, dropped := planItems(b.Items, profileKeys(pp), wantedKeys)
      for _, it := range dropped {
       if inFlight(it) {
        p.d.Withdraws = append(p.d.Withdraws, Withdraw{LangKey: it.LangKey, Seq: it.Dispatch.Seq})
       }
      }
      // New bytes: every language's history describes a file that is gone
      // (reconciler.go:411-420); what is in flight is closed and withdrawn
      // below unless this pass dispatches it again.
      stale := map[string]int64{}
      if b.ProbeHash != "" && b.ProbeHash != st.ProbeHash {
       for i := range items {
        it := &items[i]
        it.Attempts, it.NextSearchAt = commonv1.Attempts{}, nil
        if inFlight(*it) {
         stale[it.LangKey] = it.Dispatch.Seq
         it.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq, it.Dispatch.Withdrawn = it.Dispatch.Seq, true
        }
       }
      }
      if l := in.Listing; l != nil {
       for i := range items {
        rebind(&items[i], mf.Spec.Path, string(spec.HIExtension), l.Names)
       }
      }

      p.throttled = map[string]time.Time{}
      for i := range items {
       it := &items[i]
       if _, ok := stale[it.LangKey]; !ok {
        p.incorporate(it)
       }
       if p.consider(it) {
        delete(stale, it.LangKey)
       }
       // nextSearchAt is derived after the dispatch decision, from the
       // attempts a dispatch just stamped (schedule.go's rule).
       at, _, scheduled := schedule(now, *it, p.want[it.LangKey], p.cad)
       if hold := p.throttled[it.LangKey]; hold.After(at) {
        at = hold
       }
       it.NextSearchAt = &metav1.Time{Time: at}
       if scheduled && !inFlight(*it) && at.After(now) {
        p.at(at) // a past-due item waits on a gate, which set its own wake
       }
      }
      for _, k := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(stale)) {
       p.d.Withdraws = append(p.d.Withdraws, Withdraw{LangKey: k, Seq: stale[k]})
      }

      searching := false
      for i := range items {
       it := &items[i]
       switch {
       case onDisk(*it):
        it.State = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateDownloaded
        if upgradeCandidate(now, *it, p.cad) {
         it.State = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateUpgradable
        }
       case inFlight(*it):
        it.State = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateSearching
       case it.State == "", it.State == catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateSearching,
        it.State == catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateDownloaded, it.State == catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateUpgradable:
        it.State = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending
       }
       if inFlight(*it) {
        searching = true
        p.at(it.Dispatch.DispatchedAt.Add(RequestTimeout))
       }
      }
      slices.SortFunc(items, func(a, b catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus) int { return strings.Compare(a.LangKey, b.LangKey) })
      b.Items = items[:min(len(items), maxItems)]
      b.Profile, b.Reason, b.Message = p.winner.Name, "", ""
      b.Wanted = stringKeys(wantedKeys)[:min(len(wantedKeys), maxItems)]
      b.CutoffMet = cutoffMet
      b.ProbeHash = ""
      if len(b.Items) > 0 {
       b.ProbeHash = st.ProbeHash
      }
      switch {
      case searching:
       b.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSearching
      case len(wantedKeys) > 0:
       b.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted
      case len(anyWant) == 0 && len(b.Items) == 0:
       b.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseNotWanted
      default:
       b.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSatisfied
      }
      p.d.Block = b
      if !p.wake.IsZero() {
       p.d.Wake = maxTime(p.wake, now.Add(minWake)) // reconciler.go:747-752
      }
     }
     ```

     `consider` is §6.4.5-§6.4.6's dispatch decision for one item; it reports whether it
     dispatched (`pass` gains `throttled map[string]time.Time`):

     ```go
     func (p *pass) consider(it *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus) bool {
      in, now := p.in, p.in.Now
      at, upgrade, scheduled := schedule(now, *it, p.want[it.LangKey], p.cad)
      if !scheduled || now.Before(at) || inFlight(*it) {
       return false
      }
      if !in.BacklogOpen {
       p.at(now.Add(backlogRetry)) // no record, no stamp (§6.4.6)
       return false
      }
      if in.PacerSlot.IsZero() {
       p.askReserve()
       return false
      }
      if in.PacerSlot.After(now) {
       p.at(in.PacerSlot.Add(jitter(in.File.UID)))
       return false
      }
      e, _ := p.record(it.LangKey)
      if r := e.Record; e.OK && r.Verdict == schema.SubtitleVerdictThrottled && r.ThrottledUntil != nil && r.ThrottledUntil.After(now) {
       p.throttled[it.LangKey] = *r.ThrottledUntil // §6.6: nextSearchAt at or after ThrottledUntil
       p.at(*r.ThrottledUntil)
       return false
      }
      p.askList() // gate 1
      if p.adopt(it, e) {
       return true
      }
      p.dispatch(it, e, upgrade, false)
      return true
     }
     ```

     `incorporate` is §6.6's incorporation table for an item in flight (`Dispatch.Seq >
     Dispatch.AnsweredSeq`):

     ```go
     func (p *pass) incorporate(it *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus) {
      d := it.Dispatch
      if d == nil || d.Seq <= d.AnsweredSeq {
       return
      }
      e, read := p.record(it.LangKey)
      if !read {
       return // a Needs run before the records are read
      }
      now, probeHash, rec := p.in.Now, p.in.File.Status.ProbeHash, e.Record
      answered := e.OK && (rec.State == records.StateAnswered || rec.State == records.StateFailed)
      switch {
      case answered && rec.Seq >= d.Seq:
       d.Seq, d.AnsweredSeq = rec.Seq, rec.Seq
       if rec.ProbeHash == probeHash {
        applyVerdict(it, rec)
        p.askList() // gate 2: the worker wrote or replaced a file
       }
      case answered && rec.Seq > d.AnsweredSeq && rec.ProbeHash == probeHash:
       // An answer the item never incorporated: a newer dispatch's
       // request missed its CAS against it. Take it, keep d.Seq, owe
       // the request for d.Seq.
       applyVerdict(it, rec)
       p.askList()
       p.owe(it, e, rec.Seq)
      case e.OK && rec.State == records.StateRequested && rec.Seq == d.Seq:
       if now.Before(d.DispatchedAt.Add(RequestTimeout)) {
        if now.Sub(d.DispatchedAt.Time) < records.RepublishWindow && !p.in.Queued[it.LangKey] {
         p.republish(it) // §4.7; a task still stored is absorbed anyway, so it is skipped
        }
        return
       }
       p.d.Withdraws = append(p.d.Withdraws, Withdraw{LangKey: it.LangKey, Seq: d.Seq})
      case e.OK && rec.State == records.StateWithdrawn && rec.Seq == d.Seq && !now.Before(d.DispatchedAt.Add(RequestTimeout)):
       d.AnsweredSeq, it.LastError = d.Seq, "no answer within 26h"
      case e.OK && rec.State == records.StateRequested && rec.Seq > d.Seq && p.matches(rec):
       d.Seq, d.DispatchedAt = rec.Seq, metav1.NewTime(rec.RequestedAt) // adopted (§4.7)
      case now.Sub(d.DispatchedAt.Time) < records.RepublishWindow:
       // Absent, withdrawn or requested below d.Seq, or an older answer
       // already incorporated: owed (§4.7). A crash or a CAS miss between
       // the apply and the record write heals here.
       p.owe(it, e, d.AnsweredSeq)
      default:
       d.AnsweredSeq, it.LastError = d.Seq, "request lost"
      }
     }
     ```

     `p.matches(rec)` is `rec.ProbeHash == status.probeHash && rec.ProfileGeneration ==
     p.winner.Generation`. `adopt(it, e) bool` is §6.4.6 step 1 for a due item: a `requested` record
     above the item's last `Dispatch.Seq` that `p.matches` is taken (`Dispatch{Seq: rec.Seq,
     AnsweredSeq: <kept>, DispatchedAt: rec.RequestedAt}`, then `p.republish(it)` while inside
     `records.RepublishWindow` and `!p.in.Queued[k]`), and an answered one above it is incorporated (`Dispatch{Seq,
     AnsweredSeq: rec.Seq}`, `applyVerdict` when its probe hash matches); either returns true.
     `dispatch(it, e, upgrade, forced)`:

     ```go
     func (p *pass) dispatch(it *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, e subtitlestore.Entry, upgrade, forced bool) {
      now := p.in.Now
      seq := p.issue(e.Record.Seq)
      var answered int64
      if it.Dispatch != nil {
       answered = it.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq
      }
      it.Dispatch = &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: seq, AnsweredSeq: answered, DispatchedAt: metav1.NewTime(now)}
      it.Attempts = stamp(it.Attempts, now)
      prio := PriorityNormal
      switch {
      case forced:
       prio = PriorityHigh
      case upgrade:
       prio = PriorityLow
      }
      p.d.Dispatches = append(p.d.Dispatches, Dispatch{LangKey: it.LangKey, Seq: seq, Record: true,
       Revision: e.Revision, IncorporatedThrough: answered, New: true, Priority: prio,
       Task: p.task(it, seq, upgrade, forced)})
     }
     ```

     `owe(it, e, through)` appends `Dispatch{Seq: it.Dispatch.Seq, Record: true, Revision:
     e.Revision, IncorporatedThrough: through, Priority: p.priorityOf(it), Task: p.task(it,
     it.Dispatch.Seq, p.upgradeOf(it), false)}` (no `New`); `republish(it)` the same with `Record:
     false, Republish: true, Evicted: p.in.Queued != nil` (with no reading, `Queued` is nil and the
     same Msg-Id goes out; with one, the key is absent from the map only when its task is gone); `upgradeOf(it)` is `!p.want[it.LangKey] && onDisk(*it)`;
     `priorityOf` is `PriorityLow` for an upgrade, else `PriorityNormal`. `task` builds §6.7.1's
     FetchTask: `MediaFile` from the file's namespace, name and UID; `Path` and `ProbeHash` from the
     file; `Profile`/`ProfileGeneration` from the winner; `MinScore` = `p.threshold`, or
     `upgradeMinScore(it.Score, p.threshold)` for an upgrade, raised to `it.Score+1` with a subtitle
     on disk (then `OnDisk = &schema.OnDiskSubtitle{Name: it.Name, Score: it.Score}`);
     `UpgradeMarginPoints` = `spec.upgrade.minDeltaPoints`; `SidecarMode =
     uint32(sidecarMode(in.RootFolders, spec.path, DefaultSidecarMode))`; `Query` = `in.Item.Query`
     with `IDs` cloned and `ReleaseTitle` = `spec.importedFrom.releaseTitle`, else the file's stem;
     `Extract` = the probe's subtitle streams whose index is in `p.extract`, in stream order.
     `applyVerdict` is §6.6's second table:

     ```go
     func applyVerdict(it *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, rec schema.SubtitleRecord) {
      if rec.ScoreOutOf > 0 {
       it.ScoreOutOf = rec.ScoreOutOf
      }
      if rec.State == records.StateFailed { // the worker's last delivery (§4.8)
       fail(it, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateFailed, rec.Failure)
       return
      }
      switch rec.Verdict {
      case schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded:
       at := metav1.NewTime(rec.RequestedAt.UTC())
       if rec.AnsweredAt != nil { // always set by subtitlestore.Answer; a hand-made record may lack it
        at = metav1.NewTime(rec.AnsweredAt.UTC())
       }
       it.Score, it.Provider, it.SubtitleID, it.Name = rec.Score, rec.Provider, rec.SubtitleID, rec.Name
       it.DownloadedAt, it.LastError = &at, ""
      case schema.SubtitleVerdictKept:
      case schema.SubtitleVerdictUnavailable:
       fail(it, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateUnavailable, rec.LastError)
      case schema.SubtitleVerdictFailed:
       fail(it, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateFailed, rec.LastError)
      case schema.SubtitleVerdictThrottled:
       it.LastError = rec.LastError
       if !onDisk(*it) {
        it.State = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending
       }
      case schema.SubtitleVerdictDropped:
       it.LastError = clip("fetch dropped: "+rec.LastError, schema.MaxSubtitleLastError)
      }
     }

     // fail: with a subtitle on disk only the error (apply.go:224-227); else the candidate is cleared.
     func fail(it *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus, state catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleState, msg string) {
      if onDisk(*it) {
       it.LastError = msg
       return
      }
      it.State, it.LastError = state, msg
      it.Score, it.Provider, it.SubtitleID, it.Name, it.DownloadedAt = 0, "", "", "", nil
     }
     ```

     The small helpers are `profileKeys(pp)` (the profile's langKeys as a set), `stringKeys`,
     `maxTime`, `onDisk(it)` (`it.Name != "" && it.DownloadedAt != nil`) and `clip` (a rune-safe
     cut). `schedule(now, it, wanted, c) (at time.Time, upgrade, scheduled bool)` returns
     `wantedDueAt(now, it, c), false, true` for a wanted language, else `at :=
     upgradeCheckAt(it, c, now)` (its fallback is the stored `nextSearchAt`, else `now +
     upgrade.interval`, as the `schedule.go` bullet says), `upgrade = true` and `scheduled =
     upgradeScheduled(now, at, it, c)`. `jitter(uid)` is `time.Duration(fnv32a(uid) % 5000) * time.Millisecond`
     (deterministic, below `maxPacerJitter`). `inFlight(it)` is `it.Dispatch != nil &&
     it.Dispatch.Seq > it.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq`.

7. **`app/remediation/subtitles`.** `doc.go` carries the adapter's package-level RBAC:

   ```go
   // Package subtitles is the loop's subtitles adapter (loop spec §6.4): it
   // gathers subtitleplan's Input from the manager cache, clustarr-subtitles
   // and /data, and turns its Decision into effects.
   //
   // +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=subtitle.clustarr.io,resources=subtitleprofiles,verbs=get;list;watch
   // +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=subtitle.clustarr.io,resources=subtitleproviders,verbs=get;list;watch
   // +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=catalog.clustarr.io,resources=movies;episodes;series;rootfolders,verbs=get;list;watch
   package subtitles
   ```

   `adapter.go`:

   ```go
   type Options struct {
    Store       *subtitlestore.Store
    DataDir     string
    BacklogOpen func(now time.Time) bool
   }

   type Adapter struct {
    o      Options
    listed *listedSet
   }

   type In = subtitleplan.Input

   func New(o Options) *Adapter { return &Adapter{o: o, listed: newListedSet()} }

   func (a *Adapter) Name() remediation.PlannerName { return remediation.PlannerSubtitles }

   func (a *Adapter) Applies(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
    return subtitleplan.EligibleKind(mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind)
   }

   func (a *Adapter) Gather(ctx context.Context, env *remediation.Env, v *remediation.View) (In, error) {
    mf := v.File
    f := *mf
    f.Status = *v.Draft // the probe this pass incorporated plans in the same pass (§6.4.1)
    in := In{File: &f, Labels: v.Labels(), ProbeCurrent: v.ProbeCurrent(), DataDir: a.o.DataDir,
     Now: v.Now.Time, LastListed: a.listed.get(mf.UID)}
    var err error
    if in.Item, err = item(ctx, env.Reader, mf); err != nil {
     return in, remediation.Transient(err)
    }
    var profiles subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfileList
    if err := env.Reader.List(ctx, &profiles, client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy); err != nil {
     return in, remediation.Transient(fmt.Errorf("subtitles: list SubtitleProfiles: %w", err))
    }
    in.Profiles = profiles.Items
    var providers subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProviderList
    if err := env.Reader.List(ctx, &providers, client.InNamespace(mf.Namespace), client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy); err != nil {
     return in, remediation.Transient(fmt.Errorf("subtitles: list SubtitleProviders: %w", err))
    }
    in.Extractors = subtitleplan.EmbeddedEntries(providers.Items)
    var roots catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderList
    if err := env.Reader.List(ctx, &roots, client.InNamespace(mf.Namespace), client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy); err != nil {
     return in, remediation.Transient(fmt.Errorf("subtitles: list RootFolders: %w", err))
    }
    in.RootFolders = roots.Items
    if a.o.BacklogOpen != nil {
     in.BacklogOpen = a.o.BacklogOpen(in.Now)
    }

    need := subtitleplan.Needs(in)
    if need.Reserve {
     // The reservation is checked before any I/O that serves only the
     // dispatch, so a paced-out file neither lists nor reads (§4.7).
     in.PacerSlot = env.Pacer.Reserve(subtitlestore.Remediation, string(mf.UID))
     need = subtitleplan.Needs(in)
    }
    in.Records = make(map[string]subtitlestore.Entry, len(need.Records))
    for _, k := range need.Records {
     e, err := a.o.Store.Get(ctx, string(mf.UID), k)
     if err != nil {
      return in, remediation.Transient(err) // a NATS outage must not write onto every file
     }
     in.Records[k] = e
    }
    if err := a.queued(ctx, env, &in); err != nil {
     return in, err
    }
    if subtitleplan.Needs(in).List {
     if err := a.list(ctx, env, &in); err != nil {
      return in, err
     }
    }
    return in, nil
   }
   ```

   `item` Gets the Movie, or the Episode and its Series, from the cache with
   `client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy` (NotFound is `Item{}`; a missing Series is `ItemFromEpisode(ep,
   nil)`), through `subtitleplan.ItemFromMovie`/`ItemFromEpisode`. `queued` reads, for every record
   Gather read that is `requested` with `now - RequestedAt < records.RepublishWindow`, whether its
   task is still stored: when there is at least one such record and the bus is a
   `events.StreamAdmin`, it allocates `in.Queued` and sets `in.Queued[langKey] = true` for each
   whose `admin.Subjects(ctx, events.StreamWorkCaptionarr, events.WorkFetchSubjectAnyPriority(uid,
   langKey))` is non-empty, so a key absent from the map is a task gone from the stream; with no
   such record, or no admin, `Queued` stays nil and a republish reuses the Msg-Id. A `Subjects`
   error is `remediation.Transient`. (A known limit of §6.4.6's check: subjects carry no Seq, so an
   older, superseded task still queued on the same subject masks an evicted current one, which the
   26 h timeout then closes and the schedule dispatches again.) `list`:

   ```go
   func (a *Adapter) list(ctx context.Context, env *remediation.Env, in *In) error {
    local, err := datapath.Local(a.o.DataDir, in.File.Spec.Path)
    if err != nil {
     return nil // Plan blocks MediaFileNotOnDataVolume
    }
    entries, err := env.IO.ReadDir(ctx, filepath.Dir(local))
    switch {
    case errors.Is(err, syscall.EIO), remediation.IsTransient(err):
     return remediation.Transient(err) // §6.4.1: an EIO is transient, never a block
    case err != nil:
     in.Listing = &subtitleplan.Listing{Err: err}
     return nil
    }
    names := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
    for _, e := range entries {
     if e.Type().IsRegular() {
      names = append(names, e.Name())
     }
    }
    in.Listing = &subtitleplan.Listing{Names: names}
    return nil
   }
   ```

   `Plan` and `Copy`:

   ```go
   func (a *Adapter) Plan(v *remediation.View, in In, out *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) (remediation.Result, error) {
    d := subtitleplan.Plan(in, v.Issue)
    if d.Held {
     return remediation.Result{}, nil // out holds the draft's block and sidecars already
    }
    out.Subtitles, out.Sidecars = d.Block, d.Sidecars
    setNonce(out, d.HandledNonce)
    res := remediation.Result{Due: d.Wake, Effects: effectsOf(d, in.Now)}
    if d.SidecarsListed {
     a.listed.set(v.File.UID, subtitleplan.Listed{Path: v.File.Spec.Path, ProbeHash: v.Draft.ProbeHash})
    }
    for _, e := range d.Events {
     res.Events = append(res.Events, remediation.Event{Type: e.Type, Reason: e.Reason, Message: e.Message, Action: "subtitles"})
    }
    return res, nil
   }

   func (a *Adapter) Copy(from, into *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) {
    into.Subtitles = from.Subtitles.DeepCopy()
    into.Sidecars = slices.Clone(from.Sidecars)
    var nonce string
    if from.HandledNonces != nil {
     nonce = from.HandledNonces.SubtitleSearch
    }
    setNonce(into, nonce)
   }

   // setNonce sets handledNonces.subtitleSearch alone, beside the transcode leaves.
   func setNonce(st *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus, nonce string) {
    if st.HandledNonces == nil {
     if nonce == "" {
      return
     }
     st.HandledNonces = &catalogv1alpha1.HandledNonces{}
    }
    st.HandledNonces.SubtitleSearch = nonce
    if *st.HandledNonces == (catalogv1alpha1.HandledNonces{}) {
     st.HandledNonces = nil
    }
   }
   ```

   The listing set is updated in `Plan` because it is memory, not an external write: a plan whose
   apply then fails relists only when another gate opens, which costs a `ReadDir`, never
   correctness. `effectsOf(d, now)` renders withdrawals first, then for each dispatch its record
   write and its publish:

   ```go
   func effectsOf(d subtitleplan.Decision, now time.Time) []remediation.Effect {
    var out []remediation.Effect
    for _, w := range d.Withdraws {
     out = append(out, remediation.Withdraw{UID: d.FileUID, Sub: w.LangKey, Seq: w.Seq})
    }
    for _, x := range d.Dispatches {
     uid := x.Task.MediaFile.UID
     if x.Record {
      rec := subtitlestore.Requested(x.Task, now)
      b, _ := json.Marshal(rec) // a struct of strings and ints: Marshal cannot fail
      rw := remediation.RecordWrite{Bucket: events.BucketSubtitles, Key: subtitlestore.Key(uid, x.LangKey), Revision: x.Revision, Value: b}
      if x.New {
       rw.Pace = subtitlestore.Remediation
      }
      out = append(out, rw)
     }
     id := events.MsgIDForSubtitleFetch(uid, x.LangKey, x.Seq)
     if x.Evicted {
      // The task is gone from a DiscardOld stream, and its Msg-Id
      // stays in the dedupe map for the window (§6.4.6).
      id = fmt.Sprintf("%s/r%d", id, now.Unix()/60)
     }
     name, data, _ := schema.Encode(x.Task)
     out = append(out, remediation.Publish{
      Subject:      events.WorkFetchSubject(events.Priority(x.Priority), uid, x.LangKey),
      MsgID:        id,
      ExpectStream: events.StreamWorkCaptionarr,
      Envelope: &events.Envelope{ID: id, Type: schema.FetchTaskType, Schema: name,
       Source: "catalogarr@" + version.String(), Key: x.Task.MediaFile.Key(), Time: now, Data: data},
     })
    }
    return out
   }
   ```

   The `remediation.Withdrawer`:

   ```go
   // Withdraw runs a subtitle withdrawal (§4.7): withdrawn{seq} at a fresh
   // read, then the purge of the language's task subjects on every lane.
   func (a *Adapter) Withdraw(ctx context.Context, env *remediation.Env, w remediation.Withdraw) error {
    for range records.CASAttempts {
     e, err := a.o.Store.Get(ctx, w.UID, w.Sub)
     if err != nil {
      return remediation.Transient(err)
     }
     err = a.o.Store.Withdraw(ctx, w.UID, w.Sub, w.Seq, e.Revision, w.Seq)
     if errors.Is(err, records.ErrRaced) {
      continue
     }
     if err != nil {
      return err
     }
     if admin, ok := env.Bus.(events.StreamAdmin); ok {
      if err := admin.PurgeSubject(ctx, events.StreamWorkCaptionarr, events.WorkFetchSubjectAnyPriority(w.UID, w.Sub)); err != nil {
       return remediation.Transient(err)
      }
     }
     return nil
    }
    return records.ErrRaced
   }
   ```

   `listed.go`: `listedSet{mu sync.Mutex; m map[types.UID]subtitleplan.Listed}` with `get` and
   `set`; it is per process, so a new leader relists every video file once (gate 4).

8. **`app/remediation/backlog.go`** (the spec's `captionBacklog`, exported as `CaptionBacklog`):

   ```go
   const (
    subtitleBacklogCeiling = 500             // tasks of ~1.5 KB fit the scaled memory stream (§6.4.6)
    captionBacklogEvery    = 30 * time.Second
    captionBacklogStale    = 2 * time.Minute
   )

   // CaptionBacklog is §6.4.6's captionBacklog gate: scheduled and upgrade
   // subtitle dispatches wait while captionarr-fetch-normal is 500 deep or its
   // last reading is two minutes old. Forced dispatches go high and bypass it.
   type CaptionBacklog struct {
    admin events.StreamAdmin
    now   func() time.Time
    mu    sync.Mutex
    lag   uint64
    at    time.Time
   }

   func NewCaptionBacklog(admin events.StreamAdmin, now func() time.Time) *CaptionBacklog {
    return &CaptionBacklog{admin: admin, now: now}
   }

   func (b *CaptionBacklog) NeedLeaderElection() bool { return true }

   func (b *CaptionBacklog) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
    t := time.NewTicker(captionBacklogEvery)
    defer t.Stop()
    for {
     b.read(ctx)
     select {
     case <-ctx.Done():
      return nil
     case <-t.C:
     }
    }
   }

   func (b *CaptionBacklog) read(ctx context.Context) {
    s, err := b.admin.ConsumerState(ctx, events.StreamWorkCaptionarr, events.ConsumerCaptionFetchNormal)
    if err != nil {
     logging.FromContext(ctx).Warn("subtitle backlog: read the fetch consumer", "err", err)
     return
    }
    b.mu.Lock()
    b.lag, b.at = s.Lag(), b.now()
    b.mu.Unlock()
   }

   // Open reports whether a scheduled subtitle dispatch may go out at now.
   func (b *CaptionBacklog) Open(now time.Time) bool {
    b.mu.Lock()
    defer b.mu.Unlock()
    return !b.at.IsZero() && now.Sub(b.at) < captionBacklogStale && b.lag < subtitleBacklogCeiling
   }
   ```

9. **Sources (`app/remediation/subtitles_sources.go`)**, wired into `SetupWithManager`'s builder:

   ```go
   // subtitleSources are S13, S14 and S19 (loop spec §3.3).
   func (r *Reconciler) subtitleSources(b *builder.TypedBuilder[Key]) *builder.TypedBuilder[Key] {
    return b.
     Watches(&subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile{}, handler.TypedFuncs[client.Object, Key]{
      CreateFunc: func(ctx context.Context, _ event.TypedCreateEvent[client.Object], q workqueue.TypedRateLimitingInterface[Key]) { r.videoFilesLow(ctx, q) },
      UpdateFunc: func(ctx context.Context, _ event.TypedUpdateEvent[client.Object], q workqueue.TypedRateLimitingInterface[Key]) { r.videoFilesLow(ctx, q) },
      DeleteFunc: func(ctx context.Context, _ event.TypedDeleteEvent[client.Object], q workqueue.TypedRateLimitingInterface[Key]) { r.videoFilesLow(ctx, q) },
     }, builder.WithPredicates(k8s.Or(k8s.GenerationChanged(), k8s.StatusFieldChanged(subtitleProfileInvalid)))).
     Watches(&subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProvider{}, handler.TypedEnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(r.filesWithSubtitles),
      builder.WithPredicates(k8s.And(predicate.NewPredicateFuncs(isEmbeddedProvider), k8s.GenerationChanged()))).
     WatchesRawSource(recordsource.New(r.bus, events.BucketSubtitles, FileKeyOf))
   }
   ```

 assert.Equal(t, int64(100), rec.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, rec.Verdict)
 assert.Equal(t, int32(132), rec.Score)
 assert.Equal(t, int32(180), rec.ScoreOutOf)
 assert.Equal(t, "os-b", rec.Provider, "the SubtitleProvider's name, not the client's")
 assert.Equal(t, "b-other", rec.SubtitleID)
 assert.Equal(t, sidecarName, rec.Name)
 assert.Equal(t, f.probe, rec.ProbeHash)
 assert.Equal(t, "fetch-test", rec.Writer)
 require.NotNil(t, rec.AnsweredAt)
 assert.True(t, rec.AnsweredAt.Equal(now))

 assert.Zero(t, weak.downloads.Load())
 assert.Equal(t, int32(2), strong.downloads.Load(), "fall-through to the second-best candidate")
 assert.Positive(t, msg.inProgress.Load(), "a long fetch heartbeats")
 assert.Equal(t, before+1, fetches("os-b", "en", "downloaded"))

 evts := f.bus.subtitleEvents(t)
 require.Len(t, evts, 1)
 assert.Equal(t, events.ActionDownloaded, evts[0].Action)
 assert.Equal(t, schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "film", UID: fileUID}, evts[0].MediaFile)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(100), evts[0].Seq)

func TestTheProfileFencesTheTask(t *testing.T) {
 for _, tc := range []struct {
  name    string
  mutate  func(*schema.FetchTask)
  retry   bool
  dropped string
 }{
  {"the cache lags the planner", func(task *schema.FetchTask) { task.ProfileGeneration = 4 }, true, ""},
  {"the profile moved on", func(task *schema.FetchTask) { task.ProfileGeneration = 2 }, false, "SubtitleProfile subs changed since planned"},
  {"the profile is gone", func(task *schema.FetchTask) { task.Profile = "gone" }, false, "SubtitleProfile gone is gone"},
  {"the language left the profile", func(task *schema.FetchTask) { task.LangKey = "fr" }, false, "SubtitleProfile subs no longer has fr"},
 } {
  t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   f := newFixture(t, memBus(t))
   p := newFakeProvider("fake")
   f.entry("os", os1, p)
   probe := schema.FetchTask{LangKey: "en"}
   tc.mutate(&probe)
   msg := f.request(t, probe.LangKey, 100, tc.mutate)
   err := f.worker.Handle(f.ctx, msg)
   assert.Zero(t, p.searches.Load())
   if tc.retry {
    var re *events.RetryError
    require.ErrorAs(t, err, &re)
    assert.Equal(t, 30*time.Second, re.After)
    return
   }
   require.NoError(t, err)
   rec := f.answer(t, probe.LangKey)
   assert.Equal(t, schema.SubtitleVerdictDropped, rec.Verdict)
   assert.Equal(t, tc.dropped, rec.LastError)
  })
 }
}

```go
// TestTheFetchWorkerWritesNoKubernetesObject holds loop spec §6.2 decision 4:
// the caption domain answers in clustarr-subtitles and writes no Kubernetes
// object. Syntactic on purpose, as TestUINeverWrites is: a write method by
// name on any receiver fails, so it over-matches rather than misses.
// app/caption/throttle writes the throttle KV and is not scanned.
func TestTheFetchWorkerWritesNoKubernetesObject(t *testing.T) {
 banned := map[string]bool{"Create": true, "Update": true, "Patch": true, "Delete": true, "DeleteAllOf": true,
  "Status": true, "SubResource": true, "PatchStatus": true, "PatchStatusCAS": true, "Apply": true}
 files := productionFiles(t, "app/caption/worker", "app/caption/agent", "app/caption/providerset")
 require.NotEmpty(t, files)
 for rel, f := range files {
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   if sel, ok := n.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && banned[sel.Sel.Name] {
    t.Errorf("%s: a call of %s -- the caption domain writes no Kubernetes object (loop spec §6.2)", rel, sel.Sel.Name)
   }
   return true
  })
 }
}

// TestAgentCaptionRoleHasNoWriteVerbs holds §6.7.5 on the markers the caption
// domain links, which is what W6.9's agent-caption role is generated from;
// until then the domain runs under the captionarr role it shares with the
// manager's caption controllers.
func TestAgentCaptionRoleHasNoWriteVerbs(t *testing.T) {
 out, err := exec.Command("go", "list", "-deps", mod+"app/caption/agent").CombinedOutput()
 require.NoError(t, err, "%s", out)
 marker := regexp.MustCompile(`^//\s*\+kubebuilder:rbac:groups=([^,]*),resources=([^,]*),verbs=(\S+)`)
 write := map[string]bool{"create": true, "update": true, "patch": true, "delete": true, "deletecollection": true}
 gone := map[string]bool{"subtitlerequests": true, "subtitlerequests/status": true, "mediafiles": true,
  "movies": true, "episodes": true, "series": true, "rootfolders": true}
 root, err := filepath.Abs("../..")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 seen := 0
 for _, pkg := range strings.Fields(string(out)) {
  if !strings.HasPrefix(pkg, mod+"app/caption/") {
   continue
  }
  dir := filepath.Join(root, strings.TrimPrefix(pkg, mod))
  names, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "*.go"))
  require.NoError(t, err)
  for _, name := range names {
   if strings.HasSuffix(name, "_test.go") {
    continue
   }
   src, err := os.ReadFile(name)
   require.NoError(t, err)
   for _, line := range strings.Split(string(src), "\n") {
    m := marker.FindStringSubmatch(strings.TrimSpace(line))
    if m == nil {
     continue
    }
    seen++
    for _, res := range strings.Split(m[2], ";") {
     assert.False(t, gone[res], "%s grants %s: the caption domain reads no per-file object (§6.7.5)", name, res)
    }
    for _, verb := range strings.Split(m[3], ";") {
     assert.False(t, write[verb], "%s grants %s on %s: the caption domain writes nothing", name, verb, m[2])
    }
   }
  }
 }
 require.Positive(t, seen, "no RBAC marker found: the guard reads the wrong packages")
}
```

`cmd/agent/verify_envtest_test.go`'s `verifyCaptionarrWorker` is rewritten: the agent test runs
no manager, so it seeds what the loop would and waits for the answer.

```go
// verifyCaptionarrWorker proves the caption domain answers a fetch the way
// the loop asks for one (loop spec §6.6-§6.7): it creates the profile and a
// TV-only provider, writes the video and the requested record, publishes the
// v2 task, and waits for the answer in clustarr-subtitles: unavailable, naming
// the provider the movie skipped. The domain writes no Kubernetes object.
func verifyCaptionarrWorker(t *testing.T, cfg *rest.Config, natsURL, dataDir string) {
 t.Helper()
 ctx := context.Background()
 c, err := client.New(cfg, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 provider := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProvider{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: captionProbe, Namespace: "default"},
  Spec:       subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProviderSpec{Type: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProviderGestdown, Enabled: new(true)},
 }
 profile := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: captionProbe},
  Spec:       subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfileSpec{Languages: []subtitlev1alpha1.LanguageItem{{Key: "de", Language: "de"}}},
 }
 for _, o := range []client.Object{provider, profile} {
  require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, o))
 }
 t.Cleanup(func() {
  _ = c.Delete(context.Background(), provider)
  _ = c.Delete(context.Background(), profile)
 })
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(profile), profile))

 local := filepath.Join(dataDir, strings.TrimPrefix(captionProbeLogical, "/data"))
 require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(local), 0o750))
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(local, []byte("not really a movie"), 0o600))
 st, err := os.Stat(local)
 require.NoError(t, err)

 nc, err := nats.Connect(natsURL)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 t.Cleanup(nc.Close)
 bus, err := natsbus.New(nc)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 task := schema.FetchTask{
  MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: "default", Name: captionProbe, UID: "uid-" + captionProbe},
  Path:      captionProbeLogical, ProbeHash: mediainfo.ProbeHash(captionProbeLogical, st.Size(), st.ModTime()),
  LangKey: "de", Seq: time.Now().UnixMilli(), Profile: profile.Name, ProfileGeneration: profile.Generation,
  MinScore: 126, Query: schema.SubtitleQuery{Kind: commonv1alpha1.MediaKindMovie, IDs: map[string]string{"tmdb": "604"}},
 }
 store := subtitlestore.New(bus, "")
 require.NoError(t, store.Request(ctx, subtitlestore.Requested(task, time.Now()), 0, 0))
 name, data, err := schema.Encode(task)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 id := events.MsgIDForSubtitleFetch(task.MediaFile.UID, "de", task.Seq)
 _, err = bus.Publish(ctx, events.WorkFetchSubject(events.PriorityNormal, task.MediaFile.UID, "de"),
  &events.Envelope{ID: id, Type: schema.FetchTaskType, Schema: name, Key: task.MediaFile.Key(), Time: time.Now(), Data: data},
  events.WithMsgID(id), events.WithExpectStream(events.StreamWorkCaptionarr))
 require.NoError(t, err)

 var rec schema.SubtitleRecord
 starttest.WaitFor(t, "the caption domain to answer German in clustarr-subtitles", func() bool {
  e, err := store.Get(ctx, task.MediaFile.UID, "de")
  if err != nil || !e.OK || e.Record.State != records.StateAnswered {
   return false
  }
  rec = e.Record
  return true
 })
 assert.Equal(t, schema.SubtitleVerdictUnavailable, rec.Verdict)
 assert.Contains(t, rec.LastError, captionProbe, "the provider set was built and the TV-only provider skipped by name")
}
```

and the caption case in `cmd/agent/start_envtest_test.go` calls
`verifyCaptionarrWorker(t, env.Config, natsURL, captionData)`.

- [ ] **Step 2: Run them and watch them fail.**

  Run: `go test ./app/caption/... ./pkg/events/schema/ ./app/catalog/history/ && go test ./test/guards/ -run 'TestTheFetchWorkerWritesNoKubernetesObject|TestAgentCaptionRoleHasNoWriteVerbs'`
  Expected: build failures (`fetch.NewWorker` takes four arguments, `f.request` undefined,
  `schema.SubtitleEventV1Schema` undefined, `recordQuota` undefined); then
  `TestTheFetchWorkerWritesNoKubernetesObject` FAILs on `apply.go: a call of PatchStatusCAS` and
  `TestAgentCaptionRoleHasNoWriteVerbs` on `doc.go grants subtitlerequests` (and `patch` on
  `subtitlerequests/status`).

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement.**

1. **`pkg/events/schema/subtitle.go`.** `SubtitleEvent`'s `RequestRef Ref` becomes `MediaFile Ref
   json:"mediaFile"` and `Seq int64 json:"seq"` is added after `LangKey`; its doc names subject
   `clustarr.evt.subtitle.subtitle.<action>.<mediafile-uid>`; `Schema()` returns
   `"subtitle.SubtitleEvent.v2"`; add `SubtitleEventV1Schema` and `SubtitleEventType`.

2. **`app/catalog/history`.** `resolveSubtitleEvent` decodes v2 and returns
   `mediaFileTarget(ns, p.MediaFile.Name)` (namespace from the ref, else the key); a
   `subtitleEventV1Ref{RequestRef schema.Ref json:"requestRef"}` with `Schema()` =
   `schema.SubtitleEventV1Schema` and `resolveSubtitleEventV1` keep today's SubtitleRequest target
   under `resolvers[schema.SubtitleEventV1Schema]` until F5.4. In `app/catalog/worker/history/sink.go`'s `summarize` the
   `SubtitleEvent` note becomes `subtitle %s (lang=%q seq=%d provider=%q score=%d reason=%q)`.

3. **The worker (`worker.go`).**

   ```go
   const (
    heartbeatInterval = 20 * time.Second
    statRetry         = 5 * time.Minute  // a failed stat (§6.7.2 step 5)
    profileLagRetry   = 30 * time.Second // the cache is behind the planner (step 3)
    DefaultSidecarMode os.FileMode = 0o664
    maxSubtitleID     = 256
   )

   // Worker handles clustarr.work.captionarr.fetch.<priority>.<mediafile-uid>.<langKey>.
   // It reads SubtitleProfiles and SubtitleProviders and answers in
   // clustarr-subtitles; it writes no Kubernetes object (loop spec §6.7).
   type Worker struct {
    Client     client.Reader // the agent's cache: SubtitleProfiles only (§6.7.2)
    Bus        events.Bus
    Store      *subtitlestore.Store
    Providers  ProviderSource
    DataDir    string
    MaxDeliver int
    Clock      func() time.Time
   }

   func NewWorker(c client.Reader, bus events.Bus, providers ProviderSource, dataDir, writer string) *Worker {
    return &Worker{Client: c, Bus: bus, Store: subtitlestore.New(bus, writer), Providers: providers, DataDir: dataDir, Clock: time.Now}
   }

   func (w *Worker) Handle(ctx context.Context, m events.Message) error {
    env := m.Envelope()
    ctx = tracing.Extract(ctx, env)
    ctx, span := tracing.Start(ctx, "fetch.Worker.Handle")
    defer span.End()
    if env != nil && env.Schema == schema.FetchTaskV1Schema {
     logging.FromContext(ctx).Info("fetch: a v1 task names a SubtitleRequest; the loop re-plans", "key", env.Key)
     return nil
    }
    t, err := decodeTask(env)
    if err != nil {
     tracing.RecordError(span, err)
     return events.Discard("fetch: malformed FetchTask", err)
    }
    ctx = logging.With(ctx, "namespace", t.MediaFile.Namespace, "mediaFile", t.MediaFile.Name, "langKey", t.LangKey, "seq", t.Seq)
    if err := w.handle(ctx, m, t); err != nil {
     tracing.RecordError(span, err)
     return err
    }
    return nil
   }
   ```

   `decodeTask` decodes `schema.FetchTask` (v2) and refuses, as a poison message, a task with no
   `MediaFile.UID`, no `Path`, `Seq <= 0` or an unparseable `LangKey`. `handle` is §6.7.2 in order:

   ```go
   func (w *Worker) handle(ctx context.Context, m events.Message, t schema.FetchTask) error {
    if sup, err := w.Store.Superseded(ctx, t); err != nil {
     return fmt.Errorf("fetch: read the record: %w", err)
    } else if sup {
     logging.FromContext(ctx).Info("fetch: a newer request, a withdrawal or an answer supersedes this task")
     return nil
    }
    kind := t.Query.Kind
    if kind != commonv1.MediaKindMovie && kind != commonv1.MediaKindEpisode {
     return events.Discard("fetch: the task is not for a video kind", fmt.Errorf("kind %q", kind))
    }
    outOf := int32(subtitles.MaxScore[kind]) //nolint:gosec // 180 or 360

    var profile subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile
    switch err := w.Client.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Name: t.Profile}, &profile); {
    case apierrors.IsNotFound(err):
     return w.answer(ctx, t, dropped(outOf, fmt.Sprintf("SubtitleProfile %s is gone", t.Profile)))
    case err != nil:
     return fmt.Errorf("fetch: get SubtitleProfile %s: %w", t.Profile, err)
    }
    wnt, ok := wantFor(&profile, t.LangKey)
    switch {
    case !ok:
     return w.answer(ctx, t, dropped(outOf, fmt.Sprintf("SubtitleProfile %s no longer has %s", profile.Name, t.LangKey)))
    case profile.Generation < t.ProfileGeneration:
     return events.Retry(profileLagRetry, fmt.Errorf("SubtitleProfile %s is at generation %d here, the task at %d",
      profile.Name, profile.Generation, t.ProfileGeneration))
    case profile.Generation > t.ProfileGeneration:
     return w.answer(ctx, t, dropped(outOf, fmt.Sprintf("SubtitleProfile %s changed since planned", profile.Name)))
    }
    flt, err := compileFilters(profile.Spec)
    if err != nil { // the profile reconciler marks it Invalid too (§2.13)
     return w.answer(ctx, t, verdict(schema.SubtitleVerdictFailed, outOf,
      fmt.Sprintf("subtitle profile %s is invalid: %v", profile.Name, err)))
    }
    local, err := datapath.Local(w.DataDir, t.Path)
    if err != nil {
     return events.Discard("fetch: media file path is not on the data volume", err)
    }
    st, err := os.Stat(local)
    if err != nil {
     return w.transient(ctx, m, t, outOf, fmt.Errorf("stat %s: %w", t.Path, err), statRetry)
    }
    if mediainfo.ProbeHash(t.Path, st.Size(), st.ModTime()) != t.ProbeHash {
     return w.answer(ctx, t, dropped(outOf, "file changed since planned"))
    }
    entries, err := w.Providers.Build(ctx, t.MediaFile.Namespace)
    if err != nil {
     return fmt.Errorf("fetch: %w", err)
    }
    entries = providerset.Order(entries, profile.Spec.Providers)
    q := buildQuery(ctx, t, local, st.Size(), wnt.key)
    src := providerset.FileSource{Path: local, Info: commonv1.MediaInfo{Subtitles: t.Extract},
     IgnoreASS: profile.Spec.Embedded.IgnoreASS, SkipCommentary: profile.Spec.Embedded.SkipCommentaryOrDefault()}
    provs, skipped := eligible(entries, src, kind, wnt, q, profile.Spec.Embedded.ExtractOrDefault() && len(t.Extract) > 0)
    plan := searchPlan{kind: kind, query: q, want: wnt, filters: flt, threshold: int(t.MinScore),
     providers: provs, skipped: skipped, mods: mods(profile.Spec.Mods), toSRT: !profile.Spec.OriginalFormat,
     hiExt: string(profile.Spec.HIExtension), mediaPath: t.Path, probeHash: t.ProbeHash,
     mode: cmp.Or(os.FileMode(t.SidecarMode), DefaultSidecarMode)}
    out, err := w.search(ctx, m, plan)
    if err != nil {
     var moved *movedError
     if errors.As(err, &moved) {
      return w.answer(ctx, t, dropped(outOf, moved.Error()))
     }
     var we *writeError
     if errors.As(err, &we) {
      return w.transient(ctx, m, t, outOf, err, 0)
     }
     return fmt.Errorf("fetch: %w", err)
    }
    return w.finish(ctx, t, plan, out, outOf)
   }
   ```

   `eligible`'s local-provider skip reason becomes `": embedded extraction is off or the task names
   no embedded track"`. `dropped(outOf, msg)` and `verdict(v, outOf, msg)` build a
   `schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict, ScoreOutOf: outOf, LastError: truncate(msg,
   schema.MaxSubtitleLastError)}`.

4. **`select.go`.** `wantFor(profile *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile, langKey string) (want,
   bool)` (the override argument goes with `spec.languages`, D16). `minScore`, `findItem`,
   `hasSubtitle` go (§6.7.2 step 8: the threshold and the on-disk subtitle come from the task).

5. **`query.go`.** `buildQuery(ctx context.Context, t schema.FetchTask, local string, size int64,
   key subtitles.LangKey) subtitles.Query` builds `subtitles.Query{Kind: t.Query.Kind, IDs:
   maps.Clone(t.Query.IDs), Title: t.Query.Title, Year: int(t.Query.Year), Season:
   int(t.Query.Season), Episode: int(t.Query.Episode), SizeBytes: size, Languages:
   []subtitles.LangKey{key}, Release: parsedRelease(t.Query.ReleaseTitle, t.Query.Kind)}` plus the
   moviehash exactly as today (query.go:117-129); `targetRelease` becomes `parsedRelease(title
   string, kind)`; `errItemGone`, the Movie/Episode/Series reads, `imdbNumber` and `setID` go.

6. **`search.go`.** `searchPlan` gains `probeHash string`. `writeSidecar` re-stats the video
   immediately before writing and refuses a moved or replaced one:

   ```go
   // movedError is a video that moved or changed while the providers were
   // asked: the answer is dropped rather than leaving a sidecar beside a stem
   // that is no longer the planned file (§6.7.3).
   type movedError struct{ path string }

   func (e *movedError) Error() string { return "video moved or replaced during the fetch: " + e.path }

   func (w *Worker) writeSidecar(ctx context.Context, p searchPlan, content []byte) (logical, rel string, err error) {
    video, err := datapath.Local(w.DataDir, p.mediaPath)
    if err != nil {
     return "", "", err
    }
    st, err := os.Stat(video)
    if err != nil || mediainfo.ProbeHash(p.mediaPath, st.Size(), st.ModTime()) != p.probeHash {
     return "", "", &movedError{path: p.mediaPath}
    }
    // From here on, today's writeSidecar body (search.go:446-457) unchanged:
    // SidecarName, the .ass rename, datapath.Local and subtitles.NewWriter().Write.
   }
   ```

   and `fetchBest` returns a `*movedError` from `writeSidecar` unchanged, as it returns a
   `*writeError`.

7. **`apply.go`.** `decide` and `explain` stay. `finish` answers:

   ```go
   func (w *Worker) finish(ctx context.Context, t schema.FetchTask, p searchPlan, out searchOutcome, outOf int32) error {
    onDisk := t.OnDisk != nil
    switch v := decide(out, len(p.providers), onDisk); v {
    case verdictKeep:
     return w.answer(ctx, t, schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictKept, ScoreOutOf: outOf})
    case verdictDownloaded:
     ch := out.chosen
     ans := schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, Score: int32(ch.r.score), //nolint:gosec // bounded by MaxScore
      ScoreOutOf: outOf, Provider: ch.entry.entry.Name, SubtitleID: truncate(subtitleID(ch.r.c), maxSubtitleID), Name: ch.relPath}
     if onDisk && t.OnDisk.Name != ch.relPath {
      ans.ReplacedName = t.OnDisk.Name
     }
     return w.answer(ctx, t, ans)
    case verdictThrottled:
     until := out.earliest
     return w.answer(ctx, t, schema.SubtitleRecord{Verdict: schema.SubtitleVerdictThrottled, ScoreOutOf: outOf,
      LastError: explain(v, out, p, outOf), ThrottledUntil: &until})
    case verdictFailed:
     return w.answer(ctx, t, verdict(schema.SubtitleVerdictFailed, outOf, explain(v, out, p, outOf)))
    default:
     return w.answer(ctx, t, verdict(schema.SubtitleVerdictUnavailable, outOf, explain(v, out, p, outOf)))
    }
   }

   // answer records ans and, only when it lands, removes a replaced sidecar,
   // counts the fetch and publishes the history event (§6.7.3-§6.7.4). An
   // answer the record's rules drop changes nothing: the sidecar a dropped
   // download wrote is found by the loop's next listing.
   func (w *Worker) answer(ctx context.Context, t schema.FetchTask, ans schema.SubtitleRecord) error {
    landed, err := w.Store.Answer(ctx, t, ans)
    if err != nil {
     return fmt.Errorf("fetch: answer: %w", err)
    }
    if !landed {
     logging.FromContext(ctx).Warn("fetch: superseded during the fetch; the answer is dropped", "verdict", ans.Verdict)
     return nil
    }
    if ans.ReplacedName != "" {
     w.removeReplaced(ctx, t.Path, ans.ReplacedName)
    }
    metrics.SubtitleFetchesTotal.WithLabelValues(cmp.Or(ans.Provider, "none"), baseLanguage(t.LangKey), string(ans.Verdict)).Inc()
    switch ans.Verdict {
    case schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded:
     action, prev := events.ActionDownloaded, int32(0)
     if t.OnDisk != nil {
      action, prev = events.ActionUpgraded, t.OnDisk.Score
     }
     w.publish(ctx, t, action, func(e *schema.SubtitleEvent) {
      e.Provider, e.ProviderID, e.Score, e.PreviousScore = ans.Provider, ans.SubtitleID, ans.Score, prev
      e.Path = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(t.Path), ans.Name)
     })
    case schema.SubtitleVerdictFailed:
     w.publish(ctx, t, events.ActionFailed, func(e *schema.SubtitleEvent) { e.Reason = ans.LastError })
    }
    return nil
   }
   ```

   `transient(ctx, m, t, outOf, cause, retryAfter)` redelivers as today and, on the final delivery,
   answers `verdict(schema.SubtitleVerdictFailed, outOf, fmt.Sprintf("gave up after %d
   deliveries: %v", m.Attempt(), cause))` (§4.8's last delivery). `removeReplaced(ctx, mediaPath,
   oldName)` keeps today's safety checks (a bare name, never `.`/`..`). `publish` builds
   `schema.SubtitleEvent{MediaFile: t.MediaFile, Seq: t.Seq, Action, LangKey: t.LangKey, At:
   w.now()}` under envelope ID `fmt.Sprintf("%s/subtitle/%s/%d/%s", t.MediaFile.UID, t.LangKey,
   t.Seq, action)` (§4.10's `<fileUID>/<remediation>/<sub>/<seq>/<action>`), `Type:
   schema.SubtitleEventType`, `Source: "agent-caption@" + version.String()`, on
   `events.SubtitleEventSubject(action, t.MediaFile.UID)`; best effort, as today. `baseLanguage`
   is the language half of `subtitles.ParseLangKey`. Delete `record`, `recordAttempts`,
   `recordFailure`, `clearCandidate`, `FieldManager` and the `app/caption/status` import.
   Delete `profile.go` and `mode.go`.

// TestCaptionarrWorkerIsRetired: the fetch worker answers in
// clustarr-subtitles and writes no Kubernetes object (loop spec §6.7.5), so
// captionarr-worker is retired and no longer validates.
func TestCaptionarrWorkerIsRetired(t *testing.T) {
 if slices.Contains(FieldManagers(), ManagerCaptionarrWorker) {
  t.Errorf("captionarr-worker is still a live field manager")
 }
 if !slices.Contains(RetiredFieldManagers(), ManagerCaptionarrWorker) {
  t.Errorf("captionarr-worker is not among the retired field managers")
 }
 if ManagerCaptionarrWorker.Validate() == nil {
  t.Errorf("captionarr-worker still validates: the fetch worker writes nothing (loop spec §6.7.5)")
 }
}

// TestRetiredFieldManagersStayValid: the fold retires two managers; only
// catalogarr-markers, which release N's one release apply still writes as
// (§7.3.8), validates; captionarr-worker does not (F5.3). F9.4 empties the
// list and deletes this test.
func TestRetiredFieldManagersStayValid(t *testing.T) {
 want := []FieldManager{ManagerCatalogarrMarkers, ManagerCaptionarrWorker}
 if got := RetiredFieldManagers(); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
  t.Errorf("retired managers = %v, want %v", got, want)
 }
 for _, m := range RetiredFieldManagers() {
  if slices.Contains(FieldManagers(), m) {
   t.Errorf("%s is both live and retired", m)
  }
 }
 if err := ManagerCatalogarrMarkers.Validate(); err != nil {
  t.Errorf("catalogarr-markers must validate in release N: %v", err)
 }
}

   ```go
   // SubtitleProfile indexes a MediaFile by the SubtitleProfile its subtitles
   // block was planned with, and by profile and phase (loop spec §3.16).
   const SubtitleProfile = "remediation.mediafile.subtitleProfile"

   func SubtitleProfileValues(o client.Object) []string {
    mf, ok := o.(*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile)
    if !ok || mf.Status.Subtitles == nil || mf.Status.Subtitles.Profile == "" {
     return nil
    }
    s := mf.Status.Subtitles
    return []string{s.Profile, s.Profile + "/" + string(s.Phase)}
   }

   // RegisterSubtitleProfile is called by the slim SubtitleProfile reconciler,
   // the index's one reader, so app/caption/manager starts without the loop.
   func RegisterSubtitleProfile(ctx context.Context, idx client.FieldIndexer) error {
    return idx.IndexField(ctx, &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{}, SubtitleProfile, SubtitleProfileValues)
   }
   ```

3. **`subtitleprofile/wake.go`.**

   ```go
   // WakeDebounce is how often the loop's signals reach the reconciler (§2.13).
   const WakeDebounce = 10 * time.Second

   // Wake is the loop's subtitleProfileWake (loop spec §2.13, §3.3 S1'): a
   // file's winning SubtitleProfile or its subtitles phase changed. Signals
   // inside one debounce make one event, which re-counts every profile. It is
   // one of the two MediaFile-driven channels TestOnlyTheLoopWatchesMediaFile
   // allows outside the loop.
   type Wake struct {
    pending  atomic.Bool
    events   chan event.GenericEvent
    debounce time.Duration
   }

   func NewWake(debounce time.Duration) *Wake {
    return &Wake{events: make(chan event.GenericEvent, 1), debounce: debounce}
   }

   // Signal never blocks: the loop calls it from its event handler.
   func (w *Wake) Signal() { w.pending.Store(true) }

   func (w *Wake) Channel() <-chan event.GenericEvent { return w.events }

   func (w *Wake) NeedLeaderElection() bool { return true }

   func (w *Wake) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
    t := time.NewTicker(w.debounce)
    defer t.Stop()
    for {
     select {
     case <-ctx.Done():
      return nil
     case <-t.C:
      if w.pending.Swap(false) {
       select {
       case w.events <- event.GenericEvent{Object: &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile{}}:
       default: // one already queued: it re-counts everything anyway
       }
      }
     }
    }
   }
   ```

4. **`subtitleprofile/controller.go`**, the slim reconciler (§2.13). The package doc says it writes
   only SubtitleProfile status and never watches MediaFile. Its RBAC block becomes:

   ```go
   // +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=subtitle.clustarr.io,resources=subtitleprofiles,verbs=get;list;watch
   // +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=subtitle.clustarr.io,resources=subtitleprofiles/status,verbs=get;update;patch
   // +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=catalog.clustarr.io,resources=mediafiles,verbs=get;list;watch
   // +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=events.k8s.io,resources=events,verbs=create;patch
   ```

   ```go
   type Reconciler struct {
    client.Client
    Recorder events.EventRecorder
   }

   func NewReconciler(c client.Client, recorder events.EventRecorder) *Reconciler {
    return &Reconciler{Client: c, Recorder: recorder}
   }

   func (r *Reconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, req reconcile.Request) (ctrl.Result, error) {
    ctx, span := tracing.Start(ctx, "subtitleprofile.Reconcile")
    defer span.End()
    var sp subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile
    if err := r.Get(ctx, req.NamespacedName, &sp); err != nil {
     return ctrl.Result{}, client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
    }
    if k8s.IsDeleting(&sp) {
     return ctrl.Result{}, nil
    }
    var profiles subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfileList
    if err := r.List(ctx, &profiles, client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy); err != nil {
     return ctrl.Result{}, fmt.Errorf("subtitleprofile: list SubtitleProfiles: %w", err)
    }
    invalid, reason, message := validateProfile(&sp, profiles.Items)
    var planned catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
    if err := r.List(ctx, &planned, client.MatchingFields{mfindex.SubtitleProfile: sp.Name}, client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy); err != nil {
     return ctrl.Result{}, fmt.Errorf("subtitleprofile: list the files planned with %s: %w", sp.Name, err)
    }
    overlapped, err := r.overlapped(ctx, &sp, profiles.Items)
    if err != nil {
     return ctrl.Result{}, err
    }

    next := sp.Status.DeepCopy()
    next.ObservedGeneration, next.MatchingFiles, next.WantedKeys = sp.Generation, int32(len(planned.Items)), wantedKeys(sp.Spec) //nolint:gosec // bounded by the library
    conds := next.Conditions
    if invalid {
     k8s.MarkTrue(&sp, &conds, subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfileConditionInvalid, reason, "%s", message)
     k8s.MarkReady(&sp, &conds, false, reason, "%s", message)
    } else {
     k8s.MarkFalse(&sp, &conds, subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfileConditionInvalid, k8s.ReasonReconciled, "profile is valid")
     k8s.MarkReady(&sp, &conds, true, k8s.ReasonReconciled, "%d file(s) planned with this profile", next.MatchingFiles)
    }
    if overlapped {
     k8s.MarkTrue(&sp, &conds, ConditionOverlap, ReasonSelectorOverlap,
      "this profile's selector also matches file(s) a higher-priority profile wins")
    } else {
     k8s.MarkFalse(&sp, &conds, ConditionOverlap, ReasonNoOverlap, "no selector overlap with another profile")
    }
    next.Conditions = conds
    if equality.Semantic.DeepEqual(*next, sp.Status) {
     return ctrl.Result{}, nil // §2.13: an unchanged apply is skipped
    }
    if invalid && r.Recorder != nil {
     r.Recorder.Eventf(&sp, nil, "Warning", reason, "Reconcile", message)
    }
    return ctrl.Result{}, captionstatus.PatchProfile(ctx, r.Client, k8s.ManagerCaptionarr, &sp,
     func(ac *subtitleac.SubtitleProfileStatusApplyConfiguration) {
      ac.WithObservedGeneration(next.ObservedGeneration).WithMatchingFiles(next.MatchingFiles).
       WithWantedKeys(next.WantedKeys...).WithConditions(k8s.ConditionACs(conds)...)
     })
   }

   // overlapped is §2.13's Overlap: a selector pass over the cached video
   // files' labels, true when another profile wins a file sp's selector matches.
   func (r *Reconciler) overlapped(ctx context.Context, sp *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile,
    profiles []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile,
   ) (bool, error) {
    if sp.Spec.Selector == nil {
     return false, nil
    }
    var files catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
    if err := r.List(ctx, &files, client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy); err != nil {
     return false, fmt.Errorf("subtitleprofile: list MediaFiles: %w", err)
    }
    for i := range files.Items {
     mf := &files.Items[i]
     if !subtitleplan.EligibleKind(mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind) || !subtitleplan.SelectorMatches(sp, mf.Labels) {
      continue
     }
     if w := subtitleplan.WinningProfile(mf.Labels, profiles); w != nil && w.Name != sp.Name {
      return true, nil
     }
    }
    return false, nil
   }

   // SetupWithManager registers the controller (name subtitleprofile, kept,
   // D29) and the index it counts through. Its triggers are its own
   // generation, any profile's generation (a second default and an overlap
   // converge across profiles), and the loop's Wake.
   func (r *Reconciler) SetupWithManager(mgr ctrl.Manager, wake *Wake) error {
    if err := mfindex.RegisterSubtitleProfile(context.Background(), mgr.GetFieldIndexer()); err != nil {
     return err
    }
    all := handler.EnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(r.mapAllProfiles)
    return ctrl.NewControllerManagedBy(mgr).
     Named("subtitleprofile").
     For(&subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile{}, builder.WithPredicates(k8s.GenerationChanged())).
     Watches(&subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleProfile{}, all, builder.WithPredicates(k8s.GenerationChanged())).
     WatchesRawSource(source.Channel(wake.Channel(), all)).
     WithOptions(controller.Options{RecoverPanic: new(true), ReconciliationTimeout: 5 * time.Minute}).
     Complete(r)
   }
   ```

   // ReasonInvalidFilter is Invalid's reason when a mustContain or
   // mustNotContain pattern does not compile under regexp2 (§2.13), which the
   // fetch worker could only report per task.
   const ReasonInvalidFilter = "InvalidFilter"

    for field, patterns := range map[string][]string{"mustContain": sp.Spec.MustContain, "mustNotContain": sp.Spec.MustNotContain} {
     for _, p := range patterns {
      if _, err := regexp2.Compile(p, regexp2.IgnoreCase); err != nil {
       return true, ReasonInvalidFilter, fmt.Sprintf("%s %q does not compile: %v", field, p, err)

7. **`app/caption/manager/register.go`.**

   ```go
   type Options struct {
    k8s.Options
    // ProfileWake is the loop's subtitleProfileWake; internal/cli/manager
    // hands the same Wake to the remediation loop.
    ProfileWake *subtitleprofile.Wake
   }

   func Register(mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) error {
    if bus == nil {
     return errors.New("caption manager: Register needs the bus")
    }
    if o.ProfileWake == nil {
     return errors.New("caption manager: Register needs the SubtitleProfile wake the loop signals")
    }
    c := mgr.GetClient()
    if err := mgr.Add(o.ProfileWake); err != nil {
     return err
    }
    if err := subtitleprofile.NewReconciler(c, mgr.GetEventRecorder("subtitleprofile")).SetupWithManager(mgr, o.ProfileWake); err != nil {
     return fmt.Errorf("captionarr: subtitleprofile: %w", err)
    }
    if err := mgr.Add(&subtitleprofile.Bootstrap{Client: c, Namespace: o.Namespace}); err != nil {
     return fmt.Errorf("captionarr: subtitleprofile bootstrap: %w", err)
    }
    provider := subtitleprovider.NewReconciler(c, bus.KV(events.BucketProviderThrottle), mgr.GetEventRecorder("subtitleprovider"))
    provider.Secrets = mgr.GetAPIReader()
    if err := provider.SetupWithManager(mgr); err != nil {
     return fmt.Errorf("captionarr: subtitleprovider: %w", err)
    }
    return nil
   }
   ```

    ```go
    // channelRow is one raw channel source allowed outside the loop.
    type channelRow struct {
     mediaFile bool   // a MediaFile-driven wake: loop spec §3.20 allows two
     why       string // what feeds the channel, or the fold task that deletes it
    }

    // channelSources are the source.Channel and source.TypedChannel calls
    // allowed outside the loop, by package and by the channel the call passes
    // (go/types' ExprString of its first argument). A reconciler fed from a
    // channel takes wakes the For/Watches scan cannot attribute, so every such
    // call outside the loop is a row: the two MediaFile-driven wakes D3 keeps
    // outside the loop, subtitleProfileWake and ledger.profileWake (F6.3), and
    // channels no MediaFile handler feeds. A row that stops matching fails, as
    // mediaFileWatchers' rows do.
    var channelSources = map[string]map[string]channelRow{
     "app/caption/controller/subtitleprofile": {
      "wake.Channel()": {mediaFile: true, why: "subtitleProfileWake: the loop's S1' signals it (loop spec §2.13, §3.20)"},
     },
     "app/squash/controller/transcodejob": {
      "r.wake": {why: "the results consumer's admission wake; F6.6 deletes it with the controller"},
     },
    }

    // inLoop reports whether dir is one of loopHomes or under one.
    func inLoop(dir string) bool {
     for h := range loopHomes {
      if dir == h || strings.HasPrefix(dir, h+"/") {
       return true
      }
     }
     return false
    }

    // channelSourceSites maps each package outside the loop to the channel
    // expressions its source.Channel and source.TypedChannel calls pass.
    func channelSourceSites(files map[string]*ast.File) map[string][]string {
     out := map[string][]string{}
     for path, f := range files {
      src := importAlias(f, "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/source", "source")
      dir := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(path))
      if src == "" || inLoop(dir) {
       continue
      }
      ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
       call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
       if !ok || len(call.Args) == 0 {
        return true
       }
       fun := call.Fun
       switch g := fun.(type) { // source.TypedChannel[O, R](...)
       case *ast.IndexExpr:
        fun = g.X
       case *ast.IndexListExpr:
        fun = g.X
       }
       if isSelector(fun, src, "Channel") || isSelector(fun, src, "TypedChannel") {
        out[dir] = append(out[dir], types.ExprString(call.Args[0]))
       }
       return true
      })
     }
     return out
    }

    // checkChannelSources is the guard's channel half (loop spec §3.20): every
    // raw channel source outside the loop is a row of channelSources, at most
    // two rows are MediaFile-driven, and no row is stale.
    func checkChannelSources(t *testing.T, files map[string]*ast.File) {
     sites := channelSourceSites(files)
     for _, dir := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(sites)) {
      for _, e := range sites[dir] {
       _, ok := channelSources[dir][e]
       assert.True(t, ok, "%s feeds a controller from the channel %s: outside the loop only subtitleProfileWake and ledger.profileWake may carry MediaFile-driven wakes (loop spec §3.20); move the wake into the loop's sources, or add a row saying what feeds it", dir, e)
      }
     }
     var mediaFileWakes int
     for _, dir := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(channelSources)) {
      for e, row := range channelSources[dir] {
       assert.Contains(t, sites[dir], e, "%s no longer passes %s to a channel source: delete its row (%s)", dir, e, row.why)
       if row.mediaFile {
        mediaFileWakes++
       }
      }
     }
     assert.LessOrEqual(t, mediaFileWakes, 2, "loop spec §3.20 allows two MediaFile-driven wakes outside the loop")
    }
    ```

const nonce = "1759752000"

func TestForcedSearchIsHandledOnce(t *testing.T) {
 in := fixture()
 in.BacklogOpen, in.PacerSlot = false, time.Time{}
 in.ForceNonce = nonce
 d := Plan(in, issuer(0))
 assert.Equal(t, nonce, d.HandledNonce, "recorded in the apply that renders the forced dispatch")
 require.Len(t, d.Dispatches, 1)
 assert.Equal(t, PriorityHigh, d.Dispatches[0].Priority)
 assert.True(t, d.Dispatches[0].Task.Forced)
 assert.Equal(t, Need{List: true, Records: []string{"de"}}, Needs(in), "a forced search lists first and reserves no slot")

 in = withBlock(in, d.Block)
 in.File.Status.HandledNonces = &catalogv1alpha1.HandledNonces{SubtitleSearch: nonce}
 d = Plan(in, issuer(d.Dispatches[0].Seq))
 assert.Empty(t, d.Dispatches, "a nonce already handled dispatches nothing")
 assert.Equal(t, nonce, d.HandledNonce)
}

func TestTheBacklogGateDefersScheduledNotForced(t *testing.T) {
 in := fixture()
 in.BacklogOpen = false
 assert.Empty(t, Plan(in, issuer(0)).Dispatches, "scheduled: deferred")
 in.ForceNonce = nonce
 d := Plan(in, issuer(0))
 require.Len(t, d.Dispatches, 1, "forced: the high lane bypasses the gate")
 assert.Equal(t, PriorityHigh, d.Dispatches[0].Priority)
}

func TestAForcedSearchSupersedesADispatchInFlight(t *testing.T) {
 in := fixture()
 in = withBlock(in, &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{
  Phase: catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSearching, Profile: "default", ProbeHash: "hash-1",
  Wanted: []string{"de"}, Items: []catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus{searching(100, now.Add(-time.Minute))},
 })
 in.File.Status.LastSeq = 100
 in.Records["de"] = entry(3, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) { r.Seq, r.State = 100, records.StateRequested })
 in.ForceNonce = nonce
 d := Plan(in, issuer(100))
 require.Len(t, d.Dispatches, 1)
 x := d.Dispatches[0]
 assert.Greater(t, x.Seq, int64(100))
 assert.Equal(t, uint64(3), x.Revision)
 assert.Zero(t, d.Block.Items[0].Dispatch.AnsweredSeq, "the superseded dispatch stays unclosed: its answer can still be taken")
}

// TestAForcedSearchRacingAnInFlightAnswerKeepsBoth is §6.6's race row: the
// forced Request missed its CAS because the old task's answer landed between
// Gather and the Request. The next pass takes the answer, keeps the forced
// sequence, and owes its request; the nonce, recorded in the first apply,
// dispatches nothing more.
func TestAForcedSearchRacingAnInFlightAnswerKeepsBoth(t *testing.T) {
 in := fixture()
 forced := searching(5000, now.Add(-10*time.Second))
 forced.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq = 0
 in = withBlock(in, &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{
  Phase: catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSearching, Profile: "default", ProbeHash: "hash-1",
  Wanted: []string{"de"}, Items: []catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus{forced},
 })
 in.File.Status.LastSeq = 5000
 in.File.Status.HandledNonces = &catalogv1alpha1.HandledNonces{SubtitleSearch: nonce}
 in.ForceNonce = nonce
 answeredAt := now.Add(-5 * time.Second)
 in.Listing = &Listing{Names: []string{videoName, deName}}
 in.Records["de"] = entry(4, func(r *schema.SubtitleRecord) {
  r.Seq, r.State, r.AnsweredAt = 100, records.StateAnswered, &answeredAt
  r.Verdict, r.Score, r.ScoreOutOf, r.Name = schema.SubtitleVerdictDownloaded, 140, 180, deName
 })
 d := Plan(in, issuer(5000))
 it := d.Block.Items[0]
 assert.Equal(t, int32(140), it.Score, "the answer is incorporated")
 assert.Equal(t, deName, it.Name)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(5000), it.Dispatch.Seq, "the forced sequence is kept")
 require.Len(t, d.Dispatches, 1)
 assert.Equal(t, Dispatch{LangKey: "de", Seq: 5000, Record: true, Revision: 4, IncorporatedThrough: 100,
  Priority: PriorityLow, Task: d.Dispatches[0].Task}, d.Dispatches[0], "the owed request, never a new sequence")
}

func TestAForcedNonceWaitsOutABlock(t *testing.T) {
 in := fixture()
 in.Profiles = nil
 in.ForceNonce = nonce
 d := Plan(in, issuer(0))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseBlocked, d.Block.Phase)
 assert.Empty(t, d.HandledNonce, "still pending")
 in.Profiles = fixture().Profiles
 in = withBlock(in, d.Block)

}

func TestAnInvalidNonceIsRecordedWithAWarning(t *testing.T) {

 in.File.Status.HandledNonces = &catalogv1alpha1.HandledNonces{SubtitleSearch: d.HandledNonce}

}

func TestNothingToSearchIsRecorded(t *testing.T) {

// TestTheDLQProjectorMayAnnotateAMediaFile pins §6.10: FetchTask and

// projector's merge patch needs the grant. Read from the package's own

   // nonceFormat is loop spec §2.9's nonce: a letter or digit, then up to 62
   // letters, digits, dots, underscores or dashes.
   var nonceFormat = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,62}$`)

   // ValidNonce reports whether v is a one-shot intent annotation's nonce
   // (subtitle.clustarr.io/search, transcode.clustarr.io/retry and /cancel).
   func ValidNonce(v string) bool { return nonceFormat.MatchString(v) }

   No marker, no type: `make generate` changes nothing (`git diff --exit-code -- api config`

2. **`subtitleplan/plan.go`.** Constants and the nonce state:

   ```go
   const (
    EventInvalidAnnotation = "InvalidAnnotation"
    EventNothingToSearch   = "NothingToSearch"
   )

   // invalidMark is what an invalid nonce is recorded as: handledNonces holds
   // 63 characters of the nonce format, which the value itself may not fit.
   func invalidMark(v string) string {
    h := fnv.New32a()
    _, _ = h.Write([]byte(v))
    return fmt.Sprintf("invalid-%08x", h.Sum32())
   }

   // force reads subtitle.clustarr.io/search against the handled nonce (§6.5):
   // pending when set and not yet handled; invalid when it is not a nonce.
   func (p *pass) force() (pending, invalid bool) {
    v := p.in.ForceNonce
    if v == "" || v == p.d.HandledNonce || invalidMark(v) == p.d.HandledNonce {
     return false, false
    }
    return true, !catalogv1alpha1.ValidNonce(v)
   }
   ```

   `pass` gains `forced, forcedAny bool`. In `run`, after the hold check and before the profile:

   ```go
    switch pending, invalid := p.force(); {
    case pending && invalid:
     // Recorded at once, warned once: there is nothing to honour (§2.9).
     p.d.HandledNonce = invalidMark(in.ForceNonce)
     p.d.Events = append(p.d.Events, Event{Type: "Warning", Reason: EventInvalidAnnotation,
      Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s=%q is not a nonce (%s)", catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationSubtitleSearch, in.ForceNonce, nonceFormatText)})
    case pending:
     p.forced = true // honoured by plan(); a Blocked or held file leaves it pending
    }
   ```

   (`nonceFormatText` is the literal `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,62}$`.) The list gate becomes
   `if p.listGateOpen() || p.forced { p.askList() }` (forced dispatches list first, §6.5). At the
   top of `consider`:

   ```go
    if p.forced && (p.want[it.LangKey] || upgradeCandidate(now, *it, p.cad)) {
     // §6.5: every wanted language and every upgrade candidate now, in
     // flight or not, on the high lane, past the backlog gate and the
     // pacer. A dispatch in flight is superseded by the new sequence; its
     // worker finds the newer record and acks.
     e, _ := p.record(it.LangKey)
     p.dispatch(it, e, !p.want[it.LangKey], true)
     p.forcedAny = true
     return true
    }
   ```

   and after the loop:

   ```go
    if p.forced {
     p.d.HandledNonce = in.ForceNonce // in the same apply as the forced dispatches (§6.5)
     if !p.forcedAny {
      p.d.Events = append(p.d.Events, Event{Type: "Normal", Reason: EventNothingToSearch,
       Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s: no language is wanted or upgradable", catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationSubtitleSearch, in.ForceNonce)})
     }
    }
   ```

   `dispatch` with `forced` true keeps the item's `AnsweredSeq` (the superseded dispatch stays
   unclosed, so §6.6's race row can take its answer). A forced `Dispatch` has `New: true` and
   `Task.Forced: true`. In `incorporate`'s `requested`-at-`d.Seq` case the republish condition gains
   `&& !p.forced`: a forced pass supersedes the dispatch in flight instead of republishing it.

3. **`app/remediation/subtitles/adapter.go`.** `Gather` sets `in.ForceNonce =

   `d.HandledNonce` through `setNonce` and converts `d.Events` (F5.1). The loop writes no
