2. **`fileview.go`:**

```go
// FileView is one file as the ledger counts it (§5.5), built from the
// applied status (or a quorum read), never from a stale cache.
type FileView struct {
 UID           types.UID
 Key           types.NamespacedName
 Seq           int64 // status.lastSeq: orders every observation, an absent block included
 Phase         catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase // "" when there is no block
 DispatchSeq   int64
 Class         transcodev1alpha1.Hardware
 Pool          string
 Profile       string
 ProfileUID    types.UID
 PlannedAt     time.Time
 NextAttemptAt time.Time
 Suspended     bool
 Priority      int32
 Hardware      transcodev1alpha1.Hardware
 Encodes       bool   // the plan's mode is transcode
 Encoder       string // classFor's input
 Fallback      bool
 JoinedGraft   bool   // transcode.joinedGraft names the in-flight dispatch (F7.2 reads it)
 GraftPhase    catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase
 Eligible      bool
 EligibleKnown bool // false when the transcode planner failed this pass: keep the last answer
 VerdictHolds  bool // a Skipped or Failed block for the current (tag, probe)
}

// rank orders observations of one seq (§5.5): Queued < Running < the rest.
func rank(p catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase) int {
 switch p {
 case catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued:
  return 1
 case catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning:
  return 2
 }
 return 3
}

func windowPhase(p catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase) bool {
 switch p {
 case catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePending, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued,
  catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping:
  return true
 }
 return false
}

func slotPhase(p catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase) bool {
 return p == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued || p == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
}

// FileViewOf renders the view of a file from its status and the transcode
// planner's eligibility this pass (nil: the planner failed; the ledger keeps
// its last answer). ProfileUID is filled by the ledger from the profiles it
// was last given.
func FileViewOf(mf metav1.Object, st *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus, e *transcodeplan.Eligibility) FileView {
 v := FileView{UID: mf.GetUID(), Key: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: mf.GetNamespace(), Name: mf.GetName()}, Seq: st.LastSeq}
 if e != nil {
  v.Eligible, v.EligibleKnown = e.Eligible, true
  if e.Profile != nil {
   v.Profile, v.Priority, v.Hardware = e.Profile.Name, e.Profile.Spec.Priority, e.Profile.Spec.Hardware
  }
 }
 if b := st.Transcode; b != nil {
  v.Phase = b.Phase
  if b.Profile != "" {
   v.Profile = b.Profile
  }
  v.Class, v.Pool, v.Suspended = transcodev1alpha1.Hardware(b.Class), b.Pool, b.Suspended
  if b.Priority != 0 {
   v.Priority = b.Priority
  }
  if b.Hardware != "" {
   v.Hardware = transcodev1alpha1.Hardware(b.Hardware)
  }
  if b.PlannedAt != nil {
   v.PlannedAt = b.PlannedAt.Time
  }
  if b.NextAttemptAt != nil {
   v.NextAttemptAt = b.NextAttemptAt.Time
  }
  if b.Dispatch != nil {
   v.DispatchSeq = b.Dispatch.Seq
  }
  if b.Plan != nil {
   v.Encodes, v.Encoder = b.Plan.Mode == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeModeTranscode, b.Plan.Encoder
  }
  v.Fallback = b.FallbackReason != ""
  v.JoinedGraft = b.JoinedGraft != nil && b.Dispatch != nil && b.Dispatch.Seq > b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq
  v.VerdictHolds = e != nil && (b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSkipped || b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseFailed) &&
   b.ProfileHash == e.Hash && b.ProbeHash == st.ProbeHash
 }
 if st.Graft != nil {
  v.GraftPhase = st.Graft.Phase
 }
 return v
}
```

1. **`ledger.go`** (§5.5's struct; one mutex; every method O(1) except `Pass`):

```go
const (
 GrantPriority     = 100
 grantTTL          = 2 * time.Minute
 grantBackoffMax   = 30 * time.Minute
 admissionBackstop = time.Minute
 ledgerResync      = 5 * time.Minute // withdraw.go:57's sweep cadence
)

type Options struct {
 Slots  map[string]int32 // --slots
 Window int              // --job-window; 0 is unlimited (§5.11)
 Clock  clockwork.Clock  // nil: the real clock
}

type Snapshot = transcodeplan.Ledger

type entry struct {
 view       FileView
 observedAt time.Time
}

type grant struct {
 kind    transcodeplan.GrantKind
 class   transcodev1alpha1.Hardware
 profile string
 expires time.Time
 inUse   bool
}

type backoff struct {
 until time.Time
 delay time.Duration
}

type Ledger struct {
 mu                sync.Mutex
 o                 Options
 clock             clockwork.Clock
 files             map[types.UID]*entry
 byKey             map[types.NamespacedName]types.UID
 grants            map[types.UID]*grant
 backoffs          map[types.UID]backoff
 directives        map[types.UID]transcodeplan.Directive
 pools             map[pool.Key]*PoolState
 devices           map[transcodev1alpha1.Hardware]transcodeplan.Device
 waitReason        map[types.UID]string
 leaseMissingSince map[types.UID]time.Time
 profileUIDs       map[string]types.UID
 rebuilt           bool
 waker             func(types.NamespacedName, int) // LoopSource's; nil until the loop starts
 wake              chan event.GenericEvent          // the admission pass, buffer 1
 profileWake       chan event.GenericEvent          // the slim TranscodeProfile reconciler, buffer 64
}

func NewLedger(o Options) *Ledger {
 clk := o.Clock
 if clk == nil {
  clk = clockwork.NewRealClock()
 }
 return &Ledger{o: o, clock: clk, files: map[types.UID]*entry{}, byKey: map[types.NamespacedName]types.UID{},
  grants: map[types.UID]*grant{}, backoffs: map[types.UID]backoff{}, directives: map[types.UID]transcodeplan.Directive{},
  pools: map[pool.Key]*PoolState{}, devices: map[transcodev1alpha1.Hardware]transcodeplan.Device{},
  waitReason: map[types.UID]string{}, leaseMissingSince: map[types.UID]time.Time{}, profileUIDs: map[string]types.UID{},
  wake: make(chan event.GenericEvent, 1), profileWake: make(chan event.GenericEvent, 64)}
}

// Observe merges one view: it replaces the entry only when (Seq, rank) is
// lexicographically >= the entry's (§5.5), so a stale view never frees a
// slot. A view whose UID differs from the one recorded under its key
// retires the old UID's entry (a file deleted and recreated under its name).
func (l *Ledger) Observe(v FileView) {
 l.mu.Lock()
 defer l.mu.Unlock()
 if old, ok := l.byKey[v.Key]; ok && old != v.UID {
  l.retireLocked(old)
 }
 cur, ok := l.files[v.UID]
 if ok && (v.Seq < cur.view.Seq || (v.Seq == cur.view.Seq && rank(v.Phase) < rank(cur.view.Phase))) {
  return
 }
 if ok && !v.EligibleKnown {
  v.Eligible, v.EligibleKnown = cur.view.Eligible, cur.view.EligibleKnown
 }
 if v.ProfileUID == "" {
  v.ProfileUID = l.profileUIDs[v.Profile]
 }
 l.files[v.UID] = &entry{view: v, observedAt: l.clock.Now()}
 l.byKey[v.Key] = v.UID
 if slotPhase(v.Phase) || windowPhase(v.Phase) {
  if g := l.grants[v.UID]; g != nil && !g.inUse {
   delete(l.grants, v.UID) // the place is held by the block now
  }
 }
 l.signalLocked()
}

// Forget handles a NotFound pass: it drops the key's entry and its grant,
// and reports the UID it held and whether that file had a dispatch in
// flight or a window grant, for withdrawAll (F6.5).
func (l *Ledger) Forget(key types.NamespacedName) (types.UID, bool) {
 l.mu.Lock()
 defer l.mu.Unlock()
 uid, ok := l.byKey[key]
 if !ok {
  return "", false
 }
 e := l.files[uid]
 open := (e != nil && slotPhase(e.view.Phase)) || l.grants[uid] != nil
 l.retireLocked(uid)
 l.signalLocked()
 return uid, open
}

// retireLocked drops every trace of uid: entry, key, grant, backoff,
// directive, wait reason and lease note.
func (l *Ledger) retireLocked(uid types.UID) {
 if e := l.files[uid]; e != nil {
  delete(l.byKey, e.view.Key)
 }
 delete(l.files, uid)
 delete(l.grants, uid)
 delete(l.backoffs, uid)
 delete(l.directives, uid)
 delete(l.waitReason, uid)
 delete(l.leaseMissingSince, uid)
}

// Snapshot is the file's admission state for the planner: its grant (kind
// and class), its directive, the wait reason admission wants written, and
// the device of the granted class.
func (l *Ledger) Snapshot(uid types.UID) Snapshot {
 l.mu.Lock()
 defer l.mu.Unlock()
 var s Snapshot
 if g := l.grants[uid]; g != nil && (g.inUse || l.clock.Now().Before(g.expires)) {
  s.Grant, s.Class, s.Device = g.kind, g.class, l.devices[g.class]
 }
 if d, ok := l.directives[uid]; ok {
  s.Directive = &d
 }
 s.WaitReason = l.waitReason[uid]
 return s
}

// signalLocked wakes the admission pass (non-blocking, buffer 1).
func (l *Ledger) signalLocked() {
 select {
 case l.wake <- event.GenericEvent{}:
 default:
 }
}
```

   `grants.go`: `TakeGrant(uid) (Snapshot, bool)` (marks in use), `Confirm(uid, seq int64)` (drops
   the grant; for a dispatch grant the `Observe` of the Queued block now holds the slot),
   `Release(uid)` (drops it, wakes admission), `ReleaseUnconfirmed(uid)` (the loop's deferred
   release: drops an in-use grant `Confirm` did not reach), `expireLocked(now)` (an unconsumed
   grant past `expires` is dropped and its file backs off 1 minute, doubling to `grantBackoffMax`).
   `window.go`: `open(profile) int` (window-phase entries plus outstanding window grants),
   `Open(profile)` (exported for tests and status), `backlogLocked(profile) []*entry` (eligible
   entries with no window phase, no current verdict and no grant, ordered by priority descending,
   then `namespace/name`), `Backlog(profile) int`, `fillWindowLocked(now)`.
   `class.go`: `assignClasses` re-typed from `transcodejob.(*Reconciler).assignClasses` onto
   `[]candidate{uid types.UID; v FileView; slot Slot}`, with `classFor` re-typed from
   `transcodejob.classFor` (`pinnedGPU` from `v.Hardware`, `HardwareForEncoder(v.Encoder)` otherwise,
   cpu on `v.Fallback`), `choosesClass` (`auto` or `gpu`), `gpuOnly` (`gpu`).
   `pools.go`:

```go
// PoolState is what the ledger keeps of one pool between passes: the held
// message, unschedulable-until, the recreation backoff and the recreate mark
// (transcodejob.Reconciler's recreate, poolBackoff and unschedulable maps).
type PoolState struct {
 Held               string
 UnschedulableUntil time.Time
 FailedAt, BackoffUntil time.Time
 BackoffDelay       time.Duration
 Recreate           bool
}

// DispatchedPerPool is the confirmed dispatches (Queued and Running
// entries) of pool k; ok is false until the ledger is rebuilt (§5.12).
func (l *Ledger) DispatchedPerPool(k pool.Key) (int32, bool)

func (l *Ledger) SetUnschedulable(k pool.Key, until time.Time)
func (l *Ledger) PoolState(k pool.Key) PoolState
func (l *Ledger) UpdatePool(k pool.Key, f func(*PoolState))
func (l *Ledger) ProfileWake() <-chan event.GenericEvent
```

   `pass.go` (§5.7 steps 2-10; no apiserver request):

```go
type ProfileView struct {
 Name          string
 UID           types.UID
 Priority      int32
 MaxConcurrent int32
 Hardware      transcodev1alpha1.Hardware
}

type PassInputs struct {
 Profiles  map[string]ProfileView
 GPUNodes  map[transcodev1alpha1.Hardware]bool
 Devices   map[transcodev1alpha1.Hardware]transcodeplan.Device
 Unhealthy map[transcodev1alpha1.Hardware]string
 Held      map[pool.Key]string // holding(), re-typed from transcodejob/pools.go:167-192
}

type PassResult struct{ RequeueAfter time.Duration }

func (l *Ledger) Pass(in PassInputs) PassResult {
 l.mu.Lock()
 defer l.mu.Unlock()
 now := l.clock.Now()
 l.devices, l.profileUIDs = in.Devices, uidsOf(in.Profiles)
 l.expireLocked(now)
 if !l.rebuilt {
  return PassResult{RequeueAfter: admissionBackstop} // §5.6 step 4: no grant before the rebuild
 }
 l.rerouteLocked(in, now)                  // step 2: Directive{Reroute, Seq, Reason, KeepGPU}
 cands, running := l.candidatesLocked(in, now) // steps 4-5
 queued, holds := assignClasses(cands, running, in.GPUNodes, l.unschedulableLocked(in, now), in.Held,
  profileLimits(in.Profiles), l.o.Slots)                                  // step 6, re-typed
 admitted := Admit(slotsOf(queued), running, Budget{Slots: l.o.Slots, ProfileLimits: profileLimits(in.Profiles)})
 l.grantDispatchLocked(admitted, now)      // step 7
 l.waitReasonsLocked(queued, admitted, holds) // step 7: enqueue only on change
 l.fillWindowLocked(now)                   // step 8
 l.metricsLocked()                         // step 10: setActive, backlog gauge, profileWake on a changed per-pool count
 return PassResult{RequeueAfter: l.nextWakeLocked(now)}
}
```

   Each `…Locked` step is the named step of §5.7 and of today's `admit` (transcodejob/controller.go:673-813)
   re-typed onto entries; a grant enqueues the file through `l.waker(key, GrantPriority)`, and
   `metricsLocked` is `setActive` (transcodejob/metrics.go:42-59) over in-flight entries plus
   dispatch grants, plus `metrics.TranscodeBacklogFiles.WithLabelValues(profile).Set(backlog)`.

1. **`rebuild.go`** (§5.6):

```go
type RebuildInputs struct {
 APIReader  client.Reader // quorum reads
 Cache      client.Reader // the manager cache: the backlog scan
 Namespaces []string      // empty: all
 Eligible   func(ctx context.Context, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) *transcodeplan.Eligibility // the backlog scan's test (step 3)
}

var windowPhases = []catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase{catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePending, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned,
 catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping}

// Rebuild is the first pass's quorum read: seven server-filtered Lists
// (five transcode window phases, two graft phases), then the backlog scan,
// then rebuilt. Resync calls it again every ledgerResync with replace=true.
func (l *Ledger) Rebuild(ctx context.Context, in RebuildInputs) error {
 return l.rebuild(ctx, in, false)
}

func (l *Ledger) rebuild(ctx context.Context, in RebuildInputs, replace bool) error {
 started := l.clock.Now()
 seen := map[types.UID]bool{}
 for _, ns := range namespacesOrAll(in.Namespaces) {
  for _, p := range windowPhases {
   var list catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
   opts := []client.ListOption{client.MatchingFields{catalogv1alpha1.FieldTranscodePhase: string(p)}}
   if ns != "" {
    opts = append(opts, client.InNamespace(ns))
   }
   if err := in.APIReader.List(ctx, &list, opts...); err != nil {
    return fmt.Errorf("admission: rebuild: list MediaFiles in %s with %s=%s: %w", ns, catalogv1alpha1.FieldTranscodePhase, p, err)
   }
   for i := range list.Items {
    mf := &list.Items[i]
    seen[mf.UID] = true
    l.observeQuorum(FileViewOf(mf, &mf.Status, nil), started, replace)
   }
  }
  for _, p := range []catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase{catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning} {
   var list catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
   opts := []client.ListOption{client.MatchingFields{catalogv1alpha1.FieldGraftPhase: string(p)}}
   if ns != "" {
    opts = append(opts, client.InNamespace(ns))
   }
   if err := in.APIReader.List(ctx, &list, opts...); err != nil {
    return fmt.Errorf("admission: rebuild: list MediaFiles in %s with %s=%s: %w", ns, catalogv1alpha1.FieldGraftPhase, p, err)
   }
   for i := range list.Items { // FileView.GraftPhase; F7.2 counts graft slots from it
    mf := &list.Items[i]
    seen[mf.UID] = true
    l.observeQuorum(FileViewOf(mf, &mf.Status, nil), started, replace)
   }
  }
 }
 if replace {
  l.correctUnseen(ctx, in.APIReader, seen) // in flight or window entries the Lists missed: re-Get, replace, Forget on NotFound
 }
 if err := l.scanBacklog(ctx, in); err != nil { // step 3: every movie and episode file through Eligible, once
  return err
 }
 l.markRebuilt()
 return nil
}
```

   `observeQuorum` replaces an entry observed before `started` outright when `replace` is true (a
   newer loop `Observe` stands) and counts `metrics.TranscodeLedgerCorrections` with a Warn log on
   any change; `scanBacklog` lists `MediaFile`s from `in.Cache` with `client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy`
   and observes each through `in.Eligible` (the controller passes a function over
   `transcodeplan.Eligible` with the cached profiles, item existence by `mfindex.Item` and
   `graftstate.StandaloneFor`).

1. **`source.go`:**

```go
// LoopSource hands the ledger the loop's queue (S22, §5.5): grants,
// directives and changed wait reasons are added at GrantPriority, so they
// jump the LowPriority initial list. Generic, so admission never imports
// app/remediation (which imports admission for FileView).
func LoopSource[K comparable](l *Ledger, toKey func(types.NamespacedName) K) source.TypedSource[K] {
 return source.TypedFunc[K](func(ctx context.Context, q workqueue.TypedRateLimitingInterface[K]) error {
  pq, isPQ := q.(priorityqueue.PriorityQueue[K])
  l.setWaker(func(nn types.NamespacedName, prio int) {
   if isPQ {
    pq.AddWithOpts(priorityqueue.AddOpts{Priority: new(prio)}, toKey(nn))
    return
   }
   q.Add(toKey(nn))
  })
  return nil
 })
}
```

1. **`controller.go`** (`transcode-admission`):

```go
var Request = reconcile.Request{NamespacedName: types.NamespacedName{Name: "(admission)"}}

// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups="",resources=nodes,verbs=get;list;watch
// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=batch,resources=jobs,verbs=get;list;watch
// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=catalog.clustarr.io,resources=mediafiles,verbs=get;list;watch
// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=catalog.clustarr.io,resources=movies;episodes,verbs=get;list;watch
// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=transcode.clustarr.io,resources=transcodeprofiles,verbs=get;list;watch
// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=transcode.clustarr.io,resources=audiografts,verbs=get;list;watch

type Reconciler struct {
 Client      client.Client
 APIReader   client.Reader
 Ledger      *Ledger
 Bus         events.Bus         // clustarr-progress: health, limits, tier (§5.7 step 1)
 Admin       events.StreamAdmin // the task sweep (F6.5)
 Namespaces  []string
 Pool        pool.Config
 RebuildGate <-chan struct{} // tests only: the first pass waits for it
 nextResync  time.Time
}

func (r *Reconciler) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, _ reconcile.Request) (reconcile.Result, error) {
 if !r.Ledger.Rebuilt() {
  if r.RebuildGate != nil {
   select {
   case <-r.RebuildGate:
   case <-ctx.Done():
    return reconcile.Result{}, ctx.Err()
   }
  }
  if err := r.Ledger.Rebuild(ctx, r.rebuildInputs()); err != nil {
   return reconcile.Result{}, err
  }
  r.nextResync = time.Now().Add(ledgerResync)
 } else if time.Now().After(r.nextResync) {
  if err := r.Ledger.Resync(ctx, r.rebuildInputs()); err != nil {
   return reconcile.Result{}, err
  }
  r.nextResync = time.Now().Add(ledgerResync)
 }
 in, err := r.passInputs(ctx) // profiles, nodes and pool Jobs from the cache; devices from clustarr-progress
 if err != nil {
  return reconcile.Result{}, err
 }
 res := r.Ledger.Pass(in)
 return reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: min(res.RequeueAfter, time.Until(r.nextResync))}, nil
}

func (r *Reconciler) SetupWithManager(mgr ctrl.Manager) error {
 one := handler.EnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(func(context.Context, client.Object) []reconcile.Request { return []reconcile.Request{Request} })
 return ctrl.NewControllerManagedBy(mgr).Named("transcode-admission").
  WatchesRawSource(source.Channel(r.Ledger.wake, one)).
  Watches(&corev1.Node{}, one, builder.WithPredicates(gpuNodeSignal(r.Pool))).
  Watches(&transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{}, one, builder.WithPredicates(predicate.GenerationChangedPredicate{})).
  Watches(&batchv1.Job{}, one, builder.WithPredicates(pool.JobPredicate())).
  WithOptions(controller.Options{MaxConcurrentReconciles: 1, RecoverPanic: new(true)}).
  Complete(r)
}
```

   `gpuNodeSignal` fires on Ready, `spec.unschedulable`, the two GPU labels (`r.Pool.NodeLabel`) and
   allocatable GPU quantity (§5.7). `passInputs` reads `task.ReadEncoderHealth`, `ReadEncoderLimits`
   and `ReadEncoderTier` for nvidia and intel (an unreadable bucket is no report, as at
   `class.go:213-218`), `gpuNodes` (`capacity.go:43-64`, moved), and `holding` re-typed from
   `transcodejob/pools.go:167-192` over cached pool Jobs and `PoolState`.

1. **The slim `transcodeprofile` reconciler.** `git mv controller.go legacy.go` and
   `controller_envtest_test.go legacy_envtest_test.go`; rename `Reconciler` → `LegacyReconciler`,
   `NewReconciler` → `NewLegacyReconciler` (`gofmt -r`) in them, in `window_test.go` and in

   New `controller.go`:

```go
// Reconciler is the slim TranscodeProfile reconciler (loop spec §2.13,
// §5.12): it renders the profile's pool Jobs under squasharr-pool from the
// ledger's confirmed dispatches and writes TranscodeProfile.status under
// squasharr. It never watches or writes a MediaFile (D3); it counts files
// through the remediation.mediafile.transcodeProfile index.
type Reconciler struct {
 Client    client.Client
 APIReader client.Reader
 Recorder  k8sevents.EventRecorder
 Ledger    *admission.Ledger
 Pool      pool.Config
 Progress  busevents.KV // clustarr-progress: status.encoderLimits
 Now       func() time.Time
}

// StatusHash is status.hash: jobspec.ProfileHash, the function the planner
// tags with, pure over spec and standard.Version.
func StatusHash(spec transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileSpec) string { return jobspec.ProfileHash(spec) }

func (r *Reconciler) SetupWithManager(mgr ctrl.Manager) error {
 return ctrl.NewControllerManagedBy(mgr).Named("transcodeprofile").
  For(&transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{}, builder.WithPredicates(predicate.GenerationChangedPredicate{})).
  Owns(&batchv1.Job{}, builder.WithPredicates(pool.JobPredicate())).
  WatchesRawSource(source.Channel(r.Ledger.ProfileWake(), &handler.EnqueueRequestForObject{})).
  WithOptions(controller.Options{MaxConcurrentReconciles: 1}).
  Complete(r)
}
```

   `Overlap` from a selector pass over cached video MediaFile labels (`client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy`,
   `transcodeplan.SelectorMatches` and `transcodeplan.WinningProfile`); stored pool Jobs through

   `r.Ledger.SetUnschedulable(k, until)`, the `PoolUnschedulable` Warning Event, a wake of

   `applyPool`, `deletePool`, `backOffPool` re-typed from `pools.go:412-586` onto `PoolState`, taking
   **no** action that suspends or deletes a stored pool while `ok` is false (create, or a raise to a
   count it already sees, only) and requeueing in 5 s; then status (`counts.go`): `pendingJobs` from

```go
// TranscodeProfile indexes a file by the profile its transcode block names,
// and by "<profile>/<phase>" (§3.16): the slim TranscodeProfile

const TranscodeProfile = "remediation.mediafile.transcodeProfile"

func TranscodeProfileValues(o client.Object) []string {
```

  - `worker.ServeOptions.Records events.KV`; `worker.ProgressKey(mfUID string)`.
  - `transcodeplan.Decide(a task.Answer, st catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState, auto bool) Decision` (re-typed),
    `transcodeplan.MaxAttempts`, `RequeueBackoff`, `republishEvery`, `leaseLostGrace`,
    `inflightRecheck`, `deadlineGrace`; `Inputs` gains `Record *task.Record`, `RecordRev uint64`,
    `Folders`, `Issue func(int64) int64`, `Lease LeaseView`, `TaskStored *bool`;
    `Decision` gains `Request *task.Record`, `RequestRev uint64`, `Publish *task.Task`,
    `History []HistoryEvent`, `ConfirmSeq int64`, `Observe *Terminal`; `transcodeplan.Admission`
    gains `NoteLeaseMissing(uid types.UID, missing bool, now time.Time) time.Time` (the ledger's
    `leaseMissingSince`, §5.5) and `PublishFailed(uid types.UID, seq int64, err error)` (§5.8's
    held publish failure), both implemented by `*admission.Ledger`.
  - `remediationmanager.Options.Clock func() time.Time` (nil: `time.Now`), set on F3.1's
    `Reconciler.Clock`.

```go
  Class: "cpu", Inputs: Inputs{ProfileHash: "h", PlanHash: "p", Class: "cpu", SourcePath: "/data/m/h.mkv",
```

```go
package natsbus_test

// TestTranscodeTaskMsgIDDedupesOnTheRealServer is §5.17's natsbus contract:
// a republish of seq S inside the stream's Duplicates window is absorbed;
// seq S+1 is a new message, on the real server's dedupe, not membus's.
func TestTranscodeTaskMsgIDDedupesOnTheRealServer(t *testing.T) {
 bus, err := natsbus.New(connect(t))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 ctx := context.Background()
 require.NoError(t, bus.Ensure(ctx, events.Default()))
 subject := events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubject("6f1c-uid", "cpu", "a1b2-uid")
 env := func() *events.Envelope { return &events.Envelope{ID: "x", Type: "transcode.Task", Schema: "transcode.Task.v2", Data: []byte(`{}`)} }
 first, err := bus.Publish(ctx, subject, env(), events.WithMsgID(events.MsgIDForTranscodeTask("a1b2-uid", 7)),
  events.WithExpectStream(events.StreamWorkSquasharr))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 again, err := bus.Publish(ctx, subject, env(), events.WithMsgID(events.MsgIDForTranscodeTask("a1b2-uid", 7)),
  events.WithExpectStream(events.StreamWorkSquasharr))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, again.Duplicate)
 assert.Equal(t, first.Seq, again.Seq)
 next, err := bus.Publish(ctx, subject, env(), events.WithMsgID(events.MsgIDForTranscodeTask("a1b2-uid", 8)),
  events.WithExpectStream(events.StreamWorkSquasharr))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.False(t, next.Duplicate)
 assert.Equal(t, "transcode/a1b2-uid/7", events.MsgIDForTranscodeTask("a1b2-uid", 7))
}
```

```go
func dispatchIn(t *testing.T) Inputs {

// TestADispatchRendersQueuedThenOwesTheRecordAndThePublish is §5.8 steps
// 1-8: the block is Queued at the issued seq; the record request and the
// publish are effects after the apply, with the same seq in the Msg-Id.
func TestADispatchRendersQueuedThenOwesTheRecordAndThePublish(t *testing.T) {
 in := dispatchIn(t)
 d := Plan(in)
 require.NotNil(t, d.Block)
 b := d.Block
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued, b.Phase)

 assert.Equal(t, int32(1), b.Attempts)

 assert.Equal(t, pool.Name(pool.Key{Profile: "hevc", ProfileUID: "uid-hevc", Class: transcodev1alpha1.HardwareCPU}), b.Pool)
 require.NotNil(t, d.Request)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(42), d.Request.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateRequested, d.Request.State)
 assert.Equal(t, b.ProfileHash, d.Request.Inputs.ProfileHash)
 assert.Equal(t, b.Plan.PlanHash, d.Request.Inputs.PlanHash)

 assert.Equal(t, int64(42), d.Publish.Seq)

 assert.Equal(t, GrantConfirm, d.Grant)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(42), d.ConfirmSeq)
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"queued"}, actions(d.History))
}

func actions(h []HistoryEvent) []string {
 out := make([]string, 0, len(h))
 for _, e := range h {
  out = append(out, e.Action)
 }
 return out
}

// record shows no claim re-runs steps 6-7 with the same Msg-Id while under
// RepublishWindow, then is withdrawn (F6.5 renders the withdrawal).
func TestRepublishStopsAtTheWindow(t *testing.T) {
 in := dispatchIn(t)
 q := Plan(in)
 in.Prev, in.Ledger = q.Block, Ledger{}
 in.Record = q.Request
 in.Now = metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(10 * time.Minute))
 d := Plan(in)
 require.NotNil(t, d.Publish, "republished")
 assert.Equal(t, int64(42), d.Publish.Seq)
 assert.Nil(t, d.Request, "the record already says requested at 42")
 assert.Equal(t, in.Now.Add(republishEvery), d.Due)
 in.Now = metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(records.RepublishWindow + time.Second))
 assert.Nil(t, Plan(in).Publish, "past the window the dedupe would not absorb it")
}

// TestAClaimedRecordIsRunning and the answered, failed and stale rows of §5.9.
func TestTheRecordMovesTheBlock(t *testing.T) {
 in := dispatchIn(t)
 q := Plan(in)
 in.Prev, in.Ledger = q.Block, Ledger{}
 claimedAt := t0.Add(time.Minute)
 in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateClaimed, ClaimedAt: &claimedAt, Writer: "pool-0"},
  Inputs: q.Request.Inputs}
 r := Plan(in).Block
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, r.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, "pool-0", r.WorkerPod)
 assert.Equal(t, metav1.NewTime(claimedAt), *r.StartedAt)

 in.Prev = r
 done := t0.Add(time.Hour)
 in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateAnswered, AnsweredAt: &done},
  Inputs: q.Request.Inputs, Answer: &task.Answer{Outcome: task.OutcomeSucceeded, FinishedAt: &done,
   Result: &transcodev1alpha1.Result{OutputPath: "/data/media/movies/Heat (1995)/Heat (1995).mp4", OutputSizeBytes: 3 << 30}}}
 s := Plan(in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, s.Block.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(42), s.Block.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
 assert.Equal(t, metav1.NewTime(done), *s.Block.FinishedAt, "timestamps come from the record (§4.10 determinism)")
 assert.True(t, s.Again, "the next pass requests the swap's probe")
 assert.Equal(t, s, Plan(in), "incorporating twice is byte-identical")

 stale := *in.Record
 stale.Seq = 41
 in.Record = &stale
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, Plan(in).Block.Phase, "an answer for 41 is not 42's")
}

// TestAFinalDeliveryFailureIsRetriableWithItsCause is §5.9's `failed` row:
// Decide as retriable with the record's Failure, never WorkerLost.
func TestAFinalDeliveryFailureIsRetriableWithItsCause(t *testing.T) {
 in := dispatchIn(t)
 q := Plan(in)
 in.Prev, in.Ledger = q.Block, Ledger{}
 in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateFailed,
  Failure: "nats: no responders", Transient: true}, Inputs: q.Request.Inputs}
 b := Plan(in).Block
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, b.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, string(task.ReasonRetriable), b.Reason)
 assert.Contains(t, b.Message, "nats: no responders")
 assert.Equal(t, int64(42), b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
 require.NotNil(t, b.NextAttemptAt)
}

// TestALostWorkerIsRetriedAfterTheGrace is §5.9's lease row: the lease is
// gone for leaseLostGrace and the stream holds no task, so the dispatch is
// Decided as retriable, reason WorkerLost, counted toward MaxAttempts.
func TestALostWorkerIsRetriedAfterTheGrace(t *testing.T) {
 in := dispatchIn(t)
 q := Plan(in)
 in.Prev, in.Ledger = q.Block, Ledger{}
 in.Prev.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
 in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateClaimed}, Inputs: q.Request.Inputs}
 in.Lease = LeaseView{Missing: true, MissingSince: t0}
 in.Now = metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(leaseLostGrace - time.Second))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, Plan(in).Block.Phase)
 in.Now = metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(leaseLostGrace + time.Second))
 in.TaskStored = new(true)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, Plan(in).Block.Phase, "JetStream will redeliver it")
 in.TaskStored = new(false)
 b := Plan(in).Block
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, b.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, ReasonWorkerLost, b.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, int32(1), b.Attempts)
}
```

```go
// TestServeAnswersTheRecord is §4.12's worker: claim the lease, Claim the
// record, run, Answer, delete the lease, ack; no StatusEvent is published.
func TestServeAnswersTheRecord(t *testing.T) {
 bus := membusFor(t)
 tk := v2Task("a1b2c3d4-uid", 42)
 recs := task.Requests(bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodes))
 _, err := recs.Request(context.Background(), events.RecordKey(tk.File.UID), 0,
  &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: task.RecordSchema, MediaFile: tk.File, Seq: 42, State: records.StateRequested}, Inputs: tk.Inputs})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 publishTask(t, bus, tk)
 stop := serve(t, bus, func(context.Context, task.Task, Options) Outcome {
  return Outcome{Code: ExitOK, Result: &transcodev1alpha1.Result{OutputPath: tk.OutputPath, OutputSizeBytes: 7}}
 })
 defer stop()
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  r, _, ok, err := recs.Get(context.Background(), events.RecordKey(tk.File.UID))
  return err == nil && ok && r.State == records.StateAnswered && r.Answer.Outcome == task.OutcomeSucceeded
 }, 10*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond)
 _, err = bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodeLeases).Get(context.Background(), events.TranscodeLeaseKey(tk.File.UID))
 assert.ErrorIs(t, err, events.ErrKeyNotFound, "the lease is deleted after the answer")
 assert.Zero(t, published(t, bus, "clustarr.work.transcode.result.>"), "no StatusEvent")
}

// TestAV1TaskIsAckedAsStale is D25: no v1 shim; the loop requests it again.
func TestAV1TaskIsAckedAsStale(t *testing.T) {
 bus := membusFor(t)
 name, data, err := schema.Encode(task.TaskV1{Job: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "heat-0ld", UID: "job-uid"}, Attempt: 3, Class: "cpu"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = bus.Publish(context.Background(), events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubject("uid-hevc", "cpu", "job-uid"),
  &events.Envelope{ID: "v1", Type: "transcode.Task", Schema: name, Data: data})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var calls atomic.Int32
 defer serve(t, bus, func(context.Context, task.Task, Options) Outcome { calls.Add(1); return Outcome{Code: ExitOK} })()
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return published(t, bus, "clustarr.work.transcode.task.>") == 0 },
  10*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond, "the v1 task is acked")
 assert.Zero(t, calls.Load())
 _, err = bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodeLeases).Get(context.Background(), events.TranscodeLeaseKey("job-uid"))
 assert.ErrorIs(t, err, events.ErrKeyNotFound, "no lease was taken")
}

// TestServeWaitsForTheOwedRecord is §4.8's absent row: Claim writes nothing
// over an absent record; the worker naks and runs nothing.
func TestServeWaitsForTheOwedRecord(t *testing.T) {
 bus := membusFor(t)
 tk := v2Task("a1b2c3d4-uid", 42)
 publishTask(t, bus, tk)
 var calls atomic.Int32
 defer serve(t, bus, func(context.Context, task.Task, Options) Outcome { calls.Add(1); return Outcome{Code: ExitOK} })()
 assert.Never(t, func() bool { return calls.Load() > 0 }, 2*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond, "no record: nothing runs")
 assert.Equal(t, 1, published(t, bus, "clustarr.work.transcode.task.>"), "nak'd, not acked: it waits for the owed write")
 _, _, ok, err := task.Requests(bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)).Get(context.Background(), events.RecordKey(tk.File.UID))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.False(t, ok)
}

// TestServeAcksASupersededTask: a record at a higher Seq, or answered or
// withdrawn at the task's, drops the task without running it (§4.8).
func TestServeAcksASupersededTask(t *testing.T) {
 for name, h := range map[string]schema.RecordHeader{
  "a newer request": {Seq: 43, State: records.StateRequested},
  "answered at 42":  {Seq: 42, State: records.StateAnswered},
  "withdrawn at 42": {Seq: 42, State: records.StateWithdrawn},
 } {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   bus := membusFor(t)
   tk := v2Task("a1b2c3d4-uid", 42)
   h.Schema, h.MediaFile = task.RecordSchema, tk.File
   raw, err := json.Marshal(&task.Record{RecordHeader: h, Inputs: tk.Inputs})
   require.NoError(t, err)
   _, err = bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodes).Create(context.Background(), events.RecordKey(tk.File.UID), raw)
   require.NoError(t, err)
   publishTask(t, bus, tk)
   var calls atomic.Int32
   defer serve(t, bus, func(context.Context, task.Task, Options) Outcome { calls.Add(1); return Outcome{Code: ExitOK} })()
   require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return published(t, bus, "clustarr.work.transcode.task.>") == 0 },
    10*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond)
   assert.Zero(t, calls.Load())
  })
 }
}

func membusFor(t *testing.T) events.Bus {
 t.Helper()
 bus := membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock())
 require.NoError(t, bus.Ensure(context.Background(), events.Default()))
 t.Cleanup(func() { _ = bus.Close() })
 return bus
}

func v2Task(uid string, seq int64) task.Task {
 in := task.Inputs{ProfileHash: "h", PlanHash: "p", Class: "cpu", SourcePath: "/data/media/movies/H/H.mkv",
  ProbeHash: "ph", OutputPath: "/data/media/movies/H/H.mp4"}
 return task.Task{File: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "h", UID: uid}, Seq: seq, Class: "cpu",
  Profile: task.Profile{Name: "hevc", Hash: "h"}, SourcePath: in.SourcePath, SourceProbeHash: "ph",
  OutputPath: in.OutputPath, Root: task.RootFolder{Path: "/data/media/movies"}, Inputs: in,
  Deadline: metav1.Duration{Duration: time.Hour}}
}

func publishTask(t *testing.T, bus events.Bus, tk task.Task) {
 t.Helper()
 name, data, err := schema.Encode(tk)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = bus.Publish(context.Background(), events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubject("uid-hevc", tk.Class, tk.File.UID),
  &events.Envelope{ID: "t", Type: "transcode.Task", Schema: name, Data: data},
  events.WithMsgID(events.MsgIDForTranscodeTask(tk.File.UID, tk.Seq)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
}

func serve(t *testing.T, bus events.Bus, process func(context.Context, task.Task, Options) Outcome) (stop func()) {
 t.Helper()
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 done := make(chan struct{})
 go func() {
  defer close(done)
  _ = Serve(ctx, bus, ServeOptions{ProfileUID: "uid-hevc", Class: "cpu", Node: "node-a",
   Options: Options{DataDir: t.TempDir(), PodName: "pool-0"}, Process: process, HeldRetry: 100 * time.Millisecond,
   Leases: bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodeLeases), Records: bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)})
 }()
 return func() { cancel(); <-done }
}

func published(t *testing.T, bus events.Bus, filter string) int {
 t.Helper()
 subs, err := bus.(events.StreamAdmin).Subjects(context.Background(), events.StreamWorkSquasharr, filter)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 return len(subs)
}
```

`app/remediation/transcode/harness_envtest_test.go` (the dispatch harness the F6.4 and F6.5

```go
package transcode_test

// harness is one manager running the loop, transcode-admission and the slim
// TranscodeProfile reconciler on an embedded JetStream, as cmd/manager
// registers them after F6.6, with one fake clock for the loop and the
// ledger, so the republish, unclaimed and lost-worker timers run in tests.
type harness struct {
 c         client.Client
 bus       events.Bus
 raw       events.Bus // the natsbus under any wrapper, for StreamAdmin
 ledger    *admission.Ledger
 clock     *clockwork.FakeClock
 profile   *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile
 dir       string
 publishes atomic.Int32 // task publishes seen by the wrapper
 down      atomic.Bool  // task publishes fail while set (NATS down)
 pokes     atomic.Int32
 mgr       ctrl.Manager
}

// start starts the manager. A test that seeds a steady state does so first,
// so the loop's applied-status memo (§3.7) never sees a write it did not make.
func (h *harness) start(t *testing.T) { t.Helper(); starttest.Start(t, h.mgr) }

// countingBus counts and optionally fails the loop's task publishes.
type countingBus struct {
 events.Bus
 h *harness
}

func (b countingBus) Publish(ctx context.Context, subject string, e *events.Envelope, opts ...events.PublishOption) (events.Receipt, error) {
 if strings.HasPrefix(subject, "clustarr.work.transcode.task.") {
  if b.h.down.Load() {
   return events.Receipt{}, errors.New("nats: connection closed")
  }
  b.h.publishes.Add(1)
 }
 return b.Bus.Publish(ctx, subject, e, opts...)
}

func newHarness(t *testing.T, slots map[string]int32) *harness {
 t.Helper()
 cfg := starttest.RequireEnvtest(t, testCfg)
 url := starttest.EmbeddedNATS(t)
 starttest.EnsureTopology(t, url)
 nc, err := nats.Connect(url)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 t.Cleanup(nc.Close)
 raw, err := natsbus.New(nc)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 h := &harness{raw: raw, dir: t.TempDir(), clock: clockwork.NewFakeClockAt(time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second))}
 h.bus = countingBus{Bus: raw, h: h}
 h.ledger = admission.NewLedger(admission.Options{Slots: slots, Window: 32, Clock: h.clock})
 mgr := starttest.NewManager(t, cfg, func(o *ctrl.Options) {
  o.Cache.ByObject = map[client.Object]cache.ByObject{&batchv1.Job{}: pool.PoolJobCache("default")}
 })
 require.NoError(t, remediationmanager.Register(mgr, h.bus, remediationmanager.Options{
  Options: k8s.Options{Namespace: "default"}, DataDir: h.dir, Ledger: h.ledger, Clock: h.clock.Now}))
 require.NoError(t, (&admission.Reconciler{Client: mgr.GetClient(), APIReader: mgr.GetAPIReader(), Ledger: h.ledger,
  Bus: raw, Admin: raw.(events.StreamAdmin), Namespaces: []string{"default"}, Pool: poolConfig()}).SetupWithManager(mgr))
 require.NoError(t, (&transcodeprofile.Reconciler{Client: mgr.GetClient(), APIReader: mgr.GetAPIReader(),
  Ledger: h.ledger, Pool: poolConfig()}).SetupWithManager(mgr))
 probetest.Start(t, raw, probetest.ProberFunc(func(context.Context, string) (*commonv1.MediaInfo, *mediainfo.Raw, error) {
  return h264Summary(), &mediainfo.Raw{}, nil
 }))
 h.mgr = mgr
 h.c = starttest.Client(t, cfg)
 ctx := context.Background()
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Create(ctx, &catalogv1alpha1.RootFolder{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "default", Name: "movies"},
  Spec: catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderSpec{Path: "/data/media/movies", Kind: catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderKindMovie}}))
 h.profile = &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "hevc"},
  Spec: transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileSpec{Default: true}}
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Create(ctx, h.profile))
 return h
}

// file creates a movie, its MediaFile and the bytes under dir, and returns
// the file once its probe is current.
func (h *harness) file(t *testing.T, name string) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 t.Helper()
 ctx := context.Background()
 logical := "/data/media/movies/" + name + "/" + name + ".mkv"
 local := filepath.Join(h.dir, strings.TrimPrefix(logical, "/data/"))
 require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(local), 0o755))
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(local, []byte("source "+name), 0o644))
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Create(ctx, movie(name)))
 mf := mediaFile(name, logical)
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Create(ctx, mf))
 return waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "probed", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool { return m.ProbeCurrent() })
}

// poke wakes the file's pass (S1's user-label arm), after the test moved
// the fake clock.
func (h *harness) poke(t *testing.T, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) {
 t.Helper()
 patch := []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"metadata":{"labels":{"test.clustarr.io/poke":"%d"}}}`, h.pokes.Add(1)))
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Patch(context.Background(), mf, client.RawPatch(types.MergePatchType, patch)))
}

// seeded creates a movie file whose status is already in its steady state
// -- probed and current for the bytes on disk, with a transcode block in
// phase at seq on the harness's cpu pool -- before the manager starts.
func (h *harness) seeded(t *testing.T, name string, phase catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase, seq int64) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 t.Helper()
 ctx := context.Background()
 logical := "/data/media/movies/" + name + "/" + name + ".mkv"
 local := filepath.Join(h.dir, strings.TrimPrefix(logical, "/data/"))
 require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(local), 0o755))
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(local, []byte("source "+name), 0o644))
 fi, err := os.Stat(local)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Create(ctx, movie(name)))
 mf := mediaFile(name, logical)
 mf.Spec.SizeBytes, mf.Spec.ModTime = fi.Size(), metav1.NewTime(fi.ModTime())
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Create(ctx, mf))
 now := metav1.NewTime(h.clock.Now())
 mf.Status = catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{
  ProbeHash: mediainfo.ProbeHash(logical, fi.Size(), fi.ModTime()), ProbedAt: &now, ProbeVersion: mediainfo.ProbeVersion,
  MediaInfo: h264Summary(),
  Conditions: []metav1.Condition{
   {Type: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionProbed, Status: metav1.ConditionTrue, Reason: "Probed", LastTransitionTime: now},
   {Type: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileConditionReady, Status: metav1.ConditionTrue, Reason: "Ready", LastTransitionTime: now},
  },
 }
 seedStatus(t, h.c, mf, h.blockFor(t, mf, phase, seq))
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), mf))
 return mf
}

// blockFor is the steady-state status of a file dispatched at seq to the
// harness's cpu pool.
func (h *harness) blockFor(t *testing.T, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, phase catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase, seq int64) catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus {
 t.Helper()
 var tp transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(h.profile), &tp))
 hash := jobspec.ProfileHash(tp.Spec)
 st := mf.Status.DeepCopy()
 st.LastSeq = seq
 if phase == "" { // a probed backlog file: no block yet
  st.Transcode = nil
  return *st
 }
 st.Transcode = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Phase: phase, Profile: tp.Name, ProfileHash: hash,
  ProfileTag: transcodeplan.Tag(tp.Name, hash), ProbeHash: st.ProbeHash, Class: "cpu", Attempts: 1,
  Pool:     pool.Name(pool.Key{Profile: tp.Name, ProfileUID: tp.UID, Class: transcodev1alpha1.HardwareCPU}),
  Plan:     &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePlan{Mode: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeModeTranscode, Encoder: "libx265", PlanHash: "p"},
  Dispatch: &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: seq, DispatchedAt: metav1.NewTime(h.clock.Now())}}
 return *st
}

// worker serves the profile's pool with a stub Process, through the real
// worker.Serve, so lease, record and answer are the production code's.
func (h *harness) worker(t *testing.T, class string, process func(context.Context, task.Task, worker.Options) worker.Outcome) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 t.Cleanup(cancel)
 var tp transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(h.profile), &tp))
 go func() {
  _ = worker.Serve(ctx, h.raw, worker.ServeOptions{ProfileUID: string(tp.UID), Class: class, Node: "node-a",
   Options: worker.Options{DataDir: h.dir, PodName: "pool-0"}, Process: process,
   Leases: h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodeLeases), Records: h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)})
 }()
}

// storedTasks counts the task subjects the stream holds for a file.
func (h *harness) storedTasks(t *testing.T, uid types.UID) int {
 t.Helper()
 subs, err := h.raw.(events.StreamAdmin).Subjects(context.Background(), events.StreamWorkSquasharr,
  events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubjectAnyPool(string(uid)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 return len(subs)
}

// poolConfig is the pool config the slim reconciler renders with in tests.
func poolConfig() pool.Config {
 return pool.Config{Namespace: "default", Image: "native:test", DataClaimName: "clustarr-data"}
}
```

```go
package transcode_test

// TestDispatchPublishesOneTaskPerSeq is §5.17: two passes, the second from a

// the transcode binary (W5.8's verifySquashController assertion, kept).
func TestDispatchPublishesOneTaskPerSeq(t *testing.T) {

 h.start(t)
 mf := h.file(t, "heat-1995")
 got := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Queued", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued
 })
 seq := got.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.Seq
 assert.Equal(t, seq, got.Status.LastSeq)

 assert.Never(t, func() bool { return h.storedTasks(t, got.UID) > 1 }, 3*time.Second, 200*time.Millisecond)

  return h.c.Get(context.Background(), types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: got.Status.Transcode.Pool}, &j) == nil
 }, 30*time.Second, 200*time.Millisecond, "the cpu pool is rendered for the confirmed dispatch")
 assert.Equal(t, []string{binpath.Transcode}, j.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Command)
 assert.Equal(t, int32(1), ptr.Deref(j.Spec.Parallelism, 0), "TestPoolParallelismFollowsConfirmedDispatches")
}

// TestTwoFilesNeverShareTheLastSlot is §5.17: cpu=1, ten Planned files, the
// loop at 16 workers plus admission; a watch asserts at most one Queued or
// Running file at every resourceVersion.
func TestTwoFilesNeverShareTheLastSlot(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})
 h.start(t)
 w, err := client.NewWithWatch(starttest.RequireEnvtest(t, testCfg), client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 watch, err := w.Watch(context.Background(), &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList{}, client.InNamespace("default"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 defer watch.Stop()
 inFlight := map[string]bool{}
 done := make(chan struct{})
 go func() {
  defer close(done)
  for ev := range watch.ResultChan() {
   mf, ok := ev.Object.(*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile)
   if !ok {
    continue
   }
   p := ""
   if mf.Status.Transcode != nil {
    p = string(mf.Status.Transcode.Phase)
   }
   inFlight[mf.Name] = p == "Queued" || p == "Running"
   n := 0
   for _, f := range inFlight {
    if f {
     n++
    }
   }
   assert.LessOrEqual(t, n, 1, "two files in flight at resourceVersion %s", mf.ResourceVersion)
  }
 }()
 for i := range 10 {
  h.file(t, fmt.Sprintf("film-%02d", i))
 }
 time.Sleep(15 * time.Second)
 watch.Stop()
 <-done
}

// TestHeldFilesAreWrittenOnlyOnChange (§5.17, §5.11 "Bounded writes"): 32
// files under a cpu pool admission holds -- its name is taken by a Job the
// profile does not own (pools.go:167-192's foreign-owner hold) -- each get
// the held message once; five more admission passes write nothing.
func TestHeldFilesAreWrittenOnlyOnChange(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 32})
 ctx := context.Background()
 var tp transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(h.profile), &tp))
 k := pool.Key{Profile: tp.Name, ProfileUID: tp.UID, Class: transcodev1alpha1.HardwareCPU}
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Create(ctx, &batchv1.Job{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "default", Name: pool.Name(k),
   Labels: map[string]string{pool.LabelManagedBy: pool.ManagedByValue, pool.LabelProfile: pool.ProfileLabelValue(tp.Name)}},
  Spec: batchv1.JobSpec{Suspend: new(true), Template: corev1.PodTemplateSpec{Spec: corev1.PodSpec{
   RestartPolicy: corev1.RestartPolicyNever, Containers: []corev1.Container{{Name: "x", Image: "busybox"}}}}},
 }))
 files := make([]*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, 32)
 for i := range files {
  files[i] = h.seeded(t, fmt.Sprintf("held-%02d", i), "", 0)
 }
 h.start(t)
 rv := map[string]string{}
 for _, mf := range files {
  got := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "held", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
   return m.Status.Transcode != nil && strings.HasPrefix(m.Status.Transcode.Message, "waiting for pool ")
  })
  rv[got.Name] = got.ResourceVersion
 }
 for range 5 {
  h.ledger.Wake()
  time.Sleep(300 * time.Millisecond)
 }
 assert.Never(t, func() bool {
  for _, mf := range files {
   var m catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
   if h.c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &m) == nil && m.ResourceVersion != rv[m.Name] {
    return true
   }
  }
  return false
 }, 5*time.Second, 500*time.Millisecond, "a held file was written again with the same reason")
}

// TestACrashBetweenEffectsNeverHidesADispatch is §5.15's "after Queued
// landed, before the record or publish" and "publish keeps failing" rows:
// the Queued apply lands while every task publish fails; a fresh ledger
// rebuilt from the apiserver counts the slot; once NATS is back the next
// pass publishes the same seq.
func TestACrashBetweenEffectsNeverHidesADispatch(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})
 h.start(t)
 h.down.Store(true)
 mf := h.file(t, "heat-1995")
 got := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Queued with no task", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued
 })
 assert.Zero(t, h.storedTasks(t, got.UID))
 fresh := admission.NewLedger(admission.Options{Slots: map[string]int32{"cpu": 1}, Window: 32})
 require.NoError(t, fresh.Rebuild(context.Background(), admission.RebuildInputs{APIReader: h.c,
  Cache: emptyCache{}, Namespaces: []string{"default"}}))
 assert.Equal(t, 1, fresh.InFlight(transcodev1alpha1.HardwareCPU), "the rebuilt ledger counts the slot from status")
 h.down.Store(false)
 h.clock.Advance(time.Minute + time.Second)
 h.poke(t, got)
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return h.storedTasks(t, got.UID) == 1 }, 30*time.Second, 200*time.Millisecond)
 after := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "still Queued", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool { return m.Status.Transcode != nil })
 assert.Equal(t, got.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.Seq, after.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.Seq, "the same seq, the same Msg-Id")
}

// TestRepublishStopsOnceClaimed (§5.17): a claimed seq is never published
// again, however often the file is woken past republishEvery.
func TestRepublishStopsOnceClaimed(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})
 h.start(t)
 release := make(chan struct{})
 t.Cleanup(func() { close(release) })
 h.worker(t, "cpu", func(context.Context, task.Task, worker.Options) worker.Outcome {
  <-release
  return worker.Outcome{Code: worker.ExitRetriable}
 })
 mf := h.file(t, "heat-1995")
 got := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Running", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
 })
 assert.Equal(t, "pool-0", got.Status.Transcode.WorkerPod)
 before := h.publishes.Load()
 for range 3 {
  h.clock.Advance(61 * time.Second)
  h.poke(t, got)
 }
 assert.Never(t, func() bool { return h.publishes.Load() > before }, 5*time.Second, 200*time.Millisecond)
}

// TestLostWorkerIsRedispatched (§4.15; §5.17's TestWorkerLostIsRetried): a
// claimed record with no lease and no stored task becomes WorkerLost after
// leaseLostGrace, counts an attempt, and is dispatched again at a new seq.
func TestLostWorkerIsRedispatched(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})
 h.start(t)
 mf := h.file(t, "heat-1995")
 q := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Queued", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued
 })
 seq := q.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.Seq
 ghost := task.Answers(h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes), "ghost-pod")
 v, err := ghost.Claim(context.Background(), events.RecordKey(string(q.UID)), seq, false)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, records.Wrote, v)
 require.NoError(t, h.raw.(events.StreamAdmin).PurgeSubject(context.Background(), events.StreamWorkSquasharr,
  events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubjectAnyPool(string(q.UID))))
 waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Running on the ghost", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
 })
 h.clock.Advance(3*time.Minute + time.Second) // leaseLostGrace
 h.poke(t, mf)
 again := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "redispatched", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  tr := m.Status.Transcode
  return tr.Dispatch != nil && tr.Dispatch.Seq > seq && tr.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued
 })
 assert.Equal(t, int32(2), again.Status.Transcode.Attempts, "the lost attempt counts toward MaxAttempts")
}

// TestAFinalDeliveryFailureShowsItsCause (§5.17): a failed record is
// retriable with its Failure as the message, never WorkerLost.
func TestAFinalDeliveryFailureShowsItsCause(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 0}) // nothing dispatches on its own
 mf := h.seeded(t, "heat-1995", catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued, 9)
 h.start(t)
 ref := schema.Ref{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: mf.Name, UID: string(mf.UID)}
 key := events.RecordKey(string(mf.UID))
 requests := task.Requests(h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes))
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { // the owed request
  rec, _, ok, err := requests.Get(context.Background(), key)
  return err == nil && ok && rec.Seq == 9 && rec.State == records.StateRequested
 }, 30*time.Second, 200*time.Millisecond)
 _, err := task.Answers(h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes), "pool-0").Answer(context.Background(), key,
  &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: task.RecordSchema, MediaFile: ref, Seq: 9, State: records.StateFailed,
   Failure: "lease bucket unavailable", Transient: true}})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 got := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "decided", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned
 })
 assert.Contains(t, got.Status.Transcode.Message, "lease bucket unavailable")
 assert.NotEqual(t, transcodeplan.ReasonWorkerLost, got.Status.Transcode.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(9), got.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
}
```

   `schema.JobEvent` → `schema.JobEventV1` in `pkg/events/schema/transcode.go` (schema string
   unchanged), `transcodejob/events.go`, its tests, `app/catalog/history/target.go`
   (`resolveJobEvent` keeps v1 → TranscodeJob) and `app/catalog/worker/history/sink.go`.
   `go build ./...` is green after this step.

```go
// Inputs are what a transcode record is matched by (§4.10): the record
// answers this dispatch only when they are the block's.
type Inputs struct {
 ProfileHash string `json:"profileHash"`
 PlanHash    string `json:"planHash"`
 Class       string `json:"class"`
 SourcePath  string `json:"sourcePath"`
 ProbeHash   string `json:"probeHash"`
 OutputPath  string `json:"outputPath"`
}

// Task is one dispatch of one MediaFile's transcode (loop spec §4.12).
type Task struct {
 File            schema.Ref      `json:"file"`
 Seq             int64           `json:"seq"`
 Class           string          `json:"class"`
 Profile         Profile         `json:"profile"`
 SourcePath      string          `json:"sourcePath"`
 SourceProbeHash string          `json:"sourceProbeHash"`
 SourceSizeBytes int64           `json:"sourceSizeBytes"`
 SourceModifier  string          `json:"sourceModifier,omitempty"`
 OutputPath      string          `json:"outputPath"`
 Root            RootFolder      `json:"root"`
 OutputRoot      string          `json:"outputRoot,omitempty"`
 Engine          string          `json:"engine,omitempty"`
 PlanHash        string          `json:"planHash,omitempty"`
 Deadline        metav1.Duration `json:"deadline"`
 Graft           *grafttask.Task `json:"graft,omitempty"`
 Inputs          Inputs          `json:"inputs"`
}

func (Task) Schema() string { return "transcode.Task.v2" }

// Lease is one MediaFile's transcode claim in clustarr-transcode-leases at
// events.TranscodeLeaseKey(file UID); a cancelled lease applies to its Seq
// and earlier ones.
type Lease struct {
 File  schema.Ref `json:"file"`
 Seq   int64      `json:"seq"`
 State LeaseState `json:"state"`
 Pod   string     `json:"pod,omitempty"`
 Node  string     `json:"node,omitempty"`
 Since time.Time  `json:"since"`
}

func (Lease) Schema() string { return "transcode.Lease.v2" }
```

   `app/squash/task/record.go`:

```go
// Answer is a worker's answer to one dispatch (§4.12). Message is clamped to
// 1024 bytes and StderrTail to 4096 before the CAS.
type Answer struct {
 Outcome    Outcome                   `json:"outcome"`
 Reason     Reason                    `json:"reason,omitempty"`
 Message    string                    `json:"message,omitempty"`
 Class      string                    `json:"class,omitempty"`
 Pod        string                    `json:"pod,omitempty"`
 Node       string                    `json:"node,omitempty"`
 StartedAt  *time.Time                `json:"startedAt,omitempty"`
 FinishedAt *time.Time                `json:"finishedAt,omitempty"`
 Result     *transcodev1alpha1.Result `json:"result,omitempty"` // MediaInfo always nil
 StderrTail string                    `json:"stderrTail,omitempty"`
 Graft      *grafttask.Result         `json:"graft,omitempty"`
}

const RecordSchema = "records.transcode.v1"

// Record is one MediaFile's clustarr-transcodes value.
type Record struct {
 schema.RecordHeader
 Inputs Inputs  `json:"inputs"`
 Answer *Answer `json:"answer,omitempty"`
}

func (r *Record) Header() *schema.RecordHeader { return &r.RecordHeader }

var RecordSpec = records.Spec[*Record]{
 Remediation: "transcode", Bucket: events.BucketTranscodes, Schema: RecordSchema, MaxValue: 32 << 10,
 New:         func() *Record { return &Record{} },
 Answered: func(s string) bool { return s == records.StateAnswered || s == records.StateFailed },
 Fact: func(r *Record) bool {
  return r.State == records.StateAnswered && r.Answer != nil && r.Answer.Outcome == OutcomeSucceeded
 },
}

func Requests(kv events.KV) *records.Requester[*Record] { return records.NewRequester(kv, RecordSpec) }

func Answers(kv events.KV, pod string) *records.Answerer[*Record] {
 return records.NewAnswerer(kv, RecordSpec, pod, version.String())
}
```

1. **`jobspec.BuildTask` for a file** (`app/squash/jobspec/buildtask.go`):

```go
// BuildTask renders dispatch seq of mf's transcode under tp (hash is
// jobspec.ProfileHash, the block's profileHash) for class, carrying the
// planned plan's hash: everything the worker reads, resolved by the one
// function the planner and the worker's tests share.
func BuildTask(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, tp *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile, hash string,
 folders []catalogv1alpha1.RootFolder, seq int64, class transcodev1alpha1.Hardware, plan *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePlan,
) (task.Task, error) {
 source := filepath.Clean(mf.Spec.Path)
 rf := RootFolderFor(folders, source)
 if rf == nil {
  return task.Task{}, fmt.Errorf("source %s: %w", source, ErrNoRootFolder)
 }
 out, err := OutputPath(source, tp.Name, OutputContainer, ReplaceSource(tp.Spec.Policy))
 if err != nil {
  return task.Task{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", ErrInvalidOutput, err)
 }
 bin := rf.Spec.RecycleBin.Path
 if bin == "" {
  bin = defaultRecycleBin
 }
 file := schema.Ref{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: mf.Name, UID: string(mf.UID)}
 t := task.Task{
  File: file, Seq: seq, Class: string(class),
  Profile:    task.Profile{Name: tp.Name, Hash: hash, Spec: *tp.Spec.DeepCopy(), Hardware: new(class)},
  SourcePath: source, SourceProbeHash: mf.Status.ProbeHash, SourceSizeBytes: mf.Spec.SizeBytes,
  SourceModifier: string(mf.Spec.Quality.Modifier), OutputPath: out,
  Root:     task.RootFolder{Path: rf.Spec.Path, RecycleBin: bin},
  Deadline: metav1.Duration{Duration: ActiveDeadline(tp.Spec)}, Engine: task.EngineFFgo,
 }
 if plan != nil {
  t.PlanHash = plan.PlanHash
 }
 if filepath.Clean(out) != source {
  orf := RootFolderFor(folders, out)
  if orf == nil {
   return task.Task{}, fmt.Errorf("output %s: %w", out, ErrNoRootFolder)
  }
  t.OutputRoot = orf.Spec.Path
 }
 t.Inputs = task.Inputs{ProfileHash: hash, PlanHash: t.PlanHash, Class: string(class), SourcePath: source,
  ProbeHash: mf.Status.ProbeHash, OutputPath: out}
 return t, nil
}
```

   (`mf` is the view's file with `Status` set to the draft, so `ProbeHash` is the one planned.)

1. **The worker** (`app/squash/worker`). `ServeOptions` gains `Records events.KV`; `server` holds
   `answers *records.Answerer[*task.Record]` built in `Serve` from it and `o.PodName`. `handle`:

```go
func (s *server) handle(ctx context.Context, m events.Message) {
 log := logging.FromContext(ctx)
 sctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 10*time.Second)
 defer cancel()
 if m.Envelope().Schema == (task.TaskV1{}).Schema() {
  log.InfoContext(ctx, "squasharr worker: a v1 task; the loop requests this file again as v2")
  _ = m.Ack(sctx)
  return
 }
 var t task.Task
 if err := schema.Decode(m.Envelope().Schema, m.Envelope().Data, &t); err != nil {
  // dead-letter and Term as today
 }
 key := events.RecordKey(t.File.UID)
 if sup, err := s.answers.Superseded(ctx, key, t.Seq); err != nil || sup {
  if err != nil {
   _ = m.Nak(sctx, s.o.HeldRetry)
   return
  }
  _ = m.Ack(sctx)
  return
 }
 cur, rev0, ok, err := s.claim(ctx, t) // the v2 lease at TranscodeLeaseKey(t.File.UID), Seq for Attempt
 // the lease switch (serve.go:363-375 today) is unchanged: held elsewhere → Nak(HeldRetry); cancelled → Ack
 rev := &leaseRev{v: rev0}
 started := s.clock.Now().UTC()
 verdict, err := s.answers.Claim(ctx, key, t.Seq, m.Attempt() > 1) // reclaim: a redelivery, whose lease s.claim just took
 switch {
 case err != nil:
  _ = s.o.Leases.DeleteRevision(sctx, events.TranscodeLeaseKey(t.File.UID), rev.get())
  _ = m.Nak(sctx, s.o.HeldRetry)
  return
 case verdict == records.NotYet: // absent or below: wait for the loop's owed write (§4.8)
  _ = s.o.Leases.DeleteRevision(sctx, events.TranscodeLeaseKey(t.File.UID), rev.get())
  if m.Attempt() >= uint64(s.sub.MaxDeliver) {
   _ = m.Ack(sctx) // on the last delivery it acks
   return
  }
  _ = m.Nak(sctx, records.NotYetDelay)
  return
 case verdict != records.Wrote: // withdrawn, answered or superseded at this seq
  _ = s.o.Leases.DeleteRevision(sctx, events.TranscodeLeaseKey(t.File.UID), rev.get())
  _ = m.Ack(sctx)
  return
 }
 // renew, deadline, BeforeSwap, Process as today; then:
 ans, settle := answerOf(t, out, cause, ctx.Err(), s.o.Node, s.o.PodName, started, s.clock.Now().UTC())
 if !settle.answer { // fenced, cancelled or drained: today's paths, no answer
  settle.apply(sctx, s, m, t, rev)
  return
 }
 state := records.StateAnswered
 rec := &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: task.RecordSchema, MediaFile: t.File, Seq: t.Seq,
  State: state, AnsweredAt: ans.FinishedAt}, Inputs: t.Inputs, Answer: &ans}
 if ans.Reason == task.ReasonRetriable && m.Attempt() >= uint64(s.sub.MaxDeliver) {
  rec.State, rec.Failure, rec.Transient = records.StateFailed, clamp(ans.Message, 1024), true // §4.8 "Last delivery"
 }
 if _, err := s.answers.Answer(sctx, key, rec); err != nil {
  log.WarnContext(ctx, "squasharr worker: the answer was not recorded; redelivery redoes it", "error", err)
  _ = s.o.Leases.DeleteRevision(sctx, events.TranscodeLeaseKey(t.File.UID), rev.get())
  _ = m.Nak(sctx, 0)
  return
 }
 _ = s.o.Leases.DeleteRevision(sctx, events.TranscodeLeaseKey(t.File.UID), rev.get())
 _ = m.Ack(sctx)
}
```

   `answerOf` is today's outcome switch (`serve.go:401-450`) returning a `task.Answer` (Outcome,
   Reason via `reasonFor`, Message, Class via `taskClass`, Pod, Node, timestamps, `out.Result` with
   `MediaInfo` nil, `tail(out.StderrTail, 4096)`, `out.Graft`) or the settle path for fenced,
   cancelled and drained runs. Delete `report.go`'s `reporter`, `progress.go` (`progressReporter`,
   `DefaultProgressInterval`), `Options.OnProgress`, `Options.ProgressInterval` and `applyProgress`;
   `telemetry` takes `file schema.Ref, seq int64` and writes `schema.TranscodeProgress{File, Seq, …}`
   at `ProgressKey(file.UID)`. `lease.go` reads `t.File.UID` and `t.Seq` where it read `t.Job.UID`
   and `t.Attempt`. `uniquePartPath(generic, fileUID string, seq int64)` and `sweepEarlierAttempts`
   compare `FileUID8` and `Seq`, and so do `sidecarParts` and `removePart`'s sidecar sweep
   (`run.go:684-716` at main `80175fdc`, `b33e4417`: `tp.FileUID8 == cur.FileUID8 && tp.Seq == cur.Seq`);
   `fsops.SidecarPath` writes `<stem>[.<name>].part-<FileUID8>-<Seq><ext>` (`%d` of an int64).
   `Process`'s log key is `"mediaFile"`. `cmd/transcode/main.go` passes
   `Records: bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)`.

1. **The planner's dispatch and in-flight rows** (`transcodeplan/dispatch.go`, `inflight.go`,
   `decide.go`, `history.go`). `Plan`'s switch gains, before the F6.2 rows:

```go
 case in.Ledger.Grant == GrantDispatch:
  return planDispatch(in)
 case prev != nil && (prev.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued || prev.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning):
  return planInFlight(in)
```

```go
const (
 republishEvery  = time.Minute
 leaseLostGrace  = 2 * events.TranscodeLeaseTTL // 180 s
 inflightRecheck = time.Minute
 deadlineGrace   = time.Hour
)

// LeaseView is what the adapter read of the file's lease.
type LeaseView struct {
 Missing      bool
 MissingSince time.Time // the ledger's note (leaseMissingSince)
}

// planDispatch is §5.8 for a held dispatch grant of class C, only from a
// Planned view; the block is Queued first, the record and the publish are
// owed effects after the apply.
func planDispatch(in Inputs) Decision {
 prev := in.Prev
 if prev == nil || prev.Phase != catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned {
  d := Plan(Inputs{File: in.File, Prev: prev, Draft: in.Draft, ProbeCurrent: in.ProbeCurrent,
   Eligibility: in.Eligibility, Now: in.Now, Record: in.Record, RecordRev: in.RecordRev, Lease: in.Lease, TaskStored: in.TaskStored})
  d.Grant = GrantRelease
  return d
 }
 if fact := unincorporatedFact(in.Record, prev); fact {
  d := incorporate(in, prev.DeepCopy()) // §4.10: never dispatch over a fact
  d.Grant = GrantRelease
  return d
 }
 e := in.Eligibility
 b := prev.DeepCopy()
 class := in.Ledger.Class
 p, fail := PlanFor(in.File.Spec.Path, e.Profile, e.Hash, in.File, in.Draft, &class, in.Ledger.Device)
 switch {
 case fail != nil:
  b.Phase, b.Blocked, b.Reason, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseFailed, true, fail.Reason, truncate(fail.Message, 1024)
  return Decision{Block: b, Grant: GrantRelease}
 case p.Skips():
  b.Phase, b.Reason, b.Plan = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSkipped, ReasonPlanSkip, nil
  b.Message = truncate("skipped: "+firstNonEmpty(p.Reject, p.Plan.Reason), 1024)
  return Decision{Block: b, Grant: GrantRelease}
 case !runsIn(&p.Plan, class):
  if choosesClass(b, e) {
   b.FallbackReason = truncate(fmt.Sprintf("a plan for %s encodes with %s, which needs no GPU", class, p.Plan.Video.Encoder), 256)
  }
  b.Plan = StatusPlan(&p.Plan)
  return Decision{Block: b, Grant: GrantRelease} // dispatch.go:310-339, keepPlanned
 }
 seq := in.Issue(recordSeq(in.Record))
 plan := StatusPlan(&p.Plan)
 mf := in.File.DeepCopy()
 mf.Status = *in.Draft
 t, err := jobspec.BuildTask(mf, e.Profile, e.Hash, in.Folders, seq, class, plan)
 if err != nil {
  b.Phase, b.Blocked, b.Reason, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseFailed, true, ReasonInvalidSource, truncate(err.Error(), 1024)
  return Decision{Block: b, Grant: GrantRelease}
 }
 k := pool.Key{Profile: e.Profile.Name, ProfileUID: e.Profile.UID, Class: class}
 b.Phase, b.Reason = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued, ""
 b.Message = fmt.Sprintf("attempt %d dispatched to %s", seq, pool.Name(k))
 b.Dispatch = &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: seq, DispatchedAt: in.Now}
 b.Attempts++
 b.Class, b.Pool, b.Plan = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeClass(class), pool.Name(k), plan
 b.Profile, b.ProfileHash, b.ProfileTag, b.ProbeHash = e.Profile.Name, e.Hash, e.Tag, in.Draft.ProbeHash
 b.WorkerPod, b.StartedAt, b.FinishedAt, b.NextAttemptAt, b.StderrTail, b.JoinedGraft = "", nil, nil, nil, "", nil
 return Decision{
  Block: b, Grant: GrantConfirm, ConfirmSeq: seq,
  Request: requested(in.File, seq, t.Inputs, in.Now), RequestRev: in.RecordRev, Publish: &t,
  History: []HistoryEvent{{Action: events.ActionQueued, Seq: seq}},
  Due:     in.Now.Add(republishEvery),
 }
}
```

   The helpers `planDispatch` calls: `recordSeq(rec)` is `rec.Seq`, 0 when absent; `requested(mf, seq,
   inputs, now)` is the `task.Record` `{Schema: task.RecordSchema, MediaFile: <mf ref>, Seq: seq,
   State: records.StateRequested, RequestedAt: now}` with `Inputs`; `runsIn(p, class)` is
   `transcodejob.planRunsIn` re-typed onto `standard.Result` (`p.Video.Action != "encode" ||
   HardwareForEncoder(p.Video.Encoder) == class`); `choosesClass(b, e)` is the block's hardware intent,
   else the profile's, in `{auto, gpu}`; `unincorporatedFact(rec, b)` is `rec != nil &&
   task.RecordSpec.Fact(rec) && b.Dispatch != nil && rec.Seq == b.Dispatch.Seq && b.Dispatch.Withdrawn`
   (F6.5 widens it to the fact window); `incorporate(in, b)` is the `answered` row below.
   `planInFlight` implements §5.9's rows that need no withdrawal, in this order: an unincorporated
   fact at an earlier seq closes the current seq without a record write, then incorporates it; the
   record absent or below `dispatch.seq` (and not an unincorporated fact) owes the request and the
   publish; `requested` at the seq republishes while `now - dispatchedAt < records.RepublishWindow`
   (`Due` every `republishEvery`); `claimed` → Running, `WorkerPod = Writer`, `StartedAt =
   ClaimedAt`; Running with `in.Lease.Missing` past `leaseLostGrace` and `*in.TaskStored == false`
   → `Decide` as retriable with reason `WorkerLost`; `answered` → `incorporate` (`Decide`, then
   `dispatch.answeredSeq = seq`, `FinishedAt`/`StartedAt` from the record, the R9 terminal
   observation in `Decision.Observe`, history `succeeded`/`failed`/`skipped`); `failed` → `Decide`
   as retriable with the record's `Failure`, `Transient` steering the backoff. The rows that leave
   Queued or Running without an answer (unclaimed past the window, deadline, orphaned, a new probe,
   dead-lettered) are F6.5's and, until then, keep the block and set `Due` = `inflightRecheck`.
   `Decide` is copied from `transcodejob/decide.go` (`Decide`, `retry`) and re-typed onto
   `(task.Answer, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState, auto bool)`, with a success becoming `Swapping`
   unless the output is a kept copy (`!jobspec.ReplaceSource(policy)` and
   `result.outputPath != spec.path`), which becomes `Succeeded`, `Compliant` false, `Result` kept;
   `applyDecision` becomes `applyAnswer(b, a, d, now)` writing the block's fields (`StderrTail` =
   the last 1024 bytes, §2.5).

1. **The adapter.** `transcode.Options` gains `Records *records.Requester[*task.Record]`, `Leases
   events.KV`, `Admin events.StreamAdmin`. `Gather` adds, through `env.IO` for nothing (no `/data`
   here): the record (`Records.Get(RecordKey(uid))`) when the block is in flight, a dispatch grant
   is held, or `dispatch.withdrawn` is true within the fact window; the RootFolders (cache List)
   under a dispatch grant; the lease (`Leases.Get(TranscodeLeaseKey(uid))`, `ErrKeyNotFound` is
   `Missing`, with `MissingSince` from `Ledger.NoteLeaseMissing(uid, now)`) while Running; and
   `TaskStored` from `Admin.Subjects(StreamWorkSquasharr, "clustarr.work.transcode.task.*.*.<uid>")`
   only once `leaseLostGrace` has passed, with the filter `events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubjectAnyPool(uid)`. `Plan` sets `Inputs.Issue = v.Issue` and maps the
   decision to effects in this order (§3.8): `RecordWrite{Bucket: events.BucketTranscodes, Key:
   RecordKey(uid), Revision: d.RequestRev, Value: json(d.Request)}`, `Publish{Subject:
   events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubject(string(profileUID), class, uid), MsgID:
   events.MsgIDForTranscodeTask(uid, seq), ExpectStream: events.StreamWorkSquasharr, Envelope}`,
   `LedgerConfirm{UID, Seq: d.ConfirmSeq}`, `History{Subject: events.TranscodeJobSubject(action, uid),
   MsgID: uid + "/transcode/" + seq + "/" + action, Envelope: schema.JobEvent v2}`, and the R9
   observation as an effect calling `metrics.TranscodeDuration`/`SpeedRatio`/`SizeRatio`
   (`transcodejob/metrics.go:61-127`, re-typed); `admission.Ledger` exports `Wake()` (its
   `signalLocked` under the lock) for `TestHeldFilesAreWrittenOnlyOnChange`; a publish increments
   `metrics.TranscodeDispatches.WithLabelValues(class, "published"|"republished")`. A record CAS miss
   requeues in 1 s (§3.8). The adapter's `Sources` gains S17, `{Name: "S17/clustarr-transcodes", Raw:
   recordsource.New(bus, events.BucketTranscodes, remediation.FileKey)}`. `Plan` sets `Result.Unpaced`
   when it incorporated an answer, and reports each incorporation and timeout in `Result.Records`
   (`RecordNote{State, TimedOut}`, counted after the apply, F3's D-F3-4).

2. **History.** `app/catalog/history/target.go` registers `schema.JobEvent{}.Schema()` →
   `resolveJobEvent`, which resolves v2's `File` to `Kind: "MediaFile"`, `APIVersion:
   catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.String()`; `schema.JobEventV1{}.Schema()` keeps `resolveJobEventV1`
   (TranscodeJob) until F8.6. The sink's switch gains the v2 case with the same note format.

3. **Rescan.** `transcodeJobs(ctx, ns)` becomes `transcodeBlocks(ctx, ns)`: one cached List of the
   namespace's MediaFiles (`client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy`) returning `outputs` = every
   `status.transcode.result.outputPath` of a Swapping block or a Succeeded block that keeps its
   `result` (a kept copy), mapped to the MediaFile's name, and `live` = the first eight characters
   of the UID of every file whose block is Queued, Running or Swapping. `orphanPart` keys on
   `p.FileUID8`. Delete the `transcodejobs` RBAC marker (`worker.go:157`); `transcodeOutput`'s log
   key is `"mediaFile"`. `make manifests` and `sync-chart-rbac.py importarr`.
