```go
package transcodeplan

func queuedIn(t *testing.T) Inputs {
 t.Helper()
 in := dispatchIn(t)
 q := Plan(in)
 in.Prev, in.Ledger, in.Record = q.Block, Ledger{}, q.Request
 in.Profiles = map[string]*transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{"hevc": in.Eligibility.Profile}
 return in
}

// TestWithdrawalTakesTwoPasses is §5.10: the first pass keeps the phase,
// sets the cause and emits Withdraw; the second, finding the record
// withdrawn at S, writes the cause's state with answeredSeq = S and
// withdrawn = true. Writing Planned first would leave a task the rebuilt
// ledger cannot see.
func TestWithdrawalTakesTwoPasses(t *testing.T) {
 for _, tc := range []struct {
  name    string
  mutate  func(*Inputs)
  reason  string
  phase   catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase
  blocked bool
  after   string // the reason pass 2 writes, when not reason
 }{
  {"cancel", func(in *Inputs) { in.Intents.Cancel = "1759752000" }, ReasonCancelled, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSkipped, false, ""},
  {"suspend", func(in *Inputs) { in.Intents.Suspend = "true" }, ReasonSuspended, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, false, ""},
  {"reroute", func(in *Inputs) {
   in.Ledger.Directive = &Directive{Kind: DirectiveReroute, Seq: 42, Reason: "GPU pool p-nvidia unschedulable for 10m"}
  }, ReasonRerouted, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, false, ""},
  {"unclaimed", func(in *Inputs) { in.Now = metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(records.RepublishWindow + time.Second)) },
   ReasonUnclaimed, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, false, ""},
  {"new bytes, their probe landed", func(in *Inputs) { in.Draft = probed("ph-2") },
   ReasonSourceChanged, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePending, false, ReasonProbePending},
  {"dead-lettered", func(in *Inputs) {
   in.DeadLettered = "clustarr.work.transcode.task.uid-hevc.cpu." + string(in.File.UID) + "@" + t0.Add(time.Minute).Format(time.RFC3339)
  }, ReasonDeadLettered, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseFailed, true, ""},
  {"profile gone", func(in *Inputs) { in.Profiles = nil }, ReasonProfileGone, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSkipped, false, ""},
 } {
  t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   in := queuedIn(t)
   tc.mutate(&in)
   first := Plan(in)
   require.NotNil(t, first.Block)
   assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued, first.Block.Phase, "pass 1 keeps the phase")
   assert.Equal(t, tc.reason, first.Block.Reason)
   assert.Equal(t, "withdrawing attempt 42", first.Block.Message)
   assert.Equal(t, int64(42), first.Withdraw)
   assert.Nil(t, first.Request, "a withdrawing seq is never re-requested")
   assert.Nil(t, first.Publish)

   in.Prev = first.Block
   in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateWithdrawn}}
   second := Plan(in)
   b := second.Block
   require.NotNil(t, b)
   assert.Equal(t, tc.phase, b.Phase)
   want := tc.reason
   if tc.after != "" {
    want = tc.after
   }
   assert.Equal(t, want, b.Reason)
   assert.Equal(t, tc.blocked, b.Blocked)
   assert.Equal(t, int64(42), b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
   assert.True(t, b.Dispatch.Withdrawn, "the block keeps its dispatch, so a late fact is incorporated")
   assert.Zero(t, second.Withdraw)
  })
 }
}

// TestAFactAfterTheClosingWithdrawalIsIncorporated is §4.10 and D41: a
// succeeded answer at the withdrawn seq, inside FactWindow, becomes
// Swapping from whatever phase the withdrawal left, and clears withdrawn.
func TestAFactAfterTheClosingWithdrawalIsIncorporated(t *testing.T) {
 in := queuedIn(t)
 in.Intents.Cancel = "1"
 first := Plan(in)
 require.NotNil(t, first.Nonces)
 in.Prev, in.Nonces = first.Block, *first.Nonces
 in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateWithdrawn}}
 closed := Plan(in)
 require.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSkipped, closed.Block.Phase)
 in.Prev = closed.Block
 done := t0.Add(2 * time.Hour)
 in.Now = metav1.NewTime(done.Add(time.Minute))
 in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateAnswered, AnsweredAt: &done},
  Answer: &task.Answer{Outcome: task.OutcomeSucceeded, FinishedAt: &done,
   Result: &transcodev1alpha1.Result{OutputPath: "/data/media/movies/Heat (1995)/Heat (1995).mp4", OutputSizeBytes: 3 << 30}}}
 b := Plan(in).Block
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, b.Phase)
 assert.False(t, b.Dispatch.Withdrawn)

 in.Now = metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(FactWindow(48*time.Hour) + time.Second))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSkipped, Plan(in).Block.Phase, "past the fact window the record is not read")
}

// TestFileMissingRecoversTheSwapFromTheRecord is §5.9's FileMissing row:
// spec.path is gone, the record at the last dispatch names the output, and
// that file exists: Swapping with the stat's size.
func TestFileMissingRecoversTheSwapFromTheRecord(t *testing.T) {
 in := queuedIn(t)
 in.Prev.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
 in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateClaimed}, Inputs: in.Record.Inputs} // the answer never landed
 in.SpecPathMissing, in.OutputExists, in.OutputSize = true, true, 2<<30
 b := Plan(in).Block
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, b.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, in.Record.Inputs.OutputPath, b.Result.OutputPath)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(2<<30), b.Result.OutputSizeBytes)
}

// TestARecreatedProfilesFileIsRequeued and the deadline row.
func TestOrphanAndDeadlineRows(t *testing.T) {
 in := queuedIn(t)
 recreated := in.Eligibility.Profile.DeepCopy()
 recreated.UID = "uid-hevc-2"
 in.Profiles = map[string]*transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{"hevc": recreated}
 in.Eligibility.Profile = recreated
 first := Plan(in)
 assert.Equal(t, ReasonOrphaned, first.Block.Reason)
 in.Prev, in.Record = first.Block, &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateWithdrawn}}
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, Plan(in).Block.Phase)

 in = queuedIn(t)
 in.Prev.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
 claimedAt := t0
 in.Record = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 42, State: records.StateClaimed, ClaimedAt: &claimedAt}, Inputs: in.Record.Inputs}
 in.Now = metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(48*time.Hour + deadlineGrace + time.Second)) // Task.Deadline is the profile's 48 h default
 assert.Equal(t, ReasonDeadlineExceeded, Plan(in).Block.Reason)
}
```

```go
package transcodeplan

// TestIntentsAreRecordedOnce is §2.9 "Handling": every one-shot nonce is
// recorded on the pass that sees it, with NothingToRetry or NothingToCancel
// when there is nothing to act on; an invalid value is recorded with
// InvalidAnnotation; a held file keeps its nonce pending.
func TestIntentsAreRecordedOnce(t *testing.T) {
 in := inputs(nil, probed("ph-1"), GrantNone)
 in.Intents = Intents{Retry: "1759752000", Cancel: "1759752001"}
 d := Plan(in)
 require.NotNil(t, d.Nonces)
 assert.Equal(t, "1759752000", d.Nonces.TranscodeRetry)
 assert.Equal(t, "1759752001", d.Nonces.TranscodeCancel)
 assert.ElementsMatch(t, []string{"NothingToRetry", "NothingToCancel"}, reasons(d.Events))

 in.Nonces = *d.Nonces
 assert.Empty(t, Plan(in).Events, "a handled nonce is not handled again")

 in.Intents.Retry = "not a nonce!"
 bad := Plan(in)
 assert.Equal(t, "not a nonce!", bad.Nonces.TranscodeRetry, "an invalid one-shot is recorded")
 assert.Contains(t, reasons(bad.Events), "InvalidAnnotation")

 held := inputs(nil, probed("ph-1"), GrantNone)
 held.ProbeCurrent = false
 held.Intents.Retry = "1759752009"
 assert.Nil(t, Plan(held).Nonces, "a nonce on a held file waits for the hold to lift")
}

func reasons(ev []Event) []string {
 out := make([]string, 0, len(ev))
 for _, e := range ev {
  out = append(out, e.Reason)
 }
 return out
}

// TestRetryClearsAVerdictForTheCurrentTag is D14: retry clears a Failed or
// Skipped verdict for the current (profileHash, probeHash) and resets
// attempts, so the window takes the file again.
func TestRetryClearsAVerdictForTheCurrentTag(t *testing.T) {
 in := inputs(nil, probed("ph-1"), GrantNone)
 blocked := &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseFailed, Blocked: true, Reason: ReasonRetriesExhausted,
  Profile: "hevc", ProfileHash: in.Eligibility.Hash, ProfileTag: in.Eligibility.Tag, ProbeHash: "ph-1", Attempts: 5,
  Dispatch: &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: 77, AnsweredSeq: 77, DispatchedAt: metav1.NewTime(t0)}}
 in.Prev, in.Intents.Retry = blocked, "1759752000"
 d := Plan(in)
 assert.Nil(t, d.Block, "the verdict goes; the file is backlog again and the window takes it with attempts 0")
 assert.Equal(t, "1759752000", d.Nonces.TranscodeRetry)
 in.Nonces = *d.Nonces
 assert.Equal(t, blocked, Plan(in).Block, "a handled nonce retries nothing")
}

// TestStandingIntentsAreRecordedInTheBlock: priority and hardware apply at
// the next dispatch; suspend holds a Planned file in its window place.
func TestStandingIntentsAreRecordedInTheBlock(t *testing.T) {
 in := inputs(nil, probed("ph-1"), GrantWindow)
 in.Intents = Intents{Priority: "50", Hardware: "nvidia", Suspend: "true"}
 b := Plan(in).Block
 assert.Equal(t, int32(50), b.Priority)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeHardware("nvidia"), b.Hardware)
 assert.True(t, b.Suspended)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, b.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, ReasonSuspended, b.Reason)
 in.Intents.Hardware = "quantum"
 assert.Contains(t, reasons(Plan(in).Events), "InvalidAnnotation", "a bad standing value is ignored with a Warning")
}
```

```go
package transcode_test

func annotate(t *testing.T, h *harness, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, key, v string) {
 t.Helper()
 patch := []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"metadata":{"annotations":{%q:%q}}}`, key, v))
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Patch(context.Background(), mf, client.RawPatch(types.MergePatchType, patch)))
}

func suspend(t *testing.T, h *harness, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, v string) {
 t.Helper()
 annotate(t, h, mf, catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend, v)
}

// TestUnclaimedDispatchIsWithdrawnAfterTheWindow (§5.17, fake clock): no
// worker claims seq S within RepublishWindow; S is withdrawn and the file
// returns to Planned, reason Unclaimed, attempts unchanged.
func TestUnclaimedDispatchIsWithdrawnAfterTheWindow(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})
 h.start(t)
 mf := h.file(t, "heat-1995")
 q := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Queued", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued
 })
 seq := q.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.Seq
 h.clock.Advance(records.RepublishWindow + time.Second)
 h.poke(t, mf)
 got := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Unclaimed", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode.Reason == transcodeplan.ReasonUnclaimed && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned
 })
 assert.Equal(t, seq, got.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
 assert.Equal(t, int32(1), got.Status.Transcode.Attempts, "unchanged")
 rec, _, _, err := task.Requests(h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)).Get(context.Background(), events.RecordKey(string(mf.UID)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateWithdrawn, rec.State)
 assert.Zero(t, h.storedTasks(t, mf.UID), "purged")
}

// TestWithdrawalPrecedesThePlannedWrite (§5.17): a Running file is suspended;
// the record is withdrawn before the block leaves Running; with the purge
// failing the block stays Running, message "withdrawal failed: …".
func TestWithdrawalPrecedesThePlannedWrite(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})
 h.failPurge.Store(true)
 h.start(t)
 release := make(chan struct{})
 t.Cleanup(func() { close(release) })
 h.worker(t, "cpu", func(ctx context.Context, _ task.Task, _ worker.Options) worker.Outcome {
  select {
  case <-release:
  case <-ctx.Done():
  }
  return worker.Outcome{Code: worker.ExitRetriable}
 })
 mf := h.file(t, "heat-1995")
 waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Running", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
 })
 suspend(t, h, mf, "true")
 stuck := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "withdrawal failed", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return strings.HasPrefix(m.Status.Transcode.Message, "withdrawal failed: ")
 })
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, stuck.Status.Transcode.Phase, "nothing becomes Planned until withdrawal succeeds")
 h.failPurge.Store(false)
 h.poke(t, mf)
 got := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Planned, Suspended", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned && m.Status.Transcode.Reason == transcodeplan.ReasonSuspended
 })
 rec, _, _, err := task.Requests(h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)).Get(context.Background(), events.RecordKey(string(mf.UID)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateWithdrawn, rec.State)
 assert.True(t, rec.RequestedAt.Before(got.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.DispatchedAt.Add(time.Hour)))
 lease, err := h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodeLeases).Get(context.Background(), events.TranscodeLeaseKey(string(mf.UID)))
 if err == nil {
  var l task.Lease
  require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(lease.Value, &l))
  assert.Equal(t, task.LeaseCancelled, l.State, "the running worker reads cancelled at its next renewal")
 }
}

// TestDeletedFileTaskIsWithdrawnAtOnce (§5.17, D11): deleting a Queued file
// withdraws its task from the ledger's memory of the UID; no finalizer.
func TestDeletedFileTaskIsWithdrawnAtOnce(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})
 h.start(t)
 mf := h.file(t, "heat-1995")
 q := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "Queued", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued
 })
 assert.Empty(t, q.Finalizers)
 require.NoError(t, h.c.Delete(context.Background(), q))
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return h.storedTasks(t, q.UID) == 0 }, 30*time.Second, 200*time.Millisecond)
 rec, _, _, err := task.Requests(h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)).Get(context.Background(), events.RecordKey(string(q.UID)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateWithdrawn, rec.State)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(math.MaxInt64), rec.Seq)
}

// TestSucceededAfterWithdrawalIsIncorporated (§4.15) and
// TestAFactAfterTheClosingWithdrawalPassIsIncorporated (§4.10): the worker
// answers a fact after the closing withdrawal pass, for a Cancelled, a
// Suspended and a Rerouted file; the block becomes Swapping.
func TestAFactAfterTheClosingWithdrawalPassIsIncorporated(t *testing.T) {
 for _, cause := range []string{"cancel", "suspend", "reroute"} {
  t.Run(cause, func(t *testing.T) {
   h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 0})
   mf := h.seeded(t, "heat-1995", catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, 9)
   ref := schema.Ref{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: mf.Name, UID: string(mf.UID)}
   key := events.RecordKey(string(mf.UID))
   st := h.blockFor(t, mf, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, 9)
   _, err := task.Requests(h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)).Request(context.Background(), key, 0,
    &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: task.RecordSchema, MediaFile: ref, Seq: 9, State: records.StateRequested}})
   require.NoError(t, err)
   h.start(t)
   switch cause {
   case "cancel":
    annotate(t, h, mf, catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeCancel, "1759752000")
   case "suspend":
    annotate(t, h, mf, catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend, "true")
   case "reroute":
    h.ledger.UpdatePool(pool.Key{Profile: st.Transcode.Profile, ProfileUID: h.profileUID(t), Class: transcodev1alpha1.HardwareCPU},
     func(p *admission.PoolState) { p.UnschedulableUntil = h.clock.Now().Add(time.Hour) })
    h.ledger.Reroute(mf.UID, 9, "GPU pool unschedulable for 10m", false) // the directive a pass would issue
    h.poke(t, mf)
   }
   closed := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "closed by the withdrawal", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
    d := m.Status.Transcode.Dispatch
    return d != nil && d.Withdrawn && d.AnsweredSeq == 9
   })
   require.NotEqual(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, closed.Status.Transcode.Phase)
   done := h.clock.Now()
   v, err := task.Answers(h.raw.KV(events.BucketTranscodes), "pool-0").Answer(context.Background(), key,
    &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: task.RecordSchema, MediaFile: ref, Seq: 9, State: records.StateAnswered, AnsweredAt: &done},
     Inputs: task.Inputs{OutputPath: strings.TrimSuffix(mf.Spec.Path, ".mkv") + ".mp4"},
     Answer: &task.Answer{Outcome: task.OutcomeSucceeded, FinishedAt: &done,
      Result: &transcodev1alpha1.Result{OutputPath: strings.TrimSuffix(mf.Spec.Path, ".mkv") + ".mp4", OutputSizeBytes: 7}}})
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.Equal(t, records.Wrote, v, "a fact is written over withdrawn{9} (§4.8)")
   got := waitTranscode(t, h.c, mf, "the fact is incorporated", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
    return m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping ||
     m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded
   })
   assert.False(t, got.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.Withdrawn)
  })
 }
}

// TestAClearedBlockFreesItsSlot (§5.17, written to §5.9's row): new bytes
// under a Queued file withdraw it to Pending, ProbePending; the slot frees
// at the next Observe and the other Planned file is dispatched.
func TestAClearedBlockFreesItsSlot(t *testing.T) {
 h := newHarness(t, map[string]int32{"cpu": 1})
 h.start(t)
 a := h.file(t, "film-a")
 waitTranscode(t, h.c, a, "a Queued", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued
 })
 b := h.file(t, "film-b")
 waitTranscode(t, h.c, b, "b Planned", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode != nil && m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned
 })
 local := filepath.Join(h.dir, strings.TrimPrefix(a.Spec.Path, "/data/"))
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(local, []byte("new bytes, new size"), 0o644))
 h.poke(t, a)
 waitTranscode(t, h.c, a, "a no longer in flight", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  p := m.Status.Transcode.Phase // Pending, ProbePending, then Planned for the new bytes
  return p != catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued && p != catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
 })
 waitTranscode(t, h.c, b, "b dispatched into the freed slot", func(m *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
  return m.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued
 })
}
```

1. **`transcodeplan/withdraw.go`** -- the two-pass rule, ahead of every other in-flight row:

```go
// withdrawing reports whether b is taking back its dispatch: pass 1 of
// §5.10 set the cause with the message "withdrawing attempt S".
func withdrawing(b *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState) bool {
 return b != nil && b.Dispatch != nil && b.Dispatch.Seq > b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq &&
  b.Message == fmt.Sprintf("withdrawing attempt %d", b.Dispatch.Seq)
}

// startWithdrawal is pass 1: keep the phase, set the cause, emit Withdraw.
func startWithdrawal(b *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState, cause string) Decision {
 b.Reason, b.Message = cause, fmt.Sprintf("withdrawing attempt %d", b.Dispatch.Seq)
 return Decision{Block: b, Withdraw: b.Dispatch.Seq, Events: []Event{{Type: "Normal", Reason: "Withdrawn", Message: cause}}}
}

// finishWithdrawal is pass 2: the record is withdrawn at S (or answered or
// failed there, which the incorporation row takes first); write what the
// cause dictates, close the dispatch and mark it withdrawn.
func finishWithdrawal(in Inputs, b *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState) Decision {
 seq := b.Dispatch.Seq
 b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq, b.Dispatch.Withdrawn = seq, true
 b.WorkerPod, b.StartedAt = "", nil
 switch b.Reason {
 case ReasonCancelled:
  b.Phase, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSkipped, fmt.Sprintf("attempt %d cancelled", seq)
 case ReasonProfileGone:
  b.Phase, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSkipped, "its TranscodeProfile was deleted"
 case ReasonDeadLettered, ReasonDeadlineExceeded:
  b.Phase, b.Blocked = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseFailed, b.Reason == ReasonDeadLettered
  b.Message = fmt.Sprintf("attempt %d %s", seq, map[string]string{ReasonDeadLettered: "was dead-lettered after its last delivery",
   ReasonDeadlineExceeded: "ran past its deadline"}[b.Reason])
 case ReasonSourceChanged:
  b.Phase, b.Reason, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePending, ReasonProbePending, "a probe of new bytes is pending"
 case ReasonUnclaimed:
  b.Phase, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, fmt.Sprintf("attempt %d was not claimed within 50m; requeued", seq)
 case ReasonRerouted:
  b.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned
  if dir := in.Ledger.Directive; dir != nil && !dir.KeepGPU {
   b.FallbackReason = truncate(dir.Reason, 256)
  }
  b.Message = fmt.Sprintf("attempt %d withdrawn: rerouted", seq)
 default: // Suspended, Orphaned
  b.Phase, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, fmt.Sprintf("attempt %d withdrawn: %s", seq, b.Reason)
 }
 return Decision{Block: b, History: []HistoryEvent{{Action: "withdrawn", Seq: seq}},
  Events: []Event{{Type: "Normal", Reason: "Withdrawn", Message: b.Message}}}
}
```

   `planInFlight` (F6.4) checks, before its own rows: an answered or failed record at the seq
   (incorporate, as F6.4); `withdrawing(b)` and the record withdrawn at the seq → `finishWithdrawal`;
   `withdrawing(b)` otherwise → re-emit `Withdraw` (never the owed request, §5.10); then the causes
   in this order, each → `startWithdrawal`: cancel intent unhandled → `Cancelled`; suspend intent
   `"true"` → `Suspended`; `in.DeadLettered` naming `clustarr.work.transcode.task.*.*.<uid>` and dated
   after `dispatchedAt` → `DeadLettered`; `in.Profiles[b.Profile] == nil` → `ProfileGone`;
   `b.Pool != pool.Name(Key{profile, its UID, b.Class})` → `Orphaned`; a reroute directive at
   `b.Dispatch.Seq` → `Rerouted`; Queued with `in.Draft.ProbeHash != b.ProbeHash` → `SourceChanged`;
   Queued with `requested` past `records.RepublishWindow` → `Unclaimed` (plus the
   `DispatchUnclaimed` Warning Event and `TranscodeDispatches{class, "unclaimed"}`); Running and
   `claimed` past `Task.Deadline + deadlineGrace` (the deadline is `jobspec.ActiveDeadline(profile.Spec)`)
   → `DeadlineExceeded`. A `ProfileGone` block is kept until `dispatchedAt + FactWindow(deadline)`
   and then cleared (`keepFact`'s condition: `b.Dispatch.Withdrawn && now < dispatchedAt + FactWindow`).
   **`FileMissing`** (`fact.go`): when `in.SpecPathMissing` and the record at `b.Dispatch.Seq`, in any
   state, names `Inputs.OutputPath` and `in.OutputExists`, the block becomes `Swapping` with
   `Result{OutputPath: rec.Inputs.OutputPath, OutputSizeBytes: in.OutputSize}`; the probe planner's tag
   check then decides the takeover (F6.2). **A fact after the withdrawal** (`fact.go`): while
   `b.Dispatch.Withdrawn && now < dispatchedAt + FactWindow(deadline)`, a record `answered` at
   `b.Dispatch.Seq` with `task.RecordSpec.Fact` true is incorporated as `Swapping` whatever the phase,
   and `Withdrawn` is cleared. `FactWindow(d) = records.FactWindow(d, deadlineGrace)` (capped at
   `records.MaxFactWindow`, the bucket's 7-day TTL).

1. **`transcodeplan/intent.go`:**

```go
var noncePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,62}$`)

// Intents are the five transcode annotations as the file carries them (§2.9).
type Intents struct{ Retry, Cancel, Suspend, Priority, Hardware string }

func ParseIntents(a map[string]string) Intents {
 return Intents{Retry: a[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeRetry], Cancel: a[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeCancel],
  Suspend: a[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend], Priority: a[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodePriority],
  Hardware: a[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeHardware]}
}
```

   `Plan` applies intents first (`applyIntents(in, &d)`), recording each one-shot nonce in
   `Decision.Nonces` on the pass that sees it -- unless the file is held (`!in.ProbeCurrent`, or a
   standalone graft) -- with `NothingToRetry`/`NothingToCancel` (Normal) when there is nothing to act
   on and `InvalidAnnotation` (Warning) for a value off `noncePattern`; retry on a Failed or Skipped
   block for the current tag clears the verdict -- the block goes, so the file is backlog again and
   the window takes it with `Attempts` 0 (`status.lastSeq` keeps the sequence floor, §2.3); cancel
   withdraws (above) or, with nothing in flight,
   writes `Skipped`/`Cancelled` for the current `(profileHash, probeHash)`; the standing intents set
   `Suspended`, `Priority` (a decimal `int32`, else ignored with `InvalidAnnotation`) and `Hardware`
   (one of `cpu|nvidia|intel|auto|gpu`, else ignored) on the block, the hardware applying at the next
   dispatch. A backlog file with no block still records its nonces (`Decision.Nonces` without a
   block). `transcodeplan.Eligibility` gains `Priority int32`, the effective priority (the intent's,
   else the profile's `spec.priority`), which the adapter sets and `admission.FileViewOf` reads for a
   file with no block; the rebuild's backlog `Eligible` function reads the annotation the same way.
   `admission.Pass` skips `FileView.Suspended` candidates and orders window fills and admission by
   `FileView.Priority`. `admission.Ledger` gains `Reroute(uid, seq, reason, keepGPU)` (Pass step 2's
   directive, exported), `SetSlots`, `SetWindow` (take the lock and signal), `InFlightOrGranted(uid)`,
   and the `Reconciler` gains `Withdrawal task.Withdrawal`.

1. **The adapter.** `Gather` adds `Intents: transcodeplan.ParseIntents(v.File.Annotations)`,
   `Nonces` from `v.Prev.HandledNonces`, `DeadLettered` from `k8s.AnnotationDeadLettered`'s subject,
   `Profiles` (keyed by name, from the list it already reads), and -- only while a block has a
   dispatch -- `SpecPathMissing`/`OutputExists`/`OutputSize` from `env.IO.Stat` of `spec.path` and the
   record's `Inputs.OutputPath` (`remediation.Transient` on a saturated pool or open breaker). It
   implements F3.1's `remediation.Withdrawer` over `task.Withdrawal` (`app/squash/task/withdraw.go`,
   which imports only `pkg/records` and `pkg/events`, so the sweep in the squash manager uses the
   same code):

```go
// Withdrawal takes a MediaFile's transcode task back (loop spec §5.10).
type Withdrawal struct {
 Records *records.Requester[*Record]
 Leases  events.KV
 Admin   events.StreamAdmin
}

// Withdraw is §5.10's three steps for seq, in order: the record CAS (one
// records.Withdraw, refusing to overwrite an unincorporated fact), the
// lease cancel marker (unconditional), then the purge of every task subject
// of the file. A file has at most one live seq.
func (w Withdrawal) Withdraw(ctx context.Context, mfUID string, seq int64) error {
 key := events.RecordKey(mfUID)
 _, rev, _, err := w.Records.Get(ctx, key)
 if err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("withdrawal failed: %w", err)
 }
 if _, err := w.Records.Withdraw(ctx, key, rev, seq, records.IncorporatedThrough(seq-1)); err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("withdrawal failed: %w", err)
 }
 cancel, err := json.Marshal(Lease{File: schema.Ref{UID: mfUID}, Seq: seq, State: LeaseCancelled, Since: time.Now().UTC()})
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if _, err := w.Leases.Put(ctx, events.TranscodeLeaseKey(mfUID), cancel); err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("withdrawal failed: %w", err)
 }
 if err := w.Admin.PurgeSubject(ctx, events.StreamWorkSquasharr, events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubjectAnyPool(mfUID)); err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("withdrawal failed: %w", err)
 }
 return nil
}

// WithdrawAll is Withdraw at math.MaxInt64, for a deleted file (§5.10).
func (w Withdrawal) WithdrawAll(ctx context.Context, mfUID string) error { return w.Withdraw(ctx, mfUID, math.MaxInt64) }
```

   The adapter's `Withdraw(ctx, env, uid, seq)` (F3.1's `remediation.Withdrawer`) calls
   `Withdrawal.Withdraw` and increments `metrics.TranscodeDispatches{class, "withdrawn"}`. `IncorporatedThrough(seq-1)`: the block
   incorporated everything before the seq it withdraws. `WorkTranscodeTaskSubjectAnyPool` keeps its
   builder and gains a MediaFile-UID doc. `app/squash/task/withdraw_test.go` runs `Withdraw` on a
   membus against each row of §4.7's table (absent, below, requested, claimed, withdrawn, answered
   non-fact, an unincorporated fact refused with `records.ErrUnincorporatedFact`) and asserts the
   lease marker and the purge.
   A `Withdraw` error is written by the next pass as the block's message (`withdrawal failed: …`,
   §5.10) with the phase unchanged; the pass requeues. (`IncorporatedThrough(seq-1)`: the block
   incorporated everything before the seq it withdraws.) The task subject token is `events.tok`'s
   escaping, which `WorkTranscodeTaskSubject` applies to the UID; use the same helper it uses.

1. **The loop.** `remediationmanager.Options` gains `Admin events.StreamAdmin` (nil: `bus.(events.StreamAdmin)`),
   handed to the adapter. Step 1's NotFound: `if uid, open := r.ledger.Forget(nn); open { _ = transcodeWithdrawer.Withdraw(ctx, r.env, string(uid), math.MaxInt64) }`
   (an error is logged and left to the sweep).

2. **The sweep** (`admission/sweep.go`), moved from `transcodejob/withdraw.go:227-300` and re-keyed:

```go
// Sweep runs at the first pass and with every resync (§5.6): a task whose
// last token is a UID no cached MediaFile has is withdrawn with
// withdrawAll; a live file's task that is neither in flight nor granted is
// purged; then the durables of deleted profiles are deleted (sweepDurables,
// unchanged).
func (r *Reconciler) sweep(ctx context.Context, withdrawAll func(context.Context, string) error) error {
 subjects, err := r.Admin.Subjects(ctx, events.StreamWorkSquasharr, "clustarr.work.transcode.task.>")
 if err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("admission: sweep: list task subjects: %w", err)
 }
 var errs []error
 for _, subject := range subjects {
  uid := subjectUID(subject) // the last token, events.ParseKVKeyToken-inverted
  var l catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
  if err := r.Client.List(ctx, &l, client.MatchingFields{mfindex.UID: uid}, client.UnsafeDisableDeepCopy); err != nil {
   errs = append(errs, err)
   continue
  }
  switch {
  case len(l.Items) == 0:
   errs = append(errs, withdrawAll(ctx, uid))
  case !r.Ledger.InFlightOrGranted(types.UID(uid)):
   errs = append(errs, r.Admin.PurgeSubject(ctx, events.StreamWorkSquasharr, subject))
  }
 }
 return errors.Join(append(errs, r.sweepDurables(ctx))...)
}
```

   `withdrawAll` here is `r.Withdrawal.WithdrawAll` (`Reconciler.Withdrawal task.Withdrawal`).
   `sweepDurables` and `isPoolDurable` move from `transcodejob/withdraw.go` re-typed onto the cached
   profiles.

1. **The worker.** Before `Superseded`, `handle` calls `FactAlready(ctx, t, s.o.Options)`: the
   existing `producedEarlier`, `finishElsewhere` and `alreadySwappedOrChanged` checks
   (`run.go:533-600`), run against `t.Inputs` without encoding, returning a success `Outcome` when
   this dispatch's swap already happened. Its answer is written even over `withdrawn{S}` (§4.8), and
   any fact's failed `Answer` is retried with backoff (1 s doubling to 30 s) for `factAnswerTimeout`
   (10 minutes), whatever the lease says, before the nak.

```go
// Options is what the squash manager registration takes.
type Options struct {
 k8s.Options
 Slots             map[string]int32  // the per-hardware admission budget (--slots)
 DataDir           string            // the logical /data root the pools mount
 WorkerImage       string            // the image every pool and graft Job runs
 DataClaimName     string            // the RWX claim the pools mount at DataDir
 IntelRenderGroups []int64           // supplementalGroups for Intel pools
 NodeLabelNVIDIA   string            // the label marking an NVIDIA node
 NodeLabelIntel    string            // the label marking an Intel GPU node
 JobWindow         int               // most files per profile in a window phase (--job-window, loop spec §5.11)
 GraftConcurrency  int               // most audio grafts running at once (--graft-concurrency)
 Ledger            *admission.Ledger // shared with the remediation loop (cmd/manager builds it once)
 Logging           logging.Options   // rendered onto the pool workers' args
 Tracing           tracing.Options   // likewise
}

// namespacesOf is the namespaces admission rebuilds from: the manager's
// own when it is namespaced, else all (nil).
func namespacesOf(o k8s.Options) []string {
 if o.Namespace == "" {
  return nil
 }
 return []string{o.Namespace}
}

// Register adds transcode-admission, the slim TranscodeProfile reconciler
// (pools and status) and, until F7.3, the AudioGraft controller.
func Register(mgr ctrl.Manager, bus events.Bus, o Options) error {
 if bus == nil {
  return errors.New("squash manager: Register needs the bus")
 }
 if o.Ledger == nil {
  return errors.New("squash manager: Register needs the admission ledger the loop shares")
 }
 admin, ok := bus.(events.StreamAdmin)
 if !ok {
  return fmt.Errorf("squash manager: %T cannot administer streams", bus)
 }
 cfg := poolConfig(o)
 if err := (&admission.Reconciler{
  Client: mgr.GetClient(), APIReader: mgr.GetAPIReader(), Ledger: o.Ledger, Bus: bus, Admin: admin,
  Namespaces: namespacesOf(o.Options), Pool: cfg,
  Withdrawal: task.Withdrawal{Records: task.Requests(bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodes)),
   Leases: bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodeLeases), Admin: admin},
 }).SetupWithManager(mgr); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := (&transcodeprofile.Reconciler{
  Client: mgr.GetClient(), APIReader: mgr.GetAPIReader(), Ledger: o.Ledger, Pool: cfg,
  Recorder: mgr.GetEventRecorder("transcodeprofile"), Progress: bus.KV(events.BucketProgress),
 }).SetupWithManager(mgr); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 return (&audiograft.Reconciler{Client: mgr.GetClient(), APIReader: mgr.GetAPIReader(), Pool: cfg,
  Concurrency: o.GraftConcurrency}).SetupWithManager(mgr)
}
```

## Fold wave F7: graft

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: superpowers:subagent-driven-development or
> superpowers:executing-plans. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax. The Global Constraints of the
> split plan (`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-06-manager-agent-split.md`, "Global Constraints") bind
> every task here: path-scoped commits (`git commit -m '…' -- <every path>`), no `git stash`, no
> push, no `go get`/`go mod tidy`, the GPL header from `hack/boilerplate.go.txt` on every new `.go`
> file (the snippets below omit it), `gofumpt` and `goimports -local github.com/mediactl/clustarr`
> on every touched `.go` file, `make generate manifests` and the chart RBAC sync whenever an API type
> or an RBAC marker changes. No test added here runs the `ffmpeg` or `ffprobe` CLI of its own: the
> two envtests that need media reuse `app/import/worker/fileimport`'s `donorClip`, which W6.22
> converts to `internal/testmedia` with the rest of that file (U2).

**Spec:** loop spec (`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-06-mediafile-remediation-loop-design.md`) §2.6
(`status.graft`, the item's donor, when the block exists), §2.14 (how `status.audio.graft` derives;
readers that change), §3.3 (S2', S3', S15, S23), §3.5 (Copy partition: `graft`, `graftTag`,
`graftedAt` move to the graft planner in F7; why graft runs after transcode), §3.8 (effects),
§3.10 (the grafted-original takeover keyed on the flat `graftTag`), §3.12 (the item path derives the
donor), §3.14 (graft Jobs under `clustarr`, create-only), §3.18 (row `audiograft`), §4.3 (bucket
`clustarr-grafts`), §4.5-§4.10, §4.12 "Graft", §4.13, §4.14 (agent-import, agent-catalog and
manager rows), §5.4 (graft leaves admission reads), §5.5 (`FileView.JoinedGraft`), §5.6 step 2,
§5.7 step 9, §5.13, §5.17 (graft tests), §8.3 rows W3.12, W5.6, W5.7, W5.14, §8.6 "F7"; D8, D9, D10,
D42. ADR-0016. Owner rulings (`.superpowers/unify/rulings.md`, "ADR-0016 -- owner answers"): fold all
three kinds; every MediaFile watcher merges into the loop (the AudioGraft controller's included);
fold after `cmd/manager` exists.

**Depends on:** F6.7 (wave F6 gate) green, which carries F0-F5. Runs before F8.1.

**Order inside the wave:** serial, F7.1 → F7.2 → F7.3 → F7.4 → F7.5. F7.1 and F7.2 both edit the item
packages and `app/remediation`; F7.3 deletes what F7.1 and F7.2 leave without a caller.

**Commands.** `$ENVTEST go test …` means
`KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="$("$(go env GOPATH)/bin/setup-envtest" use 1.37.0 -p path)" go test …`; check
`-v` output for `SKIP` (a suite that finishes in milliseconds skipped). Chart RBAC sync uses the
split plan's `<scratchpad>/sync-chart-rbac.py <role>` (plan Wave 4d preamble: paste
`config/rbac/<role>_role.yaml`'s rules between the chart's BEGIN/END sentinels), saved once to the
executing session's scratchpad. Until W6.9 writes `RBAC_PATHS_manager`, the roles are still the
per-service ones (`RBAC_ROLES` in the `Makefile`): `./app/squash/...` markers land in
`config/rbac/squasharr_role.yaml`, `./app/import/...` in `importarr_role.yaml`,
`./app/catalog/...` in `catalogarr_role.yaml`, and `./app/remediation/...` in the role F3.1 added it
to (`grep -n remediation Makefile`).

## How the old and the new graft paths coexist inside this wave

Nothing between W4.13 and F8.12 is deployed (loop spec §8.2 rule 3, D1); every commit builds, vets
and passes the tests of the packages it touches.

- **F7.1** moves the donor onto the item. fileimport stops creating AudioGrafts and reduces the donor
  at import, so after F7.1 no new AudioGraft is ever made; the AudioGraft controller still compiles and
  is registered, with nothing to act on.
- **F7.2** builds the loop's graft planner, the graft Job on records, admission's graft slots, the
  transcode planner's join, and S15. From F7.2 the graft planner owns `status.graft`, `graftTag` and
  `graftedAt`. `grafttask.Task` changes additively (v2 fields beside the old `Graft` and `Mode`), so
  the AudioGraft controller keeps compiling until F7.3.
- **F7.3** deletes the AudioGraft controller, `app/squash/graftstate`, the termination-message
  reader, reduce mode and every AudioGraft reader except the MediaFile index release N keeps for
  F8.4's adoption, and empties `TestOnlyTheLoopWatchesMediaFile`'s allow-list.

`pkg/transcode/donoraudio/donoraudio_test.go`:

```go
package donoraudio_test

import (
 "context"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/transcode/donoraudio"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/transcode/engine"
)

func TestReducedPathIsTheStemAsMatroskaAudio(t *testing.T) {
 assert.Equal(t, "/d/x.mka", donoraudio.ReducedPath("/d/x.mkv"))
 assert.Equal(t, "/d/x.mka", donoraudio.ReducedPath("/d/x.mp4"))
 assert.Equal(t, "/d/x.MKA", donoraudio.ReducedPath("/d/x.MKA"), "Matroska audio is reduced already")
}

func TestPickComparesTheBaseLanguage(t *testing.T) {
 tracks := []engine.Track{{Index: 0, Language: "jpn"}, {Index: 1, Language: "eng"}}
 assert.Equal(t, 1, donoraudio.Pick(tracks, "en-US", false))
 assert.Equal(t, 0, donoraudio.Pick(tracks, "ja", false))
 assert.Equal(t, -1, donoraudio.Pick(tracks, "de", false))
 assert.Equal(t, -1, donoraudio.Pick([]engine.Track{{Index: 0}}, "ja", false))
 assert.Equal(t, 0, donoraudio.Pick([]engine.Track{{Index: 0}}, "ja", true), "a lone untagged track is the original")
}

// TestKeepTakesTheAnchorThenTheLanguagesOnce: what a reduction keeps (anime
// dual-audio spec §7.2): the anchor and every required language, which must
// all be there, then every optional language the donor carries.
func TestKeepTakesTheAnchorThenTheLanguagesOnce(t *testing.T) {
 tracks := []engine.Track{{Index: 0, Language: "jpn"}, {Index: 1, Language: "eng"}, {Index: 2, Language: "ger"}}
 keep, err := donoraudio.Keep(tracks, "ja", []string{"en"}, []string{"en", "de", "fr"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, []int{0, 1, 2}, keep)
 _, err = donoraudio.Keep(tracks, "ja", []string{"fr"}, nil)
 require.ErrorIs(t, err, donoraudio.ErrLacksLanguage)
 assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "fr")
 _, err = donoraudio.Keep(tracks, "ko", []string{"en"}, nil)
 require.ErrorIs(t, err, donoraudio.ErrLacksLanguage, "the anchor is required too")
}

func TestReduceReturnsAMatroskaAudioDonorUnopened(t *testing.T) {
 p := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "d.mka")
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(p, []byte("not media"), 0o644))
 got, err := donoraudio.Reduce(context.Background(), p, "ja", []string{"en"}, nil)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, p, got)
}

func TestReduceReusesAnEarlierReduction(t *testing.T) {
 dir := t.TempDir()
 mka := filepath.Join(dir, "d.mka")
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(mka, []byte("reduced"), 0o644))
 got, err := donoraudio.Reduce(context.Background(), filepath.Join(dir, "d.mkv"), "ja", []string{"en"}, nil)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, mka, got, "the .mkv is gone and its .mka stands: an earlier run reduced it")
}
```

```go
package rollup_test

import (
 "fmt"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 downloadv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/download/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/controller/rollup"
)

var donorT0 = time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

func donorDL(name, release, dest string, at time.Time, state downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhase, purpose downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPurpose) downloadv1alpha1.Download {
 dl := downloadv1alpha1.Download{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: "media"},
  Spec: downloadv1alpha1.DownloadSpec{Purpose: purpose, Release: commonv1.ReleaseInfo{Title: release},
   Target: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "perfect-blue"}},
 }
 if state != "" {
  ts := metav1.NewTime(at)
  dl.Status.Import = &downloadv1alpha1.ImportState{State: state, ImportedAt: &ts,
   Imported: []downloadv1alpha1.ImportedFile{{SourcePath: "x.mkv", DestPath: dest}}}
 }
 return dl
}

// TestDonorIsTheNewestImportedDonorDownload (loop spec §2.6): the item's
// donor is its newest audioDonor Download whose import finished.
func TestDonorIsTheNewestImportedDonorDownload(t *testing.T) {
 items := []downloadv1alpha1.Download{
  donorDL("old", "Old.DUAL-GRP", "/m/.clustarr/donors/u/old.mka", donorT0, downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImported, downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPurposeAudioDonor),
  donorDL("new", "New.DUAL-GRP", "/m/.clustarr/donors/u/new.mka", donorT0.Add(time.Hour), downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImported, downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPurposeAudioDonor),
 }
 got := rollup.Donor(items, nil, nil)
 require.NotNil(t, got)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor{Path: "/m/.clustarr/donors/u/new.mka", Release: "New.DUAL-GRP",
  DownloadRef: "new", ImportedAt: metav1.NewTime(donorT0.Add(time.Hour))}, *got)
}

// TestDonorIsCarriedForwardWhenItsDownloadIsGone: "carried forward from
// this status once seen, so deleting the Download loses nothing" (§2.6).
func TestDonorIsCarriedForwardWhenItsDownloadIsGone(t *testing.T) {
 prev := &catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor{Path: "/m/d.mka", Release: "Kept.DUAL-GRP", DownloadRef: "gone", ImportedAt: metav1.NewTime(donorT0)}
 assert.Equal(t, prev, rollup.Donor(nil, nil, prev))
 older := donorDL("older", "Older.DUAL-GRP", "/m/o.mka", donorT0.Add(-time.Hour), downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImported, downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPurposeAudioDonor)
 assert.Equal(t, prev, rollup.Donor([]downloadv1alpha1.Download{older}, nil, prev), "an older import never replaces the recorded donor")
}

func TestDonorIgnoresAVideoGrabAnUnfinishedImportAndAnotherOwner(t *testing.T) {
 video := donorDL("video", "Video", "/m/v.mkv", donorT0, downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImported, "")
 importing := donorDL("importing", "Importing", "/m/i.mka", donorT0, downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImporting, downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPurposeAudioDonor)
 foreign := donorDL("foreign", "Foreign", "/m/f.mka", donorT0, downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImported, downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPurposeAudioDonor)
 owns := func(d *downloadv1alpha1.Download) bool { return d.Name != "foreign" }
 assert.Nil(t, rollup.Donor([]downloadv1alpha1.Download{video, importing, foreign}, owns, nil))
}

// TestAppendRejectedAddsADonorFaultOnceAndKeepsTheNewest16 (§2.14
// "Rejected releases").
func TestAppendRejectedAddsADonorFaultOnceAndKeepsTheNewest16(t *testing.T) {
 failed := &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, DonorFault: true, DonorRelease: "Bad.DUAL-GRP"}
 got := rollup.AppendRejected(nil, failed)
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"Bad.DUAL-GRP"}, got)
 assert.Equal(t, got, rollup.AppendRejected(got, failed), "never twice")
 assert.Nil(t, rollup.AppendRejected(nil, &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, Reason: "JobLost", DonorRelease: "R"}),
  "a failure that is not the donor's rejects nothing")
 assert.Nil(t, rollup.AppendRejected(nil, nil))
 var many []string
 for i := range catalogv1alpha1.MaxRejectedReleases {
  many = append(many, fmt.Sprintf("R%02d", i))
 }
 got = rollup.AppendRejected(many, failed)
 require.Len(t, got, catalogv1alpha1.MaxRejectedReleases)
 assert.Equal(t, "R01", got[0], "the oldest is dropped")
 assert.Equal(t, "Bad.DUAL-GRP", got[len(got)-1])
}
```

```go
// TestAudioStateForReadsTheFilesGraftBlock (loop spec §2.14, "How
// audio.graft derives"): the item reads the file's status.graft and its own
// donor, never an AudioGraft.
func TestAudioStateForReadsTheFilesGraftBlock(t *testing.T) {
 p := &quality.Profile{AudioLanguages: []string{"en", "original"}, AudioGraft: true}
 mf := func(tag string, langs ...string) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
  var a []commonv1.AudioStream
  for _, l := range langs {
   a = append(a, commonv1.AudioStream{Language: l})
  }
  return &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{Status: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{GraftTag: tag, MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{Audio: a}}}
 }
 block := func(phase catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase, reason string, segs int) *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState {
  b := &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: phase, Reason: reason, Message: "why"}
  for range segs {
   b.Segments = append(b.Segments, catalogv1alpha1.GraftSegment{LengthMillis: 1})
  }
  return b
 }
 donor := &catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor{Path: "/m/d.mka", Release: "D.DUAL-GRP", ImportedAt: metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))}
 cases := []struct {
  name   string
  file   *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  g      rollup.GraftObservation
  want   string
  reason string
 }{
  {"missing, no donor", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{}, "searching", ""},
  {"a donor downloads", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{DonorDownloading: true}, "grabbed", ""},
  {"a donor and no block yet", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor}, "pending", ""},
  {"waiting", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, "WaitingForSlot", 0)}, "pending", ""},
  {"queued", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, "", 0)}, "pending", ""},
  {"running, not aligned", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, "", 0)}, "pending", ""},
  {"aligned and muxing", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, "", 1)}, "aligned", ""},
  {"swapped, awaiting the probe", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, "Grafted", 1)}, "pending", ""},
  {"failed", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, "AlignmentRejected", 0)}, "failed", "AlignmentRejected: why"},
  {"a new donor beats a failed graft", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{DonorDownloading: true, Donor: donor, File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, "AlignmentRejected", 0)}, "grabbed", ""},
  {"a multi-episode file is never grafted", mf("", "jpn"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, MultiItem: true}, "failed", rollup.ReasonMultiItemFile},
  {"grafted", mf("tag-1", "jpn", "eng"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded, "Grafted", 1)}, "done", ""},
  {"grafted, the block since gone", mf("tag-1", "jpn", "eng"), rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor}, "done", ""},
  {"never needed one", mf("", "jpn", "eng"), rollup.GraftObservation{}, "none", ""},
  {"unknown audio", mf("", "und"), rollup.GraftObservation{File: block(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, "x", 0)}, "none", ""},
 }
 for _, c := range cases {
  got := rollup.AudioStateFor(p, "ja", c.file, c.g)
  require.NotNil(t, got, c.name)
  require.Equal(t, c.want, got.Graft, c.name)
  require.Equal(t, c.reason, got.Reason, c.name)
 }
}

// TestAudioStateCarriesTheDonorWithoutAFile: "status.audio is rendered
// whenever the item has a donor or rejected releases, even with no file"
// (§2.6).
func TestAudioStateCarriesTheDonorWithoutAFile(t *testing.T) {
 p := &quality.Profile{AudioLanguages: []string{"en", "original"}, AudioGraft: true}
 donor := &catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor{Path: "/m/d.mka", Release: "D", ImportedAt: metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))}
 got := rollup.AudioStateFor(p, "ja", nil, rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor, Rejected: []string{"Bad"}})
 require.Equal(t, &catalogv1alpha1.AudioState{Wanted: []string{"en", "ja"}, Donor: donor, RejectedReleases: []string{"Bad"}}, got)
 require.Nil(t, rollup.AudioStateFor(p, "ja", nil, rollup.GraftObservation{}), "no file and no donor: nothing to say")
 require.Equal(t, &catalogv1alpha1.AudioState{Donor: donor}, rollup.AudioStateFor(nil, "ja", nil, rollup.GraftObservation{Donor: donor}),
  "the donor outlives an unresolved profile")
}
```

```go
// ffgoOrSkip skips without FFmpeg 9's libraries, which the reduction loads
// through ffgo (the gate app/squash/worker/graft's tests use).
func ffgoOrSkip(t *testing.T) {
 t.Helper()
 if err := ffgo.Init(); err != nil {
  t.Skipf("no FFmpeg libraries: %v", err)
 }
 if _, avcodec, _ := ffgo.Version(); avcodec>>16 != 63 {
  t.Skip("not FFmpeg 9")
 }
}

// TestADonorIsReducedBesideTheLibraryAtImport (loop spec §4.12, D8): a
// donor makes no MediaFile and no AudioGraft; its file is cut down to the
// anchor's and the missing languages' audio as <stem>.mka under the item's
// donor folder, and that .mka is the import's destPath, which the item's
// key reads into status.audio.donor.
func TestADonorIsReducedBesideTheLibraryAtImport(t *testing.T) {
 ffgoOrSkip(t)
 ctx := context.Background()
 f := newFixture(t, "fi-donor")
 contentRoot := dataDir(t, "scratch")
 copyOf(t, donorClip(t, "eng", "jpn", "ger"))(filepath.Join(contentRoot, "The.Matrix.1999.DVDRip.x264.AAC.DL-BoB.mkv"))
 dl := f.donorFor(t, "donor-dl", contentRoot)

 require.NoError(t, f.worker.Handle(ctx, newImportTaskMessage(t, f.ns, dl.Name, "")))

 var got downloadv1alpha1.Download
 require.NoError(t, f.api.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(dl), &got))
 require.NotNil(t, got.Status.Import)
 require.Equal(t, downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImported, got.Status.Import.State, got.Status.Import.Message)
 require.Len(t, got.Status.Import.Imported, 1)
 assert.Empty(t, got.Status.Import.Imported[0].MediaFileRef, "a donor is no library file")
 var movie catalogv1alpha1.Movie
 require.NoError(t, f.api.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: f.ns, Name: f.movieName}, &movie))
 folder := filepath.Join(f.mediaRoot, ".clustarr", "donors", string(movie.UID))
 want := filepath.Join(folder, f.movieName+".mka")
 assert.Equal(t, want, got.Status.Import.Imported[0].DestPath, "the reduced audio is the donor")
 assert.NoFileExists(t, filepath.Join(folder, f.movieName+".mkv"), "the donor's video left the library at import")
 tracks, err := engine.AudioTracks(want)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var langs []string
 for _, tr := range tracks {
  langs = append(langs, tr.Language)
 }
 assert.ElementsMatch(t, []string{"jpn", "eng"}, langs, "the anchor and the missing language; the German dub is not kept")

 var files catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
 require.NoError(t, f.api.List(ctx, &files, client.InNamespace(f.ns)))
 assert.Empty(t, files.Items)
 var grafts transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftList
 require.NoError(t, f.api.List(ctx, &grafts, client.InNamespace(f.ns)))
 assert.Empty(t, grafts.Items, "fileimport makes no AudioGraft (loop spec §2.14)")
}

// TestADonorThatCannotBeReducedIsRetriedThenBlocked: a reduction that
// fails for any reason but the release's is retried by redelivery, and the
// final delivery blocks the import without blocklisting the release.
func TestADonorThatCannotBeReducedIsRetriedThenBlocked(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 f := newFixture(t, "fi-donor-reduce")
 contentRoot := dataDir(t, "scratch")
 copyOf(t, donorClip(t, "eng", "jpn"))(filepath.Join(contentRoot, "The.Matrix.1999.DVDRip.x264.AAC.DL-BoB.mkv"))
 dl := f.donorFor(t, "donor-reduce-dl", contentRoot)
 f.worker.ReduceDonor = func(context.Context, string, string, []string) (string, error) {
  return "", errors.New("libavformat: I/O error")
 }

 require.ErrorContains(t, f.worker.Handle(ctx, newImportTaskMessage(t, f.ns, dl.Name, "")), "I/O error",
  "a delivery before the last is retried")

 spec, ok := events.Default().Consumer(events.ConsumerImportFile)
 require.True(t, ok)
 last := newImportTaskMessage(t, f.ns, dl.Name, "")
 last.attempt = uint64(spec.MaxDeliver)
 require.NoError(t, f.worker.Handle(ctx, last))
 var got downloadv1alpha1.Download
 require.NoError(t, f.api.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(dl), &got))
 require.NotNil(t, got.Status.Import)
 assert.Equal(t, downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseBlocked, got.Status.Import.State)
 assert.NotEqual(t, downloadv1alpha1.ImportMessageEveryFileRejected, got.Status.Import.Message, "not the release's fault: never blocklisted")
 assert.Contains(t, got.Status.Import.Message, "I/O error")
}

// TestADonorLackingALanguageAtReductionIsTheReleasesFault: the reduction's
// own language check (a donor whose tags the probe and the demuxer read
// differently) is the release's fault, as the probe's is.
func TestADonorLackingALanguageAtReductionIsTheReleasesFault(t *testing.T) {

 f := newFixture(t, "fi-donor-lacks-reduce")

 copyOf(t, donorClip(t, "eng", "jpn"))(filepath.Join(contentRoot, "The.Matrix.1999.DVDRip.x264.AAC.DL-BoB.mkv"))
 dl := f.donorFor(t, "donor-lacks-reduce-dl", contentRoot)
 f.worker.ReduceDonor = func(context.Context, string, string, []string) (string, error) {
  return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: the donor needs tagged ja and en tracks; it has jpn", donoraudio.ErrLacksLanguage)
 }
 require.NoError(t, f.worker.Handle(ctx, newImportTaskMessage(t, f.ns, dl.Name, "")))
 var got downloadv1alpha1.Download
 require.NoError(t, f.api.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(dl), &got))
 require.NotNil(t, got.Status.Import)
 assert.Equal(t, downloadv1alpha1.ImportMessageEveryFileRejected, got.Status.Import.Message)
}

// TestANewDonorRemovesTheItemsRecordedOne: the item's status.audio.donor
// names the donor a graft reads; a newer donor's import removes the old one
// from disk (§2.14).
func TestANewDonorRemovesTheItemsRecordedOne(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 f := newFixture(t, "fi-donor-replace")
 contentRoot := dataDir(t, "scratch")
 copyOf(t, donorClip(t, "eng", "jpn"))(filepath.Join(contentRoot, "The.Matrix.1999.DVDRip.x264.AAC.DL-BoB.mkv"))
 dl := f.donorFor(t, "donor-replace-dl", contentRoot)
 var movie catalogv1alpha1.Movie
 require.NoError(t, f.api.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: f.ns, Name: f.movieName}, &movie))
 folder := filepath.Join(f.mediaRoot, ".clustarr", "donors", string(movie.UID))
 old := filepath.Join(folder, "older.mka")
 require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(folder, 0o755))
 require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(old, []byte("old donor"), 0o644))
 // donorFor applied metadata and audio under catalogarr; re-declare both
 // with the recorded donor, or this apply would release them.
 _, err := k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, f.c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr, catalogac.Movie(f.movieName, f.ns).WithStatus(catalogac.MovieStatus().
  WithMetadata(catalogac.MovieMetadata().WithTitle("The Matrix").WithYear(1999).WithOriginalLanguage("ja")).
  WithAudio(catalogac.AudioState().WithWanted("en", "ja").WithPresent("ja").WithMissing("en").WithGraft("grabbed").
   WithDonor(catalogac.AudioDonor().WithPath(old).WithRelease("Older.DUAL-GRP").WithImportedAt(metav1.NewTime(time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)))))))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 waitFor(t, 5*time.Second, func() bool {
  var m catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  return f.c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: f.ns, Name: f.movieName}, &m) == nil && m.Status.Audio != nil && m.Status.Audio.Donor != nil
 })
 reduced := filepath.Join(folder, f.movieName+".mka")
 f.worker.ReduceDonor = func(_ context.Context, src, anchor string, langs []string) (string, error) {
  assert.Equal(t, "ja", anchor)
  assert.Equal(t, []string{"en"}, langs)
  if err := os.WriteFile(reduced, []byte("reduced"), 0o644); err != nil {
   return "", err
  }
  return reduced, os.Remove(src)
 }
 require.NoError(t, f.worker.Handle(ctx, newImportTaskMessage(t, f.ns, dl.Name, "")))
 assert.NoFileExists(t, old, "the superseded donor is removed")
 assert.FileExists(t, reduced)
}
```

```go
// donorDownload creates an imported audio donor Download owned by owner, its
// status.import written as fileimport writes it.
func donorDownload(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, c client.Client, owner client.Object, kind commonv1.MediaKind, name, release, dest string) *downloadv1alpha1.Download {
 t.Helper()
 nzb := "http://idx/" + name + ".nzb"
 dl := &downloadv1alpha1.Download{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: owner.GetNamespace()},
  Spec: downloadv1alpha1.DownloadSpec{
   Protocol: commonv1.ProtocolUsenet, Source: downloadv1alpha1.DownloadSource{NZBURL: &nzb},
   Release: commonv1.ReleaseInfo{GUID: "g-" + name, IndexerRef: "idx", Title: release, Protocol: commonv1.ProtocolUsenet},
   Target:  commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: kind, Name: owner.GetName()},
   Purpose: downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPurposeAudioDonor, QualityProfileRef: "dual",
  },
 }
 require.NoError(t, controllerutil.SetOwnerReference(owner, dl, k8s.MustNewScheme()))
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, dl))
 _, err := k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerImportarr, downloadac.Download(name, dl.Namespace).WithStatus(downloadac.DownloadStatus().
  WithImport(downloadac.ImportState().WithState(downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImported).WithImportedAt(metav1.Now()).
   WithImported(downloadac.ImportedFile().WithSourcePath("x.mkv").WithDestPath(dest)))))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 return dl
}

// itemCache is a started manager (its cache carrying the loop's indexes,
// which ReconcileItem reads through) and an uncached client for the test.
func itemCache(t *testing.T) (ctrl.Manager, client.Client) {
 t.Helper()
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 mgr := starttest.NewManager(t, env.Config)
 require.NoError(t, remediation.RegisterIndexes(t.Context(), mgr.GetFieldIndexer()))
 starttest.Start(t, mgr)
 require.True(t, mgr.GetCache().WaitForCacheSync(t.Context()))
 return mgr, starttest.Client(t, env.Config)
}

func TestTheMovieRecordsItsDonorAndRejectsAFaultedRelease(t *testing.T) {

  Spec: catalogv1alpha1.MovieSpec{TmdbID: 10494, QualityProfileRef: qp.Name, RootFolderRef: "movies", Monitored: new(false)}}

  WithMetadata(catalogac.MovieMetadata().WithTitle("Perfect Blue").WithYear(1997).WithOriginalLanguage("ja").WithRefreshedAt(metav1.Now()))))

   Path: "/data/media/movies/Perfect Blue (1997)/Perfect Blue (1997).mkv"}}

 probe := catalogac.MediaFileStatus().WithProbeHash("h1").WithMediaInfo(commonv1.MediaInfo{Audio: []commonv1.AudioStream{{Language: "jpn"}}})
 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr, catalogac.MediaFile(mf.Name, ns).WithStatus(probe))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(m), m))
 dl := donorDownload(t, ctx, c, m, commonv1.MediaKindMovie, "perfect-blue-donor", "Perfect.Blue.1997.DVDRip.DUAL-GRP",
  "/data/media/movies/.clustarr/donors/"+string(m.UID)+"/perfect-blue.mka")

 r := &movie.Reconciler{Client: cached, Scheme: mgr.GetScheme(), Recorder: mgr.GetEventRecorder("movie"), Bus: starttest.MemBus(t)}
 nn := client.ObjectKeyFromObject(m)
 settle := func(what string, ok func(catalogv1alpha1.Movie) bool) catalogv1alpha1.Movie {
  t.Helper()
  var got catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
   if _, err := r.ReconcileItem(ctx, nn); err != nil {
    return false
   }
   return c.Get(ctx, nn, &got) == nil && got.Status.Audio != nil && ok(got)
  }, 20*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond, what)
  return got
 }

 got := settle("status.audio.donor from the imported donor Download", func(m catalogv1alpha1.Movie) bool { return m.Status.Audio.Donor != nil })
 assert.Equal(t, "Perfect.Blue.1997.DVDRip.DUAL-GRP", got.Status.Audio.Donor.Release)
 assert.Equal(t, dl.Name, got.Status.Audio.Donor.DownloadRef)
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"en"}, got.Status.Audio.Missing)
 assert.Equal(t, "pending", got.Status.Audio.Graft, "a donor and no graft block yet")

 require.NoError(t, c.Delete(ctx, dl))
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  var gone downloadv1alpha1.Download
  return apierrors.IsNotFound(cached.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(dl), &gone))
 }, 10*time.Second, 50*time.Millisecond, "the cache never saw the Download go")
 got = settle("the donor outlives its Download", func(m catalogv1alpha1.Movie) bool { return m.Status.Audio.Donor != nil })
 assert.Equal(t, dl.Name, got.Status.Audio.Donor.DownloadRef)

 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr, catalogac.MediaFile(mf.Name, ns).WithStatus(probe.
  WithGraft(catalogac.GraftState().WithPhase(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed).WithReason("AlignmentRejected").WithMessage("drift").
   WithDonorRelease("Perfect.Blue.1997.DVDRip.DUAL-GRP").WithDonorFault(true).WithProbeHash("h1"))))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 got = settle("the donor's release is rejected", func(m catalogv1alpha1.Movie) bool { return len(m.Status.Audio.RejectedReleases) == 1 })
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"Perfect.Blue.1997.DVDRip.DUAL-GRP"}, got.Status.Audio.RejectedReleases)
 assert.Equal(t, "failed", got.Status.Audio.Graft)
 assert.Equal(t, "AlignmentRejected: drift", got.Status.Audio.Reason)
 _, err = r.ReconcileItem(ctx, nn)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, nn, &got))
 assert.Len(t, got.Status.Audio.RejectedReleases, 1, "a second pass appends nothing")
}
```

```go
// TestFileSignatureMovesWithTheGraftBlock (loop spec §3.3 S1'): the item
// key wakes when its file's graft phase or tag changes, which is how
// status.audio.graft follows the graft.
func TestFileSignatureMovesWithTheGraftBlock(t *testing.T) {
 mf := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{Status: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeHash: "h1"}}
 base := FileSignature(mf)
 waiting := mf.DeepCopy()
 waiting.Status.Graft = &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting}
 assert.NotEqual(t, base, FileSignature(waiting))
 failed := waiting.DeepCopy()
 failed.Status.Graft.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed
 assert.NotEqual(t, FileSignature(waiting), FileSignature(failed))
 tagged := mf.DeepCopy()
 tagged.Status.GraftTag = "tag-1"
 assert.NotEqual(t, base, FileSignature(tagged))
 message := waiting.DeepCopy()
 message.Status.Graft.Message = "another wait message"
 assert.Equal(t, FileSignature(waiting), FileSignature(message), "a message alone wakes no item")
}
```

3a. `pkg/transcode/donoraudio/donoraudio.go` (the bodies of `pick`, `describe` and `reducedPath` move
here verbatim from `app/squash/worker/graft/graft.go`, renamed):

```go
// Package donoraudio cuts an audio donor down to the tracks a graft needs
// (anime dual-audio spec §7.2; loop spec §4.12): fileimport reduces a donor
// at import, and the graft run reduces a donor imported before it did. It
// loads FFmpeg through pkg/transcode/engine, so only the agent's import
// domain and cmd/transcode link it, never the manager.
package donoraudio

import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "slices"
 "strings"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/fsops"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/lang"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/obs/logging"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/transcode/engine"
)

// ErrLacksLanguage is a donor without the anchor or a required language:
// the release's fault, never retried for this donor.
var ErrLacksLanguage = errors.New("the donor lacks a language")

// ReducedPath is where a donor's audio lives once reduced: the donor
// itself when it is Matroska audio, else its stem as .mka.
func ReducedPath(donor string) string {
 if strings.EqualFold(filepath.Ext(donor), ".mka") {
  return donor
 }
 return strings.TrimSuffix(donor, filepath.Ext(donor)) + ".mka"
}

// Pick is graft.go's pick, moved: the first track in language l (BCP-47
// base compared); with untagged, a lone untagged track counts.
func Pick(tracks []engine.Track, l string, untagged bool) int { /* graft.go:369-386 verbatim */ }

// Describe is graft.go's describe, moved.
func Describe(tracks []engine.Track) string { /* graft.go:388-397 verbatim */ }

// Keep is the audio a reduction keeps: the anchor's track and each
// required language's, all of which must be there, then each optional
// language's the donor carries, every track once.
func Keep(tracks []engine.Track, anchor string, required, optional []string) ([]int, error) {
 var keep []int
 add := func(i int) {
  if i >= 0 && !slices.Contains(keep, i) {
   keep = append(keep, i)
  }
 }
 for _, l := range append([]string{anchor}, required...) {
  i := Pick(tracks, l, false)
  if i < 0 {
   return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: the donor needs tagged %s and %s tracks; it has %s",
    ErrLacksLanguage, anchor, strings.Join(required, ", "), Describe(tracks))
  }
  add(i)
 }
 for _, l := range optional {
  add(Pick(tracks, l, false))
 }
 return keep, nil
}

// Reduce cuts src, a local path, to the audio Keep picks, written as
// ReducedPath(src) through a part file, and removes src. A Matroska audio
// src is returned unopened, and so is the .mka an earlier run left when
// src is gone.
func Reduce(ctx context.Context, src, anchor string, required, optional []string) (string, error) {
 if strings.EqualFold(filepath.Ext(src), ".mka") {
  return src, nil
 }
 mka := ReducedPath(src)
 if exists(mka) && !exists(src) {
  return mka, nil
 }
 tracks, err := engine.AudioTracks(src)
 if err != nil {
  return "", fmt.Errorf("read the donor's tracks: %w", err)
 }
 keep, err := Keep(tracks, anchor, required, optional)
 if err != nil {
  return "", err
 }
 part := strings.TrimSuffix(src, filepath.Ext(src)) + ".part.mka"
 if err := engine.ExtractAudio(ctx, src, part, keep); err != nil {
  _ = os.Remove(part)
  return "", fmt.Errorf("extract the donor's audio: %w", err)
 }
 if err := fsops.MoveAtomic(part, mka); err != nil {
  _ = os.Remove(part)
  return "", fmt.Errorf("place the donor's audio: %w", err)
 }
 if err := os.Remove(src); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
  logging.FromContext(ctx).Info("donoraudio: the donor's source stays", "path", src, "error", err)
 }
 return mka, nil
}

func exists(p string) bool { _, err := os.Stat(p); return err == nil }
```

```go
// reduceDonor is the donor's audio as <stem>.mka (donoraudio.Reduce): a
// donor imported before fileimport reduced at import still arrives whole.
func (r *run) reduceDonor(ctx context.Context, donor string) (string, grafttask.Result, bool) {
 mka, err := donoraudio.Reduce(ctx, donor, r.t.Anchor, []string{r.t.Language}, r.t.Languages)
 switch {
 case errors.Is(err, donoraudio.ErrLacksLanguage):
  return "", grafttask.Failed(grafttask.ReasonDonorLacksLanguage, "%v", err), false
 case err != nil:
  return "", grafttask.Failed(grafttask.ReasonError, "%v", err), false
 }
 return mka, grafttask.Result{}, true
}
```

3e. `app/catalog/controller/rollup/donor.go`:

```go
package rollup

// Donor is status.audio.donor (loop spec §2.6): the newest audioDonor
// Download among items that owns passes whose import finished with a
// destination, else prev, the donor the item recorded before -- carried
// forward, so deleting the Download loses nothing. A Download imported no
// later than prev never replaces it.
func Donor(items []downloadv1alpha1.Download, owns func(*downloadv1alpha1.Download) bool, prev *catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor) *catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor {
 best := prev.DeepCopy()
 for i := range items {
  dl := &items[i]
  if !dl.Spec.IsDonor() || (owns != nil && !owns(dl)) {
   continue
  }
  st := dl.Status.Import
  if st == nil || st.State != downloadv1alpha1.ImportPhaseImported || st.ImportedAt == nil {
   continue
  }
  dest := ""
  for _, f := range st.Imported {
   if f.DestPath != "" {
    dest = f.DestPath
   }
  }
  if dest == "" {
   continue
  }
  if best != nil && (!st.ImportedAt.After(best.ImportedAt.Time) && !(st.ImportedAt.Equal(&best.ImportedAt) && dl.Name > best.DownloadRef)) {
   continue
  }
  best = &catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor{Path: dest, Release: dl.Spec.Release.Title, DownloadRef: dl.Name, ImportedAt: *st.ImportedAt.DeepCopy()}
 }
 return best
}

// AppendRejected is status.audio.rejectedReleases (§2.14): prev, plus the
// donor release of a graft that failed by the donor's fault, once; the
// oldest dropped past catalogv1alpha1.MaxRejectedReleases.
func AppendRejected(prev []string, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState) []string {
 out := slices.Clone(prev)
 if b == nil || b.Phase != catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed || !b.DonorFault || b.DonorRelease == "" || slices.Contains(out, b.DonorRelease) {
  return out
 }
 out = append(out, b.DonorRelease)
 if n := len(out); n > catalogv1alpha1.MaxRejectedReleases {
  out = out[n-catalogv1alpha1.MaxRejectedReleases:]
 }
 return out
}
```

  (`AudioStateAC` clamps `Release` to `MaxReleaseTitleLength` and drops an unsendable path, F2.3,
  so `Donor` copies the title as it is.)

3f. `app/catalog/controller/rollup/audiostate.go`:

```go
// ReasonMultiItemFile is status.audio.reason when the item's file backs
// several items (spec.mediaRef.keys): such a file is never grafted (loop
// spec §2.6, D10).
const ReasonMultiItemFile = "MultiItemFile"

// GraftObservation is what the item's key sees of a graft: an open donor
// Download, the donor it recorded, the releases it rejected, its file's
// status.graft, and whether that file backs several items.
type GraftObservation struct {
 DonorDownloading bool
 Donor            *catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor
 Rejected         []string
 File             *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState
 MultiItem        bool
}

// AudioStateFor is status.audio (anime dual-audio spec §5.3; loop spec
// §2.6, §2.14). With no file or no audio policy it carries only the donor
// and the rejected releases (nil when there are none either).
func AudioStateFor(p *quality.Profile, originalTag string, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, g GraftObservation) *catalogv1alpha1.AudioState {
 policy := p != nil && len(p.AudioLanguages) > 0
 if mf == nil || !policy {
  if g.Donor == nil && len(g.Rejected) == 0 {
   return nil
  }
  st := &catalogv1alpha1.AudioState{Donor: g.Donor.DeepCopy(), RejectedReleases: slices.Clone(g.Rejected)}
  if policy {
   st.Wanted = wantedTags(p, originalTag)
  }
  return st
 }
 st := &catalogv1alpha1.AudioState{Wanted: wantedTags(p, originalTag), Donor: g.Donor.DeepCopy(), RejectedReleases: slices.Clone(g.Rejected)}
 // … Present and Missing exactly as today …
 if p.AudioGraft {
  st.Graft, st.Reason = graftState(len(st.Missing) > 0, g, mf.Status.GraftTag)
 }
 return st
}

// wantedTags is today's loop over p.AudioLanguages, moved out of AudioStateFor.
func wantedTags(p *quality.Profile, originalTag string) []string { /* the for-loop of today's AudioStateFor */ }

// graftState is status.audio.graft and, when failed, why (§2.14).
func graftState(missing bool, g GraftObservation, graftTag string) (string, string) {
 b := g.File
 if !missing {
  if graftTag != "" || b != nil && b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded && b.Reason == "Grafted" {
   return "done", ""
  }
  return "none", ""
 }
 switch {
 case g.MultiItem:
  return "failed", ReasonMultiItemFile
 case g.DonorDownloading:
  return "grabbed", ""
 case b == nil && g.Donor == nil:
  return "searching", ""
 case b == nil:
  return "pending", ""
 case b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed:
  reason := b.Reason
  if b.Message != "" {
   reason += ": " + b.Message
  }
  if len(reason) > catalogv1alpha1.MaxAudioReasonLength {
   reason = reason[:catalogv1alpha1.MaxAudioReasonLength]
  }
  return "failed", strings.ToValidUTF8(reason, "")
 case b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning && len(b.Segments) > 0:
  return "aligned", ""
 }
 return "pending", ""
}
```

  imports they used.

### Task F7.2: `app/squash/graftplan`, the `graft` adapter, the graft Job on records, graft slots, S15 and the join

**Spec:** loop spec §2.6 (block, existence, phases and reasons), §3.3 (S2', S3' carry the item's donor
inputs; S15), §3.5 (`graft`, `graftTag`, `graftedAt` are the graft planner's from F7; why graft runs
after transcode; the graft planner reads the transcode record while a join is unincorporated),
§3.8 (`RecordWrite`, `CreateGraftJob`, `LedgerConfirm`; owed effects), §3.10, §3.14 (graft Jobs under
`clustarr`, create-only), §4.3, §4.5-§4.10, §4.12 "Graft" (vehicle, task, answer, pod, loop rows),
§4.13, §4.14 (manager row: the graft `batch/jobs` verbs), §5.4, §5.5 (`FileView.JoinedGraft`), §5.6
step 2, §5.7 step 9, §5.8 step 4, §5.13, §5.17 (`TestGraftSlotsCountJobsStatusAndGrants`,
`TestGraftJobNameIsTheDispatchIdentity`, `TestAPanickingGraftPlannerNeverLeavesAJoinedTaskBesideAWaitingBlock`),
§4.15 (`TestAGraftJobWithoutARecordFailsJobLost`), §8.6 F7.2; D9, D42.

**Deviations, each with its reason (also spec defects, below):**

1. The Job is named `k8s.LabelSafeName(mf, "graft", seq)` (63) and labelled
   `squasharr.clustarr.io/graft-of: <MediaFile UID>`, not `k8s.ChildName` and the MediaFile's name:
   a Job name over 63 characters is refused and a label value is capped at 63, while MediaFile names
   are `ChildName`-built (up to 253). S15 maps a Job to its file by its controller owner reference.
2. A graft Job's deletion after its answer is an effect of its own, `DeleteGraftJob`, which §3.8's
   list lacks.
3. An in-flight block (`Queued`, `Running`, `Swapping`, or a withdrawn dispatch inside
   `graftplan.FactWindow`) is kept until it resolves even when §2.6's existence conditions fail.
4. S2' and S3' also carry the item's `status.audio.donor` and `status.audio.missing`, which the graft
   planner reads; without them a donor appearing on the item never wakes its file.
5. The graft's `records.FactWindow` is `graftplan.FactWindow` = the Job's deadline plus `JobGrace`
   (2 h 2 m); §4.10 defines it per remediation.
6. A graft pod finding no record waits up to `grafttask.ClaimWait` (2 min) for the loop's owed write,
   then exits 1 (a Job has no nak); the planner's lost-Job path retries.
7. `grafttask.Task` gains the v2 fields beside its old `Graft` and `Mode`, which F7.3 deletes with
   the AudioGraft controller that still sets them.

```go
package grafttask_test

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "strings"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"

// TestTheGraftFactIsAGraftedSuccess (§4.12): only a graft that swapped the
// file is a fact, written over a withdrawal and never overwritten.
func TestTheGraftFactIsAGraftedSuccess(t *testing.T) {
 fact := func(phase, reason string) bool {
  return grafttask.Spec.Fact(grafttask.Record{Answer: &grafttask.Result{Phase: phase, Reason: reason}})
 }
 assert.True(t, fact(grafttask.PhaseSucceeded, grafttask.ReasonGrafted))
 assert.False(t, fact(grafttask.PhaseSucceeded, grafttask.ReasonPresent))
 assert.False(t, fact(grafttask.PhaseFailed, grafttask.ReasonMuxFailed))
 assert.False(t, grafttask.Spec.Fact(grafttask.Record{}))
 assert.Equal(t, "graft", grafttask.Spec.Remediation)
 assert.Equal(t, grafttask.MaxRecordBytes, grafttask.Spec.MaxValue)
 assert.True(t, grafttask.Spec.Answered(records.StateAnswered))
 assert.True(t, grafttask.Spec.Answered(records.StateFailed))
 assert.False(t, grafttask.Spec.Answered(records.StateClaimed))
}

// TestAGraftRecordFitsItsBucket replaces TestAResultFitsATerminationMessage
// (F7.3 deletes Encode/Decode): the worst answer -- 16 segments, a full
// message, every path at PATH_MAX -- fits clustarr-grafts' value cap.
func TestAGraftRecordFitsItsBucket(t *testing.T) {
 r := grafttask.Failed(grafttask.ReasonMuxFailed, "%s", strings.Repeat("<&>é", 2000))
 r.Segments = make([]grafttask.Segment, 16)
 r.DonorAudio = "/" + strings.Repeat("d", 4095)
 at := time.Now()
 rec := grafttask.Record{
  RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: grafttask.RecordSchema, MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: strings.Repeat("n", 63), Name: strings.Repeat("m", 253), UID: strings.Repeat("u", 36)},
   Seq: 1 << 62, State: records.StateAnswered, AnsweredAt: &at, Writer: strings.Repeat("p", 253), Failure: strings.Repeat("f", 1024)},
  Inputs: grafttask.Inputs{TargetProbeHash: strings.Repeat("h", 128), DonorAudio: "/" + strings.Repeat("d", 4095),
   DonorRelease: strings.Repeat("r", 512), Language: strings.Repeat("l", 35), Anchor: strings.Repeat("a", 35)},
  Answer: &r,
 }
 b, err := json.Marshal(rec)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.LessOrEqual(t, len(b), grafttask.MaxRecordBytes)
}

func TestATaskV2RoundTripsAndAJoinedTaskCarriesNoRecordFields(t *testing.T) {
 in := grafttask.Task{Schema: grafttask.TaskSchema, File: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "pb", UID: "u1"}, Item: "i1", Seq: 7,
  Inputs: grafttask.Inputs{TargetProbeHash: "h1", DonorAudio: "/d.mka", DonorRelease: "R", Language: "en", Anchor: "ja"},
  Target: "/t.mkv", TargetProbeHash: "h1", Root: "/r", Donor: "/d.mka", Language: "en", Languages: []string{"en"}, Anchor: "ja"}
 b, err := json.Marshal(in)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var out grafttask.Task
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(b, &out))
 assert.Equal(t, in, out)
 joined, err := json.Marshal(grafttask.Task{Target: "/t.mkv", Language: "en"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.NotContains(t, string(joined), `"file"`, "a joined task is fenced by its transcode's record")
 assert.NotContains(t, string(joined), `"inputs"`)
}
```
