`app/squash/grafttask/serve_internal_test.go` (package `grafttask`):

```go
package grafttask

import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/schema"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/records"
)

type fakeAnswerer struct {
 calls      []string
 superseded bool
 notYet     int // Claim answers (0, false, nil) this many times first
 answerErrs int // Answer fails this many times first
 answered   *Record
}

func (f *fakeAnswerer) Superseded(context.Context, string, int64) (bool, error) {
 f.calls = append(f.calls, "superseded")
 return f.superseded, nil
}

func (f *fakeAnswerer) Claim(_ context.Context, _ string, rec Record) (uint64, bool, error) {
 f.calls = append(f.calls, "claim")
 if rec.State != records.StateClaimed {
  return 0, false, errors.New("a claim must say claimed")
 }
 if f.notYet > 0 {
  f.notYet--
  return 0, false, nil
 }
 return 2, true, nil
}

func (f *fakeAnswerer) Answer(_ context.Context, _ string, rec Record) error {
 f.calls = append(f.calls, "answer")
 if f.answerErrs > 0 {
  f.answerErrs--
  return errors.New("nats: timeout")
 }
 f.answered = &rec
 return nil
}

func task() Task {
 return Task{Schema: TaskSchema, File: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "pb", UID: "u1"}, Seq: 7,
  Inputs: Inputs{TargetProbeHash: "h1", Language: "en", Anchor: "ja"}, Target: "/t.mkv"}
}

func fast(t *testing.T) {
 t.Helper()
 p, b := claimPoll, answerBackoff
 claimPoll, answerBackoff = time.Millisecond, time.Millisecond
 t.Cleanup(func() { claimPoll, answerBackoff = p, b })
}

// TestServeClaimsRunsThenAnswers (§4.12 "Pod"): check Superseded, Claim,
// run, Answer -- in that order -- and the answer is the run's result at the
// task's Seq with its inputs.
func TestServeClaimsRunsThenAnswers(t *testing.T) {
 fast(t)
 a := &fakeAnswerer{}
 ran := false
 res, err := Serve(context.Background(), a, task(), func(_ context.Context, tk Task) Result {
  ran = true
  assert.Equal(t, int64(7), tk.Seq)
  return Result{Phase: PhaseSucceeded, Reason: ReasonGrafted, GraftTag: "tag-1"}
 })
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, ran)
 assert.Equal(t, ReasonGrafted, res.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"superseded", "claim", "answer"}, a.calls)
 require.NotNil(t, a.answered)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(7), a.answered.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateAnswered, a.answered.State)
 assert.Equal(t, "h1", a.answered.Inputs.TargetProbeHash)
 assert.Equal(t, "tag-1", a.answered.Answer.GraftTag)
}

func TestServeDoesNothingForASupersededTask(t *testing.T) {
 fast(t)
 a := &fakeAnswerer{superseded: true}
 _, err := Serve(context.Background(), a, task(), func(context.Context, Task) Result {
  t.Fatal("a superseded task never runs")
  return Result{}
 })
 require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrSuperseded)
}

// TestServeWaitsForItsRecord: an absent record is the loop's owed write
// (§4.7); the pod waits for it rather than run unfenced (§4.8).
func TestServeWaitsForItsRecord(t *testing.T) {
 fast(t)
 a := &fakeAnswerer{notYet: 3}
 _, err := Serve(context.Background(), a, task(), func(context.Context, Task) Result { return Result{Phase: PhaseSucceeded, Reason: ReasonPresent} })
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, 4, countOf(a.calls, "claim"))
 cw := ClaimWait
 ClaimWait = 5 * time.Millisecond
 t.Cleanup(func() { ClaimWait = cw })
 _, err = Serve(context.Background(), &fakeAnswerer{notYet: 1 << 30}, task(), func(context.Context, Task) Result { return Result{} })
 require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNoRecord)
}

// TestServeRetriesItsAnswer: graftAnswerTimeout (§4.12).
func TestServeRetriesItsAnswer(t *testing.T) {
 fast(t)
 a := &fakeAnswerer{answerErrs: 3}
 _, err := Serve(context.Background(), a, task(), func(context.Context, Task) Result { return Result{Phase: PhaseFailed, Reason: ReasonMuxFailed} })
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, 4, countOf(a.calls, "answer"))
}

func countOf(s []string, v string) int {
 n := 0
 for _, x := range s {
  if x == v {
   n++
  }
 }
 return n
}
```

```go
package graftplan_test

import (
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/squash/graftplan"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/squash/grafttask"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/squash/task"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/schema"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/records"
)

var (
 t0  = time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 now = metav1.NewTime(t0)
)

const (
 fileName  = "perfect-blue-1997"
 target    = "/data/media/movies/Perfect Blue (1997)/Perfect Blue (1997).mkv"
 root      = "/data/media/movies"
 donorPath = "/data/media/movies/.clustarr/donors/mv-uid/perfect-blue.mka"
 release   = "Perfect.Blue.1997.DVDRip.DUAL-GRP"
)

func theDonor() *catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor {
 return &catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor{Path: donorPath, Release: release, DownloadRef: "pb-donor", ImportedAt: metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(-time.Hour))}
}

func theItem() *graftplan.Item {
 return &graftplan.Item{UID: "mv-uid", Anchor: "ja", Grafts: true, Default: "en",
  Audio: &catalogv1alpha1.AudioState{Wanted: []string{"en", "ja"}, Present: []string{"ja"}, Missing: []string{"en"}, Donor: theDonor()}}
}

func ready() graftplan.Input {
 return graftplan.Input{Item: theItem(), Root: root, RecycleBin: "/data/media/.recycle"}
}

func theFile() *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 return &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: fileName, Namespace: "media", UID: "mf-uid"},
  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{MediaRef: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "perfect-blue"}, Path: target},
 }
}

// probed is a status probed a minute before t0 as hash, with these audio languages.
func probed(hash string, langs ...string) catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus {
 var a []commonv1.AudioStream
 for _, l := range langs {
  a = append(a, commonv1.AudioStream{Language: l})
 }
 at := metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(-time.Minute))
 return catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeHash: hash, ProbedAt: &at, MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{Audio: a}}
}

func with(st catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState) catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus {
 st.Graft = b
 return st
}

type opt func(*graftplan.View)

func at(t time.Time) opt                               { return func(v *graftplan.View) { v.Now = metav1.NewTime(t) } }
func draft(st catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) opt     { return func(v *graftplan.View) { v.Draft = &st } }
func probePending() opt                                { return func(v *graftplan.View) { v.ProbeCurrent = false } }
func fileOpt(f func(*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile)) opt   { return func(v *graftplan.View) { f(v.File) } }

// pass runs one graft planner pass over prev; the draft is prev unless an
// opt replaces it, and dispatches issue sequences from 100.
func pass(prev catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus, in graftplan.Input, opts ...opt) (catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus, graftplan.Decision) {
 next := int64(99)
 v := graftplan.View{File: theFile(), Prev: &prev, Draft: prev.DeepCopy(), Now: now, ProbeCurrent: true,
  Issue: func(rec int64) int64 { next = max(next+1, rec+1); return next }}
 for _, o := range opts {
  o(&v)
 }
 out := *v.Draft.DeepCopy()
 return out, graftplan.Plan(v, in, &out)
}

func kinds(d graftplan.Decision) []graftplan.EffectKind {
 var k []graftplan.EffectKind
 for _, e := range d.Effects {
  k = append(k, e.Kind)
 }
 return k
}

func flying(phase catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase, seq int64) *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState {
 return &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: phase, DonorRelease: release, DonorImportedAt: &theDonor().ImportedAt,
  Languages: []string{"en"}, ProbeHash: "h1", JobName: graftplan.JobName(fileName, seq),
  Dispatch: &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: seq, DispatchedAt: metav1.NewTime(t0.Add(-10 * time.Minute))}}
}

func rec(seq int64, state string, ans *grafttask.Result) *grafttask.Record {
 r := &grafttask.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: grafttask.RecordSchema,
  MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: fileName, UID: "mf-uid"}, Seq: seq, State: state, Writer: "graft-0"}, Answer: ans}
 switch state {
 case records.StateClaimed:
  c := t0.Add(-5 * time.Minute)
  r.ClaimedAt = &c
 case records.StateAnswered, records.StateFailed:
  a := t0.Add(-time.Minute)
  r.AnsweredAt = &a
 }
 return r
}

// TestAGraftBlockExistsOnlyWhereAGraftCan (§2.6, D10).
func TestAGraftBlockExistsOnlyWhereAGraftCan(t *testing.T) {
 cases := map[string]struct {
  in   func() graftplan.Input
  opts []opt
 }{
  "the profile does not graft":       {in: func() graftplan.Input { in := ready(); in.Item.Grafts = false; return in }},
  "the item has no donor":            {in: func() graftplan.Input { in := ready(); in.Item.Audio.Donor = nil; return in }},
  "the original language is unknown": {in: func() graftplan.Input { in := ready(); in.Item.Anchor = ""; return in }},
  "the item is gone":                 {in: func() graftplan.Input { in := ready(); in.Item = nil; return in }},
  "a multi-episode file": {in: ready, opts: []opt{fileOpt(func(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) {
   mf.Spec.MediaRef.Keys = []string{"perfect-blue-2"}
  })}},
 }
 for name, c := range cases {
  out, d := pass(probed("h1", "jpn"), c.in(), c.opts...)
  assert.Nil(t, out.Graft, name)
  assert.Empty(t, d.Effects, name)
 }
}

// TestAGrantedGraftIsQueuedThenRecordedThenItsJobCreated (§4.12 row 1,
// §5.13 "Dispatch"): Queued with the dispatch in the status; then, in this
// order, the requested record, the Job, the ledger's confirmation.
func TestAGrantedGraftIsQueuedThenRecordedThenItsJobCreated(t *testing.T) {
 in := ready()
 in.Granted = true
 out, d := pass(probed("h1", "jpn"), in)
 require.NotNil(t, out.Graft)
 b := out.Graft
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, b.Phase)
 require.NotNil(t, b.Dispatch)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(100), b.Dispatch.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, now, b.Dispatch.DispatchedAt)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.JobName(fileName, 100), b.JobName)
 assert.Equal(t, []graftplan.EffectKind{graftplan.EffectRequest, graftplan.EffectCreateJob, graftplan.EffectConfirm}, kinds(d))
 r := d.Effects[0].Record
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateRequested, r.State)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(100), r.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, "mf-uid", r.MediaFile.UID)
 assert.Equal(t, grafttask.Inputs{TargetProbeHash: "h1", DonorAudio: donorPath, DonorRelease: release, Language: "en", Anchor: "ja"}, r.Inputs)
 tk := d.Effects[1].Task
 assert.Equal(t, grafttask.TaskSchema, tk.Schema)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(100), tk.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, "mv-uid", tk.Item)
 assert.Equal(t, target, tk.Target)
 assert.Equal(t, donorPath, tk.Donor)
 assert.Equal(t, root, tk.Root)
 assert.True(t, tk.Default, "the profile's default is the grafted language")
 assert.Equal(t, r.Inputs, tk.Inputs)
 assert.Equal(t, b.JobName, d.Effects[1].Job)
}

// TestAnAnsweredGraftSwapsThenSucceedsOnItsProbe (§4.12 "record answered"):
// Grafted is Swapping with its tag until the grafted bytes' probe lands;
// then Succeeded, and status.graftTag takes the tag.
func TestAnAnsweredGraftSwapsThenSucceedsOnItsProbe(t *testing.T) {
 in := ready()
 in.Record = rec(100, records.StateAnswered, &grafttask.Result{Phase: grafttask.PhaseSucceeded, Reason: grafttask.ReasonGrafted,
  GraftTag: "tag-1", Segments: []grafttask.Segment{{LengthMillis: 1000}}})
 out, d := pass(with(probed("h1", "jpn"), flying(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, 100)), in)
 b := out.Graft
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, b.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, "tag-1", b.Tag)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(100), b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
 assert.Len(t, b.Segments, 1)
 assert.Equal(t, []graftplan.EffectKind{graftplan.EffectDeleteJob}, kinds(d))
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.JobName(fileName, 100), d.Effects[0].Job)
 assert.Empty(t, out.GraftTag, "not before the grafted bytes are probed")

 still, _ := pass(out, ready())
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, still.Graft.Phase, "the probe of the new bytes has not landed")
 reprobed := probed("h2", "jpn", "eng")
 reprobed.Graft = out.Graft
 done, ev := pass(out, ready(), draft(reprobed))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded, done.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, "h2", done.Graft.ProbeHash)
 assert.Equal(t, "tag-1", done.GraftTag)
 assert.Equal(t, now, *done.GraftedAt)
 require.Len(t, ev.Events, 1)
 assert.Equal(t, "Grafted", ev.Events[0].Reason)
}

// TestADonorFaultFailsForGoodAndOtherFailuresBackOff (§4.12, §2.6).
func TestADonorFaultFailsForGoodAndOtherFailuresBackOff(t *testing.T) {
 in := ready()
 in.Record = rec(100, records.StateAnswered, &grafttask.Result{Phase: grafttask.PhaseFailed, Reason: grafttask.ReasonAlignmentRejected, Message: "41% aligned"})
 out, _ := pass(with(probed("h1", "jpn"), flying(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, 100)), in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, out.Graft.Phase)
 assert.True(t, out.Graft.DonorFault)
 granted := ready()
 granted.Granted = true
 later, d := pass(out, granted, at(t0.Add(48*time.Hour)))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, later.Graft.Phase, "final for this donor and these bytes")
 assert.Empty(t, d.Effects)

 in.Record = rec(100, records.StateAnswered, &grafttask.Result{Phase: grafttask.PhaseFailed, Reason: grafttask.ReasonTargetChanged})
 out, _ = pass(with(probed("h1", "jpn"), flying(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, 100)), in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, out.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonBackoff, out.Graft.Reason)
 held, d := pass(out, granted, at(t0.Add(10*time.Minute)))
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonBackoff, held.Graft.Reason)
 assert.Empty(t, d.Effects)
 assert.Equal(t, t0.Add(-time.Minute).Add(graftplan.FailureBackoff), d.Due)
 retried, d := pass(out, granted, at(t0.Add(20*time.Minute)))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, retried.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, []graftplan.EffectKind{graftplan.EffectRequest, graftplan.EffectCreateJob, graftplan.EffectConfirm}, kinds(d))
}

// TestALostJobIsWithdrawnBeforeItFails (§4.12 "Job Complete/Failed with no
// answer after graftJobGrace", §5.10's two passes): the withdrawal fences a
// late pod; only then does the block read Failed/JobLost.
func TestALostJobIsWithdrawnBeforeItFails(t *testing.T) {
 in := ready()
 in.Record = rec(100, records.StateClaimed, nil)
 in.Job = &graftplan.Job{Name: graftplan.JobName(fileName, 100), Finished: true, FinishedAt: t0.Add(-time.Minute), Message: "DeadlineExceeded"}
 prev := with(probed("h1", "jpn"), flying(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, 100))
 held, d := pass(prev, in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, held.Graft.Phase, "inside graftJobGrace the answer may still land")
 assert.Empty(t, d.Effects)
 assert.Equal(t, t0.Add(-time.Minute).Add(graftplan.JobGrace), d.Due)

 in.Job.FinishedAt = t0.Add(-3 * time.Minute)
 first, d := pass(prev, in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, first.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonJobLost, first.Graft.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, "withdrawing attempt 100", first.Graft.Message)
 assert.Equal(t, []graftplan.EffectKind{graftplan.EffectWithdraw}, kinds(d))
 assert.Equal(t, int64(100), d.Effects[0].Seq)

 in.Record = rec(100, records.StateWithdrawn, nil)
 second, d := pass(first, in)
 b := second.Graft
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, b.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonJobLost, b.Reason)
 assert.Contains(t, b.Message, "DeadlineExceeded")
 assert.Equal(t, int64(100), b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
 assert.True(t, b.Dispatch.Withdrawn)
 assert.Equal(t, []graftplan.EffectKind{graftplan.EffectDeleteJob}, kinds(d))
}

// TestAGraftJobWithoutARecordFailsJobLost (§4.15): the Job finished and the
// record never answered -- the same withdraw-then-fail path.
func TestAGraftJobWithoutARecordFailsJobLost(t *testing.T) {

 in.Record = rec(100, records.StateRequested, nil)
 in.Job = &graftplan.Job{Name: graftplan.JobName(fileName, 100), Finished: true, FinishedAt: t0.Add(-3 * time.Minute)}
 out, d := pass(with(probed("h1", "jpn"), flying(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, 100)), in)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonJobLost, out.Graft.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, []graftplan.EffectKind{graftplan.EffectWithdraw}, kinds(d))
}

// TestAFactAfterTheWithdrawalIsIncorporated (§4.10, D41).
func TestAFactAfterTheWithdrawalIsIncorporated(t *testing.T) {
 lost := flying(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, 100)
 lost.Reason, lost.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq, lost.Dispatch.Withdrawn = graftplan.ReasonJobLost, 100, true
 in := ready()
 in.Record = rec(100, records.StateAnswered, &grafttask.Result{Phase: grafttask.PhaseSucceeded, Reason: grafttask.ReasonGrafted, GraftTag: "late"})
 out, _ := pass(with(probed("h1", "jpn"), lost), in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, out.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, "late", out.Graft.Tag)
 assert.False(t, out.Graft.Dispatch.Withdrawn)

 stale, _ := pass(with(probed("h1", "jpn"), lost), in, at(t0.Add(graftplan.FactWindow)))
 assert.NotEqual(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, stale.Graft.Phase, "past the fact window the record is not read")
 assert.Empty(t, stale.Graft.Tag)
}

// TestAFactUnderTheNextRequestClosesItAndIsIncorporated (§4.10): the
// request for 101 missed its CAS because 100's fact landed; 101 never ran.
func TestAFactUnderTheNextRequestClosesItAndIsIncorporated(t *testing.T) {
 q := flying(catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, 101)
 q.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq = 100
 in := ready()
 in.Record = rec(100, records.StateAnswered, &grafttask.Result{Phase: grafttask.PhaseSucceeded, Reason: grafttask.ReasonGrafted, GraftTag: "t100"})
 out, d := pass(with(probed("h1", "jpn"), q), in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, out.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(101), out.Graft.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
 assert.Equal(t, "t100", out.Graft.Tag)
 assert.Equal(t, []graftplan.EffectKind{graftplan.EffectDeleteJob}, kinds(d))
}

// TestOwedEffectsAreEmittedAgain (§4.7): a Queued block whose record or Job

func TestOwedEffectsAreEmittedAgain(t *testing.T) {

 assert.Equal(t, t0.Add(time.Minute), d.Due)
}

// TestAGraftWaitsForTheFilesTranscodeAtMostSixHours (§5.13, joinWait).
func TestAGraftWaitsForTheFilesTranscodeAtMostSixHours(t *testing.T) {
 st := probed("h1", "jpn")
 st.Transcode = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned}
 out, d := pass(st, ready())
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonWaitingForTranscode, out.Graft.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, now, *out.Graft.StartedAt)
 assert.Equal(t, t0.Add(30*time.Minute), d.Due)
 granted := ready()
 granted.Granted = true
 gone, d := pass(out, granted, at(t0.Add(graftplan.JoinWait+time.Minute)))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, gone.Graft.Phase, "after joinWait it grafts alone")
 assert.NotEmpty(t, d.Effects)
 st.Transcode.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning
 running, _ := pass(st, granted)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonTranscodeRunning, running.Graft.Reason, "never beside a transcode in flight")
}

// TestAJoinedGraftRunsWithItsTranscodeAndTakesItsResult (§5.13, D42).
func TestAJoinedGraftRunsWithItsTranscodeAndTakesItsResult(t *testing.T) {
 st := with(probed("h1", "jpn"), &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, Reason: graftplan.ReasonWaitingForSlot})
 st.Transcode = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued,
  Dispatch:    &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: 200, DispatchedAt: now},
  JoinedGraft: &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeGraftJoin{DonorRelease: release, Languages: []string{"en"}, ProbeHash: "h1"}}
 out, d := pass(st, ready())
 b := out.Graft
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, b.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonJoinedTranscode, b.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(200), b.JoinedTranscodeSeq)
 assert.Empty(t, d.Effects, "a joined graft holds no slot, writes no record and makes no Job")
 assert.False(t, graftplan.Standalone(b))

 in := ready()
 in.Transcode = &task.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Seq: 200, State: records.StateAnswered, AnsweredAt: &t0},
  Answer: &task.Answer{Graft: &grafttask.Result{Phase: grafttask.PhaseSucceeded, Reason: grafttask.ReasonGrafted, GraftTag: "joined-tag"}}}
 took, _ := pass(out, in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, took.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, "joined-tag", took.Graft.Tag)
 assert.Equal(t, int64(200), took.Graft.JoinedTranscodeSeq)

 in.Transcode.Answer.Graft = nil
 without, _ := pass(out, in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, without.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonWaitingForSlot, without.Graft.Reason, "the transcode never grafted: graft alone")
 again, _ := pass(without, ready(), draft(st))
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, again.Graft.Phase, "a join already incorporated is not derived again")
}
```

```go
// TestJoinPendingHoldsTheNextDispatchUntilTheGraftRecordsItsResult (§5.13).
func TestJoinPendingHoldsTheNextDispatchUntilTheGraftRecordsItsResult(t *testing.T) {

  JoinedGraft: &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeGraftJoin{ProbeHash: "h1"}}
 s, pending := graftplan.JoinPending(tc, &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, Reason: graftplan.ReasonJoinedTranscode, JoinedTranscodeSeq: 200})
 assert.Equal(t, int64(200), s)
 assert.True(t, pending)
 _, pending = graftplan.JoinPending(tc, &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, JoinedTranscodeSeq: 200})
 assert.False(t, pending)
 _, pending = graftplan.JoinPending(tc, nil)

 _, pending = graftplan.JoinPending(&catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Dispatch: &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: 200}}, nil)

}

// TestAPanickingGraftPlannerNeverLeavesAJoinedTaskBesideAWaitingBlock
// (§5.13): the transcode planner joined in pass 1 and the graft planner

// last block, F3.1). Admission never hands that file a graft slot (see
// admission's TestAJoinedGraftIsNeverAGraftSlotCandidate), the transcode

func TestAPanickingGraftPlannerNeverLeavesAJoinedTaskBesideAWaitingBlock(t *testing.T) {
 waiting := &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, Reason: graftplan.ReasonWaitingForSlot, ProbeHash: "h1"}
 afterPass1 := with(probed("h1", "jpn"), waiting)
 afterPass1.Transcode = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued,
  Dispatch: &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: 200, DispatchedAt: now},
  JoinedGraft: &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeGraftJoin{DonorRelease: release, Languages: []string{"en"}, ProbeHash: "h1"}}
 assert.True(t, graftplan.JoinInFlight(afterPass1.Transcode))
 _, held := graftplan.JoinPending(afterPass1.Transcode, afterPass1.Graft)
 assert.True(t, held, "the transcode's next dispatch waits for the graft to record the join")
 granted := ready()
 granted.Granted = true
 pass2, d := pass(afterPass1, granted)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, pass2.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, graftplan.ReasonJoinedTranscode, pass2.Graft.Reason)
 assert.Empty(t, d.Effects, "a stray graft grant is not used beside the joined task")
}
```

```go
package admission

// TestGraftSlotsCountJobsStatusAndGrants (§5.13 "Graft slots"): the union,
// by Job name, of unfinished graft Jobs and blocks that hold a slot, plus
// outstanding graft-slot grants; a joined graft holds none.
func TestGraftSlotsCountJobsStatusAndGrants(t *testing.T) {
 ns := "media"
 files := []GraftFile{
  {UID: "a", Key: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: ns, Name: "a"}, Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, JobName: "a-graft-1"},
  {UID: "b", Key: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: ns, Name: "b"}, Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, Reason: graftplan.ReasonJoinedTranscode},
  {UID: "c", Key: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: ns, Name: "c"}, Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, JobName: "c-graft-1"},
  {UID: "d", Key: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "other", Name: "d"}, Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, JobName: "d-graft-1"},
 }
 jobs := map[string][]string{ns: {"a-graft-1", "z-orphan"}}
 assert.Equal(t, 4, GraftInUse(ns, files, jobs, map[string]int{ns: 1}), "a (block and Job once), c, z-orphan, one grant")
 assert.Equal(t, 1, GraftInUse("other", files, jobs, nil))
}

func TestGraftGrantsFillFreeSlotsByDonorImportedAtThenKey(t *testing.T) {
 w := func(name string, at time.Time) GraftFile {
  return GraftFile{UID: types.UID(name), Key: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "media", Name: name},
   Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, Reason: graftplan.ReasonWaitingForSlot, DonorImportedAt: at}
 }
 files := []GraftFile{w("x", t0.Add(2*time.Hour)), w("y", t0.Add(time.Hour)), w("a", t0.Add(time.Hour))}
 assert.Equal(t, []types.UID{"a", "y"}, GraftGrants(files, nil, nil, 2))
 assert.Equal(t, []types.UID{"a"}, GraftGrants(files, map[string][]string{"media": {"busy"}}, nil, 2))
 assert.Empty(t, GraftGrants(files, nil, map[string]int{"media": 2}, 2))
 assert.Len(t, GraftGrants(files, nil, nil, 0), graftplan.DefaultConcurrency, "0 is the default")
}

// TestAJoinedGraftIsNeverAGraftSlotCandidate (§5.13): a file whose
// transcode block carries an in-flight join, a file in backoff and a file
// already granted are not candidates.
func TestAJoinedGraftIsNeverAGraftSlotCandidate(t *testing.T) {
 base := GraftFile{UID: "f", Key: types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "media", Name: "f"},
  Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, Reason: graftplan.ReasonWaitingForSlot}
 joined, backoff, granted := base, base, base
 joined.JoinInFlight = true
 backoff.Reason = graftplan.ReasonBackoff
 granted.Granted = true
 for name, f := range map[string]GraftFile{"joined": joined, "backoff": backoff, "granted": granted} {
  assert.Empty(t, GraftGrants([]GraftFile{f}, nil, nil, 2), name)
 }
 assert.Equal(t, []types.UID{"f"}, GraftGrants([]GraftFile{base}, nil, nil, 2))
}

// TestTheLedgerGrantsAGraftSlotAndTheLoopTakesIt: the pass's step 9 issues
// a GrantGraftSlot the loop's Snapshot shows, TakeGrant marks it in use,
// and Confirm drops it.
func TestTheLedgerGrantsAGraftSlotAndTheLoopTakesIt(t *testing.T) {
 l := NewLedger(Options{Slots: map[string]int32{"cpu": 1}, GraftConcurrency: 1, Clock: clockwork.NewFakeClockAt(t0)})
 l.markRebuilt()
 st := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{LastSeq: 1, Graft: &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting,
  Reason: graftplan.ReasonWaitingForSlot, DonorImportedAt: &metav1.Time{Time: t0}}}
 mf := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "f", UID: "f"}}
 l.Observe(FileViewOf(mf, st, nil))
 l.Pass(PassInputs{})
 assert.Equal(t, transcodeplan.GrantGraftSlot, l.Snapshot("f").Grant)
 snap, ok := l.TakeGrant("f")
 require.True(t, ok)
 assert.Equal(t, transcodeplan.GrantGraftSlot, snap.Grant)
 l.Confirm("f", 2)
 assert.Equal(t, transcodeplan.GrantNone, l.Snapshot("f").Grant)
}
```

```go
package graft_test

// TestTheGraftJobRunsTheTranscodeBinary is W5.6's graft-Job assertion,
// moved off the AudioGraft controller (F7.3 deletes it): the cpu pool's pod
// running `transcode --graft-task`, now with NATS (D9), owned by its
// MediaFile, labelled with its UID, and still credential-less.
func TestTheGraftJobRunsTheTranscodeBinary(t *testing.T) {
 cfg := pool.Config{Image: "native:test", DataDir: "/data", DataClaimName: "clustarr-data", NATSURL: "nats://nats:4222",
  ExtraArgs: []string{"--log-level=DEBUG"}}
 mf := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "perfect-blue-1997", UID: "mf-uid"}}
 tk := grafttask.Task{Schema: grafttask.TaskSchema, File: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: mf.Name, UID: "mf-uid"}, Seq: 100,
  Target: "/data/media/movies/pb.mkv", Language: "en"}
 name := graftplan.JobName(mf.Name, 100)
 job, err := graft.Job(cfg, mf, tk, name)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, name, job.Name)
 assert.Equal(t, "media", job.Namespace)
 assert.Equal(t, "mf-uid", job.Labels[grafttask.LabelGraftOf])
 assert.Equal(t, pool.ManagedByValue, job.Labels[pool.LabelManagedBy], "the pool Job cache holds it, so S15 sees it")
 assert.Equal(t, graft.ComponentGraft, job.Labels["app.kubernetes.io/component"])

 require.NotNil(t, owner)

 pod := job.Spec.Template.Spec
 assert.False(t, *pod.AutomountServiceAccountToken)
 c := pod.Containers[0]
 assert.Equal(t, []string{binpath.Transcode}, c.Command, "the graft Job runs `transcode --graft-task` on the native image")
 require.GreaterOrEqual(t, len(c.Args), 4)
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"--data-dir", "/data", "--graft-task"}, c.Args[:3])
 var decoded grafttask.Task
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.Args[3]), &decoded))
 assert.Equal(t, tk, decoded)
 assert.Equal(t, "--log-level=DEBUG", c.Args[4])
 env := map[string]bool{}
 for _, e := range c.Env {
  env[e.Name] = true
 }
 assert.True(t, env["NATS_URL"], "a graft pod answers in clustarr-grafts (D9)")
 assert.True(t, env["POD_NAME"], "the record's writer")
 assert.False(t, env[pool.EnvProfileUID])
 assert.False(t, env[pool.EnvClass])
}
```

```go
// TestGraftJobNameIsTheDispatchIdentity (§5.13, §5.17): a re-created Job of
// the same dispatch is AlreadyExists, counted done; a deleted one is
// NotFound, counted done.
func TestGraftJobNameIsTheDispatchIdentity(t *testing.T) {
 c := fake.NewClientBuilder().WithScheme(k8s.MustNewScheme()).Build()
 job := &batchv1.Job{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: graftplan.JobName("pb", 100)}}
 ok, err := ExecGraftJobEffect(t.Context(), c, CreateGraftJob{Job: job.DeepCopy()})
 require.True(t, ok)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 ok, err = ExecGraftJobEffect(t.Context(), c, CreateGraftJob{Job: job.DeepCopy()})
 require.True(t, ok)
 require.NoError(t, err, "AlreadyExists is done")
 var jobs batchv1.JobList
 require.NoError(t, c.List(t.Context(), &jobs))
 assert.Len(t, jobs.Items, 1)
 for range 2 {
  _, err = ExecGraftJobEffect(t.Context(), c, DeleteGraftJob{Namespace: "media", Name: job.Name})
  require.NoError(t, err, "NotFound is done")
 }
 ok, _ = ExecGraftJobEffect(t.Context(), c, RecordWrite{})
 assert.False(t, ok, "not a graft Job effect")
}
```

```go
// TestAGraftJobWakesTheFileThatOwnsIt (S15): a graft Job maps to its
// controlling MediaFile's file key; a Job without the label or that owner
// maps to nothing; only a change of finished-ness or a delete passes.
func TestAGraftJobWakesTheFileThatOwnsIt(t *testing.T) {
 mf := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "pb", UID: "mf-uid"}}
 j := &batchv1.Job{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "media", Name: "pb-graft-1", Labels: map[string]string{grafttask.LabelGraftOf: "mf-uid"}}}
 j.OwnerReferences = []metav1.OwnerReference{*metav1.NewControllerRef(mf, catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.WithKind("MediaFile"))}
 assert.Equal(t, []Key{{Kind: KindMediaFile, Namespace: "media", Name: "pb"}}, GraftJobKeys(t.Context(), j))
 unlabelled := j.DeepCopy()
 unlabelled.Labels = nil
 assert.Empty(t, GraftJobKeys(t.Context(), unlabelled))
 orphan := j.DeepCopy()
 orphan.OwnerReferences = nil
 assert.Empty(t, GraftJobKeys(t.Context(), orphan))

 p := graftJobPredicate()
 done := j.DeepCopy()
 done.Status.Conditions = []batchv1.JobCondition{{Type: batchv1.JobFailed, Status: corev1.ConditionTrue}}
 assert.True(t, p.Update(event.TypedUpdateEvent[*batchv1.Job]{ObjectOld: j, ObjectNew: done}))
 assert.False(t, p.Update(event.TypedUpdateEvent[*batchv1.Job]{ObjectOld: done, ObjectNew: done.DeepCopy()}))
 assert.True(t, p.Delete(event.TypedDeleteEvent[*batchv1.Job]{Object: j}))
 assert.False(t, p.Create(event.TypedCreateEvent[*batchv1.Job]{Object: j}), "the initial list already enqueues every file")
}
```

```go
// TestADispatchCarriesTheJoinableGraft (§5.8 step 4, D42): the dispatch
// writes task.Graft and status.transcode.joinedGraft together; with nothing
// to join it clears the previous dispatch's join.
func TestADispatchCarriesTheJoinableGraft(t *testing.T) {
 in := dispatchInputs(t) // F6.4's helper: a Planned block and a cpu dispatch grant
 j := &graftplan.Joinable{Task: grafttask.Task{Target: source, Language: "en", Donor: "/d.mka"},
  Join: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeGraftJoin{DonorRelease: "R", Languages: []string{"en"}, ProbeHash: in.Draft.ProbeHash}}
 in.Joinable = j
 d := Plan(in)
 require.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued, d.Block.Phase)
 require.NotNil(t, d.Block.JoinedGraft)
 assert.Equal(t, j.Join, *d.Block.JoinedGraft)
 require.NotNil(t, d.Task.Graft) // F6.4's Decision carries the task it publishes
 assert.Equal(t, j.Task, *d.Task.Graft)

 in = dispatchInputs(t)
 in.Prev.JoinedGraft = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeGraftJoin{ProbeHash: "old"}
 in.PrevGraft = &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, JoinedTranscodeSeq: in.Prev.Dispatch.Seq}
 d = Plan(in)
 assert.Nil(t, d.Block.JoinedGraft, "a dispatch that carries no graft clears the join")
 assert.Nil(t, d.Task.Graft)
}

// TestADispatchWaitsForTheJoinedGraftToBeRecorded (§5.13).
func TestADispatchWaitsForTheJoinedGraftToBeRecorded(t *testing.T) {
 in := dispatchInputs(t)
 in.Prev.JoinedGraft = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeGraftJoin{ProbeHash: "h"}
 in.PrevGraft = &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, Reason: graftplan.ReasonJoinedTranscode,
  JoinedTranscodeSeq: in.Prev.Dispatch.Seq}
 d := Plan(in)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned, d.Block.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, GrantRelease, d.Grant)
 assert.Equal(t, fmt.Sprintf("waiting for the joined graft of attempt %d to be recorded", in.Prev.Dispatch.Seq), d.Block.Message)
}
```

```go
// graftKV is clustarr-grafts on an embedded server with the default topology.
func graftKV(t *testing.T) (string, events.KV) {
 t.Helper()
 url := starttest.EmbeddedNATS(t)
 starttest.EnsureTopology(t, url)
 nc, err := nats.Connect(url)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 t.Cleanup(nc.Close)
 bus, err := natsbus.New(nc)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 return url, bus.KV(events.BucketGrafts)
}

func putGraftRecord(t *testing.T, kv events.KV, seq int64, state string) {
 t.Helper()
 b, err := json.Marshal(grafttask.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: grafttask.RecordSchema,
  MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "pb", UID: "mf-uid"}, Seq: seq, State: state, RequestedAt: time.Now()}})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = kv.Put(context.Background(), events.RecordKey("mf-uid"), b)
 require.NoError(t, err)
}

func graftTaskJSON(t *testing.T, seq int64) string {
 t.Helper()
 b, err := json.Marshal(grafttask.Task{Schema: grafttask.TaskSchema, File: schema.Ref{Namespace: "media", Name: "pb", UID: "mf-uid"}, Seq: seq,
  Target: "/data/media/movies/pb.mkv", TargetProbeHash: "h1", Root: "/data/media/movies", Donor: "/data/media/movies/.clustarr/donors/u/pb.mka",
  Language: "en", Anchor: "ja", Inputs: grafttask.Inputs{TargetProbeHash: "h1", Language: "en", Anchor: "ja"}})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 return string(b)
}

// TestAGraftTaskAnswersInTheRecordsBucket (§4.12 "Pod", D9): the pod
// claims its record, runs, and answers there; the target is gone, so the
// answer is TargetChanged and the pod exits 1.
func TestAGraftTaskAnswersInTheRecordsBucket(t *testing.T) {
 url, kv := graftKV(t)
 putGraftRecord(t, kv, 7, records.StateRequested)
 code := run([]string{"--graft-task", graftTaskJSON(t, 7), "--data-dir", t.TempDir()},
  env(map[string]string{"NATS_URL": url, "POD_NAME": "pb-graft-7-abcde"}))
 assert.Equal(t, 1, code)
 e, err := kv.Get(context.Background(), events.RecordKey("mf-uid"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var got grafttask.Record
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(e.Value, &got))
 assert.Equal(t, int64(7), got.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateAnswered, got.State)
 require.NotNil(t, got.Answer)
 assert.Equal(t, grafttask.ReasonTargetChanged, got.Answer.Reason)
 assert.Equal(t, "pb-graft-7-abcde", got.Writer)
}

func TestASupersededGraftTaskExitsWithoutRunning(t *testing.T) {
 url, kv := graftKV(t)
 putGraftRecord(t, kv, 8, records.StateRequested)
 code := run([]string{"--graft-task", graftTaskJSON(t, 7), "--data-dir", t.TempDir()},
  env(map[string]string{"NATS_URL": url, "POD_NAME": "pb-graft-7-abcde"}))
 assert.Equal(t, 0, code)
 e, err := kv.Get(context.Background(), events.RecordKey("mf-uid"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var got grafttask.Record
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(e.Value, &got))
 assert.Equal(t, int64(8), got.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateRequested, got.State, "a superseded task writes nothing")
}

func TestAGraftPodNeedsNATSAndItsName(t *testing.T) {
 assert.Equal(t, jobspec.WorkerExitMisconfigured, run([]string{"--graft-task", graftTaskJSON(t, 7)}, env(nil)))
}

func TestTheTerminationLogFlagIsGone(t *testing.T) {
 assert.Equal(t, jobspec.WorkerExitMisconfigured, run([]string{"--graft-task", "{}", "--termination-log", "/x"}, env(nil)),
  "the result rides clustarr-grafts now (§4.13)")
}
```

```go
// graftJob waits for the file's graft Job and returns it with its task.
func (f *graftFixture) graftJob(t *testing.T) (batchv1.Job, grafttask.Task) {
 t.Helper()

 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  var jobs batchv1.JobList
  if f.c.List(t.Context(), &jobs, client.InNamespace("default"), client.MatchingLabels{grafttask.LabelGraftOf: string(f.file(t).UID)}) != nil || len(jobs.Items) != 1 {
   return false
  }
  job = jobs.Items[0]
  return true

// TestAStandaloneGraftIsDispatchedAndItsAnswerIncorporated (§4.12, §5.13,
// §3.10; replaces mediafile's TestAGraftSwapIsIncorporatedWithoutMakingATranscode):
// the file waits for a slot, is granted one, goes Queued with its Job, the
// pod answers Grafted in clustarr-grafts, the block reads Swapping until
// the grafted bytes' probe lands, then Succeeded; status.graftTag takes the
// tag, the grafted original's size and mtime become catalogarr's while
// spec.original stays, the Job is deleted, and the movie reads done.
func TestAStandaloneGraftIsDispatchedAndItsAnswerIncorporated(t *testing.T) {
 f := startGraftFixture(t, "graft-standalone")
 ctx := t.Context()
 job, tk := f.graftJob(t)
 mf := f.file(t)
 require.NotNil(t, mf.Status.Graft)
 require.NotNil(t, mf.Status.Graft.Dispatch)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, mf.Status.Graft.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, mf.Status.Graft.Dispatch.Seq, tk.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, mf.Status.LastSeq, tk.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, mf.Status.Graft.JobName, job.Name)
 assert.Equal(t, string(mf.UID), tk.File.UID)
 assert.Equal(t, "en", tk.Language)

 res, err := grafttask.Serve(ctx, grafttask.NewAnswerer(f.bus, "graft-pod-0"), tk, func(_ context.Context, t2 grafttask.Task) grafttask.Result {
  fh, err := os.OpenFile(f.path, os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o644)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  _, err = fh.WriteString(" + the english dub")
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, fh.Close())
  later := time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second)
  require.NoError(t, os.Chtimes(f.path, later, later))
  f.grafted.Store(true)
  return grafttask.Result{Phase: grafttask.PhaseSucceeded, Reason: grafttask.ReasonGrafted, GraftTag: "tag-standalone"}
 })
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, grafttask.ReasonGrafted, res.Reason)

 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  mf = f.file(t)
  return mf.Status.Graft != nil && mf.Status.Graft.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded
 }, 2*time.Minute, 250*time.Millisecond, "the graft never succeeded")
 assert.Equal(t, "tag-standalone", mf.Status.GraftTag)
 require.NotNil(t, mf.Status.GraftedAt)
 assert.Equal(t, mf.Status.Graft.Dispatch.Seq, mf.Status.Graft.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq)
 assert.True(t, mf.Spec.Original == nil || *mf.Spec.Original, "a graft is not a transcode")
 st, err := os.Stat(f.path)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, st.Size(), mf.Spec.SizeBytes, "the grafted original's size is catalogarr's")
 owned := false
 for _, e := range mf.ManagedFields {
  if e.Manager == k8s.ManagerCatalogarr.String() && e.Subresource == "" && e.FieldsV1 != nil &&
   bytesContain(e.FieldsV1.Raw, `"f:sizeBytes"`) && bytesContain(e.FieldsV1.Raw, `"f:modTime"`) {
   owned = true
  }
 }
 assert.True(t, owned, "catalogarr owns spec.sizeBytes and spec.modTime after the graft (§3.10)")
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  var j batchv1.Job
  return apierrors.IsNotFound(f.c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&job), &j))
 }, time.Minute, 250*time.Millisecond, "the answered graft's Job was not deleted")
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  var m catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  return f.c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(f.movie), &m) == nil && m.Status.Audio != nil && m.Status.Audio.Graft == "done"
 }, time.Minute, 250*time.Millisecond, "the movie never read the graft done")
}

// TestALostGraftJobIsWithdrawnAndFails (§4.12 "Job … with no answer after
// graftJobGrace", §4.15 TestAGraftJobWithoutARecordFailsJobLost through the
// loop): the Job failed three minutes ago and its pod never answered.
func TestALostGraftJobIsWithdrawnAndFails(t *testing.T) {
 f := startGraftFixture(t, "graft-lost")
 ctx := t.Context()
 job, tk := f.graftJob(t)
 past := metav1.NewTime(time.Now().Add(-3 * time.Minute))
 // The apiserver validates Job status transitions: FailureTarget precedes Failed.
 require.NoError(t, f.c.Status().Apply(ctx, batchac.Job(job.Name, job.Namespace).WithStatus(batchac.JobStatus().
  WithStartTime(metav1.NewTime(past.Add(-time.Minute))).WithFailed(1).WithConditions(
  batchac.JobCondition().WithType(batchv1.JobFailureTarget).WithStatus(corev1.ConditionTrue).WithLastTransitionTime(past).WithReason("DeadlineExceeded"),
  batchac.JobCondition().WithType(batchv1.JobFailed).WithStatus(corev1.ConditionTrue).WithLastTransitionTime(past).WithReason("DeadlineExceeded").
   WithMessage("Job was active longer than specified deadline"))), client.FieldOwner("graft-envtest"), client.ForceOwnership))

 var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  mf = f.file(t)
  return mf.Status.Graft != nil && mf.Status.Graft.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed
 }, time.Minute, 250*time.Millisecond, "the lost Job's graft never failed")
 assert.Equal(t, "JobLost", mf.Status.Graft.Reason)
 assert.Contains(t, mf.Status.Graft.Message, "deadline")
 assert.True(t, mf.Status.Graft.Dispatch.Withdrawn)
 r, _, found, err := grafttask.NewRequester(f.bus).Get(ctx, events.RecordKey(string(mf.UID)))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.True(t, found)
 assert.Equal(t, tk.Seq, r.Seq)
 assert.Equal(t, records.StateWithdrawn, r.State, "the withdrawal fences a pod that wakes late")
}

// TestAGraftedOriginalKeepsItsSpecWhenTheGraftBlockGoes (loop spec §3.10,
// §3.20): the main apply keys spec.path, sizeBytes and modTime on the flat
// status.graftTag, never on the status.graft block, so a grafted original
// whose block goes -- its profile stops grafting -- keeps catalogarr's
// ownership of them through the next main apply, sent here because a probe
// moves the video-codec label. Keyed on the block, that apply would omit
// them and release them, and as optional fields they would leave spec.
func TestAGraftedOriginalKeepsItsSpecWhenTheGraftBlockGoes(t *testing.T) {
 f := startGraftFixture(t, "graft-goes")
 ctx := t.Context()
 f.graftToSuccess(t)

 var qp catalogv1alpha1.QualityProfile
 require.NoError(t, f.c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Name: "graft-goes"}, &qp))
 base := qp.DeepCopy()
 qp.Spec.Audio.Graft = false
 require.NoError(t, f.c.Patch(ctx, &qp, client.MergeFrom(base)))
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return f.file(t).Status.Graft == nil }, time.Minute, 250*time.Millisecond,
  "the graft block stayed after the profile stopped grafting")
 steady := f.file(t)
 require.NotEmpty(t, steady.Status.GraftTag, "status.graftTag outlives the block")

 f.hevc.Store(true)
 fh, err := os.OpenFile(f.path, os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o644)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = fh.WriteString(" + a re-encode elsewhere")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, fh.Close())
 later := time.Now().Add(4 * time.Second)
 require.NoError(t, os.Chtimes(f.path, later, later))
 touched := steady.DeepCopy()
 if touched.Annotations == nil {
  touched.Annotations = map[string]string{}
 }
 touched.Annotations[mediafile.AnnotationObservedFingerprint] = "after-the-graft-block-went" // importarr's rescan key: the loop re-stats and re-probes
 require.NoError(t, f.c.Patch(ctx, touched, client.MergeFrom(&steady)))

 var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  mf = f.file(t)
  return mf.Labels[catalogv1alpha1.LabelVideoCodec] == "hevc"
 }, 2*time.Minute, 250*time.Millisecond, "the new probe's codec never reached the labels: no main apply was sent")
 for _, field := range []string{`"f:path"`, `"f:sizeBytes"`, `"f:modTime"`} {
  owned := false
  for _, e := range mf.ManagedFields {
   if e.Manager == k8s.ManagerCatalogarr.String() && e.Subresource == "" && e.FieldsV1 != nil && bytesContain(e.FieldsV1.Raw, field) {
    owned = true
   }
  }
  assert.True(t, owned, "catalogarr released spec %s when the graft block went (§3.10)", field)
 }
}

func bytesContain(b []byte, s string) bool { return strings.Contains(string(b), s) }
```

```go
const TaskSchema = "graft.Task.v2"

// LabelGraftOf labels a standalone graft Job (and its pod) with the UID of
// the MediaFile it grafts (loop spec §4.12; a UID, since a MediaFile's name
// may exceed a label value's 63 characters).

// is incorporated only for these inputs (§4.10).
```

```go
 // (task.Task.Graft) carries none of them: its transcode's dispatch fences it.
```

3b. `app/squash/grafttask/record.go`:

```go
package grafttask

// RecordSchema marks a clustarr-grafts record (§4.5).
const RecordSchema = "records.graft.v1"

// MaxRecordBytes is clustarr-grafts' MaxValueSize (§4.3).
const MaxRecordBytes = 16 << 10

// Record is one file's clustarr-grafts record (§4.5, §4.12). It satisfies
// records.Record as F6.4's task.Record does (copy that Header method's
// receiver form).
type Record struct {
 schema.RecordHeader
 Inputs Inputs  `json:"inputs"`
 Answer *Result `json:"answer,omitempty"`
}

// Spec is the graft remediation's records spec: a Grafted success is a
// fact, written over a withdrawal and never overwritten (§4.7, §4.8).
var Spec = records.Spec[Record]{
 Remediation: "graft",
 Bucket:      events.BucketGrafts,
 MaxValue:    MaxRecordBytes,
 Answered:    func(s string) bool { return s == records.StateAnswered || s == records.StateFailed },
 Fact: func(r Record) bool {
  return r.Answer != nil && r.Answer.Phase == PhaseSucceeded && r.Answer.Reason == ReasonGrafted
 },
}

// NewRequester is the loop's half of clustarr-grafts (§4.5: the bucket
// opens only through its store).
func NewRequester(bus events.Bus) *records.Requester[Record] {
 return records.NewRequester(bus.KV(events.BucketGrafts), Spec)
}

// NewAnswerer is a graft pod's half of clustarr-grafts.
func NewAnswerer(bus events.Bus, writer string) *records.Answerer[Record] {
 return records.NewAnswerer(bus.KV(events.BucketGrafts), Spec, writer, version.String())
}
```

3c. `app/squash/grafttask/serve.go`:

```go
package grafttask

// ErrSuperseded: the record has moved past this task (§4.8); the pod does nothing.
var ErrSuperseded = errors.New("grafttask: the task is superseded")

// ErrNoRecord: the task's record never appeared within ClaimWait.
var ErrNoRecord = errors.New("grafttask: no record to claim")

// ClaimWait is how long a pod waits for its record: the loop writes it
// before it creates the Job, and rewrites a lost one at its next pass (§4.7).
var ClaimWait = 2 * time.Minute

// AnswerTimeout is graftAnswerTimeout (§4.12): bus errors on the answer are
// retried this long.
const AnswerTimeout = 2 * time.Minute

var (
 claimPoll     = 5 * time.Second
 answerBackoff = time.Second
)

// Answerer is the worker half of clustarr-grafts Serve needs;
// *records.Answerer[Record] implements it.
type Answerer interface {
 Superseded(ctx context.Context, key string, seq int64) (bool, error)
 Claim(ctx context.Context, key string, rec Record) (uint64, bool, error)
 Answer(ctx context.Context, key string, rec Record) error
}

// Serve is one graft pod (§4.12 "Pod"): Superseded, Claim, run, Answer.
func Serve(ctx context.Context, a Answerer, t Task, run func(context.Context, Task) Result) (Result, error) {
 key := events.RecordKey(t.File.UID)
 sup, err := a.Superseded(ctx, key, t.Seq)
 if err != nil {
  return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("grafttask: read the record of %s: %w", t.File.Name, err)
 }
 if sup {
  return Result{}, ErrSuperseded
 }
 head := schema.RecordHeader{Schema: RecordSchema, MediaFile: t.File, Seq: t.Seq}
 claimed := Record{RecordHeader: head, Inputs: t.Inputs}
 claimed.State, claimed.ClaimedAt = records.StateClaimed, new(time.Now().UTC())
 if err := waitClaim(ctx, a, key, claimed); err != nil {
  return Result{}, err
 }
 res := run(ctx, t)
 res.Message = Clamp(res.Message)
 answer := Record{RecordHeader: head, Inputs: t.Inputs, Answer: &res}
 answer.State, answer.AnsweredAt = records.StateAnswered, new(time.Now().UTC())
 return res, retry(ctx, AnswerTimeout, func() error { return a.Answer(ctx, key, answer) })
}

func waitClaim(ctx context.Context, a Answerer, key string, rec Record) error {
 deadline := time.Now().Add(ClaimWait)
 for {
  _, ok, err := a.Claim(ctx, key, rec)
  if err != nil {
   return fmt.Errorf("grafttask: claim %s: %w", key, err)
  }
  if ok {
   return nil
  }
  if sup, err := a.Superseded(ctx, key, rec.Seq); err == nil && sup {
   return ErrSuperseded
  }
  if !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   return ErrNoRecord
  }
  select {
  case <-ctx.Done():
   return ctx.Err()
  case <-time.After(claimPoll):
  }
 }
}

// retry runs f until it succeeds or d has passed, waiting answerBackoff
// doubled each time up to 30 s.
func retry(ctx context.Context, d time.Duration, f func() error) error {
 deadline, wait := time.Now().Add(d), answerBackoff
 for {
  err := f()
  if err == nil || !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   return err
  }
  select {
  case <-ctx.Done():
   return err
  case <-time.After(wait):
  }
  wait = min(2*wait, 30*time.Second)
 }
}
```

3d. `app/squash/graftplan/doc.go`, `plan.go`, `join.go`:

```go
// Package graftplan is the loop's graft planner (loop spec §2.6, §4.12,
// §5.13): pure, so it reads what the adapter gathered and writes only
// status.graft, status.graftTag and status.graftedAt. It also gives the
// transcode planner the graft a dispatch can carry (Join) and when to hold
// a dispatch for a joined result (JoinPending). It imports no client, no
// bus and no app/remediation.
package graftplan

const (
 DefaultConcurrency = 2                       // --graft-concurrency
 JobDeadline        = 2 * time.Hour           // a graft Job's activeDeadlineSeconds
 JoinWait           = 6 * time.Hour           // the longest a graft waits for its file's transcode
 FailureBackoff     = 15 * time.Minute        // a failure not the donor's is retried after this
 JobGrace           = 2 * time.Minute         // graftJobGrace: a finished Job's answer may lag this
 FactWindow         = JobDeadline + JobGrace  // records.FactWindow for a graft (§4.10)
 recheck            = time.Minute
 joinWaitRecheck    = 30 * time.Minute
)

const (
 ReasonFileUnprobed        = "FileUnprobed" // kept for F8.2's adoption of an AudioGraft's Waiting reason
 ReasonTranscodeRunning    = "TranscodeRunning"
 ReasonWaitingForTranscode = "WaitingForTranscode"
 ReasonWaitingForSlot      = "WaitingForSlot"
 ReasonBackoff             = "Backoff"
 ReasonJoinedTranscode     = "JoinedTranscode"
 ReasonJobLost             = "JobLost"
)

// View is the loop's view as this planner reads it (remediation.View, narrowed).
type View struct {
 File         *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 Prev         *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus
 Draft        *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus // after the probe and transcode planners this pass
 Now          metav1.Time
 ProbeCurrent bool
 Issue        func(recordSeq int64) int64 // remediation.(*View).Issue; only a dispatch calls it
}

// Item is the file's one item as a graft reads it.
type Item struct {
 UID     string
 Audio   *catalogv1alpha1.AudioState // status.audio: Missing and Donor
 Anchor  string                      // the original language, normalised; "" when unknown
 Grafts  bool                        // the QualityProfile's spec.audio.graft
 Default string                      // spec.audio.default
}

// Job is the graft Job status.graft.jobName names, as the cache has it.
type Job struct {
 Name       string
 Finished   bool
 FinishedAt time.Time
 Message    string
}

// Input is what the adapter gathered for one pass.
type Input struct {
 Item       *Item             // nil: the item or its profile is gone
 Root       string            // the RootFolder spec.path holding the file; "" none
 RecycleBin string            // jobspec.RecycleBinOf(that RootFolder)
 Record     *grafttask.Record // clustarr-grafts, when read (§4.10); nil when absent
 Transcode  *task.Record      // the transcode record, while a join is unincorporated
 Job        *Job              // nil when the cache has no such Job
 Granted    bool              // a graft-slot grant is held for the file and taken
}

type EffectKind string

const (
 EffectRequest   EffectKind = "Request"   // write Record (requested) at the read revision
 EffectWithdraw  EffectKind = "Withdraw"  // write withdrawn{Seq} at the read revision
 EffectCreateJob EffectKind = "CreateJob" // the Job of Task, named Job
 EffectDeleteJob EffectKind = "DeleteJob" // the Job named Job, Background propagation
 EffectConfirm   EffectKind = "Confirm"   // the ledger's graft-slot grant became dispatch Seq
)

type Effect struct {
 Kind   EffectKind
 Seq    int64
 Record *grafttask.Record
 Task   *grafttask.Task
 Job    string
}

type Event struct{ Type, Reason, Message string }

// Decision is Plan's answer beside the status it wrote into out.
type Decision struct {
 Effects []Effect
 Due     time.Time
 Events  []Event
}

func (d *Decision) due(t time.Time) {
 if !t.IsZero() && (d.Due.IsZero() || t.Before(d.Due)) {
  d.Due = t
 }
}

// JobName is the standalone graft Job of attempt seq: the dispatch's
// identity, so a re-create is AlreadyExists (§5.13). LabelSafeName: a Job
// name becomes the job-name pod label.
func JobName(file string, seq int64) string {
 return names.LabelSafeName(file, "graft", strconv.FormatInt(seq, 10))
}

// DonorFault reports a failure that rejects the donor's release (§2.6).
func DonorFault(reason string) bool {
 switch reason {
 case grafttask.ReasonAlignmentRejected, grafttask.ReasonVerifyFailed, grafttask.ReasonMuxFailed, grafttask.ReasonDonorLacksLanguage:
  return true
 }
 return false
}

// Standalone reports a block whose own Job holds its file: Queued, or
// Running and not riding a transcode (§5.13).
func Standalone(b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState) bool {
 if b == nil {
  return false
 }
 return b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued ||
  b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning && b.Reason != ReasonJoinedTranscode
}

// JoinInFlight reports a transcode block carrying a join for its in-flight
// dispatch (admission's FileView.JoinedGraft).
func JoinInFlight(tc *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState) bool {
 return tc != nil && tc.JoinedGraft != nil && tc.Dispatch != nil && tc.Dispatch.InFlight()
}

// FirstMissing is the first of langs the probe lacks (BCP-47 base
// compared), "" when it carries them all or is unknown.
func FirstMissing(langs []string, mi *commonv1.MediaInfo) string {
 if mi == nil {
  return ""
 }
 have := map[string]bool{}
 for _, a := range mi.Audio {
  if t, ok := lang.Normalize(a.Language); ok {
   have[baseTag(string(t))] = true
  }
 }
 for _, l := range langs {
  if t, ok := lang.Normalize(l); ok && !have[baseTag(string(t))] {
   return string(t)
  }
 }
 return ""
}

func baseTag(t string) string { b, _, _ := strings.Cut(t, "-"); return strings.ToLower(b) }

func isDefault(def, l string) bool { return def != "" && def != "original" && baseTag(def) == baseTag(l) }

func ptrTime(t metav1.Time) *metav1.Time { return &t }

// Plan is one pass of the graft planner (§4.12's loop rows, §5.13).
func Plan(v View, in Input, out *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) Decision {
 var d Decision
 out.Graft = v.Prev.Graft.DeepCopy()
 out.GraftTag, out.GraftedAt = v.Prev.GraftTag, v.Prev.GraftedAt.DeepCopy()
 if !v.ProbeCurrent {
  return d // §3.5: every planner after the probe keeps its last block
 }
 b := out.Graft
 switch {
 case b != nil && b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping:
  swapped(v, b, out, &d)
  return d
 case b != nil && b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning && b.Reason == ReasonJoinedTranscode:
  joined(v, in, b, &d)
  return d
 case Standalone(b):
  inFlight(v, in, b, &d)
  return d
 }
 if b != nil && factOpen(v, b) {
  if r := in.Record; closedAt(r, b.Dispatch.Seq) && r.Answer != nil && grafttask.Spec.Fact(*r) {
   incorporate(b, *r.Answer, answerTime(r.RecordHeader, v.Now))
   b.Dispatch.Withdrawn = false
   return d
  }
  d.due(b.Dispatch.DispatchedAt.Add(FactWindow))
 }
 if tc := v.Draft.Transcode; tc != nil && tc.JoinedGraft != nil && tc.Dispatch != nil &&
  (b == nil || b.JoinedTranscodeSeq < tc.Dispatch.Seq) {
  j, s := tc.JoinedGraft, tc.Dispatch.Seq
  g := &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning, Reason: ReasonJoinedTranscode,
   Message:      fmt.Sprintf("grafting in the same pass as transcode attempt %d", s),
   DonorRelease: j.DonorRelease, DonorImportedAt: j.DonorImportedAt.DeepCopy(), Languages: slices.Clone(j.Languages),
   ProbeHash: j.ProbeHash, JoinedTranscodeSeq: s, StartedAt: ptrTime(v.Now)}
  if b != nil {
   g.Dispatch = b.Dispatch.DeepCopy()
  }
  out.Graft = g
  return d
 }
 if !exists(v, in.Item) {
  if b == nil || !factOpen(v, b) {
   out.Graft = nil // graftTag and graftedAt stay: they describe the bytes (§3.10)
  }
  return d
 }
 idle(v, in, out, &d)
 return d
}

// exists is §2.6's "when the graft block exists".
func exists(v View, it *Item) bool {
 if len(v.File.Spec.MediaRef.Keys) > 0 || it == nil || !it.Grafts || it.Anchor == "" || it.Audio == nil || it.Audio.Donor == nil {
  return false
 }
 if len(it.Audio.Missing) > 0 {
  return true
 }
 b := v.Prev.Graft
 return b != nil && b.ProbeHash != "" && b.ProbeHash == v.Draft.ProbeHash
}

func factOpen(v View, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState) bool {
 return b.Dispatch != nil && b.Dispatch.Withdrawn && v.Now.Time.Before(b.Dispatch.DispatchedAt.Add(FactWindow))
}

func closedAt(r *grafttask.Record, s int64) bool {
 return r != nil && r.Seq == s && (r.State == records.StateAnswered || r.State == records.StateFailed)
}

func answerTime(h schema.RecordHeader, now metav1.Time) metav1.Time {
 if h.AnsweredAt != nil {
  return metav1.NewTime(*h.AnsweredAt)
 }
 return now
}

// swapped is the Swapping row: the grafted bytes' probe, once it lands,
// ends the graft and gives the file its graftTag (§4.12).
func swapped(v View, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState, out *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus, d *Decision) {
 p := v.Draft
 if p.ProbeHash == "" || p.ProbeHash == b.ProbeHash || p.ProbedAt == nil ||
  (b.CompletedAt != nil && b.CompletedAt.After(p.ProbedAt.Time)) {
  return
 }
 b.Phase, b.ProbeHash = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded, p.ProbeHash
 out.GraftTag, out.GraftedAt = b.Tag, ptrTime(v.Now)
 d.Events = append(d.Events, Event{Type: "Normal", Reason: "Grafted", Message: "the grafted dub is in the file (" + b.Tag + ")"})
}

// incorporate folds a graft result into b (§4.12 "record answered").
func incorporate(b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState, res grafttask.Result, at metav1.Time) {
 b.CompletedAt = &at
 b.RateName, b.RateMicros, b.RateMarginMilli = res.RateName, res.RateMicros, res.RateMarginMilli
 b.CoveragePercent, b.ResidualMillis, b.Within80Percent = res.CoveragePercent, res.ResidualMillis, res.Within80Percent
 b.Segments = nil
 for i, s := range res.Segments {
  if i == 16 {
   break
  }
  b.Segments = append(b.Segments, catalogv1alpha1.GraftSegment(s))
 }
 b.Reason, b.Message, b.DonorFault = res.Reason, grafttask.Clamp(res.Message), false
 switch {
 case res.Phase == grafttask.PhaseSucceeded && res.Reason == grafttask.ReasonGrafted:
  b.Phase, b.Tag = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSwapping, res.GraftTag
 case res.Phase == grafttask.PhaseSucceeded:
  b.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded
 case DonorFault(res.Reason):
  b.Phase, b.DonorFault = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, true
 default:
  b.Phase, b.Reason = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, ReasonBackoff
  b.Message = grafttask.Clamp(res.Reason + ": " + res.Message)
 }
}

// joined is the joined-graft rows: the transcode record's Answer.Graft is
// this graft's result (§5.13).
func joined(v View, in Input, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState, d *Decision) {
 s, r := b.JoinedTranscodeSeq, in.Transcode
 switch {
 case r != nil && r.Seq == s && r.State == records.StateAnswered && r.Answer != nil && r.Answer.Graft != nil:
  incorporate(b, *r.Answer.Graft, answerTime(r.RecordHeader, v.Now))
 case r != nil && (r.Seq > s || r.Seq == s && (r.State == records.StateAnswered || r.State == records.StateFailed || r.State == records.StateWithdrawn)),
  r == nil && !joinOpen(v.Draft.Transcode, s):
  b.Phase, b.Reason, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, ReasonWaitingForSlot,
   fmt.Sprintf("transcode attempt %d ended without its graft", s)
 default:
  d.due(v.Now.Add(recheck))
 }
}

func joinOpen(tc *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState, s int64) bool {
 return tc != nil && tc.JoinedGraft != nil && tc.Dispatch != nil && tc.Dispatch.Seq == s && tc.Dispatch.InFlight()
}

// inFlight is the standalone rows: record, Job, withdrawal (§4.12, §5.10).
func inFlight(v View, in Input, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState, d *Decision) {
 if b.Dispatch == nil {
  b.Phase, b.Reason, b.Message = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, ReasonWaitingForSlot, "an in-flight graft without a dispatch"
  return
 }
 s, r, now, job := b.Dispatch.Seq, in.Record, v.Now.Time, b.JobName
 switch {
 case r != nil && r.Seq < s && r.State == records.StateAnswered && r.Answer != nil && grafttask.Spec.Fact(*r):
  // the earlier dispatch's fact under this one's missed request (§4.10)
  b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq, b.JobName = s, ""
  incorporate(b, *r.Answer, answerTime(r.RecordHeader, v.Now))
  d.Effects = append(d.Effects, Effect{Kind: EffectDeleteJob, Job: job})
 case closedAt(r, s):
  if r.State == records.StateFailed || r.Answer == nil {
   at := answerTime(r.RecordHeader, v.Now)
   b.Phase, b.Reason, b.CompletedAt = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, ReasonBackoff, &at
   b.Message = grafttask.Clamp(cmp.Or(r.Failure, "the graft pod gave no answer"))
  } else {
   incorporate(b, *r.Answer, answerTime(r.RecordHeader, v.Now))
  }
  b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq, b.JobName = s, ""
  d.Effects = append(d.Effects, Effect{Kind: EffectDeleteJob, Job: job})
 case r != nil && r.Seq == s && r.State == records.StateWithdrawn:
  b.Phase, b.Reason, b.CompletedAt = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, ReasonJobLost, ptrTime(v.Now)
  b.Message = lostMessage(in.Job, s)
  b.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq, b.Dispatch.Withdrawn, b.JobName = s, true, ""
  d.Effects = append(d.Effects, Effect{Kind: EffectDeleteJob, Job: job})
  d.due(now.Add(FailureBackoff))
 case b.Reason == ReasonJobLost || jobLost(in, r, s, now):
  b.Reason, b.Message = ReasonJobLost, fmt.Sprintf("withdrawing attempt %d", s)
  d.Effects = append(d.Effects, Effect{Kind: EffectWithdraw, Seq: s})
  d.due(now.Add(time.Second))
 case r != nil && r.Seq == s && r.State == records.StateClaimed:
  b.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning
  if r.ClaimedAt != nil {
   b.StartedAt = ptrTime(metav1.NewTime(*r.ClaimedAt))
  }
  b.Message = "graft pod " + r.Writer
  d.due(now.Add(recheck))
  jobDue(in.Job, d)
 default: // absent, below s, or requested at s: §4.7's owed effects
  if r == nil || r.Seq < s {
   d.Effects = append(d.Effects, Effect{Kind: EffectRequest, Seq: s, Record: requested(v, b, inputsOf(v, b, in))})
  }
  if in.Job == nil {
   if t, ok := owedTask(v, in, b); ok {
    d.Effects = append(d.Effects, Effect{Kind: EffectCreateJob, Seq: s, Task: &t, Job: job})
   }
  }
  d.due(now.Add(recheck))
  jobDue(in.Job, d)
 }
}

func jobLost(in Input, r *grafttask.Record, s int64, now time.Time) bool {
 if closedAt(r, s) {
  return false
 }
 if in.Job == nil {
  return r != nil && r.Seq == s && r.State == records.StateClaimed // claimed, and its Job is gone
 }
 return in.Job.Finished && !now.Before(in.Job.FinishedAt.Add(JobGrace))
}

func jobDue(j *Job, d *Decision) {
 if j != nil && j.Finished {
  d.due(j.FinishedAt.Add(JobGrace))
 }
}

func lostMessage(j *Job, s int64) string {
 msg := fmt.Sprintf("graft attempt %d: the Job ended without an answer", s)
 if j != nil && j.Message != "" {
  msg += ": " + j.Message
 }
 return grafttask.Clamp(msg)
}

func inputsOf(v View, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState, in Input) grafttask.Inputs {
 x := grafttask.Inputs{TargetProbeHash: b.ProbeHash, DonorRelease: b.DonorRelease, Language: FirstMissing(b.Languages, v.Draft.MediaInfo)}
 if it := in.Item; it != nil {
  x.Anchor = it.Anchor
  if it.Audio != nil && it.Audio.Donor != nil {
   x.DonorAudio = it.Audio.Donor.Path
  }
 }
 return x
}

func requested(v View, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState, x grafttask.Inputs) *grafttask.Record {
 return &grafttask.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: grafttask.RecordSchema,
  MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: v.File.Namespace, Name: v.File.Name, UID: string(v.File.UID)},
  Seq:       b.Dispatch.Seq, State: records.StateRequested, RequestedAt: b.Dispatch.DispatchedAt.Time}, Inputs: x}
}

// owedTask is the task of b's dispatch, re-created from its record's
// inputs when the record holds them.
func owedTask(v View, in Input, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState) (grafttask.Task, bool) {
 if in.Item == nil || in.Root == "" {
  return grafttask.Task{}, false
 }
 x := inputsOf(v, b, in)
 if r := in.Record; r != nil && r.Seq == b.Dispatch.Seq {
  x = r.Inputs
 }
 if x.Language == "" || x.DonorAudio == "" {
  return grafttask.Task{}, false
 }
 return taskOf(v, in, b.Dispatch.Seq, x, b.Languages), true
}

func taskOf(v View, in Input, s int64, x grafttask.Inputs, langs []string) grafttask.Task {
 return grafttask.Task{
  Schema: grafttask.TaskSchema,
  File:   schema.Ref{Namespace: v.File.Namespace, Name: v.File.Name, UID: string(v.File.UID)},
  Item:   in.Item.UID, Seq: s, Inputs: x,
  Target: v.File.Spec.Path, TargetProbeHash: x.TargetProbeHash, Root: in.Root, Donor: x.DonorAudio,
  Language: x.Language, Languages: slices.Clone(langs), Anchor: x.Anchor,
  Default: isDefault(in.Item.Default, x.Language), RecycleBin: in.RecycleBin,
 }
}

func sameAttempt(b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState, donor *catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor, probe string) bool {
 return b.DonorRelease == donor.Release && b.ProbeHash == probe && b.DonorImportedAt != nil && b.DonorImportedAt.Equal(&donor.ImportedAt)
}

func waitingOf(base catalogv1alpha1.GraftState, reason, msg string) *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState {
 base.Phase, base.Reason, base.Message = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting, reason, msg
 return &base
}

// idle decides for a file with no graft in flight: Present, a verdict that
// stands, waiting for the file's transcode, a slot, or a dispatch.
func idle(v View, in Input, out *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus, d *Decision) {
 b, it, now := out.Graft, in.Item, v.Now.Time
 if v.Draft.MediaInfo == nil {
  return
 }
 donor := it.Audio.Donor
 l := FirstMissing(it.Audio.Missing, v.Draft.MediaInfo)
 base := catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{DonorRelease: donor.Release, DonorImportedAt: donor.ImportedAt.DeepCopy(),
  Languages: slices.Clone(it.Audio.Missing), ProbeHash: v.Draft.ProbeHash}
 if b != nil {
  base.Dispatch, base.JoinedTranscodeSeq = b.Dispatch.DeepCopy(), b.JoinedTranscodeSeq
 }
 if l == "" {
  if b != nil && b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded && b.ProbeHash == v.Draft.ProbeHash {
   return
  }
  p := base
  p.Phase, p.Reason, p.CompletedAt = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded, grafttask.ReasonPresent, ptrTime(v.Now)
  p.Message = grafttask.Clamp("the file carries " + strings.Join(it.Audio.Missing, ", "))
  out.Graft = &p
  return
 }
 if b != nil && sameAttempt(b, donor, v.Draft.ProbeHash) {
  switch {
  case b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed && b.DonorFault:
   return // final for this donor and these bytes (§2.6)
  case b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting && b.Reason == ReasonBackoff:
   if b.CompletedAt != nil {
    if retry := b.CompletedAt.Add(FailureBackoff); now.Before(retry) {
     d.due(retry)
     return
    }
   }
  }
 }
 if tc := v.Draft.Transcode; tc != nil {
  switch tc.Phase {
  case catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseQueued, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping:
   out.Graft = waitingOf(base, ReasonTranscodeRunning, "the file's transcode is in flight; the graft follows it")
   return
  case catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePending, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned:
   since := v.Now
   if b != nil && b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting && b.Reason == ReasonWaitingForTranscode && b.StartedAt != nil {
    since = *b.StartedAt
   }
   if until := since.Add(JoinWait); now.Before(until) {
    w := waitingOf(base, ReasonWaitingForTranscode, "waiting for the file's transcode, to graft in the same pass")
    w.StartedAt = &since
    out.Graft = w
    d.due(until)
    d.due(now.Add(joinWaitRecheck))
    return
   }
  }
 }
 if in.Root == "" {
  f := base
  f.Phase, f.Reason, f.CompletedAt = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed, grafttask.ReasonInvalidTask, ptrTime(v.Now)
  f.Message = grafttask.Clamp("the file " + v.File.Spec.Path + " is under no RootFolder")
  out.Graft = &f
  return
 }
 if !in.Granted {
  out.Graft = waitingOf(base, ReasonWaitingForSlot, "waiting for a graft slot")
  return
 }
 var recSeq int64
 if in.Record != nil {
  recSeq = in.Record.Seq
 }
 s := v.Issue(recSeq)
 x := grafttask.Inputs{TargetProbeHash: v.Draft.ProbeHash, DonorAudio: donor.Path, DonorRelease: donor.Release, Language: l, Anchor: it.Anchor}
 t := taskOf(v, in, s, x, it.Audio.Missing)
 q := base
 q.Phase, q.Reason, q.JobName = catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued, "", JobName(v.File.Name, s)
 q.Message = fmt.Sprintf("attempt %d: graft Job %s", s, q.JobName)
 q.Dispatch = &catalogv1alpha1.Dispatch{Seq: s, DispatchedAt: v.Now}
 if base.Dispatch != nil {
  q.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq = base.Dispatch.AnsweredSeq
 }
 out.Graft = &q
 rec := &grafttask.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: grafttask.RecordSchema, MediaFile: t.File, Seq: s,
  State: records.StateRequested, RequestedAt: now}, Inputs: x}
 d.Effects = append(d.Effects,
  Effect{Kind: EffectRequest, Seq: s, Record: rec},
  Effect{Kind: EffectCreateJob, Seq: s, Task: &t, Job: q.JobName},
  Effect{Kind: EffectConfirm, Seq: s})
 d.Events = append(d.Events, Event{Type: "Normal", Reason: "Dispatched", Message: fmt.Sprintf("graft attempt %d: %s from %s", s, l, donor.Release)})
}
```

```go
// JoinInput is what the transcode adapter hands Join: the same gather as
// the graft adapter's (graft.GatherItem).
type JoinInput struct {
 Item       *Item
 Root       string
 RecycleBin string
}

// Joinable is the graft a transcode dispatch carries (task.Task.Graft) and
// the join its block records (status.transcode.joinedGraft, §5.13, D42).
type Joinable struct {
 Task grafttask.Task
 Join catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeGraftJoin
}

// Join is today's audiograft.JoinTask over the file's own state: the graft
// rides along when it could exist, no standalone graft holds the file, no
// donor fault stands for this donor and these bytes, a language is missing
// and the file lies under a RootFolder. v.Draft is the transcode planner's
// draft; v.Issue is not used.
func Join(v View, in JoinInput) *Joinable {
 b := v.Prev.Graft
 if !exists(v, in.Item) || Standalone(b) || v.Draft.MediaInfo == nil || in.Root == "" {
  return nil
 }
 it := in.Item
 donor := it.Audio.Donor
 if b != nil && b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed && b.DonorFault && sameAttempt(b, donor, v.Draft.ProbeHash) {
  return nil
 }
 l := FirstMissing(it.Audio.Missing, v.Draft.MediaInfo)
 if l == "" {
  return nil
 }
 return &Joinable{
  Task: grafttask.Task{Target: v.File.Spec.Path, TargetProbeHash: v.Draft.ProbeHash, Root: in.Root, Donor: donor.Path,
   Language: l, Languages: slices.Clone(it.Audio.Missing), Anchor: it.Anchor, Default: isDefault(it.Default, l), RecycleBin: in.RecycleBin},
  Join: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeGraftJoin{DonorRelease: donor.Release, DonorImportedAt: donor.ImportedAt.DeepCopy(),
   Languages: slices.Clone(it.Audio.Missing), ProbeHash: v.Draft.ProbeHash},
 }
}

// JoinPending reports the dispatch S whose joined graft the graft block has
// not incorporated (it is not at joinedTranscodeSeq S in a phase other than
// Running/JoinedTranscode): the transcode planner holds its next dispatch
// until it has (§5.13).
func JoinPending(tc *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState, b *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState) (int64, bool) {
 if tc == nil || tc.JoinedGraft == nil || tc.Dispatch == nil {
  return 0, false
 }
 s := tc.Dispatch.Seq
 done := b != nil && b.JoinedTranscodeSeq == s && !(b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning && b.Reason == ReasonJoinedTranscode)
 return s, !done
}
```

3e. `app/squash/controller/pool/cache.go` (F6.3's file):

```go
// JobFinished reports whether j has a Complete or Failed condition, when,
// and the Failed condition's message.
func JobFinished(j *batchv1.Job) (bool, time.Time, string) {
 for _, c := range j.Status.Conditions {
  if (c.Type == batchv1.JobComplete || c.Type == batchv1.JobFailed) && c.Status == corev1.ConditionTrue {
   msg := ""
   if c.Type == batchv1.JobFailed {
    msg = c.Message
   }
   return true, c.LastTransitionTime.Time, msg
  }
 }
 return false, time.Time{}, ""
}
```
