directory, its `Copy` becomes the one below and the rest is replaced):

```go
// Package graft is the loop's graft planner adapter (loop spec §4.12,
// §5.13): it gathers what graftplan.Plan reads and maps its effects onto
// the loop's.
//
// +kubebuilder:rbac:groups=batch,resources=jobs,verbs=get;list;watch;create;delete
package graft

// ComponentGraft is a graft Job's component label (W5.6 left it so).
const ComponentGraft = "squasharr-graft"

type Options struct {
 Pool   pool.Config               // the cpu pool's pod template the Job runs on
 Ledger transcodeplan.Admission   // TakeGrant for a graft-slot grant
}

type Adapter struct {
 o          Options
 grafts     *records.Requester[grafttask.Record]
 transcodes *records.Requester[task.Record]
}

func New(bus events.Bus, o Options) *Adapter {
 return &Adapter{o: o, grafts: grafttask.NewRequester(bus), transcodes: task.NewRequester(bus)}
}

type In struct {
 Plan     graftplan.Input
 Revision uint64 // the clustarr-grafts revision Plan.Record was read at; 0 absent
}

func (a *Adapter) Name() remediation.PlannerName { return remediation.PlannerGraft }

func (a *Adapter) Applies(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) bool {
 k := mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind
 return k == commonv1.MediaKindMovie || k == commonv1.MediaKindEpisode
}

func (a *Adapter) Gather(ctx context.Context, env *remediation.Env, v *remediation.View) (In, error) {
 var in In
 mf, b := v.File, v.Prev.Graft
 item, root, bin, err := GatherItem(ctx, env.Reader, mf)
 if err != nil {
  return in, remediation.Transient(err)
 }
 in.Plan.Item, in.Plan.Root, in.Plan.RecycleBin = item, root, bin
 if v.Ledger.Grant == transcodeplan.GrantGraftSlot {
  snap, ok := a.o.Ledger.TakeGrant(mf.UID)
  in.Plan.Granted = ok && snap.Grant == transcodeplan.GrantGraftSlot
 }
 if graftplan.Standalone(b) || in.Plan.Granted ||
  b != nil && b.Dispatch != nil && b.Dispatch.Withdrawn && v.Now.Time.Before(b.Dispatch.DispatchedAt.Add(graftplan.FactWindow)) {
  rec, rev, found, err := a.grafts.Get(ctx, events.RecordKey(string(mf.UID)))
  if err != nil {
   return in, remediation.Transient(err)
  }
  if found {
   in.Plan.Record, in.Revision = &rec, rev
  }
 }
 if b != nil && b.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning && b.Reason == graftplan.ReasonJoinedTranscode {
  rec, _, found, err := a.transcodes.Get(ctx, events.RecordKey(string(mf.UID)))
  if err != nil {
   return in, remediation.Transient(err)
  }
  if found {
   in.Plan.Transcode = &rec
  }
 }
 if graftplan.Standalone(b) && b.JobName != "" {
  var j batchv1.Job
  switch err := env.Reader.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: b.JobName}, &j); {
  case err == nil:
   done, at, msg := pool.JobFinished(&j)
   in.Plan.Job = &graftplan.Job{Name: j.Name, Finished: done, FinishedAt: at, Message: msg}
  case !apierrors.IsNotFound(err):
   return in, remediation.Transient(err)
  }
 }
 return in, nil
}

func (a *Adapter) Plan(v *remediation.View, in In, out *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) (remediation.Result, error) {
 gv := graftplan.View{File: v.File, Prev: v.Prev, Draft: v.Draft, Now: v.Now, ProbeCurrent: v.ProbeCurrent(), Issue: v.Issue}
 d := graftplan.Plan(gv, in.Plan, out)
 res := remediation.Result{Due: d.Due}
 key := events.RecordKey(string(v.File.UID))
 for _, e := range d.Effects {
  switch e.Kind {
  case graftplan.EffectRequest:
   val, err := json.Marshal(e.Record)
   if err != nil {
    return res, err
   }
   res.Effects = append(res.Effects, remediation.RecordWrite{Bucket: events.BucketGrafts, Key: key, Revision: in.Revision, Value: val})
  case graftplan.EffectWithdraw:
   w := grafttask.Record{RecordHeader: schema.RecordHeader{Schema: grafttask.RecordSchema,
    MediaFile: schema.Ref{Namespace: v.File.Namespace, Name: v.File.Name, UID: string(v.File.UID)}, Seq: e.Seq, State: records.StateWithdrawn}}
   if r := in.Plan.Record; r != nil {
    w.Inputs = r.Inputs
   }
   val, err := json.Marshal(w)
   if err != nil {
    return res, err
   }
   res.Effects = append(res.Effects, remediation.RecordWrite{Bucket: events.BucketGrafts, Key: key, Revision: in.Revision, Value: val})
  case graftplan.EffectCreateJob:
   job, err := Job(a.o.Pool, v.File, *e.Task, e.Job)
   if err != nil {
    return res, err
   }
   res.Effects = append(res.Effects, remediation.CreateGraftJob{Job: job})
  case graftplan.EffectDeleteJob:
   if e.Job != "" {
    res.Effects = append(res.Effects, remediation.DeleteGraftJob{Namespace: v.File.Namespace, Name: e.Job})
   }
  case graftplan.EffectConfirm:
   res.Effects = append(res.Effects, remediation.LedgerConfirm{UID: v.File.UID, Seq: e.Seq})
  }
 }
 for _, ev := range d.Events {
  res.Events = append(res.Events, remediation.Event{Type: ev.Type, Reason: ev.Reason, Message: ev.Message, Action: "graft"})
 }
 return res, nil
}

// Copy is the graft planner's fields (§3.5): the block and the flat tag.
func (a *Adapter) Copy(from, into *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) {
 into.Graft = from.Graft.DeepCopy()
 into.GraftTag, into.GraftedAt = from.GraftTag, from.GraftedAt.DeepCopy()
}

// GatherItem reads the file's item, its QualityProfile's audio policy and
// the RootFolder holding the file, from the cache. A gone item or profile
// is a nil item, not an error.
func GatherItem(ctx context.Context, r client.Reader, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) (*graftplan.Item, string, string, error) {
 key := client.ObjectKey{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: mf.Spec.MediaRef.Name}
 it := &graftplan.Item{}
 var profileRef, original string
 switch mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind {
 case commonv1.MediaKindMovie:
  var m catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  if err := r.Get(ctx, key, &m); err != nil {
   return nil, "", "", client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
  }
  it.UID, it.Audio, profileRef = string(m.UID), m.Status.Audio, m.Spec.QualityProfileRef
  if m.Status.Metadata != nil {
   original = m.Status.Metadata.OriginalLanguage
  }
 case commonv1.MediaKindEpisode:
  var e catalogv1alpha1.Episode
  if err := r.Get(ctx, key, &e); err != nil {
   return nil, "", "", client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
  }
  var s catalogv1alpha1.Series
  if err := r.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: e.Spec.SeriesRef}, &s); err != nil {
   return nil, "", "", client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
  }
  it.UID, it.Audio, profileRef = string(e.UID), e.Status.Audio, s.Spec.QualityProfileRef
  if s.Status.Metadata != nil {
   original = s.Status.Metadata.OriginalLanguage
  }
 default:
  return nil, "", "", nil
 }
 if t, ok := lang.Normalize(original); ok {
  it.Anchor = string(t)
 }
 var qp catalogv1alpha1.QualityProfile // cluster-scoped
 if err := r.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Name: profileRef}, &qp); err != nil {
  return nil, "", "", client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
 }
 if a := qp.Spec.Audio; a != nil {
  it.Grafts, it.Default = a.Graft, a.Default
 }
 var folders catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderList
 if err := r.List(ctx, &folders, client.InNamespace(mf.Namespace)); err != nil {
  return nil, "", "", err
 }
 if rf := jobspec.RootFolderFor(folders.Items, mf.Spec.Path); rf != nil {
  return it, rf.Spec.Path, jobspec.RecycleBinOf(rf), nil
 }
 return it, "", "", nil
}
```

  (If F6.4 named the transcode record store's constructor otherwise than `task.NewRequester`, use
  F6.4's; if it made none, add `func NewRequester(bus events.Bus) *records.Requester[Record] {
  return records.NewRequester(bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodes), Spec) }` to `app/squash/task`.)

  `job.go`:

```go
// Job renders the standalone graft Job of a dispatch (§4.12 "Vehicle"):
// the cpu pool's pod running `transcode --graft-task`, keeping NATS_URL and
// POD_NAME (it answers in clustarr-grafts, D9), owned by its MediaFile and
// labelled with its UID; no termination message is read.
func Job(cfg pool.Config, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, t grafttask.Task, name string) (*batchv1.Job, error) {
 b, err := json.Marshal(t)
 if err != nil {
  return nil, err
 }
 tmpl := pool.Template(&transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{}, transcodev1alpha1.HardwareCPU, cfg)
 c := &tmpl.Spec.Containers[0]
 c.Args = append([]string{"--data-dir", cmp.Or(cfg.DataDir, pool.DefaultDataDir), "--graft-task", string(b)}, cfg.ExtraArgs...)
 c.Env = slices.DeleteFunc(c.Env, func(e corev1.EnvVar) bool { return e.Name == pool.EnvProfileUID || e.Name == pool.EnvClass })
 tmpl.Labels[grafttask.LabelGraftOf] = string(mf.UID)
 tmpl.Labels["app.kubernetes.io/component"] = ComponentGraft
 job := &batchv1.Job{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: mf.Namespace, Labels: map[string]string{
   pool.LabelManagedBy: pool.ManagedByValue, grafttask.LabelGraftOf: string(mf.UID),
   "app.kubernetes.io/name": "clustarr", "app.kubernetes.io/component": ComponentGraft,
  }},
  Spec: batchv1.JobSpec{
   BackoffLimit:            ptr.To[int32](0),
   ActiveDeadlineSeconds:   new(int64(graftplan.JobDeadline.Seconds())),
   TTLSecondsAfterFinished: ptr.To[int32](int32((24 * time.Hour).Seconds())),
   Template:                tmpl,
  },
 }
 job.OwnerReferences = []metav1.OwnerReference{*metav1.NewControllerRef(mf, catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.WithKind("MediaFile"))}
 return job, nil
}
```

3g. `app/remediation/effects_graft.go` and the executor:

```go
package remediation

// CreateGraftJob creates a standalone graft Job (§3.8, §4.12); its name is
// the dispatch's identity, so AlreadyExists is done.
type CreateGraftJob struct{ Job *batchv1.Job }

// DeleteGraftJob deletes an answered graft's Job, Background propagation;
// NotFound is done. (§3.8's list lacks it; §4.12's "record answered" row
// deletes the Job.)
type DeleteGraftJob struct{ Namespace, Name string }

// ExecGraftJobEffect runs e when it is a graft Job effect: ok is false for
// any other effect. The effect executor calls it first.
func ExecGraftJobEffect(ctx context.Context, c client.Client, e any) (bool, error) {
 switch e := e.(type) {
 case CreateGraftJob:
  if err := c.Create(ctx, e.Job); err != nil && !apierrors.IsAlreadyExists(err) {
   return true, fmt.Errorf("create graft Job %s/%s: %w", e.Job.Namespace, e.Job.Name, err)
  }
  return true, nil
 case DeleteGraftJob:
  err := c.Delete(ctx, &batchv1.Job{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: e.Namespace, Name: e.Name}},
   client.PropagationPolicy(metav1.DeletePropagationBackground))
  if client.IgnoreNotFound(err) != nil {
   return true, fmt.Errorf("delete graft Job %s/%s: %w", e.Namespace, e.Name, err)
  }
  return true, nil
 }
 return false, nil
}
```

  In F3.1's executor (the function holding `case RecordWrite`), before its type switch:
  `if ok, err := ExecGraftJobEffect(ctx, r.Client, e); ok { return err }` (the executor's own
  variable names). If F3.1 already defined a `CreateGraftJob`, delete its definition and executor
  case in favour of these.

3h. `app/remediation/source_graftjob.go`, S15:

```go
// graftJobSource is S15 (§3.3): a graft Job's completion, failure or
// deletion enqueues the MediaFile that controls it. The manager caches
// Jobs through pool.PoolJobCache, which graft Jobs pass by their
// managed-by label.
func graftJobSource(c cache.Cache) source.TypedSource[Key] {
 return source.Kind(c, &batchv1.Job{}, handler.TypedEnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(GraftJobKeys), graftJobPredicate())
}

// GraftJobKeys maps a graft Job to its controlling MediaFile's file key.
func GraftJobKeys(_ context.Context, j *batchv1.Job) []Key {
 if _, ok := j.Labels[grafttask.LabelGraftOf]; !ok {
  return nil
 }
 ref := metav1.GetControllerOf(j)
 if ref == nil || ref.Kind != "MediaFile" || ref.APIVersion != catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.String() {
  return nil
 }
 return []Key{{Kind: KindMediaFile, Namespace: j.Namespace, Name: ref.Name}}
}

func graftJobPredicate() predicate.TypedPredicate[*batchv1.Job] {
 finished := func(j *batchv1.Job) bool { done, _, _ := pool.JobFinished(j); return done }
 return predicate.TypedFuncs[*batchv1.Job]{
  CreateFunc:  func(event.TypedCreateEvent[*batchv1.Job]) bool { return false },
  UpdateFunc:  func(e event.TypedUpdateEvent[*batchv1.Job]) bool { return finished(e.ObjectOld) != finished(e.ObjectNew) },
  DeleteFunc:  func(event.TypedDeleteEvent[*batchv1.Job]) bool { return true },
  GenericFunc: func(event.TypedGenericEvent[*batchv1.Job]) bool { return false },
 }
}
```

  and in F3.1's `SetupWithManager` builder chain: `.WatchesRawSource(graftJobSource(mgr.GetCache()))`.

3m. Admission (F6.3):

- `app/squash/admission/graft.go`:

```go
package admission

// GraftFile is a file as the graft-slot count reads it (§5.13).
type GraftFile struct {
 UID             types.UID
 Key             types.NamespacedName
 Phase           catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase
 Reason          string
 JobName         string
 DonorImportedAt time.Time
 JoinInFlight    bool // its transcode block carries an in-flight joinedGraft
 Granted         bool // it holds an outstanding grant of any kind
}

func holdsGraftSlot(f GraftFile) bool {
 return f.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseQueued ||
  f.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseRunning && f.Reason != graftplan.ReasonJoinedTranscode
}

func graftCandidate(f GraftFile) bool {
 return f.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting && f.Reason == graftplan.ReasonWaitingForSlot && !f.JoinInFlight && !f.Granted
}

// GraftInUse is a namespace's graft slots in use (§5.13): the union, by
// Job name, of its unfinished graft Jobs (jobs, by namespace) and its
// blocks that hold a slot, plus its outstanding graft-slot grants.
func GraftInUse(ns string, files []GraftFile, jobs map[string][]string, grants map[string]int) int {
 names := map[string]bool{}
 for _, j := range jobs[ns] {
  names[j] = true
 }
 extra := 0
 for _, f := range files {
  if f.Key.Namespace != ns || !holdsGraftSlot(f) {
   continue
  }
  if f.JobName == "" {
   extra++
   continue
  }
  names[f.JobName] = true
 }
 return len(names) + extra + grants[ns]
}

// GraftGrants picks the files that get a graft slot now: per namespace, up
// to limit (graftplan.DefaultConcurrency when <= 0) less GraftInUse, the
// candidates by donorImportedAt, then namespace/name.
func GraftGrants(files []GraftFile, jobs map[string][]string, grants map[string]int, limit int) []types.UID {
 if limit <= 0 {
  limit = graftplan.DefaultConcurrency
 }
 byNS := map[string][]GraftFile{}
 for _, f := range files {
  if graftCandidate(f) {
   byNS[f.Key.Namespace] = append(byNS[f.Key.Namespace], f)
  }
 }
 var out []types.UID
 for _, ns := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(byNS)) {
  c := byNS[ns]
  slices.SortFunc(c, func(a, b GraftFile) int {
   if n := a.DonorImportedAt.Compare(b.DonorImportedAt); n != 0 {
    return n
   }
   return strings.Compare(a.Key.String(), b.Key.String())
  })
  for i := 0; i < limit-GraftInUse(ns, files, jobs, grants) && i < len(c); i++ {
   out = append(out, c[i].UID)
  }
 }
 return out
}
```

```go
func (l *Ledger) grantGraftSlotsLocked(in PassInputs, now time.Time) {
 files := make([]GraftFile, 0, len(l.files))
 grants := map[string]int{}
 for uid, e := range l.files {
  g := l.grants[uid]
  files = append(files, GraftFile{UID: uid, Key: e.view.Key, Phase: e.view.GraftPhase, Reason: e.view.GraftReason,
   JobName: e.view.GraftJobName, DonorImportedAt: e.view.DonorImportedAt, JoinInFlight: e.view.JoinedGraft, Granted: g != nil})
  if g != nil && g.kind == transcodeplan.GrantGraftSlot {
   grants[e.view.Key.Namespace]++
  }
 }
 for _, uid := range GraftGrants(files, in.GraftJobs, grants, l.o.GraftConcurrency) {
  l.grants[uid] = &grant{kind: transcodeplan.GrantGraftSlot, expires: now.Add(grantTTL)}
  if l.waker != nil {
   l.waker(l.files[uid].view.Key, GrantPriority)
  }
 }
}
```

3o. `cmd/transcode/main.go`: `flags` loses `termLog` and `newFlags` the `--termination-log` flag;
`--graft-task`'s usage reads "Run this audio graft (grafttask.Task v2 JSON) instead of serving a
pool, answer it in clustarr-grafts and exit: 0 when it grafted, found the language present or was
superseded."; `run` calls `runGraft(*f.graftTask, *f.dataDir, getenv, logging.New(*f.lo))`:

```go
// runGraft is one graft Job's pod (loop spec §4.12 "Pod"): NATS and /data,
// no Kubernetes credentials; it answers its task in clustarr-grafts.
func runGraft(taskJSON, dataDir string, getenv func(string) string, log *slog.Logger) int {
 ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM, os.Interrupt)
 defer stop()
 ctx = logging.NewContext(ctx, log)
 var t grafttask.Task
 if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(taskJSON), &t); err != nil || t.Schema != grafttask.TaskSchema || t.File.UID == "" || t.Seq <= 0 {
  log.ErrorContext(ctx, "a --graft-task the loop did not issue", "error", err, "schema", t.Schema)
  return 1
 }
 url, pod := getenv("NATS_URL"), getenv("POD_NAME")
 if url == "" || pod == "" {
  fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "transcode: a graft pod needs $NATS_URL and $POD_NAME")
  return jobspec.WorkerExitMisconfigured
 }
 nc, err := nats.Connect(url, nats.Name("transcode/graft/"+pod))
 if err != nil {
  log.ErrorContext(ctx, "nats connect", "error", err)
  return 1
 }
 defer nc.Close()
 bus, err := natsbus.New(nc)
 if err != nil {
  log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bus", "error", err)
  return 1
 }
 res, err := grafttask.Serve(ctx, grafttask.NewAnswerer(bus, pod), t, func(ctx context.Context, t grafttask.Task) grafttask.Result {
  return graft.Run(ctx, t, graft.Options{DataDir: dataDir})
 })
 switch {
 case errors.Is(err, grafttask.ErrSuperseded):
  log.InfoContext(ctx, "graft superseded", "file", t.File.Name, "seq", t.Seq)
  return 0
 case err != nil:
  log.ErrorContext(ctx, "graft", "file", t.File.Name, "seq", t.Seq, "error", err)
  return 1
 }
 log.InfoContext(ctx, "graft finished", "file", t.File.Name, "seq", t.Seq, "phase", res.Phase, "reason", res.Reason, "message", res.Message)
 if res.Phase == grafttask.PhaseSucceeded {
  return 0
 }
 return 1
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the guards.** `test/guards/records_test.go`:

```go
package guards

import (
 "go/ast"
 "go/token"
 "go/types"
 "maps"
 "path/filepath"
 "slices"
 "strconv"
 "strings"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
)

// recordStores is each records bucket's store: the one package that opens
// the bucket and wraps pkg/records for it (loop spec §4.5). It names every
// Records bucket of the default topology, and nothing else.
var recordStores = map[string]string{
 events.BucketProbes:     "pkg/probestore",
 events.BucketMarkers:    "app/catalog/markers",
 events.BucketSegments:   "pkg/segments",
 events.BucketSubtitles:  "pkg/subtitlestore",
 events.BucketTranscodes: "app/squash/task",
 events.BucketGrafts:     "app/squash/grafttask",
}

// bucketIdents are the pkg/events constants naming the records buckets, by
// identifier, so the scan recognises events.BucketX at a call site.
var bucketIdents = map[string]string{
 "BucketProbes": events.BucketProbes, "BucketMarkers": events.BucketMarkers, "BucketSegments": events.BucketSegments,
 "BucketSubtitles": events.BucketSubtitles, "BucketTranscodes": events.BucketTranscodes, "BucketGrafts": events.BucketGrafts,
}

// bucketOpeners are raw opens of a records bucket outside its store that the
// store still mediates, keyed "<package dir>: <bucket>", each with how. A
// row that matches no open fails.
var bucketOpeners = map[string]string{
 "cmd/transcode: " + events.BucketTranscodes:      "worker.ServeOptions.Records (F6.4): app/squash/worker builds the pod's task.Answers from it and uses it for nothing else",
 "app/catalog/manager: " + events.BucketSegments: "segmentplan.Sweeper (F3.4, loop spec §4.11): deletes the records of MediaFiles that are gone, the bucket's one write that is not a compare-and-swap",
}

// notRecordsCalls are Request or Withdraw calls, in a file that imports
// pkg/records or a store, whose receiver is not a records requester (a NATS
// RPC Request, say), keyed "<package dir>: <receiver expression>", each with
// what the receiver is. Empty: add a row only with a reason a reviewer can
// check against the code.
var notRecordsCalls = map[string]string{}

// inRemediation reports whether dir is the loop: app/remediation or under it.
func inRemediation(dir string) bool {
 return dir == "app/remediation" || strings.HasPrefix(dir, "app/remediation/")
}

// recordsCaller may call a requester's Request or Withdraw: the loop (loop
// spec §4.15), pkg/records itself, and each store's own wrapper over it --
// pkg/probestore's Request, pkg/subtitlestore's Request and Withdraw,
// app/squash/task's Withdrawal -- which only the loop calls (defect D11: a
// store wraps the loop's requester; it does not hand a worker one).
func recordsCaller(dir string) bool {
 return inRemediation(dir) || dir == "pkg/records" || slices.Contains(slices.Collect(maps.Values(recordStores)), dir)
}

// TestRecordsRequestersAreTheLoop (loop spec §4.15): only the remediation
// loop requests or withdraws a record; a worker claims, defers and answers
// through pkg/records' Answerer, and calls no requester.
func TestRecordsRequestersAreTheLoop(t *testing.T) {
 var buckets []string
 for _, b := range events.Default().Buckets {
  if b.Records {
   buckets = append(buckets, b.Name)
  }
 }
 assert.ElementsMatch(t, buckets, slices.Collect(maps.Keys(recordStores)), "every records bucket has a store row, and only records buckets do")
 assert.ElementsMatch(t, slices.Collect(maps.Keys(recordStores)), slices.Collect(maps.Values(bucketIdents)))

 imports := map[string]bool{mod + "pkg/records": true}
 for _, dir := range recordStores {
  imports[mod+dir] = true
 }
 seen := map[string]int{}
 for file, f := range productionFiles(t) {
  dir := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(file))
  uses := recordsCaller(dir)
  for _, imp := range f.Imports {
   if p, err := strconv.Unquote(imp.Path.Value); err == nil && imports[p] {
    uses = true
   }
  }
  if !uses {
   continue
  }
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
   if !ok {
    return true
   }
   sel, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
   if !ok || (sel.Sel.Name != "Request" && sel.Sel.Name != "Withdraw" && sel.Sel.Name != "WithdrawAll") {
    return true
   }
   if recordsCaller(dir) {
    seen[sel.Sel.Name]++
    return true
   }
   recv := types.ExprString(sel.X)
   if _, ok := notRecordsCalls[dir+": "+recv]; !ok {
    t.Errorf("%s: %s.%s outside the loop: only app/remediation requests or withdraws a record (loop spec §4.15); a worker claims and answers", file, recv, sel.Sel.Name)
   }
   return true
  })
 }
 assert.Positive(t, seen["Request"], "no Request in the loop or a store: the scan is looking in the wrong place")
 assert.Positive(t, seen["Withdraw"], "no Withdraw in the loop or a store: the scan is looking in the wrong place")
}

// TestRecordsBucketsOpenOnlyThroughTheirStores (loop spec §4.5, §4.15): a
// records bucket is opened -- Bus.KV(events.BucketX) -- only in its store's
// package, as the direct argument of a call into that store
// (segments.NewStore(bus.KV(…)), task.Requests(bus.KV(…))), at a
// bucketOpeners site, or in app/remediation, whose effect executor writes
// the loop's RecordWrite effects by revision-checked Create and Update (Wave
// F3's defect 5: the guard exempts the executor). No code outside pkg/events
// spells a records bucket's name.
func TestRecordsBucketsOpenOnlyThroughTheirStores(t *testing.T) {
 names := map[string]string{} // bucket name -> its constant
 for id, name := range bucketIdents {
  names[name] = id
 }
 used := map[string]bool{}
 for file, f := range productionFiles(t) {
  dir := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(file))
  if dir == "pkg/events" || strings.HasPrefix(dir, "pkg/events/") {
   continue // the topology declares the buckets
  }
  ev := importAlias(f, mod+"pkg/events", "events")
  storeOf := map[string]string{} // import alias -> store dir
  for _, s := range recordStores {
   if a := importAlias(f, mod+s, filepath.Base(s)); a != "" {
    storeOf[a] = s
   }
  }
  wrapped := map[ast.Expr]string{} // an argument -> the store whose call it is passed to
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   if call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
    if sel, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok {
     if x, ok := sel.X.(*ast.Ident); ok && storeOf[x.Name] != "" {
      for _, a := range call.Args {
       wrapped[a] = storeOf[x.Name]
      }
     }
    }
   }
   return true
  })
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   switch v := n.(type) {
   case *ast.BasicLit:
    if s, err := strconv.Unquote(v.Value); v.Kind == token.STRING && err == nil && names[s] != "" {
     t.Errorf("%s: spells the records bucket %q; name it events.%s, through its store", file, s, names[s])
    }
   case *ast.CallExpr:
    sel, ok := v.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
    if !ok || sel.Sel.Name != "KV" || len(v.Args) != 1 || ev == "" {
     return true
    }
    arg, ok := v.Args[0].(*ast.SelectorExpr)
    if !ok {
     return true
    }
    if x, ok := arg.X.(*ast.Ident); !ok || x.Name != ev {
     return true
    }
    bucket, ok := bucketIdents[arg.Sel.Name]
    if !ok {
     return true
    }
    store, key := recordStores[bucket], dir+": "+bucket
    switch {
    case dir == store, wrapped[v] == store, inRemediation(dir):
    case bucketOpeners[key] != "":
     used[key] = true
    default:
     t.Errorf("%s: opens %s outside its store: only %s holds the bucket's KV (loop spec §4.5)", file, bucket, store)
    }
   }
   return true
  })
 }
 for key := range bucketOpeners {
  assert.True(t, used[key], "bucketOpeners row %q matches no open: delete it", key)
 }
}
```

`test/guards/v1tasks_test.go`:

```go
package guards

import (
 "go/ast"
 "strconv"
 "strings"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/squash/grafttask"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/squash/task"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/schema"
)

// v1TaskSchemas are the folded remediations' bus tasks before the fold.
// Release N still decodes them for one release -- a stale ack in each
// worker, a namespace-only resolver in history (loop spec §6.7.2, §4.12,
// §6.10) -- but no code may produce one.
var v1TaskSchemas = map[string]bool{
 "catalog.MarkersTask.v1": true, "subtitle.FetchTask.v1": true, "transcode.Task.v1": true,
}

// v1TaskTypes are the pre-fold payload types release N keeps for those
// decoders; encoding one is producing a v1 task.
var v1TaskTypes = map[string]bool{"FetchTaskV1": true, "TaskV1": true}

// TestNoV1TaskProducers (loop spec §4.15): each folded remediation's task
// encodes v2, and no production code encodes a v1 payload or builds an
// envelope whose schema is a v1 task's. Comparing a received envelope's
// schema with a v1 name -- a stale ack -- is not producing one.
func TestNoV1TaskProducers(t *testing.T) {
 for name, s := range map[string]string{
  "schema.MarkersTask": schema.MarkersTask{}.Schema(), "schema.FetchTask": schema.FetchTask{}.Schema(),
  "task.Task": task.Task{}.Schema(), "grafttask.TaskSchema": grafttask.TaskSchema,
 } {
  assert.True(t, strings.HasSuffix(s, ".v2"), "%s encodes %s, not v2", name, s)
 }
 for file, f := range productionFiles(t) {
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   switch v := n.(type) {
   case *ast.CallExpr: // schema.Encode(task.TaskV1{…})
    if sel, ok := v.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.Sel.Name == "Encode" && len(v.Args) == 1 && isV1Payload(v.Args[0]) {
     t.Errorf("%s: encodes a v1 task payload: release N produces only v2 tasks (loop spec §4.15)", file)
    }
   case *ast.CompositeLit: // events.Envelope{Schema: "transcode.Task.v1", …}
    if sel, ok := v.Type.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.Sel.Name == "Envelope" {
     for _, el := range v.Elts {
      if kv, ok := el.(*ast.KeyValueExpr); ok {
       if k, ok := kv.Key.(*ast.Ident); ok && k.Name == "Schema" && isV1Schema(kv.Value) {
        t.Errorf("%s: builds an envelope with a v1 task schema (loop spec §4.15)", file)
       }
      }
     }
    }
   case *ast.AssignStmt: // env.Schema = schema.FetchTaskV1Schema
    for i, l := range v.Lhs {
     if sel, ok := l.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.Sel.Name == "Schema" && i < len(v.Rhs) && isV1Schema(v.Rhs[i]) {
      t.Errorf("%s: sets an envelope's schema to a v1 task's (loop spec §4.15)", file)
     }
    }
   }
   return true
  })
 }
}

// isV1Payload reports a composite literal of a v1 task type, parenthesised
// or not, by value or by address.
func isV1Payload(e ast.Expr) bool {
 for {
  switch v := e.(type) {
  case *ast.ParenExpr:
   e = v.X
  case *ast.UnaryExpr:
   e = v.X
  case *ast.CompositeLit:
   switch ty := v.Type.(type) {
   case *ast.SelectorExpr:
    return v1TaskTypes[ty.Sel.Name]
   case *ast.Ident:
    return v1TaskTypes[ty.Name]
   }
   return false
  default:
   return false
  }
 }
}

// isV1Schema reports a v1 task schema written as a literal, as the constant
// release N keeps for the decoders (schema.FetchTaskV1Schema), or as a v1
// payload's Schema() (task.TaskV1{}.Schema()). The guard names the v1
// constant and types only as strings, so F9.4's deletions leave it compiling.
func isV1Schema(e ast.Expr) bool {
 switch v := e.(type) {
 case *ast.BasicLit:
  s, err := strconv.Unquote(v.Value)
  return err == nil && v1TaskSchemas[s]
 case *ast.SelectorExpr:
  return v.Sel.Name == "FetchTaskV1Schema"
 case *ast.CallExpr:
  sel, ok := v.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
  return ok && sel.Sel.Name == "Schema" && isV1Payload(sel.X)
 }
 return false
}
```

```go
// TestLegacyFoldIsAbsentUntilAdoptionWritesIt: a file that never had a
// legacy object carries no legacyFold at all (omitempty), so release N's
// first render of the 8,900 files without one writes nothing for it.
func TestLegacyFoldIsAbsentUntilAdoptionWritesIt(t *testing.T) {
 b, err := json.Marshal(catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.NotContains(t, string(b), "legacyFold")

 at := metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
 st := catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{LegacyFold: &catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldStatus{
  Adopted: []catalogv1alpha1.LegacyAdoption{{
   Kind: catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob, Name: "heat-c5a05678", UID: "u-1",
   Outcome: catalogv1alpha1.LegacyOutcomeDismissed, At: at,
  }},
 }}
 b, err = json.Marshal(st)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.JSONEq(t, `{"legacyFold":{"adopted":[{"kind":"TranscodeJob","name":"heat-c5a05678","uid":"u-1","outcome":"Dismissed","at":"2026-10-06T12:00:00Z"}]}}`, string(b))
 assert.Equal(t, 16, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldMaxAdopted)
}
```

```go
package crdcheck

import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime/schema"
 "k8s.io/client-go/dynamic"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/envtest"
)

// TestMediaFileLegacyFoldIsBoundedAndClosed compiles loop spec §7.3.1's
// schema against a real apiserver: 16 adopted entries fit and a 17th is
// refused; kind, outcome and held are closed enums; uid is capped at 36.
func TestMediaFileLegacyFoldIsBoundedAndClosed(t *testing.T) {
 if os.Getenv("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS") == "" {
  t.Skip("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS is unset; run via `make test` to install the CRDs")
 }
 env := &envtest.Environment{CRDDirectoryPaths: []string{"../../config/crd/bases"}, ErrorIfCRDPathMissing: true}
 cfg, err := env.Start()
 require.NoError(t, err)
 t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, env.Stop()) })
 dyn, err := dynamic.NewForConfig(cfg)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 ctx := context.Background()
 gvr := schema.GroupVersionResource{Group: "catalog.clustarr.io", Version: "v1alpha1", Resource: "mediafiles"}
 mf, err := dyn.Resource(gvr).Namespace("default").Create(ctx, &unstructured.Unstructured{Object: map[string]any{
  "apiVersion": "catalog.clustarr.io/v1alpha1", "kind": "MediaFile",
  "metadata": map[string]any{"name": "heat-abc1234567", "namespace": "default"},
  "spec": map[string]any{
   "mediaRef": map[string]any{"kind": "movie", "name": "heat"},
   "path":     "/data/media/movies/Heat (1995)/Heat (1995).mkv",
  },
 }}, metav1.CreateOptions{})
 require.NoError(t, err)

 entry := func(i int, kind, outcome string) map[string]any {
  return map[string]any{"kind": kind, "name": fmt.Sprintf("obj-%d", i), "uid": fmt.Sprintf("00000000-0000-0000-0000-%012d", i),
   "outcome": outcome, "at": "2026-10-06T12:00:00Z"}
 }
 write := func(legacy map[string]any) error {
  cur, err := dyn.Resource(gvr).Namespace("default").Get(ctx, mf.GetName(), metav1.GetOptions{})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, unstructured.SetNestedField(cur.Object, legacy, "status", "legacyFold"))
  _, err = dyn.Resource(gvr).Namespace("default").UpdateStatus(ctx, cur, metav1.UpdateOptions{})
  return err
 }
 var sixteen []any
 for i := range 16 {
  sixteen = append(sixteen, entry(i, "TranscodeJob", "Dismissed"))
 }
 require.NoError(t, write(map[string]any{"adopted": sixteen, "held": "Preparation", "message": "waiting"}), "16 entries fit")
 require.Error(t, write(map[string]any{"adopted": append(sixteen, entry(16, "TranscodeJob", "Dismissed"))}), "a 17th entry is refused")
 require.Error(t, write(map[string]any{"adopted": []any{entry(0, "Download", "Copied")}}), "kind is closed")
 require.Error(t, write(map[string]any{"adopted": []any{entry(0, "AudioGraft", "Kept")}}), "outcome is closed")
 require.Error(t, write(map[string]any{"held": "Later"}), "held is closed")
 long := entry(0, "SubtitleRequest", "Copied")
 long["uid"] = "0123456789012345678901234567890123456789"
 require.Error(t, write(map[string]any{"adopted": []any{long}}), "uid is capped at 36")
 require.Error(t, write(map[string]any{"adopted": []any{entry(0, "TranscodeJob", "Copied"), entry(0, "TranscodeJob", "Copied")}}),
  "adopted is a map list keyed by uid: a duplicate uid is refused")
}
```

```go
package v1alpha1

import (
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
)

// LegacyKind is a kind release N adopts onto MediaFile status (ADR-0016,
// loop spec §7.3.1). Release N+1 deletes this file.
// +kubebuilder:validation:Enum=SubtitleRequest;TranscodeJob;AudioGraft
type LegacyKind string

const (
 LegacyKindSubtitleRequest LegacyKind = "SubtitleRequest"
 LegacyKindTranscodeJob    LegacyKind = "TranscodeJob"
 LegacyKindAudioGraft      LegacyKind = "AudioGraft"
)

// LegacyOutcome is whether an adopted object's state was copied into a
// block or dismissed (its metric outcome says which rule decided).
// +kubebuilder:validation:Enum=Copied;Dismissed
type LegacyOutcome string

const (
 LegacyOutcomeCopied    LegacyOutcome = "Copied"
 LegacyOutcomeDismissed LegacyOutcome = "Dismissed"
)

// LegacyFoldHold says why adoption waits on a file.
// +kubebuilder:validation:Enum=Mode;Preparation;TooMany
type LegacyFoldHold string

const (
 // LegacyFoldHoldMode: the manager runs --legacy-fold=hold.
 LegacyFoldHoldMode LegacyFoldHold = "Mode"
 // LegacyFoldHoldPreparation: the Migrator has not yet withdrawn a task
 // or carried an intent annotation for one of the file's objects.
 LegacyFoldHoldPreparation LegacyFoldHold = "Preparation"
 // LegacyFoldHoldTooMany: the file has more legacy objects than
 // adopted can record; it is reported, never truncated.
 LegacyFoldHoldTooMany LegacyFoldHold = "TooMany"
)

// LegacyFoldMaxAdopted is adopted's MaxItems.
const LegacyFoldMaxAdopted = 16

// LegacyFoldStatus is release N's record of the SubtitleRequest, TranscodeJob
// and AudioGraft objects whose state the remediation loop adopted onto this
// file (ADR-0016). Release N+1 removes it.
type LegacyFoldStatus struct {
 // Adopted is one entry per legacy object adopted, by UID. An entry is
 // stamped once and carried forward unchanged.
 // +optional
 // +listType=map
 // +listMapKey=uid
 // +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
 Adopted []LegacyAdoption `json:"adopted,omitempty"`
 // Held says why adoption waits on this file; empty when nothing waits.
 // +optional
 Held LegacyFoldHold `json:"held,omitempty"`
 // +optional
 // +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
 Message string `json:"message,omitempty"`
}

// LegacyAdoption is one adopted legacy object.
type LegacyAdoption struct {
 Kind LegacyKind `json:"kind"`
 // +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=253
 Name string `json:"name"`
 // +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=36
 UID     types.UID     `json:"uid"`
 Outcome LegacyOutcome `json:"outcome"`
 At      metav1.Time   `json:"at"`
}
```

```go
package legacyfold_test

import (

// loadGz decodes one of test/data/legacyfold's gzipped List dumps into out.
func loadGz(t *testing.T, name string, out any) {
 t.Helper()
 f, err := os.Open(filepath.Join("..", "..", "..", "test", "data", "legacyfold", name))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 defer f.Close()
 zr, err := gzip.NewReader(f)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(zr).Decode(out))
}

type liveFixture struct {
 files map[string]*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 srs   map[string][]subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest
 tjs   map[string][]transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob
}

func loadLive(t *testing.T) liveFixture {

 loadGz(t, "mediafiles.json.gz", &mfs)

 }
```

  1c. `app/catalog/legacyfold/plan_test.go`:

```go
package legacyfold_test

import (
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/legacyfold"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/squash/jobspec"
)

var now = metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 7, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))

func always(types.UID) bool { return true }

// liveProfile is hevc-mkv as the live jobs' names prove it was: an empty
// spec (every default), test/data/legacyfold/README.md.
func liveProfile() transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile {
 return transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "hevc-mkv"}}
}

func TestTheLiveProfileIsTheDefaultSpec(t *testing.T) {
 assert.Equal(t, "c5a056785c9e2ecf2c96152440cba662cedc16b67cba7f69f08350d486e8a8db",
  jobspec.ProfileHashAt(liveProfile().Spec, 1))
}

// totals runs Plan over every live file, as the loop would on its first pass
// with every object prepared, and counts outcomes by kind.
func totals(t *testing.T, hash func(transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileSpec) string) map[string]map[string]int {
 fx := loadLive(t)
 got := map[string]map[string]int{}
 for name, mf := range fx.files {
  out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{
   File: mf, SubtitleRequests: fx.srs[name], TranscodeJobs: fx.tjs[name],
   Profiles: []transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{liveProfile()},
   Mode:     legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now, Hash: hash,
  })
  require.Empty(t, out.Status.Held, "%s: nothing is held with every object prepared", name)
  for _, o := range out.Objects {
   if got[string(o.Kind)] == nil {
    got[string(o.Kind)] = map[string]int{}
   }
   got[string(o.Kind)][o.Outcome]++
  }
 }
 return got
}

// TestPlanReproducesTheLiveTotals is loop spec §7.1/§7.3.3's arithmetic on
// the live objects: under the version-1 hash the dump was taken under, and
// under the current standard.Version, where every verdict is superseded.
func TestPlanReproducesTheLiveTotals(t *testing.T) {
 v1 := func(s transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileSpec) string { return jobspec.ProfileHashAt(s, 1) }
 got := totals(t, v1)
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]int{legacyfold.OutcomeCopied: 283, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedEmpty: 2162}, got["SubtitleRequest"])
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]int{
  legacyfold.OutcomeCopiedVerdict: 19, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSourceChanged: 3,
  legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSuperseded: 524, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedOpen: 32,
  legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedIncorporated: 48,
 }, got["TranscodeJob"])

 got = totals(t, nil) // jobspec.ProfileHash: standard.Version 2 and later
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]int{
  legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSourceChanged: 3, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSuperseded: 543,
  legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedOpen: 32, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedIncorporated: 48,
 }, got["TranscodeJob"])
}

// TestTheNamedLiveObjects pins the cases §7.3.12 names, by name.
func TestTheNamedLiveObjects(t *testing.T) {
 fx := loadLive(t)
 outcome := func(kind catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKind, obj string) legacyfold.Object {
  for name, mf := range fx.files {
   out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: mf, SubtitleRequests: fx.srs[name], TranscodeJobs: fx.tjs[name],
    Profiles: []transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{liveProfile()}, Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now})
   for _, o := range out.Objects {
    if o.Kind == kind && o.Name == obj {
     return o
    }
   }
  }
  t.Fatalf("no %s %s in the fixture", kind, obj)
  return legacyfold.Object{}
 }
 phantom := outcome(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob, "avatar---the-last-airbender-403da1849a-s02e09-debec48de0-c5a05678")
 assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedOpen, phantom.Outcome, "the phantom Running job is withdrawn and planned afresh")
 for _, blocked := range []string{"35-up-fc3ea6ba71-1c23ce1201-438c9a3e", "35-up-fc3ea6ba71-1c23ce1201-f0a6f12c"} {
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSuperseded, outcome(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob, blocked).Outcome, blocked)
 }
 for _, sc := range []string{"an-unmarried-woman-ef5fb4983f-5b16f70699-c5a05678", "andor-f0582941ca-s02e01-70bba62d09-c5a05678", "andor-f0582941ca-s02e02-fe779e3051-c5a05678"} {
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSourceChanged, outcome(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob, sc).Outcome, sc)
 }
 // Every copied item keeps its backoff: 277 items sit at count 14.
 at14 := 0
 for name, mf := range fx.files {
  out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: mf, SubtitleRequests: fx.srs[name], Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now})
  if out.Subtitles == nil {
   continue
  }
  for _, it := range out.Subtitles.Items {
   if it.Attempts.Count == 14 {
    at14++
    require.NotNil(t, it.NextSearchAt, "%s/%s: the weekly cadence is carried", name, it.LangKey)
   }
   assert.Nil(t, it.Dispatch, "dispatch starts nil")
  }
 }
 assert.Equal(t, 277, at14)
}

func mf(name string) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 probed := metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
 return &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: "films", UID: types.UID(name + "-uid")},
  Spec:       catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{Path: "/data/media/movies/Heat (1995)/Heat (1995).mkv", MediaRef: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"}},
  Status:     catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeHash: "p1", ProbedAt: &probed},
 }
}

func tj(name string, phase transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhase, finished *time.Time) transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob {
 j := transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: "films", UID: types.UID(name + "-uid"), CreationTimestamp: metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 9, 30, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))},
  Spec:       transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobSpec{MediaFileRef: "heat-file", ProfileRef: "hevc-mkv", SourceProbeHash: "p1"},
  Status:     transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobStatus{Phase: phase},
 }
 if finished != nil {
  f := metav1.NewTime(*finished)
  j.Status.FinishedAt = &f
 }
 return j
}

func TestTranscodeRules(t *testing.T) {
 probed := time.Date(2026, 10, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 later := probed.Add(time.Hour)
 hash := jobspec.ProfileHash(liveProfile().Spec)
 current := "heat-file-" + hash[:8]
 succeeded := func(name string, fin time.Time, tag string) transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob {
  j := tj(name, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSucceeded, &fin)
  j.Status.Result = &transcodev1alpha1.Result{OutputPath: "/data/media/movies/Heat (1995)/Heat (1995).mp4", OutputSizeBytes: 42,
   MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{TranscodeProfile: tag}}
  return j
 }
 in := func(file *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, jobs ...transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) legacyfold.Input {
  return legacyfold.Input{File: file, TranscodeJobs: jobs, Profiles: []transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile{liveProfile()},
   Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now}
 }

 t.Run("an equal finishedAt is incorporated; a strictly later one is a pending swap", func(t *testing.T) {
  out := legacyfold.Plan(in(mf("heat-file"), succeeded("old", probed, "hevc-mkv@aaa")))
  require.Len(t, out.Objects, 1)
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedIncorporated, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
  assert.Nil(t, out.Transcode)

  out = legacyfold.Plan(in(mf("heat-file"), succeeded("new", later, "hevc-mkv@"+hash)))
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeCopiedSwap, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
  require.NotNil(t, out.Transcode)
  assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, out.Transcode.Phase)
  assert.Equal(t, "hevc-mkv", out.Transcode.Profile)
  assert.Equal(t, hash, out.Transcode.ProfileHash, "split from the output's tag, never from the profile's current hash")
  assert.Equal(t, "hevc-mkv@"+hash, out.Transcode.ProfileTag)
  require.NotNil(t, out.Transcode.Result)
  assert.Equal(t, int64(42), out.Transcode.Result.OutputSizeBytes)
  assert.True(t, out.Transcode.FinishedAt.Time.Equal(later))
 })
 t.Run("only the newest swap counts", func(t *testing.T) {
  out := legacyfold.Plan(in(mf("heat-file"), succeeded("a", later, "hevc-mkv@x"), succeeded("b", later.Add(time.Minute), "hevc-mkv@y")))
  byName := map[string]string{}
  for _, o := range out.Objects {
   byName[o.Name] = o.Outcome
  }
  assert.Equal(t, map[string]string{"a": legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSuperseded, "b": legacyfold.OutcomeCopiedSwap}, byName)
  assert.Equal(t, "y", out.Transcode.ProfileHash)
 })
 t.Run("a swap is carried into an existing block that holds none and finished earlier", func(t *testing.T) {
  file := mf("heat-file")
  file.Status.Transcode = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Compliant: true, ProfileTag: "hevc-mkv@old"} // a live phase-less block
  out := legacyfold.Plan(in(file, succeeded("new", later, "hevc-mkv@"+hash)))
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeCopiedSwap, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
  assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, out.Transcode.Phase)
 })
 t.Run("a verdict beside an existing block is dismissed", func(t *testing.T) {
  file := mf("heat-file")
  file.Status.Transcode = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Compliant: true, ProfileTag: "hevc-mkv@old"}
  skipped := tj(current, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSkipped, &later)
  out := legacyfold.Plan(in(file, skipped))
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedBlockExists, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
  assert.Nil(t, out.Transcode)
 })
 t.Run("a verdict under the current hash is copied", func(t *testing.T) {
  failed := tj(current, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseFailed, &later)
  failed.Status.Attempts, failed.Status.FallbackReason = 3, "nvenc refused the source"
  failed.Status.Conditions = []metav1.Condition{
   {Type: transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobConditionFailed, Status: metav1.ConditionTrue, Reason: "RetriesExhausted"},
   {Type: transcodev1alpha1.ConditionBlocked, Status: metav1.ConditionTrue, Reason: "RetriesExhausted"},
  }
  out := legacyfold.Plan(in(mf("heat-file"), failed))
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeCopiedVerdict, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
  assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseFailed, out.Transcode.Phase)
  assert.Equal(t, "RetriesExhausted", out.Transcode.Reason)
  assert.True(t, out.Transcode.Blocked)
  assert.Equal(t, int32(3), out.Transcode.Attempts)
  assert.Equal(t, hash, out.Transcode.ProfileHash)
  assert.Equal(t, "p1", out.Transcode.ProbeHash)
 })
 t.Run("SourceChanged precedes the verdict rule; another hash is superseded", func(t *testing.T) {
  sc := tj(current, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseFailed, &later)
  sc.Status.Conditions = []metav1.Condition{{Type: transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobConditionFailed, Status: metav1.ConditionTrue, Reason: "SourceChanged"}}
  other := tj("heat-file-f0a6f12c", transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSkipped, &later)
  out := legacyfold.Plan(in(mf("heat-file"), sc, other))
  byName := map[string]string{}
  for _, o := range out.Objects {
   byName[o.Name] = o.Outcome
  }
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSourceChanged, byName[current])
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedSuperseded, byName["heat-file-f0a6f12c"])
 })
 t.Run("an open job waits for preparation and holds the transcode planner and the rename", func(t *testing.T) {
  open := tj(current, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhasePlanned, nil)
  i := in(mf("heat-file"), open)
  i.Prepared = func(types.UID) bool { return false }
  out := legacyfold.Plan(i)
  assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHoldPreparation, out.Status.Held)
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.Hold{Transcode: true, Rename: true}, out.Hold)
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.PreparationRetry, out.Requeue)
  assert.Empty(t, out.Status.Adopted)
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.StateHeldPreparation, out.Objects[0].State)

  i.Prepared = always
  out = legacyfold.Plan(i)
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedOpen, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
  assert.Empty(t, out.Status.Held)
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.Hold{}, out.Hold)
  require.Len(t, out.Status.Adopted, 1)
  assert.Equal(t, now, out.Status.Adopted[0].At)
 })
}

func TestSubtitleRules(t *testing.T) {
 tried := metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
 next := metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 12, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
 sr := subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "heat-file", Namespace: "films", UID: "sr-uid", Generation: 3},
  Spec:       subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: "heat-file", ProfileRef: "english"},
  Status: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestStatus{ProbeHash: "p1", Phase: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestPhaseSearching, Items: []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItem{
   {LangKey: "es", State: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemSearching, Attempts: commonv1.Attempts{Initial: &tried, Latest: &tried, Count: 14}, NextSearchAt: &next,
    LastError: "every eligible provider is throttled" + strings.Repeat("!", 600)},
   {LangKey: "en", State: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemDownloaded, Provider: "os", SubtitleID: "9", Score: 90, ScoreOutOf: 100,
    Path: "Heat (1995).en.srt", DownloadedAt: &tried},
   {LangKey: "fr", State: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemDownloaded, Path: strings.Repeat("x", 256) + ".srt"},
  }},
 }
 out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: mf("heat-file"), SubtitleRequests: []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{sr},
  Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now})
 require.Len(t, out.Objects, 1)
 assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeCopied, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
 require.NotNil(t, out.Subtitles)
 assert.Equal(t, "english", out.Subtitles.Profile)
 assert.Equal(t, "p1", out.Subtitles.ProbeHash)
 require.Len(t, out.Subtitles.Items, 3)
 en, es, fr := out.Subtitles.Items[0], out.Subtitles.Items[1], out.Subtitles.Items[2]
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"en", "es", "fr"}, []string{en.LangKey, es.LangKey, fr.LangKey}, "sorted by langKey")
 assert.Equal(t, "Heat (1995).en.srt", en.Name, "path becomes name")
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateDownloaded, en.State)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending, es.State, "searching becomes pending")
 assert.Equal(t, int32(14), es.Attempts.Count)
 assert.LessOrEqual(t, len(es.LastError), 512, "lastError is clamped")
 assert.Empty(t, fr.Name, "a name over 255 characters is dropped")
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending, fr.State, "and the item reads pending")

 t.Run("an empty request is dismissed", func(t *testing.T) {
  empty := sr.DeepCopy()
  empty.Status.Items = nil
  out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: mf("heat-file"), SubtitleRequests: []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{*empty},
   Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now})
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedEmpty, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
  assert.Nil(t, out.Subtitles)
 })
 t.Run("a pending force needs preparation, and is held until it is prepared", func(t *testing.T) {
  forced := sr.DeepCopy()
  forced.Spec.ForceSearch = true
  assert.True(t, legacyfold.NeedsPreparation(forced))
  set, dropped := legacyfold.Intent(forced)
  assert.Equal(t, map[string]string{catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationSubtitleSearch: "fold-3"}, set)
  assert.Empty(t, dropped)
  out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: mf("heat-file"), SubtitleRequests: []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{*forced},
   Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: func(types.UID) bool { return false }, Now: now})
  assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHoldPreparation, out.Status.Held)
  assert.True(t, out.Hold.Subtitles)
 })
 t.Run("a block already there wins", func(t *testing.T) {
  file := mf("heat-file")
  file.Status.Subtitles = &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseNotWanted}
  out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: file, SubtitleRequests: []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{sr},
   Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now})
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedBlockExists, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
  assert.Nil(t, out.Subtitles)
 })
 t.Run("an adopted UID is never adopted again, whatever the block says", func(t *testing.T) {
  file := mf("heat-file")
  file.Status.LegacyFold = &catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldStatus{Adopted: []catalogv1alpha1.LegacyAdoption{{
   Kind: catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindSubtitleRequest, Name: "heat-file", UID: "sr-uid", Outcome: catalogv1alpha1.LegacyOutcomeCopied,
   At: metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)),
  }}}
  out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: file, SubtitleRequests: []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{sr},
   Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now})
  assert.Nil(t, out.Subtitles, "the planner cleared its block; the legacy object is not adopted twice")
  assert.Equal(t, file.Status.LegacyFold, out.Status, "the record is carried forward byte for byte")
  assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.StateAdopted, out.Objects[0].State)
 })
}

func TestHoldModeAndTooMany(t *testing.T) {
 sr := subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "heat-file", Namespace: "films", UID: "sr-uid"},
  Spec: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: "heat-file"}}
 out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: mf("heat-file"), SubtitleRequests: []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{sr},
  Mode: legacyfold.ModeHold, Prepared: always, Now: now})
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHoldMode, out.Status.Held)
 assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.Hold{Subtitles: true}, out.Hold)
 assert.Empty(t, out.Status.Adopted)
 assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.StateHeldMode, out.Objects[0].State)

 var many []transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob
 for i := range legacyfold.MaxObjectsPerFile + 1 {
  many = append(many, tj("heat-file-"+string(rune('a'+i)), transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSkipped, new(time.Now())))
 }
 out = legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: mf("heat-file"), TranscodeJobs: many, Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now})
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHoldTooMany, out.Status.Held)
 assert.Empty(t, out.Status.Adopted, "reported, never truncated")
 assert.True(t, out.Hold.Transcode)
}

 created := metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 9, 29, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
 ag := transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "heat-audiograft", Namespace: "films", UID: "ag-uid", CreationTimestamp: created},

 multi := mf("heat-file")
 multi.Spec.MediaRef.Keys = []string{"heat-2"}
 out = legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: multi, AudioGrafts: []transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft{ag}, Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: always, Now: now})
 assert.Equal(t, legacyfold.OutcomeDismissedMultiItem, out.Objects[0].Outcome)
 assert.Nil(t, out.Graft)
}
```

```go
// Package legacyfold is release N's adoption of SubtitleRequest, TranscodeJob
// and AudioGraft state onto MediaFile status (ADR-0016, loop spec §7). Plan
// is pure: the remediation loop runs it as its first planner (in
// app/remediation/adopt), the Migrator runs it for its census, and
// `manager legacy-fold report` runs it read-only, so all three agree. It is
// the only package that names the three kinds outside api/ and
// app/remediation/adopt (test/guards TestOnlyLegacyFoldNamesTheFoldedKinds).
// Release N+1 deletes it (F9.1).
package legacyfold
```

  `clamp.go`:

```go
package legacyfold

import "unicode/utf8"

// clamp cuts s to at most n bytes on a rune boundary (loop spec §2.11.1
// rule 1). It is for free text only; a name or path is dropped, never cut.
func clamp(s string, n int) string {
 if len(s) <= n {
  return s
 }
 s = s[:n]
 for len(s) > 0 && !utf8.ValidString(s) {
  s = s[:len(s)-1]
 }
 return s
}
```

  `names.go` (the loop's copy of `transcodeprofile/profile.go:98`, loop §7.3.3 rule 5):

```go
package legacyfold

import "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"

// legacyJobName is the name the TranscodeProfile controller gave the job for
// (mediaFile, profileHash) before the fold: <mediaFile>-<hash[:8]>, the file
// name trimmed so the whole fits k8s.MaxNameLength.
func legacyJobName(mediaFileName, profileHash string) string {
 suffix := profileHash
 if len(suffix) > 8 {
  suffix = suffix[:8]
 }
 name := mediaFileName + "-" + suffix
 if len(name) <= k8s.MaxNameLength {
  return name
 }
 trim := max(len(mediaFileName)-(len(name)-k8s.MaxNameLength), 1)
 return mediaFileName[:trim] + "-" + suffix
}
```

```go
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/squash/jobspec"
)

// Mode is --legacy-fold (loop spec §7.3.10).
type Mode string

const (
 ModeApply Mode = "apply"
 ModeHold  Mode = "hold"
)

// ParseMode reads --legacy-fold.
func ParseMode(s string) (Mode, error) {
 switch m := Mode(s); m {
 case ModeApply, ModeHold:
  return m, nil
 }
 return "", fmt.Errorf("legacyfold: --legacy-fold must be apply or hold, not %q", s)
}

// MaxObjectsPerFile: a file with more legacy objects (adopted and pending)
// than this is held TooMany and reported, never truncated (§7.3.1).
const MaxObjectsPerFile = 15

// PreparationRetry is how soon a file held for Preparation is planned again.
const PreparationRetry = 10 * time.Second

// The outcome label of clustarr_legacy_fold_adoptions_total (§7.3.11).
const (
 OutcomeCopied                 = "copied"
 OutcomeDismissedEmpty         = "dismissed_empty"
 OutcomeCopiedSwap             = "copied_swap"
 OutcomeCopiedVerdict          = "copied_verdict"
 OutcomeDismissedOpen          = "dismissed_open"
 OutcomeDismissedIncorporated  = "dismissed_incorporated"
 OutcomeDismissedSourceChanged = "dismissed_source_changed"
 OutcomeDismissedSuperseded    = "dismissed_superseded"
 OutcomeDismissedBlockExists   = "dismissed_block_exists"
 OutcomeDismissedMultiItem     = "dismissed_multi_item"
 OutcomeCopiedGraft            = "copied_graft"
)

// The state label of clustarr_legacy_fold_objects (§7.3.7).
const (
 StateUnadopted       = "unadopted"
 StateHeldMode        = "held_mode"
 StateHeldPreparation = "held_preparation"
 StateHeldNoTarget    = "held_no_target"
 StateAdopted         = "adopted"
 StateDeleting        = "deleting"
)

// Input is one file and every legacy object that targets it.
type Input struct {
 File             *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 SubtitleRequests []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest
 TranscodeJobs    []transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob
 // AudioGrafts are the grafts whose target is File: status.mediaFileRef,
 // else their item's status.fileRef (the caller resolves it).
 AudioGrafts []transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft
 Profiles    []transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile
 Mode        Mode
 // Prepared reports whether the Migrator has prepared an object (§7.3.5).
 Prepared func(types.UID) bool
 Now      metav1.Time
 // Hash is the profile hash rule 5 matches job names against; nil is
 // jobspec.ProfileHash, the hash the loop computes now.
 Hash func(transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileSpec) string
}

// Hold is which planners keep their last block and publish nothing this
// pass, and whether the rename actuator treats the file as transcoding.
type Hold struct {
 Subtitles, Transcode, Graft, Rename bool
}

// Object is one legacy object's fate this pass.
type Object struct {
 Kind    catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKind
 Name    string
 UID     types.UID
 Outcome string // set when this pass adopts it
 State   string
}

// Output is everything Plan decides for one file.
type Output struct {
 // Subtitles, Transcode and Graft are the seeds: each planner's previous
 // block for this pass, nil when there is nothing to seed.
 Subtitles *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus
 Transcode *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState
 Graft     *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState
 Hold      Hold
 // Status is the next status.legacyFold; nil for a file that never had a
 // legacy object, so release N writes nothing new on it.
 Status  *catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldStatus
 Objects []Object
 // Requeue is non-zero while the file waits for preparation.
 Requeue time.Duration
}

type pending struct {
 kind catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKind
 name string
 uid  types.UID
 sr   *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest
 tj   *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob
 ag   *transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft
}

// Plan applies loop spec §7.3.3-§7.3.6 to one file. It is pure: no I/O, no
// clock but in.Now, and its output does not depend on input order.
func Plan(in Input) Output {
 var out Output
 stored := in.File.Status.LegacyFold
 adopted := map[types.UID]bool{}
 if stored != nil {
  for _, a := range stored.Adopted {
   adopted[a.UID] = true
  }
 }
 var todo []pending
 add := func(p pending, deleting bool) {
  switch {
  case adopted[p.uid]:
   out.Objects = append(out.Objects, Object{Kind: p.kind, Name: p.name, UID: p.uid, State: StateAdopted})
  case deleting:
   out.Objects = append(out.Objects, Object{Kind: p.kind, Name: p.name, UID: p.uid, State: StateDeleting})
  default:
   todo = append(todo, p)
  }
 }
 for i := range in.SubtitleRequests {
  o := &in.SubtitleRequests[i]
  add(pending{kind: catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindSubtitleRequest, name: o.Name, uid: o.UID, sr: o}, o.DeletionTimestamp != nil)
 }
 for i := range in.TranscodeJobs {
  o := &in.TranscodeJobs[i]
  add(pending{kind: catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob, name: o.Name, uid: o.UID, tj: o}, o.DeletionTimestamp != nil)
 }
 for i := range in.AudioGrafts {
  o := &in.AudioGrafts[i]
  add(pending{kind: catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindAudioGraft, name: o.Name, uid: o.UID, ag: o}, o.DeletionTimestamp != nil)
 }
 slices.SortFunc(todo, func(a, b pending) int { return cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(a.kind, b.kind), cmp.Compare(a.name, b.name)) })
 openJob := false
 for _, p := range todo {
  openJob = openJob || (p.tj != nil && OpenTranscodeJob(p.tj))
 }
 if len(todo) == 0 {
  out.Status = carry(stored, "", "")
  return out
 }
 next := carry(stored, "", "")
 if next == nil {
  next = &catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldStatus{}
 }
 hold := func(h catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHold, state, msg string) Output {
  for _, p := range todo {
   out.Objects = append(out.Objects, Object{Kind: p.kind, Name: p.name, UID: p.uid, State: state})
   switch p.kind {
   case catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindSubtitleRequest:
    out.Hold.Subtitles = true
   case catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob:
    out.Hold.Transcode = true
   case catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindAudioGraft:
    out.Hold.Graft = true
   }
  }
  // §7.3.6: while it is not adopted, an open job is a transcode in
  // flight to the rename actuator. One adopted this pass has been
  // withdrawn already (it needed preparation), so it holds nothing.
  out.Hold.Rename = openJob
  next.Held, next.Message = h, clamp(msg, 256)
  out.Status = next
  return out
 }
 switch {
 case len(next.Adopted)+len(todo) > MaxObjectsPerFile:
  return hold(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHoldTooMany, StateUnadopted,
   fmt.Sprintf("%d legacy objects target this file; adoption records at most %d", len(next.Adopted)+len(todo), MaxObjectsPerFile))
 case in.Mode == ModeHold:
  return hold(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHoldMode, StateHeldMode, "--legacy-fold=hold")
 }
 for _, p := range todo {
  if obj := p.object(); NeedsPreparation(obj) && (in.Prepared == nil || !in.Prepared(p.uid)) {
   out.Requeue = PreparationRetry
   return hold(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHoldPreparation, StateHeldPreparation,
    fmt.Sprintf("waiting for the Migrator to prepare %s %s", p.kind, p.name))
  }
 }

 outcomes := map[types.UID]string{}
 out.Subtitles = planSubtitles(in, todo, outcomes)
 out.Transcode = planTranscode(in, todo, outcomes)
 out.Graft = planGraft(in, todo, outcomes)
 for _, p := range todo {
  o := outcomes[p.uid]
  out.Objects = append(out.Objects, Object{Kind: p.kind, Name: p.name, UID: p.uid, Outcome: o, State: StateUnadopted})
  lo := catalogv1alpha1.LegacyOutcomeDismissed
  if o == OutcomeCopied || o == OutcomeCopiedSwap || o == OutcomeCopiedVerdict || o == OutcomeCopiedGraft {
   lo = catalogv1alpha1.LegacyOutcomeCopied
  }
  next.Adopted = append(next.Adopted, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyAdoption{Kind: p.kind, Name: p.name, UID: p.uid, Outcome: lo, At: in.Now})
 }
 next.Held, next.Message = "", ""
 out.Status = next
 return out
}

func (p pending) object() client.Object {
 switch {
 case p.sr != nil:
  return p.sr
 case p.tj != nil:
  return p.tj
 default:
  return p.ag
 }
}

// carry copies the stored record forward unchanged, so `at` is stamped once
// and a re-render is byte-identical (§7.3.1).
func carry(stored *catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldStatus, held catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldHold, msg string) *catalogv1alpha1.LegacyFoldStatus {
 if stored == nil {
  return nil
 }
 c := stored.DeepCopy()
 c.Held, c.Message = held, msg
 return c
}

func (in Input) hash(spec transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileSpec) string {
 if in.Hash != nil {
  return in.Hash(spec)
 }
 return jobspec.ProfileHash(spec)
}
```

  (`plan.go` also imports `sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client` for `client.Object`.)

  `subtitles.go` (§7.3.3, the SubtitleRequest table; the newest request wins when a file has
  two, the others are `dismissed_superseded`):

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "cmp"
 "path/filepath"
 "slices"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
)

func planSubtitles(in Input, todo []pending, outcomes map[types.UID]string) *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus {
 var srs []*subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest
 for _, p := range todo {
  if p.sr != nil {
   srs = append(srs, p.sr)
  }
 }
 slices.SortFunc(srs, func(a, b *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest) int {
  return cmp.Or(b.CreationTimestamp.Compare(a.CreationTimestamp.Time), cmp.Compare(a.Name, b.Name))
 })
 var seed *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus
 for i, sr := range srs {
  switch {
  case i > 0:
   outcomes[sr.UID] = OutcomeDismissedSuperseded
  case in.File.Status.Subtitles != nil:
   outcomes[sr.UID] = OutcomeDismissedBlockExists
  case len(sr.Status.Items) == 0:
   outcomes[sr.UID] = OutcomeDismissedEmpty
  default:
   outcomes[sr.UID] = OutcomeCopied
   seed = subtitleSeed(sr)
  }
 }
 return seed
}

func subtitleSeed(sr *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest) *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus {
 s := &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{Profile: sr.Spec.ProfileRef, ProbeHash: sr.Status.ProbeHash, Phase: subtitlesPhase(sr.Status.Phase)}
 for _, it := range sr.Status.Items {
  item := catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus{
   LangKey: it.LangKey, State: subtitleState(it.State), Score: it.Score, ScoreOutOf: it.ScoreOutOf,
   Provider: it.Provider, SubtitleID: it.SubtitleID, DownloadedAt: it.DownloadedAt,
   LastError: clamp(it.LastError, 512), Attempts: it.Attempts, NextSearchAt: it.NextSearchAt,
  }
  if it.Path != "" {
   if name := filepath.Base(it.Path); len(name) <= 255 {
    item.Name = name
   } else {
    item.State = catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending // a name that cannot be recorded reads pending
   }
  }
  s.Items = append(s.Items, item)
 }
 slices.SortFunc(s.Items, func(a, b catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus) int { return cmp.Compare(a.LangKey, b.LangKey) })
 if len(s.Items) > 20 {
  s.Items = s.Items[:20]
 }
 return s
}

func subtitleState(st subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemState) catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleState {
 switch st {
 case "", subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemSearching, subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemPending:
  return catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStatePending
 }
 return catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleState(st) // downloaded, upgradable, unavailable, failed: same values
}

// subtitlesPhase seeds a previous phase; the subtitles planner recomputes it.
func subtitlesPhase(p subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestPhase) catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhase {
 switch p {
 case subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestPhaseSatisfied:
  return catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseSatisfied
 case subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestPhaseBlocked:
  return catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseBlocked
 }
 return catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted
}
```

  (`subtitles.go` imports `k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types` too.)

  `transcode.go` (§7.3.3 rules 1-6 in order per job; then the newest swap, then the verdict,
  under §7.3.4's precedence; a verdict on a file whose swap is carried is superseded, because
  the swap replaces the bytes it was for):

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "cmp"
 "slices"
 "strings"

 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/meta"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
)

// OpenTranscodeJob is rule 1: no phase, Pending, Planned, Queued, Running,
// or the legacy Verifying readers treat as Running.
func OpenTranscodeJob(tj *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) bool {
 switch tj.Status.Phase {
 case "", transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhasePending, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhasePlanned,
  transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseQueued, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseRunning,
  transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseVerifying:
  return true
 }
 return false
}

func failedReason(tj *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) string {
 if c := meta.FindStatusCondition(tj.Status.Conditions, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobConditionFailed); c != nil {
  return c.Reason
 }
 return ""
}

func verdictReason(tj *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) string {
 if tj.Status.Phase == transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseFailed {
  return failedReason(tj)
 }
 if tj.Status.Plan != nil && tj.Status.Plan.SkipReason != "" {
  return tj.Status.Plan.SkipReason
 }
 if c := meta.FindStatusCondition(tj.Status.Conditions, transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobConditionPlanned); c != nil {
  return c.Reason
 }
 return ""
}

// blockExists reads a live phase-less block as Succeeded when it carries a
// profileTag, else as absent (loop spec §2.5, "Legacy objects").
func blockExists(t *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState) bool {
 return t != nil && (t.Phase != "" || t.ProfileTag != "")
}

func planTranscode(in Input, todo []pending, outcomes map[types.UID]string) *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState {
 probedAt := in.File.Status.ProbedAt
 hashes := map[string]string{}
 for _, p := range in.Profiles {
  hashes[p.Name] = in.hash(p.Spec)
 }
 var swaps []*transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob
 var verdict *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob
 for _, p := range todo {
  tj := p.tj
  if tj == nil {
   continue
  }
  succeeded := tj.Status.Phase == transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSucceeded
  failed := tj.Status.Phase == transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseFailed
  skipped := tj.Status.Phase == transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSkipped
  h, ok := hashes[tj.Spec.ProfileRef]
  switch {
  case OpenTranscodeJob(tj):
   outcomes[tj.UID] = OutcomeDismissedOpen
  case succeeded && tj.Status.FinishedAt != nil && (probedAt == nil || tj.Status.FinishedAt.After(probedAt.Time)):
   swaps = append(swaps, tj) // strictly after: equal is incorporated (catalogarr's test)
  case succeeded:
   outcomes[tj.UID] = OutcomeDismissedIncorporated
  case failed && failedReason(tj) == "SourceChanged":
   outcomes[tj.UID] = OutcomeDismissedSourceChanged
  case (skipped || failed) && ok && tj.Name == legacyJobName(in.File.Name, h):
   verdict = tj
  default:
   outcomes[tj.UID] = OutcomeDismissedSuperseded
  }
 }
 slices.SortFunc(swaps, func(a, b *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) int {
  return cmp.Or(b.Status.FinishedAt.Compare(a.Status.FinishedAt.Time), cmp.Compare(a.Name, b.Name))
 })
 var seed *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState
 for i, tj := range swaps {
  if i > 0 {
   outcomes[tj.UID] = OutcomeDismissedSuperseded
   continue
  }
  seed = swapSeed(in.File.Status.Transcode, tj)
  if seed == nil {
   outcomes[tj.UID] = OutcomeDismissedBlockExists
   continue
  }
  outcomes[tj.UID] = OutcomeCopiedSwap
 }
 if verdict != nil {
  switch {
  case seed != nil:
   outcomes[verdict.UID] = OutcomeDismissedSuperseded
  case blockExists(in.File.Status.Transcode):
   outcomes[verdict.UID] = OutcomeDismissedBlockExists
  default:
   outcomes[verdict.UID] = OutcomeCopiedVerdict
   seed = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{
    Phase: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase(verdict.Status.Phase), Reason: clamp(verdictReason(verdict), 64),
    Blocked:        meta.IsStatusConditionTrue(verdict.Status.Conditions, transcodev1alpha1.ConditionBlocked),
    Attempts:       verdict.Status.Attempts, FallbackReason: clamp(verdict.Status.FallbackReason, 256),
    NextAttemptAt:  verdict.Status.NextAttemptAt, ProfileHash: hashes[verdict.Spec.ProfileRef],
    ProbeHash:      verdict.Spec.SourceProbeHash,
   }
  }
 }
 return seed
}

// swapSeed is rule 2's pending swap: the tag the worker wrote into the
// output, split into profile and hash. It is carried into an existing block
// only when that block holds no swap of its own and its last incorporated
// result finished earlier (§7.3.4); nil otherwise, or when the output
// carries no tag to attribute it by.
func swapSeed(cur *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState, tj *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState {
 if tj.Status.Result == nil || tj.Status.Result.MediaInfo == nil {
  return nil
 }
 tag := tj.Status.Result.MediaInfo.TranscodeProfile
 at := strings.LastIndex(tag, "@")
 if at <= 0 || at == len(tag)-1 {
  return nil
 }
 seed := &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{}
 if blockExists(cur) {
  if cur.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping || (cur.FinishedAt != nil && !cur.FinishedAt.Before(tj.Status.FinishedAt)) {
   return nil
  }
  seed = cur.DeepCopy()
 }
 seed.Phase = catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping
 seed.Result = &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeOutput{OutputPath: tj.Status.Result.OutputPath, OutputSizeBytes: tj.Status.Result.OutputSizeBytes}
 seed.FinishedAt = tj.Status.FinishedAt.DeepCopy()
 seed.Profile, seed.ProfileHash, seed.ProfileTag = tag[:at], tag[at+1:], tag
 return seed
}
```
