  `graft.go` (§7.3.3, AudioGraft):

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "cmp"
 "slices"

 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
)

func planGraft(in Input, todo []pending, outcomes map[types.UID]string) *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState {
 var ags []*transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft
 for _, p := range todo {
  if p.ag != nil {
   ags = append(ags, p.ag)
  }
 }
 slices.SortFunc(ags, func(a, b *transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft) int {
  return cmp.Or(b.CreationTimestamp.Compare(a.CreationTimestamp.Time), cmp.Compare(a.Name, b.Name))
 })
 var seed *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState
 for i, ag := range ags {
  switch {
  case len(in.File.Spec.MediaRef.Keys) > 0:
   outcomes[ag.UID] = OutcomeDismissedMultiItem
  case i > 0:
   outcomes[ag.UID] = OutcomeDismissedSuperseded
  case in.File.Status.Graft != nil:
   outcomes[ag.UID] = OutcomeDismissedBlockExists
  default:
   outcomes[ag.UID] = OutcomeCopiedGraft
   seed = graftSeed(ag)
  }
 }
 return seed
}

func graftSeed(ag *transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft) *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState {
 st := ag.Status
 s := &catalogv1alpha1.GraftState{
  Phase: graftPhase(st.Phase), Reason: clamp(st.Reason, 64), Message: clamp(st.Message, 1024),
  ProbeHash: st.TargetProbeHash, RateName: st.RateName, RateMicros: st.RateMicros,
  RateMarginMilli: st.RateMarginMilli, CoveragePercent: st.CoveragePercent, ResidualMillis: st.ResidualMillis,
  Within80Percent: st.Within80Percent, Tag: st.GraftTag, StartedAt: st.StartedAt, CompletedAt: st.CompletedAt,
  DonorRelease: ag.Spec.Release, DonorImportedAt: ag.CreationTimestamp.DeepCopy(),
 }
 for i, l := range ag.Spec.Languages {
  if i == 4 {
   break
  }
  s.Languages = append(s.Languages, l)
 }
 for i, seg := range st.Segments {
  if i == 16 {
   break
  }
  s.Segments = append(s.Segments, catalogv1alpha1.GraftSegment{DonorStartMillis: seg.DonorStartMillis, TargetStartMillis: seg.TargetStartMillis, LengthMillis: seg.LengthMillis})
 }
 return s
}

// graftPhase: a graft Job's pod result is never read across the fold (the
// runbook requires that no graft Job exists), so Pending and Running wait.
func graftPhase(p transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftPhase) catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhase {
 switch p {
 case transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftSucceeded:
  return catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded
 case transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftFailed:
  return catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseFailed
 }
 return catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseWaiting
}

// ItemDonor is the AudioGraft's item-scoped half (§7.3.3, "To the item"):
// the donor, status.donorAudioPath else spec.donorPath, and the releases a
// graft rejected (the newest 16).
func ItemDonor(ag *transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft) (*catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor, []string) {
 if ag == nil {
  return nil, nil
 }
 path := ag.Status.DonorAudioPath
 if path == "" {
  path = ag.Spec.DonorPath
 }
 var donor *catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor
 if path != "" {
  donor = &catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor{Path: path, Release: ag.Spec.Release, ImportedAt: ag.CreationTimestamp}
 }
 rejected := ag.Status.RejectedReleases
 if len(rejected) > 16 {
  rejected = rejected[len(rejected)-16:]
 }
 return donor, slices.Clone(rejected)
}
```

  `prepare.go` (§7.3.5's preparation set and intent table; priority is never carried):

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "fmt"

 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
)

// NeedsPreparation reports whether the Migrator must act on obj before the
// loop may adopt it: withdraw an open job's task, or carry an intent
// annotation. Adoption excludes adopted UIDs, so this runs once per object.
func NeedsPreparation(obj client.Object) bool {
 switch o := obj.(type) {
 case *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob:
  return OpenTranscodeJob(o) || (o.Spec.Hardware != nil && *o.Spec.Hardware != "")
 case *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest:
  return o.Spec.ForceSearch
 }
 return false
}

// Intent is the annotations obj's user intent becomes on its MediaFile, and
// the intent fields that are dropped (loop spec §7.3.5, §9 D16).
func Intent(obj client.Object) (set map[string]string, dropped []string) {
 set = map[string]string{}
 switch o := obj.(type) {
 case *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob:
  if OpenTranscodeJob(o) && o.Spec.Suspend != nil && *o.Spec.Suspend {
   set[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend] = "true"
  }
  if o.Spec.Hardware != nil && *o.Spec.Hardware != "" {
   set[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeHardware] = string(*o.Spec.Hardware)
  }
  if o.Spec.OutputPath != nil {
   dropped = append(dropped, "outputPath")
  }
 case *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest:
  if o.Spec.ForceSearch {
   set[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationSubtitleSearch] = fmt.Sprintf("fold-%d", o.Generation)
  }
  if len(o.Spec.Languages) > 0 {
   dropped = append(dropped, "languages")
  }
  if o.Spec.MinScoreOverride != nil {
   dropped = append(dropped, "minScoreOverride")
  }
 }
 return set, dropped
}
```

```go
 items := []metav1.PartialObjectMetadata{
  {ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "a", Namespace: "n", UID: "a"}},
  {ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "b", Namespace: "n", UID: "b"}},
 }

 assert.Equal(t, "b", (<-p.Wake()).Object.GetName())
```

```go
package legacyfold_test

// startEnv starts an apiserver with every CRD; it skips without
// KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS (make test sets it).
func startEnv(t *testing.T) (*rest.Config, client.WithWatch) {
 t.Helper()
 if os.Getenv("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS") == "" {
  t.Skip("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS is unset; run via `make test`")
 }
 env := &envtest.Environment{CRDDirectoryPaths: []string{"../../../config/crd/bases"}, ErrorIfCRDPathMissing: true}
 cfg, err := env.Start()
 require.NoError(t, err)
 t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, env.Stop()) })
 c, err := client.NewWithWatch(cfg, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 return cfg, c
}
```

```go
package legacyfold_test

import (
 "context"
 "sync"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/jonboulle/clockwork"
 "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
 "github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/testutil"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 apierrors "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/errors"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client/interceptor"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 catalogac "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/applyconfiguration/catalog/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/legacyfold"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/membus"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/natsbus"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/obs/metrics"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/test/starttest"
)

// trail records the order of the Migrator's side effects across the KV, the
// stream admin and the apiserver.
type trail struct {
 mu  sync.Mutex
 log []string
}

func (r *trail) add(s string) { r.mu.Lock(); r.log = append(r.log, s); r.mu.Unlock() }
func (r *trail) get() []string { r.mu.Lock(); defer r.mu.Unlock(); return append([]string(nil), r.log...) }

type recKV struct {
 events.KV
 t *trail
}

func (k recKV) Put(ctx context.Context, key string, v []byte) (uint64, error) {
 k.t.add("lease:" + key)
 return k.KV.Put(ctx, key, v)
}

type recAdmin struct {
 events.StreamAdmin
 t *trail
}

func (a recAdmin) PurgeSubject(ctx context.Context, stream, subject string) error {
 a.t.add("purge:" + subject)
 return a.StreamAdmin.PurgeSubject(ctx, stream, subject)
}

const ns = "default"

func newMediaFile(t *testing.T, c client.Client, name string) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 t.Helper()
 mf := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: ns},
  Spec: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{Path: "/data/media/movies/" + name + ".mkv",
   MediaRef: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: name}},
 }
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(context.Background(), mf))
 return mf
}

func newTranscodeJob(t *testing.T, c client.Client, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, name string, phase transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhase, finalizer bool) *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob {
 t.Helper()
 tj := &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: ns},
  Spec: transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobSpec{MediaFileRef: mf.Name, ProfileRef: "hevc-mkv", SourcePath: mf.Spec.Path,
   Suspend: new(true)},
 }
 if finalizer {
  tj.Finalizers = []string{legacyfold.FinalizerTaskWithdrawal}
 }
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(context.Background(), tj))
 tj.Status.Phase = phase
 require.NoError(t, c.Status().Update(context.Background(), tj))
 return tj
}

// adopt writes the record the loop would have written for obj, as catalogarr.
func adopt(t *testing.T, c client.Client, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, kind catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKind, obj client.Object, at time.Time) {
 t.Helper()
 ac := catalogac.MediaFile(mf.Name, mf.Namespace).WithStatus(catalogac.MediaFileStatus().WithLegacyFold(
  catalogac.LegacyFoldStatus().WithAdopted(catalogac.LegacyAdoption().WithKind(kind).WithName(obj.GetName()).
   WithUID(obj.GetUID()).WithOutcome(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyOutcomeDismissed).WithAt(metav1.NewTime(at)))))
 _, err := k8s.PatchStatus(context.Background(), c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr, ac)
 require.NoError(t, err)
}

func migrator(t *testing.T, c client.Client, bus events.Bus, tr *trail, mode legacyfold.Mode, retain time.Duration, now time.Time) *legacyfold.Migrator {
 t.Helper()
 admin, ok := any(bus).(events.StreamAdmin)
 require.True(t, ok)
 require.NoError(t, bus.Ensure(context.Background(), events.Default()))
 m := legacyfold.NewMigrator(c, c, recKV{KV: bus.KV(events.BucketTranscodeLeases), t: tr}, recAdmin{StreamAdmin: admin, t: tr},
  legacyfold.Options{Mode: mode, Retain: retain, Namespace: ns, DeletesPerSecond: 1000}, nil)
 m.Now = func() time.Time { return now }
 return m
}

func TestDeletionNeedsTheRecordAndTheRetentionAndWithdrawsBeforeTheFinalizer(t *testing.T) {
 _, raw := startEnv(t)
 tr := &trail{}
 c := interceptor.NewClient(raw, interceptor.Funcs{
  Update: func(ctx context.Context, cl client.WithWatch, obj client.Object, opts ...client.UpdateOption) error {
   tr.add("update:" + obj.GetName())
   return cl.Update(ctx, obj, opts...)
  },
 })
 now := time.Date(2026, 10, 7, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 mf := newMediaFile(t, c, "heat-file")
 tj := newTranscodeJob(t, c, mf, "heat-file-c5a05678", transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSkipped, true)
 unrecorded := newTranscodeJob(t, c, mf, "heat-file-f0a6f12c", transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseSkipped, false)
 adopt(t, c, mf, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob, tj, now.Add(-time.Hour))
 bus := membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock())

 _, err := migrator(t, c, bus, tr, legacyfold.ModeApply, 2*time.Hour, now).Pass(context.Background())
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(tj), &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{}), "retain has not passed")

 before := testutil.ToFloat64(metrics.LegacyFoldDeletions.WithLabelValues("TranscodeJob", "deleted"))
 _, err = migrator(t, c, bus, tr, legacyfold.ModeApply, 30*time.Minute, now).Pass(context.Background())
 require.NoError(t, err)
 err = c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(tj), &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{})
 assert.True(t, apierrors.IsNotFound(err), "adopted and past retain: deleted, got %v", err)
 assert.NoError(t, c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(unrecorded), &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{}),
  "no adoption record: never deleted, whatever its age")
 assert.Equal(t, before+1, testutil.ToFloat64(metrics.LegacyFoldDeletions.WithLabelValues("TranscodeJob", "deleted")))
 assert.Equal(t, []string{
  "lease:" + events.TranscodeLeaseKey(string(tj.UID)),
  "purge:" + events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubjectAnyPool(string(tj.UID)),
  "update:" + tj.Name,
 }, tr.get(), "the cancel marker and the purge land before the finalizer Update")
}

func TestARecreatedObjectSurvivesTheUIDPrecondition(t *testing.T) {
 _, raw := startEnv(t)
 now := time.Date(2026, 10, 7, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 mf := newMediaFile(t, raw, "alien-file")
 sr := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "alien-file", Namespace: ns},
  Spec: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: mf.Name}}
 require.NoError(t, raw.Create(context.Background(), sr))
 adopt(t, raw, mf, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindSubtitleRequest, sr, now.Add(-100*time.Hour))
 var recreated types.UID
 c := interceptor.NewClient(raw, interceptor.Funcs{
  Delete: func(ctx context.Context, cl client.WithWatch, obj client.Object, opts ...client.DeleteOption) error {
   // Between the census read and the delete, someone recreates it.
   require.NoError(t, cl.Delete(ctx, obj))
   fresh := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: obj.GetName(), Namespace: ns},
    Spec: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: mf.Name}}
   require.NoError(t, cl.Create(ctx, fresh))
   recreated = fresh.UID
   return cl.Delete(ctx, obj, opts...)
  },
 })
 _, err := migrator(t, c, membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock()), &trail{}, legacyfold.ModeApply, 72*time.Hour, now).Pass(context.Background())
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var live subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest
 require.NoError(t, raw.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(sr), &live))
 assert.Equal(t, recreated, live.UID, "the object recreated under the same name survives the UID precondition")
}

func TestHoldWithdrawsAnnotatesAndDeletesNothing(t *testing.T) {
 _, c := startEnv(t)
 now := time.Date(2026, 10, 7, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 mf := newMediaFile(t, c, "brazil-file")
 open := newTranscodeJob(t, c, mf, "brazil-file-c5a05678", transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhasePlanned, true)
 sr := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "brazil-file", Namespace: ns},
  Spec: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: mf.Name, ForceSearch: true}}
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(context.Background(), sr))
 adopt(t, c, mf, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindSubtitleRequest, sr, now.Add(-100*time.Hour))
 tr := &trail{}
 m := migrator(t, c, membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock()), tr, legacyfold.ModeHold, 0, now)
 _, err := m.Pass(context.Background())

 assert.Empty(t, tr.get(), "hold writes no lease and purges nothing")

 assert.NoError(t, c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(sr), &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{}), "hold deletes nothing")
 assert.Equal(t, 1.0, testutil.ToFloat64(metrics.LegacyFoldObjects.WithLabelValues("TranscodeJob", legacyfold.StateHeldMode)))
}

func TestApplyPreparesOnceWithoutOverwritingTheUser(t *testing.T) {
 _, c := startEnv(t)
 now := time.Date(2026, 10, 7, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
 mf := newMediaFile(t, c, "dune-file")
 // The user already chose a hardware for the file: the carried intent
 // must not overwrite it (only keys absent on the read are written).
 var live catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &live))
 live.Annotations = map[string]string{catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeHardware: "cpu"}
 require.NoError(t, c.Update(context.Background(), &live))
 open := &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{
  ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "dune-file-c5a05678", Namespace: ns, Finalizers: []string{legacyfold.FinalizerTaskWithdrawal}},
  Spec: transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobSpec{MediaFileRef: mf.Name, ProfileRef: "hevc-mkv", SourcePath: mf.Spec.Path,
   Suspend: new(true), Hardware: ptr.To(transcodev1alpha1.HardwareIntel)},
 }
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(context.Background(), open))
 open.Status.Phase = transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobPhaseQueued
 require.NoError(t, c.Status().Update(context.Background(), open))

 tr := &trail{}
 m := migrator(t, c, membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock()), tr, legacyfold.ModeApply, 72*time.Hour, now)
 _, err := m.Pass(context.Background())
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, m.Prepared(open.UID))
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &live))
 assert.Equal(t, "true", live.Annotations[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend], "spec.suspend on an open job becomes the annotation")
 assert.Equal(t, "cpu", live.Annotations[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeHardware], "the user's own value wins")
 owners := map[string]bool{}
 for _, e := range live.ManagedFields {
  owners[e.Manager] = true
 }
 assert.True(t, owners["clustarr-legacy-fold"], "the carried annotation is owned by clustarr-legacy-fold")
 assert.Equal(t, []string{"lease:" + events.TranscodeLeaseKey(string(open.UID)), "purge:" + events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubjectAnyPool(string(open.UID))},
  tr.get(), "an open job is withdrawn, once")
 _, err = m.Pass(context.Background())
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Len(t, tr.get(), 2, "a prepared object is not prepared again in this process")
}

// TestARetiredDurableIsReportedUndrainedAndHoldsCompletion runs on both buses:
// a retired durable the start-up Ensure found with a lag is counted
// undrained, and the Migrator completes only once it is gone.
func TestARetiredDurableIsReportedUndrainedAndHoldsCompletion(t *testing.T) {
 _, c := startEnv(t)
 nc, err := nats.Connect(starttest.EmbeddedNATS(t))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 t.Cleanup(nc.Close)
 nb, err := natsbus.New(nc)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 for name, bus := range map[string]events.Bus{"membus": membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock()), "natsbus": nb} {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   ctx := context.Background()
   m := migrator(t, c, bus, &trail{}, legacyfold.ModeApply, 0, time.Now())
   stream, _ := events.Default().Stream(events.StreamWorkSquasharr)
   require.NoError(t, bus.Ensure(ctx, events.Topology{Streams: []events.StreamSpec{stream}, Consumers: []events.ConsumerSpec{{
    Name: events.ConsumerSquasharrResults, Stream: events.StreamWorkSquasharr, Filters: []string{events.FilterTranscodeResults},
    AckWait: 30 * time.Second, MaxDeliver: 3, MaxAckPending: 1,
   }}}))
   m.Retired = []legacyfold.RetiredLag{{Stream: events.StreamWorkSquasharr, Durable: events.ConsumerSquasharrResults, Lag: 3, Existed: true}}
   before := testutil.ToFloat64(metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("retire_results", "undrained"))
   done, err := m.Pass(ctx)
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.False(t, done, "a retired durable still exists")
   assert.Equal(t, before+1, testutil.ToFloat64(metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("retire_results", "undrained")))
   require.NoError(t, any(bus).(events.StreamAdmin).DeleteSubscription(ctx, events.StreamWorkSquasharr, events.ConsumerSquasharrResults))
   done, err = m.Pass(ctx)
   require.NoError(t, err)
   assert.True(t, done, "no legacy object and no retired durable: complete")
   assert.Equal(t, before+1, testutil.ToFloat64(metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("retire_results", "undrained")), "reported once")
  })
 }
}
```

```go
package legacyfold

import "time"

const (
 DefaultRetain           = 72 * time.Hour
 DefaultInterval         = 60 * time.Second
 DefaultDeletesPerSecond = 20
)

// Options is --legacy-fold and --legacy-fold-retain, plus the census tuning.
type Options struct {
 Mode   Mode
 Retain time.Duration
 // Namespace limits the census and deletion; "" is every namespace the
 // manager's cache serves.
 Namespace        string
 Interval         time.Duration
 DeletesPerSecond float64
}

// RetiredLag is one retired results durable as the manager's start-up Ensure
// found it (F1.2): whether it existed and its lag (pending plus ack-pending)

 Stream, Durable string
 Lag             uint64
 Existed         bool
}
```

  deleted it, onto the previous release's lease shape):

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "math"
 "time"

 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events/schema"
)

// FinalizerTaskWithdrawal is the previous release's TranscodeJob finalizer
// (transcodejob.FinalizerTaskWithdrawal before F6.6). Only the Migrator
// removes it in release N.
const FinalizerTaskWithdrawal = "squasharr.clustarr.io/task-withdrawal"

const leaseCancelled = "cancelled"

// leaseV1 is the previous release's task.Lease, schema transcode.Lease.v1
// (app/squash/task/task.go:163-173 before F6.4 made the lease v2). A
// previous-release worker honours a cancel marker only in this shape, and
// only when cur.Attempt >= its task's attempt (worker/lease.go:79), so the
// marker names every attempt. F9.1 deletes it.
type leaseV1 struct {
 Job     schema.Ref `json:"job"`
 Attempt int32      `json:"attempt"`
 State   string     `json:"state"`
 Pod     string     `json:"pod,omitempty"`
 Node    string     `json:"node,omitempty"`
 Since   time.Time  `json:"since"`
}

func (leaseV1) Schema() string { return "transcode.Lease.v1" }

// withdraw cancels every attempt of tj's task and purges the task under every
// profile and class (withdrawAll's rule), marker first, so a worker that
// fetched the task just before the purge still finds it cancelled.
func (m *Migrator) withdraw(ctx context.Context, tj *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) error {
 uid := string(tj.UID)
 b, err := json.Marshal(leaseV1{Job: schema.Ref{Namespace: tj.Namespace, Name: tj.Name, UID: uid},
  Attempt: math.MaxInt32, State: leaseCancelled, Since: m.now().UTC()})
 if err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("legacyfold: encode cancel marker: %w", err)
 }
 if m.Leases == nil || m.Admin == nil {
  return errors.New("legacyfold: no lease bucket or stream admin to withdraw with")
 }
 if _, err := m.Leases.Put(ctx, events.TranscodeLeaseKey(uid), b); err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("legacyfold: cancel lease of %s/%s: %w", tj.Namespace, tj.Name, err)
 }
 if err := m.Admin.PurgeSubject(ctx, events.StreamWorkSquasharr, events.WorkTranscodeTaskSubjectAnyPool(uid)); err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("legacyfold: purge the task of %s/%s: %w", tj.Namespace, tj.Name, err)
 }
 return nil
}
```

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"

 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// annotate writes the intent keys absent on a fresh read, as one JSON merge
// patch of metadata.annotations carrying that read's resourceVersion, under
// clustarr-legacy-fold. A key the user already set wins; a Conflict is
// retried at the next census.
func (m *Migrator) annotate(ctx context.Context, key types.NamespacedName, set map[string]string) error {
 var fresh catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 if err := m.APIReader.Get(ctx, key, &fresh); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 missing := map[string]string{}
 for k, v := range set {
  if _, ok := fresh.Annotations[k]; !ok {
   missing[k] = v
  }
 }
 if len(missing) == 0 {
  return nil
 }
 body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"metadata": map[string]any{"resourceVersion": fresh.ResourceVersion, "annotations": missing}})
 if err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := m.Client.Patch(ctx, &fresh, client.RawPatch(types.MergePatchType, body), client.FieldOwner(k8s.ManagerLegacyFold.String())); err != nil {
  return fmt.Errorf("legacyfold: annotate MediaFile %s: %w", key, err)
 }
 return nil
}
```

  3g. `app/catalog/legacyfold/markerspending.go`:

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "context"
 "sync"

 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/event"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// MarkersPending is the set of MediaFiles whose status still carries a
// catalogarr-markers managedFields entry (loop spec §7.3.8 step 1). The
// Migrator fills it once at start; the loop claims and releases each file
// and removes it; Wake re-enqueues every file the moment the set is known.
type MarkersPending struct {
 mu    sync.Mutex
 set   map[types.UID]bool
 ready bool
 wake  chan event.TypedGenericEvent[*metav1.PartialObjectMetadata]
}

func NewMarkersPending() *MarkersPending {
 return &MarkersPending{set: map[types.UID]bool{}, wake: make(chan event.TypedGenericEvent[*metav1.PartialObjectMetadata], 1024)}
}

func (p *MarkersPending) Has(uid types.UID) bool { p.mu.Lock(); defer p.mu.Unlock(); return p.set[uid] }
func (p *MarkersPending) Done(uid types.UID)     { p.mu.Lock(); delete(p.set, uid); p.mu.Unlock() }
func (p *MarkersPending) Len() int               { p.mu.Lock(); defer p.mu.Unlock(); return len(p.set) }
func (p *MarkersPending) Ready() bool            { p.mu.Lock(); defer p.mu.Unlock(); return p.ready }

// Wake is the channel the loop's markers source reads (app/remediation/adopt).
func (p *MarkersPending) Wake() <-chan event.TypedGenericEvent[*metav1.PartialObjectMetadata] {
 return p.wake
}

// Fill records items and wakes each of them, blocking until the loop has
// taken every wake or ctx ends.
func (p *MarkersPending) Fill(ctx context.Context, items []metav1.PartialObjectMetadata) {
 p.mu.Lock()
 for _, it := range items {
  p.set[it.UID] = true
 }
 p.ready = true
 p.mu.Unlock()
 for i := range items {
  select {
  case p.wake <- event.TypedGenericEvent[*metav1.PartialObjectMetadata]{Object: &items[i]}:
  case <-ctx.Done():
   return
  }
 }
}

// HasMarkersEntry reports whether fields hold a catalogarr-markers entry on
// the status subresource.
func HasMarkersEntry(fields []metav1.ManagedFieldsEntry) bool {
 for _, f := range fields {
  if f.Manager == k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMarkers.String() && f.Subresource == "status" {
   return true
  }
 }
 return false
}

// LoadMarkersPending pages every MediaFile's metadata, managedFields
// included, through r (the APIReader: the cache strips managedFields), and
// returns those that still carry a catalogarr-markers entry.
func LoadMarkersPending(ctx context.Context, r client.Reader, namespace string) ([]metav1.PartialObjectMetadata, error) {
 var out []metav1.PartialObjectMetadata
 cont := ""
 for {
  list := &metav1.PartialObjectMetadataList{}
  list.SetGroupVersionKind(catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.WithKind("MediaFileList"))
  opts := []client.ListOption{client.Limit(500), client.Continue(cont)}
  if namespace != "" {
   opts = append(opts, client.InNamespace(namespace))
  }
  if err := r.List(ctx, list, opts...); err != nil {
   return nil, err
  }
  for _, it := range list.Items {
   if HasMarkersEntry(it.ManagedFields) {
    out = append(out, it)
   }
  }
  if cont = list.Continue; cont == "" {
   return out, nil
  }
 }
}
```

  3h. `app/catalog/legacyfold/migrator.go` and `census.go`:

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "slices"
 "sync"
 "time"

 apierrors "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/errors"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "golang.org/x/time/rate"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/obs/logging"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/obs/metrics"
)

// Migrator is release N's leader-only runnable (loop spec §7.2): everything
// the legacy fold does that is not a MediaFile status write. Withdrawal,
// intent annotations, the census, deletion after retention, the retired
// results durables and the catalogarr-markers pending set. It never writes
// MediaFile status: adoption is the loop's (app/remediation/adopt).
type Migrator struct {
 Client    client.Client // the manager's client: cached reads, apiserver writes
 APIReader client.Reader // uncached: the metadata list and fresh reads before a write
 Leases    events.KV     // clustarr-transcode-leases
 Admin     events.StreamAdmin
 Opts      Options
 Retired   []RetiredLag
 Markers   *MarkersPending
 Now       func() time.Time

 limiter *rate.Limiter

 mu              sync.Mutex
 prepared        map[types.UID]bool
 reportedRetired bool
 lastTotals      map[string]int
}

func NewMigrator(c client.Client, apiReader client.Reader, leases events.KV, admin events.StreamAdmin, o Options, markers *MarkersPending) *Migrator {
 if o.Interval <= 0 {
  o.Interval = DefaultInterval
 }
 if o.DeletesPerSecond <= 0 {
  o.DeletesPerSecond = DefaultDeletesPerSecond
 }
 return &Migrator{Client: c, APIReader: apiReader, Leases: leases, Admin: admin, Opts: o, Markers: markers,
  limiter: rate.NewLimiter(rate.Limit(o.DeletesPerSecond), 1), prepared: map[types.UID]bool{}}
}

func (m *Migrator) now() time.Time {
 if m.Now != nil {
  return m.Now()
 }
 return time.Now()
}

// Prepared is Plan's Input.Prepared. The set lives in memory: after a
// restart preparation repeats, and both of its steps are idempotent.
func (m *Migrator) Prepared(uid types.UID) bool { m.mu.Lock(); defer m.mu.Unlock(); return m.prepared[uid] }

func (m *Migrator) markPrepared(uid types.UID) { m.mu.Lock(); m.prepared[uid] = true; m.mu.Unlock() }

// Run fills the markers pending set, then runs a census every
// Opts.Interval until every folded object is gone and both retired durables
// are deleted, logs "legacy fold complete" and returns nil: a one-shot.
func (m *Migrator) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
 log := logging.FromContext(ctx).With("component", "legacyfold")
 if m.Markers != nil {
  for {
   pending, err := LoadMarkersPending(ctx, m.APIReader, m.Opts.Namespace)
   if err == nil {
    log.InfoContext(ctx, "legacyfold: MediaFiles still carrying a catalogarr-markers entry", "count", len(pending))
    m.Markers.Fill(ctx, pending)
    break
   }
   log.WarnContext(ctx, "legacyfold: list MediaFiles' field managers; retrying", "error", err)
   select {
   case <-ctx.Done():
    return nil
   case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
   }
  }
 }
 t := time.NewTicker(m.Opts.Interval)
 defer t.Stop()
 for {
  done, err := m.Pass(ctx)
  if err != nil {
   log.WarnContext(ctx, "legacyfold: census pass failed; retrying at the next tick", "error", err)
  }
  if done {
   log.InfoContext(ctx, "legacy fold complete")
   return nil
  }
  select {
  case <-ctx.Done():
   return nil
  case <-t.C:
  }
 }
}

type fileKey = types.NamespacedName

// world is one census's view of the cache.
type world struct {
 files    map[fileKey]*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 srs      map[fileKey][]subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest
 tjs      map[fileKey][]transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob
 ags      map[fileKey][]transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft
 noTarget []transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft
 profiles []transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile
 all      []client.Object
}

func (m *Migrator) read(ctx context.Context) (*world, error) {
 var (
  mfs catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
  srs subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestList
  tjs transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobList
  ags transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftList
  tps transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileList
 )
 in := client.InNamespace(m.Opts.Namespace)
 for _, l := range []client.ObjectList{&mfs, &srs, &tjs, &ags} {
  if err := m.Client.List(ctx, l, in); err != nil {
   return nil, err
  }
 }
 if err := m.Client.List(ctx, &tps); err != nil {
  return nil, err
 }
 w := &world{files: map[fileKey]*catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{}, srs: map[fileKey][]subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{},
  tjs: map[fileKey][]transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{}, ags: map[fileKey][]transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft{}, profiles: tps.Items}
 for i := range mfs.Items {
  w.files[client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&mfs.Items[i])] = &mfs.Items[i]
 }
 for i := range srs.Items {
  sr := srs.Items[i]
  w.srs[fileKey{Namespace: sr.Namespace, Name: sr.Spec.MediaFileRef}] = append(w.srs[fileKey{Namespace: sr.Namespace, Name: sr.Spec.MediaFileRef}], sr)
  w.all = append(w.all, &srs.Items[i])
 }
 for i := range tjs.Items {
  tj := tjs.Items[i]
  w.tjs[fileKey{Namespace: tj.Namespace, Name: tj.Spec.MediaFileRef}] = append(w.tjs[fileKey{Namespace: tj.Namespace, Name: tj.Spec.MediaFileRef}], tj)
  w.all = append(w.all, &tjs.Items[i])
 }
 for i := range ags.Items {
  ag := ags.Items[i]
  target, err := AudioGraftTarget(ctx, m.Client, &ag)
  if err != nil {
   return nil, err
  }
  if target == "" {
   w.noTarget = append(w.noTarget, ag)
  } else {
   k := fileKey{Namespace: ag.Namespace, Name: target}
   w.ags[k] = append(w.ags[k], ag)
  }
  w.all = append(w.all, &ags.Items[i])
 }
 return w, nil
}

// AudioGraftTarget is the file a graft's state goes to: status.mediaFileRef,
// else its Movie's or Episode's status.fileRef; "" when neither names one.
func AudioGraftTarget(ctx context.Context, r client.Reader, ag *transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft) (string, error) {
 if ag.Status.MediaFileRef != "" {
  return ag.Status.MediaFileRef, nil
 }
 key := types.NamespacedName{Namespace: ag.Namespace, Name: ag.Spec.ItemRef.Name}
 var ref *string
 switch ag.Spec.ItemRef.Kind {
 case "movie":
  var mv catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  if err := r.Get(ctx, key, &mv); err != nil {
   return "", client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
  }
  ref = mv.Status.FileRef
 case "episode":
  var ep catalogv1alpha1.Episode
  if err := r.Get(ctx, key, &ep); err != nil {
   return "", client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
  }
  ref = ep.Status.FileRef
 }
 if ref == nil {
  return "", nil
 }
 return *ref, nil
}

// Pass is one census (loop spec §7.3.7): release what the garbage collector
// is deleting, prepare (apply mode), count every object's state, delete
// adopted objects past retention (apply mode), and report whether the fold
// is complete.
func (m *Migrator) Pass(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
 m.reportRetired(ctx)
 w, err := m.read(ctx)
 if err != nil {
  return false, err
 }
 var errs []error
 for _, jobs := range w.tjs {
  for i := range jobs {
   if tj := &jobs[i]; tj.DeletionTimestamp != nil && k8s.HasFinalizer(tj, FinalizerTaskWithdrawal) {
    errs = append(errs, m.release(ctx, tj))
   }
  }
 }
 if m.Opts.Mode == ModeApply {
  errs = append(errs, m.prepare(ctx, w))
 }
 m.census(ctx, w)
 if m.Opts.Mode == ModeApply {
  errs = append(errs, m.deleteRetained(ctx, w))
 }
 gone, err := m.retiredGone(ctx)
 errs = append(errs, err)
 return len(w.all) == 0 && gone, errors.Join(errs...)
}

// release withdraws a job the garbage collector is deleting and drops its
// finalizer, adopted or not: no controller would otherwise remove it in N.
func (m *Migrator) release(ctx context.Context, tj *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob) error {
 if err := m.withdraw(ctx, tj); err != nil {
  metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("withdraw", "error").Inc()
  return err
 }
 metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("withdraw", "ok").Inc()
 _, err := k8s.RemoveFinalizer(ctx, m.Client, tj, FinalizerTaskWithdrawal)
 return client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
}

// prepare runs §7.3.5 for every object NeedsPreparation names that is not
// adopted yet and not prepared in this process.
func (m *Migrator) prepare(ctx context.Context, w *world) error {
 var errs []error
 for k, mf := range w.files {
  adopted := adoptedUIDs(mf)
  var objs []client.Object
  for i := range w.srs[k] {
   objs = append(objs, &w.srs[k][i])
  }
  for i := range w.tjs[k] {
   objs = append(objs, &w.tjs[k][i])
  }
  for _, obj := range objs {
   uid := obj.GetUID()
   if adopted[uid] || m.Prepared(uid) || obj.GetDeletionTimestamp() != nil || !NeedsPreparation(obj) {
    continue
   }
   if tj, ok := obj.(*transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob); ok && OpenTranscodeJob(tj) {
    if err := m.withdraw(ctx, tj); err != nil {
     metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("withdraw", "error").Inc()
     errs = append(errs, err)
     continue
    }
    metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("withdraw", "ok").Inc()
   }
   set, dropped := Intent(obj)
   if len(dropped) > 0 {
    logging.FromContext(ctx).InfoContext(ctx, "legacyfold: intent dropped", "kind", obj.GetObjectKind().GroupVersionKind().Kind,
     "name", obj.GetName(), "fields", dropped)
   }
   if len(set) > 0 {
    if err := m.annotate(ctx, k, set); err != nil {
     metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("annotate", "error").Inc()
     errs = append(errs, err)
     continue
    }
    metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("annotate", "ok").Inc()
   }
   m.markPrepared(uid)
  }
 }
 return errors.Join(errs...)
}

func adoptedUIDs(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) map[types.UID]bool {
 out := map[types.UID]bool{}
 if lf := mf.Status.LegacyFold; lf != nil {
  for _, a := range lf.Adopted {
   out[a.UID] = true
  }
 }
 return out
}
```

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "maps"
 "slices"

 apierrors "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/errors"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/obs/logging"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/obs/metrics"
)

var (
 kinds  = []catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKind{catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindSubtitleRequest, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob, catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindAudioGraft}
 states = []string{StateUnadopted, StateHeldMode, StateHeldPreparation, StateHeldNoTarget, StateAdopted, StateDeleting}
)

// census runs Plan over every file with a legacy object and sets the gauge
// for all 18 (kind, state) series, zeros included, so "reads 0" is a value.
func (m *Migrator) census(ctx context.Context, w *world) {
 counts := map[string]int{}
 seen := map[fileKey]bool{}
 for _, k := range slices.Concat(slices.Collect(maps.Keys(w.srs)), slices.Collect(maps.Keys(w.tjs)), slices.Collect(maps.Keys(w.ags))) {
  if seen[k] {
   continue
  }
  seen[k] = true
  mf, ok := w.files[k]
  if !ok {
   // The file is gone: the garbage collector deletes the object
   // through its owner reference.
   for range w.srs[k] {
    counts[string(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindSubtitleRequest)+"/"+StateDeleting]++
   }
   for range w.tjs[k] {
    counts[string(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob)+"/"+StateDeleting]++
   }
   for range w.ags[k] {
    counts[string(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindAudioGraft)+"/"+StateHeldNoTarget]++
   }
   continue
  }
  out := Plan(Input{File: mf, SubtitleRequests: w.srs[k], TranscodeJobs: w.tjs[k], AudioGrafts: w.ags[k], Profiles: w.profiles,
   Mode: m.Opts.Mode, Prepared: m.Prepared, Now: metav1.NewTime(m.now())})
  for _, o := range out.Objects {
   counts[string(o.Kind)+"/"+o.State]++
  }
 }
 for range w.noTarget {
  counts[string(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindAudioGraft)+"/"+StateHeldNoTarget]++
 }
 for _, k := range kinds {
  for _, s := range states {
   metrics.LegacyFoldObjects.WithLabelValues(string(k), s).Set(float64(counts[string(k)+"/"+s]))
  }
 }
 m.mu.Lock()
 changed := !maps.Equal(counts, m.lastTotals)
 m.lastTotals = counts
 m.mu.Unlock()
 if changed {
  logging.FromContext(ctx).InfoContext(ctx, "legacyfold: census", "totals", fmt.Sprint(counts))
 }
}

// deleteRetained deletes every object adopted at least Opts.Retain ago,
// paced, with a UID precondition; a job behind the withdrawal finalizer is
// withdrawn again and released first.
func (m *Migrator) deleteRetained(ctx context.Context, w *world) error {
 now := m.now()
 var errs []error
 for k, mf := range w.files {
  if mf.Status.LegacyFold == nil {
   continue
  }
  at := map[types.UID]metav1.Time{}
  for _, a := range mf.Status.LegacyFold.Adopted {
   at[a.UID] = a.At
  }
  var objs []client.Object
  for i := range w.srs[k] {
   objs = append(objs, &w.srs[k][i])
  }
  for i := range w.tjs[k] {
   objs = append(objs, &w.tjs[k][i])
  }
  for i := range w.ags[k] {
   objs = append(objs, &w.ags[k][i])
  }
  for _, obj := range objs {
   stamp, ok := at[obj.GetUID()]
   if !ok || stamp.Add(m.Opts.Retain).After(now) || obj.GetDeletionTimestamp() != nil {
    continue
   }
   kind := kindOf(obj)
   if tj, ok := obj.(*transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob); ok && k8s.HasFinalizer(tj, FinalizerTaskWithdrawal) {
    if err := m.release(ctx, tj); err != nil {
     errs = append(errs, err)
     continue
    }
   }
   if err := m.limiter.Wait(ctx); err != nil {
    return err
   }
   uid := obj.GetUID()
   err := m.Client.Delete(ctx, obj, client.Preconditions{UID: &uid}, client.PropagationPolicy(metav1.DeletePropagationBackground))
   switch {
   case err == nil:
    metrics.LegacyFoldDeletions.WithLabelValues(kind, "deleted").Inc()
   case apierrors.IsNotFound(err), apierrors.IsConflict(err):
    // Gone, or recreated under the name with another UID: the
    // adopted object no longer exists.
    metrics.LegacyFoldDeletions.WithLabelValues(kind, "not_found").Inc()
   default:
    metrics.LegacyFoldDeletions.WithLabelValues(kind, "error").Inc()
    errs = append(errs, err)
   }
  }
 }
 return errors.Join(errs...)
}

func kindOf(obj client.Object) string {
 switch obj.(type) {
 case *subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest:
  return string(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindSubtitleRequest)
 case *transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob:
  return string(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindTranscodeJob)
 }
 return string(catalogv1alpha1.LegacyKindAudioGraft)
}

// reportRetired counts each retired durable the start-up Ensure found with
// a lag, once per process (§7.3.9): a result nobody will apply.
func (m *Migrator) reportRetired(ctx context.Context) {
 m.mu.Lock()
 defer m.mu.Unlock()
 if m.reportedRetired {
  return
 }
 m.reportedRetired = true
 for _, r := range m.Retired {
  result := "ok"
  if r.Lag > 0 {
   result = "undrained"
   logging.FromContext(ctx).WarnContext(ctx, "legacyfold: a retired durable had results nobody will apply",
    "stream", r.Stream, "durable", r.Durable, "lag", r.Lag)
  }
  metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("retire_results", result).Inc()
 }
}

// retiredGone reports whether both retired results durables are absent.
func (m *Migrator) retiredGone(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
 if m.Admin == nil {
  return false, errors.New("legacyfold: no stream admin")
 }
 for _, c := range []struct{ stream, durable string }{
  {events.StreamWorkSquasharr, events.ConsumerSquasharrResults},
  {events.StreamWorkSegmentarr, events.ConsumerCatalogSegmentsResult},
 } {
  subs, err := m.Admin.Subscriptions(ctx, c.stream)
  if errors.Is(err, events.ErrStreamNotFound) {
   continue
  }
  if err != nil {
   return false, err
  }
  if slices.Contains(subs, c.durable) {
   return false, nil
  }
 }
 return true, nil
}
```

**The hook in the pass, step by step (loop §3.4, numbering kept).** F3.1's pass gains exactly
these edits; nothing else in it changes:

| §3.4 step | Release-N edit |
| --- | --- |
| 2 (View) → new 2b | When `r.Adopt != nil`, run `r.Adopt.Adopt(ctx, v, out)` under F3.1's isolation as planner `adopt` (10 s deadline) **before any other planner gathers**, so the probe planner sees a seeded swap and no planner reads a record for an unseeded block. On success: `v.Prev = seedPrev(v.Prev, seed)`, the draft likewise, `r.Adopt.Copy(out, draft)`. On failure: `r.Adopt.Copy(v.Prev, draft)` and hold subtitles, transcode, graft and the rename for this pass (a planner that ran unseeded could fire the searches the copy exists to space out). `adopt` has no condition type (§7.3.1); its failures are logged and counted by F3.1's `clustarr_remediation_planner_failures_total{planner="adopt"}`. |
| 3, 4 (Gather, Plan) | A planner with `seed.Hold[p.Name()]` is neither gathered nor planned: `p.Copy(v.Prev, next)`, no effects, no events. |
| 7 (status) | When `r.Adopt.Claim(uid)`, the render never skips as unchanged (§7.3.8 step 2); the apply still takes a status-write token. |
| after 7 | On a landed apply (`applied`): `seed.Landed()`; then, when claimed, take a second token and `r.Adopt.Release(ctx, applied)` with the resourceVersion the apply returned; a Conflict requeues the key in 1 s (the next pass retries the release). |
| 10 (actuators) | The rename actuator does not run while `seed.HoldRename`. |
| 11 (Result) | The adopter's due time (`now + PreparationRetry` while held for Preparation) joins the `RequeueAfter` minimum. |

```bash
      ([$all[] | select(.status.markers.result == "Found")][:16]) +
      ([$all[] | select(.status.markers.result == "NotFound" and .status.markers.notFoundSince != null)][:16]) +
      ([$all[] | select(.status.markers.analysis != null and (.status.markers.segments // [] | length) > 0)][:16]) +
      ([$all[] | select(.status.markers.result == "Error" or .status.markers.message != null)][:16])
    | map(del(.metadata.managedFields, .metadata.ownerReferences, .metadata.resourceVersion, .metadata.creationTimestamp, .metadata.generation)))}' \
  "$MIGR/mf.json" | gzip -9n > test/data/legacyfold/seedkey-mediafiles.json.gz
gunzip -c test/data/legacyfold/seedkey-mediafiles.json.gz | jq '.items|length'   # 64; fewer means a class is short: record which in README.md
gunzip -c test/data/legacyfold/seedkey-mediafiles.json.gz | jq -r '.items[].metadata.uid'   # the 64 UIDs the owner's segments dump covers
```

  1c. `test/data/legacyfold/segments-v1.json.gz` from the owner-approved dump (Precondition):
  `jq -c . "$MIGR/segments.json" | gzip -9n > test/data/legacyfold/segments-v1.json.gz`. The
  README records both cuts and that the records are the previous release's v1
  `segments.Record` values, keyed by the dumped MediaFile UID.

```go
func TestAdoptLegacyDonorFillsOnlyWhatIsMissing(t *testing.T) {
```

```go
package remediation

import (
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"

// TestSeedPrevLeavesTheCachedObjectAlone: the seeds become the previous
// blocks the planners read, never the cached object the CAS render compares
// against -- else a seeded block would read as already applied and adoption
// would never be written.
func TestSeedPrevLeavesTheCachedObjectAlone(t *testing.T) {
 cached := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{Status: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeHash: "p1"}}
 seeded := seedPrev(&cached.Status, Seed{
  Subtitles: &catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted},
  Transcode: &catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping},
 })
 assert.Nil(t, cached.Status.Subtitles)
 assert.Nil(t, cached.Status.Transcode)
 assert.Equal(t, "p1", seeded.ProbeHash)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted, seeded.Subtitles.Phase)
 assert.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, seeded.Transcode.Phase)
 assert.Nil(t, seeded.Graft, "an unseeded block keeps its stored value")
}
```

```go
package legacyfold_test
```

```go
const repo = "../../.."

// crdPaths is every CRD file, with the MediaFile CRD taken from mediaFileCRD.
func crdPaths(t *testing.T, mediaFileCRD string) []string {
 t.Helper()
 files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(repo, "config/crd/bases/*.yaml"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 out := []string{mediaFileCRD}
 for _, f := range files {
  if !strings.HasSuffix(f, "catalog.clustarr.io_mediafiles.yaml") {
   out = append(out, f)
  }
 }
 return out
}

var (
 previousCRD = filepath.Join(repo, "test/data/legacyfold/previous-crd/catalog.clustarr.io_mediafiles.yaml")
 currentCRD  = filepath.Join(repo, "config/crd/bases/catalog.clustarr.io_mediafiles.yaml")
)

// installMediaFileCRD replaces the MediaFile CRD and waits until the
// apiserver serves its schema: a dry-run status apply of a leaf only N's
// schema has comes back with it (N) or pruned (previous).
func installMediaFileCRD(t *testing.T, cfg *rest.Config, c client.Client, path string, wantLegacyFold bool) {
 t.Helper()
 _, err := envtest.InstallCRDs(cfg, envtest.CRDInstallOptions{Paths: []string{path}, ErrorIfPathMissing: true})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 probe := &unstructured.Unstructured{Object: map[string]any{
  "apiVersion": "catalog.clustarr.io/v1alpha1", "kind": "MediaFile",
  "metadata": map[string]any{"name": "schema-probe", "namespace": "default"},
  "spec":     map[string]any{"mediaRef": map[string]any{"kind": "movie", "name": "x"}, "path": "/data/x.mkv"},
 }}
 _ = c.Create(context.Background(), probe.DeepCopy())
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  u := probe.DeepCopy()
  u.Object["status"] = map[string]any{"legacyFold": map[string]any{"held": "Mode"}}
  body, err := json.Marshal(u.Object)
  if err != nil {
   return false
  }
  if err := c.Status().Patch(context.Background(), u, client.RawPatch(types.ApplyPatchType, body),
   client.FieldOwner("schema-probe"), client.ForceOwnership, client.DryRunAll); err != nil {
   return false
  }
  _, found, _ := unstructured.NestedFieldNoCopy(u.Object, "status", "legacyFold")
  return found == wantLegacyFold
 }, 30*time.Second, 200*time.Millisecond, "the apiserver serves %s", path)
}

// applyAs applies a raw status body under manager to the status subresource
// (server-side apply, forced, as k8s.PatchStatus does).
func applyAs(ctx context.Context, c client.Client, manager string, body []byte) error {
 u := &unstructured.Unstructured{}
 if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &u.Object); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 return c.Status().Patch(ctx, u, client.RawPatch(types.ApplyPatchType, body), client.FieldOwner(manager), client.ForceOwnership)
}

// newBus is an in-memory bus with the default topology ensured.
func newBus(t *testing.T) events.Bus {
 t.Helper()
 bus := membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock())
 require.NoError(t, bus.Ensure(context.Background(), events.Default()))
 return bus
}

// startLoop runs the remediation loop (and, with lf, release N's adoption)
// over bus in a manager of its own until the returned stop is called.
func startLoop(t *testing.T, cfg *rest.Config, dataDir string, lf *legacyfold.Options, bus events.Bus) func() {
 t.Helper()
 mgr, err := ctrl.NewManager(cfg, ctrl.Options{
  Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme(), Metrics: metricsserver.Options{BindAddress: "0"}, HealthProbeBindAddress: "0",
  Controller: config.Controller{SkipNameValidation: new(true)},
 })
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, remediationmanager.Register(mgr, bus, remediationmanager.Options{DataDir: dataDir, LegacyFold: lf}))
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 done := make(chan struct{})
 go func() { defer close(done); _ = mgr.Start(ctx) }()
 var once sync.Once
 stop := func() { once.Do(func() { cancel(); <-done }) }
 t.Cleanup(stop)
 return stop
}

func readGolden(t *testing.T, name string) []byte {
 t.Helper()
 b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(repo, "test/data/legacyfold/previous-applies", name+".json"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 return b
}

// assertSubset fails for any leaf of want that got does not hold; a list
// keyed by path is matched entry by entry.
func assertSubset(t *testing.T, want, got any, at string) {
 t.Helper()
 switch w := want.(type) {
 case map[string]any:
  g, ok := got.(map[string]any)
  require.True(t, ok, "%s: want an object, got %v", at, got)
  for k, v := range w {
   assertSubset(t, v, g[k], at+"."+k)
  }
 case []any:
  g, ok := got.([]any)
  require.True(t, ok, "%s: want a list, got %v", at, got)
  for _, wi := range w {
   wm, keyed := wi.(map[string]any)
   if path, hasPath := wm["path"]; keyed && hasPath {
    found := false
    for _, gi := range g {
     if gm, ok := gi.(map[string]any); ok && gm["path"] == path {
      assertSubset(t, wm, gm, at+"[path="+path.(string)+"]")
      found = true
     }
    }
    assert.True(t, found, "%s: entry %v lost", at, path)
    continue
   }
   if wm != nil && wm["type"] != nil { // conditions: by type
    found := false
    for _, gi := range g {
     if gm, ok := gi.(map[string]any); ok && gm["type"] == wm["type"] {
      assertSubset(t, wm, gm, at+"[type="+wm["type"].(string)+"]")
      found = true
     }
    }
    assert.True(t, found, "%s: condition %v lost", at, wm["type"])
    continue
   }
  }
 default:
  assert.Equal(t, want, got, at)
 }
}

func TestThePreviousReleasesStatusApplyIsAccepted(t *testing.T) {
 if os.Getenv("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS") == "" {
  t.Skip("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS is unset; run via `make test`")
 }
 env := &envtest.Environment{CRDInstallOptions: envtest.CRDInstallOptions{Paths: crdPaths(t, previousCRD), ErrorIfPathMissing: true}}
 cfg, err := env.Start()
 require.NoError(t, err)
 t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, env.Stop()) })
 c, err := client.New(cfg, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 ctx := context.Background()

 goldens := map[string]string{"transcoded": "heat-file", "two-sidecars": "alien-file", "phaseless-block": "brazil-file"}
 seeded := map[string]string{}
 for golden, name := range goldens {
  require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{
   ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: "default"},
   Spec: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{Path: "/data/media/movies/" + name + ".mkv",
    MediaRef: catalogMovie(name)},
  }))
  require.NoError(t, applyAs(ctx, c, "catalogarr", readGolden(t, golden)), "the previous release seeds %s", golden)
  var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: name}, &mf))
  seeded[name] = mf.ResourceVersion
 }

 installMediaFileCRD(t, cfg, c, currentCRD, true)
 stop := startLoop(t, cfg, t.TempDir(), &legacyfold.Options{Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Retain: legacyfold.DefaultRetain, Namespace: "default"}, newBus(t))
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  for _, name := range goldens {
   var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
   if c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: name}, &mf) != nil || mf.ResourceVersion == seeded[name] {
    return false
   }
  }
  return true
 }, 2*time.Minute, time.Second, "one loop pass rendered every seeded file")
 stop()

 replay := func(crd string) {
  for golden, name := range goldens {
   require.NoError(t, applyAs(ctx, c, "catalogarr", readGolden(t, golden)), "the previous release's apply of %s is accepted under %s", golden, crd)
   var u unstructured.Unstructured
   u.SetGroupVersionKind(catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.WithKind("MediaFile"))
   require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: name}, &u))
   var want map[string]any
   require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(readGolden(t, golden), &want))
   assertSubset(t, want["status"], u.Object["status"], golden+".status")
  }
 }
 replay("N's CRD")
 installMediaFileCRD(t, cfg, c, previousCRD, false)
 replay("the previous CRD re-applied")
}

func TestRestoreMarkersMakesARollbackLossless(t *testing.T) {
 _, c := startEnv(t)
 ctx := context.Background()
 markers := []byte(`{"apiVersion":"catalog.clustarr.io/v1alpha1","kind":"MediaFile","metadata":{"name":"heat-file","namespace":"default"},
  "status":{"markers":{"result":"NotFound","forProbeHash":"1111111111111111111111111111111111111111","fetchedAt":"2026-09-30T21:18:40Z","notFoundSince":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"}}}`)
 seed := func(t *testing.T) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
  _ = c.Delete(ctx, &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "heat-file", Namespace: "default"}})
  require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
   return c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: "heat-file"}, &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{}) != nil
  }, 10*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond)
  require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "heat-file", Namespace: "default"},
   Spec: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{Path: "/data/media/movies/heat-file.mkv", MediaRef: catalogMovie("heat-file")}}))
  require.NoError(t, applyAs(ctx, c, "catalogarr", readGolden(t, "transcoded")))
  require.NoError(t, applyAs(ctx, c, "catalogarr-markers", markers))
  // Release N: the loop's claim (the whole status, markers included, as
  // catalogarr), then §7.3.8's release.
  var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: "heat-file"}, &mf))
  claim := map[string]any{"apiVersion": "catalog.clustarr.io/v1alpha1", "kind": "MediaFile",
   "metadata": map[string]any{"name": "heat-file", "namespace": "default"}, "status": mf.Status}
  b, err := json.Marshal(claim)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, applyAs(ctx, c, "catalogarr", b))
  require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: "heat-file"}, &mf))
  require.NoError(t, legacyfold.ReleaseMarkers(ctx, c, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&mf), mf.ResourceVersion))
  require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: "heat-file"}, &mf))
  require.False(t, legacyfold.HasMarkersEntry(mf.ManagedFields), "released")
  require.NotNil(t, mf.Status.Markers)
  return &mf
 }
 previousApply := func(t *testing.T) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
  require.NoError(t, applyAs(ctx, c, "catalogarr", readGolden(t, "transcoded")))
  var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: "heat-file"}, &mf))
  return &mf
 }

 t.Run("without restore-markers the previous release deletes status.markers", func(t *testing.T) {
  seed(t)
  assert.Nil(t, previousApply(t).Status.Markers, "the falsifier: catalogarr alone owned the markers it no longer sends")
 })
 t.Run("restore-markers keeps them, unchanged and co-owned", func(t *testing.T) {
  before := seed(t).Status.Markers.DeepCopy()
  restored, left, err := legacyfold.RestoreMarkers(ctx, c, "default", 1000)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  assert.Equal(t, 1, restored)
  assert.Zero(t, left)
  after := previousApply(t)
  assert.Equal(t, before, after.Status.Markers)
  assert.True(t, legacyfold.HasMarkersEntry(after.ManagedFields))
 })
}

// seedKey re-implements cluster-plex's clustarrwatch.SeedKey over the same
// five fields (cluster-plex pkg/clustarrwatch/fields.go:156-171).
func seedKey(u *unstructured.Unstructured) string {
 keep := map[string]any{}
 for _, f := range [][]string{{"spec", "path"}, {"spec", "sizeBytes"}, {"status", "probeHash"}, {"status", "mediaInfo"}, {"status", "markers"}} {
  if v, ok, _ := unstructured.NestedFieldNoCopy(u.Object, f...); ok {
   keep[strings.Join(f, ".")] = v
  }
 }
 b, _ := json.Marshal(keep)
 sum := sha256.Sum256(b)
 return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

// planted is one fixture file planted under the test's --data-dir, with its
// v1 segment record re-keyed to the planted bytes' probe hash.
type planted struct {
 mf     *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 record json.RawMessage
}

func TestTheFirstLoopPassKeepsEverySeedKey(t *testing.T) {
 cfg, c := startEnv(t)
 ctx := context.Background()
 var fixture catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
 loadGz(t, "seedkey-mediafiles.json.gz", &fixture)
 var records map[string]json.RawMessage
 loadGz(t, "segments-v1.json.gz", &records)
 dataDir := t.TempDir()

 // The opaque probe hash is re-keyed consistently: stat hashes name the
 // path and the mtime's nanoseconds, which a dump cannot reproduce on
 // another disk, so each file is planted at its logical path under the
 // test's --data-dir, and every place the old hash appears (probeHash,
 // markers.forProbeHash, markers.analysis.forProbeHash, the v1 record's
 // probeHash) takes the hash of what was planted. Equalities between those
 // fields, which is all the planners compare, are unchanged.
 var files []planted
 for i := range fixture.Items {
  mf := &fixture.Items[i]
  local := filepath.Join(dataDir, strings.TrimPrefix(mf.Spec.Path, "/data/"))
  require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(local), 0o755))
  f, err := os.Create(local)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, f.Truncate(mf.Spec.SizeBytes))
  require.NoError(t, f.Close())
  mtime := mf.Spec.ModTime.Time.Truncate(time.Second)
  require.NoError(t, os.Chtimes(local, mtime, mtime))
  old, fresh := mf.Status.ProbeHash, mediainfo.ProbeHash(mf.Spec.Path, mf.Spec.SizeBytes, mtime)
  b, err := json.Marshal(mf.Status)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.ReplaceAll(string(b), old, fresh)), &mf.Status))
  rec := json.RawMessage(strings.ReplaceAll(string(records[string(mf.UID)]), old, fresh))
  files = append(files, planted{mf: mf, record: rec})
 }

 // The previous release's state: spec and status as dumped, markers under
 // catalogarr-markers, the rest under catalogarr.
 byName := map[string]string{}
 for _, p := range files {
  status := p.mf.Status.DeepCopy()
  obj := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: p.mf.Name, Namespace: "default", Labels: p.mf.Labels, Annotations: p.mf.Annotations}, Spec: p.mf.Spec}
  require.NoError(t, c.Create(ctx, obj))
  byName[p.mf.Name] = string(obj.UID)
  markers := status.Markers
  status.Markers = nil
  for manager, st := range map[string]any{"catalogarr": status, "catalogarr-markers": map[string]any{"markers": markers}} {
   b, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"apiVersion": "catalog.clustarr.io/v1alpha1", "kind": "MediaFile",
    "metadata": map[string]any{"name": p.mf.Name, "namespace": "default"}, "status": st})
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.NoError(t, applyAs(ctx, c, manager, b))
  }
 }
 before := map[string]string{}
 for name := range byName {
  var u unstructured.Unstructured
  u.SetGroupVersionKind(catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.WithKind("MediaFile"))
  require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: name}, &u))
  before[name] = seedKey(&u)
 }

 // The previous release's v1 records, under the new UIDs, before the
 // loop's first pass reads them.
 bus := newBus(t)
 kv := bus.KV(events.BucketSegments)
 for _, p := range files {
  if len(p.record) > 0 {
   _, err := kv.Put(ctx, events.RecordKey(types.UID(byName[p.mf.Name])), p.record)
   require.NoError(t, err)
  }
 }
 stop := startLoop(t, cfg, dataDir, &legacyfold.Options{Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Retain: legacyfold.DefaultRetain, Namespace: "default"}, bus)
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  for name := range byName {
   var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
   if c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: name}, &mf) != nil || legacyfold.HasMarkersEntry(mf.ManagedFields) {
    return false
   }
  }
  return true
 }, 3*time.Minute, time.Second, "the loop's first pass claimed and released every file")
 stop()
 for name, key := range before {
  var u unstructured.Unstructured
  u.SetGroupVersionKind(catalogv1alpha1.GroupVersion.WithKind("MediaFile"))
  require.NoError(t, c.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: "default", Name: name}, &u))
  assert.Equal(t, key, seedKey(&u), "%s: the first pass changed what cluster-plex seeds", name)
 }
}
```

  The helper the tests name, in the same file:

```go
func catalogMovie(name string) commonv1.MediaRef {
 return commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: name}
```

```go
func env(t *testing.T) (*rest.Config, client.Client) {
 t.Helper()
 if os.Getenv("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS") == "" {
  t.Skip("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS is unset; run via `make test`")
 }
 e := &envtest.Environment{CRDDirectoryPaths: []string{"../../../config/crd/bases"}, ErrorIfCRDPathMissing: true}
 cfg, err := e.Start()
 require.NoError(t, err)
 t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, e.Stop()) })
 c, err := client.New(cfg, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 return cfg, c
}

func loop(t *testing.T, cfg *rest.Config, lf *legacyfold.Options) func() {
 t.Helper()
 bus := membus.New(clockwork.NewRealClock())
 require.NoError(t, bus.Ensure(context.Background(), events.Default()))
 mgr, err := ctrl.NewManager(cfg, ctrl.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme(), Metrics: metricsserver.Options{BindAddress: "0"},
  HealthProbeBindAddress: "0", Controller: config.Controller{SkipNameValidation: new(true)}})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, remediationmanager.Register(mgr, bus, remediationmanager.Options{DataDir: t.TempDir(), LegacyFold: lf}))
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
 done := make(chan struct{})
 go func() { defer close(done); _ = mgr.Start(ctx) }()
 stop := func() { cancel(); <-done }
 t.Cleanup(stop)
 return stop
}

var apply = &legacyfold.Options{Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Retain: legacyfold.DefaultRetain, Namespace: "default"}

// steady creates a file and lets the loop (release N without adoption)
// bring it to steady state, so the adoption below acts on an object that
// already has status: the only test that can see a release.
func steady(t *testing.T, cfg *rest.Config, c client.Client, name string) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 t.Helper()
 mf := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name, Namespace: "default"},
  Spec: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{Path: "/data/media/movies/" + name + ".mkv", MediaRef: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: name}}}
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(context.Background(), mf))
 at := metav1.NewTime(time.Date(2026, 10, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
 _, err := k8s.PatchStatus(context.Background(), c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarr, catalogac.MediaFile(name, "default").WithStatus(
  catalogac.MediaFileStatus().WithProbeHash("p1").WithProbedAt(at).WithProbeVersion(3).
   WithMediaInfo(commonv1.MediaInfo{Container: "matroska,webm", VideoCodec: "hevc"}).
   WithNaming(catalogac.NamingStatus().WithCurrent(true).WithExpectedPath(mf.Spec.Path))))

 stop := loop(t, cfg, nil)
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  var live catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  return c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &live) == nil && live.Status.ObservedGeneration == live.Generation
 }, time.Minute, 200*time.Millisecond)
 stop()
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), mf))
 return mf
}

func TestAdoptionIntoASteadyStateFileKeepsEveryPriorLeaf(t *testing.T) {

  {LangKey: "es", State: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemPending, Attempts: commonv1.Attempts{Count: 14}, NextSearchAt: &next, LastError: "every eligible provider is throttled"}}}

  return c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &live) == nil && live.Status.LegacyFold != nil && len(live.Status.LegacyFold.Adopted) == 1

func TestAWriterBetweenReadAndApplyConflictsAndTheAdoptionIsRedone(t *testing.T) {
 cfg, c := env(t)
 mf := steady(t, cfg, c, "alien-file")
 sr := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "alien-file", Namespace: "default"},
  Spec: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: "alien-file", ProfileRef: "english"}}
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(context.Background(), sr))
 var interleaved, applies atomic.Int32
 wrapped := rest.CopyConfig(cfg)
 wrapped.WrapTransport = func(rt http.RoundTripper) http.RoundTripper {
  return roundTripFunc(func(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
   if req.Method == http.MethodPatch && strings.HasSuffix(req.URL.Path, "/mediafiles/alien-file/status") {
    applies.Add(1)
    if interleaved.CompareAndSwap(0, 1) {
     // The Migrator's annotation patch lands between the loop's
     // read and its apply.
     var live catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
     require.NoError(t, c.Get(req.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &live))
     live.Annotations = map[string]string{catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend: "true"}
     require.NoError(t, c.Update(req.Context(), &live, client.FieldOwner(k8s.ManagerLegacyFold.String())))
    }
   }
   return rt.RoundTrip(req)
  })
 }
 loop(t, wrapped, apply)
 var live catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  return c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &live) == nil && live.Status.LegacyFold != nil && len(live.Status.LegacyFold.Adopted) == 1
 }, time.Minute, 200*time.Millisecond)
 assert.GreaterOrEqual(t, applies.Load(), int32(2), "the first apply conflicted and the pass was redone from a fresh read")
 assert.Equal(t, "true", live.Annotations[catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend], "the interleaved writer is not rolled back")
}

type roundTripFunc func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f roundTripFunc) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }

func TestAnAdoptedObjectIsNeverAdoptedAgain(t *testing.T) {
 cfg, c := env(t)
 mf := steady(t, cfg, c, "brazil-file")
 sr := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "brazil-file", Namespace: "default"},
  Spec: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: "brazil-file", ProfileRef: "english"}}
 require.NoError(t, c.Create(context.Background(), sr))
 sr.Status.Items = []subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItem{{LangKey: "fr", State: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleItemFailed, LastError: "first"}}
 require.NoError(t, c.Status().Update(context.Background(), sr))
 loop(t, cfg, apply)
 var live catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
  return c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &live) == nil && live.Status.LegacyFold != nil && len(live.Status.LegacyFold.Adopted) == 1
 }, time.Minute, 200*time.Millisecond)
 stamp := live.Status.LegacyFold.Adopted[0].At

 // The legacy object changes and the file is woken: the loop must not
 // adopt it a second time (keyed by UID, never by block presence).
 sr.Status.Items[0].LastError = "second"
 require.NoError(t, c.Status().Update(context.Background(), sr))
 live.Annotations = map[string]string{"test.clustarr.io/wake": "1"}
 require.NoError(t, c.Update(context.Background(), &live))
 time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &live))
 require.Len(t, live.Status.LegacyFold.Adopted, 1)
 assert.Equal(t, stamp, live.Status.LegacyFold.Adopted[0].At, "the record is carried forward byte for byte")
 for _, it := range live.Status.Subtitles.Items {
  assert.NotEqual(t, "second", it.LastError, "nothing was copied again")
 }
}

func TestAfterTheReleaseCatalogarrAloneOwnsTheMarkers(t *testing.T) {

 mf := steady(t, cfg, c, "dune-file")
```

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "context"

 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
)

const (
 IndexTranscodeJobMediaFile    = "spec.mediaFileRef"
 IndexSubtitleRequestMediaFile = "spec.mediaFileRef"
 IndexAudioGraftMediaFile      = "status.mediaFileRef"
)

// RegisterIndexes registers the three legacy lookups under the names they
// had before the fold (loop spec §7.3.2). Release N only.
func RegisterIndexes(ctx context.Context, idx client.FieldIndexer) error {
 if err := idx.IndexField(ctx, &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{}, IndexTranscodeJobMediaFile, func(o client.Object) []string {
  return []string{o.(*transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob).Spec.MediaFileRef}
 }); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 if err := idx.IndexField(ctx, &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{}, IndexSubtitleRequestMediaFile, func(o client.Object) []string {
  return []string{o.(*subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest).Spec.MediaFileRef}
 }); err != nil {
  return err
 }
 return idx.IndexField(ctx, &transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft{}, IndexAudioGraftMediaFile, func(o client.Object) []string {
  if ref := o.(*transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft).Status.MediaFileRef; ref != "" {
   return []string{ref}
  }
  return nil
 })
}
```

  3b. `app/catalog/legacyfold/markers.go` (loop §7.3.8 steps 3 and the rollback command's
  function; `TestOnlyLegacyFoldAppliesAsCatalogarrMarkers`, F8.10, holds every
  `catalogarr-markers` write to this file):

```go
package legacyfold

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"

 apierrors "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/errors"
 "golang.org/x/time/rate"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogac "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/applyconfiguration/catalog/catalog/v1alpha1"
 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// ReleaseMarkers applies an empty status configuration under
// catalogarr-markers, preconditioned on resourceVersion: the leaves
// catalogarr co-owns stay, and the retired manager's entry disappears.
func ReleaseMarkers(ctx context.Context, c client.Client, key client.ObjectKey, resourceVersion string) error {
 _, err := k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMarkers,
  catalogac.MediaFile(key.Name, key.Namespace).WithResourceVersion(resourceVersion))
 return err
}

// RestoreMarkers is `manager legacy-fold restore-markers` (loop spec §7.3.8,
// §7.3.11, §7.6 step 3): for every MediaFile with status.markers and no
// catalogarr-markers entry, it applies status.markers exactly as stored
// under catalogarr-markers with the read's resourceVersion, so a
// previous-release catalogarr apply that never sends markers releases only
// its own ownership. c must be uncached (managedFields). It returns how many
// files it restored and how many are still without the entry afterwards.
func RestoreMarkers(ctx context.Context, c client.Client, namespace string, writesPerSecond float64) (restored, left int, err error) {
 lim := rate.NewLimiter(rate.Limit(writesPerSecond), 1)
 var list catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
 if err := c.List(ctx, &list, client.InNamespace(namespace)); err != nil {
  return 0, 0, err
 }
 for i := range list.Items {
  mf := &list.Items[i]
  for attempt := 0; ; attempt++ {
   if mf.Status.Markers == nil || HasMarkersEntry(mf.ManagedFields) {
    break
   }
   b, err := json.Marshal(mf.Status.Markers)
   if err != nil {
    return restored, 0, err
   }
   var markers catalogac.FileMarkersApplyConfiguration
   if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &markers); err != nil {
    return restored, 0, err
   }
   if err := lim.Wait(ctx); err != nil {
    return restored, 0, err
   }
   _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMarkers, catalogac.MediaFile(mf.Name, mf.Namespace).
    WithResourceVersion(mf.ResourceVersion).WithStatus(catalogac.MediaFileStatus().WithMarkers(&markers)))
   if err == nil {
    restored++
    break
   }
   if !apierrors.IsConflict(err) || attempt == 4 {
    return restored, 0, fmt.Errorf("legacyfold: restore markers on %s/%s: %w", mf.Namespace, mf.Name, err)
   }
   if err := c.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), mf); err != nil {
    return restored, 0, err
   }
  }
 }
 if err := c.List(ctx, &list, client.InNamespace(namespace)); err != nil {
  return restored, 0, err
 }
 for _, mf := range list.Items {
  if mf.Status.Markers != nil && !HasMarkersEntry(mf.ManagedFields) {
   left++
  }
 }
 return restored, left, nil
}
```

  3c. `app/catalog/controller/rollup/legacydonor.go`:

```go
package rollup

import (
 "context"
 "slices"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
)

// LegacyDonor reads release N's AudioGraft for an item (loop spec §7.3.3, "To
// the item"): its donor and the releases its grafts rejected. The item
// packages call it without naming the folded kind; app/remediation/adopt
// provides it. nil in N+1 (F9.1).
type LegacyDonor func(ctx context.Context, namespace, item string) (*catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor, []string, error)

// AdoptLegacyDonor fills audio.donor from a legacy donor when the item's own
// derivation found none, and merges rejected releases (deduplicated, oldest
// dropped past 16). It returns audio unchanged when there is nothing to adopt.
func AdoptLegacyDonor(audio *catalogv1alpha1.AudioState, donor *catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor, rejected []string) *catalogv1alpha1.AudioState {
 if donor == nil && len(rejected) == 0 {
  return audio
 }
 if audio == nil {
  audio = &catalogv1alpha1.AudioState{}
 }
 if audio.Donor == nil && donor != nil {
  audio.Donor = donor.DeepCopy()
 }
 for _, r := range rejected {
  if !slices.Contains(audio.RejectedReleases, r) {
   audio.RejectedReleases = append(audio.RejectedReleases, r)
  }
 }
 if n := len(audio.RejectedReleases); n > 16 {
  audio.RejectedReleases = audio.RejectedReleases[n-16:]
 }
 return audio
}
```

  3d. `app/remediation/legacy.go`:

```go
package remediation

import (
 "context"
 "time"

 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/builder"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
)

// Seed is release N's adoption, handed from the adopt planner to the pass
// before any other planner gathers (loop spec §7.2, §7.3.3): the previous
// blocks the subtitles, transcode and graft planners plan from this pass,
// the planners that hold, and the outcomes to count once the apply lands.
// F9.1 deletes it.
type Seed struct {
 Subtitles  *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitlesStatus
 Transcode  *catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeState
 Graft      *catalogv1alpha1.GraftState
 Hold       map[PlannerName]bool
 HoldRename bool
 // Landed runs once the status apply lands, never on a skipped or
 // conflicted one: adoption metrics count landed writes only (§7.3.4).
 Landed func()
}

// Adopter is release N's adoption hook (app/remediation/adopt.Hook). The
// Reconciler's Adopt is nil in N+1.
type Adopter interface {
 // Adopt gathers the file's legacy objects and plans their adoption,
 // writing only out.LegacyFold. due is when the file must be planned
 // again for adoption's sake (zero: no timer).
 Adopt(ctx context.Context, v *View, out *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) (s Seed, due time.Time, err error)
 // Copy copies status.legacyFold, the adopt planner's only field.
 Copy(from, into *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus)
 // Claim reports whether uid's next status apply may not be skipped
 // (§7.3.8 step 2: catalogarr co-owns every markers leaf).
 Claim(uid types.UID) bool
 // Release is §7.3.8 step 3, after a landed apply, at the
 // resourceVersion that apply returned.
 Release(ctx context.Context, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) error
 // Watches adds S23 (the three kinds, create events only) and the
 // markers-pending wake source to the loop's builder.
 Watches(b *builder.TypedBuilder[Key]) *builder.TypedBuilder[Key]
}

// seedPrev returns prev with s's blocks in place. It never writes to prev:
// View.File's status is what the CAS render compares the draft against.
func seedPrev(prev *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus, s Seed) *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus {
 out := prev.DeepCopy()
 if s.Subtitles != nil {
  out.Subtitles = s.Subtitles.DeepCopy()
 }
 if s.Transcode != nil {
  out.Transcode = s.Transcode.DeepCopy()
 }
 if s.Graft != nil {
  out.Graft = s.Graft.DeepCopy()
 }
 return out
}
```
