```go
  err := r.isolate(ctx, PlannerAdopt, "plan", 10*time.Second, func(ctx context.Context) error {
   var e error
   seed, adoptDue, e = r.Adopt.Adopt(ctx, v, legacy)
   return e
  })
  if err == nil {
   v.Prev = seedPrev(v.Prev, seed)
   draft = seedPrev(draft, seed)
   r.Adopt.Copy(legacy, draft)
  } else {
   r.Adopt.Copy(v.Prev, draft)
   seed = Seed{Hold: map[PlannerName]bool{PlannerSubtitles: true, PlannerTranscode: true, PlannerGraft: true}, HoldRename: true}
  }
 }
 // §3.4 steps 3 and 4: in both loops over Order, first thing per planner:
 // if seed.Hold[p.Name()] { p.Copy(v.Prev, next); continue }
 // §3.4 step 7: the render's unchanged-skip becomes
 // if !claimed && equality.Semantic.DeepEqual(normalize(draft), normalize(&fresh.Status)) { return nil, true, nil }
 // with claimed := r.Adopt != nil && r.Adopt.Claim(v.File.UID), computed before the apply.
 // After a landed apply (applied == true):
 // if seed.Landed != nil { seed.Landed() }
 // if claimed { take a bulk-write token (requeue at its wait when refused); if err := r.Adopt.Release(ctx, appliedObj); apierrors.IsConflict(err) { result.RequeueAfter = time.Second } }
 // where appliedObj is the file with the resourceVersion the status apply returned.
 // §3.4 step 10: the rename actuator runs only when !seed.HoldRename.
 // §3.4 step 11: adoptDue joins the RequeueAfter minimum when non-zero.
```

  In the `TestPlannerCopyPartitionsTheStatus` file, `LegacyFold` leaves the loop-owned set and is

  3e. `app/remediation/adopt` (`doc.go`: "Package adopt is release N's adoption planner over

  `api/` that names SubtitleRequest, TranscodeJob or AudioGraft. Release N+1 deletes it (F9.1).").

  `hook.go`:

```go
package adopt

import (
 "context"
 "time"

 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/legacyfold"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/obs/metrics"
)

// Hook implements remediation.Adopter.
type Hook struct {
 Reader   client.Reader // the manager's cache
 Client   client.Client // the release apply
 Migrator *legacyfold.Migrator
 Markers  *legacyfold.MarkersPending
 Mode     legacyfold.Mode
}

var _ remediation.Adopter = (*Hook)(nil)

func (h *Hook) Adopt(ctx context.Context, v *remediation.View, out *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) (remediation.Seed, time.Time, error) {
 in, err := h.gather(ctx, v.File)
 if err != nil {
  return remediation.Seed{}, time.Time{}, remediation.Transient(err)
 }
 in.Mode, in.Prepared, in.Now = h.Mode, h.Migrator.Prepared, v.Now
 o := legacyfold.Plan(in)
 out.LegacyFold = o.Status
 seed := remediation.Seed{
  Subtitles: o.Subtitles, Transcode: o.Transcode, Graft: o.Graft, HoldRename: o.Hold.Rename,
  Hold: map[remediation.PlannerName]bool{
   remediation.PlannerSubtitles: o.Hold.Subtitles, remediation.PlannerTranscode: o.Hold.Transcode, remediation.PlannerGraft: o.Hold.Graft,
  },
 }
 type label struct{ kind, outcome string }
 counts := map[label]float64{}
 for _, obj := range o.Objects {
  if obj.Outcome != "" {
   counts[label{string(obj.Kind), obj.Outcome}]++
  }
 }
 if len(counts) > 0 {
  seed.Landed = func() {
   for l, n := range counts {
    metrics.LegacyFoldAdoptions.WithLabelValues(l.kind, l.outcome).Add(n)
   }
  }
 }
 var due time.Time
 if o.Requeue > 0 {
  due = v.Now.Add(o.Requeue)
 }
 return seed, due, nil
}

func (h *Hook) Copy(from, into *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus) {
 into.LegacyFold = from.LegacyFold.DeepCopy()
}

func (h *Hook) Claim(uid types.UID) bool { return h.Markers != nil && h.Markers.Has(uid) }

func (h *Hook) Release(ctx context.Context, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) error {
 if err := legacyfold.ReleaseMarkers(ctx, h.Client, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), mf.ResourceVersion); err != nil {
  metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("release_markers", "error").Inc()
  return err
 }
 metrics.LegacyFoldPreparations.WithLabelValues("release_markers", "ok").Inc()
 h.Markers.Done(mf.UID)
 return nil
}

// ItemDonor is the item keys' AudioGraft read (§7.3.3): the AudioGraft named
// k8s.AudioGraftName(item), when it exists.
func (h *Hook) ItemDonor(ctx context.Context, namespace, item string) (*catalogv1alpha1.AudioDonor, []string, error) {
 var ag transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft
 if err := h.Reader.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: namespace, Name: k8s.AudioGraftName(item)}, &ag); err != nil {
  return nil, nil, client.IgnoreNotFound(err)
 }
 donor, rejected := legacyfold.ItemDonor(&ag)
 return donor, rejected, nil
}
```

  `gather.go`:

```go
package adopt

import (
 "context"

 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/legacyfold"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// gather reads the file's legacy objects from the cache through the three
// indexes, plus the item's AudioGraft when its status.mediaFileRef is empty
// and the item's status.fileRef names this file.
func (h *Hook) gather(ctx context.Context, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) (legacyfold.Input, error) {
 in := legacyfold.Input{File: mf}
 ns := client.InNamespace(mf.Namespace)
 var srs subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestList
 if err := h.Reader.List(ctx, &srs, ns, client.MatchingFields{legacyfold.IndexSubtitleRequestMediaFile: mf.Name}); err != nil {
  return in, err
 }
 var tjs transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobList
 if err := h.Reader.List(ctx, &tjs, ns, client.MatchingFields{legacyfold.IndexTranscodeJobMediaFile: mf.Name}); err != nil {
  return in, err
 }
 var ags transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftList
 if err := h.Reader.List(ctx, &ags, ns, client.MatchingFields{legacyfold.IndexAudioGraftMediaFile: mf.Name}); err != nil {
  return in, err
 }
 in.SubtitleRequests, in.TranscodeJobs, in.AudioGrafts = srs.Items, tjs.Items, ags.Items
 if k := mf.Spec.MediaRef.Kind; len(mf.Spec.MediaRef.Keys) == 0 && (k == commonv1.MediaKindMovie || k == commonv1.MediaKindEpisode) {
  var ag transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft
  err := h.Reader.Get(ctx, types.NamespacedName{Namespace: mf.Namespace, Name: k8s.AudioGraftName(mf.Spec.MediaRef.Name)}, &ag)
  switch {
  case err == nil && ag.Status.MediaFileRef == "":
   target, err := legacyfold.AudioGraftTarget(ctx, h.Reader, &ag)
   if err != nil {
    return in, err
   }
   if target == mf.Name {
    in.AudioGrafts = append(in.AudioGrafts, ag)
   }
  case client.IgnoreNotFound(err) != nil:
   return in, err
  }
 }
 var tps transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileList
 if err := h.Reader.List(ctx, &tps); err != nil {
  return in, err
 }
 in.Profiles = tps.Items
 return in, nil
}
```

  `watches.go` (S23 in release N: create events only, §7.3.2; and the pending set's wake):

```go
package adopt

import (
 "context"

 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/builder"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/event"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/handler"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/predicate"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/source"

 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/legacyfold"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation"
)

var createOnly = predicate.Funcs{
 CreateFunc:  func(event.CreateEvent) bool { return true },
 UpdateFunc:  func(event.UpdateEvent) bool { return false },
 DeleteFunc:  func(event.DeleteEvent) bool { return false },
 GenericFunc: func(event.GenericEvent) bool { return false },
}

func fileKey(ns, name string) []remediation.Key {
 if name == "" {
  return nil
 }
 return []remediation.Key{{Kind: remediation.KindMediaFile, Namespace: ns, Name: name}}
}

func (h *Hook) Watches(b *builder.TypedBuilder[remediation.Key]) *builder.TypedBuilder[remediation.Key] {
 b = b.Watches(&subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{}, handler.TypedEnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(
  func(_ context.Context, o client.Object) []remediation.Key {
   return fileKey(o.GetNamespace(), o.(*subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest).Spec.MediaFileRef)
  }), builder.WithPredicates(createOnly))
 b = b.Watches(&transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{}, handler.TypedEnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(
  func(_ context.Context, o client.Object) []remediation.Key {
   return fileKey(o.GetNamespace(), o.(*transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob).Spec.MediaFileRef)
  }), builder.WithPredicates(createOnly))
 b = b.Watches(&transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft{}, handler.TypedEnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(
  func(ctx context.Context, o client.Object) []remediation.Key {
   target, err := legacyfold.AudioGraftTarget(ctx, h.Reader, o.(*transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft))
   if err != nil {
    return nil
   }
   return fileKey(o.GetNamespace(), target)
  }), builder.WithPredicates(createOnly))
 if h.Markers != nil {
  b = b.WatchesRawSource(source.TypedChannel[*metav1.PartialObjectMetadata, remediation.Key](h.Markers.Wake(),
   handler.TypedEnqueueRequestsFromMapFunc(func(_ context.Context, o *metav1.PartialObjectMetadata) []remediation.Key {
    return fileKey(o.Namespace, o.Name)
   })))
 }
 return b
}
```

```go
package remediation_test

import (
 "context"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation"
)

// TestRenderCheckSeesOnlyWhatTheFirstRenderWouldChange: a stored C1 control
// cannot be applied at all, so it is the one stored value the renderer
// replaces (§2.11.1 rule 5); without the segments bucket the markers are
// unknown, never "unchanged".
func TestRenderCheckSeesOnlyWhatTheFirstRenderWouldChange(t *testing.T) {
 clean := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{Status: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileStatus{ProbeHash: "p1",
  MediaInfo: &commonv1.MediaInfo{Container: "matroska,webm", VideoCodec: "hevc",
   Audio: []commonv1.AudioStream{{Codec: "aac", Language: "eng", Title: "Stereo"}}}}}
 changed, unknown, err := remediation.RenderCheck(context.Background(), nil, clean)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.False(t, changed)
 assert.True(t, unknown, "no --nats-url: the markers planner's record is unknown")

 c1 := clean.DeepCopy()
 c1.Status.MediaInfo.Audio[0].Title = "Stereo\u0096"
 changed, _, err = remediation.RenderCheck(context.Background(), nil, c1)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, changed, "a stored C1 control is replaced on the first render, which reseeds Plex")
}
```

```go
func seedLegacy(t *testing.T, c client.Client) {

 ctx := context.Background()

 }
 _, err := k8s.PatchStatus(ctx, c, k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMarkers, catalogac.MediaFile("heat-file", "default").WithStatus(
  catalogac.MediaFileStatus().WithMarkers(catalogac.FileMarkers().WithResult(catalogv1alpha1.MarkersNotFound).WithForProbeHash("p1"))))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 sr := &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "heat-file", Namespace: "default"},
  Spec: subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestSpec{MediaFileRef: "heat-file", ProfileRef: "english", ForceSearch: true}}

// resourceVersions is every object's resourceVersion the report could touch.
func resourceVersions(t *testing.T, c client.Client) map[string]string {
 t.Helper()
 out := map[string]string{}
 for _, l := range []client.ObjectList{&catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList{}, &subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestList{}, &transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobList{}} {
  require.NoError(t, c.List(context.Background(), l))
  items, err := meta.ExtractList(l)
  require.NoError(t, err)
  for _, it := range items {
   o := it.(client.Object)
   out[o.GetName()] = o.GetResourceVersion()
  }
 }
 return out
}

func TestLegacyFoldReportIsReadOnlyAndCountsWhatTheRunbookChecks(t *testing.T) {
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 c, err := client.New(env.Config, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 seedLegacy(t, c)
 before := resourceVersions(t, c)

 out, err := runLegacyFold(t, env.Config, "report", "--namespace", "default", "-o", "json")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var r adopt.Report
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &r))
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]int{"copied": 1}, r.Outcomes["SubtitleRequest"])
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]int{"dismissed_open": 1}, r.Outcomes["TranscodeJob"])
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]int{"subtitle.clustarr.io/search": 1, "transcode.clustarr.io/suspend": 1}, r.Intent)
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]int{"outputPath": 1}, r.IntentDropped)
 assert.Equal(t, 1, r.OpenTranscodeJobs)
 assert.Equal(t, 1, r.WithdrawalFinalizers)
 assert.Equal(t, 1, r.MarkersEntries)
 assert.Equal(t, 2, r.RenderUnknown, "no --nats-url: every file's markers render is unknown")
 assert.Len(t, r.Objects, 2)
 assert.Equal(t, before, resourceVersions(t, c), "the report writes nothing")

 table, err := runLegacyFold(t, env.Config, "report", "--namespace", "default")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Contains(t, table, "dismissed_open")
}

 lease := &coordinationv1.Lease{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: LeaderElectionID, Namespace: "default"},

}
```

  3c. `app/remediation/rendercheck.go`:

```go
package remediation

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "time"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
)

// RenderCheck reports whether the loop's first render of mf would change
// status.markers or status.mediaInfo, the two fields cluster-plex hashes into
// SeedKey (loop spec §7.3.11, §7.10): the markers planner run over the stored
// status with its records, then the sanitiser every apply runs. It reads no
// /data and writes nothing. With a nil bus the markers planner cannot read
// its records, and the markers half is unknown.
func RenderCheck(ctx context.Context, bus events.Bus, mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile) (changed, unknown bool, err error) {
 file := mf.DeepCopy()
 v := &View{File: file, Prev: &file.Status, Draft: file.Status.DeepCopy(), Now: nowWholeSeconds(time.Now())}
 next := file.Status.DeepCopy()
 if bus == nil {
  unknown = true
 } else {
  p := markersPlanner() // the PlannerMarkers entry of Order (F3.4's adapter)
  in, err := p.Gather(ctx, dryEnv(bus), v)
  if err != nil {
   return false, false, err
  }
  out := next.DeepCopy()
  if _, err := p.Plan(v, in, out); err != nil {
   return false, false, err
  }
  p.Copy(out, next)
 }
 sanitize(next) // §2.11.1 rules 1-3, as the apply runs it; rule 5 keeps stored values
 same := func(a, b any) bool {
  x, _ := json.Marshal(a)
  y, _ := json.Marshal(b)
  return string(x) == string(y)
 }
 return !same(next.Markers, mf.Status.Markers) || !same(next.MediaInfo, mf.Status.MediaInfo), unknown, nil
}
```

  `markersPlanner`, `dryEnv` and `nowWholeSeconds` are three small helpers in the same file over
  F3.1's names: the bound planner in `Order` whose `Name()` is `PlannerMarkers`; the `Env` F3.1's
  `Register` builds for the pass, from `bus` alone, with no I/O executor (the markers planner
  touches no `/data`); and `metav1.NewTime(t.UTC().Truncate(time.Second))`. `sanitize` is F3.1's
  sanitiser (§3.7). If F3.1 named any of them otherwise, call F3.1's.

  3d. `app/remediation/adopt/report.go`:

```go
package adopt

import (
 "context"
 "sort"

 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 subtitlev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/subtitle/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/legacyfold"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// Report is `manager legacy-fold report` (loop spec §7.3.11): what release
// N's adoption will do, from the live objects, with every object treated as
// prepared. The runbook's step 1 compares it with §7.1's inventory.
type Report struct {
 Outcomes             map[string]map[string]int `json:"outcomes"`
 Intent               map[string]int            `json:"intent"`
 IntentDropped        map[string]int            `json:"intentDropped"`
 OpenTranscodeJobs    int                       `json:"openTranscodeJobs"`
 WithdrawalFinalizers int                       `json:"withdrawalFinalizers"`
 HeldNoTarget         int                       `json:"heldNoTarget"`
 MarkersEntries       int                       `json:"markersEntries"`
 RenderChanges        int                       `json:"renderChanges"`
 RenderUnknown        int                       `json:"renderUnknown"`
 Objects              []ReportObject            `json:"objects,omitempty"`
}

// ReportObject is one legacy object's line in -o json.
type ReportObject struct {
 Kind      string            `json:"kind"`
 Name      string            `json:"name"`
 UID       types.UID         `json:"uid"`
 MediaFile string            `json:"mediaFile"`
 Outcome   string            `json:"outcome"`
 Intent    map[string]string `json:"intent,omitempty"`
}

// BuildReport lists through c (uncached: managedFields are read) and bus
// (nil without --nats-url) and writes nothing.
func BuildReport(ctx context.Context, c client.Client, bus events.Bus, namespace string) (*Report, error) {
 r := &Report{Outcomes: map[string]map[string]int{}, Intent: map[string]int{}, IntentDropped: map[string]int{}}
 in := client.InNamespace(namespace)
 var (
  mfs catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
  srs subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequestList
  tjs transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJobList
  ags transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraftList
  tps transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfileList
 )
 for _, l := range []client.ObjectList{&mfs, &srs, &tjs, &ags} {
  if err := c.List(ctx, l, in); err != nil {
   return nil, err
  }
 }
 if err := c.List(ctx, &tps); err != nil {
  return nil, err
 }
 bySR, byTJ, byAG := map[string][]subtitlev1alpha1.SubtitleRequest{}, map[string][]transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeJob{}, map[string][]transcodev1alpha1.AudioGraft{}
 for _, sr := range srs.Items {
  bySR[sr.Spec.MediaFileRef] = append(bySR[sr.Spec.MediaFileRef], sr)
  set, dropped := legacyfold.Intent(&sr)
  count(r, set, dropped)
 }
 for _, tj := range tjs.Items {
  byTJ[tj.Spec.MediaFileRef] = append(byTJ[tj.Spec.MediaFileRef], tj)
  set, dropped := legacyfold.Intent(&tj)
  count(r, set, dropped)
  if legacyfold.OpenTranscodeJob(&tj) {
   r.OpenTranscodeJobs++
  }
  if k8s.HasFinalizer(&tj, legacyfold.FinalizerTaskWithdrawal) {
   r.WithdrawalFinalizers++
  }
 }
 for i := range ags.Items {
  target, err := legacyfold.AudioGraftTarget(ctx, c, &ags.Items[i])
  if err != nil {
   return nil, err
  }
  if target == "" {
   r.HeldNoTarget++
   continue
  }
  byAG[target] = append(byAG[target], ags.Items[i])
 }
 now := metav1.Now()
 for i := range mfs.Items {
  mf := &mfs.Items[i]
  if legacyfold.HasMarkersEntry(mf.ManagedFields) {
   r.MarkersEntries++
  }
  changed, unknown, err := remediation.RenderCheck(ctx, bus, mf)
  if err != nil {
   return nil, err
  }
  if changed {
   r.RenderChanges++
  }
  if unknown {
   r.RenderUnknown++
  }
  if len(bySR[mf.Name])+len(byTJ[mf.Name])+len(byAG[mf.Name]) == 0 {
   continue
  }
  out := legacyfold.Plan(legacyfold.Input{File: mf, SubtitleRequests: bySR[mf.Name], TranscodeJobs: byTJ[mf.Name], AudioGrafts: byAG[mf.Name],
   Profiles: tps.Items, Mode: legacyfold.ModeApply, Prepared: func(types.UID) bool { return true }, Now: now})
  for _, o := range out.Objects {
   if o.Outcome == "" {
    continue
   }
   if r.Outcomes[string(o.Kind)] == nil {
    r.Outcomes[string(o.Kind)] = map[string]int{}
   }
   r.Outcomes[string(o.Kind)][o.Outcome]++
   r.Objects = append(r.Objects, ReportObject{Kind: string(o.Kind), Name: o.Name, UID: o.UID, MediaFile: mf.Name, Outcome: o.Outcome})
  }
 }
 sort.Slice(r.Objects, func(i, j int) bool { return r.Objects[i].Kind+r.Objects[i].Name < r.Objects[j].Kind+r.Objects[j].Name })
 return r, nil
}

func count(r *Report, set map[string]string, dropped []string) {
 for k := range set {
  r.Intent[k]++
 }
 for _, f := range dropped {
  r.IntentDropped[f]++
 }
}
```

  (Fill `ReportObject.Intent` from `legacyfold.Intent` of the object while building `Objects`.)

  3e. `internal/cli/manager/legacyfold.go`:

```go
package manager

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "text/tabwriter"
 "time"

 "github.com/spf13/cobra"
 coordinationv1 "k8s.io/api/coordination/v1"
 "k8s.io/client-go/rest"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/catalog/legacyfold"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/app/remediation/adopt"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/busconn"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
)

// newLegacyFoldCommand is release N's `manager legacy-fold`; F9.1 deletes it.
// Both subcommands run with the operator's kubeconfig and an uncached client:
// no manager, no cache, no lease.
func newLegacyFoldCommand(getConfig func() (*rest.Config, error)) *cobra.Command {
 lf := &cobra.Command{Use: "legacy-fold", Short: "Release N's legacy-fold tools (ADR-0016): a read-only report, and restore-markers for a rollback"}
 newClient := func() (client.Client, error) {
  cfg, err := getConfig()
  if err != nil {
   return nil, err
  }
  return client.New(cfg, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 }

 var ns, output, natsURL string
 report := &cobra.Command{
  Use: "report", Short: "What adoption will copy, dismiss and annotate, read-only (runbook step 1)", Args: cobra.NoArgs,
  RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
   c, err := newClient()
   if err != nil {
    return err
   }
   var bus events.Bus
   if natsURL != "" {
    b, nc, err := busconn.Connect(natsURL, "legacy-fold-report")
    if err != nil {
     return err
    }
    defer nc.Close()
    bus = b
   }
   r, err := adopt.BuildReport(cmd.Context(), c, bus, ns)
   if err != nil {
    return err
   }
   if output == "json" {
    enc := json.NewEncoder(cmd.OutOrStdout())
    enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
    return enc.Encode(r)
   }
   tw := tabwriter.NewWriter(cmd.OutOrStdout(), 0, 4, 2, ' ', 0)
   for kind, outs := range r.Outcomes {
    for o, n := range outs {
     fmt.Fprintf(tw, "%s\t%s\t%d\n", kind, o, n)
    }
   }
   fmt.Fprintf(tw, "intent\t%v\nintent dropped\t%v\nopen TranscodeJobs\t%d\ntask-withdrawal finalizers\t%d\nAudioGrafts without a target\t%d\nMediaFiles carrying catalogarr-markers\t%d\nfirst render changes markers or mediaInfo\t%d\nfirst render unknown (no --nats-url)\t%d\n",
    r.Intent, r.IntentDropped, r.OpenTranscodeJobs, r.WithdrawalFinalizers, r.HeldNoTarget, r.MarkersEntries, r.RenderChanges, r.RenderUnknown)
   return tw.Flush()
  },
 }
 report.Flags().StringVar(&ns, "namespace", "clustarr-system", "the namespace to report on")
 report.Flags().StringVarP(&output, "output", "o", "table", "table or json")
 report.Flags().StringVar(&natsURL, "nats-url", "", "read the markers planner's records from this NATS server; without it the render check is unknown")

 var rns string
 var wps float64
 restore := &cobra.Command{
  Use: "restore-markers", Short: "Before a rollback: give status.markers back to catalogarr-markers (runbook §7.6 step 3)", Args: cobra.NoArgs,
  RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
   c, err := newClient()
   if err != nil {
    return err
   }
   var lease coordinationv1.Lease
   if err := c.Get(cmd.Context(), client.ObjectKey{Namespace: rns, Name: LeaderElectionID}, &lease); client.IgnoreNotFound(err) != nil {
    return err
   } else if err == nil && leaseHeld(&lease, time.Now()) {
    return fmt.Errorf("a manager holds %s; scale it to 0 and wait for the lease to lapse first", LeaderElectionID)
   }
   restored, left, err := legacyfold.RestoreMarkers(cmd.Context(), c, rns, wps)
   fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "restored %d; %d MediaFile(s) with status.markers still without a catalogarr-markers entry\n", restored, left)
   if err != nil {
    return err
   }
   if left > 0 {
    return errors.New("some MediaFiles were left without a catalogarr-markers entry; run it again before rolling back")
   }
   return nil
  },
 }
 restore.Flags().StringVar(&rns, "namespace", "clustarr-system", "the namespace to restore")
 restore.Flags().Float64Var(&wps, "writes-per-second", 25, "status writes per second")
 lf.AddCommand(report, restore)
 return lf
}

func leaseHeld(l *coordinationv1.Lease, now time.Time) bool {
 if l.Spec.HolderIdentity == nil || *l.Spec.HolderIdentity == "" || l.Spec.RenewTime == nil {
  return false
 }
 d := 60 * time.Second
 if l.Spec.LeaseDurationSeconds != nil {
  d = time.Duration(*l.Spec.LeaseDurationSeconds) * time.Second
 }
 return now.Before(l.Spec.RenewTime.Add(d))
}
```

  `busconn.Connect(url, name, opts...)` is W1.4's signature (returns the bus and the connection);
  use it as W5.7's `Run` does.

```go
  Spec: catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileSpec{Path: "/data/x.mkv", MediaRef: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindMovie, Name: "heat"}}}

 rec := &fakeRecorder{}
 proj := workerhistory.NewDLQProjector(workerhistory.DLQDeps{Client: c, Recorder: rec})
 name, data, err := schema.Encode(task.Task{File: schema.Ref{Namespace: "films", Name: "heat-file", UID: "u1"}, Seq: 7, Class: "cpu"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.NoError(t, proj.Handle(context.Background(), dead(t, &events.Envelope{Schema: name, Data: data}, "clustarr.work.transcode.task.p.cpu.u1")))
 var got catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.NoError(t, c.Get(context.Background(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(mf), &got))

func TestTheProjectorMayPatchExactlyTheKindsItAnnotates(t *testing.T) {
 src, err := os.ReadFile("dlq.go")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 re := regexp.MustCompile(`\+kubebuilder:rbac:groups=([^,]+),resources=([^,]+),verbs=patch\b`)
 got := map[string]bool{}
 for _, m := range re.FindAllStringSubmatch(string(src), -1) {
  if m[1] == "events.k8s.io" {
   continue
  }
  for _, r := range strings.Split(m[2], ";") {
   got[m[1]+"/"+r] = true
  }
 }

 }
 want["index.clustarr.io/indexers"], want["download.clustarr.io/downloads"] = true, true
 assert.Equal(t, want, got)
}
```

  3a. `target.go`: one resolver for the four v1 schemas, replacing whatever F5.4 and F6.5 left
  under those names (`resolveFetchTaskV1`, `resolveSubtitleEventV1`, the v1 `transcodeTaskRef`):

```go
// v1Ref is the one reference a previous-release payload of a folded kind
// carried: a SubtitleRequest (requestRef) or a TranscodeJob (jobRef, or job
// on a transcode.Task). Release N folded both kinds into MediaFile status
// (ADR-0016), so a v1 dead letter names no object any more: it resolves to
// its namespace, and the DLQ projector files a Warning Event there (loop
// spec §6.10, §7.3.9). F9.4 deletes it with the v1 decoders.
type v1Ref struct {
 RequestRef schema.Ref `json:"requestRef"`
 JobRef     schema.Ref `json:"jobRef"`
 Job        schema.Ref `json:"job"`
}

func resolveFoldedV1(key string, data []byte) Target {
 var p v1Ref
 if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &p); err == nil {
  for _, r := range []schema.Ref{p.RequestRef, p.JobRef, p.Job} {
   if r.Namespace != "" {
    return Target{Namespace: r.Namespace}
   }
  }
 }
 return Target{Namespace: namespaceOf(key)}
}
```

```go
 "subtitle.SubtitleEvent.v1": resolveFoldedV1,
 "transcode.JobEvent.v1":     resolveFoldedV1,
 "transcode.Task.v1":         resolveFoldedV1,
```

  `TestProjectMovieWithNoTranscodeJobDoesNotReachComplete` is replaced by:

```go
// TestCompleteNeedsATerminalTranscodeNotAJob: Complete no longer needs a job
// or a request (loop spec §7.7). A Skipped or Succeeded block, or a file
// already transcoded, completes once its subtitles are satisfied or not
// wanted -- and a Succeeded block stays, so retention no longer drops an item
// back to SubtitleDone. A video file with no transcode block yet (no profile
// has won it, or it waits beyond the window) is not complete. A failed
// transcode is a failure whatever the subtitles say.
func TestCompleteNeedsATerminalTranscodeNotAJob(t *testing.T) {
 movie := movieWith(t, ready(catalogv1.MovieConditionMetadataReady))
 succeeded := &catalogv1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded, ProfileTag: "hevc-mkv@abc"}
 require.Equal(t, pipeline.StageComplete, pipeline.Project(movie, withFile(subs(catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseSatisfied), succeeded)).Stage)
 require.Equal(t, pipeline.StageSubtitleDone, pipeline.Project(movie, withFile(subs(catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseSatisfied), nil)).Stage,
  "no transcode block: not complete")
 elsewhere := withFile(subs(catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseNotWanted), nil)
 elsewhere.MediaFile.Spec.Original = new(false)
 require.Equal(t, pipeline.StageComplete, pipeline.Project(movie, elsewhere).Stage, "a file already transcoded is final")
 require.Equal(t, pipeline.StageImported, pipeline.Project(movie, withFile(nil, nil)).Stage,
  "an unprobed video file has no subtitles block yet: imported, not complete")
 failed := pipeline.Project(movie, withFile(subs(catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseSatisfied),
  &catalogv1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1.TranscodePhaseFailed, Reason: "RetriesExhausted", Message: "encoder refused the source"}))
 require.Equal(t, pipeline.StageFailed, failed.Stage)
 require.Equal(t, "encoder refused the source", failed.Failure)
 running := pipeline.Project(movie, withPercent(withFile(subs(catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted), &catalogv1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1.TranscodePhaseRunning}), 42))
 require.Equal(t, int32(42), running.Percent)
}
```

```go
   Status: catalogv1.MediaFileStatus{Transcode: &catalogv1.TranscodeState{Phase: catalogv1.TranscodePhaseRunning}}},
  &catalogv1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "music", Name: "track-1", UID: "f2", CreationTimestamp: old},
   Spec: catalogv1.MediaFileSpec{MediaRef: commonv1.MediaRef{Kind: commonv1.MediaKindAlbum, Name: "kid-a"}}},
  &catalogv1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "music", Name: "track-2", UID: "f3", CreationTimestamp: young},

 idx.progress = func(_ context.Context, uid types.UID) (int32, bool, error) { return 42, uid == "f1", nil }

 ep2 := &catalogv1.Episode{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "tv", Name: "show-s01e02"}}
 rel := idx.Related(context.Background(), ep2)
```

  3b. `pkg/pipeline/project.go`: `failedJob`, `blockedSubtitle`, `activeJob`,
  `subtitlesSatisfied`, `fetchingSubtitle`, `foundSubtitle` and `searchingSubtitle` are replaced
  by:

```go
func transcodeOf(r Related) *catalogv1.TranscodeState {
 if r.MediaFile == nil {
  return nil
 }
 return r.MediaFile.Status.Transcode
}

func subtitlesOf(r Related) *catalogv1.SubtitlesStatus {
 if r.MediaFile == nil {
  return nil
 }
 return r.MediaFile.Status.Subtitles
}

func transcodeIs(r Related, phases ...catalogv1.TranscodePhase) bool {
 t := transcodeOf(r)
 return t != nil && slices.Contains(phases, t.Phase)
}

// transcodeDone: swapped, incorporated, or a file that is final (a live
// phase-less block with a profileTag reads as Succeeded, loop spec §2.5).
func transcodeDone(r Related) bool {
 if transcodeIs(r, catalogv1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, catalogv1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded) {
  return true
 }
 if t := transcodeOf(r); t != nil && t.Phase == "" && t.ProfileTag != "" {
  return true
 }
 return r.MediaFile != nil && r.MediaFile.Transcoded()
}

// transcodeSettled: the file's transcode is over -- Succeeded (a live
// phase-less block with a profileTag reads as Succeeded), Skipped, or the
// file is already final. A video file with no block yet (no profile won it,
// or it waits in the backlog beyond the window) is not settled: scenario
// 13's SubtitleDone leg depends on it (loop spec §7.8).
func transcodeSettled(r Related) bool {
 if transcodeIs(r, catalogv1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded, catalogv1.TranscodePhaseSkipped) {
  return true
 }
 if t := transcodeOf(r); t != nil && t.Phase == "" && t.ProfileTag != "" {
  return true
 }
 return r.MediaFile != nil && r.MediaFile.Transcoded()
}

func subtitlesIs(r Related, phases ...catalogv1.SubtitlesPhase) bool {
 s := subtitlesOf(r)
 return s != nil && slices.Contains(phases, s.Phase)
}

func subtitleOnDisk(r Related) bool {
 if !subtitlesIs(r, catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted, catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseSearching) {
  return false
 }
 for _, it := range subtitlesOf(r).Items {
  if it.State == catalogv1.SubtitleStateDownloaded || it.State == catalogv1.SubtitleStateUpgradable {
   return true
  }
 }
 return false
}
```

  and in `project`, the signal block and the switch's post-processing arms become:

```go
 subsDone := subtitlesIs(related, catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseSatisfied, catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseNotWanted)
 complete := imported && (!postProcessed || (subsDone && transcodeSettled(related)))
 ...
 case postProcessed && transcodeIs(related, catalogv1.TranscodePhaseFailed):
  t := transcodeOf(related)
  entry.Stage, entry.Failure = StageFailed, cmp.Or(t.Message, t.Reason)
  return entry
 ...
 case postProcessed && subtitlesIs(related, catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseBlocked):
  entry.Stage, entry.Failure = StageBlocked, "subtitles: "+subtitlesOf(related).Reason
  return entry
 case complete:
  entry.Stage, entry.Percent = StageComplete, 100
  return entry
 case postProcessed && transcodeIs(related, catalogv1.TranscodePhaseQueued, catalogv1.TranscodePhaseRunning):
  t := transcodeOf(related)
  entry.Stage = StageTranscoding
  if related.TranscodePercent != nil {
   entry.Percent = *related.TranscodePercent
  }
  if t.Plan != nil {
   entry.Detail = t.Plan.Encoder
  }
  if t.StartedAt != nil {
   entry.Since = t.StartedAt.Time
  }
  return entry
 case postProcessed && transcodeDone(related):
  entry.Stage, entry.Percent = StageTranscodeDone, 100
  return entry
 case postProcessed && subsDone:
  entry.Stage, entry.Percent = StageSubtitleDone, 100
  return entry
 case postProcessed && subtitleOnDisk(related):
  entry.Stage = StageSubtitleFound
  return entry
 case postProcessed && subtitlesIs(related, catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseWanted, catalogv1.SubtitlesPhaseSearching):
  entry.Stage = StageSubtitleSearching
  return entry
```

  (the arms for downloads, import, search and metadata are unchanged). `settledAt` reads the

  3c. `ui/projection/index.go`: `relatedIndex` loses `jobs`, `subtitles`, `mediaFiles` and
  `mediaFileOwner`, and gains

```go
 // files buckets every MediaFile under each item its spec.mediaRef names,
 // "<namespace>/<kind>/<name>" for mediaRef.name and every mediaRef.keys
 // entry, so a multi-episode file belongs to each of its Episodes.
 files  map[string][]*catalogv1.MediaFile
 byName map[types.NamespacedName]*catalogv1.MediaFile
 // progress reads a running transcode's percent; nil renders none.
 progress TranscodeProgressFunc
```

  `buildRelatedIndex` lists MediaFile, Download and Search only (three List calls), and fills
  `files` and `byName`. `Related` becomes:

```go
func (idx *relatedIndex) Related(ctx context.Context, item client.Object) pipeline.Related {
 r := pipeline.Related{Downloads: idx.downloads[item.GetUID()], Search: latestSearch(idx.searches[item.GetUID()]), MediaFile: idx.fileOf(item)}
 if mf := r.MediaFile; mf != nil && idx.progress != nil && mf.Status.Transcode != nil && mf.Status.Transcode.Phase == catalogv1.TranscodePhaseRunning {
  pctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)
  if pct, ok, err := idx.progress(pctx, mf.UID); err == nil && ok {
   r.TranscodePercent = &pct
  }
  cancel()
 }
 return r
}

func itemKey(ns string, kind commonv1.MediaKind, name string) string { return ns + "/" + string(kind) + "/" + name }

// fileOf is the file status.fileRef names (Movie, Episode, Book, Issue),
// else the newest file bucketed under the item.
func (idx *relatedIndex) fileOf(item client.Object) *catalogv1.MediaFile {
 var kind commonv1.MediaKind
 var ref *string
 switch o := item.(type) {
 case *catalogv1.Movie:
  kind, ref = commonv1.MediaKindMovie, o.Status.FileRef
 case *catalogv1.Episode:
  kind, ref = commonv1.MediaKindEpisode, o.Status.FileRef
 case *catalogv1.Book:
  kind, ref = commonv1.MediaKindBook, o.Status.FileRef
 case *catalogv1.Issue:
  kind, ref = commonv1.MediaKindIssue, o.Status.FileRef
 case *catalogv1.Album:
  kind = commonv1.MediaKindAlbum
 case *catalogv1.Audiobook:
  kind = commonv1.MediaKindAudiobook
 default:
  return nil
 }
 if ref != nil && *ref != "" {
  if mf := idx.byName[types.NamespacedName{Namespace: item.GetNamespace(), Name: *ref}]; mf != nil {
   return mf
  }
 }
 var newest *catalogv1.MediaFile
 for _, mf := range idx.files[itemKey(item.GetNamespace(), kind, item.GetName())] {
  if newest == nil || mf.CreationTimestamp.After(newest.CreationTimestamp.Time) {
   newest = mf
  }
 }
 return newest
}
```

  The type's doc comment loses the owner-reference paragraph about MediaFiles and jobs and says
  why `spec.mediaRef` is used: no production MediaFile has an owner reference, so
  `Related.MediaFile` was always nil and scenario 13's pipeline leg could never pass.

```go
 progressKV := bus.KV(events.BucketProgress)
 progress := func(ctx context.Context, uid types.UID) (int32, bool, error) {
  ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)
  defer cancel()
  e, err := progressKV.Get(ctx, "transcode."+events.KVKeyToken(string(uid)))
  if errors.Is(err, events.ErrKeyNotFound) {
   return 0, false, nil
  }
  if err != nil {
   return 0, false, err
  }
  var p schema.TranscodeProgress
  if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Value, &p); err != nil {
   return 0, false, err
  }
  return p.PercentMilli / 1000, true, nil
 }
```

```go
package guards

import (
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "regexp"
 "slices"
 "strings"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/test/installtest"
)

var foldedResources = []string{"subtitlerequests", "transcodejobs", "transcodejobs/finalizers", "transcodejobs/status",
 "audiografts", "audiografts/status"}

// TestReleaseNGrantsOnTheFoldedKinds holds loop spec §7.3.10: the only RBAC
// markers naming the three folded kinds are app/catalog/legacyfold's, and
// the roles generated from it grant exactly what the Migrator and the adopt
// planner need. Release N+1 deletes this test with the package (F9.1).
func TestReleaseNGrantsOnTheFoldedKinds(t *testing.T) {
 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 marker := regexp.MustCompile(`\+kubebuilder:rbac:groups=([^,]+),resources=([^,]+),verbs=(\S+)`)
 for path := range productionFiles(t, "app", "pkg", "internal", "cmd", "ui") {
  src, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
  require.NoError(t, err)
  for _, m := range marker.FindAllStringSubmatch(string(src), -1) {
   for _, r := range strings.Split(m[2], ";") {
    if slices.Contains(foldedResources, r) {
     assert.Equal(t, "app/catalog/legacyfold/rbac.go", path, "%s grants %s on %s; only the legacy fold may (loop spec §7.3.10)", path, m[3], r)
    }
   }
  }
 }
 want := map[string][]string{
  "subtitlerequests":         {"delete", "get", "list", "watch"},
  "transcodejobs":            {"delete", "get", "list", "update", "watch"},
  "transcodejobs/finalizers": {"update"},
  "audiografts":              {"delete", "get", "list", "watch"},
 }
 for _, role := range installtest.RBACRoles(t, root) {
  covers := slices.ContainsFunc(role.Paths, func(p string) bool { return installtest.PatternCovers(p, "app/catalog/legacyfold") })
  got := map[string][]string{}
  for _, rule := range installtest.ReadRole(t, root, role.File()).Rules {
   for _, r := range rule.Resources {
    if slices.Contains(foldedResources, r) {
     got[r] = append(got[r], rule.Verbs...)
     slices.Sort(got[r])
     got[r] = slices.Compact(got[r])
    }
   }
  }
  if covers {
   assert.Equal(t, want, got, "role %s (covers app/catalog/legacyfold)", role.Name)
  } else {
   assert.Empty(t, got, "role %s names a folded kind", role.Name)
  }
 }
}
```

```go
// TestKustomizationListsEveryGeneratedCRD: config/crd/kustomization.yaml is
// what `make install` and the e2e suite apply, so a CRD controller-gen writes
// but the kustomization omits is never installed (OverlayProfile was, M7).
func TestKustomizationListsEveryGeneratedCRD(t *testing.T) {
 raw, err := os.ReadFile("../kustomization.yaml")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var k struct{ Resources []string `json:"resources"` }
 require.NoError(t, yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &k))
 files, err := filepath.Glob("*.yaml")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var want []string
 for _, f := range files {
  want = append(want, "bases/"+f)
 }
 assert.ElementsMatch(t, want, k.Resources)
 assert.Len(t, k.Resources, len(crdbases.All()))
}
```

```go
// describeTranscode renders a MediaFile's status.transcode for a failure message.
func describeTranscode(key client.ObjectKey) func() string {
 return func() string {
  var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  if err := k8sClient.Get(context.Background(), key, &mf); err != nil {
   return fmt.Sprintf("MediaFile %s could not be read back: %v", key.Name, err)
  }
  tr := mf.Status.Transcode
  if tr == nil {
   return fmt.Sprintf("MediaFile %s has no status.transcode (spec.path=%s)", key.Name, mf.Spec.Path)
  }
  seq := int64(0)
  if tr.Dispatch != nil {
   seq = tr.Dispatch.Seq
  }
  return fmt.Sprintf("MediaFile %s transcode phase=%q reason=%q message=%q profile=%s@%s class=%s pool=%s worker=%s seq=%d attempts=%d suspended=%t path=%s",
   key.Name, tr.Phase, tr.Reason, tr.Message, tr.Profile, tr.ProfileHash, tr.Class, tr.Pool, tr.WorkerPod, seq, tr.Attempts, tr.Suspended, mf.Spec.Path)
 }
}

// waitForTranscodePhase polls until status.transcode.phase is one of want.
func waitForTranscodePhase(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, key client.ObjectKey, timeout time.Duration, want ...catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhase) catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile {
 t.Helper()
 var live catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 waitFor(t, ctx, timeout, fmt.Sprintf("MediaFile %s status.transcode.phase in %v", key.Name, want), func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  if err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, key, &live); err != nil {
   //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
   return false, nil
  }
  return live.Status.Transcode != nil && slices.Contains(want, live.Status.Transcode.Phase), nil
 }, describeTranscode(key))
 return live
}

// annotateMediaFile sets (value != "") or removes one annotation with a
// merge patch, as `kubectl annotate` does: the ui offers none of the intent
// annotations (loop spec §9 D18).
func annotateMediaFile(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, key client.ObjectKey, name, value string) {
 t.Helper()
 var v any = value
 if value == "" {
  v = nil
 }
 body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"metadata": map[string]any{"annotations": map[string]any{name: v}}})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 mf := &catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: key.Namespace, Name: key.Name}}
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.Patch(ctx, mf, client.RawPatch(types.MergePatchType, body), client.FieldOwner("kubectl")))
}
```

```go
// TestTranscodeMediaFileThroughItsStatus is scenario 12 after ADR-0016: the
// file's own status.transcode carries the plan, the admission fields, the
// dispatch and the swap; the suspend annotation holds and releases it; a
// profile edit rehashes and re-transcodes nothing.
func TestTranscodeMediaFileThroughItsStatus(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), scenarioTimeout)
 defer cancel()

 rf := newRootFolder(ctx, t, "e2e-tc-rf", catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderKindMovie, "movies")
 filePath := path.Join(rf.Spec.Path, transcodeMovieFolder, transcodeMovieFile)
 plantMedia(t, hostPath(filePath))
 runScan(ctx, t, rf, catalogv1alpha1.ScanModeFull)
 files := waitForMediaFileCount(ctx, t, rf.Spec.Path, 1)
 mfKey := client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&files[0])
 mf := waitForMediaFileProbed(ctx, t, mfKey)
 require.Equal(t, int32(2160), mf.Spec.Quality.Resolution)
 require.Equal(t, commonv1.SourceWebDL, mf.Spec.Quality.Source)
 originalSizeBytes := mf.Spec.SizeBytes
 movieName := mf.Spec.MediaRef.Name
 cleanupUnlessFailed(t, func() {
  _ = k8sClient.Delete(context.Background(), &catalogv1alpha1.Movie{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: movieName, Namespace: Namespace}})
 })

 // Suspended before a profile wins the file: planned, in the window, never dispatched.
 annotateMediaFile(ctx, t, mfKey, catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend, "true")
 tp := newTranscodeProfile(ctx, t, "e2e-tc-profile", 2160, commonv1.SourceWebDL, transcodev1alpha1.ContainerMKV)
 planned := waitForTranscodePhase(ctx, t, mfKey, transcodeJobPlannedTimeout, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhasePlanned)
 tr := planned.Status.Transcode
 require.True(t, tr.Suspended, "the suspend annotation is in force")
 require.Equal(t, "Suspended", tr.Reason)
 require.Equal(t, tp.Name, tr.Profile)
 require.Equal(t, tp.Status.Hash, tr.ProfileHash, "the block is planned under the profile's status.hash")
 require.NotNil(t, tr.Plan)
 require.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodeModeTranscode, tr.Plan.Mode, "an h264 source is a real encode")
 require.NotEmpty(t, tr.Plan.PlanHash)
 require.NotNil(t, tr.PlannedAt)
 require.Nil(t, tr.Dispatch, "a suspended file is never dispatched")

 // Released: admission grants the slot and the pool resumes from zero.
 annotateMediaFile(ctx, t, mfKey, catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationTranscodeSuspend, "")
 running := waitForTranscodePhase(ctx, t, mfKey, transcodeJobSucceededTimeout,
  catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded)
 require.NotNil(t, running.Status.Transcode.Dispatch)
 require.NotEmpty(t, running.Status.Transcode.Pool, "the dispatch names its pool Job")
 poolKey := types.NamespacedName{Namespace: Namespace, Name: running.Status.Transcode.Pool}
 var poolJob batchv1.Job
 waitFor(t, ctx, poolResumedTimeout, "pool "+poolKey.Name+" resumed from zero", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  if err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, poolKey, &poolJob); err != nil {
   //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
   return false, nil
  }
  return !ptr.Deref(poolJob.Spec.Suspend, true), nil
 })
 assert.False(t, ptr.Deref(poolJob.Spec.Template.Spec.AutomountServiceAccountToken, true), "a pool pod carries no ServiceAccount token")

 succeeded := waitForTranscodePhase(ctx, t, mfKey, transcodeJobSucceededTimeout+transcodeSwapIncorporatedTimeout, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded)
 st := succeeded.Status.Transcode
 require.True(t, st.Compliant)
 require.Equal(t, tp.Name+"@"+tp.Status.Hash, st.ProfileTag, "the tag comes from the dispatched hash")
 require.Equal(t, "hevc", succeeded.Status.MediaInfo.VideoCodec)
 require.EqualValues(t, 8, succeeded.Status.MediaInfo.VideoBitDepth)
 require.Equal(t, st.ProfileTag, succeeded.Status.MediaInfo.TranscodeProfile)
 require.True(t, succeeded.Transcoded())
 wantOutput := strings.TrimSuffix(filePath, path.Ext(filePath)) + ".mp4"
 require.Equal(t, wantOutput, succeeded.Spec.Path, "every output is <stem>.mp4: catalogarr takes over spec.path")
 require.NotEqual(t, originalSizeBytes, succeeded.Spec.SizeBytes)

 waitFor(t, ctx, poolSuspendedTimeout, "pool "+poolKey.Name+" suspended after its only task", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  if err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, poolKey, &poolJob); err != nil {
   //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
   return false, nil
  }
  return ptr.Deref(poolJob.Spec.Suspend, false), nil
 })
 recycled := hostPath(path.Join(defaultRecycleBinLogical, time.Now().UTC().Format("2006-01-02"), transcodeMovieFile))
 waitFor(t, ctx, recycledOriginalTimeout, "recycled original at "+recycled, func(context.Context) (bool, error) {
  info, err := os.Stat(recycled)
  //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
  return err == nil && info.Size() == originalSizeBytes, nil
 })

 // A profile edit rehashes; a transcoded file is final, so nothing is dispatched again.
 seq := st.Dispatch.Seq
 var live transcodev1alpha1.TranscodeProfile
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(tp), &live))
 oldHash := live.Status.Hash
 live.Spec.Quality = ptr.To[int32](30)
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.Update(ctx, &live))
 waitFor(t, ctx, transcodeProfileReadyTimeout, "TranscodeProfile "+tp.Name+" rehashed", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  if err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(tp), &live); err != nil {
   //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
   return false, nil
  }
  return live.Status.Hash != "" && live.Status.Hash != oldHash, nil
 }, describeTranscodeProfile(client.ObjectKeyFromObject(tp)))
 time.Sleep(30 * time.Second)
 var after catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.Get(ctx, mfKey, &after))
 require.NotNil(t, after.Status.Transcode)
 require.Equal(t, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded, after.Status.Transcode.Phase, describeTranscode(mfKey)())
 require.Equal(t, seq, after.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.Seq, "a new hash re-transcodes nothing")

 base, stopPF := portForwardService(ctx, t, "ui", uiServicePort)
 defer stopPF()
 pageClient := &http.Client{Timeout: 15 * time.Second}
 ref := types.NamespacedName{Namespace: Namespace, Name: movieName}
 waitFor(t, ctx, uiPageWaitTimeout, "GET /pipeline shows Movie "+movieName+" past the transcode stage", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  body, status, err := httpGetString(ctx, pageClient, base+"/pipeline")
  if err != nil || status != http.StatusOK {
   //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
   return false, nil
  }
  stage, ok := pipelineRowStage(body, commonv1.MediaKindMovie, ref)
  return ok && (pipeline.Stage(stage) == pipeline.StageTranscodeDone || pipeline.Stage(stage) == pipeline.StageComplete), nil
 })
}
```

  1c. `test/e2e/subtitle_test.go`: `describeSubtitleRequest` becomes `describeSubtitles`;
  `subtitleItem` becomes `subtitleItemOf` over the new item type; `itemDownloaded` reads `Name`:

```go
func subtitleItemOf(mf *catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile, langKey string) *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus {
 if mf.Status.Subtitles == nil {
  return nil
 }
 for i := range mf.Status.Subtitles.Items {
  if mf.Status.Subtitles.Items[i].LangKey == langKey {
   return &mf.Status.Subtitles.Items[i]
  }
 }
 return nil
}

// describeSubtitles renders a MediaFile's status.subtitles for a failure message.
func describeSubtitles(key client.ObjectKey) func() string {
 return func() string {
  var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  if err := k8sClient.Get(context.Background(), key, &mf); err != nil {
   return fmt.Sprintf("MediaFile %s could not be read back: %v", key.Name, err)
  }
  s := mf.Status.Subtitles
  if s == nil {
   return fmt.Sprintf("MediaFile %s has no status.subtitles", key.Name)
  }
  out := fmt.Sprintf("MediaFile %s subtitles phase=%q reason=%q profile=%q probeHash=%q wanted=%v", key.Name, s.Phase, s.Reason, s.Profile, s.ProbeHash, s.Wanted)
  for _, it := range s.Items {
   out += fmt.Sprintf("\n    item langKey=%q state=%q score=%d/%d provider=%q name=%q lastError=%q", it.LangKey, it.State, it.Score, it.ScoreOutOf, it.Provider, it.Name, it.LastError)
  }
  return out
 }
}

func itemDownloaded(it *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus) bool {
 return it != nil && it.State == catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleStateDownloaded && it.Name != ""
}
```

```go
// TestForcedSubtitleSearchAnnotation: subtitle.clustarr.io/search=<nonce>
// forces one search now, whatever the backoff, and is recorded in
// status.handledNonces.subtitleSearch so the same nonce never searches twice
// (loop spec §6.5, §2.9).
func TestForcedSubtitleSearchAnnotation(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), scenarioTimeout)
 defer cancel()
 setOpenSubtitlesMode(ctx, t, opensubtitlesstub.ModeOK)
 rf := newRootFolder(ctx, t, "e2e-subforce-rf", catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderKindMovie, "movies")
 filePath := path.Join(rf.Spec.Path, subtitleMovieFolder+" force", subtitleMovieFile)
 plantMedia(t, hostPath(filePath))
 runScan(ctx, t, rf, catalogv1alpha1.ScanModeFull)
 mf := waitForMediaFileProbed(ctx, t, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&waitForMediaFileCount(ctx, t, rf.Spec.Path, 1)[0]))
 mfKey := client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&mf)
 newSubtitleFixtures(ctx, t, "e2e-subforce", []subtitlev1alpha1.LanguageItem{{Key: "en", Language: "en"}})
 waitFor(t, ctx, subtitleFetchTimeout, "en downloaded", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  var live catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
  return k8sClient.Get(ctx, mfKey, &live) == nil && itemDownloaded(subtitleItemOf(&live, "en")), nil
 }, describeSubtitles(mfKey))

 t0 := time.Now()
 nonce := strconv.FormatInt(t0.Unix(), 10)
 annotateMediaFile(ctx, t, mfKey, catalogv1alpha1.AnnotationSubtitleSearch, nonce)
 waitFor(t, ctx, subtitleFetchTimeout, "the nonce is handled", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  var live catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  if err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, mfKey, &live); err != nil {
   //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
   return false, nil
  }
  return live.Status.HandledNonces != nil && live.Status.HandledNonces.SubtitleSearch == nonce, nil
 }, describeSubtitles(mfKey))
 waitFor(t, ctx, subtitleFetchTimeout, "the forced search reached the provider", func(context.Context) (bool, error) {
  return len(readOpenSubtitlesRequestsSince(t, t0)) > 0, nil
 })
 n := len(readOpenSubtitlesRequestsSince(t, t0))
 annotateMediaFile(ctx, t, mfKey, "test.clustarr.io/wake", nonce) // any other change wakes the file
 time.Sleep(30 * time.Second)
 assert.Equal(t, n, len(readOpenSubtitlesRequestsSince(t, t0)), "a handled nonce never searches again")
}
```

  1e. `test/e2e/legacyfold_test.go` (release N only; F9.1 deletes it):

```go
//go:build e2e

package e2e

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "path"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured"
 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/types"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/events"
)

// TestLegacyFoldAdoptsThenDeletes is release N's adoption end to end, the
// legacy objects made through the dynamic client as the previous release
// left them: a SubtitleRequest at count 5 with its next search an hour out,
// a Succeeded TranscodeJob whose swap the previous release never
// incorporated (finishedAt after probedAt, over a real output), and an open
// TranscodeJob behind the withdrawal finalizer. config/e2e runs the manager
// with --legacy-fold-retain=0s (W6.15), so adoption is followed by deletion.
func TestLegacyFoldAdoptsThenDeletes(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), scenarioTimeout)
 defer cancel()
 rf := newRootFolder(ctx, t, "e2e-fold-rf", catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderKindMovie, "movies")
 src := path.Join(rf.Spec.Path, "Fixture Fold Movie (2019) {tmdb-27205}", "Fixture.Fold.Movie.2019.2160p.WEB-DL.x264-CLUSTARR.mkv")
 plantMedia(t, hostPath(src))
 runScan(ctx, t, rf, catalogv1alpha1.ScanModeFull)
 mf := waitForMediaFileProbed(ctx, t, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&waitForMediaFileCount(ctx, t, rf.Spec.Path, 1)[0]))
 mfKey := client.ObjectKeyFromObject(&mf)
 output := src[:len(src)-len(".mkv")] + ".mp4"
 plantMedia(t, hostPath(output)) // the swap a previous-release worker made: a real file at the output path

 next := time.Now().Add(time.Hour).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
 finished := mf.Status.ProbedAt.Add(time.Minute).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
 sr := createLegacy(ctx, t, "subtitle.clustarr.io", "SubtitleRequest", mf.Name, map[string]any{"mediaFileRef": mf.Name, "profileRef": "english"},
  map[string]any{"probeHash": mf.Status.ProbeHash, "items": []any{map[string]any{"langKey": "es", "state": "pending",
   "attempts": map[string]any{"count": 5}, "nextSearchAt": next, "lastError": "every eligible provider is throttled"}}}, nil)
 swap := createLegacy(ctx, t, "transcode.clustarr.io", "TranscodeJob", mf.Name+"-swap", map[string]any{"mediaFileRef": mf.Name,
  "profileRef": "hevc-mkv", "sourcePath": src},
  map[string]any{"phase": "Succeeded", "finishedAt": finished, "result": map[string]any{"outputPath": output, "outputSizeBytes": len(sampleClip(t)),
   "mediaInfo": map[string]any{"transcodeProfile": "hevc-mkv@c5a056785c9e2ecf2c96152440cba662cedc16b67cba7f69f08350d486e8a8db"}}}, nil)
 open := createLegacy(ctx, t, "transcode.clustarr.io", "TranscodeJob", mf.Name+"-open", map[string]any{"mediaFileRef": mf.Name,
  "profileRef": "hevc-mkv", "sourcePath": src}, map[string]any{"phase": "Planned"}, []string{"squasharr.clustarr.io/task-withdrawal"})

 var adopted catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 waitFor(t, ctx, 3*time.Minute, "the loop adopts all three", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  if err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, mfKey, &adopted); err != nil {
   //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
   return false, nil
  }
  return adopted.Status.LegacyFold != nil && len(adopted.Status.LegacyFold.Adopted) == 3, nil
 }, describeMediaFile(mfKey))
 var es *catalogv1alpha1.SubtitleItemStatus
 for i := range adopted.Status.Subtitles.Items {
  if adopted.Status.Subtitles.Items[i].LangKey == "es" {
   es = &adopted.Status.Subtitles.Items[i]
  }
 }
 require.NotNil(t, es, "the copied item is in status.subtitles")
 require.Equal(t, int32(5), es.Attempts.Count)
 require.Equal(t, "every eligible provider is throttled", es.LastError)

 swapped := waitForTranscodePhase(ctx, t, mfKey, transcodeSwapIncorporatedTimeout, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded)
 require.Equal(t, output, swapped.Spec.Path, "the pending swap is incorporated: spec.path follows it")

 leases := natsKVGet(ctx, t, events.BucketTranscodeLeases, events.TranscodeLeaseKey(string(open.GetUID())))
 require.Contains(t, string(leases), `"state":"cancelled"`, "the open job's task was withdrawn")

 for _, obj := range []*unstructured.Unstructured{sr, swap, open} {
  waitFor(t, ctx, 3*time.Minute, "retain=0s deletes "+obj.GetKind()+" "+obj.GetName(), func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
   u := &unstructured.Unstructured{}
   u.SetGroupVersionKind(obj.GroupVersionKind())
   err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(obj), u)
   return err != nil, nil
  })
 }
}

// createLegacy creates one previous-release object through the
// unstructured client (the typed client would send zero values the
// previous release never wrote) and sets its status.
func createLegacy(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, group, kind, name string, spec, status map[string]any, finalizers []string) *unstructured.Unstructured {
 t.Helper()
 u := &unstructured.Unstructured{Object: map[string]any{"apiVersion": group + "/v1alpha1", "kind": kind,
  "metadata": map[string]any{"name": name, "namespace": Namespace}, "spec": spec}}
 if finalizers != nil {
  u.SetFinalizers(finalizers)
 }
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.Create(ctx, u))
 u.Object["status"] = status
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.Status().Update(ctx, u))
 cleanupUnlessFailed(t, func() {
  u.SetFinalizers(nil)
  _ = k8sClient.Update(context.Background(), u)
  _ = k8sClient.Delete(context.Background(), u)
 })
 return u
}
```

  `natsKVGet` is a new helper in `helpers_test.go`, read-only, over the port-forward the suite
  already uses for every ClusterIP Service (the NATS Service is `nats`, `config/nats/service.yaml`):

```go
// natsKVGet reads one key of a JetStream KV bucket through a port-forward
// to svc/nats: the test process cannot reach NATS otherwise. Read-only.
func natsKVGet(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, bucket, key string) []byte {
 t.Helper()
 base, stop := portForwardService(ctx, t, "nats", 4222)
 defer stop()
 nc, err := nats.Connect("nats://" + strings.TrimPrefix(base, "http://"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 defer nc.Close()
 js, err := jetstream.New(nc)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 kv, err := js.KeyValue(ctx, bucket)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 e, err := kv.Get(ctx, key)
 require.NoError(t, err, "%s/%s", bucket, key)
 return e.Value()
}
```

  (`github.com/nats-io/nats.go` and `github.com/nats-io/nats.go/jetstream`, both already in
  `go.mod`. Drop `encoding/json`, `metav1` and `types` from `legacyfold_test.go`'s imports if
  the final file does not use them.)

```dockerfile
RUN ffmpeg -v error -i /out/tiny.mkv -map 0 -c copy -metadata:s:a:0 language=jpn /out/donor-jpn.mkv
```

```go
//go:build e2e

package e2e

import (
 "context"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 commonv1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/common/v1alpha1"
 downloadv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/download/v1alpha1"
 transcodev1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/transcode/v1alpha1"
)

// TestAGraftRidesAFilesTranscode: an item missing Japanese audio, whose
// profile grafts, gets a donor through a Download with purpose audioDonor;
// the transcode of its file carries the graft (status.transcode.joinedGraft),
// the file's status.graft reads Running/JoinedTranscode, then Succeeded, and
// status.graftTag lands with the re-probe (loop spec §2.6, §5.13).
func TestAGraftRidesAFilesTranscode(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), scenarioTimeout)
 defer cancel()
 requireFixtureService(ctx, t, "seeder")
 requireFixtureService(ctx, t, "seeder-donor")

 qp := newRankedQualityProfile(ctx, t, "e2e-graft-qp", []tier{{name: "Bluray1080", qualities: []string{"Bluray-1080p"}}})
 var live catalogv1alpha1.QualityProfile
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(qp), &live))
 live.Spec.Audio = &catalogv1alpha1.AudioPolicy{Languages: []string{"en", "ja"}, Graft: true}
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.Update(ctx, &live))

 rf := newRootFolder(ctx, t, "e2e-graft-rf", catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderKindMovie, "movies")
 movie := newMovie(ctx, t, "e2e-graft-movie", fixtureTmdbID, qp.Name, rf.Name, catalogv1alpha1.MinimumAvailabilityAnnounced)
 settled := waitForMovieSettled(ctx, t, movie, "Inception")
 newTorrentDownloadClientE2E(ctx, t, "e2e-graft-dc")
 dl := newTorrentDownloadE2E(ctx, t, "e2e-graft-dl", &settled, "http://seeder."+Namespace+".svc/fixture.torrent", "guid-graft-1", qp.Name)
 waitForDownloadPhaseAtLeast(ctx, t, dl, downloadCompleteTimeout, downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPhaseCompleted)
 imp := waitForImportOutcome(ctx, t, dl, importAttemptTimeout)
 mfKey := client.ObjectKey{Namespace: Namespace, Name: imp.Imported[0].MediaFileRef}
 waitForMediaFileProbed(ctx, t, mfKey)

 waitFor(t, ctx, 2*time.Minute, "the movie reads ja missing", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  var m catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
  return k8sClient.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(movie), &m) == nil && m.Status.Audio != nil && len(m.Status.Audio.Missing) > 0, nil
 })
 newTorrentDownloadWithPurpose(ctx, t, "e2e-graft-donor", &settled, "http://seeder-donor."+Namespace+".svc/fixture.torrent",
  "guid-graft-donor", qp.Name, downloadv1alpha1.DownloadPurposeAudioDonor)
 waitFor(t, ctx, downloadCompleteTimeout+importAttemptTimeout, "the movie carries its donor", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  var m catalogv1alpha1.Movie
  //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
  return k8sClient.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(movie), &m) == nil && m.Status.Audio != nil && m.Status.Audio.Donor != nil, nil
 })

 newTranscodeProfile(ctx, t, "e2e-graft-profile", 1080, commonv1.SourceBluray, transcodev1alpha1.ContainerMKV)
 running := waitForTranscodePhase(ctx, t, mfKey, transcodeJobSucceededTimeout, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseRunning,
  catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSwapping, catalogv1alpha1.TranscodePhaseSucceeded)
 require.NotNil(t, running.Status.Transcode.JoinedGraft, "the transcode carries the graft")
 require.Equal(t, []string{"ja"}, running.Status.Transcode.JoinedGraft.Languages)

 var done catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 waitFor(t, ctx, transcodeJobSucceededTimeout+transcodeSwapIncorporatedTimeout, "the graft rode the transcode", func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
  if err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, mfKey, &done); err != nil {
   //nolint:nilerr // keep polling
   return false, nil
  }
  return done.Status.Graft != nil && done.Status.Graft.Phase == catalogv1alpha1.GraftPhaseSucceeded && done.Status.GraftTag != "", nil
 }, describeTranscode(mfKey))
 require.Equal(t, done.Status.Transcode.Dispatch.Seq, done.Status.Graft.JoinedTranscodeSeq, "the graft rode the transcode dispatch that swapped the file")
 var langs []string
 for _, a := range done.Status.MediaInfo.Audio {
  langs = append(langs, a.Language)
 }
 require.Contains(t, langs, "jpn", "the re-probe reads the grafted Japanese track")
}
```

  In `helpers_test.go`, `newTorrentDownloadE2E`'s body moves into

  1g. `test/e2e/upgrade_test.go` (tag `e2eupgrade`; loop §7.3.12: deploy the previous
  release, populate it, follow §7.5 into hold and then apply, follow §7.6 back, and diff
  MediaFile status and managedFields at each step; run by Phase H on a throwaway kind cluster):

```go
//go:build e2e && e2eupgrade

package e2e

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "os/exec"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
)

// TestUpgradeToReleaseNAndRollBack drives the release-N runbook (loop spec
// §7.5) and the rollback (§7.6) on a throwaway kind cluster. It refuses
// kind-cluster-plex: that cluster is the owner's, and every action there
// waits for the owner's OK.
//
// Inputs: CLUSTARR_UPGRADE_PREVIOUS_CHART (the previous commit's chart, from
// `git archive`), CLUSTARR_UPGRADE_PREVIOUS_VALUES and CLUSTARR_UPGRADE_N_VALUES
// (fresh values files: never --reuse-values), CLUSTARR_UPGRADE_PREVIOUS_CRDS
// (the previous commit's config/crd/bases, saved as §7.5 step 0 does), and
// bin/manager built from N.
func TestUpgradeToReleaseNAndRollBack(t *testing.T) {
 ctxName := strings.TrimSpace(upgradeRun(t, "kubectl", "config", "current-context"))
 require.NotContains(t, ctxName, "cluster-plex", "never against kind-cluster-plex")
 require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(ctxName, "kind-"), "a throwaway kind cluster only, not %q", ctxName)
 prevChart, prevValues, nValues, prevCRDs := upgradeInput(t, "CLUSTARR_UPGRADE_PREVIOUS_CHART"), upgradeInput(t, "CLUSTARR_UPGRADE_PREVIOUS_VALUES"),
  upgradeInput(t, "CLUSTARR_UPGRADE_N_VALUES"), upgradeInput(t, "CLUSTARR_UPGRADE_PREVIOUS_CRDS")
 ctx := context.Background()
 ns := Namespace

 // The previous release, populated from the e2e fixtures.
 upgradeRun(t, "kubectl", "apply", "--server-side", "-f", prevCRDs)
 upgradeRun(t, "helm", "upgrade", "--install", "clustarr", prevChart, "-n", ns, "-f", prevValues, "--wait", "--timeout", "15m")
 upgradePopulate(ctx, t) // a scan of the fixture library: MediaFiles, SubtitleRequests and TranscodeJobs
 before := upgradeSnapshot(ctx, t)

 // §7.5 steps 1, 6-10: report, drain, stop the old writers, N's CRDs, deploy in hold with zero slots.
 report := upgradeRun(t, "bin/manager", "legacy-fold", "report", "--namespace", ns, "-o", "json")
 require.Contains(t, report, `"renderChanges": 0`, "the first render must not change markers or mediaInfo")
 upgradeRun(t, "kubectl", "-n", ns, "scale", "deploy", "--all", "--replicas=0")
 upgradeRun(t, "kubectl", "apply", "--server-side", "--force-conflicts", "-f", "config/crd/bases/")
 upgradeRun(t, "helm", "upgrade", "clustarr", "charts/clustarr", "-n", ns, "-f", nValues, "--set", "manager.legacyFold.mode=hold",
  "--set", "manager.slots=cpu=0\\,intel=0\\,nvidia=0", "--wait", "--timeout", "15m")
 held := upgradeWaitStable(ctx, t)
 upgradeDiff(t, before, held, "hold: no legacy object adopted or deleted; markers and mediaInfo unchanged")

 // §7.5 steps 11-12: apply.
 upgradeRun(t, "helm", "upgrade", "clustarr", "charts/clustarr", "-n", ns, "-f", nValues, "--set", "manager.legacyFold.mode=apply",
  "--set", "manager.slots=cpu=0\\,intel=0\\,nvidia=0", "--wait", "--timeout", "15m")
 applied := upgradeWaitStable(ctx, t)
 upgradeDiff(t, before, applied, "apply: markers and mediaInfo unchanged; adoption recorded")

 // §7.6: stop N, restore markers, revert the CRDs, roll back.
 upgradeRun(t, "kubectl", "-n", ns, "scale", "deploy", "--all", "--replicas=0")
 upgradeRun(t, "bin/manager", "legacy-fold", "restore-markers", "--namespace", ns)
 upgradeRun(t, "kubectl", "apply", "--server-side", "--force-conflicts", "-f", prevCRDs)
 upgradeRun(t, "helm", "rollback", "clustarr", "-n", ns, "--wait", "--timeout", "15m")
 rolled := upgradeWaitStable(ctx, t)
 upgradeDiff(t, before, rolled, "rollback: status.markers kept on every file")
}

func upgradeInput(t *testing.T, name string) string {
 t.Helper()
 v := os.Getenv(name)
 if v == "" {
  t.Skipf("%s is unset: the upgrade scenario needs the previous release's chart, values and CRDs", name)
 }
 return v
}

func upgradeRun(t *testing.T, name string, args ...string) string {
 t.Helper()
 out, err := exec.Command(name, args...).CombinedOutput()
 require.NoError(t, err, "%s %s\n%s", name, strings.Join(args, " "), out)
 return string(out)
}

// fileState is what the scenario diffs: each MediaFile's markers, mediaInfo
// and the managers that own its status.
type fileState struct {
 Markers, MediaInfo string
 Managers           []string
}

func upgradeSnapshot(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T) map[string]fileState {
 t.Helper()
 var list catalogv1alpha1.MediaFileList
 require.NoError(t, k8sClient.List(ctx, &list))
 out := map[string]fileState{}
 for _, mf := range list.Items {
  m, _ := json.Marshal(mf.Status.Markers)
  mi, _ := json.Marshal(mf.Status.MediaInfo)
  var managers []string
  for _, e := range mf.ManagedFields {
   if e.Subresource == "status" {
    managers = append(managers, e.Manager)
   }
  }
  out[mf.Name] = fileState{Markers: string(m), MediaInfo: string(mi), Managers: managers}
 }
 return out
}

// waitStable waits until two snapshots a minute apart agree.
func upgradeWaitStable(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T) map[string]fileState {
 t.Helper()
 prev := upgradeSnapshot(ctx, t)
 for range 30 {
  time.Sleep(time.Minute)
  cur := upgradeSnapshot(ctx, t)
  same := len(cur) == len(prev)
  for k, v := range cur {
   same = same && prev[k].Markers == v.Markers && prev[k].MediaInfo == v.MediaInfo
  }
  if same {
   return cur
  }
  prev = cur
 }
 t.Fatal("MediaFile status did not settle within 30 minutes")
 return nil
}

func upgradeDiff(t *testing.T, before, after map[string]fileState, what string) {
 t.Helper()
 for name, b := range before {
  a, ok := after[name]
  require.True(t, ok, "%s: MediaFile %s is gone", what, name)
  require.Equal(t, b.Markers, a.Markers, "%s: %s status.markers changed", what, name)
  require.Equal(t, b.MediaInfo, a.MediaInfo, "%s: %s status.mediaInfo changed", what, name)
  t.Logf("%s: %s status managers %v -> %v", what, name, b.Managers, a.Managers)
 }
}

// populate scans the fixture library into the previous release: it reuses
// the suite's RootFolder and scan helpers on the fixture movies.
func upgradePopulate(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T) {
 t.Helper()
 rf := newRootFolder(ctx, t, "e2e-upgrade-rf", catalogv1alpha1.RootFolderKindMovie, "movies")
 plantMedia(t, hostPath(rf.Spec.Path+"/Fixture Upgrade Movie (2019) {tmdb-27205}/Fixture.Upgrade.Movie.2019.1080p.BluRay.x264-CLUSTARR.mkv"))
 runScan(ctx, t, rf, catalogv1alpha1.ScanModeFull)
 waitForMediaFileCount(ctx, t, rf.Spec.Path, 1)
}
```

### Task F8.10: `test(guards)`: only `app/catalog/legacyfold` names SubtitleRequest, TranscodeJob or AudioGraft

**Spec:** loop §7.3.12 last bullet (`TestOnlyLegacyFoldNamesTheFoldedKinds`, the AST walk and
the role half, verbatim), §7.3.8 (`TestOnlyLegacyFoldAppliesAsCatalogarrMarkers`, "holds this to
one call site; N+1 deletes it"), §7.4 ("this guard makes N+1 a deletion of one package plus the
types"); loop §8.6 F8.10.

**Files:**

- Create: `test/guards/legacyfold_test.go`

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: W5.15 (`productionFiles`, `importAlias`, `mod`), W5.4 (`installtest.{RepoRoot,
  RBACRoles, PatternCovers, ReadRole}`), F8.7 (the ui role names neither kind), F8.8 (no other
  marker names them).
- Produces: `TestOnlyLegacyFoldNamesTheFoldedKinds`, `TestOnlyLegacyFoldAppliesAsCatalogarrMarkers`.

**Why the walk resolves imports.** A selector named only by its identifier would flag
`QualityProfile`'s own `AudioGraft` bool (`pkg/decision/audiopolicy.go:159`,
`pkg/quality/profile.go:398`) and a struct field called `TranscodeJob` anywhere. The guard
matches `X.Sel` only when `X` is the file's import name for `api/subtitle/v1alpha1` or
`api/transcode/v1alpha1`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the test.** `test/guards/legacyfold_test.go`:

```go
package guards

import (
 "go/ast"
 "go/token"
 "path/filepath"
 "slices"
 "strconv"
 "strings"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/test/installtest"
)

// foldedSelectors are the folded kinds' Go names (loop spec §7.3.12).
var foldedSelectors = map[string]bool{
 "SubtitleRequest": true, "SubtitleRequestList": true, "TranscodeJob": true, "TranscodeJobList": true,
 "AudioGraft": true, "AudioGraftList": true, "GraftResult": true,
}

var foldedAPIs = map[string]string{
 mod + "api/subtitle/v1alpha1":  "v1alpha1",
 mod + "api/transcode/v1alpha1": "v1alpha1",
}

// legacyFoldHomes are the only directories release N lets name the folded
// kinds; N+1 deletes both, then the types (F9.1, F9.2).
var legacyFoldHomes = []string{"app/catalog/legacyfold", "app/remediation/adopt"}

// TestOnlyLegacyFoldNamesTheFoldedKinds is loop spec §7.3.12's guard: outside
// api/, no non-test Go names SubtitleRequest, TranscodeJob, AudioGraft, their
// Lists or GraftResult except the legacy fold; and no RBAC role but the one
// generated from app/catalog/legacyfold names the three resources.
func TestOnlyLegacyFoldNamesTheFoldedKinds(t *testing.T) {
 for path, f := range productionFiles(t, "app", "pkg", "internal", "cmd", "ui", "test", "hack") {
  dir := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(path))
  if slices.Contains(legacyFoldHomes, dir) {
   continue
  }
  aliases := map[string]bool{}
  for imp, name := range foldedAPIs {
   if a := importAlias(f, imp, name); a != "" && a != "_" {
    aliases[a] = true
   }
  }
  if len(aliases) == 0 {
   continue
  }
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   sel, ok := n.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
   if !ok || !foldedSelectors[sel.Sel.Name] {
    return true
   }
   if x, ok := sel.X.(*ast.Ident); ok && aliases[x.Name] {
    t.Errorf("%s names %s.%s: only %v may (loop spec §7.3.12)", path, x.Name, sel.Sel.Name, legacyFoldHomes)
   }
   return true
  })
 }

 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 allowed := map[string]bool{}
 for _, role := range installtest.RBACRoles(t, root) {
  if slices.ContainsFunc(role.Paths, func(p string) bool { return installtest.PatternCovers(p, "app/catalog/legacyfold") }) {
   allowed[role.File()] = true
  }
 }
 require.NotEmpty(t, allowed, "some generated role must cover app/catalog/legacyfold")
 files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, "config", "rbac", "*_role.yaml"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 for _, path := range files {
  name := filepath.Base(path)
  if allowed[name] {
   continue
  }
  for _, rule := range installtest.ReadRole(t, root, name).Rules {
   for _, r := range rule.Resources {
    base := strings.SplitN(r, "/", 2)[0]
    assert.NotContains(t, []string{"subtitlerequests", "transcodejobs", "audiografts"}, base,
     "config/rbac/%s grants %v on %s; only the legacy fold's role may", name, rule.Verbs, r)
   }
  }
 }
}

// TestOnlyLegacyFoldAppliesAsCatalogarrMarkers holds §7.3.8's release and
// restore-markers' apply to app/catalog/legacyfold: no other non-test Go
// names k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMarkers or the "catalogarr-markers" literal,
// except pkg/k8s, which declares it.
func TestOnlyLegacyFoldAppliesAsCatalogarrMarkers(t *testing.T) {
 for path, f := range productionFiles(t, "app", "pkg", "internal", "cmd", "ui", "test", "hack") {
  dir := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(path))
  if dir == "app/catalog/legacyfold" || dir == "pkg/k8s" {
   continue
  }
  k8sAlias := importAlias(f, mod+"pkg/k8s", "k8s")
  ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
   switch n := n.(type) {
   case *ast.SelectorExpr:
    if x, ok := n.X.(*ast.Ident); ok && k8sAlias != "" && x.Name == k8sAlias && n.Sel.Name == "ManagerCatalogarrMarkers" {
     t.Errorf("%s names k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMarkers: only app/catalog/legacyfold may write as it (loop spec §7.3.8)", path)
    }
   case *ast.BasicLit:
    if n.Kind == token.STRING {
     if v, err := strconv.Unquote(n.Value); err == nil && v == "catalogarr-markers" {
      t.Errorf("%s spells the catalogarr-markers manager: only app/catalog/legacyfold may write as it", path)
     }
    }
   }
   return true
  })
 }
}
```

```go
package system

import (
 "context"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "testing"

 "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"

 catalogac "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/applyconfiguration/catalog/catalog/v1alpha1"
 catalogv1alpha1 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/api/catalog/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/internal/cli/agent"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/internal/cli/manager"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/pkg/k8s"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/test/installtest"
 "github.com/mediactl/clustarr/test/starttest"
)

// TestAMediaFilesStatusCarriesOnlyCatalogarrAcrossTheManagerAndImport: with
// the manager (release N, --legacy-fold=apply) and the import agent each under
// its own identity, a file the previous release left with a
// catalogarr-markers entry is probed through the queue, claimed and released,
// and ends with exactly one status manager: catalogarr (ADR-0016; loop spec
// §2.12, §7.3.8).
func TestAMediaFilesStatusCarriesOnlyCatalogarrAcrossTheManagerAndImport(t *testing.T) {
 installtest.FindTool(t, "ffprobe") // the import domain probes through ffprobeexec until W8.6 (W5.13's U2 amendment)
 env := starttest.StartEnv(t)
 natsURL := starttest.EmbeddedNATS(t)
 admin, err := client.New(env.Config, client.Options{Scheme: k8s.MustNewScheme()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var dataDir string
 pair(t, env, natsURL, "import", func(m *manager.Options, _ *agent.Options) { dataDir = m.DataDir })
 src, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(installtest.RepoRoot(t), "test/data/mediainfo/sample_h264_8bit.mp4"))
 require.NoError(t, err)
 movieDir := filepath.Join(dataDir, "media/movies/Sample (2024)")
 require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(movieDir, 0o755))

 _, err = k8s.PatchStatus(context.Background(), admin, k8s.ManagerCatalogarrMarkers, catalogac.MediaFile("sample-2024", "default").WithStatus(
  catalogac.MediaFileStatus().WithMarkers(catalogac.FileMarkers().WithResult(catalogv1alpha1.MarkersNotFound))))
 require.NoError(t, err)

 key := client.ObjectKey{Namespace: "default", Name: "sample-2024"}
 starttest.WaitForLong(t, "probed, claimed and released", func() bool {
  var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
  if admin.Get(context.Background(), key, &mf) != nil || mf.Status.MediaInfo == nil {
   return false
  }
  managers := starttest.StatusManagers(mf.ManagedFields)
  return len(managers) == 1 && managers["catalogarr"]
 })
 var mf catalogv1alpha1.MediaFile
 require.NoError(t, admin.Get(context.Background(), key, &mf))
 assert.Equal(t, map[string]bool{"catalogarr": true}, starttest.StatusManagers(mf.ManagedFields), "under f:status, only catalogarr")
 assert.NotNil(t, mf.Status.Markers, "the release keeps the markers catalogarr co-owned")
}
```

> bind every task here unchanged: branch `unify-manager-agent` in
