```go
// TestInstallerArgsParseAsTheManager: the manager container each installer
// renders runs through this binary's own command tree with its rendered
// environment and yields valid options under the one lease. envtest runs no
// pods, so this is where an unknown flag or env var shows up first.
func TestInstallerArgsParseAsTheManager(t *testing.T) {
 for name, tc := range map[string]struct {
  out       []byte
  autoscale bool
  defsDir   string
 }{
  "helm":                  {out: installtest.RenderChart(t), autoscale: true},
  "helm, autoscaling off": {out: installtest.RenderChart(t, "--set", "autoscaling.enabled=false")},
  "helm, cardigann definitions": {out: installtest.RenderChart(t, "--set", "manager.cardigann.definitions.configMap=defs",
   "--set", "manager.cardigann.bundled=false"), autoscale: true, defsDir: "/etc/clustarr/cardigann"},
  "kustomize": {out: installtest.BuildKustomize(t, "config/default"), autoscale: true},
 } {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   c := installtest.Container(t, installtest.DecodeRendered(t, tc.out), "manager")
   require.Equal(t, []string{binpath.Manager}, c.Command)
   installtest.SetEnvFrom(t, c, "manager-0")
   var got manager.Options
   cmd := manager.NewCommandWith(func(_ context.Context, o manager.Options) error { got = o; return nil })
   cmd.SetArgs(c.Args)
   cmd.SetOut(io.Discard)
   cmd.SetErr(io.Discard)
   require.NoError(t, cmd.Execute(), "manager %v", c.Args)
   require.NoError(t, got.Validate())
   assert.True(t, got.LeaderElect, "the manager runs under the lease")
   assert.Equal(t, tc.autoscale, got.Autoscale)
   assert.NotEmpty(t, got.NativeImage)
   assert.Equal(t, tc.defsDir, got.CardigannDefinitionsDir)
   assert.Equal(t, tc.defsDir == "", got.CardigannBundled)
  })
 }
}
```

```go
// TestManagerCarriesTheFoldFlags (loop spec §7.3.10, §3.7, §3.17, §5.13):
// both installers run release N's manager with its adoption mode and
// retention, the remediation loop's concurrency, write pacing and I/O
// workers, and the admission ledger's graft slots, and never
// --job-retention, which the fold removed with TranscodeJob (D5). Only
// config/e2e shortens the retention, so its scenarios see an adopted object
// deleted.
func TestManagerCarriesTheFoldFlags(t *testing.T) {
 want := []string{
  "--graft-concurrency=2",
  "--remediation-concurrency=16",
  "--remediation-bulk-writes-per-second=25",
  "--remediation-io-workers=8",
  "--legacy-fold=apply",
  "--legacy-fold-retain=72h",
 }
 for name, out := range map[string][]byte{
  "helm":      installtest.RenderChart(t),
  "kustomize": installtest.BuildKustomize(t, "config/default"),
 } {
  args := installtest.Container(t, installtest.DecodeRendered(t, out), "manager").Args
  for _, a := range want {
   assert.Contains(t, args, a, "%s's manager args", name)
  }
  for _, a := range args {
   assert.False(t, strings.HasPrefix(a, "--job-retention"), "%s's manager passes %s: ADR-0016 removed it (loop spec D5)", name, a)
  }
 }
 e2e := installtest.Container(t, installtest.DecodeRendered(t, installtest.BuildKustomize(t, "config/e2e")), "manager").Args
 assert.Contains(t, e2e, "--legacy-fold-retain=0s", "config/e2e deletes an adopted object at the next census (loop spec §7.3.10)")
 assert.NotContains(t, e2e, "--legacy-fold-retain=72h")
}
```

  `config/manager/manager.yaml`:

```yaml
# manager -- every reconciler in one process (spec 2026-10-06 §3.4): the
# catalog, import, index, grab, squash and caption controllers, the history
# replay controllers, the artwork reaper, the Cardigann bundle loader and the
# autoscale reconciler with the External Metrics API it serves. One replica
# under the lease manager.clustarr.io; RollingUpdate with maxUnavailable 0,
# so the new pod is up (not leading) before the old one stops.
#
# It renders the download engines (as grabarr-engine, below) and the
# transcode pool and graft Jobs, all on CLUSTARR_NATIVE_IMAGE, and
# mounts /data for its filesystem reconcilers (§5.14).
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: manager
---
# The identity every engine pod the DownloadClient controller creates runs as
# (--engine-service-account). It holds only the engines' own ClusterRole
# (config/rbac/grabarr_engine_role.yaml, generated from app/grab/engine's
# markers): read its DownloadClient, watch, update and finalize its Downloads,
# write their engine status.
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: grabarr-engine
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: manager
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: manager
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: manager
  ports:
    - name: metrics
      port: 8443
      targetPort: metrics
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: manager
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: manager
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: manager
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: manager
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: manager
      # The longest AckWait it drains (catalogarr-segments-plan, 60 s; ADR-0016
      # retired squasharr-transcode-results) plus 25 s (spec §3.5.6,
      # TestGracePeriodsCoverAckWait).
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 85
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: manager
          image: ghcr.io/mediactl/clustarr:dev
          command: ["/usr/bin/manager"]
          # --nats-single-node: config/default ships the single-server dev NATS
          # in config/nats, which cannot host R3 streams; the manager is the
          # only process that ensures topology (§5.9). charts/clustarr derives
          # it from the subchart instead.
          # Release N's fold flags (loop spec §7.3.10, §3.7, §3.17, §5.13): the
          # ledger's graft slots, the remediation loop's concurrency, status-write
          # pacing and /data workers, and the adoption of the three folded kinds.
          # Keep --legacy-fold-retain last: config/e2e/manager-e2e-patch.yaml
          # replaces args/8. The chart renders the same from
          # manager.{graftConcurrency,remediation,legacyFold}.
          args: ["--leader-elect", "--slots=cpu=2,nvidia=1,intel=1", "--nats-single-node", "--graft-concurrency=2", "--remediation-concurrency=16", "--remediation-bulk-writes-per-second=25", "--remediation-io-workers=8", "--legacy-fold=apply", "--legacy-fold-retain=72h"]
          env:
            - name: NATS_URL
              value: nats://nats.clustarr-system.svc:4222
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace
            - name: UMASK
              value: "002"
            # GOMEMLIMIT = 80% of 1536Mi, in bytes (the chart computes the same
            # with clustarr.gomemlimit; TestGOMEMLIMITIsItsShareOfTheLimit).
            - name: GOMEMLIMIT
              value: "1288490189"
            # The image of every engine, pool and graft pod (--native-image).
            - name: CLUSTARR_NATIVE_IMAGE
              value: ghcr.io/mediactl/clustarr/native:dev
            - name: CLUSTARR_ENGINE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
              value: grabarr-engine
            - name: CLUSTARR_DATA_CLAIM
              value: clustarr-data
            # The External Metrics API's TLS Secret (created by the manager)
            # and the Service config/autoscaling's APIService names.
            - name: CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_METRICS_SECRET
              value: external-metrics-tls
            - name: CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_METRICS_SERVICE
              value: external-metrics
            # Intel transcode pods need the host's render group: add
            #   - name: CLUSTARR_INTEL_RENDER_GROUPS
            #     value: "109"
            # (host-specific, so nothing is set here). The GPU node labels
            # default to the NVIDIA GPU Operator's and Intel NFD's; override
            # with CLUSTARR_GPU_NODE_LABEL_NVIDIA / _INTEL.
          ports:
            - name: extmetrics
              containerPort: 6443
              protocol: TCP
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 8443
              protocol: TCP
            - name: health
              containerPort: 8081
              protocol: TCP
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: health
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /readyz
              port: health
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "2"
              memory: 1536Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: clustarr-data
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
```

  `config/manager/agent-catalog.yaml` (the shape of every autoscaled agent):

```yaml
# agent-catalog -- searches, grabs and artwork renders (agent --domain=catalog,
# spec 2026-10-06 §3.5). No spec.replicas: the manager's autoscale reconciler
# owns this Deployment's HPA, selected by autoscale.clustarr.io/domain, and
# scales it 0..1 (its searches end in the index agent's per-host limiter).
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: agent-catalog
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: agent-catalog
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: agent-catalog
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: agent-catalog
  ports:
    - name: metrics
      port: 8443
      targetPort: metrics
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: agent-catalog
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: agent-catalog
    autoscale.clustarr.io/domain: catalog
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: agent-catalog
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: agent-catalog
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: agent-catalog
      # The longest AckWait it drains plus 25 s (spec §3.5.6).
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 145
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      # Soft: a required anti-affinity would stall a RollingUpdate surge on a
      # single node (OD33).
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/component: agent-catalog
      containers:
        - name: agent-catalog
          image: ghcr.io/mediactl/clustarr/native:dev
          command: ["/usr/bin/agent"]
          args: ["--domain=catalog"]
          env:
            - name: NATS_URL
              value: nats://nats.clustarr-system.svc:4222
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace
            # GOMEMLIMIT = 80% of 1Gi, in bytes.
            - name: GOMEMLIMIT
              value: "858993459"
          ports:
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 8443
              protocol: TCP
            - name: health
              containerPort: 8081
              protocol: TCP
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: health
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /readyz
              port: health
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
```

  The other agent files are `agent-catalog.yaml` with every `agent-catalog` replaced by the file's
  name and these differences, each written out in full in its file:

Autoscaled 1..N: its streams are memory-backed with discard-old on single-node NATS (§3.5.4), so it never scales to zero.` | `events` | none / none | 55 | `["--domain=events"]` | `"858993459"` (80% of 1Gi) | 100m/256Mi → 1/1Gi | none |

Exactly one replica, Recreate: its provider rate limiters live in process memory (ADR-0007).` | none (delete the label line and the `topologySpreadConstraints` block) | `replicas: 1`, `strategy: {type: Recreate}` | 85 | `["--domain=metadata"]` | `"429496730"` (80% of 512Mi) | 50m/96Mi → 500m/512Mi | none |

Autoscaled 0..N; mounts /data read-write.` | `import` | none / none | 85 | `["--domain=import"]` | `"966367642"` (60% of 1536Mi: FFmpeg allocates outside the Go heap) | 100m/256Mi → 2/1536Mi | rw, with `UMASK=002` after `POD_NAMESPACE`, the fsGroup pod securityContext, a `data` mount at `/data` and volume `persistentVolumeClaim: {claimName: clustarr-data}` before `tmp` |

Mounts /data read-write for sidecars.` | `caption` | none / none | 115 | `["--domain=caption"]` | `"644245094"` (60% of 1Gi) | 100m/192Mi → 1/1Gi | rw, as agent-import |

Exactly one replica, Recreate: the release index is SQLite on the ReadWriteOnce PVC clustarr-index, and the RPC responders, facade and per-host limiter are one process (R4 amendment).`,

  `config/manager/markers.yaml` (whole file):

```yaml
# markers -- skip-segment detection (spec 2026-10-01 segment detection; spec
# 2026-10-06 §3.7): the credential-less cmd/markers binary on the native
# image. It reads /data and talks NATS, so its ServiceAccount mounts no token
# and nothing binds it. Autoscaled 0..N on segmentarr-analyze's lag; a pod's
# slots come from that consumer's Slots, or CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS
# (`segmentarr-analyze=N`), the number the HPA targets too. Grace is the
# consumer's 30-minute AckWait plus 25 s: it drains or naks what it holds.
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: markers
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: markers
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
  ports:
    - name: metrics
      port: 8080
      targetPort: metrics
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: markers
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
    autoscale.clustarr.io/domain: markers
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: markers
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 1825
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
      containers:
        - name: markers
          image: ghcr.io/mediactl/clustarr/native:dev
          command: ["/usr/bin/markers"]
          env:
            - name: NATS_URL
              value: nats://nats.clustarr-system.svc:4222
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace
            # GOMEMLIMIT = 50% of 2Gi, in bytes: FFmpeg and ONNX Runtime
            # allocate outside the Go heap (OD42).
            - name: GOMEMLIMIT
              value: "1073741824"
          ports:
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: metrics
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
          readinessProbe:
            # NATS connected and the subscription bound (§3.3).
            httpGet:
              path: /readyz
              port: metrics
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "2"
              memory: 2Gi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
              readOnly: true
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: clustarr-data
            readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
```

  **3b. RBAC.** `Makefile`: replace the RBAC comment block (`# The RBAC ClusterRoles …` through
  `… TestChartRBACMatchesTheGeneratedRoles.`) and every `RBAC_ROLES`/`RBAC_PATHS_*` line with

```make
# The RBAC ClusterRoles `make manifests` generates, one per identity that runs
# under its own ServiceAccount (spec 2026-10-06 §4.6, §10.2.4): the manager,
# each agent domain's Deployment, and grabarr-engine, the identity of the
# engine pods the manager's DownloadClient controller renders. ui's role is
# hand-written (config/rbac/ui_role.yaml); markers and the transcode pool and
# graft Jobs run with no ServiceAccount token and hold no role.
#
# Each role is generated from exactly the packages in RBAC_PATHS_<role>,
# written to config/rbac/<role>_role.yaml (hyphens as underscores) as
# ClusterRole clustarr-<role>-role. The paths are explicit: a glob such as
# ./app/catalog/... cannot separate the manager's controllers from the
# agents' workers, and a role holds only what its process runs. Each
# RBAC_PATHS_* stays on one line: the guards read this file line by line.
#
# test/guards reads RBAC_ROLES and RBAC_PATHS_* from here rather than
# restating them: TestEveryPackageWithRBACMarkersIsInARole fails when a
# package with markers is in no role, TestEachRoleCoversTheMarkedPackagesItsHomeLinks
# when a role's paths and what its process links disagree,
# TestConfigRBACHoldsOnlyKnownRoleFiles when config/rbac keeps a retired role,
# and TestChartRBACMatchesTheGeneratedRoles holds the chart's copies to these
# files byte for byte.
RBAC_ROLES := manager agent-catalog agent-events agent-metadata agent-import agent-index agent-caption grabarr-engine
```

```yaml
{{- if .Values.markers.enabled }}
{{/*
markers detects skip segments (spec 2026-10-01 segment detection; spec
2026-10-06 §3.7): the credential-less cmd/markers binary on the native
image. It reads /data and talks NATS, so its ServiceAccount mounts no token
and nothing binds it. Grace is its consumer's 30-minute AckWait plus 25 s.
Autoscaled 0..N by the manager on segmentarr-analyze's lag; per-pod slots

targets too.
*/}}
{{- $name := printf "%s-markers" (include "clustarr.fullname" .) }}

kind: ServiceAccount

  name: {{ $name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "clustarr.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
automountServiceAccountToken: false
{{- with .Values.imagePullSecrets }}
imagePullSecrets:
  {{- toYaml . | nindent 2 }}
{{- end }}

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ $name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "clustarr.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
spec:

    targetPort: metrics
    protocol: TCP
---

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ $name }}
  labels:
    {{- include "clustarr.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
    {{- if .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}
    autoscale.clustarr.io/domain: markers
    {{- end }}
spec:
  {{- if .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}
  # replicas omitted: the manager's autoscale reconciler owns this Deployment's HPA.
  {{- else }}
  replicas: {{ .Values.markers.replicas }}
  {{- end }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "clustarr.selectorLabels" (dict "root" $ "component" "markers") | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "clustarr.labels" . | nindent 8 }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: markers
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ $name }}
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 1825
      {{- with .Values.imagePullSecrets }}

      {{- end }}

        {{- toYaml .Values.podSecurityContext | nindent 8 }}
      {{- with .Values.markers.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.markers.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.markers.affinity }}

        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}

          matchLabels:
            {{- include "clustarr.selectorLabels" (dict "root" $ "component" "markers") | nindent 12 }}

        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}

        - name: POD_NAME

        - name: POD_NAMESPACE
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.namespace
        {{- with dig "resources" "limits" "memory" "" .Values.markers }}

        {{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.markers.consumerSlots }}
        - name: CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS
          value: {{ include "clustarr.consumerSlots" . | quote }}
        {{- end }}
        ports:
        - name: metrics
          containerPort: 8080
          protocol: TCP
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: metrics
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 20
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /readyz
            port: metrics
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
        resources:
          {{- toYaml .Values.markers.resources | nindent 10 }}
        securityContext:
          {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 10 }}
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /data
          readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: {{ default (printf "%s-data" (include "clustarr.fullname" .)) .Values.storage.data.existingClaim }}
          readOnly: true
      # readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, so /tmp has to be a volume.
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir: {}
{{- end }}
```

```yaml
{{/*
One Deployment per row of the process topology (spec 2026-10-06 §10.2.1):
the manager, one agent per domain, and ui; markers is templates/markers.yaml.
This mirrors config/manager; test/guards holds the two to each other
(TestInstallersRenderTheTopology, TestChartAndKustomizeAgreePerComponent).

The download engines (<downloadclient>-engine StatefulSets and Deployments)
and the transcode pool and graft Jobs are absent on purpose: the
manager creates those at runtime, owned by the CR that asked for them.
*/}}
{{- $fullname := include "clustarr.fullname" . }}
{{- $dataClaim := default (printf "%s-data" $fullname) .Values.storage.data.existingClaim }}
{{- /* Release N's fold flags (loop spec §7.3.10, §3.7, §3.17, §5.13), as
       config/manager/manager.yaml passes them. */}}
{{- $managerArgs := list (printf "--slots=%s" .Values.manager.slots)
      (printf "--graft-concurrency=%d" (int .Values.manager.graftConcurrency))
      (printf "--remediation-concurrency=%d" (int .Values.manager.remediation.concurrency))
      (printf "--remediation-bulk-writes-per-second=%d" (int .Values.manager.remediation.bulkWritesPerSecond))
      (printf "--remediation-io-workers=%d" (int .Values.manager.remediation.ioWorkers))
      (printf "--legacy-fold=%s" .Values.manager.legacyFold.mode)
      (printf "--legacy-fold-retain=%s" .Values.manager.legacyFold.retain) }}
{{- $managerEnv := list
      (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_NATIVE_IMAGE" "value" (include "clustarr.image" (dict "root" $ "which" "native")))
      (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_ENGINE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT" "value" (printf "%s-grabarr-engine" $fullname))
      (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_DATA_CLAIM" "value" $dataClaim) }}
{{- $managerPorts := list }}
{{- if .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}
{{- $managerEnv = append $managerEnv (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_METRICS_SECRET" "value" (printf "%s-external-metrics-tls" $fullname)) }}
{{- $managerEnv = append $managerEnv (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_METRICS_SERVICE" "value" (printf "%s-external-metrics" $fullname)) }}
{{- $managerPorts = append $managerPorts (dict "name" "extmetrics" "containerPort" 6443) }}
{{- else }}
{{- /* No HPA reconciler, External Metrics server or CA injection; the
       manager deletes the HPAs it labelled, once, at start (spec §9.4). */}}
{{- $managerArgs = append $managerArgs "--autoscale=false" }}
{{- end }}
{{- /* Host-specific, so set only when given. */}}
{{- with .Values.manager.intelRenderGroups }}
{{- $managerEnv = append $managerEnv (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_INTEL_RENDER_GROUPS" "value" (join "," .)) }}
{{- end }}
{{- /* The binary's defaults match the NVIDIA GPU Operator and Intel NFD. */}}
{{- with .Values.manager.gpuNodeLabelNvidia }}
{{- $managerEnv = append $managerEnv (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_GPU_NODE_LABEL_NVIDIA" "value" .) }}
{{- end }}
{{- with .Values.manager.gpuNodeLabelIntel }}
{{- $managerEnv = append $managerEnv (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_GPU_NODE_LABEL_INTEL" "value" .) }}
{{- end }}
{{- /* --cardigann-bundled defaults on in the binary, so only "off" is
       rendered. The bundle loader is the manager's (R8, R9). */}}
{{- if not .Values.manager.cardigann.bundled }}
{{- $managerEnv = append $managerEnv (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_CARDIGANN_BUNDLED" "value" "false") }}
{{- end }}
{{- $managerVolumes := list }}
{{- $managerMounts := list }}
{{- /* A definitions directory replaces the embedded corpus entirely
       (--cardigann-definitions-dir); read-only. clustarr.validate refuses
       configMap and existingClaim together. */}}
{{- with .Values.manager.cardigann.definitions }}
{{- if or .configMap .existingClaim }}
{{- $dir := "/etc/clustarr/cardigann" }}
{{- $managerEnv = append $managerEnv (dict "name" "CLUSTARR_CARDIGANN_DEFINITIONS_DIR" "value" $dir) }}
{{- $mount := dict "name" "cardigann" "mountPath" $dir "readOnly" true }}
{{- with .subPath }}
{{- $_ := set $mount "subPath" . }}
{{- end }}
```

  **3d. Values and schema.** `charts/clustarr/values.yaml`: replace the `Images` section (`:8-36`, through
  `imagePullSecrets: []` exclusive) with

```yaml
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Images
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two images (spec 2026-10-06 §10.1, R1):
#   clustarr -- distroless static: the manager and ui binaries.
#   native   -- FROM scratch: the agent, markers and transcode binaries on
#               FFmpeg 9's libraries and ONNX Runtime. Every agent, markers,
#               and everything the manager renders at runtime (the download
#               engines, the transcode pools, graft Jobs) run it, nvidia
#               pools included: the NVIDIA container runtime injects the
#               driver's libraries from the host, so there is no CUDA image
#               (docs/adr/0015-no-cuda-image.md).
# An empty tag falls back to .Chart.AppVersion.
image:
  registry: ghcr.io
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  clustarr:
    repository: mediactl/clustarr
    tag: ""
  native:
    repository: mediactl/clustarr/native
    tag: ""
```

  insert after the `cloudnative-pg:` block

```yaml
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Autoscaling (spec 2026-10-06 §9)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# true: the manager owns one HorizontalPodAutoscaler per queue-driven
# Deployment (agent-catalog, agent-events, agent-import, agent-caption,
# markers) and scales each on JetStream consumer lag -- to zero while its
# queues are empty (agent-events keeps one) and up to the number of nodes its
# pods can schedule on -- through the External Metrics API it serves itself
# (templates/autoscaling.yaml renders the APIService). The chart never renders
# an HPA: the manager's reconciler owns them.
# false: fixed replicas from agents.<domain>.replicas and markers.replicas,
# and no APIService. Use it where KEDA or prometheus-adapter already holds
# v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io: only one APIService may hold the group.
autoscaling:
  enabled: true
```

  and replace everything from the `# Services` banner through the end of the `segmentarrWorker:` block
  (up to the `ui:` block's comment) with

```yaml
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Workloads (spec 2026-10-06 §10.2.1)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The parts that are not knobs -- image, command, domain, volumes, update
# strategy, grace period -- live in the templates, because getting them wrong
# is a correctness bug rather than a preference. GOMEMLIMIT is a share of
# resources.limits.memory: 80%, except agent-import and agent-caption (60%)
# and markers (50%), whose FFmpeg, par2 and ONNX Runtime allocations live
# outside the Go heap.

# Every controller in one process, one replica under the lease
# manager.clustarr.io (no replica knob). It renders the download engines, the
# transcode pools and graft Jobs, runs the MediaFile remediation loop
# (ADR-0016) and serves the External Metrics API.
manager:
  # Transcode admission per hardware class (--slots): class=count pairs.
  slots: cpu=2,nvidia=1,intel=1
  # GIDs of the host group owning /dev/dri/renderD* on the Intel GPU nodes
  # (--intel-render-groups), added to every Intel transcode pod as
  # supplementalGroups. Host-specific, so no default; leave empty with a
  # runtime that has device_ownership_from_security_context.
  intelRenderGroups: []
  # Override the node labels that mark NVIDIA and Intel GPU nodes
  # (--gpu-node-label-nvidia/-intel). Empty uses the binary's defaults,
  # nvidia.com/gpu.present and intel.feature.node.kubernetes.io/gpu.
  gpuNodeLabelNvidia: ""
  gpuNodeLabelIntel: ""
  # The Cardigann definitions the manager's bundle loader applies. See the
  # README's "Cardigann definitions".
  cardigann:
    # --cardigann-bundled: load the corpus compiled into the binary.
    bundled: true
    # A ConfigMap or claim of definition files, mounted read-only and passed
    # as --cardigann-definitions-dir, replacing the corpus. One, not both.
    definitions:
      configMap: ""
      existingClaim: ""
      subPath: ""
  # Audio grafts running at once in the namespace (--graft-concurrency): the
  # admission ledger's graft slots, each a CPU pod of a cpu pool's size.
  graftConcurrency: 2
  # The MediaFile remediation loop (ADR-0016; loop spec §3.7, §3.17).
  remediation:
    # MediaFiles and items reconciled at once (--remediation-concurrency, 1-64).
    concurrency: 16
    # MediaFile status applies per second that no grant, answer, intent or
    # first probe caused (--remediation-bulk-writes-per-second; 0 disables
    # the pacing): a ProbeVersion or standard.Version raise stays off etcd.
    bulkWritesPerSecond: 25
    # Goroutines for the loop's /data calls (--remediation-io-workers, 1-64).
    ioWorkers: 8
  # Release N's adoption of SubtitleRequests, TranscodeJobs and AudioGrafts
  # into MediaFile status (loop spec §7.3.10); the next chart release drops it.
  legacyFold:
    # --legacy-fold: apply copies, then deletes, the legacy objects; hold
    # writes nothing about them (the upgrade runbook starts in hold).
    mode: apply
    # --legacy-fold-retain: how long an adoption stands before the legacy
    # object is deleted.
    retain: 72h
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 512Mi
    limits:
      cpu: "2"
      memory: 1536Mi
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}

# One Deployment per agent domain (agent --domain=<domain>). replicas applies
# only with autoscaling.enabled=false. consumerSlots overrides a consumer's
# per-pod handler count (CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS), which is also the HPA's
# per-pod target, e.g. {catalogarr-artwork-render: 2}.
agents:
  # Searches, grabs and artwork renders. Autoscaled 0..1: its searches end in
  # the index agent's per-host limiter, which more replicas cannot feed.
  catalog:
    enabled: true
    replicas: 1
    consumerSlots: {}
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
      limits:
        cpu: "1"
        memory: 1Gi
    nodeSelector: {}
    tolerations: []
    affinity: {}
  # The RSS matcher, history sink, redownloads and DLQ projector. Their
  # streams are memory-backed on single-node NATS, so it never scales below one.
  events:
    enabled: true
    replicas: 1
    consumerSlots: {}
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
      limits:
        cpu: "1"
        memory: 1Gi
    nodeSelector: {}
    tolerations: []
    affinity: {}
  # The metadata gateway, TheIntroDB markers and artwork
  # fetches. Always one replica, Recreate: its provider rate limiters live in
  # process memory (ADR-0007), so a second replica doubles the request rate.
  metadata:
    enabled: true
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 50m
        memory: 96Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 512Mi
    nodeSelector: {}
    tolerations: []
    affinity: {}
  # Library scans, file imports, import-list syncs, recycle sweeps and probes.
  # Mounts /data read-write.
  import:
    enabled: true
    replicas: 1
    consumerSlots: {}
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
      limits:
        cpu: "2"
        memory: 1536Mi
    nodeSelector: {}
    tolerations: []
    affinity: {}
  # The release index, the search/download/query RPC, RSS polls and the
  # Torznab facade. Always one replica, Recreate: a SQLite index on a
  # ReadWriteOnce PVC, and under postgres.enabled still one process holding
  # the RPC responders, the facade and the per-host limiter.
  index:
    enabled: true
    facade:
      service:
        type: ClusterIP
        port: 8080
      # The Secret holding the facade's API keys; empty means
      # <release>-indexarr-facade, created by the agent with one random key.
      apiKeySecret: ""
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
      limits:
        cpu: "1"
        memory: 1Gi
    nodeSelector: {}
    tolerations: []
    affinity: {}
  # Subtitle fetches. Autoscaled 0..1: fetches wait on the shared provider
  # token bucket. Mounts /data read-write for sidecars.
  caption:
    enabled: true
    replicas: 1
    consumerSlots: {}
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 192Mi
      limits:
        cpu: "1"
        memory: 1Gi
    nodeSelector: {}
    tolerations: []
    affinity: {}

# Skip-segment detection (cmd/markers). Reads /data read-only and holds no
# ServiceAccount token. Autoscaled 0..N on segmentarr-analyze; its per-pod
# analyses are consumerSlots.segmentarr-analyze (default 1).
markers:
  enabled: true
  replicas: 1
  consumerSlots: {}
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 512Mi
    limits:
      cpu: "2"
      memory: 2Gi
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
```

  `git mv config/postgres/indexarr-patch.yaml config/postgres/agent-index-patch.yaml`, content:

```yaml
# Strategic-merge patch: points the index agent at the CloudNativePG
# Cluster's release index instead of the local SQLite volume
# config/manager/agent-index.yaml mounts by default (design spec 2026-09-24
# §A.3-A.4; ADR-0010).
#
# CLUSTARR_INDEX_DSN is added (CLUSTARR_INDEX_PATH stays: the agent logs and
# ignores it once a DSN is set) from Secret "clustarr-postgres-app", which
# CNPG's bootstrap.initdb creates for cluster.yaml's "clustarr-postgres"
# Cluster (key "uri"). $patch: delete removes the index volumeMount and the
# volume: there is no PVC to mount under Postgres. The strategy stays
# Recreate: the index agent is one process under both engines (its RPC
# responders, facade and per-host limiter; spec 2026-10-06 R4 amendment).
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: agent-index
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: agent-index
        env:
        - name: CLUSTARR_INDEX_DSN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: clustarr-postgres-app
              key: uri
        volumeMounts:
        # volumeMounts' merge key is mountPath, not name.
        - mountPath: /var/lib/clustarr/index
          $patch: delete
      volumes:
      - name: index
        $patch: delete
```

```yaml
# Indexer health is written by both the manager's Indexer controller and the
# index agent's search fan-out (R8).
- target:
    kind: Deployment

  path: indexarr-e2e-patch.yaml
- target:

# The manager drives the Trakt device-code flow; the import agent syncs.
- target:
    kind: Deployment
    name: manager
  path: importarr-e2e-patch.yaml
- target:
    kind: Deployment
    name: agent-import

    kind: Deployment
    name: ui
  path: ui-e2e-patch.yaml
# Release N deletes an adopted SubtitleRequest, TranscodeJob or AudioGraft at
# the next census in e2e, not 72 h later (loop spec §7.3.10).
- target:
    kind: Deployment
    name: manager
  path: manager-e2e-patch.yaml
```

```go
// assertExternalMetricsAPI holds an installer's External Metrics API to
// spec §10.2.2: the APIService names the external-metrics Service on 443,
// sends no caBundle (the manager injects it under clustarr-autoscale, and an
// installer that sent one would fight it) and never skips TLS; the Service
// selects the manager pods and publishes not-ready addresses, so the
// aggregator reaches a manager whose caches are still syncing; the manager
// may read the front-proxy CA in kube-system; and the manager is told the
// Service and Secret names.
func assertExternalMetricsAPI(t *testing.T, objs []*unstructured.Unstructured, prefix string) {
 t.Helper()
 svcName := prefix + "external-metrics"
 var api, svc, reader, manager *unstructured.Unstructured
 for _, o := range objs {
  switch {
  case o.GetKind() == "APIService" && o.GetName() == "v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io":
   api = o
  case o.GetKind() == "Service" && o.GetName() == svcName:
   svc = o
  case o.GetKind() == "RoleBinding" && o.GetNamespace() == "kube-system":
   reader = o
  case o.GetKind() == "Deployment" && o.GetName() == prefix+"manager":
   manager = o
  }
 }
 require.NotNil(t, api, "no APIService v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io")
 spec, _, _ := unstructured.NestedMap(api.Object, "spec")
 assert.Equal(t, "external.metrics.k8s.io", spec["group"])
 assert.Equal(t, "v1beta1", spec["version"])
 assert.NotContains(t, spec, "caBundle", "the manager injects caBundle")
 assert.Equal(t, false, spec["insecureSkipTLSVerify"])
 assert.EqualValues(t, 100, spec["groupPriorityMinimum"])
 assert.EqualValues(t, 100, spec["versionPriority"])
 service, _, _ := unstructured.NestedMap(api.Object, "spec", "service")
 assert.Equal(t, svcName, service["name"])
 assert.Equal(t, "clustarr-system", service["namespace"], "the APIService names the release namespace")
 assert.EqualValues(t, 443, service["port"])

 require.NotNil(t, svc, "no Service %s", svcName)
 pnra, _, _ := unstructured.NestedBool(svc.Object, "spec", "publishNotReadyAddresses")
 assert.True(t, pnra, "publishNotReadyAddresses")
 sel, _, _ := unstructured.NestedStringMap(svc.Object, "spec", "selector")
 assert.Equal(t, "manager", sel["app.kubernetes.io/component"], "the Service selects the manager pods")
 ports, _, _ := unstructured.NestedSlice(svc.Object, "spec", "ports")
 require.Len(t, ports, 1)
 p := ports[0].(map[string]any)
 assert.Equal(t, "https", p["name"])
 assert.EqualValues(t, 443, p["port"])
 assert.Equal(t, "extmetrics", p["targetPort"])

 require.NotNil(t, reader, "no RoleBinding in kube-system")
 ref, _, _ := unstructured.NestedString(reader.Object, "roleRef", "name")
 assert.Equal(t, "extension-apiserver-authentication-reader", ref)
 subjects, _, _ := unstructured.NestedSlice(reader.Object, "subjects")
 require.Len(t, subjects, 1)
 assert.Equal(t, prefix+"manager", subjects[0].(map[string]any)["name"])

 require.NotNil(t, manager, "no manager Deployment")
 containers, _, _ := unstructured.NestedSlice(manager.Object, "spec", "template", "spec", "containers")
 c := containers[0].(map[string]any)
 extmetrics := false
 for _, cp := range c["ports"].([]any) {
  if m := cp.(map[string]any); m["name"] == "extmetrics" {
   extmetrics = true
   assert.EqualValues(t, 6443, m["containerPort"])
  }
 }
 assert.True(t, extmetrics, "the manager exposes extmetrics")
 env := map[string]string{}
 for _, e := range c["env"].([]any) {
  m := e.(map[string]any)
  if v, ok := m["value"].(string); ok {
   env[m["name"].(string)] = v
  }
 }
 assert.Equal(t, svcName, env["CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_METRICS_SERVICE"])
 assert.Equal(t, prefix+"external-metrics-tls", env["CLUSTARR_EXTERNAL_METRICS_SECRET"])
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement.** `charts/clustarr/templates/autoscaling.yaml`:

```yaml
{{- if .Values.autoscaling.enabled }}
{{/*
The External Metrics API the manager serves itself (spec 2026-10-06 §9.4),
which its autoscale reconciler's HPAs read to scale the queue-driven agents
on JetStream consumer lag. The manager creates its CA and serving cert in
<fullname>-external-metrics-tls and writes only spec.caBundle (field manager
clustarr-autoscale); nothing here sends caBundle, so Helm and the manager
never fight over it. Only one APIService may hold
v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io: where KEDA or prometheus-adapter already
does, set autoscaling.enabled=false (Helm refuses to adopt it, loudly).
*/}}
apiVersion: apiregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: APIService
metadata:
  name: v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io
  labels:
    {{- include "clustarr.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: external-metrics
spec:
  group: external.metrics.k8s.io
  version: v1beta1
  service:
    namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
    name: {{ include "clustarr.fullname" . }}-external-metrics
    port: 443
  groupPriorityMinimum: 100
  versionPriority: 100
  insecureSkipTLSVerify: false
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "clustarr.fullname" . }}-external-metrics
  labels:
    {{- include "clustarr.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: external-metrics
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  # The aggregator must reach a manager whose caches are still syncing: the
  # server answers before they do, and nothing gates on its readiness (§9.4).
  publishNotReadyAddresses: true
  selector:
    {{- include "clustarr.selectorLabels" (dict "root" $ "component" "manager") | nindent 4 }}
  ports:
  - name: https
    port: 443
    targetPort: extmetrics
    protocol: TCP
---
{{/* The manager reads the front-proxy client CA from
     kube-system/extension-apiserver-authentication. No
     system:auth-delegator binding: the kube-apiserver authenticates and
     authorizes before it proxies, and the server reviews no tokens. */}}
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: {{ include "clustarr.fullname" . }}-manager-auth-reader
  namespace: kube-system
  labels:
    {{- include "clustarr.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: manager
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: extension-apiserver-authentication-reader
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: {{ include "clustarr.fullname" . }}-manager
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
{{- end }}
```

```yaml
# The External Metrics API the manager serves itself (spec 2026-10-06 §9.4,
# §10.2.6): the APIService, the Service it names and the kube-system
# RoleBinding that lets the manager read the front-proxy client CA. The
# manager writes only the APIService's spec.caBundle (field manager
# clustarr-autoscale); nothing here sends it. config/default includes this
# directory. Only one APIService may hold v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io: on
# a cluster where KEDA or prometheus-adapter already does, leave it out and

    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: clustarr
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kustomize

resources:

- service.yaml
- auth_reader_binding.yaml
```

  `config/default/kustomization.yaml` (whole file):

```yaml
# The deployable Clustarr install:
#
#   kustomize build config/default | kubectl apply --server-side -f -
#
# Composes the CRDs, RBAC, the nine Deployments of config/manager (the
# manager, six agents, markers and the ui), the External Metrics APIService
# (config/autoscaling), the dev NATS StatefulSet and the two PVCs (§11) into
# the clustarr-system namespace.
#
# The namespace comes from a NamespaceTransformer with unsetOnly, not the
# plain `namespace:` field, which would also move config/autoscaling's
# kube-system RoleBinding.
#
# Optional, not included here; add them when the cluster has the operators:
#   ../prometheus  ServiceMonitors (needs the Prometheus Operator CRDs)
#   ../postgres    the release index on CloudNativePG (a Component)
#
# Production installs should prefer charts/clustarr, which swaps this plain
# NATS StatefulSet for the upstream nats chart (clustered R3, reloader,
# prometheus-nats-exporter).
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
- namespace.yaml
- pvc.yaml
- ../crd
- ../rbac
- ../manager
- ../autoscaling
- ../nats

transformers:
- |-
  apiVersion: builtin
  kind: NamespaceTransformer
  metadata:
    name: clustarr-namespace
    namespace: clustarr-system
  unsetOnly: true
```

  `charts/clustarr/README.md`: replace W6.2's interim `## Autoscaling` paragraph with

```markdown
## Autoscaling

`autoscaling.enabled=true` (the default) lets the manager scale the
queue-driven workloads itself (spec 2026-10-06 §9). It owns one
HorizontalPodAutoscaler per Deployment labelled `autoscale.clustarr.io/domain`
(`agent-catalog`, `agent-events`, `agent-import`, `agent-caption`, `markers`)
and scales each on JetStream consumer lag: to zero while its queues are empty
(`agent-events` to one, its streams cannot buffer through zero) and up to the
number of nodes its pods can schedule on. The lag comes from an External
Metrics API the manager serves itself: `templates/autoscaling.yaml` renders the
`v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io` APIService, its `<release>-external-metrics`
Service and a `kube-system` RoleBinding that lets the manager read the
front-proxy client CA. The manager creates its own CA and serving certificate
in `<release>-external-metrics-tls` and injects the APIService's `caBundle`.

The chart never renders an HPA, and the autoscaled Deployments carry no
`replicas`: the manager's reconciler owns both, and Helm's server-side apply
would fight it. On a cluster without the `HPAScaleToZero` feature (on by
default from Kubernetes 1.37) the manager keeps one replica of each and records
a `ScaleToZeroUnavailable` Event.

Only one APIService may hold `v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io`. Where KEDA or
prometheus-adapter already does, set `autoscaling.enabled=false`: the chart
then renders `agents.<domain>.replicas` and `markers.replicas`, no APIService,
and passes `--autoscale=false` to the manager. Helm refuses to adopt an
APIService it does not own, so the conflict is a loud install error.

`agents.<domain>.consumerSlots` and `markers.consumerSlots` set a consumer's
per-pod handler count (`CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS`), which is also the HPA's
per-pod target, for example `--set markers.consumerSlots.segmentarr-analyze=3`.
If the manager is down, `kubectl delete ns` of its namespace can hang on the
unavailable APIService; `kubectl delete apiservice v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io`
releases it.
```

```go
   "--set", "nameOverride=media", "--set", "fullnameOverride=media-release"},
  "autoscaling off": {"--set", "autoscaling.enabled=false"},
  "consumer slots":  {"--set", "markers.consumerSlots.segmentarr-analyze=3", "--set", "agents.import.consumerSlots.importarr-fileimport=2"},
 } {
  t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
   installtest.Run(t, root, helm, append([]string{"lint", "--strict", "charts/clustarr"}, args...)...)
   installtest.Run(t, root, helm, append([]string{"template", "clustarr", "charts/clustarr"}, args...)...)
  })
 }
 var schema struct {
  AdditionalProperties *bool                      `json:"additionalProperties"`
  Properties           map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"properties"`
 }
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(readRepoFile(t, root, "charts/clustarr/values.schema.json"), &schema))
 require.NotNil(t, schema.AdditionalProperties, "the schema's top level must say additionalProperties")
 assert.False(t, *schema.AdditionalProperties, "the schema's top level is closed (OD37)")
 assert.Contains(t, schema.Properties, "global", "Helm injects global into a chart with dependencies")
 var values map[string]any
 require.NoError(t, yaml.Unmarshal(readRepoFile(t, root, "charts/clustarr/values.yaml"), &values))
 for k := range values {
  assert.Contains(t, schema.Properties, k, "values.yaml's %s is not in the schema", k)
 }
}

// TestRetiredValuesKeysAreRejected (§10.2.8, OD37): a 0.4.x values file
// fails at install, naming the key, instead of rendering with its blocks
// silently ignored. Upgrade from `helm get values -o yaml` with the keys
// renamed, passed with -f, never --reuse-values (the ADR-0015 precedent).
func TestRetiredValuesKeysAreRejected(t *testing.T) {
 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 helm := installtest.FindTool(t, "helm")
 for _, set := range []string{
  "image.controller.tag=x", "image.media.tag=x", "image.transcoder.tag=x",
  "catalogarr.replicas=1", "catalogarrMetadata.replicas=1", "importarr.replicas=1", "importarrWorker.replicas=1",
  "indexarr.replicas=1", "grabarr.replicas=1", "squasharr.workerEngine=ffgo", "captionarr.replicas=1",
  "captionarrWorker.ackWaitSeconds=120", "segmentarrWorker.concurrency=1", "keda.enabled=true",
  "agents.metadata.replicas=2", "agents.index.replicas=2", "manager.replicas=2", "markers.concurrency=2",
  "manager.jobRetention=24h", // --job-retention went with TranscodeJob (ADR-0016, loop spec D5)
 } {
  t.Run(set, func(t *testing.T) {
   cmd := exec.Command(helm, "template", "clustarr", "charts/clustarr", "--set", set)
   cmd.Dir = root
   out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
   require.Error(t, err, "--set %s must fail the schema", set)
   assert.Regexp(t, regexp.MustCompile(`additional properties '[^']+' not allowed`), string(out))
  })
 }
}

// slotSchema is the part of an autoscaled workload's schema that names its
// consumers: allOf[1].properties.consumerSlots.propertyNames.enum.
type slotSchema struct {
 AllOf []struct {
  Properties struct {
   ConsumerSlots struct {
    PropertyNames struct {
     Enum []string `json:"enum"`
    } `json:"propertyNames"`
   } `json:"consumerSlots"`
  } `json:"properties"`
 } `json:"allOf"`
}

// TestConsumerSlotsNameOnlyTheDomainsConsumers (§10.2.2): a workload's
// consumerSlots may name exactly its own domain's consumers, so a slot meant
// for another workload fails at install instead of rendering an override its
// binary ignores and its HPA misreads.
func TestConsumerSlotsNameOnlyTheDomainsConsumers(t *testing.T) {
 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 var schema struct {
  Properties struct {
   Agents struct {
    Properties map[string]slotSchema `json:"properties"`
   } `json:"agents"`
   Markers slotSchema `json:"markers"`
  } `json:"properties"`
 }
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(readRepoFile(t, root, "charts/clustarr/values.schema.json"), &schema))
 enumOf := func(s slotSchema) []string {
  for _, a := range s.AllOf {
   if e := a.Properties.ConsumerSlots.PropertyNames.Enum; len(e) > 0 {
    return e
   }
  }
  return nil
 }
 for _, d := range agentdomain.Domains() {
  if !d.Autoscaled || len(d.Consumers) == 0 {
   continue
  }
  s := schema.Properties.Agents.Properties[d.Name]
  if d.Name == agentdomain.Markers {
   s = schema.Properties.Markers
  }
  assert.ElementsMatch(t, d.Consumers, enumOf(s), "%s's consumerSlots names exactly agentdomain's consumers", d.Name)
 }
 cmd := exec.Command(installtest.FindTool(t, "helm"), "template", "clustarr", "charts/clustarr",
  "--set", "agents.catalog.consumerSlots.captionarr-fetch-high=2")
 cmd.Dir = root
 out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
 require.Error(t, err, "a caption consumer in the catalog agent's slots must fail")
 assert.Contains(t, string(out), "captionarr-fetch-high")
}

// TestTheChartREADMENamesOnlyLiveValuesKeys: outside "Upgrading from 0.4.x",
// the README names no retired key, and every key it names under a live top
// key exists in values.yaml (<domain>-style placeholders match any key).
func TestTheChartREADMENamesOnlyLiveValuesKeys(t *testing.T) {
 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 readme := string(readRepoFile(t, root, "charts/clustarr/README.md"))
 upgrading := regexp.MustCompile(`(?ms)^## Upgrading from 0\.4\.x\n.*?(^## |\z)`)
 require.Regexp(t, upgrading, readme, "the README has an \"Upgrading from 0.4.x\" section")
 rest := upgrading.ReplaceAllString(readme, "$1")
 retired := regexp.MustCompile("`(catalogarr|catalogarrMetadata|importarr|importarrWorker|indexarr|grabarr|squasharr|captionarr|captionarrWorker|segmentarrWorker|keda|image\\.controller|image\\.media|image\\.transcoder)\\b[^`]*`")
 for _, m := range retired.FindAllString(rest, -1) {
  t.Errorf("charts/clustarr/README.md names retired key %s outside \"Upgrading from 0.4.x\"", m)
 }
 var values map[string]any
 require.NoError(t, yaml.Unmarshal(readRepoFile(t, root, "charts/clustarr/values.yaml"), &values))
 key := regexp.MustCompile("`((?:manager|agents|markers|autoscaling)(?:\\.[A-Za-z<>-]+)+)`")
 for _, m := range key.FindAllStringSubmatch(rest, -1) {
  node := any(values)
  for _, seg := range strings.Split(m[1], ".") {
   obj, ok := node.(map[string]any)
   if !ok {
    break
   }
   if strings.HasPrefix(seg, "<") {
    for _, v := range obj {
     node = v
     break
    }
    continue
   }
   next, ok := obj[seg]
   assert.True(t, ok, "charts/clustarr/README.md names %s, which values.yaml does not have", m[1])
   if !ok {
    break
   }
   node = next
  }
 }
}

// TestReleaseNsManagerValuesAreChecked (loop spec §7.3.10, §3.7, §3.17,
// §5.13): the fold's manager values are as closed as the rest --
// legacyFold.mode is apply or hold, legacyFold.retain a Go duration, the
// loop's knobs bounded integers, graftConcurrency at least 1 (0 would read
// as the binary's default) -- and --job-retention has no key.
func TestReleaseNsManagerValuesAreChecked(t *testing.T) {
 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 helm := installtest.FindTool(t, "helm")
 for _, set := range []string{
  "manager.legacyFold.mode=hold", "manager.legacyFold.retain=0s", "manager.remediation.concurrency=64",
  "manager.remediation.bulkWritesPerSecond=0", "manager.remediation.ioWorkers=1", "manager.graftConcurrency=1",
 } {
  t.Run("accepts "+set, func(t *testing.T) {
   installtest.Run(t, root, helm, "template", "clustarr", "charts/clustarr", "--set", set)
  })
 }
 for _, set := range []string{
  "manager.legacyFold.mode=drain", "manager.legacyFold.retain=soon", "manager.remediation.concurrency=0",
  "manager.remediation.concurrency=65", "manager.remediation.ioWorkers=0", "manager.remediation.bulkWritesPerSecond=-1",
  "manager.graftConcurrency=0", "manager.jobRetention=24h",
 } {
  t.Run("rejects "+set, func(t *testing.T) {
   cmd := exec.Command(helm, "template", "clustarr", "charts/clustarr", "--set", set)
   cmd.Dir = root
   out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
   require.Error(t, err, "--set %s must fail the schema", set)
   assert.Contains(t, string(out), "manager", "the schema error names the manager block")
  })
 }
}
```

```python
import json
p = "charts/clustarr/values.schema.json"
d = json.load(open(p))
props, defs = d["properties"], d["$defs"]
retired = ["catalogarr", "catalogarrMetadata", "importarr", "importarrWorker", "indexarr",
           "grabarr", "squasharr", "captionarr", "captionarrWorker", "segmentarrWorker", "keda"]
old = {k: props.pop(k) for k in retired if k in props}
defs.pop("serviceBlock", None)

def reword(node, pairs):
    s = json.dumps(node)
    for a, b in pairs:
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    return json.loads(s)

cardigann = reword(old["indexarr"]["properties"]["cardigann"], [("indexarr --", "manager --"), ("indexarr", "the manager")])
facade = old["indexarr"]["properties"]["facade"]
sq = reword(old["squasharr"]["properties"], [("squasharr --", "manager --")])
sched = {"nodeSelector": {"type": "object"}, "tolerations": {"type": "array"}, "affinity": {"type": "object"}}
resources = {"$ref": "#/$defs/resources"}

defs["agentBlock"] = {
    "type": "object", "additionalProperties": False,
    "required": ["enabled", "replicas", "consumerSlots", "resources", "nodeSelector", "tolerations", "affinity"],
    "properties": {
        "enabled": {"type": "boolean"},
        "replicas": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0,
                     "description": "Used only with autoscaling.enabled=false: otherwise the manager's HPA owns the replica count and the Deployment carries none."},
        "consumerSlots": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1},
                          "description": "Per-pod handler slots by consumer (CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS), also the HPA's per-pod target."},
        "resources": resources, **sched}}

def autoscaled(consumers):
    return {"allOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/agentBlock"},
                      {"properties": {"consumerSlots": {"propertyNames": {"enum": consumers}}}}]}

def fixed(extra):
    return {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": False,
            "required": ["enabled", *extra.keys(), "resources", "nodeSelector", "tolerations", "affinity"],
            "properties": {"enabled": {"type": "boolean"}, **extra, "resources": resources, **sched}}

props["global"] = {"type": "object", "description": "Injected by Helm into a chart with dependencies; clustarr reads nothing from it."}
props["autoscaling"] = {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": False, "required": ["enabled"], "properties": {
    "enabled": {"type": "boolean", "description": "The manager owns the queue-driven workloads' HPAs and serves the External Metrics API they read; false renders fixed replicas and no APIService (README, \"Autoscaling\")."}}}
props["manager"] = {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": False,
    "required": ["slots", "intelRenderGroups", "gpuNodeLabelNvidia", "gpuNodeLabelIntel", "cardigann",
                 "graftConcurrency", "remediation", "legacyFold", "resources", "nodeSelector", "tolerations", "affinity"],
    "properties": {"slots": sq["slots"], "intelRenderGroups": sq["intelRenderGroups"],
                   # The fold's manager flags (loop spec §3.7, §3.17, §5.13, §7.3.10). --job-retention is gone
                   # with TranscodeJob, so manager.jobRetention fails as any unknown key does.
                   "graftConcurrency": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1,
                                        "description": "Audio grafts running at once in the namespace (--graft-concurrency): the admission ledger's graft slots."},
                   "remediation": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": False,
                                   "required": ["concurrency", "bulkWritesPerSecond", "ioWorkers"],
                                   "properties": {
                                       "concurrency": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 64,
                                                       "description": "MediaFiles and items the remediation loop reconciles at once (--remediation-concurrency)."},
                                       "bulkWritesPerSecond": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0,
                                                               "description": "MediaFile status applies per second that no grant, answer, intent or first probe caused (--remediation-bulk-writes-per-second); 0 disables the pacing."},
                                       "ioWorkers": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 64,
                                                     "description": "Goroutines for the loop's /data calls (--remediation-io-workers)."}}},
                   "legacyFold": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": False, "required": ["mode", "retain"],
                                  "description": "Release N only: the adoption of SubtitleRequests, TranscodeJobs and AudioGrafts into MediaFile status. The next chart release removes it.",
                                  "properties": {
                                      "mode": {"type": "string", "enum": ["apply", "hold"],
                                               "description": "--legacy-fold: apply copies, then deletes, the legacy objects; hold writes nothing about them."},
                                      "retain": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^([0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?(ns|us|µs|ms|s|m|h))+$",
                                                 "description": "--legacy-fold-retain: how long an adoption stands before the object is deleted (a Go duration)."}}},
                   "gpuNodeLabelNvidia": sq["gpuNodeLabelNvidia"], "gpuNodeLabelIntel": sq["gpuNodeLabelIntel"],
                   "cardigann": cardigann, "resources": resources, **sched}}
props["agents"] = {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": False,
    "required": ["catalog", "events", "metadata", "import", "index", "caption"],
    "properties": {
        "catalog": autoscaled(["catalogarr-search-high", "catalogarr-search-normal", "catalogarr-grab", "catalogarr-artwork-render"]),
        "events": autoscaled(["catalogarr-rss-matcher", "catalogarr-redownload", "catalogarr-history", "clustarr-dlq-projector"]),
        "metadata": fixed({}),
        "import": autoscaled(["importarr-scan", "importarr-fileimport", "importarr-list", "importarr-recycle", "importarr-probe-high", "importarr-probe-low"]),
        "index": fixed({"facade": facade}),
        "caption": autoscaled(["captionarr-fetch-high", "captionarr-fetch-normal"]),
    }}
props["markers"] = autoscaled(["segmentarr-analyze"])
d["additionalProperties"] = False
d["required"] = ["image", "storage", "podSecurityContext", "securityContext", "autoscaling", "manager", "agents", "markers"]
d["description"] = (
    "Values for the clustarr umbrella chart (0.5.0: the manager, agent and ui topology). Checks shapes "
    "(types, enums, known number/string formats) so a bad values file fails at `helm install`/`helm template`/"
    "`helm lint` with a schema-path error naming the exact key. The top level is closed: a key chart 0.5.0 "
    "retired (catalogarr, importarr, indexarr, grabarr, squasharr, captionarr and their worker blocks, "
    "segmentarrWorker, keda, image.controller/media/transcoder) fails here; see the README's \"Upgrading from "
    "0.4.x\". Cross-field invariants are clustarr.validate's in templates/_helpers.tpl. nats and cloudnative-pg "
    "pass through to the subcharts, which ship no schema of their own, and are checked only shallowly.")
open(p, "w").write(json.dumps(d, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
```

````markdown
## Upgrading from 0.4.x

Chart 0.5.0 replaces the per-service Deployments with the manager, one agent
per domain, markers and the ui (spec 2026-10-06), and its schema rejects every
retired key. Upgrade with a fresh values file passed by `-f`, never
`--reuse-values`: take `helm get values <release> -o yaml`, rename the keys
below, delete the retired ones, and pass the result.

| 0.4.x key | 0.5.0 key |
| --- | --- |
| `image.controller` | `image.clustarr` |
| `image.transcoder` | `image.native` |
| `image.media` | gone: everything that used it runs `image.native` |
| `catalogarr`, `importarr`, `grabarr`, `squasharr`, `captionarr` | `manager` (one block; size its `resources` for the merged controllers) |
| `squasharr.slots`, `.intelRenderGroups`, `.gpuNodeLabelNvidia`, `.gpuNodeLabelIntel` | `manager.*` |
| `squasharr.workerEngine` | gone (no template read it) |
| `catalogarrMetadata` | `agents.metadata` (no `replicas`: always one) |
| `importarrWorker` | `agents.import` |
| `indexarr.replicas` | gone: the index agent always runs one |
| `indexarr.facade`, `indexarr.resources`, scheduling | `agents.index.*` |
| `indexarr.cardigann` | `manager.cardigann` |
| `captionarrWorker` (incl. `ackWaitSeconds`) | `agents.caption` (grace comes from the code) |
| `segmentarrWorker` (incl. `concurrency`) | `markers` (`concurrency: N` becomes `consumerSlots: {segmentarr-analyze: N}`) |
| `keda` | `autoscaling.enabled` |

Chart 0.5.0 is also the release that folds SubtitleRequest, TranscodeJob and
AudioGraft into MediaFile status (ADR-0016). Install it with
`manager.legacyFold.mode=hold`, compare `manager legacy-fold report` (run in the
manager's container) with the report you took before the upgrade, then upgrade
again with `mode: apply`; `manager.legacyFold.retain` (72h) is how long an
adopted object stands before it is deleted. The next chart release drops
`manager.legacyFold` and the three CRDs.

Before the first upgrade, annotate the release index's claim so Helm keeps it
(0.5.0 renders the annotation itself from then on):

```sh
kubectl -n <namespace> annotate pvc <release>-index helm.sh/resource-policy=keep
```
````

```markdown
Every workload the chart renders gets `GOMEMLIMIT` set to a share of its own
`resources.limits.memory`, computed at render time (`clustarr.gomemlimit` in
`templates/_helpers.tpl`) as a literal byte count: 80%, except `agent-import`
and `agent-caption` (60%) and `markers` (50%), whose FFmpeg, par2 and ONNX
Runtime allocations live outside the Go heap. The Downward API's
`resourceFieldRef` can only report 100% of a container's own limit, so the
share is computed here, from the same quantity `values.yaml` sets. Change a
memory limit and its `GOMEMLIMIT` moves with it on the next `helm upgrade`;
`config/manager` carries the same figures as literals, and
`TestGOMEMLIMITIsItsShareOfTheLimit` holds the two installers together.
```

```markdown
| `storage.data.size` | `/data` PVC size. | `100Gi` |
| `storage.index.existingClaim`/`.storageClass`/`.size` | The index agent's `ReadWriteOnce` SQLite index PVC, kept on uninstall. Not rendered when `postgres.enabled`. | `""`, `""`, `5Gi` |
| `podSecurityContext` | Pod-level `securityContext` for every PVC-mounting workload (`fsGroup` chowns a fresh PVC root to uid 1000). | see `values.yaml` |
| `securityContext` | Container-level `securityContext` (non-root, read-only rootfs, all capabilities dropped). | see `values.yaml` |
| `manager.slots` | Transcode admission per hardware class (`--slots`), e.g. `cpu=2,nvidia=1,intel=1`. | `cpu=2,nvidia=1,intel=1` |
| `manager.intelRenderGroups` | GIDs of the host group owning `/dev/dri/renderD*` on the Intel GPU nodes (`--intel-render-groups`), added to every Intel transcode pod as `supplementalGroups`. Host-specific, so no default. | `[]` |
| `manager.gpuNodeLabelNvidia`/`.gpuNodeLabelIntel` | Override the node labels that mark GPU nodes. Empty uses `nvidia.com/gpu.present` and `intel.feature.node.kubernetes.io/gpu`. | `""` |
| `manager.cardigann.bundled` | Load the Cardigann corpus compiled into the binary (`--cardigann-bundled`). See [Cardigann definitions](#cardigann-definitions). | `true` |
| `manager.cardigann.definitions.configMap`/`.existingClaim`/`.subPath` | A ConfigMap or PVC of definition files, mounted read-only into the manager as `--cardigann-definitions-dir`, **replacing** the corpus; one, not both. | `""` |
| `manager.graftConcurrency` | Audio grafts running at once in the namespace (`--graft-concurrency`): the admission ledger's graft slots, each a CPU pod of a cpu pool's size. | `2` |
| `manager.remediation.concurrency` | MediaFiles and items the remediation loop reconciles at once (`--remediation-concurrency`, 1-64). | `16` |
| `manager.remediation.bulkWritesPerSecond` | MediaFile status applies per second that no grant, answer, intent or first probe caused (`--remediation-bulk-writes-per-second`); `0` disables the pacing. | `25` |
| `manager.remediation.ioWorkers` | Goroutines for the loop's `/data` calls (`--remediation-io-workers`, 1-64). | `8` |
| `manager.legacyFold.mode` | This release's adoption of SubtitleRequests, TranscodeJobs and AudioGrafts into MediaFile status (`--legacy-fold`): `apply`, or `hold` to write nothing about them. The next chart release removes it. | `apply` |
| `manager.legacyFold.retain` | How long an adoption stands before the legacy object is deleted (`--legacy-fold-retain`). | `72h` |
| `manager.resources`/`.nodeSelector`/`.tolerations`/`.affinity` | The manager's resources (also the input to [GOMEMLIMIT](#gomemlimit)) and scheduling. It always runs one replica. | see `values.yaml` |
| `agents.<domain>.enabled` | Render that agent (`catalog`, `events`, `metadata`, `import`, `index`, `caption`). | `true` |
| `agents.<domain>.replicas` | Replicas with `autoscaling.enabled=false` (`catalog`, `events`, `import`, `caption`). `metadata` and `index` always run one. | `1` |
| `agents.<domain>.consumerSlots` | Per-pod handler slots by consumer (`CLUSTARR_CONSUMER_SLOTS`), also the HPA's per-pod target; only that domain's consumers. | `{}` |
| `agents.<domain>.resources`/`.nodeSelector`/`.tolerations`/`.affinity` | Standard resources and scheduling. | see `values.yaml` |
| `agents.index.facade.service.type`/`.port` | The Torznab facade Service (`/{indexer}/api`, `/{indexer}/download`, `/search/api`). | `ClusterIP`, `8080` |
| `agents.index.facade.apiKeySecret` | Secret holding the facade's API keys; empty means `<release>-indexarr-facade`, created by the index agent with one random key. | `""` |
| `markers.enabled`/`.replicas`/`.consumerSlots`/`.resources` | Skip-segment detection; `consumerSlots.segmentarr-analyze` is its per-pod analyses. | `true`, `1`, `{}` |
```

```go
func kubectlOut(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, args ...string) []byte {
 t.Helper()
 cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "kubectl", append([]string{"--context", KubeContext, "-n", Namespace}, args...)...)
 out, err := cmd.Output()
 require.NoError(t, err, "kubectl %v", args)
 return out

// TestCaptionAgentScalesFromZero is spec §11.2's gate-6 scenario (§10.4).
// With config/e2e's min-replicas floor removed, agent-caption scales to zero
// on an empty queue, the manager's External Metrics API reports its lag as
// 0, a new file's subtitle fetch tasks (planned in its status.subtitles by the
// manager's remediation loop, ADR-0016) wake it within two minutes and its
// sidecar appears, and it returns to zero. It runs last (zzz_scale sorts
// after zzz_observability) because it removes the always-a-pod guarantee the
// other scenarios rely on; the cleanup restores it.
func TestCaptionAgentScalesFromZero(t *testing.T) {
 ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Minute)
 defer cancel()
 const deployment = "agent-caption"
 kubectlOut(ctx, t, "annotate", "deployment", deployment, agentdomain.AnnotationMinReplicas+"-")
 t.Cleanup(func() {
  cctx, ccancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 6*time.Minute)
  defer ccancel()
  kubectlOut(cctx, t, "annotate", "--overwrite", "deployment", deployment, agentdomain.AnnotationMinReplicas+"=1")
  kubectlOut(cctx, t, "wait", "--for=condition=Available", "deployment/"+deployment, "--timeout=300s")
 })
 replicas := func(ctx context.Context) int32 {
  var d appsv1.Deployment
  if err := k8sClient.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: Namespace, Name: deployment}, &d); err != nil {
   return -1
  }
  return d.Status.Replicas
 }

 // The 300 s scale-down window plus HPA syncs.
 waitFor(t, ctx, 7*time.Minute, deployment+" scaled to zero",
  func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) { return replicas(ctx) == 0, nil })
 raw := kubectlOut(ctx, t, "get", "--raw",
  "/apis/external.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/"+Namespace+"/clustarr_consumer_lag?labelSelector=consumer%3Dcaptionarr-fetch-high")
 var list struct {
  Items []struct {
   Value string `json:"value"`
  } `json:"items"`
 }
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &list), "%s", raw)
 require.Len(t, list.Items, 1, "one series for captionarr-fetch-high")
 assert.Equal(t, "0", list.Items[0].Value, "an empty queue reads lag 0")

 // A new file wanting subtitles: the loop plans status.subtitles and
 // publishes its fetch tasks.
 mf, profile, mfKey := setUpSubtitleFixture(ctx, t, "e2e-scale0")
 waitFor(t, ctx, 2*time.Minute, deployment+" woke from zero",
  func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) { return replicas(ctx) >= 1, nil })
 sidecar := hostPath(subtitles.SidecarName(mf.Spec.Path, "en", string(profile.Spec.HIExtension)))
 waitFor(t, ctx, subtitleFetchTimeout, "the en sidecar for "+mf.Name,
  func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) { _, err := os.Stat(sidecar); return err == nil, nil },
  describeSubtitles(mfKey))
 waitFor(t, ctx, 7*time.Minute, deployment+" back to zero",
  func(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) { return replicas(ctx) == 0, nil })
}
```

```go
// TestTheWorkflowsCheckImagesThroughOneScript: CI and the release check
// images only through hack/image-checks.sh, naming checks it defines, build
// only the images that exist, and CI refuses a go.mod that replaces a module
// with a local directory, naming the cause, instead of failing obscurely in
// go mod download.
func TestTheWorkflowsCheckImagesThroughOneScript(t *testing.T) {
 root := installtest.RepoRoot(t)
 patterns := imageCheckPatterns(t, root)
 known := func(c string) bool {
  for _, p := range patterns {
   if p.MatchString(c) {
    return true
   }
  }
  return false
 }
 type step struct {
  Name string `json:"name"`
  Run  string `json:"run"`
 }
 type job struct {
  Strategy struct {
   Matrix struct {
    Include []map[string]any `json:"include"`
   } `json:"matrix"`
  } `json:"strategy"`
  Steps []step `json:"steps"`
 }
 for _, f := range []string{".github/workflows/ci.yml", ".github/workflows/release.yml"} {
  raw := readRepoFile(t, root, f)
  for _, gone := range []string{"kedacore", "Dockerfile.media", "Dockerfile.transcoder", "Dockerfile.controller", "--self-check="} {
   assert.NotContains(t, string(raw), gone, f)
  }
  var wf struct {
   Jobs map[string]job `json:"jobs"`
  }
  require.NoError(t, yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &wf), f)
  var checksRun bool
  for name, j := range wf.Jobs {
   for _, inc := range j.Strategy.Matrix.Include {
    checks, _ := inc["checks"].(string)
    for _, c := range strings.Fields(checks) {
     assert.True(t, known(c), "%s job %s's matrix names check %q, which hack/image-checks.sh does not define", f, name, c)
    }
   }
   for _, s := range j.Steps {
    if strings.Contains(s.Run, "hack/image-checks.sh") {
     checksRun = true
    }
    assert.NotContains(t, s.Run, "docker run", "%s job %s step %q checks an image itself", f, name, s.Name)
   }
  }
  assert.True(t, checksRun, "%s never runs hack/image-checks.sh", f)
 }
 assert.Contains(t, string(readRepoFile(t, root, ".github/workflows/ci.yml")), `grep -nE '^replace .* => \.{1,2}/' go.mod`)
}
```

```yaml
# locally (`make generate manifests build lint test`, plus `go vet -tags e2e`).
```

```yaml
  images:
    name: image ${{ matrix.image }} (${{ matrix.arch }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { image: clustarr, file: images/Dockerfile.clustarr, target: clustarr, arch: amd64, runner: ubuntu-24.04,
              checks: "version:manager version:ui no-shell" }
          - { image: native, file: images/Dockerfile.native, target: native, arch: amd64, runner: ubuntu-24.04,
              checks: "self-check:transcode:cpu self-check:transcode:cuda self-check:transcode:intel self-check:agent version:agent version:markers version:transcode no-shell" }
          - { image: native, file: images/Dockerfile.native, target: native, arch: arm64, runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm,
              checks: "self-check:transcode:cpu self-check:agent version:agent version:markers version:transcode no-shell" }
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1

      - name: Build ${{ matrix.image }}
        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
        with:
          context: .
          file: ${{ matrix.file }}
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          platforms: linux/${{ matrix.arch }}
          load: true
          tags: selfcheck/${{ matrix.image }}:ci
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.image }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ matrix.image }}-${{ matrix.arch }}

      # The one definition of the image checks (hack/image-checks.sh); GPU
      # encodes need hardware (--trial, run on hosts that have it).
      - name: Check ${{ matrix.image }}
        env:
          IMAGE: selfcheck/${{ matrix.image }}:ci
          CHECKS: ${{ matrix.checks }}
        # CHECKS is a space-separated list, split on purpose.
        run: hack/image-checks.sh "$IMAGE" $CHECKS
```
